ये पुत्रा जज्ञिरे शूराः समस्तांस् तान् निबोधत //
text_mt: The heroic sons who were born of the seven illustrious wives / of Vasudeva—hear about them all.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojaś ca vijayaś caiva śāntidevāsutāv ubhau
vṛkadevaḥ sunāmāyāṃ gadaś cāstāṃ sutāv ubhau //
meaning:
भोजश् च विजयश् चैव शान्तिदेवासुताव् उभौ
वृकदेवः सुनामायां गदश् चास्तां सुताव् उभौ //
text_mt: Bhoja and Vijaya were both sons of Śāntidevā; / Vṛkadeva and Gada were both sons born of Sunāmā.

sanskrit_iast:
agāvahaṃ mahātmānaṃ vṛkadevī vyajāyata
kanyā trigartarājasya bhāryā vai śiśirāyaṇeḥ //
meaning:
अगावहं महात्मानं वृकदेवी व्यजायत
कन्या त्रिगर्तराजस्य भार्या वै शिशिरायणेः //
text_mt: Vṛkadevī gave birth to the great-souled Agāvaha. / The daughter of the king of Trigarta was the wife of the descendant of Śiśira.

sanskrit_iast:
jijñāsāṃ pauruṣe cakre na caskande ca pauruṣam
kṛṣṇāyasasamaprakhyo varṣe dvādaśame tathā //
meaning:
जिज्ञासां पौरुषे चक्रे न चस्कन्दे च पौरुषम्
कृष्णायससमप्रख्यो वर्षे द्वादशमे तथा //
text_mt: He made a trial of his virility, and his virility did not fail; / having the appearance of black iron, in his twelfth year likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
mithyābhiśasto gārgyas tu manyunātisamīritaḥ
ghoṣakanyām upādāya maithunāyopacakrame //
meaning:
मिथ्याभिशस्तो गार्ग्यस् तु मन्युनातिसमीरितः
घोषकन्याम् उपादाय मैथुनायोपचक्रमे //
text_mt: Gārgya, falsely accused and exceedingly impelled by anger, / took a maiden from the cowherd settlement and approached her for intercourse.

sanskrit_iast:
gopālī cāpsarās tasya gopastrīveṣadhāriṇī
dhārayām āsa gārgyasya garbhaṃ durdharam acyutam //
meaning:
गोपाली चाप्सरास् तस्य गोपस्त्रीवेषधारिणी
धारयाम् आस गार्ग्यस्य गर्भं दुर्धरम् अच्युतम् //
text_mt: And the apsaras Gopālī, assuming the disguise of a cowherd woman, / bore the hard-to-bear, unfailing embryo of Gārgya.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyāṃ gargabhāryāyāṃ niyogāc chūlapāṇinaḥ
sa kālayavano nāma jajñe rājā mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
मानुष्यां गर्गभार्यायां नियोगाच् छूलपाणिनः
स कालयवनो नाम जज्ञे राजा महाबलः //
text_mt: In the human wife of Garga, by the command of the Spear-bearer, / that mighty king named Kālayavana was born.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttapūrvārdhakāyas tu siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā
aputrasya sa rājñas tu vavṛdhe 'ntaḥpure śiśuḥ //
meaning:
वृत्तपूर्वार्धकायस् तु सिंहसंहननो युवा
अपुत्रस्य स राज्ञस् तु ववृधे ऽन्तःपुरे शिशुः //
text_mt: With the upper half of his body rounded, a youth with the build of a lion, / that child grew up in the inner apartments of the king who had no son.

sanskrit_iast:
yavanasya muniśreṣṭhāḥ sa kālayavano 'bhavat
āyudhyamāno nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchad dvijottamam //
meaning:
यवनस्य मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स कालयवनो ऽभवत्
आयुध्यमानो नृपतिः पर्यपृच्छद् द्विजोत्तमम् //
text_mt: He became Kālayavana, the king of the Yavanas, O best of sages. / Desiring battle, that ruler of men questioned the foremost of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣṇyandhakakulaṃ tasya nārado 'kathayad vibhuḥ
akṣauhiṇyā tu sainyasya mathurām abhyayāt tadā //
meaning:
वृष्ण्यन्धककुलं तस्य नारदो ऽकथयद् विभुः
अक्षौहिण्या तु सैन्यस्य मथुराम् अभ्ययात् तदा //
text_mt: The powerful Nārada told him of the clan of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas. / Then with an akṣauhiṇī of troops he marched against Mathurā.

sanskrit_iast:
dūtaṃ saṃpreṣayām āsa vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśanam
tato vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ puraskṛtya mahāmatim //
meaning:
दूतं संप्रेषयाम् आस वृष्ण्यन्धकनिवेशनम्
ततो वृष्ण्यन्धकाः कृष्णं पुरस्कृत्य महामतिम् //
text_mt: He dispatched a messenger to the dwelling of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas. / Then the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, placing the wise Kṛṣṇa at their head,

sanskrit_iast:
sametā mantrayām āsur yavanasya bhayāt tadā
kṛtvā viniścayaṃ sarve palāyanam arocayan //
meaning:
समेता मन्त्रयाम् आसुर् यवनस्य भयात् तदा
कृत्वा विनिश्चयं सर्वे पलायनम् अरोचयन् //
text_mt: assembled and took counsel then out of fear of the Yavana. / Having made their decision, all resolved upon flight,

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya mathurāṃ ramyāṃ mānayantaḥ pinākinam
kuśasthalīṃ dvāravatīṃ niveśayitum īpsavaḥ //
meaning:
विहाय मथुरां रम्यां मानयन्तः पिनाकिनम्
कुशस्थलीं द्वारवतीं निवेशयितुम् ईप्सवः //
text_mt: leaving delightful Mathurā, showing respect to the Wielder of the Pināka, / and desiring to settle in Kuśasthalī-Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
iti kṛṣṇasya janmedaṃ yaḥ śucir niyatendriyaḥ
parvasu śrāvayed vidvān anṛṇaḥ sa sukhī bhavet //
meaning:
इति कृष्णस्य जन्मेदं यः शुचिर् नियतेन्द्रियः
पर्वसु श्रावयेद् विद्वान् अनृणः स सुखी भवेत् //
text_mt: If a learned person, pure and self-restrained, recites this birth of Kṛṣṇa / on sacred days, he becomes free from debt and happy.

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
kroṣṭor athābhavat putro vṛjinīvān mahāyaśāḥ
vārjinīvatam icchanti svāhiṃ svāhākṛtāṃ varam //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
क्रोष्टोर् अथाभवत् पुत्रो वृजिनीवान् महायशाः
वार्जिनीवतम् इच्छन्ति स्वाहिं स्वाहाकृतां वरम् //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / Then the son of Kroṣṭu was the highly renowned Vṛjinīvat. / They consider Svāhi, the best among those who make oblations, to be the son of Vṛjinīvat.

sanskrit_iast:
svāhiputro 'bhavad rājā uṣadgur vadatāṃ varaḥ
mahākratubhir īje yo vividhair bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ //
meaning:
स्वाहिपुत्रो ऽभवद् राजा उषद्गुर् वदतां वरः
महाक्रतुभिर् ईजे यो विविधैर् भूरिदक्षिणैः //
text_mt: The son of Svāhi was King Uṣadgu, the best of speakers, / who sacrificed with great rites of various kinds, accompanied by abundant sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasūtim icchan vai uṣadguḥ so 'gryam ātmajam
jajñe citrarathas tasya putraḥ karmabhir anvitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रसूतिम् इच्छन् वै उषद्गुः सो ऽग्र्यम् आत्मजम्
जज्ञे चित्ररथस् तस्य पुत्रः कर्मभिर् अन्वितः //
text_mt: Then Uṣadgu, desiring offspring, [obtained] a foremost son; / his son Citraratha, devoted to virtuous deeds, was born.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīc caitrarathir vīro yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ
śaśabinduḥ paraṃ vṛttaṃ rājarṣīṇām anuṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
आसीच् चैत्ररथिर् वीरो यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः
शशबिन्दुः परं वृत्तं राजर्षीणाम् अनुष्ठितः //
text_mt: Citraratha's son was the heroic Śaśabindu, a sacrificer with lavish sacrificial gifts, / who followed the supreme conduct of royal sages.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthuśravāḥ pṛthuyaśā rājāsīc chāśibindavaḥ
śaṃsanti ca purāṇajñāḥ pārthaśravasam antaram //
meaning:
पृथुश्रवाः पृथुयशा राजासीच् छाशिबिन्दवः
शंसन्ति च पुराणज्ञाः पार्थश्रवसम् अन्तरम् //
text_mt: Pṛthuśravas of vast renown was the king born of Śaśabindu; / and those knowledgeable in the Purāṇas praise Antara, the son of Pṛthuśravas.

sanskrit_iast:
antarasya suyajñas tu suyajñatanayo 'bhavat
uṣato yajñam akhilaṃ svadharme ca kṛtādaraḥ //
meaning:
अन्तरस्य सुयज्ञस् तु सुयज्ञतनयो ऽभवत्
उषतो यज्ञम् अखिलं स्वधर्मे च कृतादरः //
text_mt: The son of Antara was Suyajña, and Suyajña's son / was Uśat, who performed every sacrifice and was devoted to his own dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
śineyur abhavat putra uṣataḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
marutas tasya tanayo rājarṣir abhavan nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
शिनेयुर् अभवत् पुत्र उषतः शत्रुतापनः
मरुतस् तस्य तनयो राजर्षिर् अभवन् नृपः //
text_mt: Uṣat's son was Śineyu, a scorcher of enemies; / his son was King Marutta, a royal sage.

sanskrit_iast:
maruto 'labhata jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ kambalabarhiṣam
cacāra vipulaṃ dharmam amarṣāt pratyabhāg api //
meaning:
मरुतो ऽलभत ज्येष्ठं सुतं कम्बलबर्हिषम्
चचार विपुलं धर्मम् अमर्षात् प्रत्यभाग् अपि //
text_mt: Marutta obtained as his eldest son Kambalabarhis; / he performed abundant dharma, and received his share out of impatience.

sanskrit_iast:
sa satprasūtim icchan vai sutaṃ kambalabarhiṣaḥ
babhūva rukmakavacaḥ śataprasavataḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
स सत्प्रसूतिम् इच्छन् वै सुतं कम्बलबर्हिषः
बभूव रुक्मकवचः शतप्रसवतः सुतः //
text_mt: Desiring good progeny, Kambalabarhis [begot] a son; / Rukmakavaca was born as his son out of a hundred births.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatya rukmakavacaḥ śataṃ kavacināṃ raṇe
dhanvināṃ niśitair bāṇair avāpa śriyam uttamām //
meaning:
निहत्य रुक्मकवचः शतं कवचिनां रणे
धन्विनां निशितैर् बाणैर् अवाप श्रियम् उत्तमाम् //
text_mt: Having slain in battle a hundred mail-clad archers / with his sharp arrows, Rukmakavaca attained supreme glory.

sanskrit_iast:
jajñe ca rukmakavacāt parajit paravīrahā
jajñire pañca putrās tu mahāvīryāḥ parājitāḥ //
meaning:
जज्ञे च रुक्मकवचात् परजित् परवीरहा
जज्ञिरे पञ्च पुत्रास् तु महावीर्याः पराजिताः //
text_mt: From Rukmakavaca was born Parājit, a slayer of enemy heroes; / and five sons were born to Parājit, possessing great valor:

sanskrit_iast:
rukmeṣuḥ pṛthurukmaś ca jyāmaghaḥ pālito hariḥ
pālitaṃ ca hariṃ caiva videhebhyaḥ pitā dadau //
meaning:
रुक्मेषुः पृथुरुक्मश् च ज्यामघः पालितो हरिः
पालितं च हरिं चैव विदेहेभ्यः पिता ददौ //
text_mt: Rukmeṣu, Pṛthurukma, Jyāmagha, Pālita, and Hari. / The father gave Pālita and Hari to the Videhas.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmeṣur abhavad rājā pṛthurukmasya saṃśrayāt
tābhyāṃ pravrājito rājā jyāmagho 'vasad āśrame //
meaning:
रुक्मेषुर् अभवद् राजा पृथुरुक्मस्य संश्रयात्
ताभ्यां प्रव्राजितो राजा ज्यामघो ऽवसद् आश्रमे //
text_mt: Rukmeṣu became king by depending upon Pṛthurukma; / banished by the two of them, King Jyāmagha dwelt in a hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
praśāntaś ca tadā rājā brāhmaṇaiś cāvabodhitaḥ
jagāma dhanur ādāya deśam anyaṃ dhvajī rathī //
meaning:
प्रशान्तश् च तदा राजा ब्राह्मणैश् चावबोधितः
जगाम धनुर् आदाय देशम् अन्यं ध्वजी रथी //
text_mt: Having become calm and instructed by the brahmins, / the king, taking his bow, an owner of banners and a car-warrior, went to another land.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadākūlam ekākīm ekalāṃ mṛttikāvatīm
ṛkṣavantaṃ giriṃ jitvā śuktimatyām uvāsa saḥ //
meaning:
नर्मदाकूलम् एकाकीम् एकलां मृत्तिकावतीम्
ऋक्षवन्तं गिरिं जित्वा शुक्तिमत्याम् उवास सः //
text_mt: Conquering the bank of the Narmadā, solitary Mṛttikāvatī, / and the Ṛkṣavat mountain, he dwelt on the Śuktimatī.

sanskrit_iast:
jyāmaghasyābhavad bhāryā śaibyā balavatī satī
aputro 'pi sa rājā vai nānyāṃ bhāryām avindata //
meaning:
ज्यामघस्याभवद् भार्या शैब्या बलवती सती
अपुत्रो ऽपि स राजा वै नान्यां भार्याम् अविन्दत //
text_mt: Jyāmagha had a wife named Śaibyā, strong and faithful; / though sonless, that king did not take another wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsīd vijayo yuddhe tatra kanyām avāpa saḥ
bhāryām uvāca saṃtrastaḥ snuṣeti sa janeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तस्यासीद् विजयो युद्धे तत्र कन्याम् अवाप सः
भार्याम् उवाच संत्रस्तः स्नुषेति स जनेश्वरः //
text_mt: Victory in battle was his, and there he won a maiden; / terrified, that lord of men said to his wife: 'She is your daughter-in-law.'

sanskrit_iast:
etac chrutvābravīd devī kasya deva snuṣeti vai
abravīt tad upaśrutya jyāmagho rājasattamaḥ //
meaning:
एतच् छ्रुत्वाब्रवीद् देवी कस्य देव स्नुषेति वै
अब्रवीत् तद् उपश्रुत्य ज्यामघो राजसत्तमः //
text_mt: Hearing this, the queen said: 'Whose daughter-in-law, my lord?' / Hearing that, Jyāmagha, the best of kings, replied:

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
yas te janiṣyate putras tasya bhāryopapāditā //
meaning:
राजोवाच
यस् ते जनिष्यते पुत्रस् तस्य भार्योपपादिता //
text_mt: The king said: / 'A wife has been provided for the son who will be born to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
ugreṇa tapasā tasyāḥ kanyāyāḥ sā vyajāyata
putraṃ vidarbhaṃ subhāgā śaibyā pariṇatā satī //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
उग्रेण तपसा तस्याः कन्यायाः सा व्यजायत
पुत्रं विदर्भं सुभागा शैब्या परिणता सती //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / By severe asceticism, through that maiden, the fortunate and virtuous / Śaibyā, though aged, brought forth a son, Vidarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
rājaputryāṃ tu vidvāṃsau snuṣāyāṃ krathakaiśikau
paścād vidarbho 'janayac chūrau raṇaviśāradau //
meaning:
राजपुत्र्यां तु विद्वांसौ स्नुषायां क्रथकैशिकौ
पश्चाद् विदर्भो ऽजनयच् छूरौ रणविशारदौ //
text_mt: Afterwards, Vidarbha begot on the princess, his daughter-in-law, / two wise sons, Kratha and Kaiśika, heroic and skilled in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmo vidarbhasya sutaḥ kuntis tasyātmajo 'bhavat
kunter dhṛṣṭaḥ suto jajñe raṇadhṛṣṭaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
भीमो विदर्भस्य सुतः कुन्तिस् तस्यात्मजो ऽभवत्
कुन्तेर् धृष्टः सुतो जज्ञे रणधृष्टः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: Vidarbha's son was Bhīma; Kunti was his son; / to Kunti was born a son Dhṛṣṭa, daring in battle and glorious.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛṣṭasya jajñire śūrās trayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
āvantaś ca daśārhaś ca balī viṣaharaś ca saḥ //
meaning:
धृष्टस्य जज्ञिरे शूरास् त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
आवन्तश् च दशार्हश् च बली विषहरश् च सः //
text_mt: To Dhṛṣṭa were born three heroic, supremely righteous [sons]: / Āvanta, Daśārha, and the mighty Viṣahara.

sanskrit_iast:
daśārhasya suto vyomā vyomno jīmūta ucyate
jīmūtaputro vikṛtis tasya bhīmarathaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दशार्हस्य सुतो व्योमा व्योम्नो जीमूत उच्यते
जीमूतपुत्रो विकृतिस् तस्य भीमरथः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Daśārha's son was Vyoman; Vyoman's [son] is called Jīmūta; / Jīmūta's son was Vikṛti; his [son] is traditionally remembered as Bhīmaratha.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhīmarathasyāsīt putro navarathas tathā
tasya cāsīd daśarathaḥ śakunis tasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
अथ भीमरथस्यासीत् पुत्रो नवरथस् तथा
तस्य चासीद् दशरथः शकुनिस् तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: Then Bhīmaratha had a son Navaratha; / and he had Daśaratha, and Śakuni was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt karambhaḥ kārambhir devarāto 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
devakṣatro 'bhavat tasya vṛddhakṣatro mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् करम्भः कारम्भिर् देवरातो ऽभवन् नृपः
देवक्षत्रो ऽभवत् तस्य वृद्धक्षत्रो महायशाः //
text_mt: From him came Karambha; from Karambha came King Devarāta; / Devakṣatra was his [son], [and] Vṛddhakṣatra of great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
devagarbhasamo jajñe devakṣatrasya nandanaḥ
madhūnāṃ vaṃśakṛd rājā madhur madhuravāg api //
meaning:
देवगर्भसमो जज्ञे देवक्षत्रस्य नन्दनः
मधूनां वंशकृद् राजा मधुर् मधुरवाग् अपि //
text_mt: Devakṣatra's delight was born equal to a child of the gods, / King Madhu, sweet of speech, the founder of the dynasty of the Madhus.

sanskrit_iast:
madhor jajñe 'tha vaidarbhyāṃ purudvān puruṣottamaḥ
aikṣvākī cābhavad bhāryā madhos tasyāṃ vyajāyata //
meaning:
मधोर् जज्ञे ऽथ वैदर्भ्यां पुरुद्वान् पुरुषोत्तमः
ऐक्ष्वाकी चाभवद् भार्या मधोस् तस्यां व्यजायत //
text_mt: From Madhu was then born Purudvat on Vaidarbhī, a Puruṣottama; / and Madhu had an Aikṣvākī wife; upon her was born

sanskrit_iast:
satvān sarvaguṇopetaḥ sātvatā kīrtivardhanaḥ
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ vijñāya jyāmaghasya mahātmanaḥ
yujyate paramaprītyā prajāvāṃś ca bhavet sadā //
meaning:
सत्वान् सर्वगुणोपेतः सात्वता कीर्तिवर्धनः
इमां विसृष्टिं विज्ञाय ज्यामघस्य महात्मनः
युज्यते परमप्रीत्या प्रजावांश् च भवेत् सदा //
text_mt: Satvan, endowed with all virtues, an increaser of the fame of the Sātvatas. / Knowing this progeny of the great-souled Jyāmagha, / one is united with supreme delight and will always possess offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
satvataḥ sattvasaṃpannān kauśalyā suṣuve sutān
bhāginaṃ bhajamānaṃ ca divyaṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
सत्वतः सत्त्वसंपन्नान् कौशल्या सुषुवे सुतान्
भागिनं भजमानं च दिव्यं देवावृधं नृपम् //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / Kauśalyā bore to Satvata sons endowed with vigor: / Bhāgina, Bhajamāna, and the divine king Devāvṛdha,

sanskrit_iast:
andhakaṃ ca mahābāhuṃ vṛṣṇiṃ ca yadunandanam
teṣāṃ visargāś catvāro vistareṇeha kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अन्धकं च महाबाहुं वृष्णिं च यदुनन्दनम्
तेषां विसर्गाश् चत्वारो विस्तरेणेह कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: and the mighty-armed Andhaka, and Vṛṣṇi, the delighter of the Yadus. / Their four lineages are proclaimed here in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajamānasya sṛñjayyau bāhyakāthopabāhyakā
āstāṃ bhārye tayos tasmāj jajñire bahavaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
भजमानस्य सृञ्जय्यौ बाह्यकाथोपबाह्यका
आस्तां भार्ये तयोस् तस्माज् जज्ञिरे बहवः सुताः //
text_mt: Bhajamāna had two wives of the Sṛñjaya clan, Bāhyakā and Upabāhyakā; / from the two of them were born many sons to him:

sanskrit_iast:
krimiś ca kramaṇaś caiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śūraḥ puraṃjayaḥ
ete bāhyakasṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānād vijajñire //
meaning:
क्रिमिश् च क्रमणश् चैव धृष्टः शूरः पुरंजयः
एते बाह्यकसृञ्जय्यां भजमानाद् विजज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Krimi, Kramaṇa, Dhṛṣṭa, the hero, and Puraṃjaya: / these were born of Bhajamāna upon the Sṛñjayī Bāhyakā.

sanskrit_iast:
āyutājit sahasrājic chatājit tv atha dāsakaḥ
upabāhyakasṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānād vijajñire //
meaning:
आयुताजित् सहस्राजिच् छताजित् त्व् अथ दासकः
उपबाह्यकसृञ्जय्यां भजमानाद् विजज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Ayutājit, Sahasrājit, Śatājit, and Dāsaka / were born of Bhajamāna upon the Sṛñjayī Upabāhyakā.

sanskrit_iast:
yajvā devāvṛdho rājā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama syād iti niścitaḥ //
meaning:
यज्वा देवावृधो राजा चचार विपुलं तपः
पुत्रः सर्वगुणोपेतो मम स्याद् इति निश्चितः //
text_mt: King Devāvṛdha, a sacrificer, performed intense austerity, / having resolved: 'May I have a son endowed with all good qualities.'

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyujyamānas tapasā parṇāśāyā jalaṃ spṛśan
sadopaspṛśatas tasya cakāra priyam āpagā //
meaning:
संयुज्यमानस् तपसा पर्णाशाया जलं स्पृशन्
सदोपस्पृशतस् तस्य चकार प्रियम् आपगा //
text_mt: Practicing austerity and touching the water of the Parṇāśā, / as he was constantly touching its water, the river did him a kindness.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayābhiparītā sā na jagāmaiva niścayam
kalyāṇatvān narapates tasya sā nimnagottamā //
meaning:
चिन्तयाभिपरीता सा न जगामैव निश्चयम्
कल्याणत्वान् नरपतेस् तस्य सा निम्नगोत्तमा //
text_mt: Beset with anxious thought, she could not come to a conclusion; / on account of that king's excellence, that best of streams [pondered]:

sanskrit_iast:
nādhyagacchat tu tāṃ nārīṃ yasyām evaṃvidhaḥ sutaḥ
bhavet tasmāt svayaṃ gatvā bhavāmy asya sahānugā //
meaning:
नाध्यगच्छत् तु तां नारीं यस्याम् एवंविधः सुतः
भवेत् तस्मात् स्वयं गत्वा भवाम्य् अस्य सहानुगा //
text_mt: 'I do not find any woman in whom such a son / could be born; therefore, going myself, I shall become his companion.'

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhūtvā kumārī sā bibhratī paramaṃ vapuḥ
varayām āsa nṛpatiṃ tām iyeṣa ca sa prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अथ भूत्वा कुमारी सा बिभ्रती परमं वपुः
वरयाम् आस नृपतिं ताम् इयेष च स प्रभुः //
text_mt: Then, becoming a maiden possessing supreme beauty, / she chose the king, and that lord desired her.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyām ādhatta garbhaṃ sa tejasvinam udāradhīḥ
atha sā daśame māsi suṣuve saritāṃ varā //
meaning:
तस्याम् आधत्त गर्भं स तेजस्विनम् उदारधीः
अथ सा दशमे मासि सुषुवे सरितां वरा //
text_mt: In her he, noble-minded, deposited a radiant embryo; / then in the tenth month that best of rivers brought forth

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ babhruṃ devāvṛdhaṃ dvijāḥ
atra vaṃśe purāṇajñā gāyantīti pariśrutam //
meaning:
पुत्रं सर्वगुणोपेतं बभ्रुं देवावृधं द्विजाः
अत्र वंशे पुराणज्ञा गायन्तीति परिश्रुतम् //
text_mt: a son endowed with all virtues, Babhru Devāvṛdha, O twice-born ones. / In this lineage, those who know the Purāṇas sing this celebrated [verse],

sanskrit_iast:
guṇān devāvṛdhasyāpi kīrtayanto mahātmanaḥ
yathaivāgre tathā dūrāt paśyāmas tāvad antikāt //
meaning:
गुणान् देवावृधस्यापि कीर्तयन्तो महात्मनः
यथैवाग्रे तथा दूरात् पश्यामस् तावद् अन्तिकात् //
text_mt: praising also the qualities of the great-souled Devāvṛdha: / 'Just as we see him from nearby, even so we see him from afar.

sanskrit_iast:
babhruḥ śreṣṭho manuṣyāṇāṃ devair devāvṛdhaḥ samaḥ
ṣaṣṭiś ca ṣaṭ ca puruṣāḥ sahasrāṇi ca sapta ca //
meaning:
बभ्रुः श्रेष्ठो मनुष्याणां देवैर् देवावृधः समः
षष्टिश् च षट् च पुरुषाः सहस्राणि च सप्त च //
text_mt: Babhru is the best among men, and Devāvṛdha is equal to the gods. / Sixty-six men and seven thousand [besides]—

sanskrit_iast:
ete 'mṛtatvaṃ prāptā vai babhror devāvṛdhād api
yajvā dānapatir dhīmān brahmaṇyaḥ sudṛḍhāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
एते ऽमृतत्वं प्राप्ता वै बभ्रोर् देवावृधाद् अपि
यज्वा दानपतिर् धीमान् ब्रह्मण्यः सुदृढायुधः //
text_mt: these indeed attained immortality through Babhru and Devāvṛdha.' / A sacrificer, a generous lord, wise, devoted to brahmins, and of steadfast weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyānvavāyaḥ sumahān bhojā ye sārtikāvatāḥ
andhakāt kāśyaduhitā caturo 'labhatātmajān //
meaning:
तस्यान्ववायः सुमहान् भोजा ये सार्तिकावताः
अन्धकात् काश्यदुहिता चतुरो ऽलभतात्मजान् //
text_mt: his lineage was exceedingly great, namely the Bhojas who belong to Mṛttikāvatī. / The daughter of the Kāśi king bore four sons to Andhaka:

sanskrit_iast:
kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca sasakaṃ balabarhiṣam
kukurasya suto vṛṣṭir vṛṣṭes tu tanayas tathā //
meaning:
कुकुरं भजमानं च ससकं बलबर्हिषम्
कुकुरस्य सुतो वृष्टिर् वृष्टेस् तु तनयस् तथा //
text_mt: Kukura, Bhajamāna, Sasaka, and Balabarhis. / Kukura's son was Vṛṣṭi, and the son of Vṛṣṭi was likewise

sanskrit_iast:
kapotaromā tasyātha tiliris tanayo 'bhavat
jajñe punar vasus tasmād abhijic ca punar vasoḥ //
meaning:
कपोतरोमा तस्याथ तिलिरिस् तनयो ऽभवत्
जज्ञे पुनर् वसुस् तस्माद् अभिजिच् च पुनर् वसोः //
text_mt: Kapotaroman; then his son was Tiliris. / From him was born Punarvasu, and from Punarvasu Abhijit.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vai putramithunaṃ babhūvābhijitaḥ kila
āhukaḥ śrāhukaś caiva khyātau khyātimatāṃ varau //
meaning:
तथा वै पुत्रमिथुनं बभूवाभिजितः किल
आहुकः श्राहुकश् चैव ख्यातौ ख्यातिमतां वरौ //
text_mt: And indeed, a pair of sons was born to Abhijit, it is said: / Āhuka and Śrāhuka, renowned, best among the famous.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ codāharanty atra gāthāṃ prati tam āhukam
śvetena parivāreṇa kiśorapratimo mahān //
meaning:
इमां चोदाहरन्त्य् अत्र गाथां प्रति तम् आहुकम्
श्वेतेन परिवारेण किशोरप्रतिमो महान् //
text_mt: Here they also quote this verse concerning that Āhuka: / 'With his white retinue, the great one, resembling a colt,

sanskrit_iast:
aśītivarmaṇā yukta āhukaḥ prathamaṃ vrajet
nāputravān nāśatado nāsahasraśatāyuṣaḥ //
meaning:
अशीतिवर्मणा युक्त आहुकः प्रथमं व्रजेत्
नापुत्रवान् नाशतदो नासहस्रशतायुषः //
text_mt: equipped with eighty armors, Āhuka would march first. / None was childless, none had given less than a hundred, none lived less than a hundred and a thousand [years],

sanskrit_iast:
nāśuddhakarmā nāyajvā yo bhojam abhito vrajet
pūrvasyāṃ diśi nāgānāṃ bhojasya prayayuḥ kila //
meaning:
नाशुद्धकर्मा नायज्वा यो भोजम् अभितो व्रजेत्
पूर्वस्यां दिशि नागानां भोजस्य प्रययुः किल //
text_mt: none was of impure deeds, none had not sacrificed, among those who marched around the Bhoja. / In the eastern direction, indeed, of the elephants belonging to the Bhoja,

sanskrit_iast:
somāt saṅgānukarṣāṇāṃ dhvajināṃ savarūthinām
rathānāṃ meghaghoṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśaiva tu //
meaning:
सोमात् सङ्गानुकर्षाणां ध्वजिनां सवरूथिनाम्
रथानां मेघघोषाणां सहस्राणि दशैव तु //
text_mt: ten thousand chariots with rumbles like clouds / advanced, their axles tied with ropes, having banners and charioteer-guards;

sanskrit_iast:
raupyakāñcanakakṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇy ekaviṃśatiḥ
tāvaty eva sahasrāṇi uttarasyāṃ tathā diśi //
meaning:
रौप्यकाञ्चनकक्षाणां सहस्राण्य् एकविंशतिः
तावत्य् एव सहस्राणि उत्तरस्यां तथा दिशि //
text_mt: twenty-one thousand [chariots] with silver and gold girdles [advanced], / and just as many thousands in the northern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
ābhūmipālā bhojās tu santi jyākiṅkiṇīkinaḥ
āhuḥ kiṃ cāpy avantibhyaḥ svasāraṃ dadur andhakāḥ //
meaning:
आभूमिपाला भोजास् तु सन्ति ज्याकिङ्किणीकिनः
आहुः किं चाप्य् अवन्तिभ्यः स्वसारं ददुर् अन्धकाः //
text_mt: The Bhojas are rulers of the earth, bearing marks made by bowstrings and bells.' / Moreover, they say the Andhakas gave their sister to the Avantis.

sanskrit_iast:
āhukasya tu kāśyāyāṃ dvau putrau saṃbabhūvatuḥ
devakaś cograsenaś ca devagarbhasamāv ubhau //
meaning:
आहुकस्य तु काश्यायां द्वौ पुत्रौ संबभूवतुः
देवकश् चोग्रसेनश् च देवगर्भसमाव् उभौ //
text_mt: To Āhuka, by the princess of Kāśi, two sons were born: / Devaka and Ugrasena, both equal to the offspring of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devakasyābhavan putrāś catvāras tridaśopamāḥ
devavān upadevaś ca saṃdevo devarakṣitaḥ //
meaning:
देवकस्याभवन् पुत्राश् चत्वारस् त्रिदशोपमाः
देववान् उपदेवश् च संदेवो देवरक्षितः //
text_mt: Devaka had four sons, who were like the thirty [gods]: / Devavān, Upadeva, Saṃdeva, and Devarakṣita.

sanskrit_iast:
kumāryaḥ sapta cāsyātha vasudevāya tā dadau
devakī śāntidevā ca sudevā devarakṣitā //
meaning:
कुमार्यः सप्त चास्याथ वसुदेवाय ता ददौ
देवकी शान्तिदेवा च सुदेवा देवरक्षिता //
text_mt: And he had seven maiden daughters; he gave them to Vasudeva: / Devakī, Śāntidevā, Sudevā, Devarakṣitā,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkadevy upadevī ca sunāmnī caiva saptamī
navograsenasya sutās teṣāṃ kaṃsas tu pūrvajaḥ //
meaning:
वृकदेव्य् उपदेवी च सुनाम्नी चैव सप्तमी
नवोग्रसेनस्य सुतास् तेषां कंसस् तु पूर्वजः //
text_mt: Vṛkadevī, Upadevī, and Sunāmnī as the seventh. / Ugrasena had nine sons; of these Kaṃsa was the eldest,

sanskrit_iast:
nyagrodhaś ca sunāmā ca tathā kaṅkaḥ subhūṣaṇaḥ
rāṣṭrapālo 'tha sutanur anāvṛṣṭis tu puṣṭimān //
meaning:
न्यग्रोधश् च सुनामा च तथा कङ्कः सुभूषणः
राष्ट्रपालो ऽथ सुतनुर् अनावृष्टिस् तु पुष्टिमान् //
text_mt: and Nyagrodha, Sunāman, Kaṅka, Subhūṣaṇa, / Rāṣṭrapāla, Sutanu, and Anāvṛṣṭi the thriving.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ pañcāsan kaṃsā kaṃsavatī tathā
sutanū rāṣṭrapālī ca kaṅkā caiva varāṅganā //
meaning:
तेषां स्वसारः पञ्चासन् कंसा कंसवती तथा
सुतनू राष्ट्रपाली च कङ्का चैव वराङ्गना //
text_mt: They had five sisters: Kaṃsā, Kaṃsavatī, / Sutanū, Rāṣṭrapālī, and Kaṅkā, an excellent woman.

sanskrit_iast:
ugrasenaḥ sahāpatyo vyākhyātaḥ kukurodbhavaḥ
kukurāṇām imaṃ vaṃśaṃ dhārayann amitaujasām //
meaning:
उग्रसेनः सहापत्यो व्याख्यातः कुकुरोद्भवः
कुकुराणाम् इमं वंशं धारयन्न् अमितौजसाम् //
text_mt: Ugrasena, born of the Kukuras, has been described along with his offspring. / A person who retains in memory this lineage of the Kukuras of boundless power,

sanskrit_iast: ātmano vipulaṃ vaṃśaṃ prajāvān āpnuyān naraḥ //
meaning: आत्मनो विपुलं वंशं प्रजावान् आप्नुयान् नरः //
text_mt: shall obtain an extensive lineage of his own, rich in offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
bhajamānasya putro 'tha rathamukhyo vidūrathaḥ
rājādhidevaḥ śūras tu vidūrathasuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
भजमानस्य पुत्रो ऽथ रथमुख्यो विदूरथः
राजाधिदेवः शूरस् तु विदूरथसुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / The son of Bhajamāna was the chief chariot-warrior Vidūratha; / the hero Rājādhideva was Vidūratha's son.

sanskrit_iast:
rājādhidevasya sutā jajñire vīryavattarāḥ
dattātidattau balinau śoṇāśvaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
राजाधिदेवस्य सुता जज्ञिरे वीर्यवत्तराः
दत्तातिदत्तौ बलिनौ शोणाश्वः श्वेतवाहनः //
text_mt: To Rājādhideva were born sons of exceedingly great prowess: / the mighty Datta and Atidatta, Śoṇāśva, Śvetavāhana,

sanskrit_iast:
śamī ca daṇḍaśarmā ca dantaśatruś ca śatrujit
śravaṇā ca śraviṣṭhā ca svasārau saṃbabhūvatuḥ //
meaning:
शमी च दण्डशर्मा च दन्तशत्रुश् च शत्रुजित्
श्रवणा च श्रविष्ठा च स्वसारौ संबभूवतुः //
text_mt: Śamī, Daṇḍaśarman, Dantaśatru, and Śatrujit. / Śravaṇā and Śraviṣṭhā were their two sisters.

sanskrit_iast:
śamiputraḥ pratikṣatraḥ pratikṣatrasya cātmajaḥ
svayaṃbhojaḥ svayaṃbhojād bhadikaḥ saṃbabhūva ha //
meaning:
शमिपुत्रः प्रतिक्षत्रः प्रतिक्षत्रस्य चात्मजः
स्वयंभोजः स्वयंभोजाद् भदिकः संबभूव ह //
text_mt: Śamī's son was Pratikṣatra, and Pratikṣatra's son / was Svayaṃbhoja; from Svayaṃbhoja was born Bhadika.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putrā babhūvur hi sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ
kṛtavarmāgrajas teṣāṃ śatadhanvā tu madhyamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर् हि सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः
कृतवर्माग्रजस् तेषां शतधन्वा तु मध्यमः //
text_mt: He indeed had sons, all of formidable valour; / Kṛtavarman was the eldest among them, and Śatadhanvan was the middle one,

sanskrit_iast:
devāntaś ca narāntaś ca bhiṣagvaitaraṇaś ca yaḥ
sudāntaś cātidāntaś ca nikāśyaḥ kāmadambhakaḥ //
meaning:
देवान्तश् च नरान्तश् च भिषग्वैतरणश् च यः
सुदान्तश् चातिदान्तश् च निकाश्यः कामदम्भकः //
text_mt: along with Devānta, Narānta, Bhiṣagvaitaraṇa, / Sudānta, Atidānta, Nikāśya, and Kāmadambhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
devāntasyābhavat putro vidvān kambalabarhiṣaḥ
asamaujāḥ sutas tasya nāsamaujāś ca tāv ubhau //
meaning:
देवान्तस्याभवत् पुत्रो विद्वान् कम्बलबर्हिषः
असमौजाः सुतस् तस्य नासमौजाश् च ताव् उभौ //
text_mt: Devānta had a learned son, Kambalabarhiṣ; / his son was Asamaujas, and Nāsatau... both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
ajātaputrāya sutān pradadāv asamaujase
sudaṃṣṭraś ca sucāruś ca kṛṣṇa ity andhakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अजातपुत्राय सुतान् प्रददाव् असमौजसे
सुदंष्ट्रश् च सुचारुश् च कृष्ण इत्य् अन्धकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: He gave sons to the sonless Asamaujas: / Sudaṃṣṭra, Sucāru, and Kṛṣṇa—these are remembered as the Andhakas.

sanskrit_iast:
gāndhārī caiva mādrī ca kroṣṭubhārye babhūvatuḥ
gāndhārī janayām āsa anamitraṃ mahābalam //
meaning:
गान्धारी चैव माद्री च क्रोष्टुभार्ये बभूवतुः
गान्धारी जनयाम् आस अनमित्रं महाबलम् //
text_mt: Gāndhārī and Mādrī were the two wives of Kroṣṭu. / Gāndhārī gave birth to Anamitra of great might,

sanskrit_iast:
mādrī yudhājitaṃ putraṃ tato vai devamīdhuṣam
anamitram amitrāṇāṃ jetāram aparājitam //
meaning:
माद्री युधाजितं पुत्रं ततो वै देवमीधुषम्
अनमित्रम् अमित्राणां जेतारम् अपराजितम् //
text_mt: and Mādrī to the son Yudhājit, and from him Devamīdhuṣ, / and Anamitra, the vanquisher of enemies, unconquered.

sanskrit_iast:
anamitrasuto nighno nighnato dvau babhūvatuḥ
prasenaś cātha satrājic chatrusenājitāv ubhau //
meaning:
अनमित्रसुतो निघ्नो निघ्नतो द्वौ बभूवतुः
प्रसेनश् चाथ सत्राजिच् छत्रुसेनाजिताव् उभौ //
text_mt: Anamitra's son was Nighna; from Nighna were born two: / Prasena and Satrājit, both conquerors of enemy armies.

sanskrit_iast:
praseno dvāravatyāṃ tu nivasan yo mahāmaṇim
divyaṃ syamantakaṃ nāma sa sūryād upalabdhavān //
meaning:
प्रसेनो द्वारवत्यां तु निवसन् यो महामणिम्
दिव्यं स्यमन्तकं नाम स सूर्याद् उपलब्धवान् //
text_mt: Prasena, dwelling in Dvāravatī, obtained from the sun / that great celestial jewel named Syamantaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya satrājitaḥ sūryaḥ sakhā prāṇasamo 'bhavat
sa kadācin niśāpāye rathena rathināṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य सत्राजितः सूर्यः सखा प्राणसमो ऽभवत्
स कदाचिन् निशापाये रथेन रथिनां वरः //
text_mt: The sun was a friend as dear as life itself to that Satrājit. / Once, at the end of night, that best of chariot-warriors,

sanskrit_iast:
toyakūlam apaḥ spraṣṭum upasthātuṃ yayau ravim
tasyopatiṣṭhataḥ sūryaṃ vivasvān agrataḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
तोयकूलम् अपः स्प्रष्टुम् उपस्थातुं ययौ रविम्
तस्योपतिष्ठतः सूर्यं विवस्वान् अग्रतः स्थितः //
text_mt: went by chariot to the water's edge to touch the water and worship the sun. / As he was worshipping the sun, Vivasvān stood before him,

sanskrit_iast:
vispaṣṭamūrtir bhagavāṃs tejomaṇḍalavān vibhuḥ
atha rājā vivasvantam uvāca sthitam agrataḥ //
meaning:
विस्पष्टमूर्तिर् भगवांस् तेजोमण्डलवान् विभुः
अथ राजा विवस्वन्तम् उवाच स्थितम् अग्रतः //
text_mt: the Lord of distinct form, possessing a circle of radiance. / Then the king spoke to Vivasvān standing before him:

sanskrit_iast:
yathaiva vyomni paśyāmi sadā tvāṃ jyotiṣāṃ pate
tejomaṇḍalinaṃ devaṃ tathaiva purataḥ sthitam //
meaning:
यथैव व्योम्नि पश्यामि सदा त्वां ज्योतिषां पते
तेजोमण्डलिनं देवं तथैव पुरतः स्थितम् //
text_mt: "Just as I always see you in the sky, O lord of luminaries, / as a deity encircled by brilliance, so you stand before me.

sanskrit_iast:
ko viśeṣo 'sti me tvattaḥ sakhyenopagatasya vai
etac chrutvā tu bhagavān maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam //
meaning:
को विशेषो ऽस्ति मे त्वत्तः सख्येनोपगतस्य वै
एतच् छ्रुत्वा तु भगवान् मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम् //
text_mt: What special difference is there for me who have approached you in friendship?" / Hearing this, the blessed Lord took off the excellent jewel Syamantaka

sanskrit_iast:
svakaṇṭhād avamucyātha ekānte nyastavān vibhuḥ
tato vigrahavantaṃ taṃ dadarśa nṛpatis tadā //
meaning:
स्वकण्ठाद् अवमुच्याथ एकान्ते न्यस्तवान् विभुः
ततो विग्रहवन्तं तं ददर्श नृपतिस् तदा //
text_mt: from his neck and placed it aside. / Then the king saw him in embodied form.

sanskrit_iast:
prītimān atha taṃ dṛṣṭvā muhūrtaṃ kṛtavān kathām
tam abhiprasthitaṃ bhūyo vivasvantaṃ sa satrajit //
meaning:
प्रीतिमान् अथ तं दृष्ट्वा मुहूर्तं कृतवान् कथाम्
तम् अभिप्रस्थितं भूयो विवस्वन्तं स सत्रजित् //
text_mt: Pleased upon seeing him, he conversed for a moment. / As Vivasvān was about to depart again, Satrājit [said]:

sanskrit_iast:
lokān bhāsayase sarvān yena tvaṃ satataṃ prabho
tad etan maṇiratnaṃ me bhagavan dātum arhasi //
meaning:
लोकान् भासयसे सर्वान् येन त्वं सततं प्रभो
तद् एतन् मणिरत्नं मे भगवन् दातुम् अर्हसि //
text_mt: "O Lord, by which you constantly illumine all the worlds, / that excellent jewel, O Blessed One, you ought to give to me."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ syamantakamaṇiṃ dattavān bhāskaras tadā
sa tam ābadhya nagarīṃ praviveśa mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
ततः स्यमन्तकमणिं दत्तवान् भास्करस् तदा
स तम् आबध्य नगरीं प्रविवेश महीपतिः //
text_mt: Then the sun gave him the Syamantaka jewel. / Fastening it on, the lord of the earth entered the city.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ janāḥ paryadhāvanta sūryo 'yaṃ gacchatīti ha
svāṃ purīṃ sa visiṣmāya rājā tv antaḥpuraṃ tathā //
meaning:
तं जनाः पर्यधावन्त सूर्यो ऽयं गच्छतीति ह
स्वां पुरीं स विसिष्माय राजा त्व् अन्तःपुरं तथा //
text_mt: People ran toward him, saying, "Here goes the sun!" / The king astonished his city and his inner quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prasenajitaṃ divyaṃ maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam
dadau bhrātre narapatiḥ premṇā satrājid uttamam //
meaning:
तं प्रसेनजितं दिव्यं मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम्
ददौ भ्रात्रे नरपतिः प्रेम्णा सत्राजिद् उत्तमम् //
text_mt: That celestial, excellent Syamantaka jewel the king / Satrājit affectionately gave to his brother Prasena.

sanskrit_iast:
sa maṇiḥ syandate rukmaṃ vṛṣṇyandhakaniveśane
kālavarṣī ca parjanyo na ca vyādhibhayaṃ hy abhūt //
meaning:
स मणिः स्यन्दते रुक्मं वृष्ण्यन्धकनिवेशने
कालवर्षी च पर्जन्यो न च व्याधिभयं ह्य् अभूत् //
text_mt: That jewel poured out gold in the dwelling of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, / and Parjanya rained in season, and there was no fear of disease.

sanskrit_iast:
lipsāṃ cakre prasenasya maṇiratne syamantake
govindo na ca taṃ lebhe śakto 'pi na jahāra saḥ //
meaning:
लिप्सां चक्रे प्रसेनस्य मणिरत्ने स्यमन्तके
गोविन्दो न च तं लेभे शक्तो ऽपि न जहार सः //
text_mt: Govinda desired the excellent Syamantaka jewel of Prasena, / but he did not obtain it, nor did he seize it though he was capable.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācin mṛgayāṃ yātaḥ prasenas tena bhūṣitaḥ
syamantakakṛte siṃhād vadhaṃ prāpa vanecarāt //
meaning:
कदाचिन् मृगयां यातः प्रसेनस् तेन भूषितः
स्यमन्तककृते सिंहाद् वधं प्राप वनेचरात् //
text_mt: Once Prasena, adorned with it, went on a hunt; / for the sake of the Syamantaka, he met his death from a lion roaming the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
atha siṃhaṃ pradhāvantam ṛkṣarājo mahābalaḥ
nihatya maṇiratnaṃ tad ādāya prāviśad guhām //
meaning:
अथ सिंहं प्रधावन्तम् ऋक्षराजो महाबलः
निहत्य मणिरत्नं तद् आदाय प्राविशद् गुहाम् //
text_mt: Then the mighty king of bears, slaying the running lion, / took that excellent jewel and entered a cave.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasenavadhakāraṇāt
prārthanāṃ tāṃ maṇer baddhvā sarva eva śaśaṅkire //
meaning:
ततो वृष्ण्यन्धकाः कृष्णं प्रसेनवधकारणात्
प्रार्थनां तां मणेर् बद्ध्वा सर्व एव शशङ्किरे //
text_mt: Then all the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas suspected Kṛṣṇa, / because of the killing of Prasena and because he had desired the jewel.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śaṅkyamāno dharmātmā akārī tasya karmaṇaḥ
āhariṣye maṇim iti pratijñāya vanaṃ yayau //
meaning:
स शङ्क्यमानो धर्मात्मा अकारी तस्य कर्मणः
आहरिष्ये मणिम् इति प्रतिज्ञाय वनं ययौ //
text_mt: Suspected though he was righteous and had not committed that deed, / he vowed, "I shall fetch the jewel," and went to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra praseno mṛgayāṃ vyacarat tatra cāpy atha
prasenasya padaṃ gṛhya puruṣair āptakāribhiḥ //
meaning:
यत्र प्रसेनो मृगयां व्यचरत् तत्र चाप्य् अथ
प्रसेनस्य पदं गृह्य पुरुषैर् आप्तकारिभिः //
text_mt: Where Prasena had ranged on the hunt, there / he followed Prasena's tracks with trustworthy men.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣavantaṃ girivaraṃ vindhyaṃ ca girim uttamam
anveṣayan pariśrāntaḥ sa dadarśa mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
ऋक्षवन्तं गिरिवरं विन्ध्यं च गिरिम् उत्तमम्
अन्वेषयन् परिश्रान्तः स ददर्श महामनाः //
text_mt: Searching Mount Ṛkṣavant, the best of mountains, and the supreme mountain Vindhya, / the high-minded one, exhausted, saw

sanskrit_iast:
sāśvaṃ hataṃ prasenaṃ tu nāvindata ca tanmaṇim
atha siṃhaḥ prasenasya śarīrasyāvidūrataḥ //
meaning:
साश्वं हतं प्रसेनं तु नाविन्दत च तन्मणिम्
अथ सिंहः प्रसेनस्य शरीरस्याविदूरतः //
text_mt: Prasena slain along with his horse, but did not find the jewel. / Then not far from Prasena's body, a lion

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣeṇa nihato dṛṣṭaḥ padair ṛkṣas tu sūcitaḥ
padais tair anviyāyātha guhām ṛkṣasya mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
ऋक्षेण निहतो दृष्टः पदैर् ऋक्षस् तु सूचितः
पदैस् तैर् अन्वियायाथ गुहाम् ऋक्षस्य माधवः //
text_mt: was seen slain by a bear, and the bear was indicated by its footprints. / Following those footprints, Mādhava went to the bear's cave.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi ṛkṣabile vāṇīṃ śuśrāva pramaderitām
dhātryā kumāram ādāya sutaṃ jāmbavato dvijāḥ //
meaning:
स हि ऋक्षबिले वाणीं शुश्राव प्रमदेरिताम्
धात्र्या कुमारम् आदाय सुतं जाम्बवतो द्विजाः //
text_mt: In the bear's cave, O twice-born ones, he heard a voice uttered by a woman, / by a nurse holding the child, the son of Jāmbavat,

sanskrit_iast: krīḍayantyā ca maṇinā mā rodīr ity atheritām //
meaning: क्रीडयन्त्या च मणिना मा रोदीर् इत्य् अथेरिताम् //
text_mt: amusing him with the jewel, saying: "Do not cry!"

sanskrit_iast:
dhātry uvāca
siṃhaḥ prasenam avadhīt siṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ
sukumāraka mā rodīs tava hy eṣa syamantakaḥ //
meaning:
धात्र्य् उवाच
सिंहः प्रसेनम् अवधीत् सिंहो जाम्बवता हतः
सुकुमारक मा रोदीस् तव ह्य् एष स्यमन्तकः //
text_mt: The nurse said: / "The lion killed Prasena; the lion was killed by Jāmbavat. / Do not weep, delicate child, for this Syamantaka is yours."

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktitas tasya śabdasya tūrṇam eva bilaṃ yayau
praviśya tatra bhagavāṃs tad ṛkṣabilam añjasā //
meaning:
व्यक्तितस् तस्य शब्दस्य तूर्णम् एव बिलं ययौ
प्रविश्य तत्र भगवांस् तद् ऋक्षबिलम् अञ्जसा //
text_mt: Following the clarity of that sound, he went swiftly to the cave; / the Blessed One entering that bear's cave at once,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā biladvāre yadūṃl lāṅgalinā saha
śārṅgadhanvā bilasthaṃ tu jāmbavantaṃ dadarśa saḥ //
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा बिलद्वारे यदूंल् लाङ्गलिना सह
शार्ङ्गधन्वा बिलस्थं तु जाम्बवन्तं ददर्श सः //
text_mt: having stationed the Yadus with the plow-bearer at the entrance of the cave, / he who bears the Śārṅga bow saw Jāmbavat residing in the cave.

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhe vāsudevas tu bile jāmbavatā saha
bāhubhyām eva govindo divasān ekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
युयुधे वासुदेवस् तु बिले जाम्बवता सह
बाहुभ्याम् एव गोविन्दो दिवसान् एकविंशतिम् //
text_mt: Vāsudeva fought with Jāmbavat in the cave, / Govinda fighting with his bare arms for twenty-one days.

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭe 'tha bile kṛṣṇe baladevapuraḥsarāḥ
purīṃ dvāravatīm etya hataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nyavedayan //
meaning:
प्रविष्टे ऽथ बिले कृष्णे बलदेवपुरःसराः
पुरीं द्वारवतीम् एत्य हतं कृष्णं न्यवेदयन् //
text_mt: When Kṛṣṇa had entered the cave, [the Yadus] headed by Baladeva, / having arrived in the city of Dvāravatī, reported that Kṛṣṇa was killed.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevo 'pi nirjitya jāmbavantaṃ mahābalam
lebhe jāmbavatīṃ kanyām ṛkṣarājasya saṃmatām //
meaning:
वासुदेवो ऽपि निर्जित्य जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम्
लेभे जाम्बवतीं कन्याम् ऋक्षराजस्य संमताम् //
text_mt: Vāsudeva too, having conquered the mighty Jāmbavat, / obtained his maiden daughter Jāmbavatī, cherished by the king of bears.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇiṃ syamantakaṃ caiva jagrāhātmaviśuddhaye
anunīyarkṣarājaṃ tu niryayau ca tato bilāt //
meaning:
मणिं स्यमन्तकं चैव जग्राहात्मविशुद्धये
अनुनीयर्क्षराजं तु निर्ययौ च ततो बिलात् //
text_mt: And he took the Syamantaka jewel for his own purification; / having conciliated the king of bears, he came out from that cave.

sanskrit_iast:
upāyād dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sa vinītaiḥ puraḥsaraiḥ
evaṃ sa maṇim āhṛtya viśodhyātmānam acyutaḥ //
meaning:
उपायाद् द्वारकां कृष्णः स विनीतैः पुरःसरैः
एवं स मणिम् आहृत्य विशोध्यात्मानम् अच्युतः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa approached Dvārakā accompanied by disciplined attendants; / thus, bringing back the jewel and purifying himself, Acyuta,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau satrājite taṃ vai sarvasātvatasaṃsadi
evaṃ mithyābhiśastena kṛṣṇenāmitraghātinā //
meaning:
ददौ सत्राजिते तं वै सर्वसात्वतसंसदि
एवं मिथ्याभिशस्तेन कृष्णेनामित्रघातिना //
text_mt: gave it to Satrājit in the assembly of all the Sātvatas. / In this way, having been falsely accused, Kṛṣṇa, the slayer of his foes,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā viśodhitaḥ pāpād vinirjitya syamantakam
satrājito daśa tv āsan bhāryās tāsāṃ śataṃ sutāḥ //
meaning:
आत्मा विशोधितः पापाद् विनिर्जित्य स्यमन्तकम्
सत्राजितो दश त्व् आसन् भार्यास् तासां शतं सुताः //
text_mt: cleared himself of the sin, having retrieved the Syamantaka. / Satrājit had ten wives, and they had a hundred sons.

sanskrit_iast:
khyātimantas trayas teṣāṃ bhagaṃkāras tu pūrvajaḥ
vīro vātapatiś caiva vasumedhas tathaiva ca //
meaning:
ख्यातिमन्तस् त्रयस् तेषां भगंकारस् तु पूर्वजः
वीरो वातपतिश् चैव वसुमेधस् तथैव च //
text_mt: Three of them were renowned: the eldest was Bhagaṃkāra, / the heroic Vātapati, and also Vasumedhas.

sanskrit_iast:
kumāryaś cāpi tisro vai dikṣu khyātā dvijottamāḥ
satyabhāmottamā tāsāṃ vratinī ca dṛḍhavratā //
meaning:
कुमार्यश् चापि तिस्रो वै दिक्षु ख्याता द्विजोत्तमाः
सत्यभामोत्तमा तासां व्रतिनी च दृढव्रता //
text_mt: There were also three daughters, famous across the directions, O best of twice-born: / the best among them was Satyabhāmā, observant of vows and firm in her vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā prasvāpinī caiva bhāryāṃ kṛṣṇāya tāṃ dadau
sabhākṣo bhaṅgakāris tu nāveyaś ca narottamau //
meaning:
तथा प्रस्वापिनी चैव भार्यां कृष्णाय तां ददौ
सभाक्षो भङ्गकारिस् तु नावेयश् च नरोत्तमौ //
text_mt: and also Prasvāpinī; he gave her as wife to Kṛṣṇa. / Sabhākṣa, Bhaṅgakāri, and Nāveya, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
jajñāte guṇasaṃpannau viśrutau rūpasaṃpadā
mādryāḥ putro 'tha jajñe 'tha vṛṣṇiputro yudhājitaḥ //
meaning:
जज्ञाते गुणसंपन्नौ विश्रुतौ रूपसंपदा
माद्र्याः पुत्रो ऽथ जज्ञे ऽथ वृष्णिपुत्रो युधाजितः //
text_mt: were born endowed with virtues and celebrated for the excellence of their beauty. / Then Mādrī's son was born; then Yudhājit, son of Vṛṣṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
jajñāte tanayau vṛṣṇeḥ śvaphalkaś citrakas tathā
śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryām avindata //
meaning:
जज्ञाते तनयौ वृष्णेः श्वफल्कश् चित्रकस् तथा
श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्याम् अविन्दत //
text_mt: Two sons were born to Vṛṣṇi: Śvaphalka and Citraka. / Śvaphalka took the daughter of the king of Kāśi as his wife,

sanskrit_iast:
gāndinīṃ nāma tasyāś ca gāḥ sadā pradadau pitā
tasyāṃ jajñe mahābāhuḥ śrutavān atithipriyaḥ //
meaning:
गान्दिनीं नाम तस्याश् च गाः सदा प्रददौ पिता
तस्यां जज्ञे महाबाहुः श्रुतवान् अतिथिप्रियः //
text_mt: named Gāndinī, to whom her father always gave cows. / By her was born the mighty-armed one, learned and fond of guests,

sanskrit_iast:
akrūro 'tha mahābhāgo jajñe vipuladakṣiṇaḥ
upamadgus tathā madgur mudaraś cārimardanaḥ //
meaning:
अक्रूरो ऽथ महाभागो जज्ञे विपुलदक्षिणः
उपमद्गुस् तथा मद्गुर् मुदरश् चारिमर्दनः //
text_mt: the illustrious Akrūra, who gave generous sacrificial fees. / Upamadgu, Madgu, Mudara, the crusher of enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
ārikṣepas tathopekṣaḥ śatruhā cārimejayaḥ
dharmabhṛc cāpi dharmā ca gṛdhrabhojāndhakas tathā //
meaning:
आरिक्षेपस् तथोपेक्षः शत्रुहा चारिमेजयः
धर्मभृच् चापि धर्मा च गृध्रभोजान्धकस् तथा //
text_mt: Ārikṣepa, Upekṣa, Śatruhā, Arimejaya, / Dharmabhṛt, Dharmā, Gṛdhrabhojāndhaka,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhaprativāhau ca sundarī ca varāṅganā
viśrutāśvasya mahiṣī kanyā cāsya vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
आवाहप्रतिवाहौ च सुन्दरी च वराङ्गना
विश्रुताश्वस्य महिषी कन्या चास्य वसुंधरा //
text_mt: Āvāha, Prativāha, Sundarī, an excellent woman / who was the queen of Viśrutāśva, and his daughter Vasuṃdharā,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanasaṃpannā sarvasattvamanoharā
akrūreṇograsenāyāṃ sutau vai kulanandanau //
meaning:
रूपयौवनसंपन्ना सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरा
अक्रूरेणोग्रसेनायां सुतौ वै कुलनन्दनौ //
text_mt: endowed with beauty and youth, captivating the minds of all beings. / By Akrūra, on Ugrasenā, were begotten two sons, the delight of their family,

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevaś copadevaś ca jajñāte devavarcasau
citrakasyābhavan putrāḥ pṛthur vipṛthur eva ca //
meaning:
वसुदेवश् चोपदेवश् च जज्ञाते देववर्चसौ
चित्रकस्याभवन् पुत्राः पृथुर् विपृथुर् एव च //
text_mt: Vasudeva and Upadeva, possessing divine splendor. / The sons of Citraka were Pṛthu and Vipṛthu,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvagrīvo 'śvabāhuś ca supārśvakagaveṣaṇau
ariṣṭanemiś ca sutā dharmo dharmabhṛd eva ca //
meaning:
अश्वग्रीवो ऽश्वबाहुश् च सुपार्श्वकगवेषणौ
अरिष्टनेमिश् च सुता धर्मो धर्मभृद् एव च //
text_mt: Aśvagrīva, Aśvabāhu, Supārśvaka, Gaveṣaṇa, / Ariṣṭanemi, Dharma, and Dharmabhṛt as sons,

sanskrit_iast:
subāhur bahubāhuś ca śraviṣṭhāśravaṇe striyau
imāṃ mithyābhiśastiṃ yaḥ kṛṣṇasya samudāhṛtām //
meaning:
सुबाहुर् बहुबाहुश् च श्रविष्ठाश्रवणे स्त्रियौ
इमां मिथ्याभिशस्तिं यः कृष्णस्य समुदाहृताम् //
text_mt: Subāhu and Bahubāhu, and two females: Śraviṣṭhā and Śravaṇā. / Whoever knows this false accusation related of Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast: veda mithyābhiśāpās taṃ na spṛśanti kadācana //
meaning: वेद मिथ्याभिशापास् तं न स्पृशन्ति कदाचन //
text_mt: false accusations will never touch him.

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
yat tu satrājite kṛṣṇo maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam
dadāv ahārayad babhrur bhojena śatadhanvanā //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
यत् तु सत्राजिते कृष्णो मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम्
ददाव् अहारयद् बभ्रुर् भोजेन शतधन्वना //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / But the precious Syamantaka jewel which Kṛṣṇa gave to Satrājit, / Babhru caused to be carried off through the Bhoja Śatadhanvan.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā hi prārthayām āsa satyabhāmām aninditām
akrūro 'ntaram anviṣyan maṇiṃ caiva syamantakam //
meaning:
सदा हि प्रार्थयाम् आस सत्यभामाम् अनिन्दिताम्
अक्रूरो ऽन्तरम् अन्विष्यन् मणिं चैव स्यमन्तकम् //
text_mt: For Akrūra, seeking an opportunity, always coveted the faultless Satyabhāmā / and the Syamantaka jewel.

sanskrit_iast:
satrājitaṃ tato hatvā śatadhanvā mahābalaḥ
rātrau taṃ maṇim ādāya tato 'krūrāya dattavān //
meaning:
सत्राजितं ततो हत्वा शतधन्वा महाबलः
रात्रौ तं मणिम् आदाय ततो ऽक्रूराय दत्तवान् //
text_mt: Then, having slain Satrājit, the mighty Śatadhanvan / took that jewel at night and handed it over to Akrūra.

sanskrit_iast:
akrūras tu tadā viprā ratnam ādāya cottamam
samayaṃ kārayāṃ cakre nāvedyo 'haṃ tvayety uta //
meaning:
अक्रूरस् तु तदा विप्रा रत्नम् आदाय चोत्तमम्
समयं कारयां चक्रे नावेद्यो ऽहं त्वयेत्य् उत //
text_mt: Akrūra then, taking the excellent jewel, O twice-born, / made an agreement: "I must not be disclosed by you.

sanskrit_iast:
vayam abhyutprapatsyāmaḥ kṛṣṇena tvāṃ pradharṣitam
mamādya dvārakā sarvā vaśe tiṣṭhaty asaṃśayam //
meaning:
वयम् अभ्युत्प्रपत्स्यामः कृष्णेन त्वां प्रधर्षितम्
ममाद्य द्वारका सर्वा वशे तिष्ठत्य् असंशयम् //
text_mt: We shall stand by you if you are assaulted by Kṛṣṇa; / today all of Dvārakā stands under my control, without a doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
hate pitari duḥkhārtā satyabhāmā manasvinī
prayayau ratham āruhya nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam //
meaning:
हते पितरि दुःखार्ता सत्यभामा मनस्विनी
प्रययौ रथम् आरुह्य नगरं वारणावतम् //
text_mt: When her father was slain, the wise Satyabhāmā, stricken with grief, / mounted her chariot and went to the city of Vāraṇāvata.

sanskrit_iast:
satyabhāmā tu tad vṛttaṃ bhojasya śatadhanvanaḥ
bhartur nivedya duḥkhārtā pārśvasthāśrūṇy avartayat //
meaning:
सत्यभामा तु तद् वृत्तं भोजस्य शतधन्वनः
भर्तुर् निवेद्य दुःखार्ता पार्श्वस्थाश्रूण्य् अवर्तयत् //
text_mt: Satyabhāmā, stricken with grief, informed her husband / of that deed of the Bhoja Śatadhanvan, and standing beside him, shed tears.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍavānāṃ ca dagdhānāṃ hariḥ kṛtvodakakriyām
kulyārthe cāpi pāṇḍūnāṃ nyayojayata sātyakim //
meaning:
पाण्डवानां च दग्धानां हरिः कृत्वोदकक्रियाम्
कुल्यार्थे चापि पाण्डूनां न्ययोजयत सात्यकिम् //
text_mt: Hari, having performed the water-offering rites for the burned Pāṇḍavas, / also appointed Sātyaki for the welfare of the lineage of the Pāṇḍus.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tvaritam āgamya dvārakāṃ madhusūdanaḥ
pūrvajaṃ halinaṃ śrīmān idaṃ vacanam abravīt //
meaning:
ततस् त्वरितम् आगम्य द्वारकां मधुसूदनः
पूर्वजं हलिनं श्रीमान् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then the glorious Madhusūdana, having quickly arrived at Dvārakā, / spoke these words to his elder brother, the plow-wielder:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
hataḥ prasenaḥ siṃhena satrājic chatadhanvanā
syamantakas tu madnāmī tasya prabhur ahaṃ vibho //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
हतः प्रसेनः सिंहेन सत्राजिच् छतधन्वना
स्यमन्तकस् तु मद्नामी तस्य प्रभुर् अहं विभो //
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Prasena was slain by a lion, and Satrājit by Śatadhanvan. / Syamantaka belongs to my lineage, and I am its master, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tad āroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ bhojaṃ hatvā mahāratham
syamantako mahābāho asmākaṃ sa bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तद् आरोह रथं शीघ्रं भोजं हत्वा महारथम्
स्यमन्तको महाबाहो अस्माकं स भविष्यति //
text_mt: Therefore mount the chariot quickly; having slain the Bhoja, the great car-warrior, / the Syamantaka will be ours, O mighty-armed one."

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ bhojakṛṣṇayoḥ
śatadhanvā tato 'krūraṃ sarvatodiśam aikṣata //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं भोजकृष्णयोः
शतधन्वा ततो ऽक्रूरं सर्वतोदिशम् ऐक्षत //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / Then a tumultuous battle ensued between the Bhoja and Kṛṣṇa; / then Śatadhanvan looked in every direction toward Akrūra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrabdhau tāv ubhau tatra dṛṣṭvā bhojajanārdanau
śakto 'pi śāpād dhārdikyam akrūro nānvapadyata //
meaning:
संरब्धौ ताव् उभौ तत्र दृष्ट्वा भोजजनार्दनौ
शक्तो ऽपि शापाद् धार्दिक्यम् अक्रूरो नान्वपद्यत //
text_mt: Seeing both Bhoja and Janārdana enraged there, / Akrūra, though capable, did not side with Hārdikya out of fear of a curse.

sanskrit_iast:
apayāne tato buddhiṃ bhojaś cakre bhayārditaḥ
yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ hṛdayā pratyapadyata //
meaning:
अपयाने ततो बुद्धिं भोजश् चक्रे भयार्दितः
योजनानां शतं साग्रं हृदया प्रत्यपद्यत //
text_mt: Then the Bhoja, afflicted with fear, resolved to flee; / [the mare] Hṛdayā covered fully a hundred yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyātā hṛdayā nāma śatayojanagāminī
bhojasya vaḍavā viprā yayā kṛṣṇam ayodhayat //
meaning:
विख्याता हृदया नाम शतयोजनगामिनी
भोजस्य वडवा विप्रा यया कृष्णम् अयोधयत् //
text_mt: Celebrated by the name of Hṛdayā, capable of traversing a hundred yojanas, / was the Bhoja's mare, O twice-born, with which he had fought Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīṇāṃ javena hṛdayām adhvanaḥ śatayojane
dṛṣṭvā rathasya svāṃ vṛddhiṃ śatadhanvānam ardayat //
meaning:
क्षीणां जवेन हृदयाम् अध्वनः शतयोजने
दृष्ट्वा रथस्य स्वां वृद्धिं शतधन्वानम् अर्दयत् //
text_mt: Seeing that Hṛdayā was exhausted in speed at the distance of a hundred yojanas, / [Kṛṣṇa,] observing his chariot's advance, pressed hard against Śatadhanvan.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tasyā hatāyās tu śramāt khedāc ca bho dvijāḥ
kham utpetur atha prāṇāḥ kṛṣṇo rāmam athābravīt //
meaning:
ततस् तस्या हतायास् तु श्रमात् खेदाच् च भो द्विजाः
खम् उत्पेतुर् अथ प्राणाः कृष्णो रामम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then, when she perished from exhaustion and distress, O twice-born, / her life-breaths flew into the sky; Kṛṣṇa then said to Rāma:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
tiṣṭheha tvaṃ mahābāho dṛṣṭadoṣā hayā mayā
padbhyāṃ gatvā hariṣyāmi maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
तिष्ठेह त्वं महाबाहो दृष्टदोषा हया मया
पद्भ्यां गत्वा हरिष्यामि मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम् //
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Wait here, O mighty-armed one; I have seen the defect of the mare. / Going on foot, I shall take the Syamantaka jewel."

sanskrit_iast:
padbhyām eva tato gatvā śatadhanvānam acyutaḥ
mithilām abhito viprā jaghāna paramāstravit //
meaning:
पद्भ्याम् एव ततो गत्वा शतधन्वानम् अच्युतः
मिथिलाम् अभितो विप्रा जघान परमास्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Then Acyuta, having gone on foot, O twice-born, / skilled in the supreme weapons, slew Śatadhanvan in the vicinity of Mithilā.

sanskrit_iast:
syamantakaṃ ca nāpaśyad dhatvā bhojaṃ mahābalam
nivṛttaṃ cābravīt kṛṣṇaṃ maṇiṃ dehīti lāṅgalī //
meaning:
स्यमन्तकं च नापश्यद् धत्वा भोजं महाबलम्
निवृत्तं चाब्रवीत् कृष्णं मणिं देहीति लाङ्गली //
text_mt: And having slain the mighty Bhoja, he did not see the Syamantaka; / and to Kṛṣṇa who returned, the plow-holder said: "Give me the jewel."

sanskrit_iast:
nāstīti kṛṣṇaś covāca tato rāmo ruṣānvitaḥ
dhikśabdapūrvam asakṛt pratyuvāca janārdanam //
meaning:
नास्तीति कृष्णश् चोवाच ततो रामो रुषान्वितः
धिक्शब्दपूर्वम् असकृत् प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa said, "It is not [here]." Then Rāma, filled with wrath, / repeatedly spoke to Janārdana, beginning with words of reproach:

sanskrit_iast:
balarāma uvāca
bhrātṛtvān marṣayāmy eṣa svasti te 'stu vrajāmy aham
kṛtyaṃ na me dvārakayā na tvayā na ca vṛṣṇibhiḥ //
meaning:
बलराम उवाच
भ्रातृत्वान् मर्षयाम्य् एष स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु व्रजाम्य् अहम्
कृत्यं न मे द्वारकया न त्वया न च वृष्णिभिः //
text_mt: Balarāma said: / "Out of brotherhood I tolerate this; may you prosper, I am leaving. / I have no business with Dvārakā, nor with you, nor with the Vṛṣṇis."

sanskrit_iast:
praviveśa tato rāmo mithilām arimardanaḥ
sarvakāmair upahṛtair mithilenābhipūjitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रविवेश ततो रामो मिथिलाम् अरिमर्दनः
सर्वकामैर् उपहृतैर् मिथिलेनाभिपूजितः //
text_mt: Then Rāma, crusher of enemies, entered Mithilā, / worshipped by the king of Mithilā with all objects of desire brought forth.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn eva kāle tu babhrur matimatāṃ varaḥ
nānārūpān kratūn sarvān ājahāra nirargalān //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु बभ्रुर् मतिमतां वरः
नानारूपान् क्रतून् सर्वान् आजहार निरर्गलान् //
text_mt: At that very time, Babhru, the best among the intelligent, / undertook all manner of sacrifices without impediment.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāmayaṃ sa kavacaṃ rakṣārthaṃ praviveśa ha
syamantakakṛte prājño gāndīputro mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
दीक्षामयं स कवचं रक्षार्थं प्रविवेश ह
स्यमन्तककृते प्राज्ञो गान्दीपुत्रो महायशाः //
text_mt: For the sake of protection, he entered the armor consisting of consecration; / for the sake of the Syamantaka, the wise son of Gāndī, renowned for great fame,

sanskrit_iast:
atha ratnāni cānyāni dhanāni vividhāni ca
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāṇi dharmātmā yajñeṣv eva nyayojayat //
meaning:
अथ रत्नानि चान्यानि धनानि विविधानि च
षष्टिं वर्षाणि धर्मात्मा यज्ञेष्व् एव न्ययोजयत् //
text_mt: and then other jewels and various riches, / the righteous one employed for sixty years in sacrifices alone.

sanskrit_iast:
akrūrayajñā iti te khyātās tasya mahātmanaḥ
bahvannadakṣiṇāḥ sarve sarvakāmapradāyinaḥ //
meaning:
अक्रूरयज्ञा इति ते ख्यातास् तस्य महात्मनः
बह्वन्नदक्षिणाः सर्वे सर्वकामप्रदायिनः //
text_mt: Those celebrated as the Akrūra-sacrifices of that great soul, / all possessed abundant food and fees, granting all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
atha duryodhano rājā gatvā sa mithilāṃ prabhuḥ
gadāśikṣāṃ tato divyāṃ baladevād avāptavān //
meaning:
अथ दुर्योधनो राजा गत्वा स मिथिलां प्रभुः
गदाशिक्षां ततो दिव्यां बलदेवाद् अवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Then the powerful king Duryodhana, having gone to Mithilā, / obtained divine instruction in the mace from Baladeva.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprasādya tato rāmo vṛṣṇyandhakamahārathaiḥ
ānīto dvārakām eva kṛṣṇena ca mahātmanā //
meaning:
संप्रसाद्य ततो रामो वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथैः
आनीतो द्वारकाम् एव कृष्णेन च महात्मना //
text_mt: Then, having been conciliated by the great car-warriors of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas / and by the great-souled Kṛṣṇa, Rāma was brought back to Dvārakā.

sanskrit_iast:
akrūraś cāndhakaiḥ sārdham āyātaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
hatvā satrājitaṃ suptaṃ sahabandhuṃ mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
अक्रूरश् चान्धकैः सार्धम् आयातः पुरुषर्षभः
हत्वा सत्राजितं सुप्तं सहबन्धुं महाबलः //
text_mt: And Akrūra, that bull among men of great strength, arrived along with the Andhakas, / having slain Satrājit while he was asleep, together with his kin.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātibhedabhayāt kṛṣṇas tam upekṣitavāṃs tadā
apayāte tadākrūre nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञातिभेदभयात् कृष्णस् तम् उपेक्षितवांस् तदा
अपयाते तदाक्रूरे नावर्षत् पाकशासनः //
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa disregarded him out of fear of division among kinsmen. / When Akrūra had departed, Indra the chastiser of Pāka did not send rain.

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛṣṭyā tadā rāṣṭram abhavad bahudhā kṛśam
tataḥ prasādayām āsur akrūraṃ kukurāndhakāḥ //
meaning:
अनावृष्ट्या तदा राष्ट्रम् अभवद् बहुधा कृशम्
ततः प्रसादयाम् आसुर् अक्रूरं कुकुरान्धकाः //
text_mt: Due to the drought, the realm then became severely emaciated in many ways. / Thereupon the Kukuras and Andhakas appeased Akrūra.

sanskrit_iast:
punar dvāravatīṃ prāpte tasmin dānapatau tataḥ
pravavarṣa sahasrākṣaḥ kakṣe jalanidhes tadā //
meaning:
पुनर् द्वारवतीं प्राप्ते तस्मिन् दानपतौ ततः
प्रववर्ष सहस्राक्षः कक्षे जलनिधेस् तदा //
text_mt: Then, when that master of gifts returned to Dvāravatī, / the thousand-eyed [Indra] poured down rain upon the shore of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ ca vāsudevāya svasāraṃ śīlasaṃmatām
akrūraḥ pradadau dhīmān prītyarthaṃ munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
कन्यां च वासुदेवाय स्वसारं शीलसंमताम्
अक्रूरः प्रददौ धीमान् प्रीत्यर्थं मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: And Akrūra, the wise, gave a maiden, his sister of approved good conduct, / to Vāsudeva for the sake of friendship, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vijñāya yogena kṛṣṇo babhrugataṃ maṇim
sabhāmadhyagataḥ prāha tam akrūraṃ janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
अथ विज्ञाय योगेन कृष्णो बभ्रुगतं मणिम्
सभामध्यगतः प्राह तम् अक्रूरं जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Then, knowing by yogic insight that the jewel was in Babhru's possession, / Kṛṣṇa Janārdana, standing in the midst of the assembly, spoke to that Akrūra:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
yat tad ratnaṃ maṇivaraṃ tava hastagataṃ vibho
tat prayaccha ca mānārha mayi mānāryakaṃ kṛthāḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
यत् तद् रत्नं मणिवरं तव हस्तगतं विभो
तत् प्रयच्छ च मानार्ह मयि मानार्यकं कृथाः //
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / 'That excellent gem, that jewel which has come into your hands, O lord, / surrender that, O you who deserve honor; do not show dishonor toward me.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣagate kāle yo roṣo 'bhūn mamānagha
sa saṃrūḍho 'sakṛt prāptas tataḥ kālātyayo mahān //
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षगते काले यो रोषो ऽभून् ममानघ
स संरूढो ऽसकृत् प्राप्तस् ततः कालात्ययो महान् //
text_mt: 'When sixty years had elapsed, whatever anger I had, O sinless one, / that has subsided, having repeatedly returned; since then a great passage of time [has occurred].'

sanskrit_iast:
sa tataḥ kṛṣṇavacanāt sarvasātvatasaṃsadi
pradadau taṃ maṇiṃ babhrur akleśena mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
स ततः कृष्णवचनात् सर्वसात्वतसंसदि
प्रददौ तं मणिं बभ्रुर् अक्लेशेन महामतिः //
text_mt: Thereupon Babhru of great intellect, at the word of Kṛṣṇa, / gave up that jewel without distress in the assembly of all the Sātvatas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tam ārjavāt prāptaṃ babhror hastād ariṃdamaḥ
dadau hṛṣṭamanāḥ kṛṣṇas taṃ maṇiṃ babhrave punaḥ //
meaning:
ततस् तम् आर्जवात् प्राप्तं बभ्रोर् हस्ताद् अरिंदमः
ददौ हृष्टमनाः कृष्णस् तं मणिं बभ्रवे पुनः //
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa, the subduer of foes, having received it from Babhru's hand on account of his straightforwardness, / with a delighted mind gave that jewel back to Babhru again.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛṣṇahastāt saṃprāptaṃ maṇiratnaṃ syamantakam
ābadhya gāndinīputro virarājāṃśumān iva //
meaning:
स कृष्णहस्तात् संप्राप्तं मणिरत्नं स्यमन्तकम्
आबध्य गान्दिनीपुत्रो विरराजांशुमान् इव //
text_mt: Having received the Syamantaka jewel from Kṛṣṇa's hand / and fastened it on, the son of Gāndinī shone like the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
aho sumahad ākhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrtitam
bhāratānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
अहो सुमहद् आख्यानं भवता परिकीर्तितम्
भारतानां च सर्वेषां पार्थिवानां तथैव च //
text_mt: The sages said: / 'Ah, a very great narrative has been related by you / of all the Bhāratas and likewise of the kings,'

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām
daityānām atha siddhānāṃ guhyakānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्
दैत्यानाम् अथ सिद्धानां गुह्यकानां तथैव च //
text_mt: 'and of the gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Uragas, and Rakṣases, / of the Daityas, and of the Siddhas, and likewise of the Guhyakas,'

sanskrit_iast:
atyadbhutāni karmāṇi vikramā dharmaniścayāḥ
vividhāś ca kathā divyā janma cāgryam anuttamam //
meaning:
अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि विक्रमा धर्मनिश्चयाः
विविधाश् च कथा दिव्या जन्म चाग्र्यम् अनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: 'very wonderful deeds, prowess, and determinations of dharma, / diverse celestial tales, and foremost, unsurpassed origins.'

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpateḥ samyak tvayā proktā mahāmate
prajāpatīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ guhyakāpsarasāṃ tathā //
meaning:
सृष्टिः प्रजापतेः सम्यक् त्वया प्रोक्ता महामते
प्रजापतीनां सर्वेषां गुह्यकाप्सरसां तथा //
text_mt: 'The creation by the Lord of Creatures has been properly told by you, O noble-minded one, / and of all the Lords of Creatures, and also of Guhyakas and Apsarases.'

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ sarvam utpannaṃ vividhaṃ jagat
tvayā proktaṃ mahābhāga śrutaṃ caitan manoharam //
meaning:
स्थावरं जङ्गमं सर्वम् उत्पन्नं विविधं जगत्
त्वया प्रोक्तं महाभाग श्रुतं चैतन् मनोहरम् //
text_mt: 'The entire manifold world, both stationary and moving, as it arose, / has been declared by you, O fortunate one, and this delightful [account] has been heard [by us].'

sanskrit_iast:
kathitaṃ puṇyaphaladaṃ purāṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā
manaḥkarṇasukhaṃ samyak prīṇāty amṛtasaṃmitam //
meaning:
कथितं पुण्यफलदं पुराणं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा
मनःकर्णसुखं सम्यक् प्रीणात्य् अमृतसंमितम् //
text_mt: 'The Purāṇa, yielding the fruit of religious merit, has been told in polished speech; / pleasing to the mind and the ear, it delights fully, like nectar.'

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ śrotum icchāmaḥ sakalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ
vaktum arhasi sarvajña paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ //
meaning:
इदानीं श्रोतुम् इच्छामः सकलं मण्डलं भुवः
वक्तुम् अर्हसि सर्वज्ञ परं कौतूहलं हि नः //
text_mt: 'Now we wish to hear the entire orb of the earth; / you ought to speak, O all-knowing one, for great indeed is our curiosity,'

sanskrit_iast:
yāvantaḥ sāgarā dvīpās tathā varṣāṇi parvatāḥ
vanāni saritaḥ puṇyadevādīnāṃ mahāmate //
meaning:
यावन्तः सागरा द्वीपास् तथा वर्षाणि पर्वताः
वनानि सरितः पुण्यदेवादीनां महामते //
text_mt: 'as many oceans, continents, realms, and mountains as there are, / and the sacred forests and rivers of the gods and others, O noble-minded one.'

sanskrit_iast:
yatpramāṇam idaṃ sarvaṃ yadādhāraṃ yadātmakam
saṃsthānam asya jagato yathāvad vaktum arhasi //
meaning:
यत्प्रमाणम् इदं सर्वं यदाधारं यदात्मकम्
संस्थानम् अस्य जगतो यथावद् वक्तुम् अर्हसि //
text_mt: 'Of what measure all this is, what its foundation is, what its nature is, / you ought to tell properly the arrangement of this world.'

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
munayaḥ śrūyatām etat saṃkṣepād vadato mama
nāsya varṣaśatenāpi vaktuṃ śakyo 'tivistaraḥ //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
मुनयः श्रूयताम् एतत् संक्षेपाद् वदतो मम
नास्य वर्षशतेनापि वक्तुं शक्यो ऽतिविस्तरः //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / 'O sages, let this be heard as I speak in brief; / not even in a hundred years could its full extent be told.'

sanskrit_iast:
jambūplakṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmalaś cāparo dvijāḥ
kuśaḥ krauñcas tathā śākaḥ puṣkaraś caiva saptamaḥ //
meaning:
जम्बूप्लक्षाह्वयौ द्वीपौ शाल्मलश् चापरो द्विजाः
कुशः क्रौञ्चस् तथा शाकः पुष्करश् चैव सप्तमः //
text_mt: 'The continents named Jambū and Plakṣa, and another is Śālmala, O twice-born; / Kuśa, Krauñca, and Śāka, and Puṣkara is the seventh.'

sanskrit_iast:
ete dvīpāḥ samudrais tu sapta saptabhir āvṛtāḥ
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpir dadhidugdhajalaiḥ samam //
meaning:
एते द्वीपाः समुद्रैस् तु सप्त सप्तभिर् आवृताः
लवणेक्षुसुरासर्पिर् दधिदुग्धजलैः समम् //
text_mt: 'These seven continents are encircled by seven oceans, / equal [in extent], consisting of salt water, sugarcane juice, liquor, clarified butter, curds, milk, and water.'

sanskrit_iast:
jambūdvīpaḥ samastānām eteṣāṃ madhyasaṃsthitaḥ
tasyāpi madhye viprendrā meruḥ kanakaparvataḥ //
meaning:
जम्बूद्वीपः समस्तानाम् एतेषां मध्यसंस्थितः
तस्यापि मध्ये विप्रेन्द्रा मेरुः कनकपर्वतः //
text_mt: 'Jambūdvīpa is situated in the middle of all these; / and in its middle, O best of priests, is Meru, the mountain of gold.'

sanskrit_iast:
caturaśītisāhasrair yojanais tasya cocchrayaḥ
praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastād dvātriṃśan mūrdhni vistṛtaḥ //
meaning:
चतुरशीतिसाहस्रैर् योजनैस् तस्य चोच्छ्रयः
प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद् द्वात्रिंशन् मूर्ध्नि विस्तृतः //
text_mt: 'Its height is eighty-four thousand yojanas; / it penetrates sixteen [thousand yojanas] below, and expands thirty-two [thousand] at the summit.'

sanskrit_iast:
mūle ṣoḍaśasāhasrair vistāras tasya sarvataḥ
bhūpadmasyāsya śailo 'sau karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
मूले षोडशसाहस्रैर् विस्तारस् तस्य सर्वतः
भूपद्मस्यास्य शैलो ऽसौ कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः //
text_mt: 'At the base its expanse is sixteen thousand [yojanas] on all sides; / this mountain stands in the shape of the pericarp of this earth-lotus.'

sanskrit_iast:
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhas tasya dakṣiṇe
nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ //
meaning:
हिमवान् हेमकूटश् च निषधस् तस्य दक्षिणे
नीलः श्वेतश् च शृङ्गी च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वताः //
text_mt: 'Himavān, Hemakūṭa, and Niṣadha are to its south; / Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgī to the north are realm-mountains.'

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnās tathāpare
sahasradvitayocchrāyās tāvadvistāriṇaś ca te //
meaning:
लक्षप्रमाणौ द्वौ मध्ये दशहीनास् तथापरे
सहस्रद्वितयोच्छ्रायास् तावद्विस्तारिणश् च ते //
text_mt: 'The two in the middle measure a hundred thousand [yojanas], and the others are less by ten [thousand]; / they are two thousand [yojanas] in height, and just as broad in extent.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam
harivarṣaṃ tathaivānyan meror dakṣiṇato dvijāḥ //
meaning:
भारतं प्रथमं वर्षं ततः किंपुरुषं स्मृतम्
हरिवर्षं तथैवान्यन् मेरोर् दक्षिणतो द्विजाः //
text_mt: 'Bhārata is the first realm; after that Kiṃpuruṣa is known, / and Harivarṣa is likewise another to the south of Meru, O twice-born.'

sanskrit_iast:
ramyakaṃ cottaraṃ varṣaṃ tasyaiva tu hiraṇmayam
uttarāḥ kuravaś caiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā //
meaning:
रम्यकं चोत्तरं वर्षं तस्यैव तु हिरण्मयम्
उत्तराः कुरवश् चैव यथा वै भारतं तथा //
text_mt: 'And Ramyaka is the northern realm, and Hiraṇmaya belongs to it; / and the Northern Kurus are just like Bhārata.'

sanskrit_iast:
navasāhasram ekaikam eteṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ
ilāvṛtaṃ ca tanmadhye sauvarṇo merur ucchritaḥ //
meaning:
नवसाहस्रम् एकैकम् एतेषां द्विजसत्तमाः
इलावृतं च तन्मध्ये सौवर्णो मेरुर् उच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: 'Each one of these measures nine thousand [yojanas], O best of the twice-born; / and Ilāvṛta is in their center, [where] golden Meru rises high.'

sanskrit_iast:
meroś caturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhasravistṛtam
ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāgāś catvāraś cātra parvatāḥ //
meaning:
मेरोश् चतुर्दिशं तत्र नवसाहस्रविस्तृतम्
इलावृतं महाभागाश् चत्वारश् चात्र पर्वताः //
text_mt: 'Surrounding Meru in the four directions there, nine thousand [yojanas] in extent, / is Ilāvṛta, O fortunate ones; and there are four mountains,'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkambhā vitatā meror yojanāyutavistṛtāḥ
pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ //
meaning:
विष्कम्भा वितता मेरोर् योजनायुतविस्तृताः
पूर्वेण मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः //
text_mt: 'the expansive buttress-mountains of Meru, extending ten thousand yojanas: / to the east is the one named Mandara, to the south is Gandhamādana,'

sanskrit_iast:
vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaś cottare sthitaḥ
kadambas teṣu jambūś ca pippalo vaṭa eva ca //
meaning:
विपुलः पश्चिमे पार्श्वे सुपार्श्वश् चोत्तरे स्थितः
कदम्बस् तेषु जम्बूश् च पिप्पलो वट एव च //
text_mt: 'Vipula on the western flank, and Supārśva is situated on the north. / On them are a kadamba, a rose-apple, a peepal, and a banyan tree;'

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ
jambūdvīpasya sā jambūr nāmahetur dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
एकादशशतायामाः पादपा गिरिकेतवः
जम्बूद्वीपस्य सा जम्बूर् नामहेतुर् द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: 'these trees, the banners of the mountains, are eleven hundred [yojanas] in length. / That rose-apple tree is the cause of the name of Jambūdvīpa, O best of the twice-born.'

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgajapramāṇāni jambvās tasyāḥ phalāni vai
patanti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvataḥ //
meaning:
महागजप्रमाणानि जम्ब्वास् तस्याः फलानि वै
पतन्ति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वतः //
text_mt: 'The fruits of that rose-apple tree are indeed as large as great elephants; / shattering on all sides, they fall upon the back of the mountain.'

sanskrit_iast:
rasena teṣāṃ vikhyātā tatra jambūnadīti vai
sarit pravartate sā ca pīyate tannivāsibhiḥ //
meaning:
रसेन तेषां विख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै
सरित् प्रवर्तते सा च पीयते तन्निवासिभिः //
text_mt: 'From their juice, that well-known river named the Jambū River / flows forth there, and it is drunk by the inhabitants thereof.'

sanskrit_iast:
na khedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ na jarā nendriyakṣayaḥ
tatpānasvasthamanasāṃ janānāṃ tatra jāyate //
meaning:
न खेदो न च दौर्गन्ध्यं न जरा नेन्द्रियक्षयः
तत्पानस्वस्थमनसां जनानां तत्र जायते //
text_mt: 'Neither fatigue, nor foul odor, nor old age, nor decay of the senses / occurs there for the people whose minds are healthy from drinking it.'

sanskrit_iast:
tīramṛt tadrasaṃ prāpya sukhavāyuviśoṣitā
jāmbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
तीरमृत् तद्रसं प्राप्य सुखवायुविशोषिता
जाम्बूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम् //
text_mt: 'The mud on its banks, having obtained that juice and dried by pleasant breezes, / becomes the gold called Jāmbūnada, the ornament of the Siddhas.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāśvaṃ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaṃ ca paścime
varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭhās tayor madhye tv ilāvṛtam //
meaning:
भद्राश्वं पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालं च पश्चिमे
वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठास् तयोर् मध्ये त्व् इलावृतम् //
text_mt: 'Bhadrāśva is to the east of Meru, and Ketumāla to the west; / these are two realms, O best of sages, and between the two is Ilāvṛta.'

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanam
vaibhrājaṃ paścime tadvad uttare nandanaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनम्
वैभ्राजं पश्चिमे तद्वद् उत्तरे नन्दनं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: 'The forest Caitraratha is in the east, Gandhamādana in the south; / Vaibhrāja likewise in the west, and Nandana is known in the north.'

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadram asitodaṃ samānasam
sarāṃsy etāni catvāri devabhogyāni sarvadā //
meaning:
अरुणोदं महाभद्रम् असितोदं समानसम्
सरांस्य् एतानि चत्वारि देवभोग्यानि सर्वदा //
text_mt: 'Aruṇoda, Mahābhadra, Asitoda, and Mānasa: / these four lakes are always enjoyed by the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
śāntavāṃś cakrakuñjaś ca kurarī mālyavāṃs tathā
vaikaṅkapramukhā meroḥ pūrvataḥ kesarācalāḥ //
meaning:
शान्तवांश् चक्रकुञ्जश् च कुररी माल्यवांस् तथा
वैकङ्कप्रमुखा मेरोः पूर्वतः केसराचलाः //
text_mt: 'Śāntavān, Cakrakuñja, Kurarī, and Mālyavān, / with Vaikaṅka as the foremost, are the filament-mountains east of Meru.'

sanskrit_iast:
trikūṭaḥ śiśiraś caiva pataṃgo rucakas tathā
niṣadhādayo dakṣiṇatas tasya kesaraparvatāḥ //
meaning:
त्रिकूटः शिशिरश् चैव पतंगो रुचकस् तथा
निषधादयो दक्षिणतस् तस्य केसरपर्वताः //
text_mt: 'Trikūṭa, Śiśira, Pataṅga, and Rucaka, / and Niṣadha and the rest, are its filament-mountains on the south.'

sanskrit_iast:
śikhivāsaḥ savaidūryaḥ kapilo gandhamādanaḥ
jānudhipramukhās tadvat paścime kesarācalāḥ //
meaning:
शिखिवासः सवैदूर्यः कपिलो गन्धमादनः
जानुधिप्रमुखास् तद्वत् पश्चिमे केसराचलाः //
text_mt: 'Śikhivāsa, Vaidūrya, Kapila, Gandhamādana, / and Jānudhi and the rest are likewise the filament-mountains in the west.'

sanskrit_iast:
meror anantarās te ca jaṭharādiṣv avasthitāḥ
śaṅkhakūṭo 'tha ṛṣabho haṃso nāgas tathāparāḥ //
meaning:
मेरोर् अनन्तरास् ते च जठरादिष्व् अवस्थिताः
शङ्खकूटो ऽथ ऋषभो हंसो नागस् तथापराः //
text_mt: 'And those adjacent to Meru, situated at Jaṭhara and the others: / Śaṅkhakūṭa, then Ṛṣabha, Haṃsa, Nāga, and others,'

sanskrit_iast:
kālañjarādyāś ca tathā uttare kesarācalāḥ
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ mahāpurī //
meaning:
कालञ्जराद्याश् च तथा उत्तरे केसराचलाः
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि योजनानां महापुरी //
text_mt: 'and Kālañjara and others, are the filament-mountains on the north. / The great city [of Brahmā], fourteen thousand yojanas [in extent],'

sanskrit_iast:
meror upari viprendrā brahmaṇaḥ kathitā divi
tasyāṃ samantataś cāṣṭau diśāsu vidiśāsu ca //
meaning:
मेरोर् उपरि विप्रेन्द्रा ब्रह्मणः कथिता दिवि
तस्यां समन्ततश् चाष्टौ दिशासु विदिशासु च //
text_mt: O eminent twice-born, on top of Meru in heaven, the great city of Brahmā is described [as fourteen thousand yojanas]. / All around it, in the cardinal and intermediate directions, are eight

sanskrit_iast:
indrādilokapālānāṃ prakhyātāḥ pravarāḥ puraḥ
viṣṇupādaviniṣkrāntā plāvayantīndumaṇḍalam //
meaning:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां प्रख्याताः प्रवराः पुरः
विष्णुपादविनिष्क्रान्ता प्लावयन्तीन्दुमण्डलम् //
text_mt: [are] the famous, excellent cities of the world-guardians beginning with Indra. / Issuing from the foot of Viṣṇu, bathing the lunar orb,

sanskrit_iast:
samantād brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ gaṅgā patati vai divi
sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā pratyapadyata //
meaning:
समन्ताद् ब्रह्मणः पुर्यां गङ्गा पतति वै दिवि
सा तत्र पतिता दिक्षु चतुर्धा प्रत्यपद्यत //
text_mt: the Gaṅgā falls down everywhere into the city of Brahmā in heaven. / Having fallen there, she divides fourfold into the cardinal directions:

sanskrit_iast:
sītā cālakanandā ca cakṣur badhrā ca vai kramāt
pūrveṇa sītā śailāc ca śailaṃ yānty antarikṣagā //
meaning:
सीता चालकनन्दा च चक्षुर् बध्रा च वै क्रमात्
पूर्वेण सीता शैलाच् च शैलं यान्त्य् अन्तरिक्षगा //
text_mt: the Sītā, the Alakanandā, the Cakṣu, and the Bhadrā in succession. / Travelling through the intermediate space towards the east, going from mountain to mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
tataś ca pūrvavarṣeṇa bhadrāśvenaiti sārṇavam
tathaivālakanandā ca dakṣiṇenaitya bhāratam //
meaning:
ततश् च पूर्ववर्षेण भद्राश्वेनैति सार्णवम्
तथैवालकनन्दा च दक्षिणेनैत्य भारतम् //
text_mt: and then through the eastern continent Bhadrāśva, the Sītā reaches the ocean. / In the very same way the Alakanandā, going south to Bhārata,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāti sāgaraṃ bhūtvā saptabhedā dvijottamāḥ
cakṣuś ca paścimagirīn atītya sakalāṃs tataḥ //
meaning:
प्रयाति सागरं भूत्वा सप्तभेदा द्विजोत्तमाः
चक्षुश् च पश्चिमगिरीन् अतीत्य सकलांस् ततः //
text_mt: goes to the ocean, having become divided into seven, O best of the twice-born. / And the Cakṣu, having passed beyond all the western mountains, then

sanskrit_iast:
paścimaṃ ketumālākhyaṃ varṣam anveti sārṇavam
bhadrā tathottaragirīn uttarāṃś ca tathā kurūn //
meaning:
पश्चिमं केतुमालाख्यं वर्षम् अन्वेति सार्णवम्
भद्रा तथोत्तरगिरीन् उत्तरांश् च तथा कुरून् //
text_mt: proceeds through the western continent called Ketumāla to the ocean. / The Bhadrā likewise [passes beyond] the northern mountains and the Northern Kurus;

sanskrit_iast:
atītyottaram ambhodhiṃ samabhyeti dvijottamāḥ
ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau mālyavadgandhamādanau //
meaning:
अतीत्योत्तरम् अम्भोधिं समभ्येति द्विजोत्तमाः
आनीलनिषधायामौ माल्यवद्गन्धमादनौ //
text_mt: having traversed [them], it reaches the northern ocean, O best of the twice-born. / Extending from Nīla to Niṣadha are Mālyavat and Gandhamādana;

sanskrit_iast:
tayor madhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ
bhāratāḥ ketumālāś ca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravas tathā //
meaning:
तयोर् मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः
भारताः केतुमालाश् च भद्राश्वाः कुरवस् तथा //
text_mt: situated between them is Meru, standing in the shape of a pericarp. / Bhārata, Ketumāla, Bhadrāśva, and Kuru

sanskrit_iast:
pattrāṇi lokaśailasya maryādāśailabāhyataḥ
jaṭharo devakūṭaś ca maryādāparvatāv ubhau //
meaning:
पत्त्राणि लोकशैलस्य मर्यादाशैलबाह्यतः
जठरो देवकूटश् च मर्यादापर्वताव् उभौ //
text_mt: are the petals of the world-mountain, lying outside the boundary mountains. / Jaṭhara and Devakūṭa are both boundary mountains;

sanskrit_iast:
tau dakṣiṇottarāyāmāv ānīlaniṣadhāyatau
gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvapaścāt tu tāv ubhau //
meaning:
तौ दक्षिणोत्तरायामाव् आनीलनिषधायतौ
गन्धमादनकैलासौ पूर्वपश्चात् तु ताव् उभौ //
text_mt: both extend south to north, reaching from Nīla to Niṣadha. / Gandhamādana and Kailāsa, however, both lie east and west,

sanskrit_iast:
aśītiyojanāyāmāv arṇavāntarvyavasthitau
niṣadhaḥ pāriyātraś ca maryādāparvatāv ubhau //
meaning:
अशीतियोजनायामाव् अर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
निषधः पारियात्रश् च मर्यादापर्वताव् उभौ //
text_mt: extending eighty yojanas, situated within the ocean. / Niṣadha and Pāriyātra are both boundary mountains;

sanskrit_iast:
tau dakṣiṇottarāyāmāv ānīlaniṣadhāyatau
meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathā pūrvau tathā sthitau //
meaning:
तौ दक्षिणोत्तरायामाव् आनीलनिषधायतौ
मेरोः पश्चिमदिग्भागे यथा पूर्वौ तथा स्थितौ //
text_mt: both extend south to north, reaching from Nīla to Niṣadha, / situated on the western side of Meru just as the first two [are on the east].

sanskrit_iast:
triśṛṅgo jārudhiś caiva uttarau varṣaparvatau
pūrvapaścāyatāv etāv arṇavāntarvyavasthitau //
meaning:
त्रिशृङ्गो जारुधिश् चैव उत्तरौ वर्षपर्वतौ
पूर्वपश्चायताव् एताव् अर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ //
text_mt: Triśṛṅga and Jārudhi are northern continental boundary mountains; / extending east to west, these two are situated within the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
ity ete hi mayā proktā maryādāparvatā dvijāḥ
jaṭharāvasthitā meror yeṣāṃ dvau dvau caturdiśam //
meaning:
इत्य् एते हि मया प्रोक्ता मर्यादापर्वता द्विजाः
जठरावस्थिता मेरोर् येषां द्वौ द्वौ चतुर्दिशम् //
text_mt: Thus these boundary mountains have been declared by me, O twice-born, / situated at the flanks of Meru, two in each of the four directions.

sanskrit_iast:
meroś caturdiśaṃ ye tu proktāḥ kesaraparvatāḥ
śītāntādyā dvijās teṣām atīva hi manoharāḥ //
meaning:
मेरोश् चतुर्दिशं ये तु प्रोक्ताः केसरपर्वताः
शीतान्ताद्या द्विजास् तेषाम् अतीव हि मनोहराः //
text_mt: And the filament mountains that were described on all four sides of Meru, / beginning with Śītānta, O twice-born, are exceedingly enchanting.

sanskrit_iast:
śailānām antaradroṇyaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ
suramyāṇi tathā tāsu kānanāni purāṇi ca //
meaning:
शैलानाम् अन्तरद्रोण्यः सिद्धचारणसेविताः
सुरम्याणि तथा तासु काननानि पुराणि च //
text_mt: The valleys between those mountains are frequented by siddhas and cāraṇas; / likewise in them are delightful forests and cities,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīviṣṇvagnisūryendradevānāṃ munisattamāḥ
tāsv āyatanavaryāṇi juṣṭāni narakiṃnaraiḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीविष्ण्वग्निसूर्येन्द्रदेवानां मुनिसत्तमाः
तास्व् आयतनवर्याणि जुष्टानि नरकिंनरैः //
text_mt: and the supreme sanctuaries of Lakṣmī, Viṣṇu, Agni, Sūrya, Indra, and the gods, O best of sages, / frequented by humans and kiṃnaras.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi tathā daiteyadānavāḥ
krīḍanti tāsu ramyāsu śailadroṇīṣv aharniśam //
meaning:
गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षांसि तथा दैतेयदानवाः
क्रीडन्ति तासु रम्यासु शैलद्रोणीष्व् अहर्निशम् //
text_mt: Gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas, as well as Daiteyas and Dānavas, / sport in those delightful mountain valleys day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumā hy ete smṛtāḥ svargā dharmiṇām ālayā dvijāḥ
naiteṣu pāpakartāro yānti janmaśatair api //
meaning:
भौमा ह्य् एते स्मृताः स्वर्गा धर्मिणाम् आलया द्विजाः
नैतेषु पापकर्तारो यान्ति जन्मशतैर् अपि //
text_mt: These are known as the earthly heavens, the abodes of the virtuous, O twice-born; / evildoers do not go to them even after hundreds of births.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāśve bhagavān viṣṇur āste hayaśirā dvijāḥ
vārāhaḥ ketumāle tu bhārate kūrmarūpadhṛk //
meaning:
भद्राश्वे भगवान् विष्णुर् आस्ते हयशिरा द्विजाः
वाराहः केतुमाले तु भारते कूर्मरूपधृक् //
text_mt: In Bhadrāśva the blessed Viṣṇu dwells as the horse-headed one, O twice-born; / as the boar in Ketumāla, and bearing the form of the tortoise in Bhārata;

sanskrit_iast:
matsyarūpaś ca govindaḥ kuruṣv āste sanātanaḥ
viśvarūpeṇa sarvatra sarvaḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ //
meaning:
मत्स्यरूपश् च गोविन्दः कुरुष्व् आस्ते सनातनः
विश्वरूपेण सर्वत्र सर्वः सर्वेश्वरो हरिः //
text_mt: and the eternal Govinda dwells in the form of the fish among the Kurus. / In his cosmic form everywhere, Hari, the lord of all, is everything;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasyādhārabhūto 'sau dvijā āste 'khilātmakaḥ
yāni kiṃpuruṣādyāni varṣāṇy aṣṭau dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वस्याधारभूतो ऽसौ द्विजा आस्ते ऽखिलात्मकः
यानि किंपुरुषाद्यानि वर्षाण्य् अष्टौ द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: he remains as the support of all, O twice-born, being the soul of the universe. / The eight continents beginning with Kiṃpuruṣa, O best of the twice-born—

sanskrit_iast:
na teṣu śoko nāyāso nodvegaḥ kṣudbhayādikam
susthāḥ prajā nirātaṅkāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
न तेषु शोको नायासो नोद्वेगः क्षुद्भयादिकम्
सुस्थाः प्रजा निरातङ्काः सर्वदुःखविवर्जिताः //
