तद् एतद् भारतं वर्षं सर्वबीजं द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: with the Himavat to its north like the string of a bow. / This very Bhārata realm is the seed of all, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmatvam amareśatvaṃ devatvaṃ marutāṃ tathā
mṛgayakṣāpsaroyoniṃ tadvat sarpasarīsṛpāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मत्वम् अमरेशत्वं देवत्वं मरुतां तथा
मृगयक्षाप्सरोयोनिं तद्वत् सर्पसरीसृपाः //
text_mt: The state of Brahmā, the sovereignty of the immortals, the godhood of the Maruts, / birth as beasts, yakṣas, and apsarases, and likewise as snakes and reptiles,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mito viprāḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ
prayānti karmabhūr viprā nānyā lokeṣu vidyate //
meaning:
स्थावराणां च सर्वेषां मितो विप्राः शुभाशुभैः
प्रयान्ति कर्मभूर् विप्रा नान्या लोकेषु विद्यते //
text_mt: and of all stationary beings, O brahmins, [is attained] by good and bad [actions]. / Brahmins, they attain it [here]; no other land of actions exists among the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
devānām api bho viprāḥ sadaivaiṣa manorathaḥ
api mānuṣyam āpsyāmo devatvāt pracyutāḥ kṣitau //
meaning:
देवानाम् अपि भो विप्राः सदैवैष मनोरथः
अपि मानुष्यम् आप्स्यामो देवत्वात् प्रच्युताः क्षितौ //
text_mt: Even of the gods, O brahmins, this desire is constant: / ‘Shall we, fallen from godhood, attain human birth on earth?’

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyaḥ kurute yat tu tan na śakyaṃ surāsuraiḥ
tatkarmanigaḍagrastais tatkarmakṣapaṇonmukhaiḥ //
meaning:
मनुष्यः कुरुते यत् तु तन् न शक्यं सुरासुरैः
तत्कर्मनिगडग्रस्तैस् तत्कर्मक्षपणोन्मुखैः //
text_mt: For what a human being performs cannot be performed by gods and demons, / who are seized by the shackles of their karma and intent only on exhausting that karma.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhāratasamaṃ varṣaṃ pṛthivyām asti bho dvijāḥ
yatra viprādayo varṇāḥ prāpnuvanty abhivāñchitam //
meaning:
न भारतसमं वर्षं पृथिव्याम् अस्ति भो द्विजाः
यत्र विप्रादयो वर्णाः प्राप्नुवन्त्य् अभिवाञ्छितम् //
text_mt: There is no realm equal to Bhārata on earth, O twice-born, / where the social classes beginning with brahmins attain what they desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyās te bhārate varṣe jāyante ye narottamāḥ
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāpnuvanti mahāphalam //
meaning:
धन्यास् ते भारते वर्षे जायन्ते ये नरोत्तमाः
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां प्राप्नुवन्ति महाफलम् //
text_mt: Fortunate are they, the best of men, who are born in Bhārata realm; / they obtain the great fruit of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyate yatra tapasaḥ phalaṃ paramadurlabham
sarvadānaphalaṃ caiva sarvayajñaphalaṃ tathā //
meaning:
प्राप्यते यत्र तपसः फलं परमदुर्लभम्
सर्वदानफलं चैव सर्वयज्ञफलं तथा //
text_mt: Where the exceedingly rare fruit of asceticism is attained, / and the fruit of all giving, and the fruit of every sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthayātrāphalaṃ caiva gurusevāphalaṃ tathā
devatārādhanaphalaṃ svādhyāyasya phalaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थयात्राफलं चैव गुरुसेवाफलं तथा
देवताराधनफलं स्वाध्यायस्य फलं द्विजाः //
text_mt: and the fruit of pilgrimage to tīrthas, and the fruit of service to the guru, / the fruit of worshipping deities, and the fruit of Vedic study, O twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
yatra devāḥ sadā hṛṣṭā janma vāñchanti śobhanam
nānāvrataphalaṃ caiva nānāśāstraphalaṃ tathā //
meaning:
यत्र देवाः सदा हृष्टा जन्म वाञ्छन्ति शोभनम्
नानाव्रतफलं चैव नानाशास्त्रफलं तथा //
text_mt: where the gods, ever joyful, desire an auspicious birth; / and the fruit of diverse vows, and the fruit of diverse sacred treatises;

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsādiphalaṃ samyak phalaṃ sarvābhivāñchitam
brahmacaryaphalaṃ caiva gārhasthyena ca yat phalam //
meaning:
अहिंसादिफलं सम्यक् फलं सर्वाभिवाञ्छितम्
ब्रह्मचर्यफलं चैव गार्हस्थ्येन च यत् फलम् //
text_mt: the proper fruit of nonviolence and the rest, every desired fruit; / the fruit of student celibacy, and whatever fruit [is won] through householdership;

sanskrit_iast:
yat phalaṃ vanavāsena saṃnyāsena ca yat phalam
iṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ caiva tathānyac chubhakarmaṇām //
meaning:
यत् फलं वनवासेन संन्यासेन च यत् फलम्
इष्टापूर्तफलं चैव तथान्यच् छुभकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: whatever fruit [is won] through forest-dwelling, and whatever fruit through renunciation; / the fruit of sacrificial and charitable deeds, and likewise of other auspicious actions;

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyate bhārate varṣe na cānyatra dvijottamāḥ
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ bhāratasyākhilān dvijāḥ //
meaning:
प्राप्यते भारते वर्षे न चान्यत्र द्विजोत्तमाः
कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं भारतस्याखिलान् द्विजाः //
text_mt: all is attained in Bhārata realm, and nowhere else, O best of the twice-born. / Who is able to declare all the virtues of Bhārata, O twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ samyaṅ mayā proktaṃ bhārataṃ varṣam uttamam
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ buddhivivardhanam //
meaning:
एवं सम्यङ् मया प्रोक्तं भारतं वर्षम् उत्तमम्
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं धन्यं बुद्धिविवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Thus has the excellent Bhārata realm been properly spoken of by me— / dispelling all sins, holy, auspicious, and increasing intelligence.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ paṭhed vā niyatendriyaḥ
sarvapāpair vinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान् नित्यं पठेद् वा नियतेन्द्रियः
सर्वपापैर् विनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever, with senses restrained, constantly hears this or recites it, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tatrāste bhārate varṣe dakṣiṇodadhisaṃsthitaḥ
oṇḍradeśa iti khyātaḥ svargamokṣapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तत्रास्ते भारते वर्षे दक्षिणोदधिसंस्थितः
ओण्ड्रदेश इति ख्यातः स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There, in Bhārata realm, situated by the southern ocean, / is the realm known as Oṇḍra, which bestows heaven and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
samudrād uttaraṃ tāvad yāvad virajamaṇḍalam
deśo 'sau puṇyaśīlānāṃ guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
समुद्राद् उत्तरं तावद् यावद् विरजमण्डलम्
देशो ऽसौ पुण्यशीलानां गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः //
text_mt: North of the ocean as far as the district of Viraja, / that land belongs to the virtuous and is adorned with every virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra deśaprasūtā ye brāhmaṇāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ
tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā vandyāḥ pūjyāś ca te sadā //
meaning:
तत्र देशप्रसूता ये ब्राह्मणाः संयतेन्द्रियाः
तपःस्वाध्यायनिरता वन्द्याः पूज्याश् च ते सदा //
text_mt: The brahmins born in that country, with their senses restrained, / devoted to asceticism and Vedic study, are ever to be praised and honoured.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe dāne vivāhe ca yajñe vācāryakarmaṇi
praśastāḥ sarvakāryeṣu tatradeśodbhavā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धे दाने विवाहे च यज्ञे वाचार्यकर्मणि
प्रशस्ताः सर्वकार्येषु तत्रदेशोद्भवा द्विजाः //
text_mt: In ancestral rites, in giving, in marriage, in sacrifice, and in the duties of a teacher— / in all ceremonies the twice-born born in that land are commended.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkarmaniratās tatra brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
itihāsavidaś caiva purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ //
meaning:
षट्कर्मनिरतास् तत्र ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः
इतिहासविदश् चैव पुराणार्थविशारदाः //
text_mt: The brahmins there are devoted to the six duties, masters of the Vedas, / knowers of epic history, and proficient in the meaning of the Purāṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalā yajvāno vītamatsarāḥ
agnihotraratāḥ kecit kecit smārtāgnitatparāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थकुशला यज्वानो वीतमत्सराः
अग्निहोत्ररताः केचित् केचित् स्मार्ताग्नितत्पराः //
text_mt: skilled in the meaning of all treatises, sacrificers, free from envy, / some devoted to the Agnihotra, some intent on the domestic fire;

sanskrit_iast:
putradāradhanair yuktā dātāraḥ satyavādinaḥ
nivasanty utkale puṇye yajñotsavavibhūṣite //
meaning:
पुत्रदारधनैर् युक्ता दातारः सत्यवादिनः
निवसन्त्य् उत्कले पुण्ये यज्ञोत्सवविभूषिते //
text_mt: endowed with sons, wives, and wealth, generous, speaking the truth, / they dwell in holy Utkala, which is adorned with sacrificial festivals.

sanskrit_iast:
itare 'pi trayo varṇāḥ kṣatriyādyāḥ susaṃyatāḥ
svakarmaniratāḥ śāntās tatra tiṣṭhanti dhārmikāḥ //
meaning:
इतरे ऽपि त्रयो वर्णाः क्षत्रियाद्याः सुसंयताः
स्वकर्मनिरताः शान्तास् तत्र तिष्ठन्ति धार्मिकाः //
text_mt: The other three classes as well, beginning with kṣatriyas, fully restrained, / devoted to their own duties, tranquil and righteous, abide there.

sanskrit_iast:
koṇāditya iti khyātas tasmin deśe vyavasthitaḥ
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāskaraṃ martyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
कोणादित्य इति ख्यातस् तस्मिन् देशे व्यवस्थितः
यं दृष्ट्वा भास्करं मर्त्यः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Known as Koṇāditya, [the sun god] is situated in that land; / seeing that sun, a mortal is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
śrotum icchāma tad brūhi kṣetraṃ sūryasya sāṃpratam
tasmin deśe suraśreṣṭha yatrāste sa divākaraḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
श्रोतुम् इच्छाम तद् ब्रूहि क्षेत्रं सूर्यस्य सांप्रतम्
तस्मिन् देशे सुरश्रेष्ठ यत्रास्ते स दिवाकरः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
We wish to hear; tell [us] now of that sacred precinct of the sun, / O best of gods, in that land where the sun dwells.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
lavaṇasyodadhes tīre pavitre sumanohare
sarvatra vālukākīrṇe deśe sarvaguṇānvite //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
लवणस्योदधेस् तीरे पवित्रे सुमनोहरे
सर्वत्र वालुकाकीर्णे देशे सर्वगुणान्विते //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
On the shore of the salt ocean, pure and charming, / in a land covered everywhere with sand, endowed with all virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
campakāśokabakulaiḥ karavīraiḥ sapāṭalaiḥ
puṃnāgaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca bakulair nāgakesaraiḥ //
meaning:
चम्पकाशोकबकुलैः करवीरैः सपाटलैः
पुंनागैः कर्णिकारैश् च बकुलैर् नागकेसरैः //
text_mt: with campaka, aśoka, and bakula trees, with karavīras and pāṭalas, / with puṃnāgas, karṇikāras, bakulas, and nāgakesaras,

sanskrit_iast:
tagarair dhavabāṇaiś ca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ
mālatīkundapuṣpaiś ca tathānyair mallikādibhiḥ //
meaning:
तगरैर् धवबाणैश् च अतिमुक्तैः सकुब्जकैः
मालतीकुन्दपुष्पैश् च तथान्यैर् मल्लिकादिभिः //
text_mt: with tagaras, dhava-bāṇas, atimuktas, and kubjakas, / with mālatī and kunda flowers, and likewise others such as mallikā,

sanskrit_iast:
ketakīvanakhaṇḍaiś ca sarvartukusumojjvalaiḥ
kadambair lakucaiḥ śālaiḥ panasair devadārubhiḥ //
meaning:
केतकीवनखण्डैश् च सर्वर्तुकुसुमोज्ज्वलैः
कदम्बैर् लकुचैः शालैः पनसैर् देवदारुभिः //
text_mt: with groves of ketakī, resplendent with flowers of all seasons, / with kadambas, lakucas, śālas, jackfruits, and deodars,

sanskrit_iast:
saralair mucukundaiś ca candanaiś ca sitetaraiḥ
aśvatthaiḥ saptaparṇaiś ca āmrair āmrātakais tathā //
meaning:
सरलैर् मुचुकुन्दैश् च चन्दनैश् च सितेतरैः
अश्वत्थैः सप्तपर्णैश् च आम्रैर् आम्रातकैस् तथा //
text_mt: with pine trees, mucukundas, and dark sandalwoods, / with aśvattha trees, saptaparṇas, mangoes, and hog-plums,

sanskrit_iast:
tālaiḥ pūgaphalaiś caiva nārikeraiḥ kapitthakaiḥ
anyaiś ca vividhair vṛkṣaiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtam //
meaning:
तालैः पूगफलैश् चैव नारिकेरैः कपित्थकैः
अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वृक्षैः सर्वतः समलंकृतम् //
text_mt: with palmyra palms, areca palms, coconuts, wood-apples, / and various other trees, it is adorned on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ tatra raveḥ puṇyam āste jagati viśrutam
samantād yojanaṃ sāgraṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam //
meaning:
क्षेत्रं तत्र रवेः पुण्यम् आस्ते जगति विश्रुतम्
समन्ताद् योजनं साग्रं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: There abides the holy sacred precinct of the sun, renowned throughout the world, / a little more than a yojana all around, bestowing the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
āste tatra svayaṃ devaḥ sahasrāṃśur divākaraḥ
koṇāditya iti khyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
आस्ते तत्र स्वयं देवः सहस्रांशुर् दिवाकरः
कोणादित्य इति ख्यातो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः //
text_mt: There the god himself resides, the thousand-rayed day-maker, / celebrated as Koṇāditya, bestower of the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe māsi site pakṣe saptamyāṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ
kṛtopavāso yatretya snātvā tu makarālaye //
meaning:
माघे मासि सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां संयतेन्द्रियः
कृतोपवासो यत्रेत्य स्नात्वा तु मकरालये //
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, on the seventh day, with senses restrained, / having observed a fast and arrived there, having bathed in the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaśauco viśuddhātmā smaran devaṃ divākaram
sāgare vidhivat snātvā śarvaryante samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कृतशौचो विशुद्धात्मा स्मरन् देवं दिवाकरम्
सागरे विधिवत् स्नात्वा शर्वर्यन्ते समाहितः //
text_mt: having purified himself, purified in spirit, remembering the divine day-maker, / having bathed duly in the ocean at the end of the night, fully concentrated,

sanskrit_iast:
devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝn saṃtarpya ca dvijāḥ
uttīrya vāsasī dhaute paridhāya sunirmale //
meaning:
देवान् ऋषीन् मनुष्यांश् च पितॄन् संतर्प्य च द्विजाः
उत्तीर्य वाससी धौते परिधाय सुनिर्मले //
text_mt: having gratified the gods, the ṛṣis, humans, and the ancestors, O twice-born ones, / having emerged and put on two washed, purely clean garments,

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya prayato bhūtvā tīre tasya mahodadheḥ
upaviśyodaye kāle prāṅmukhaḥ savitus tadā //
meaning:
आचम्य प्रयतो भूत्वा तीरे तस्य महोदधेः
उपविश्योदये काले प्राङ्मुखः सवितुस् तदा //
text_mt: having sipped water, purified, on the shore of that great ocean, / seated at the time of sunrise, facing east toward the sun then,

sanskrit_iast:
vilikhya padmaṃ medhāvī raktacandanavāriṇā
aṣṭapattraṃ kesarāḍhyaṃ vartulaṃ cordhvakarṇikam //
meaning:
विलिख्य पद्मं मेधावी रक्तचन्दनवारिणा
अष्टपत्त्रं केसराढ्यं वर्तुलं चोर्ध्वकर्णिकम् //
text_mt: the wise man, drawing an eight-petalled lotus with red sandalwood water, / rich in filaments, circular, and with an upright pericarp,

sanskrit_iast:
tilataṇḍulatoyaṃ ca raktacandanasaṃyutam
raktapuṣpaṃ sadarbhaṃ ca prakṣipet tāmrabhājane //
meaning:
तिलतण्डुलतोयं च रक्तचन्दनसंयुतम्
रक्तपुष्पं सदर्भं च प्रक्षिपेत् ताम्रभाजने //
text_mt: should place water with sesame and raw rice, mixed with red sandalwood, / along with red flowers and darbha grass, into a copper vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrābhāve 'rkapattrasya puṭe kṛtvā tilādikam
pidhāya tan muniśreṣṭhāḥ pātraṃ pātreṇa vinyaset //
meaning:
ताम्राभावे ऽर्कपत्त्रस्य पुटे कृत्वा तिलादिकम्
पिधाय तन् मुनिश्रेष्ठाः पात्रं पात्रेण विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: In the absence of copper, having placed the sesame and other items in a bowl of arka-leaves, / and having covered it, O best of sages, he should set vessel upon vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
karanyāsāṅgavinyāsaṃ kṛtvāṅgair hṛdayādibhiḥ
ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ dhyātvā samyak śraddhāsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
करन्यासाङ्गविन्यासं कृत्वाङ्गैर् हृदयादिभिः
आत्मानं भास्करं ध्यात्वा सम्यक् श्रद्धासमन्वितः //
text_mt: Having performed the placement on the hands and limbs with the limb-mantras such as the heart, / meditating on the sun as the self, endowed with perfect faith,

sanskrit_iast:
madhye cāgnidale dhīmān nairṛte śvasane dale
kāmārigocare caiva punar madhye ca pūjayet //
meaning:
मध्ये चाग्निदले धीमान् नैरृते श्वसने दले
कामारिगोचरे चैव पुनर् मध्ये च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: the wise man should worship in the center, and on the Agni-petal, on the Nairṛta-petal, on the Vāyu-petal, / on the petal of the enemy of Kāma [Īśāna], and again in the center,

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ sāram ārādhyaṃ paramaṃ sukham
saṃpūjya padmam āvāhya gaganāt tatra bhāskaram //
meaning:
प्रभूतं विमलं सारम् आराध्यं परमं सुखम्
संपूज्य पद्मम् आवाह्य गगनात् तत्र भास्करम् //
text_mt: having worshipped the lotus as vast, stainless, essential, adorable, supreme bliss, / and having invoked the sun from the sky into it,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikopari saṃsthāpya tato mudrāṃ pradarśayet
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ dhyātvā taṃ susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कर्णिकोपरि संस्थाप्य ततो मुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्
कृत्वा स्नानादिकं सर्वं ध्यात्वा तं सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: having installed him upon the pericarp, he should then display the mudrā. / Having completed all rites such as bathing, meditating on him with great concentration,

sanskrit_iast:
sitapadmopari raviṃ tejobimbe vyavasthitam
piṅgākṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ padmapattrāruṇāmbaram //
meaning:
सितपद्मोपरि रविं तेजोबिम्बे व्यवस्थितम्
पिङ्गाक्षं द्विभुजं रक्तं पद्मपत्त्रारुणाम्बरम् //
text_mt: upon a white lotus [meditating on] the sun situated within the orb of splendor, / amber-eyed, two-armed, red, with garments reddish like lotus petals,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
surūpaṃ varadaṃ śāntaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
सुरूपं वरदं शान्तं प्रभामण्डलमण्डितम् //
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / handsome, boon-bestowing, serene, adorned with an aureole of radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
udyantaṃ bhāskaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sāndrasindūrasaṃnibham
tatas tat pātram ādāya jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
उद्यन्तं भास्करं दृष्ट्वा सान्द्रसिन्दूरसंनिभम्
ततस् तत् पात्रम् आदाय जानुभ्यां धरणीं गतः //
text_mt: seeing the sun rising, resembling dense vermilion, / then, taking that vessel, having touched the ground with both knees,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śirasi tat pātram ekacittas tu vāgyataḥ
tryakṣareṇa tu mantreṇa sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत् पात्रम् एकचित्तस् तु वाग्यतः
त्र्यक्षरेण तु मन्त्रेण सूर्यायार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: placing that vessel on his head, single-minded and restrained in speech, / he should offer the arghya to the sun with the three-syllabled mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitas tu tasyaiva nāmnaivārghaṃ prayacchati
śraddhayā bhāvayuktena bhaktigrāhyo ravir yataḥ //
meaning:
अदीक्षितस् तु तस्यैव नाम्नैवार्घं प्रयच्छति
श्रद्धया भावयुक्तेन भक्तिग्राह्यो रविर् यतः //
text_mt: One who is uninitiated, however, offers the arghya using merely his name, / since the sun is grasped through devotion by one endowed with faith and feeling.

sanskrit_iast:
agninirṛtivāyvīśamadhyapūrvādidikṣu ca
hṛc chiraś ca śikhāvarmanetrāṇy astraṃ ca pūjayet //
meaning:
अग्निनिरृतिवाय्वीशमध्यपूर्वादिदिक्षु च
हृच् छिरश् च शिखावर्मनेत्राण्य् अस्त्रं च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: In the Agni, Nirṛti, Vāyu, and Īśa directions, and in the center and the east, / he should worship the heart, the head, the crest, the armor, the eyes, and the weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvārghyaṃ gandhadhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyam eva ca
japtvā stutvā namas kṛtvā mudrāṃ baddhvā visarjayet //
meaning:
दत्त्वार्घ्यं गन्धधूपं च दीपं नैवेद्यम् एव च
जप्त्वा स्तुत्वा नमस् कृत्वा मुद्रां बद्ध्वा विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Having offered arghya, fragrant paste, incense, light, and food-offering, / having recited, praised, paid homage, and formed the mudrā, he should release [the deity].

sanskrit_iast:
ye vārghyaṃ saṃprayacchanti sūryāya niyatendriyāḥ
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāś ca saṃyatāḥ //
meaning:
ये वार्घ्यं संप्रयच्छन्ति सूर्याय नियतेन्द्रियाः
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्राश् च संयताः //
text_mt: Those who offer arghya to the sun with restrained senses— / brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, and disciplined śūdras—

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktibhāvena satataṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā
te bhuktvābhimatān kāmān prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
भक्तिभावेन सततं विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना
ते भुक्त्वाभिमतान् कामान् प्राप्नुवन्ति परां गतिम् //
text_mt: constantly with the disposition of devotion, with a purified inner self, / they, having enjoyed their desired wishes, attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyadīpakaṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaganecaram
ye saṃśrayanti manujās te syuḥ sukhasya bhājanam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यदीपकं देवं भास्करं गगनेचरम्
ये संश्रयन्ति मनुजास् ते स्युः सुखस्य भाजनम् //
text_mt: The god who illuminates the three worlds, the sun that moves in the sky— / humans who take refuge in him become vessels of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvan na dīyate cārghyaṃ bhāskarāya yathoditam
tāvan na pūjayed viṣṇuṃ śaṃkaraṃ vā sureśvaram //
meaning:
यावन् न दीयते चार्घ्यं भास्कराय यथोदितम्
तावन् न पूजयेद् विष्णुं शंकरं वा सुरेश्वरम् //
text_mt: As long as arghya is not offered to the sun as prescribed, / so long one should not worship Viṣṇu or Śaṅkara, the lord of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt prayatnam āsthāya dadyād arghyaṃ dine dine
ādityāya śucir bhūtvā puṣpair gandhair manoramaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् प्रयत्नम् आस्थाय दद्याद् अर्घ्यं दिने दिने
आदित्याय शुचिर् भूत्वा पुष्पैर् गन्धैर् मनोरमैः //
text_mt: Therefore, making an effort, one should give arghya day after day / to Āditya, having become pure, with delightful flowers and fragrances.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dadāti yaś cārghyaṃ saptamyāṃ susamāhitaḥ
ādityāya śuciḥ snātaḥ sa labhed īpsitaṃ phalam //
meaning:
एवं ददाति यश् चार्घ्यं सप्तम्यां सुसमाहितः
आदित्याय शुचिः स्नातः स लभेद् ईप्सितं फलम् //
text_mt: And whoever offers arghya in this manner on the seventh day, deeply concentrated, / to Āditya, pure and bathed, obtains his desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
rogād vimucyate rogī vittārthī labhate dhanam
vidyāṃ prāpnoti vidyārthī sutārthī putravān bhavet //
meaning:
रोगाद् विमुच्यते रोगी वित्तार्थी लभते धनम्
विद्यां प्राप्नोति विद्यार्थी सुतार्थी पुत्रवान् भवेत् //
text_mt: A diseased person is freed from disease; one desiring wealth obtains riches; / one desiring knowledge attains knowledge; one desiring a son becomes father of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyan sūryāyārghyaṃ prayacchati
tasya tasya phalaṃ samyak prāpnoti puruṣaḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
यं यं कामम् अभिध्यायन् सूर्यायार्घ्यं प्रयच्छति
तस्य तस्य फलं सम्यक् प्राप्नोति पुरुषः सुधीः //
text_mt: Whatever desire a wise person focuses on when offering arghya to the sun, / the fruit of each of those he fully obtains.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā vai sāgare dattvā sūryāyārghyaṃ praṇamya ca
naro vā yadi vā nārī sarvakāmaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
स्नात्वा वै सागरे दत्त्वा सूर्यायार्घ्यं प्रणम्य च
नरो वा यदि वा नारी सर्वकामफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Having bathed in the ocean, offered arghya to the sun, and bowed down, / a man or a woman obtains the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sūryālayaṃ gacchet puṣpam ādāya vāgyataḥ
praviśya pūjayed bhānuṃ kṛtvā tu triḥ pradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
ततः सूर्यालयं गच्छेत् पुष्पम् आदाय वाग्यतः
प्रविश्य पूजयेद् भानुं कृत्वा तु त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Then one should go to the sun's temple, taking a flower, restrained in speech; / having entered, he should worship the sun after circumambulating thrice.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā koṇārkaṃ munisattamāḥ
gandhaiḥ puṣpais tathā dīpair dhūpair naivedyakair api //
meaning:
पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या कोणार्कं मुनिसत्तमाः
गन्धैः पुष्पैस् तथा दीपैर् धूपैर् नैवेद्यकैर् अपि //
text_mt: One should worship Koṇārka with supreme devotion, O best of sages, / with fragrant pastes, flowers, lights, incense, and food-offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍavat praṇipātaiś ca jayaśabdais tathā stavaiḥ
evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ devaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ jagatpatim //
meaning:
दण्डवत् प्रणिपातैश् च जयशब्दैस् तथा स्तवैः
एवं संपूज्य तं देवं सहस्रांशुं जगत्पतिम् //
text_mt: and with prostrations like a staff, cries of victory, and praises. / Having thus worshipped that god, the thousand-rayed lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
sarvapāpavinirmukto yuvā divyavapur naraḥ //
meaning:
दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो युवा दिव्यवपुर् नरः //
text_mt: a human being obtains the fruit of ten horse sacrifices; / freed from all sins, a youthful man with a celestial body,

sanskrit_iast:
saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya bho dvijāḥ
vimānenārkavarṇena kāmagena suvarcasā //
meaning:
सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् वंशान् उद्धृत्य भो द्विजाः
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन कामगेन सुवर्चसा //
text_mt: having delivered seven generations after and seven before, O twice-born ones, / by means of a sun-colored, sky-faring celestial vehicle of great splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
upagīyamāno gandharvaiḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
उपगीयमानो गन्धर्वैः सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति
भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: sung to by gandharvas, he goes to the world of the sun; / having enjoyed excellent pleasures there until the dissolution of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ pravare yogināṃ kule
caturvedo bhaved vipraḥ svadharmanirataḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः प्रवरे योगिनां कुले
चतुर्वेदो भवेद् विप्रः स्वधर्मनिरतः शुचिः //
text_mt: returning here due to the exhaustion of merit, he is born in an eminent lineage of yogins; / he becomes a brāhmaṇa versed in the four Vedas, devoted to his own dharma, and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaṃ vivasvataḥ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
caitre māsi site pakṣe yātrāṃ damanabhañjikām //
meaning:
योगं विवस्वतः प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
चैत्रे मासि सिते पक्षे यात्रां दमनभञ्जिकाम् //
text_mt: Having attained union with Vivasvat, he then obtains liberation. / In the month of Caitra, in the bright fortnight, the pilgrimage to break the damana plant—

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karoti naras tatra pūrvoktaṃ sa phalaṃ labhet
śayanotthāpane bhānoḥ saṃkrāntyāṃ viṣuvāyane //
meaning:
यः करोति नरस् तत्र पूर्वोक्तं स फलं लभेत्
शयनोत्थापने भानोः संक्रान्त्यां विषुवायने //
text_mt: the person who undertakes that pilgrimage there obtains the previously stated fruit. / At the reclining and the waking of the sun, at an equinox, a solstice,

sanskrit_iast:
vāre raves tithau caiva parvakāle 'thavā dvijāḥ
ye tatra yātrāṃ kurvanti śraddhayā saṃyatendriyāḥ //
meaning:
वारे रवेस् तिथौ चैव पर्वकाले ऽथवा द्विजाः
ये तत्र यात्रां कुर्वन्ति श्रद्धया संयतेन्द्रियाः //
text_mt: on the day of the sun, on a lunar day, or at a festival period, O twice-born ones, / those who make a pilgrimage there with faith and controlled senses,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānenārkavarṇena sūryalokaṃ vrajanti te
āste tatra mahādevas tīre nadanadīpateḥ //
meaning:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन सूर्यलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
आस्ते तत्र महादेवस् तीरे नदनदीपतेः //
text_mt: travel in a sun-colored celestial vehicle to the world of the sun. / There resides Mahādeva on the shore of the lord of rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeśvara iti khyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ
ye taṃ paśyanti kāmāriṃ snātvā samyaṅ mahodadhau //
meaning:
रामेश्वर इति ख्यातः सर्वकामफलप्रदः
ये तं पश्यन्ति कामारिं स्नात्वा सम्यङ् महोदधौ //
text_mt: renowned as Rāmeśvara, bestower of the fruits of all desires. / Those who behold that enemy of Kāma after having bathed properly in the great ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaiḥ puṣpais tathā dhūpair dīpair naivedyakair varaiḥ
praṇipātais tathā stotrair gītair vādyair manoharaiḥ //
meaning:
गन्धैः पुष्पैस् तथा धूपैर् दीपैर् नैवेद्यकैर् वरैः
प्रणिपातैस् तथा स्तोत्रैर् गीतैर् वाद्यैर् मनोहरैः //
text_mt: with fragrances, flowers, incense, lights, and excellent food-offerings, / with prostrations, hymns of praise, songs, and delightful musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
rājasūyaphalaṃ samyag vājimedhaphalaṃ tathā
prāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ tathā //
meaning:
राजसूयफलं सम्यग् वाजिमेधफलं तथा
प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां तथा //
text_mt: those great souls fully obtain the fruit of a royal consecration and the fruit of a horse sacrifice, / as well as supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmagena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā
upagīyamānā gandharvaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te //
meaning:
कामगेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना
उपगीयमाना गन्धर्वैः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते //
text_mt: In a sky-faring celestial vehicle garlanded with networks of tiny bells, / sung to by gandharvas, they go to the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvad bhuktvā bhogān manoramān
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya cāturvedā bhavanti te //
meaning:
आहूतसंप्लवं यावद् भुक्त्वा भोगान् मनोरमान्
पुण्यक्षयाद् इहागत्य चातुर्वेदा भवन्ति ते //
text_mt: Having enjoyed delightful pleasures until the dissolution of beings, / returning here due to the exhaustion of merit, they become knowers of the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃkaraṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣaṃ vrajanti te
yas tatra savituḥ kṣetre prāṇāṃs tyajati mānavaḥ //
meaning:
शांकरं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षं व्रजन्ति ते
यस् तत्र सवितुः क्षेत्रे प्राणांस् त्यजति मानवः //
text_mt: Resorting to the yoga of Śaṅkara, they then go to liberation. / The person who gives up his life's breaths in that sacred domain of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
sa sūryalokam āsthāya devavan modate divi
punar mānuṣatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
स सूर्यलोकम् आस्थाय देववन् मोदते दिवि
पुनर् मानुषतां प्राप्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः //
text_mt: resorting to the world of the sun, rejoices in heaven like a god; / having regained human existence, he becomes a righteous king.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaṃ raveḥ samāsādya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ proktaṃ kṣetraṃ sudurlabham //
meaning:
योगं रवेः समासाद्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
एवं मया मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रोक्तं क्षेत्रं सुदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Having attained union with the sun, he then obtains liberation. / Thus, O best of sages, has this most rarely accessible sacred field been declared by me.

sanskrit_iast: koṇārkasyodadhes tīre bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ //
meaning: कोणार्कस्योदधेस् तीरे भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः //
text_mt: [the sacred site] of Koṇārka on the shore of the ocean, which yields the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
śruto 'smābhiḥ suraśreṣṭha bhavatā yad udāhṛtam
bhāskarasya paraṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
श्रुतो ऽस्माभिः सुरश्रेष्ठ भवता यद् उदाहृतम्
भास्करस्य परं क्षेत्रं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
We have heard, O best of gods, what you have related,
the supreme sacred site of the Sun that grants the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
na tṛptim adhigacchāmaḥ śṛṇvantaḥ sukhadāṃ kathām
tava vaktrodbhavāṃ puṇyām ādityasyāghanāśinīm //
meaning:
न तृप्तिम् अधिगच्छामः शृण्वन्तः सुखदां कथाम्
तव वक्त्रोद्भवां पुण्याम् आदित्यस्याघनाशिनीम् //
text_mt:
We do not attain satiety listening to the happiness-granting narrative,
holy and sin-destroying, arising from your mouth, concerning the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ suraśreṣṭha brūhi no vadatāṃ vara
devapūjāphalaṃ yac ca yac ca dānaphalaṃ prabho //
meaning:
अतः परं सुरश्रेष्ठ ब्रूहि नो वदतां वर
देवपूजाफलं यच् च यच् च दानफलं प्रभो //
text_mt:
Beyond this, O best of gods, tell us, O best of speakers,
what the fruit of worshiping the god is, and what the fruit of giving is, O lord;

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipāte namaskāre tathā caiva pradakṣiṇe
dīpadhūpapradāne ca saṃmārjanavidhau ca yat //
meaning:
प्रणिपाते नमस्कारे तथा चैव प्रदक्षिणे
दीपधूपप्रदाने च संमार्जनविधौ च यत् //
text_mt:
and what [the fruit] is in bowing down, in paying homage, and likewise in circumambulation,
in the offering of lamps and incense, and in the rite of sweeping;

sanskrit_iast:
upavāse ca yat puṇyaṃ yat puṇyaṃ naktabhojane
arghaś ca kīdṛśaḥ proktaḥ kutra vā saṃpradīyate //
meaning:
उपवासे च यत् पुण्यं यत् पुण्यं नक्तभोजने
अर्घश् च कीदृशः प्रोक्तः कुत्र वा संप्रदीयते //
text_mt:
and what merit lies in fasting, and what merit in eating at night;
and what kind of water-offering is prescribed, and where it is to be presented;

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ ca kriyate bhaktiḥ kathaṃ devaḥ prasīdati
etat sarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha śrotum icchāmahe vayam //
meaning:
कथं च क्रियते भक्तिः कथं देवः प्रसीदति
एतत् सर्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे वयम् //
text_mt:
and how devotion is performed, and how the god is pleased—
all this, O best of gods, we wish to hear.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
arghyaṃ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhāskarasya dvijottamāḥ
bhaktiṃ śraddhāṃ samādhiṃ ca kathyamānaṃ nibodhata //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अर्घ्यं पूजादिकं सर्वं भास्करस्य द्विजोत्तमाः
भक्तिं श्रद्धां समाधिं च कथ्यमानं निबोधत //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Learn of the water-offering, the worship, and all the rest for the Sun, O best of the twice-born,
as devotion, faith, and absorption are explained.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā bhāvanā bhaktir iṣṭā śraddhā ca kīrtyate
dhyānaṃ samādhir ity uktaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ //
meaning:
मनसा भावना भक्तिर् इष्टा श्रद्धा च कीर्त्यते
ध्यानं समाधिर् इत्य् उक्तं शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः //
text_mt:
Mental contemplation is devotion; faith is proclaimed as cherished regard;
meditation is called absorption. Listen attentively with concentrated mind:

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathāṃ śrāvayed yas tu tadbhaktān pūjayīta vā
agniśuśrūṣakaś caiva sa vai bhaktaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
तत्कथां श्रावयेद् यस् तु तद्भक्तान् पूजयीत वा
अग्निशुश्रूषकश् चैव स वै भक्तः सनातनः //
text_mt:
He who recites stories of him, or who honors his devotees,
and who attends upon the fire—he indeed is an eternal devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
taccittas tanmanāś caiva devapūjārataḥ sadā
tatkarmakṛd bhaved yas tu sa vai bhaktaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
तच्चित्तस् तन्मनाश् चैव देवपूजारतः सदा
तत्कर्मकृद् भवेद् यस् तु स वै भक्तः सनातनः //
text_mt:
He whose mind is fixed on him, whose thoughts are set on him, who is ever devoted to worshiping the god,
and who performs work for his sake—he indeed is an eternal devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
devārthe kriyamāṇāni yaḥ karmāṇy anumanyate
kīrtanād vā paro viprāḥ sa vai bhaktataro naraḥ //
meaning:
देवार्थे क्रियमाणानि यः कर्माण्य् अनुमन्यते
कीर्तनाद् वा परो विप्राः स वै भक्ततरो नरः //
text_mt:
The man who approves of rites performed for the god’s sake,
or who surpasses others in chanting [his praise], O brahmins—he is an even greater devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhyasūyeta tadbhaktān na nindyāc cānyadevatām
ādityavratacārī ca sa vai bhaktataro naraḥ //
meaning:
नाभ्यसूयेत तद्भक्तान् न निन्द्याच् चान्यदेवताम्
आदित्यव्रतचारी च स वै भक्ततरो नरः //
text_mt:
He who does not harbor malice toward his devotees, nor revile another deity,
and who observes the vow of the Sun—he is an even greater devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchaṃs tiṣṭhan svapañ jighrann unmiṣan nimiṣann api
yaḥ smared bhāskaraṃ nityaṃ sa vai bhaktataro naraḥ //
meaning:
गच्छंस् तिष्ठन् स्वपञ् जिघ्रन्न् उन्मिषन् निमिषन्न् अपि
यः स्मरेद् भास्करं नित्यं स वै भक्ततरो नरः //
text_mt:
Walking, standing, sleeping, smelling, opening his eyes or closing them,
whoever remembers the Sun constantly—that man is an even greater devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhā tv iyaṃ bhaktiḥ sadā kāryā vijānatā
bhaktyā samādhinā caiva stavena manasā tathā //
meaning:
एवंविधा त्व् इयं भक्तिः सदा कार्या विजानता
भक्त्या समाधिना चैव स्तवेन मनसा तथा //
text_mt:
Such devotion as this should always be performed by one who knows,
with devotion, with absorption, with praise, and with the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyate niyamo yas tu dānaṃ viprāya dīyate
pratigṛhṇanti taṃ devā manuṣyāḥ pitaras tathā //
meaning:
क्रियते नियमो यस् तु दानं विप्राय दीयते
प्रतिगृह्णन्ति तं देवा मनुष्याः पितरस् तथा //
text_mt:
Whatever observance is undertaken, whatever gift is given to a brahmin,
the gods, men, and ancestors accept it.

sanskrit_iast:
pattraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yad bhaktyā samupāhṛtam
pratigṛhṇanti tad devā nāstikān varjayanti ca //
meaning:
पत्त्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यद् भक्त्या समुपाहृतम्
प्रतिगृह्णन्ति तद् देवा नास्तिकान् वर्जयन्ति च //
text_mt:
A leaf, a flower, a fruit, water, which is offered with devotion,
the gods accept, and they turn away from atheists.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaśuddhiḥ prayoktavyā niyamācārasaṃyutā
bhāvaśuddhyā kriyate yat tat sarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
भावशुद्धिः प्रयोक्तव्या नियमाचारसंयुता
भावशुद्ध्या क्रियते यत् तत् सर्वं सफलं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Purity of intention should be applied, combined with disciplined conduct;
whatever is done with purity of intention will bear fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
stutijapyopahāreṇa pūjayāpi vivasvataḥ
upavāsena bhaktyā vai sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
स्तुतिजप्योपहारेण पूजयापि विवस्वतः
उपवासेन भक्त्या वै सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Through hymn, silent recitation, and offering, and through worship of the Sun,
through fasting with devotion, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇidhāya śiro bhūmyāṃ namaskāraṃ karoti yaḥ
tatkṣaṇāt sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणिधाय शिरो भूम्यां नमस्कारं करोति यः
तत्क्षणात् सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
He who places his head on the ground and pays homage
is instantly freed from all sins; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiyukto naro yo 'sau raveḥ kuryāt pradakṣiṇām
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
भक्तियुक्तो नरो यो ऽसौ रवेः कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणाम्
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा //
text_mt:
The man endowed with devotion who performs the circumambulation of the Sun—
by him the earth with its seven continents is circumambulated.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaṃ manasi yaḥ kṛtvā kuryād vyomapradakṣiṇām
pradakṣiṇīkṛtās tena sarve devā bhavanti hi //
meaning:
सूर्यं मनसि यः कृत्वा कुर्याद् व्योमप्रदक्षिणाम्
प्रदक्षिणीकृतास् तेन सर्वे देवा भवन्ति हि //
text_mt:
He who, having placed the Sun in his mind, performs a circumambulation toward the sky—
by him indeed all the gods have been circumambulated.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhāro naro bhūtvā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ yo 'rcayate ravim
niyamavratacārī ca bhaved bhaktisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
एकाहारो नरो भूत्वा षष्ठ्यां यो ऽर्चयते रविम्
नियमव्रतचारी च भवेद् भक्तिसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
The man who, eating once a day, worships the Sun on the sixth day,
observing rules and vows, filled with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyāṃ vā mahābhāgāḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
ahorātropavāsena pūjayed yas tu bhāskaram //
meaning:
सप्तम्यां वा महाभागाः सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
अहोरात्रोपवासेन पूजयेद् यस् तु भास्करम् //
text_mt:
or on the seventh day, O fortunate ones, obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.
Moreover, whoever worships the Sun by fasting day and night

sanskrit_iast:
saptamyām athavā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
kṛṣṇapakṣasya saptamyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
सप्तम्याम् अथवा षष्ठ्यां स याति परमां गतिम्
कृष्णपक्षस्य सप्तम्यां सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt:
on the seventh or the sixth day goes to the supreme state.
Fasting on the seventh day of the dark fortnight with senses restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaratnopahāreṇa pūjayed yas tu bhāskaram
padmaprabheṇa yānena sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
सर्वरत्नोपहारेण पूजयेद् यस् तु भास्करम्
पद्मप्रभेण यानेन सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt:
whoever worships the Sun with offerings of all kinds of gems
goes to the world of the Sun in a vehicle shining like a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣasya saptamyām upavāsaparo naraḥ
sarvaśuklopahāreṇa pūjayed yas tu bhāskaram //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षस्य सप्तम्याम् उपवासपरो नरः
सर्वशुक्लोपहारेण पूजयेद् यस् तु भास्करम् //
text_mt:
The man dedicated to fasting on the seventh day of the bright fortnight
who worships the Sun with offerings entirely white,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati
arkasaṃpuṭasaṃyuktam udakaṃ prasṛtaṃ pibet //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति
अर्कसंपुटसंयुक्तम् उदकं प्रसृतं पिबेत् //
text_mt:
freed from all sins, goes to the world of the Sun.
He should drink cupped handfuls of water enclosed within calotropis leaves:

sanskrit_iast:
kramavṛddhyā caturviṃśam ekaikaṃ kṣapayet punaḥ
dvābhyāṃ saṃvatsarābhyāṃ tu samāptaniyamo bhavet //
meaning:
क्रमवृद्ध्या चतुर्विंशम् एकैकं क्षपयेत् पुनः
द्वाभ्यां संवत्सराभ्यां तु समाप्तनियमो भवेत् //
text_mt:
increasing step by step up to twenty-four, he should then reduce them one by one;
in two years his observance will be completed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradā hy eṣā praśastā hy arkasaptamī
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ yadādityadinaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदा ह्य् एषा प्रशस्ता ह्य् अर्कसप्तमी
शुक्लपक्षस्य सप्तम्यां यदादित्यदिनं भवेत् //
text_mt:
For this Seventh Day of the Sun is praiseworthy and grants all desires.
When Sunday falls on the seventh day of the bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahat phalam
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homa upavāsas tathaiva ca //
meaning:
सप्तमी विजया नाम तत्र दत्तं महत् फलम्
स्नानं दानं तपो होम उपवासस् तथैव च //
text_mt:
it is the seventh day named Vijayā; what is given there brings great fruit.
Bathing, giving gifts, austerity, fire-offerings, and likewise fasting—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ vijayasaptamyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
ye cādityadine prāpte śrāddhaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वं विजयसप्तम्यां महापातकनाशनम्
ये चादित्यदिने प्राप्ते श्राद्धं कुर्वन्ति मानवाः //
text_mt:
all of it on Vijayā-saptamī destroys grave sins.
And those mortals who perform an ancestral rite when Sunday arrives,

sanskrit_iast:
yajanti ca mahāśvetaṃ te labhante yathepsitam
yeṣāṃ dharmyāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sadaivoddiśya bhāskaram //
meaning:
यजन्ति च महाश्वेतं ते लभन्ते यथेप्सितम्
येषां धर्म्याः क्रियाः सर्वाः सदैवोद्दिश्य भास्करम् //
text_mt:
and worship the Great White One, obtain whatever they desire.
Those all of whose righteous actions are always dedicated to the Sun—

sanskrit_iast:
na kule jāyate teṣāṃ daridro vyādhito 'pi vā
śvetayā raktayā vāpi pītamṛttikayāpi vā //
meaning:
न कुले जायते तेषां दरिद्रो व्याधितो ऽपि वा
श्वेतया रक्तया वापि पीतमृत्तिकयापि वा //
text_mt:
in their family no one is born poor or afflicted with disease.
One who smears [the ground] with white, red,

sanskrit_iast:
upalepanakartā tu cintitaṃ labhate phalam
citrabhānuṃ vicitrais tu kusumaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ //
meaning:
उपलेपनकर्ता तु चिन्तितं लभते फलम्
चित्रभानुं विचित्रैस् तु कुसुमैश् च सुगन्धिभिः //
text_mt:
or yellow clay attains the fruit he has contemplated.
He who, fasting, worships the radiant Sun with various

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet sopavāso yaḥ sa kāmān īpsitāṃl labhet
ghṛtena dīpaṃ prajvālya tilatailena vā punaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेत् सोपवासो यः स कामान् ईप्सितांल् लभेत्
घृतेन दीपं प्रज्वाल्य तिलतैलेन वा पुनः //
text_mt:
fragrant flowers attains his desired wishes.
Kindling a lamp with clarified butter or with sesame oil,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaṃ pūjayed yas tu cakṣuṣā na sa hīyate
dīpadātā naro nityaṃ jñānadīpena dīpyate //
meaning:
आदित्यं पूजयेद् यस् तु चक्षुषा न स हीयते
दीपदाता नरो नित्यं ज्ञानदीपेन दीप्यते //
text_mt:
he who worships the Sun is never deprived of eyesight.
The man who constantly gives a lamp shines with the lamp of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
tilāḥ pavitraṃ tailaṃ vā tilagodānam uttamam
agnikārye ca dīpe ca mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
तिलाः पवित्रं तैलं वा तिलगोदानम् उत्तमम्
अग्निकार्ये च दीपे च महापातकनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Sesame seeds or [sesame] oil are purifying; the gift of sesame and a cow is supreme.
In the fire-rite and in the lamp, it destroys grave sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaṃ dadāti yo nityaṃ devatāyataneṣu ca
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu rūpavān subhago bhavet //
meaning:
दीपं ददाति यो नित्यं देवतायतनेषु च
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु रूपवान् सुभगो भवेत् //
text_mt:
He who constantly gives a lamp in temples of deities,
at crossroads, and on public roads becomes handsome and fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
havirbhiḥ prathamaḥ kalpo dvitīyaś cauṣadhīrasaiḥ
vasāmedosthiniryāsair na tu deyaḥ kathaṃcana //
meaning:
हविर्भिः प्रथमः कल्पो द्वितीयश् चौषधीरसैः
वसामेदोस्थिनिर्यासैर् न तु देयः कथंचन //
text_mt:
The first method is with clarified butter, and the second is with herbal oils;
but it must never be given with fat, marrow, or bone-extracts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaved ūrdhvagatir dīpo na kadācid adhogatiḥ
dātā dīpyati cāpy evaṃ na tiryaggatim āpnuyāt //
meaning:
भवेद् ऊर्ध्वगतिर् दीपो न कदाचिद् अधोगतिः
दाता दीप्यति चाप्य् एवं न तिर्यग्गतिम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
A lamp moves upward; it never moves downward.
Likewise, the giver shines and does not attain birth among animals.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalamānaṃ sadā dīpaṃ na haren nāpi nāśayet
dīpahartā naro bandhaṃ nāśaṃ krodhaṃ tamo vrajet //
meaning:
ज्वलमानं सदा दीपं न हरेन् नापि नाशयेत्
दीपहर्ता नरो बन्धं नाशं क्रोधं तमो व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
One must not steal or extinguish a burning lamp;
the stealer of a lamp meets with bondage, destruction, wrath, and darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadātā svargaloke dīpamāleva rājate
yaḥ samālabhate nityaṃ kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ //
meaning:
दीपदाता स्वर्गलोके दीपमालेव राजते
यः समालभते नित्यं कुङ्कुमागुरुचन्दनैः //
text_mt:
The giver of a lamp shines in heaven like a row of lamps.
He who constantly anoints [the deity] with saffron, agallochum, and sandalwood

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpadyate naraḥ pretya dhanena yaśasā śriyā
raktacandanasaṃmiśrai raktapuṣpaiḥ śucir naraḥ //
meaning:
संपद्यते नरः प्रेत्य धनेन यशसा श्रिया
रक्तचन्दनसंमिश्रै रक्तपुष्पैः शुचिर् नरः //
text_mt:
becomes endowed, after death, with wealth, renown, and splendor.
A pure man who, with red flowers mixed with red sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
udaye 'rghyaṃ sadā dattvā siddhiṃ saṃvatsarāl labhet
udayāt parivarteta yāvad astamane sthitaḥ //
meaning:
उदये ऽर्घ्यं सदा दत्त्वा सिद्धिं संवत्सराल् लभेत्
उदयात् परिवर्तेत यावद् अस्तमने स्थितः //
text_mt:
always offers a water-offering at sunrise attains success in a year.
He should turn around following the sun from its rising until it stands at sunset,

sanskrit_iast:
japann abhimukhaḥ kiṃcin mantraṃ stotram athāpi vā
ādityavratam etat tu mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
जपन्न् अभिमुखः किंचिन् मन्त्रं स्तोत्रम् अथापि वा
आदित्यव्रतम् एतत् तु महापातकनाशनम् //
text_mt:
facing it and reciting some mantra or hymn;
this is the vow of the Sun, which destroys grave sins.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyeṇa sahitaṃ caiva sarve sāṅgaṃ pradāpayet
udaye śraddhayā yuktaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
अर्घ्येण सहितं चैव सर्वे साङ्गं प्रदापयेत्
उदये श्रद्धया युक्तः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
One should offer all of it complete with its limbs together with the water-offering;
filled with faith at sunrise, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇadhenuanaḍvāhavasudhāvastrasaṃyutam
arghyapradātā labhate saptajanmānugaṃ phalam //
meaning:
सुवर्णधेनुअनड्वाहवसुधावस्त्रसंयुतम्
अर्घ्यप्रदाता लभते सप्तजन्मानुगं फलम् //
text_mt:
Joined with gold, a milk cow, an ox, land, and clothing,
the giver of the water-offering attains a fruit that lasts through seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau toye 'ntarikṣe ca śucau bhūmyāṃ tathaiva ca
pratimāyāṃ tathā piṇḍyāṃ deyam arghyaṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
अग्नौ तोये ऽन्तरिक्षे च शुचौ भूम्यां तथैव च
प्रतिमायां तथा पिण्ड्यां देयम् अर्घ्यं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: In fire, in water, and in the atmosphere, and likewise on pure ground, / on an image, and likewise on an altar-base, the water offering should be given with care.

sanskrit_iast:
nāpasavyaṃ na savyaṃ ca dadyād abhimukhaḥ sadā
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ vāpi raver bhaktisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
नापसव्यं न सव्यं च दद्याद् अभिमुखः सदा
सघृतं गुग्गुलं वापि रवेर् भक्तिसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Neither to the left nor to the right, facing [him] directly at all times, / or [offering] bdellium resin with ghee to the sun, endowed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇāt sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
śrīvāsaṃ caturasraṃ ca devadāruṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
तत्क्षणात् सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
श्रीवासं चतुरस्रं च देवदारुं तथैव च //
text_mt: he is instantly freed from all sins, there is no doubt of this. / And having offered śrīvāsa, caturasra, deodar,

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrāgarudhūpāni dattvā vai svargagāminaḥ
ayane tūttare sūryam athavā dakṣiṇāyane //
meaning:
कर्पूरागरुधूपानि दत्त्वा वै स्वर्गगामिनः
अयने तूत्तरे सूर्यम् अथवा दक्षिणायने //
text_mt: camphor, and aloe incense, [men] indeed go to heaven. / On the northern transit or on the southern transit of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
viṣuveṣūparāgeṣu ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विशेषेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
विषुवेषूपरागेषु षडशीतिमुखेषु च //
text_mt: having worshipped [him] especially, one is freed from all sins. / At equinoxes, during eclipses, and at the ṣaḍaśītimukha periods,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
evaṃ velāsu sarvāsu sarvakālaṃ ca mānavaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विशेषेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
एवं वेलासु सर्वासु सर्वकालं च मानवः //
text_mt: having worshipped [him] especially, one is freed from all sins. / Thus, at all proper times and at all hours, the human being

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā pūjayate yo 'rkaṃ so 'rkaloke mahīyate
kṛsaraiḥ pāyasaiḥ pūpaiḥ phalamūlaghṛtaudanaiḥ //
meaning:
भक्त्या पूजयते यो ऽर्कं सो ऽर्कलोके महीयते
कृसरैः पायसैः पूपैः फलमूलघृतौदनैः //
text_mt: who worships the sun with devotion is exalted in the realm of the sun. / With dishes of rice and sesame, boiled milk-rice, cakes, and rice cooked with fruit, roots, and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ kṛtvā tu sūryāya sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
ghṛtena tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddho bhaven naraḥ //
meaning:
बलिं कृत्वा तु सूर्याय सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात्
घृतेन तर्पणं कृत्वा सर्वसिद्धो भवेन् नरः //
text_mt: having made an offering to the sun, he obtains all desires. / Having made a libation with ghee, a man becomes successful in all things.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīreṇa tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā manas tāpair na yujyate
dadhnā tu tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā kāryasiddhiṃ labhen naraḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरेण तर्पणं कृत्वा मनस् तापैर् न युज्यते
दध्ना तु तर्पणं कृत्वा कार्यसिद्धिं लभेन् नरः //
text_mt: Having made a libation with milk, he is not afflicted by mental distress. / And having made a libation with curds, a man attains success in his affairs.

sanskrit_iast:
snānārtham āhared yas tu jalaṃ bhānoḥ samāhitaḥ
tīrtheṣu śucitāpannaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
स्नानार्थम् आहरेद् यस् तु जलं भानोः समाहितः
तीर्थेषु शुचितापन्नः स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Whoever, with concentrated mind, fetches water for the bathing of the sun / at holy bathing places, having attained purity, goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
chattraṃ dhvajaṃ vitānaṃ vā patākāṃ cāmarāṇi ca
śraddhayā bhānave dattvā gatim iṣṭām avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
छत्त्रं ध्वजं वितानं वा पताकां चामराणि च
श्रद्धया भानवे दत्त्वा गतिम् इष्टाम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having offered an umbrella, a banner, a canopy, a flag, and fly whisks / with faith to the sun, he attains the desired state.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yad dravyaṃ naro bhaktyā ādityāya prayacchati
tat tasya śatasāhasram utpādayati bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
यद् यद् द्रव्यं नरो भक्त्या आदित्याय प्रयच्छति
तत् तस्य शतसाहस्रम् उत्पादयति भास्करः //
text_mt: Whatever article a man gives with devotion to the sun, / that the sun multiplies a hundred-thousandfold for him.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyajaṃ yac ca duṣkṛtam
sarvaṃ sūryaprasādena tad aśeṣaṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
मानसं वाचिकं वापि कायजं यच् च दुष्कृतम्
सर्वं सूर्यप्रसादेन तद् अशेषं व्यपोहति //
text_mt: Whatever evil deed has been done—mental, vocal, / or bodily—he removes all of it entirely by the sun’s grace.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhenāpi yad bhānoḥ pūjāyāḥ prāpyate phalam
yathoktadakṣiṇair viprair na tat kratuśatair api //
meaning:
एकाहेनापि यद् भानोः पूजायाः प्राप्यते फलम्
यथोक्तदक्षिणैर् विप्रैर् न तत् क्रतुशतैर् अपि //
text_mt: The fruit obtained even in a single day from the worship of the sun / cannot be obtained even through a hundred sacrifices performed by priests with the prescribed sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ śrutam evaṃ jagatpate
bhāskarasya suraśreṣṭha vadatas teṣu durlabham //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
अहो देवस्य माहात्म्यं श्रुतम् एवं जगत्पते
भास्करस्य सुरश्रेष्ठ वदतस् तेषु दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / Oh, the greatness of the god, hard to obtain among those [beings], has thus been heard, O lord of the world, / as you speak, O best of gods, concerning the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaḥ prabrūhi deveśa yat pṛcchāmo jagatpate
śrotum icchāmahe brahman paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ //
meaning:
भूयः प्रब्रूहि देवेश यत् पृच्छामो जगत्पते
श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् परं कौतूहलं हि नः //
text_mt: Tell [us] further, O lord of gods, what we ask, O lord of the world; / we wish to hear, O Brahmā, for our curiosity is indeed great.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho 'tha bhikṣukaḥ
ya icchen mokṣam āsthātuṃ devatāṃ kāṃ yajeta saḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थो ऽथ भिक्षुकः
य इच्छेन् मोक्षम् आस्थातुं देवतां कां यजेत सः //
text_mt: The householder, the student of the Veda, the forest-dweller, or the wandering ascetic— / who wishes to attain liberation, which deity should he worship?

sanskrit_iast:
kuto hy asyākṣayaḥ svargaḥ kuto niḥśreyasaṃ param
svargataś caiva kiṃ kuryād yena na cyavate punaḥ //
meaning:
कुतो ह्य् अस्याक्षयः स्वर्गः कुतो निःश्रेयसं परम्
स्वर्गतश् चैव किं कुर्याद् येन न च्यवते पुनः //
text_mt: From where does he have imperishable heaven, from where the supreme final beatitude? / And having gone to heaven, what should he do so that he does not fall back again?

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ cātra ko devaḥ pitṝṇāṃ caiva kaḥ pitā
yasmāt parataraṃ nāsti tan me brūhi sureśvara //
meaning:
देवानां चात्र को देवः पितॄणां चैव कः पिता
यस्मात् परतरं नास्ति तन् मे ब्रूहि सुरेश्वर //
text_mt: And who is the god of the gods here, and who is the father of the ancestors? / Tell me that, O lord of gods, than whom nothing is higher.

sanskrit_iast:
kutaḥ sṛṣṭam idaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
pralaye ca kam abhyeti tad bhavān vaktum arhati //
meaning:
कुतः सृष्टम् इदं विश्वं सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
प्रलये च कम् अभ्येति तद् भवान् वक्तुम् अर्हति //
text_mt: From where was this whole universe created, moving and unmoving? / And at the dissolution, to whom does it return? You ought to explain that.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
udyann evaiṣa kurute jagad vitimiraṃ karaiḥ
nātaḥ parataro devaḥ kaścid anyo dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
उद्यन्न् एवैष कुरुते जगद् वितिमिरं करैः
नातः परतरो देवः कश्चिद् अन्यो द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Rising indeed, he makes the world free of darkness with his rays; / there is no other god higher than he, O best of twice-born [sages].

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhano hy eṣa puruṣaḥ śāśvato 'vyayaḥ
tāpayaty eṣa trīṃl lokān bhavan raśmibhir ulbaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अनादिनिधनो ह्य् एष पुरुषः शाश्वतो ऽव्ययः
तापयत्य् एष त्रींल् लोकान् भवन् रश्मिभिर् उल्बणः //
text_mt: For he is the puruṣa without beginning or end, eternal and imperishable; / he burns the three worlds, becoming fierce with his rays.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayo hy eṣa tapatāṃ tapano varaḥ
sarvasya jagato nāthaḥ sarvasākṣī jagatpatiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयो ह्य् एष तपतां तपनो वरः
सर्वस्य जगतो नाथः सर्वसाक्षी जगत्पतिः //
text_mt: For he comprises all deities, the best heater among those that heat, / the master of the entire world, the witness of all, the lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣipaty eṣa bhūtāni tathā visṛjate punaḥ
eṣa bhāti tapaty eṣa varṣaty eṣa gabhastibhiḥ //
meaning:
संक्षिपत्य् एष भूतानि तथा विसृजते पुनः
एष भाति तपत्य् एष वर्षत्य् एष गभस्तिभिः //
text_mt: He withdraws the beings, and likewise emits them again; / he shines, he scorches, he rains down with his rays.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca bhūtādir bhūtabhāvanaḥ
na hy eṣa kṣayam āyāti nityam akṣayamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
एष धाता विधाता च भूतादिर् भूतभावनः
न ह्य् एष क्षयम् आयाति नित्यम् अक्षयमण्डलः //
text_mt: He is the supporter and the creator, the source of beings, the bringer of beings into existence; / he does not go to destruction, his disc is eternally imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ ca pitā hy eṣa devatānāṃ hi devatā
dhruvaṃ sthānaṃ smṛtaṃ hy etad yasmān na cyavate punaḥ //
meaning:
पितॄणां च पिता ह्य् एष देवतानां हि देवता
ध्रुवं स्थानं स्मृतं ह्य् एतद् यस्मान् न च्यवते पुनः //
text_mt: And he is the father of the ancestors, the deity of the deities; / this is remembered as the steadfast abode from which one does not fall back again.

sanskrit_iast:
sargakāle jagat kṛtsnam ādityāt saṃprasūyate
pralaye ca tam abhyeti bhāskaraṃ dīptatejasam //
meaning:
सर्गकाले जगत् कृत्स्नम् आदित्यात् संप्रसूयते
प्रलये च तम् अभ्येति भास्करं दीप्ततेजसम् //
text_mt: At the time of primary creation, the whole world is born from the sun; / and at the dissolution, it returns to him, the sun of radiant splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginaś cāpy asaṃkhyātās tyaktvā gṛhakalevaram
vāyur bhūtvā viśanty asmiṃs tejorāśau divākare //
meaning:
योगिनश् चाप्य् असंख्यातास् त्यक्त्वा गृहकलेवरम्
वायुर् भूत्वा विशन्त्य् अस्मिंस् तेजोराशौ दिवाकरे //
text_mt: And innumerable yogins, having abandoned the bodily frame, / become wind and enter this mass of splendour, the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
asya raśmisahasrāṇi śākhā iva vihaṃgamāḥ
vasanty āśritya munayaḥ saṃsiddhā daivataiḥ saha //
meaning:
अस्य रश्मिसहस्राणि शाखा इव विहंगमाः
वसन्त्य् आश्रित्य मुनयः संसिद्धा दैवतैः सह //
text_mt: Having resorted to his thousands of rays, like birds to branches, / perfected sages dwell together with the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthā janakādyāś ca rājāno yogadharmiṇaḥ
vālakhilyādayaś caiva ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्था जनकाद्याश् च राजानो योगधर्मिणः
वालखिल्यादयश् चैव ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: Householders like Janaka and others, kings who practiced yoga, / and the Vālakhilyas and other sages who discourse on the absolute,

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprasthāś ca ye cānye vyāsādyā bhikṣavas tathā
yogam āsthāya sarve te praviṣṭāḥ sūryamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थाश् च ये चान्ये व्यासाद्या भिक्षवस् तथा
योगम् आस्थाय सर्वे ते प्रविष्टाः सूर्यमण्डलम् //
text_mt: and forest-dwellers and whoever else, wandering ascetics like Vyāsa and others, / having applied themselves to yoga, have all entered the solar disc.

sanskrit_iast:
śuko vyāsasutaḥ śrīmān yogadharmam avāpya saḥ
ādityakiraṇān gatvā hy apunarbhāvam āsthitaḥ //
meaning:
शुको व्याससुतः श्रीमान् योगधर्मम् अवाप्य सः
आदित्यकिरणान् गत्वा ह्य् अपुनर्भावम् आस्थितः //
text_mt: The glorious Śuka, son of Vyāsa, having attained the yoga of dharma, / went to the rays of the sun and attained non-return.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdamātraśrutimukhā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ
pratyakṣo 'yaṃ paro devaḥ sūryas timiranāśanaḥ //
meaning:
शब्दमात्रश्रुतिमुखा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः
प्रत्यक्षो ऽयं परो देवः सूर्यस् तिमिरनाशनः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others have the oral tradition of mere sound as their source; / this supreme god, the sun, the destroyer of darkness, is perceived directly.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād anyatra bhaktir hi na kāryā śubham icchatā
yasmād dṛṣṭer agamyās te devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद् अन्यत्र भक्तिर् हि न कार्या शुभम् इच्छता
यस्माद् दृष्टेर् अगम्यास् ते देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: Therefore, devotion should not be paid elsewhere by one who desires what is auspicious, / since those gods headed by Viṣṇu cannot be perceived by the sight.

sanskrit_iast:
ato bhavadbhiḥ satatam abhyarcyo bhagavān raviḥ
sa hi mātā pitā caiva kṛtsnasya jagato guruḥ //
meaning:
अतो भवद्भिः सततम् अभ्यर्च्यो भगवान् रविः
स हि माता पिता चैव कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गुरुः //
text_mt: Therefore, the blessed sun should be constantly worshipped by you; / for he is the mother, the father, and the teacher of the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
anādyo lokanātho 'sau raśmimālī jagatpatiḥ
mitratve ca sthito yasmāt tapas tepe dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
अनाद्यो लोकनाथो ऽसौ रश्मिमाली जगत्पतिः
मित्रत्वे च स्थितो यस्मात् तपस् तेपे द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: He is without beginning, the lord of the world, adorned with a wreath of rays, the master of the world; / and since he stood in friendliness, he performed austerities, O best of twice-born [sages].

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhano brahmā nityaś cākṣaya eva ca
sṛṣṭvā sasāgarān dvīpān bhuvanāni caturdaśa //
meaning:
अनादिनिधनो ब्रह्मा नित्यश् चाक्षय एव च
सृष्ट्वा ससागरान् द्वीपान् भुवनानि चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Brahmā, without beginning or end, eternal and imperishable, / having created the continents with the oceans and the fourteen worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
lokānāṃ sa hitārthāya sthitaś candrasarittaṭe
sṛṣṭvā prajāpatīn sarvān sṛṣṭvā ca vividhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
लोकानां स हितार्थाय स्थितश् चन्द्रसरित्तटे
सृष्ट्वा प्रजापतीन् सर्वान् सृष्ट्वा च विविधाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: stood on the bank of the Candrasarit for the welfare of the worlds, / having created all the lords of creatures and having created various creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śatasahasrāṃśur avyaktaś ca punaḥ svayam
kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānam ādityam upapadyate //
meaning:
ततः शतसहस्रांशुर् अव्यक्तश् च पुनः स्वयम्
कृत्वा द्वादशधात्मानम् आदित्यम् उपपद्यते //
text_mt: Then, having hundreds of thousands of rays and being unmanifest, he himself / made himself twelvefold and became the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
indro dhātātha parjanyas tvaṣṭā pūṣāryamā bhagaḥ
vivasvān viṣṇur aṃśaś ca varuṇo mitra eva ca //
meaning:
इन्द्रो धाताथ पर्जन्यस् त्वष्टा पूषार्यमा भगः
विवस्वान् विष्णुर् अंशश् च वरुणो मित्र एव च //
text_mt: Indra, Dhātṛ, and Parjanya, Tvaṣṭṛ, Pūṣan, Aryaman, Bhaga, / Vivasvat, Viṣṇu, and Aṃśa, Varuṇa, and Mitra—

sanskrit_iast:
ābhir dvādaśabhis tena sūryeṇa paramātmanā
kṛtsnaṃ jagad idaṃ vyāptaṃ mūrtibhiś ca dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
आभिर् द्वादशभिस् तेन सूर्येण परमात्मना
कृत्स्नं जगद् इदं व्याप्तं मूर्तिभिश् च द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: by these twelve forms of his, by the sun, the supreme self, / this entire world is pervaded, O best of twice-born [sages].

sanskrit_iast:
tasya yā prathamā mūrtir ādityasyendrasaṃjñitā
sthitā sā devarājatve devānāṃ ripunāśinī //
meaning:
तस्य या प्रथमा मूर्तिर् आदित्यस्येन्द्रसंज्ञिता
स्थिता सा देवराजत्वे देवानां रिपुनाशिनी //
text_mt: That first form of his, the sun named Indra, / stationed in the kingship of the gods, destroys the enemies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyā tasya yā mūrtir nāmnā dhāteti kīrtitā
sthitā prajāpatitvena vividhāḥ sṛjate prajāḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीया तस्य या मूर्तिर् नाम्ना धातेति कीर्तिता
स्थिता प्रजापतित्वेन विविधाः सृजते प्रजाः //
text_mt: His second form, praised by the name Dhātṛ, / stationed as lord of creatures, creates various creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyārkasya yā mūrtiḥ parjanya iti viśrutā
megheṣv eva sthitā sā tu varṣate ca gabhastibhiḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयार्कस्य या मूर्तिः पर्जन्य इति विश्रुता
मेघेष्व् एव स्थिता सा तु वर्षते च गभस्तिभिः //
text_mt: The third form of the sun, renowned as Parjanya, / is stationed in the clouds and rains down through his rays.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthī tasya yā mūrtir nāmnā tvaṣṭeti viśrutā
sthitā vanaspatau sā tu oṣadhīṣu ca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थी तस्य या मूर्तिर् नाम्ना त्वष्टेति विश्रुता
स्थिता वनस्पतौ सा तु ओषधीषु च सर्वतः //
text_mt: His fourth form, renowned by the name Tvaṣṭṛ, / is stationed in trees and in medicinal herbs everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamī tasya yā mūrtir nāmnā pūṣeti viśrutā
anne vyavasthitā sā tu prajāṃ puṣṇāti nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमी तस्य या मूर्तिर् नाम्ना पूषेति विश्रुता
अन्ने व्यवस्थिता सा तु प्रजां पुष्णाति नित्यशः //
text_mt: His fifth form, renowned by the name Pūṣan, / is stationed in food and nourishes living beings constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiḥ ṣaṣṭhī raver yā tu aryamā iti viśrutā
vāyoḥ saṃsaraṇā sā tu deveṣv eva samāśritā //
meaning:
मूर्तिः षष्ठी रवेर् या तु अर्यमा इति विश्रुता
वायोः संसरणा सा तु देवेष्व् एव समाश्रिता //
text_mt: The sixth form of the sun, which is renowned as Aryaman, / causes the circulation of the wind and resides within the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānor yā saptamī mūrtir nāmnā bhageti viśrutā
bhūyiṣv avasthitā sā tu śarīreṣu ca dehinām //
meaning:
भानोर् या सप्तमी मूर्तिर् नाम्ना भगेति विश्रुता
भूयिष्व् अवस्थिता सा तु शरीरेषु च देहिनाम् //
text_mt: The seventh form of the sun is known by the name Bhaga; / it resides mostly in the bodies of embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtir yā tv aṣṭamī tasya vivasvān iti viśrutā
agnau pratiṣṭhitā sā tu pacaty annaṃ śarīriṇām //
meaning:
मूर्तिर् या त्व् अष्टमी तस्य विवस्वान् इति विश्रुता
अग्नौ प्रतिष्ठिता सा तु पचत्य् अन्नं शरीरिणाम् //
text_mt: His eighth form is known as Vivasvān; / established in fire, it cooks the food of embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
navamī citrabhānor yā mūrtir viṣṇuś ca nāmataḥ
prādurbhavati sā nityaṃ devānām arisūdanī //
meaning:
नवमी चित्रभानोर् या मूर्तिर् विष्णुश् च नामतः
प्रादुर्भवति सा नित्यं देवानाम् अरिसूदनी //
text_mt: The ninth form of the bright-rayed sun is named Viṣṇu; / it manifests constantly, destroying the enemies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamī tasya yā mūrtir aṃśumān iti viśrutā
vāyau pratiṣṭhitā sā tu prahlādayati vai prajāḥ //
meaning:
दशमी तस्य या मूर्तिर् अंशुमान् इति विश्रुता
वायौ प्रतिष्ठिता सा तु प्रह्लादयति वै प्रजाः //
text_mt: His tenth form is known as Aṃśumān; / established in wind, it delights the creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtis tv ekādaśī bhānor nāmnā varuṇasaṃjñitā
jaleṣv avasthitā sā tu prajāṃ puṣṇāti nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
मूर्तिस् त्व् एकादशी भानोर् नाम्ना वरुणसंज्ञिता
जलेष्व् अवस्थिता सा तु प्रजां पुष्णाति नित्यशः //
text_mt: The eleventh form of the sun is designated by the name Varuṇa; / residing in the waters, it nourishes creatures constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtir yā dvādaśī bhānor nāmnā mitreti saṃjñitā
lokānāṃ sā hitārthāya sthitā candrasarittaṭe //
meaning:
मूर्तिर् या द्वादशी भानोर् नाम्ना मित्रेति संज्ञिता
लोकानां सा हितार्थाय स्थिता चन्द्रसरित्तटे //
text_mt: The twelfth form of the sun is designated by the name Mitra; / for the benefit of the worlds, it stands on the bank of the river of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyubhakṣas tapas tepe sthitvā maitreṇa cakṣuṣā
anugṛhṇan sadā bhaktān varair nānāvidhais tu saḥ //
meaning:
वायुभक्षस् तपस् तेपे स्थित्वा मैत्रेण चक्षुषा
अनुगृह्णन् सदा भक्तान् वरैर् नानाविधैस् तु सः //
text_mt: Feeding on wind, he performed austerities, abiding with a friendly gaze, / always gracing his devotees with various boons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sā jagatāṃ mūrtir hitā vihitā purā
tatra mitraḥ sthito yasmāt tasmān mitraṃ paraṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
एवं सा जगतां मूर्तिर् हिता विहिता पुरा
तत्र मित्रः स्थितो यस्मात् तस्मान् मित्रं परं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Thus that beneficial form of the worlds was established long ago; / because Mitra stood there, therefore Mitra is remembered as supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
ābhir dvādaśabhis tena savitrā paramātmanā
kṛtsnaṃ jagad idaṃ vyāptaṃ mūrtibhiś ca dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
आभिर् द्वादशभिस् तेन सवित्रा परमात्मना
कृत्स्नं जगद् इदं व्याप्तं मूर्तिभिश् च द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: By these twelve forms, O best of the twice-born, / this entire world is pervaded by that sun, the supreme self.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād dhyeyo namasyaś ca dvādaśasthāsu mūrtiṣu
bhaktimadbhir narair nityaṃ tadgatenāntarātmanā //
meaning:
तस्माद् ध्येयो नमस्यश् च द्वादशस्थासु मूर्तिषु
भक्तिमद्भिर् नरैर् नित्यं तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना //
text_mt: Therefore, he is to be meditated upon and bowed to in his twelve forms / constantly by devout people, with their inner self directed toward him.

sanskrit_iast:
ity evaṃ dvādaśādityān namaskṛtvā tu mānavaḥ
nityaṃ śrutvā paṭhitvā ca sūryaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
इत्य् एवं द्वादशादित्यान् नमस्कृत्वा तु मानवः
नित्यं श्रुत्वा पठित्वा च सूर्यलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Having thus bowed to the twelve Ādityas, / a person, by constantly listening and reciting, is glorified in the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
yadi tāvad ayaṃ sūryaś cādidevaḥ sanātanaḥ
tataḥ kasmāt tapas tepe varepsuḥ prākṛto yathā //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
यदि तावद् अयं सूर्यश् चादिदेवः सनातनः
ततः कस्मात् तपस् तेपे वरेप्सुः प्राकृतो यथा //
text_mt: The sages said: / If this sun is indeed the primal eternal god, / then why did he perform austerities, desiring a boon like an ordinary man?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etad vaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ vibhāvasoḥ
pṛṣṭaṃ mitreṇa yat pūrvaṃ nāradāya mahātmane //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतद् वः संप्रवक्ष्यामि परं गुह्यं विभावसोः
पृष्टं मित्रेण यत् पूर्वं नारदाय महात्मने //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / I shall explain to you this supreme secret of the sun, / which was formerly asked by Mitra to the great-souled Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅ mayoktās tu yuṣmabhyaṃ raver dvādaśa mūrtayaḥ
mitraś ca varuṇaś cobhau tāsāṃ tapasi saṃsthitau //
meaning:
प्राङ् मयोक्तास् तु युष्मभ्यं रवेर् द्वादश मूर्तयः
मित्रश् च वरुणश् चोभौ तासां तपसि संस्थितौ //
text_mt: Earlier, the twelve forms of the sun were declared by me to you; / among them, both Mitra and Varuṇa were engaged in austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
abbhakṣo varuṇas tāsāṃ tasthau paścimasāgare
mitro mitravane cāsmin vāyubhakṣo 'bhavat tadā //
meaning:
अब्भक्षो वरुणस् तासां तस्थौ पश्चिमसागरे
मित्रो मित्रवने चास्मिन् वायुभक्षो ऽभवत् तदा //
text_mt: Varuṇa among them, living on water, stood in the western ocean; / and Mitra then lived on wind in this Mitra Forest.

sanskrit_iast:
atha merugireḥ śṛṅgāt pracyuto gandhamādanāt
nāradas tu mahāyogī sarvāṃl lokāṃś caran vaśī //
meaning:
अथ मेरुगिरेः शृङ्गात् प्रच्युतो गन्धमादनात्
नारदस् तु महायोगी सर्वांल् लोकांश् चरन् वशी //
text_mt: Then descending from Gandhamādana, a peak of Mount Meru, / the great yogin Nārada, self-controlled, wandering through all worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāmātha tatraiva yatra mitro 'carat tapaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tapasyantaṃ tasya kautūhalaṃ hy abhūt //
meaning:
आजगामाथ तत्रैव यत्र मित्रो ऽचरत् तपः
तं दृष्ट्वा तु तपस्यन्तं तस्य कौतूहलं ह्य् अभूत् //
text_mt: came right there where Mitra was performing austerity; / seeing him performing austerity, curiosity arose in him:

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'kṣayaś cāvyayaś caiva vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ
dhṛtam ekātmakaṃ yena trailokyaṃ sumahātmanā //
meaning:
यो ऽक्षयश् चाव्ययश् चैव व्यक्ताव्यक्तः सनातनः
धृतम् एकात्मकं येन त्रैलोक्यं सुमहात्मना //
text_mt: “He who is imperishable and undecaying, manifest and unmanifest, eternal, / by which very great-souled one the three worlds are sustained as one self,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pitā sarvadevānāṃ parāṇām api yaḥ paraḥ
ayajad devatāḥ kās tu pitṝn vā kān asau yajet
iti saṃcintya manasā taṃ devaṃ nārado 'bravīt //
meaning:
यः पिता सर्वदेवानां पराणाम् अपि यः परः
अयजद् देवताः कास् तु पितॄन् वा कान् असौ यजेत्
इति संचिन्त्य मनसा तं देवं नारदो ऽब्रवीत् //
text_mt: he who is the father of all the gods, and higher than the highest— / what deities does he worship, or what ancestors could he worship?” / Reflecting thus in his mind, Nārada spoke to that god.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vedeṣu sapurāṇeṣu sāṅgopāṅgeṣu gīyase
tvam ajaḥ śāśvato dhātā tvaṃ nidhānam anuttamam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
वेदेषु सपुराणेषु साङ्गोपाङ्गेषु गीयसे
त्वम् अजः शाश्वतो धाता त्वं निधानम् अनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / In the Vedas along with the Purāṇas, the limbs and sub-limbs, you are sung; / you are unborn, eternal, the ordainer, you are the unsurpassed treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavac caiva tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
catvāraś cāśramā deva gṛhasthādyās tathaiva hi //
meaning:
भूतं भव्यं भवच् चैव त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
चत्वारश् चाश्रमा देव गृहस्थाद्यास् तथैव हि //
text_mt: The past, the future, and the present—all is established in you; / and the four stages of life, O god, beginning with the householder, likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
yajanti tvām aharahas tvāṃ mūrtitvaṃ samāśritam
pitā mātā ca sarvasya daivataṃ tvaṃ hi śāśvatam //
meaning:
यजन्ति त्वाम् अहरहस् त्वां मूर्तित्वं समाश्रितम्
पिता माता च सर्वस्य दैवतं त्वं हि शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: They sacrifice to you day after day, to you who have taken embodied form; / you are the father and mother of all, you are indeed the eternal deity.

sanskrit_iast: yajase pitaraṃ kaṃ tvaṃ devaṃ vāpi na vidmahe //
meaning: यजसे पितरं कं त्वं देवं वापि न विद्महे //
text_mt: What father or what god do you worship? We do not know.

sanskrit_iast:
mitra uvāca
avācyam etad vaktavyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sanātanam
tvayi bhaktimati brahman pravakṣyāmi yathātatham //
meaning:
मित्र उवाच
अवाच्यम् एतद् वक्तव्यं परं गुह्यं सनातनम्
त्वयि भक्तिमति ब्रह्मन् प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथम् //
text_mt: Mitra said: / This should not be spoken, yet it must be spoken, the supreme, eternal secret; / to you who are devoted, O Brahmin, I will declare it as it truly is.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tat sūkṣmam avijñeyam avyaktam acalaṃ dhruvam
indriyair indriyārthaiś ca sarvabhūtair vivarjitam //
meaning:
यत् तत् सूक्ष्मम् अविज्ञेयम् अव्यक्तम् अचलं ध्रुवम्
इन्द्रियैर् इन्द्रियार्थैश् च सर्वभूतैर् विवर्जितम् //
text_mt: That which is subtle, unknowable, unmanifest, immovable, constant, / devoid of sense-organs and sense-objects, and devoid of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sa hy antarātmā bhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñaś caiva kathyate
triguṇād vyatirikto 'sau puruṣaś caiva kalpitaḥ //
meaning:
स ह्य् अन्तरात्मा भूतानां क्षेत्रज्ञश् चैव कथ्यते
त्रिगुणाद् व्यतिरिक्तो ऽसौ पुरुषश् चैव कल्पितः //
text_mt: he is said to be the inner self of beings and the knower of the field; / beyond the three qualities, he is conceived of as the puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān saiva buddhir iti smṛtaḥ
mahān iti ca yogeṣu pradhānam iti kathyate //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् सैव बुद्धिर् इति स्मृतः
महान् इति च योगेषु प्रधानम् इति कथ्यते //
text_mt: The blessed Hiraṇyagarbha, he is remembered as the intellect; / and in yogas he is spoken of as the great-intellect and as pradhāna.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhye ca kathyate yoge nāmabhir bahudhātmakaḥ
sa ca trirūpo viśvātmā śarvo 'kṣara iti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सांख्ये च कथ्यते योगे नामभिर् बहुधात्मकः
स च त्रिरूपो विश्वात्मा शर्वो ऽक्षर इति स्मृतः //
text_mt: In Sāṃkhya and in Yoga he is described by manifold names; / possessing three forms, he is the self of all, remembered as Śarva, the imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtam ekātmakaṃ tena trailokyam idam ātmanā
aśarīraḥ śarīreṣu sarveṣu nivasaty asau //
meaning:
धृतम् एकात्मकं तेन त्रैलोक्यम् इदम् आत्मना
अशरीरः शरीरेषु सर्वेषु निवसत्य् असौ //
text_mt: By him as the self, these three worlds are sustained as having a single self; / bodiless, he dwells in all bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
vasann api śarīreṣu na sa lipyeta karmabhiḥ
mamāntarātmā tava ca ye cānye dehasaṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
वसन्न् अपि शरीरेषु न स लिप्येत कर्मभिः
ममान्तरात्मा तव च ये चान्ये देहसंस्थिताः //
text_mt: Though dwelling in bodies, he is not stained by actions; / he is my inner self and yours, and of whatever others dwell in a body.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ sākṣibhūto 'sau na grāhyaḥ kenacit kvacit
saguṇo nirguṇo viśvo jñānagamyo hy asau smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां साक्षिभूतो ऽसौ न ग्राह्यः केनचित् क्वचित्
सगुणो निर्गुणो विश्वो ज्ञानगम्यो ह्य् असौ स्मृतः //
text_mt: He is the witness of all, grasped by no one anywhere; / with qualities, without qualities, all-pervading, he is remembered as accessible only through knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ
sarvataḥśrutimāṃl loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
सर्वतःपाणिपादान्तः सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखः
सर्वतःश्रुतिमांल् लोके सर्वम् आवृत्य तिष्ठति //
text_mt: Having hands and feet on all sides, eyes, heads, and faces on all sides, / possessing ears on all sides in the world, he stands encompassing all.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvamūrdhā viśvabhujo viśvapādākṣināsikaḥ
ekaś carati vai kṣetre svairacārī yathāsukham //
meaning:
विश्वमूर्धा विश्वभुजो विश्वपादाक्षिनासिकः
एकश् चरति वै क्षेत्रे स्वैरचारी यथासुखम् //
text_mt: Having universal heads, universal arms, universal feet, eyes, and noses, / alone he moves in the field, wandering at will as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrāṇīha śarīrāṇi teṣāṃ caiva yathāsukham
tāni vetti sa yogātmā tataḥ kṣetrajña ucyate //
meaning:
क्षेत्राणीह शरीराणि तेषां चैव यथासुखम्
तानि वेत्ति स योगात्मा ततः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते //
text_mt: Bodies here are the fields, and he knows them / as he pleases, that yogic self; therefore he is called the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
avyakte ca pure śete puruṣas tena cocyate
viśvaṃ bahuvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ sa ca sarvatra ucyate //
meaning:
अव्यक्ते च पुरे शेते पुरुषस् तेन चोच्यते
विश्वं बहुविधं ज्ञेयं स च सर्वत्र उच्यते //
text_mt: And he lies in the unmanifest city, therefore he is called puruṣa; / the all is to be known as manifold, and he is spoken of as everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sa bahurūpatvād viśvarūpa iti smṛtaḥ
tasyaikasya mahattvaṃ hi sa caikaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् स बहुरूपत्वाद् विश्वरूप इति स्मृतः
तस्यैकस्य महत्त्वं हि स चैकः पुरुषः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Therefore, because of having manifold forms, he is remembered as having all forms; / the greatness of him, the one, is this, and he is remembered as the one puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpuruṣaśabdaṃ hi bibharty ekaḥ sanātanaḥ
sa tu vidhikriyāyattaḥ sṛjaty ātmānam ātmanā //
meaning:
महापुरुषशब्दं हि बिभर्त्य् एकः सनातनः
स तु विधिक्रियायत्तः सृजत्य् आत्मानम् आत्मना //
text_mt: Indeed, he alone, eternal, bears the designation ‘supreme person’; / subject to cosmic operation, he creates himself by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā
koṭiśaś ca karoty eṣa pratyagātmānam ātmanā //
meaning:
शतधा सहस्रधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा
कोटिशश् च करोत्य् एष प्रत्यगात्मानम् आत्मना //
text_mt: A hundredfold, a thousandfold, and likewise a hundred thousandfold, / and by the tens of millions, this inner self makes himself by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśāt patitaṃ toyaṃ yāti svādvantaraṃ yathā
bhūme rasaviśeṣeṇa tathā guṇarasāt tu saḥ //
meaning:
आकाशात् पतितं तोयं याति स्वाद्वन्तरं यथा
भूमे रसविशेषेण तथा गुणरसात् तु सः //
text_mt: Just as water fallen from the sky acquires a different taste / through the distinct flavor of the soil, so does he through the flavor of the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva yathā vāyur deheṣv eva hi pañcadhā
ekatvaṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ ca tathā tasya na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एक एव यथा वायुर् देहेष्व् एव हि पञ्चधा
एकत्वं च पृथक्त्वं च तथा तस्य न संशयः //
text_mt: Just as wind, though one alone, is fivefold in bodies, / so are unity and multiplicity in him, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānāntaraviśeṣāc ca yathāgnir labhate parām
saṃjñāṃ tathā mune so 'yaṃ brahmādiṣu tathāpnuyāt //
meaning:
स्थानान्तरविशेषाच् च यथाग्निर् लभते पराम्
संज्ञां तथा मुने सो ऽयं ब्रह्मादिषु तथाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: And just as fire obtains a distinct higher name / from difference of location, so, O sage, does he in Brahmā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dīpasahasrāṇi dīpa ekaḥ prasūyate
tathā rūpasahasrāṇi sa ekaḥ saṃprasūyate //
meaning:
यथा दीपसहस्राणि दीप एकः प्रसूयते
तथा रूपसहस्राणि स एकः संप्रसूयते //
text_mt: Just as a single lamp gives birth to thousands of lamps, / so he, the one, brings forth thousands of forms.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā sa budhyaty ātmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ
ekatvapralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartate //
meaning:
यदा स बुध्यत्य् आत्मानं तदा भवति केवलः
एकत्वप्रलये चास्य बहुत्वं च प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: When he understands the self, then he becomes solitary; / and upon the dissolution of unity, his multiplicity proceeds.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
akṣayaś cāprameyaś ca sarvagaś ca sa ucyate //
meaning:
नित्यं हि नास्ति जगति भूतं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
अक्षयश् चाप्रमेयश् च सर्वगश् च स उच्यते //
text_mt: For nothing in the world, unmoving or moving, is eternal; / he is spoken of as imperishable, immeasurable, and omnipresent.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād avyaktam utpannaṃ triguṇaṃ dvijasattamāḥ
avyaktāvyaktabhāvasthā yā sā prakṛtir ucyate //
meaning:
तस्माद् अव्यक्तम् उत्पन्नं त्रिगुणं द्विजसत्तमाः
अव्यक्ताव्यक्तभावस्था या सा प्रकृतिर् उच्यते //
text_mt: From him the unmanifest arose, having three qualities, O best of the twice-born; / that which exists in unmanifest and manifest condition is called prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ yoniṃ brahmaṇo viddhi yo 'sau sadasadātmakaḥ
loke ca pūjyate yo 'sau daive pitrye ca karmaṇi //
meaning:
तां योनिं ब्रह्मणो विद्धि यो ऽसौ सदसदात्मकः
लोके च पूज्यते यो ऽसौ दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि //
text_mt: Know that to be the womb of Brahman, which consists of being and non-being; / and he who is worshipped in the world in rites for gods and ancestors—

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti tasmāt paro hy anyaḥ pitā devo 'pi vā dvijāḥ
ātmanā sa tu vijñeyas tatas taṃ pūjayāmy aham //
meaning:
नास्ति तस्मात् परो ह्य् अन्यः पिता देवो ऽपि वा द्विजाः
आत्मना स तु विज्ञेयस् ततस् तं पूजयाम्य् अहम् //
text_mt: there is no other father or god higher than him, O twice-born; / he is to be known through oneself, therefore I worship him.

sanskrit_iast:
svargeṣv api hi ye kecit taṃ namasyanti dehinaḥ
tena gacchanti devarṣe tenoddiṣṭaphalāṃ gatim //
meaning:
स्वर्गेष्व् अपि हि ये केचित् तं नमस्यन्ति देहिनः
तेन गच्छन्ति देवर्षे तेनोद्दिष्टफलां गतिम् //
text_mt: For whatever embodied beings bow down to him even in heaven, / through him, O divine sage, they attain the goal whose fruit has been ordained by him.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ devāḥ svāśramasthāś ca nānāmūrtisamāśritāḥ
bhaktyā saṃpūjayanty ādyaṃ gatiś caiṣāṃ dadāti saḥ //
meaning:
तं देवाः स्वाश्रमस्थाश् च नानामूर्तिसमाश्रिताः
भक्त्या संपूजयन्त्य् आद्यं गतिश् चैषां ददाति सः //
text_mt: The gods, dwelling in their own abodes and resting upon various forms, / worship that primeval one with devotion, and he grants them their state.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi sarvagataś caiva nirguṇaś caiva kathyate
evaṃ matvā yathājñānaṃ pūjayāmi divākaram //
meaning:
स हि सर्वगतश् चैव निर्गुणश् चैव कथ्यते
एवं मत्वा यथाज्ञानं पूजयामि दिवाकरम् //
text_mt: For he is spoken of as omnipresent and without qualities; / knowing thus, according to my understanding, I worship the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ca tadbhāvitā loka ekatattvaṃ samāśritāḥ
etad apy adhikaṃ teṣāṃ yad ekaṃ praviśanty uta //
meaning:
ये च तद्भाविता लोक एकतत्त्वं समाश्रिताः
एतद् अप्य् अधिकं तेषां यद् एकं प्रविशन्त्य् उत //
text_mt: And those people who are devoted to him, relying upon the single principle, / even more is attained by them, in that they enter into the One.

sanskrit_iast:
