pleasing to the touch, blew, displaying devotion to Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
samudrās tatra catvāraḥ śakrādyāś ca surottamāḥ
devanadyo mahānadyaḥ siddhā munaya eva ca //
meaning:
समुद्रास् तत्र चत्वारः शक्राद्याश् च सुरोत्तमाः
देवनद्यो महानद्यः सिद्धा मुनय एव च //
text_mt:
The four oceans were there, and the best of gods headed by Śakra,
the celestial rivers and great rivers, the siddhas and the munis,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarve nāgā yakṣāḥ sarākṣasāḥ
audakāḥ khecarāś cānye kiṃnarā devacāraṇāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्वे नागा यक्षाः सराक्षसाः
औदकाः खेचराश् चान्ये किंनरा देवचारणाः //
text_mt:
all the gandharvas and apsarases, the nāgas, the yakṣas, together with rākṣasas,
aquatic beings, and others that move in the sky, kiṃnaras, and divine cāraṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tumburur nārado hāhā hūhūś caiva tu sāmagāḥ
ramyāṇy ādāya vādyāni tatrājagmus tadā puram //
meaning:
तुम्बुरुर् नारदो हाहा हूहूश् चैव तु सामगाः
रम्याण्य् आदाय वाद्यानि तत्राजग्मुस् तदा पुरम् //
text_mt:
Tumburu, Nārada, Hāhā, and Hūhū, singers of the Sāman hymns,
taking charming musical instruments, then came to the city.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayas tu kathās tatra vedagītās tapodhanāḥ
puṇyān vaivāhikān mantrāñ jepuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषयस् तु कथास् तत्र वेदगीतास् तपोधनाः
पुण्यान् वैवाहिकान् मन्त्राञ् जेपुः संहृष्टमानसाः //
text_mt:
And the sages rich in asceticism, with glad hearts, related stories
sung in the Vedas and chanted the sacred wedding mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
jagato mātaraḥ sarvā devakanyāś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
gāyanti harṣitāḥ sarvā udvāhe parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
जगतो मातरः सर्वा देवकन्याश् च कृत्स्नशः
गायन्ति हर्षिताः सर्वा उद्वाहे परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt:
All the mothers of the universe and all the divine maidens,
exceedingly delighted, sang at the wedding of Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ samaṃ tatra nānāgandhasukhāvahāḥ
udvāhaḥ śaṃkarasyeti mūrtimanta upasthitāḥ //
meaning:
ऋतवः षट् समं तत्र नानागन्धसुखावहाः
उद्वाहः शंकरस्येति मूर्तिमन्त उपस्थिताः //
text_mt:
The six seasons all together, bringing delight with diverse scents,
presented themselves in embodied forms, saying, ‘It is the wedding of Śaṅkara.’

sanskrit_iast:
nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśair mantradhvanipraharṣibhiḥ
kekāyamānaiḥ śikhibhir nṛtyamānaiś ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
नीलजीमूतसंकाशैर् मन्त्रध्वनिप्रहर्षिभिः
केकायमानैः शिखिभिर् नृत्यमानैश् च सर्वशः //
text_mt:
With peacocks resembling dark clouds, rejoicing at the sound of the mantras,
uttering cries and dancing on all sides;

sanskrit_iast:
vilolapiṅgalaspaṣṭavidyullekhāvihāsitā
kumudāpīḍaśuklābhir balākābhiś ca śobhitā //
meaning:
विलोलपिङ्गलस्पष्टविद्युल्लेखाविहासिता
कुमुदापीडशुक्लाभिर् बलाकाभिश् च शोभिता //
text_mt:
made to smile by quivering, tawny, bright streaks of lightning,
and adorned with cranes white as garlands of white water lilies;

sanskrit_iast:
pratyagrasaṃjātaśilīndhrakandalī
latādrumādyudgatapallavā śubhā
śubhāmbudhārāpraṇayaprabodhitair
mahālasair bhekagaṇaiś ca nāditā
meaning:
प्रत्यग्रसंजातशिलीन्ध्रकन्दली
लताद्रुमाद्युद्गतपल्लवा शुभा
शुभाम्बुधाराप्रणयप्रबोधितैर्
महालसैर् भेकगणैश् च नादिता

sanskrit_iast:
priyeṣu mānoddhatamānasānāṃ
manasvinīnām api kāminīnām
mayūrakekābhirutaiḥ kṣaṇena
manoharair mānavibhaṅgahetubhiḥ
meaning:
प्रियेषु मानोद्धतमानसानां
मनस्विनीनाम् अपि कामिनीनाम्
मयूरकेकाभिरुतैः क्षणेन
मनोहरैर् मानविभङ्गहेतुभिः

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vivarṇojjvalacārumūrtinā
śaśāṅkalekhākuṭilena sarvataḥ
payodasaṃghātasamīpavartinā
mahendracāpena bhṛśaṃ virājitā
meaning:
तथा विवर्णोज्ज्वलचारुमूर्तिना
शशाङ्कलेखाकुटिलेन सर्वतः
पयोदसंघातसमीपवर्तिना
महेन्द्रचापेन भृशं विराजिता
text_mt:
and intensely illumined all around by the rainbow of great Indra,
which possessed an extraordinarily bright and lovely form, was curved like the crescent moon,
and rested near masses of rainclouds.

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrapuṣpāmbubhavaiḥ sugandhibhir
ghanāmbusaṃparkatayā suśītalaiḥ
vikampayantī pavanair manoharaiḥ
surāṅganānām alakāvalīḥ śubhāḥ
meaning:
विचित्रपुष्पाम्बुभवैः सुगन्धिभिर्
घनाम्बुसंपर्कतया सुशीतलैः
विकम्पयन्ती पवनैर् मनोहरैः
सुराङ्गनानाम् अलकावलीः शुभाः
text_mt: With fragrant [breezes] arising from waters with varied flowers, / extremely cool through contact with cloud-water, / with delightful breezes fluttering / the lovely curls of the wives of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
garjatpayodasthagitendubimbā
navāmbusiktodakacārudūrvā
nirīkṣitā sādaram utsukābhir
niśvāsadhūmraṃ pathikāṅganābhiḥ
meaning:
गर्जत्पयोदस्थगितेन्दुबिम्बा
नवाम्बुसिक्तोदकचारुदूर्वा
निरीक्षिता सादरम् उत्सुकाभिर्
निश्वासधूम्रं पथिकाङ्गनाभिः
text_mt: having the disk of the moon covered by thundering clouds, / with charming dūrvā grass sprinkled with fresh water, / she was looked upon respectfully by anxious / wives of travelers, smokily clouded by their sighs;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsanūpuraśabdāḍhyā samunnatapayodharā
caladvidyullatāhārā spaṣṭapadmavilocanā //
meaning:
हंसनूपुरशब्दाढ्या समुन्नतपयोधरा
चलद्विद्युल्लताहारा स्पष्टपद्मविलोचना //
text_mt: rich with the sound of geese like tinkling anklets, with elevated cloud-breasts, / with trembling streaks of lightning as necklaces, with wide-opened lotus eyes —

sanskrit_iast:
asitajaladadhīradhvānavitrastahaṃsā
vimalasaliladhārotpātanamrotpalāgrā
surabhikusumareṇukḹptasarvāṅgaśobhā
giriduhitṛvivāhe prāvṛḍ āvirbabhūva
meaning:
असितजलदधीरध्वानवित्रस्तहंसा
विमलसलिलधारोत्पातनम्रोत्पलाग्रा
सुरभिकुसुमरेणुकॣप्तसर्वाङ्गशोभा
गिरिदुहितृविवाहे प्रावृड् आविर्बभूव
text_mt: with geese frightened by the deep rumbling of dark clouds, / with the tips of blue lotuses bent by the falling streams of pure water, / with her whole body's beauty adorned with the pollen of fragrant blossoms, / the rainy season appeared at the wedding of the mountain's daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
meghakañcukanirmuktā padmakośodbhavastanī
haṃsanūpuranihrādā sarvasasyadigantarā //
meaning:
मेघकञ्चुकनिर्मुक्ता पद्मकोशोद्भवस्तनी
हंसनूपुरनिह्रादा सर्वसस्यदिगन्तरा //
text_mt: Cast off from the bodice of clouds, with breasts like lotus-buds, / with the sound of geese as anklets, with the quarters filled with all kinds of grain,

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇapulinaśroṇī kūjatsārasamekhalā
praphullendīvaraśyāmavilocanamanoharā //
meaning:
विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणी कूजत्सारसमेखला
प्रफुल्लेन्दीवरश्यामविलोचनमनोहरा //
text_mt: with broad sandbank-hips, with calling crane-girdles, / captivating with eyes dark as blossoming blue water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
pakvabimbādharapuṭā kundadantaprahāsinī
navaśyāmalatāśyāmaromarājipuraskṛtā //
meaning:
पक्वबिम्बाधरपुटा कुन्ददन्तप्रहासिनी
नवश्यामलताश्यामरोमराजिपुरस्कृता //
text_mt: with ripe bimba-fruit lips, smiling with kunda-flower teeth, / adorned with a line of down dark as fresh dark creepers,

sanskrit_iast:
candrāṃśuhāravargeṇa kaṇṭhorasthalagāminā
prahlādayantī cetāṃsi sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām //
meaning:
चन्द्रांशुहारवर्गेण कण्ठोरस्थलगामिना
प्रह्लादयन्ती चेतांसि सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: gladdening the minds of all the dwellers of heaven / with garlands of moonbeams hanging over her throat and bosom,

sanskrit_iast:
samadālikulodgītamadhurasvarabhāṣiṇī
calatkumudasaṃghātacārukuṇḍalaśobhinī //
meaning:
समदालिकुलोद्गीतमधुरस्वरभाषिणी
चलत्कुमुदसंघातचारुकुण्डलशोभिनी //
text_mt: speaking with sweet voices sung by swarms of intoxicated bees, / radiant with lovely earrings of moving clusters of white water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
raktāśokapraśākhotthapallavāṅgulidhāriṇī
tatpuṣpasaṃcayamayair vāsobhiḥ samalaṃkṛtā //
meaning:
रक्ताशोकप्रशाखोत्थपल्लवाङ्गुलिधारिणी
तत्पुष्पसंचयमयैर् वासोभिः समलंकृता //
text_mt: possessing leaf-fingers sprung from branches of the red aśoka, / adorned with garments made of its heaps of blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
raktotpalāgracaraṇā jātīpuṣpanakhāvalī
kadalīstambhavāmorūḥ śaśāṅkavadanā tathā //
meaning:
रक्तोत्पलाग्रचरणा जातीपुष्पनखावली
कदलीस्तम्भवामोरूः शशाङ्कवदना तथा //
text_mt: with feet tipped with red lotuses, a row of nails like jātī flowers, / with thighs lovely as banana trunks, and a face like the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā
premṇā spṛśati kānteva sānurāgā manoramā //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना सर्वालंकारभूषिता
प्रेम्णा स्पृशति कान्तेव सानुरागा मनोरमा //
text_mt: endowed with every auspicious mark, adorned with all ornaments, / affectionate and lovely, touching [him] with love like a beloved wife —

sanskrit_iast:
nirmuktāsitameghakañcukapaṭā pūrṇendubimbānanā
nīlāmbhojavilocanā ravikaraprodbhinnapadmastanī
nānāpuṣparajaḥsugandhipavanaprahrādanī cetasāṃ
tatrāsīt kalahaṃsanūpuraravā devyā vivāhe śarat
meaning:
निर्मुक्तासितमेघकञ्चुकपटा पूर्णेन्दुबिम्बानना
नीलाम्भोजविलोचना रविकरप्रोद्भिन्नपद्मस्तनी
नानापुष्परजःसुगन्धिपवनप्रह्रादनी चेतसां
तत्रासीत् कलहंसनूपुररवा देव्या विवाहे शरत्
text_mt: having cast off her garment-bodice of dark clouds, with a face like the orb of the full moon, / with eyes like blue lotuses, with lotus-breasts opened by the sun's rays, / gladdening the minds with breezes fragrant with pollen of diverse flowers, / the autumn was present there at the goddess's wedding, sounding with the anklets of mallard ducks.

sanskrit_iast:
atyarthaśītalāmbhobhiḥ plāvayantau diśaḥ sadā
ṛtū hemantaśiśirau ājagmatur atidyutī //
meaning:
अत्यर्थशीतलाम्भोभिः प्लावयन्तौ दिशः सदा
ऋतू हेमन्तशिशिरौ आजग्मतुर् अतिद्युती //
text_mt: Constantly inundating the directions with exceedingly cold waters, / the two seasons, late autumn and winter, came, possessing great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyām ṛtubhyāṃ saṃprāpto himavān sa nagottamaḥ
prāleyacūrṇavarṣibhyāṃ kṣipraṃ raupyaharo babhau //
meaning:
ताभ्याम् ऋतुभ्यां संप्राप्तो हिमवान् स नगोत्तमः
प्रालेयचूर्णवर्षिभ्यां क्षिप्रं रौप्यहरो बभौ //
text_mt: Approached by those two seasons / showering powder of snow, that Himavat, best of mountains, quickly shone as if clad in silver.

sanskrit_iast:
tena prāleyavarṣeṇa ghanenaiva himālayaḥ
agādhena tadā reje kṣīroda iva sāgaraḥ //
meaning:
तेन प्रालेयवर्षेण घनेनैव हिमालयः
अगाधेन तदा रेजे क्षीरोद इव सागरः //
text_mt: By that shower of snow, thick indeed, / the fathomless Himālaya shone then like the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtupāryayasaṃprāpto babhūva sa mahāgiriḥ
sādhūpacārāt sahasā kṛtārtha iva durjanaḥ //
meaning:
ऋतुपार्ययसंप्राप्तो बभूव स महागिरिः
साधूपचारात् सहसा कृतार्थ इव दुर्जनः //
text_mt: Overtaken by the sequence of seasons, that great mountain became, / like a wicked person suddenly gratified, [rendered blessed] by the homage of the righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
prāleyapaṭalacchannaiḥ śṛṅgais tu śuśubhe nagaḥ
chattrair iva mahābhāgaiḥ pāṇḍaraiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ //
meaning:
प्रालेयपटलच्छन्नैः शृङ्गैस् तु शुशुभे नगः
छत्त्रैर् इव महाभागैः पाण्डरैः पृथिवीपतिः //
text_mt: With peaks covered by sheets of snow, the mountain shone / like a glorious king of the earth with white parasols.

sanskrit_iast:
manobhavodrekakarāḥ surāṇāṃ
surāṅganānāṃ ca muhuḥ samīrāḥ
svacchāmbupūrṇāś ca tathā nalinyaḥ
padmotpalānāṃ kusumair upetāḥ
meaning:
मनोभवोद्रेककराः सुराणां
सुराङ्गनानां च मुहुः समीराः
स्वच्छाम्बुपूर्णाश् च तथा नलिन्यः
पद्मोत्पलानां कुसुमैर् उपेताः
text_mt: Breezes constantly exciting the desire / of the gods and the women of the gods, / and lotus-ponds filled with clear water, / furnished with blossoms of lotuses and water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast: vivāhe gurukanyāyā vasantaḥ samagād ṛtuḥ //
meaning: विवाहे गुरुकन्याया वसन्तः समगाद् ऋतुः //
text_mt: at the wedding of the mountain's daughter, the spring season arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣatsamudbhinnapayodharāgrā
nāryo yathā ramyatarā babhūvuḥ
nātyuṣṇaśītāni payaḥsarāṃsi
kiñjalkacūrṇaiḥ kapilīkṛtāni
meaning:
ईषत्समुद्भिन्नपयोधराग्रा
नार्यो यथा रम्यतरा बभूवुः
नात्युष्णशीतानि पयःसरांसि
किञ्जल्कचूर्णैः कपिलीकृतानि
text_mt:
Just as women with breasts barely budding became more delightful,
so the prime celestial elephants, overjoyed, plunged into lakes of water
neither too hot nor too cold,
yellowed by powdered filaments,
resounding with pairs of cakravāka birds.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṅgūś cūtataravaś cūtāṃś cāpi priyaṅgavaḥ
tarjayanta ivānyonyaṃ mañjarībhiś cakāśire //
meaning:
प्रियङ्गूश् चूततरवश् चूतांश् चापि प्रियङ्गवः
तर्जयन्त इवान्योन्यं मञ्जरीभिश् चकाशिरे //
text_mt: The mango trees toward the priyaṅgu creepers, and the priyaṅgus toward the mangoes, / shone as if challenging one another with their blossoms.

sanskrit_iast:
himaśṛṅgeṣu śukleṣu tilakāḥ kusumotkarāḥ
śuśubhuḥ kāryam uddiśya vṛddhā iva samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
हिमशृङ्गेषु शुक्लेषु तिलकाः कुसुमोत्कराः
शुशुभुः कार्यम् उद्दिश्य वृद्धा इव समागताः //
text_mt: On the white peaks of snow, the tilaka trees with their masses of flowers / shone like elders gathered together for some undertaking.

sanskrit_iast:
phullāśokalatās tatra rejire śālasaṃśritāḥ
kāminya iva kāntānāṃ kaṇṭhālambitabāhavaḥ //
meaning:
फुल्लाशोकलतास् तत्र रेजिरे शालसंश्रिताः
कामिन्य इव कान्तानां कण्ठालम्बितबाहवः //
text_mt: Flowering aśoka creepers clung there to the śāla trees, / shining like loving women with their arms hung around their lovers' necks.

sanskrit_iast:
aśokasarjārjunakovidārāḥ
puṃnāganāgeśvarakarṇikārāḥ
lavaṅgatālāgurusaptaparṇā
nyagrodhaśobhāñjananārikelāḥ
meaning:
अशोकसर्जार्जुनकोविदाराः
पुंनागनागेश्वरकर्णिकाराः
लवङ्गतालागुरुसप्तपर्णा
न्यग्रोधशोभाञ्जननारिकेलाः
text_mt: Aśokas, sarjas, arjunas, and kovidāras, / puṃnāgas, nāgeśvaras, and karṇikāras, / cloves, palmyras, agurus, and saptaparṇas, / banyans, sobhanjanas, and coconut palms,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣās tathānye phalapuṣpavanto
dṛśyā babhūvuḥ sumanoharāṅgāḥ
jalāśayāś caiva suvarṇatoyāś
cakrāṅgakāraṇḍavahaṃsajuṣṭāḥ
meaning:
वृक्षास् तथान्ये फलपुष्पवन्तो
दृश्या बभूवुः सुमनोहराङ्गाः
जलाशयाश् चैव सुवर्णतोयाश्
चक्राङ्गकारण्डवहंसजुष्टाः
text_mt: and other trees bearing fruit and flowers / were visible, having exceedingly captivating forms; / and reservoirs with golden water / were frequented by shelducks, kāraṇḍavas, and geese;

sanskrit_iast:
koyaṣṭidātyūhabalākayuktā
dṛśyās tu padmotpalamīnapūrṇāḥ
khagāś ca nānāvidhabhūṣitāṅgā
dṛśyās tu vṛkṣeṣu sucitrapakṣāḥ
meaning:
कोयष्टिदात्यूहबलाकयुक्ता
दृश्यास् तु पद्मोत्पलमीनपूर्णाः
खगाश् च नानाविधभूषिताङ्गा
दृश्यास् तु वृक्षेषु सुचित्रपक्षाः
text_mt: provided with koyaṣṭis, water-hens, and egrets, / visible, full of lotuses, blue lotuses, and fish; / and birds with bodies decorated in various ways, / with brightly colored wings, were visible in the trees.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāsu yuktān atha tarjayantaḥ
kurvanti śabdaṃ madaneritāṅgāḥ
tasmin girāv adrisutāvivāhe
vavuś ca vātāḥ sukhaśītalāṅgāḥ
meaning:
क्रीडासु युक्तान् अथ तर्जयन्तः
कुर्वन्ति शब्दं मदनेरिताङ्गाः
तस्मिन् गिराव् अद्रिसुताविवाहे
ववुश् च वाताः सुखशीतलाङ्गाः
text_mt: Then, challenging those engaged in play, / their bodies excited by love, they made noise; / on that mountain at the wedding of the mountain's daughter / breezes blew, pleasant and cool to the body,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇi śubhrāṇy api pātayantaḥ
śanair nagebhyo malayādrijātāḥ
tathaiva sarve ṛtavaś ca puṇyāś
cakāśire 'nyonyavimiśritāṅgāḥ
meaning:
पुष्पाणि शुभ्राण्य् अपि पातयन्तः
शनैर् नगेभ्यो मलयाद्रिजाताः
तथैव सर्वे ऋतवश् च पुण्याश्
चकाशिरे ऽन्योन्यविमिश्रिताङ्गाः
text_mt: gently shaking white blossoms / down from the trees, born on the Malaya mountains. / In the same way, all the holy seasons / shone with their bodies intermingled with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
samadālikulodgītaśilākusumasaṃcayaiḥ
parasparaṃ hi mālatyo bhāvayantyo virejire //
meaning:
समदालिकुलोद्गीतशिलाकुसुमसंचयैः
परस्परं हि मालत्यो भावयन्त्यो विरेजिरे //
text_mt: With heaps of flowers on the rocks sung over by swarms of intoxicated bees, / the mālatī jasmines shone, mutually bringing one another to mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāni nīlāmburuhaiḥ payāṃsi
gaurāṇi gauraiś ca mṛṇāladaṇḍaiḥ
raktaiś ca raktāni bhṛśaṃ kṛtāni
mattadvirephāvalijuṣṭapattraiḥ
meaning:
नीलानि नीलाम्बुरुहैः पयांसि
गौराणि गौरैश् च मृणालदण्डैः
रक्तैश् च रक्तानि भृशं कृतानि
मत्तद्विरेफावलिजुष्टपत्त्रैः
text_mt: The waters were made deeply blue by blue lotuses, / white by white lotus-stalks, / and red by red lotuses / whose petals were frequented by rows of intoxicated bees.

sanskrit_iast:
haimāni vistīrṇajaleṣu keṣucin
nirantaraṃ cārutarāṇi keṣucit
vaidūryanālāni saraḥsu keṣucit
prajajñire padmavanāni sarvataḥ
meaning:
हैमानि विस्तीर्णजलेषु केषुचिन्
निरन्तरं चारुतराणि केषुचित्
वैदूर्यनालानि सरःसु केषुचित्
प्रजज्ञिरे पद्मवनानि सर्वतः
text_mt: Golden in some extensive waters, / densely clustered and more beautiful in some, / with lapis-lazuli stalks in some lakes, / lotus beds were produced on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpyas tatrābhavan ramyāḥ kamalotpalapuṣpitāḥ
nānāvihaṃgasaṃjuṣṭā haimasopānapaṅktayaḥ //
meaning:
वाप्यस् तत्राभवन् रम्याः कमलोत्पलपुष्पिताः
नानाविहंगसंजुष्टा हैमसोपानपङ्क्तयः //
text_mt: Charming step-wells were there, abloom with white and blue lotuses, / frequented by various birds, with tiers of golden steps.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgāṇi tasya tu gireḥ karṇikāraiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ
samucchritāny aviralair hemānīva babhur dvijāḥ //
meaning:
शृङ्गाणि तस्य तु गिरेः कर्णिकारैः सुपुष्पितैः
समुच्छ्रितान्य् अविरलैर् हेमानीव बभुर् द्विजाः //
text_mt: The elevated, dense peaks of that mountain / shone like gold, O twice-born ones, with blossoming karṇikāras.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣadvibhinnakusumaiḥ pāṭalaiś cāpi pāṭalāḥ
saṃbabhūvur diśaḥ sarvāḥ pavanākampimūrtibhiḥ //
meaning:
ईषद्विभिन्नकुसुमैः पाटलैश् चापि पाटलाः
संबभूवुर् दिशः सर्वाः पवनाकम्पिमूर्तिभिः //
text_mt: With slightly opened blossoms of pāṭalā trees, / all the directions became pale red, their forms shaken by the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇārjunā daśaguṇā nīlāśokamahīruhāḥ
girau vavṛdhire phullāḥ spardhayantaḥ parasparam //
meaning:
कृष्णार्जुना दशगुणा नीलाशोकमहीरुहाः
गिरौ ववृधिरे फुल्लाः स्पर्धयन्तः परस्परम् //
text_mt: The black arjuna and blue aśoka trees / grew tenfold in full bloom upon the mountain, vying with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
cārurāvavijuṣṭāni kiṃśukānāṃ vanāni ca
parvatasya nitambeṣu sarveṣu ca virejire //
meaning:
चारुरावविजुष्टानि किंशुकानां वनानि च
पर्वतस्य नितम्बेषु सर्वेषु च विरेजिरे //
text_mt: And groves of kiṃśuka trees, frequented by charming sounds, / shone on all the mountain slopes.

sanskrit_iast:
tamālagulmais tasyāsīc chobhā himavatas tadā
nīlajīmūtasaṃghātair nilīnair iva saṃdhiṣu //
meaning:
तमालगुल्मैस् तस्यासीच् छोभा हिमवतस् तदा
नीलजीमूतसंघातैर् निलीनैर् इव संधिषु //
text_mt: Himavat then had the beauty, through thickets of tamālas, / as if dark clouds had gathered in its hollows.

sanskrit_iast:
nikāmapuṣpaiḥ suviśālaśākhaiḥ
samucchritaiś candanacampakaiś ca
pramattapuṃskokilasaṃpralāpair
himācalo 'tīva tadā rarāja
meaning:
निकामपुष्पैः सुविशालशाखैः
समुच्छ्रितैश् चन्दनचम्पकैश् च
प्रमत्तपुंस्कोकिलसंप्रलापैर्
हिमाचलो ऽतीव तदा रराज
text_mt: With sandalwood and campaka trees abundant with flowers, / with very large branches, standing tall, / and with the chatter of impassioned male cuckoos, / the Himālaya then shone exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā śabdaṃ mṛdumadakalaṃ sarvataḥ kokilānāṃ
cañcatpakṣāḥ samadhurataraṃ nīlakaṇṭhā vineduḥ
teṣāṃ śabdair upacitabalaḥ puṣpacāpeṣuhastaḥ
sajjībhūtas tridaśavanitā veddhum aṅgeṣv anaṅgaḥ
meaning:
श्रुत्वा शब्दं मृदुमदकलं सर्वतः कोकिलानां
चञ्चत्पक्षाः समधुरतरं नीलकण्ठा विनेदुः
तेषां शब्दैर् उपचितबलः पुष्पचापेषुहस्तः
सज्जीभूतस् त्रिदशवनिता वेद्धुम् अङ्गेष्व् अनङ्गः
text_mt: Hearing the soft, impassioned, indistinct call of the cuckoos on every side, / peacocks with fluttering wings shrieked most sweetly; / with his strength increased by their sounds, the bodiless god [Kāma], flower-bow and arrow in hand, / became prepared to pierce the limbs of the wives of the thirty [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
paṭuḥ sūryātapaś cāpi prāyaśo 'lpajalāśayaḥ
devīvivāhasamaye grīṣma āgād dhimācalam //
meaning:
पटुः सूर्यातपश् चापि प्रायशो ऽल्पजलाशयः
देवीविवाहसमये ग्रीष्म आगाद् धिमाचलम् //
text_mt: With sharp sunlight, too, and mostly shallow waters, / the summer season came to the Himālaya at the time of the goddess's wedding.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi tarubhis tatra bahubhiḥ kusumotkaraiḥ
śobhayām āsa śṛṅgāṇi prāleyādreḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
स चापि तरुभिस् तत्र बहुभिः कुसुमोत्करैः
शोभयाम् आस शृङ्गाणि प्रालेयाद्रेः समन्ततः //
text_mt: And it adorned the peaks of the snowy mountain on all sides / with many trees bearing masses of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi ca girau tatra vāyavaḥ sumanoharāḥ
vavuḥ pāṭalavistīrṇakadambārjunagandhinaḥ //
meaning:
तथापि च गिरौ तत्र वायवः सुमनोहराः
ववुः पाटलविस्तीर्णकदम्बार्जुनगन्धिनः //
text_mt: Even so, exceedingly captivating breezes blew on that mountain, / fragrant with pāṭala, broad kadamba, and arjuna flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpyaḥ praphullapadmaughakesarāruṇamūrtayaḥ
abhavaṃs taṭasaṃghuṣṭaphalahaṃsakadambakāḥ //
meaning:
वाप्यः प्रफुल्लपद्मौघकेसरारुणमूर्तयः
अभवंस् तटसंघुष्टफलहंसकदम्बकाः //
text_mt: The step-wells, their forms made ruddy by the filaments of heaps of full-blown lotuses, / had flocks of mallards and kadamba geese calling out along their banks.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kurabakāś cāpi kusumāpāṇḍumūrtayaḥ
sarveṣu nagaśṛṅgeṣu bhramarāvalisevitāḥ //
meaning:
तथा कुरबकाश् चापि कुसुमापाण्डुमूर्तयः
सर्वेषु नगशृङ्गेषु भ्रमरावलिसेविताः //
text_mt: Likewise, the kurabaka trees, pale white in their blossoms, / were frequented on all the mountain crests by swarms of bees.

sanskrit_iast:
bakulāś ca nitambeṣu viśāleṣu mahībhṛtaḥ
utsasarja manojñāni kusumāni samantataḥ //
meaning:
बकुलाश् च नितम्बेषु विशालेषु महीभृतः
उत्ससर्ज मनोज्ञानि कुसुमानि समन्ततः //
text_mt: And on the mountain's broad slopes, the bakula trees / cast their delightful blossoms all around.

sanskrit_iast:
iti kusumavicitrasarvavṛkṣā
vividhavihaṃgamanādaramyadeśāḥ
himagiritanayāvivāhabhūtyai
ṣaḍ upayayur ṛtavo munipravīrāḥ
meaning:
इति कुसुमविचित्रसर्ववृक्षा
विविधविहंगमनादरम्यदेशाः
हिमगिरितनयाविवाहभूत्यै
षड् उपययुर् ऋतवो मुनिप्रवीराः
text_mt: Thus, with all trees wondrous with blossoms / and their lands delightful with the calls of various birds, / the six seasons arrived, O best of sages, / for the celebration of the marriage of the daughter of the Snow Mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tata evaṃ pravṛtte tu sarvabhūtasamāgame
nānāvādyasamākīrṇe ahaṃ tatra dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
तत एवं प्रवृत्ते तु सर्वभूतसमागमे
नानावाद्यसमाकीर्णे अहं तत्र द्विजातयः //
text_mt: Then, when this assembly of all beings had gathered / crowded with various musical instruments, I, O twice-born ones,

sanskrit_iast:
śailaputrīm alaṃkṛtya yogyābharaṇasaṃpadā
puraṃ praveśitavāṃs tāṃ svayam ādāya bho dvijāḥ //
meaning:
शैलपुत्रीम् अलंकृत्य योग्याभरणसंपदा
पुरं प्रवेशितवांस् तां स्वयम् आदाय भो द्विजाः //
text_mt: adorned the daughter of the mountain with an abundance of suitable ornaments, / and having taken her myself, O twice-born ones, led her into the city.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tu punar eveśam ahaṃ caivoktavān vibhum
havir juhomi vahnau te upādhyāyapade sthitaḥ //
meaning:
ततस् तु पुनर् एवेशम् अहं चैवोक्तवान् विभुम्
हविर् जुहोमि वह्नौ ते उपाध्यायपदे स्थितः //
text_mt: Then I spoke again to the all-pervading Lord: / 'Standing in the position of family priest, I shall offer oblation into the fire for you.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāsi mahyaṃ yady ājñāṃ kartavyo 'yaṃ kriyāvidhiḥ
mām āha śaṃkaraś caivaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ //
meaning:
ददासि मह्यं यद्य् आज्ञां कर्तव्यो ऽयं क्रियाविधिः
माम् आह शंकरश् चैवं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः //
text_mt: If you give me the command, this ritual procedure is to be performed.' / And Śaṅkara, God of gods, Lord of the world, said to me:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
yad uddiṣṭaṃ sureśāna tat kuruṣva yathepsitam
kartāsmi vacanaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṃs tava jagadvibho //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
यद् उद्दिष्टं सुरेशान तत् कुरुष्व यथेप्सितम्
कर्तास्मि वचनं सर्वं ब्रह्मंस् तव जगद्विभो //
text_mt: Śiva said: / 'O Lord of gods, perform as you desire whatever has been prescribed. / I shall carry out all your words, O Brahmā, sovereign of the world.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataś cāhaṃ prahṛṣṭātmā kuśān ādāya satvaram
hastaṃ devasya devyāś ca yogabandhena yuktavān //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततश् चाहं प्रहृष्टात्मा कुशान् आदाय सत्वरम्
हस्तं देवस्य देव्याश् च योगबन्धेन युक्तवान् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then, delighted in my heart, taking kuśa grass swiftly, / I joined the hand of the god and of the goddess with the bond of union.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalanaś ca svayaṃ tatra kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ
śrutigītair mahāmantrair mūrtimadbhir upasthitaiḥ //
meaning:
ज्वलनश् च स्वयं तत्र कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः
श्रुतिगीतैर् महामन्त्रैर् मूर्तिमद्भिर् उपस्थितैः //
text_mt: And the Fire himself stood there with hands folded in reverent greeting, / attended by the great mantras sung by the Vedas present in bodily form.

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktavidhinā hutvā sarpis tad amṛtaṃ haviḥ
tatas taṃ jvalanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
यथोक्तविधिना हुत्वा सर्पिस् तद् अमृतं हविः
ततस् तं ज्वलनं सर्वं कारयित्वा प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Having offered according to the prescribed rule the clarified butter, that immortal oblation, / and having then caused them to make a full circumambulation of that fire,

sanskrit_iast:
muktvā hastasamāyogaṃ sahitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ
putraiś ca mānasaiḥ siddhaiḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā //
meaning:
मुक्त्वा हस्तसमायोगं सहितः सर्वदैवतैः
पुत्रैश् च मानसैः सिद्धैः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना //
text_mt: releasing the clasping of hands, together with all the deities, / his mind-born sons, and the Siddhas, with a rejoiced inner self,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtta udvāhakāle tu praṇamya ca vṛṣadhvajam
yogenaiva tayor viprās tad umāparameśayoḥ //
meaning:
वृत्त उद्वाहकाले तु प्रणम्य च वृषध्वजम्
योगेनैव तयोर् विप्रास् तद् उमापरमेशयोः //
text_mt: and bowing to the bull-bannered god when the wedding moment had passed, / through that very union of those two, O brahmins, of Umā and the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhaḥ sa paro vṛtto yaṃ devā na viduḥ kvacit
iti vaḥ sarvam ākhyātaṃ svayaṃvaram idaṃ śubham
udvāhaś caiva devasya śṛṇudhvaṃ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
उद्वाहः स परो वृत्तो यं देवा न विदुः क्वचित्
इति वः सर्वम् आख्यातं स्वयंवरम् इदं शुभम्
उद्वाहश् चैव देवस्य शृणुध्वं परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt: that highest marriage was accomplished, which the gods never knew before. / Thus this auspicious choice of a husband has been recounted to you all, / as well as the wedding of the god; hear [now] the supreme marvel!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
atha vṛtte vivāhe tu bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ
praharṣam atulaṃ gatvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir ādyābhiḥ praṇemus te maheśvaram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अथ वृत्ते विवाहे तु भवस्यामिततेजसः
प्रहर्षम् अतुलं गत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
तुष्टुवुर् वाग्भिर् आद्याभिः प्रणेमुस् ते महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Now when the marriage of Bhava of boundless splendor was concluded, / the gods, preceded by Indra, experienced matchless delight; / they praised Maheśvara with primordial words and bowed down to him.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
namaḥ parvataliṅgāya parvateśāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ pavanavegāya virūpāyājitāya ca
namaḥ kleśavināśāya dātre ca śubhasaṃpadām //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नमः पर्वतलिङ्गाय पर्वतेशाय वै नमः
नमः पवनवेगाय विरूपायाजिताय च
नमः क्लेशविनाशाय दात्रे च शुभसंपदाम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / 'Salutations to the one whose emblem is the mountain, salutations to the Lord of the mountain! / Salutations to the one swift as the wind, to the multiform, and to the unconquered! / Salutations to the destroyer of affliction and the giver of auspicious fortunes!

sanskrit_iast:
namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya ambikāpataye namaḥ
namaḥ pavanarūpāya śatarūpāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो नीलशिखण्डाय अम्बिकापतये नमः
नमः पवनरूपाय शतरूपाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the one with the dark crest! Salutations to the lord of Ambikā! / Salutations to the one whose form is the wind! Salutations to the one of a hundred forms!

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhairavarūpāya virūpanayanāya ca
namaḥ sahasranetrāya sahasracaraṇāya ca //
meaning:
नमो भैरवरूपाय विरूपनयनाय च
नमः सहस्रनेत्राय सहस्रचरणाय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the one whose form is terrible, and to the one of multiform eyes! / Salutations to the thousand-eyed one and to the thousand-footed one!

sanskrit_iast:
namo devavayasyāya vedāṅgāya namo namaḥ
viṣṭambhanāya śakrasya bāhvor vedāṅkurāya ca //
meaning:
नमो देववयस्याय वेदाङ्गाय नमो नमः
विष्टम्भनाय शक्रस्य बाह्वोर् वेदाङ्कुराय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the companion of gods! Salutations, salutations to the limb of the Veda! / Salutations to the paralyser of Indra's arms, and to the sprout of the Veda!

sanskrit_iast:
carācarādhipataye śamanāya namo namaḥ
salilāśayaliṅgāya yugāntāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
चराचराधिपतये शमनाय नमो नमः
सलिलाशयलिङ्गाय युगान्ताय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Salutations, salutations to the sovereign of the moving and unmoving, to the restrainer! / Salutations, salutations to the one whose emblem is water reservoirs, to the end of the cosmic age!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kapālamālāya kapālasūtradhāriṇe
namaḥ kapālahastāya daṇḍine gadine namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः कपालमालाय कपालसूत्रधारिणे
नमः कपालहस्ताय दण्डिने गदिने नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the one garlanded with skulls, to the bearer of the skull-cord! / Salutations to the one with a skull in hand, to the staff-bearer, salutations to the mace-bearer!

sanskrit_iast:
namas trailokyanāthāya paśulokaratāya ca
namaḥ khaṭvāṅgahastāya pramathārtiharāya ca //
meaning:
नमस् त्रैलोक्यनाथाय पशुलोकरताय च
नमः खट्वाङ्गहस्ताय प्रमथार्तिहराय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the protector of the three worlds, and to the one delighting in the world of beasts! / Salutations to the one with a club in hand, and to the remover of the distress of the attendants!

sanskrit_iast:
namo yajñaśirohantre kṛṣṇakeśāpahāriṇe
bhaganetranipātāya pūṣṇo dantaharāya ca //
meaning:
नमो यज्ञशिरोहन्त्रे कृष्णकेशापहारिणे
भगनेत्रनिपाताय पूष्णो दन्तहराय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the destroyer of the head of the sacrifice, to the remover of the black hair! / Salutations to the smiter of Bhaga's eye, and to the extractor of Pūṣan's teeth!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ pinākaśūlāsikhaḍgamudgaradhāriṇe
namo 'stu kālakālāya tṛtīyanayanāya ca //
meaning:
नमः पिनाकशूलासिखड्गमुद्गरधारिणे
नमो ऽस्तु कालकालाय तृतीयनयनाय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the bearer of the Pināka bow, the trident, the sword, the scimitar, and the mallet! / Salutations be to the death of Death, and to the three-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
antakāntakṛte caiva namaḥ parvatavāsine
suvarṇaretase caiva namaḥ kuṇḍaladhāriṇe //
meaning:
अन्तकान्तकृते चैव नमः पर्वतवासिने
सुवर्णरेतसे चैव नमः कुण्डलधारिणे //
text_mt: Salutations to the one who makes an end of the Ender, and to the dweller on the mountain! / Salutations to the one whose semen is gold, and to the wearer of earrings!

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāṃ yoganāśāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
śaśāṅkādityanetrāya lalāṭanayanāya ca //
meaning:
दैत्यानां योगनाशाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः
शशाङ्कादित्यनेत्राय ललाटनयनाय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the destroyer of the magical power of the Daityas, to the teacher of yogins! / Salutations to the one whose eyes are the moon and the sun, and to the one with an eye on his forehead!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śmaśānarataye śmaśānavaradāya ca
namo daivatanāthāya tryambakāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः श्मशानरतये श्मशानवरदाय च
नमो दैवतनाथाय त्र्यम्बकाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the one delighting in cremation grounds, to the giver of boons in the cremation ground! / Salutations to the lord of deities! Salutations, salutations to Tryambaka!

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthasādhave nityaṃ jaṭile brahmacāriṇe
namo muṇḍārdhamuṇḍāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्थसाधवे नित्यं जटिले ब्रह्मचारिणे
नमो मुण्डार्धमुण्डाय पशूनां पतये नमः //
text_mt: To the ever virtuous householder, to the matted-haired ascetic student! / Salutations to the shaven-headed and half-shaven, salutations to the lord of beasts!

sanskrit_iast:
salile tapyamānāya yogaiśvaryapradāya ca
namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya pralayotpattikāriṇe //
meaning:
सलिले तप्यमानाय योगैश्वर्यप्रदाय च
नमः शान्ताय दान्ताय प्रलयोत्पत्तिकारिणे //
text_mt: To the one performing tapas in the water, and to the giver of sovereignty through yoga! / Salutations to the peaceful, the restrained, the cause of dissolution and origination!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'nugrahakartre ca sthitikartre namo namaḥ
namo rudrāya vasava ādityāyāśvine namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽनुग्रहकर्त्रे च स्थितिकर्त्रे नमो नमः
नमो रुद्राय वसव आदित्यायाश्विने नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the granter of grace, salutations, salutations to the author of preservation! / Salutations to Rudra, to the Vasu, to the Āditya, salutations to the Aśvin!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ pitre 'tha sāṃkhyāya viśvedevāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ śarvāya ugrāya śivāya varadāya ca //
meaning:
नमः पित्रे ऽथ सांख्याय विश्वेदेवाय वै नमः
नमः शर्वाय उग्राय शिवाय वरदाय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the ancestor, to Sāṃkhya, salutations indeed to the Viśvedevas! / Salutations to Śarva, to the fierce, to the auspicious, and to the giver of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhīmāya senānye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
śucaye vairihānāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो भीमाय सेनान्ये पशूनां पतये नमः
शुचये वैरिहानाय सद्योजाताय वै नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the formidable, to the commander of the army, salutations to the lord of beasts! / Salutations indeed to the pure, to the destroyer of enemies, to Sadyojāta!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya citrāya vicitrāya ca vai namaḥ
pradhānāyāprameyāya kāryāya kāraṇāya ca //
meaning:
महादेवाय चित्राय विचित्राय च वै नमः
प्रधानायाप्रमेयाय कार्याय कारणाय च //
text_mt: Salutations to the great god, to the wondrous, and indeed to the variegated! / Salutations to pradhāna, to the immeasurable, to effect and to cause!

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāya namas te 'stu puruṣecchākarāya ca
namaḥ puruṣasaṃyogapradhānaguṇakāriṇe //
meaning:
पुरुषाय नमस् ते ऽस्तु पुरुषेच्छाकराय च
नमः पुरुषसंयोगप्रधानगुणकारिणे //
text_mt: Salutations be to you, the puruṣa, and to the fulfiller of puruṣa's desires! / Salutations to the cause of the qualities of pradhāna through union with puruṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
pravartakāya prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca sarvaśaḥ
kṛtākṛtasya satkartre phalasaṃyogadāya ca //
meaning:
प्रवर्तकाय प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च सर्वशः
कृताकृतस्य सत्कर्त्रे फलसंयोगदाय च //
text_mt: To the instigator of prakṛti and of puruṣa in every way, / to the right creator of what is done and undone, and to the giver of the union with fruits!

sanskrit_iast:
kālajñāya ca sarveṣāṃ namo niyamakāriṇe
namo vaiṣamyakartre ca guṇānāṃ vṛttidāya ca //
meaning:
कालज्ञाय च सर्वेषां नमो नियमकारिणे
नमो वैषम्यकर्त्रे च गुणानां वृत्तिदाय च //
text_mt: To the knower of time, and salutations to the maker of order for all! / Salutations to the creator of diversity, and to the dispenser of functions of the guṇas!

sanskrit_iast:
namas te devadeveśa namas te bhūtabhāvana
śiva saumyamukho draṣṭuṃ bhava saumyo hi naḥ prabho //
meaning:
नमस् ते देवदेवेश नमस् ते भूतभावन
शिव सौम्यमुखो द्रष्टुं भव सौम्यो हि नः प्रभो //
text_mt: Salutations to you, O God of gods! Salutations to you, O source of beings! / O Śiva, gentle-faced to behold, be gentle indeed to us, O Lord!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evaṃ sa bhagavān devo jagatpatir umāpatiḥ
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvair amarān idam abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवं स भगवान् देवो जगत्पतिर् उमापतिः
स्तूयमानः सुरैः सर्वैर् अमरान् इदम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus praised by all the gods, the blessed god, / the Lord of the world, the husband of Umā, addressed the immortals thus:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśaṃkara uvāca
draṣṭuṃ sukhaś ca saumyaś ca devānām asmi bhoḥ surāḥ
varaṃ varayata kṣipraṃ dātāsmi tam asaṃśayam //
meaning:
श्रीशंकर उवाच
द्रष्टुं सुखश् च सौम्यश् च देवानाम् अस्मि भोः सुराः
वरं वरयत क्षिप्रं दातास्मि तम् असंशयम् //
text_mt: The venerable Śaṅkara said: / 'I am pleasant to behold and gentle to the gods, O deities! / Choose a boon quickly; I shall grant it without doubt.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tatas te praṇatāḥ sarve surā ūcus trilocanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततस् ते प्रणताः सर्वे सुरा ऊचुस् त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then all those gods bowed down and said to the three-eyed one:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
tavaiva bhagavan haste vara eṣo 'vatiṣṭhatām
yadā kāryaṃ tadā nas tvaṃ dāsyase varam īpsitam //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
तवैव भगवन् हस्ते वर एषो ऽवतिष्ठताम्
यदा कार्यं तदा नस् त्वं दास्यसे वरम् ईप्सितम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / 'O Blessed One, let this boon remain in your hand alone: / whenever there is a need, then you will grant us the desired boon.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam astv iti tān uktvā visṛjya ca surān haraḥ
lokāṃś ca pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ viveśa bhavanaṃ svakam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् अस्त्व् इति तान् उक्त्वा विसृज्य च सुरान् हरः
लोकांश् च प्रमथैः सार्धं विवेश भवनं स्वकम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Saying 'So be it' to them, and dismissing the gods / and the worlds, Hara entered his own dwelling together with his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
yas tu harotsavam adbhutam enaṃ
gāyati daivataviprasamakṣam
so 'pratirūpagaṇeśasamāno
dehaviparyayam etya sukhī syāt
meaning:
यस् तु हरोत्सवम् अद्भुतम् एनं
गायति दैवतविप्रसमक्षम्
सो ऽप्रतिरूपगणेशसमानो
देहविपर्ययम् एत्य सुखी स्यात्
text_mt: He who sings of this wondrous festival of Hara / in the presence of gods and brahmins / becomes equal to an incomparable lord of gaṇas, / and having undergone the change of body, will be happy.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vipravaryāḥ stavaṃ hīmaṃ śṛṇuyād vā paṭhec ca yaḥ
sa sarvalokago devaiḥ pūjyate 'mararāḍ iva //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
विप्रवर्याः स्तवं हीमं शृणुयाद् वा पठेच् च यः
स सर्वलोकगो देवैः पूज्यते ऽमरराड् इव //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / O best of brahmins, whoever hears or recites this hymn of praise, / going to all the worlds, is worshipped by the gods like the king of immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
praviṣṭe bhavanaṃ deve sūpaviṣṭe varāsane
sa vakro manmathaḥ krūro devaṃ veddhumanā bhavat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
प्रविष्टे भवनं देवे सूपविष्टे वरासने
स वक्रो मन्मथः क्रूरो देवं वेद्धुमना भवत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When the god had entered his dwelling and sat down comfortably on an excellent seat, / crooked, cruel Manmatha became intent on piercing the god—

sanskrit_iast:
tam anācārasaṃyuktaṃ durātmānaṃ kulādhamam
lokān sarvān pīḍayantaṃ sarvāṅgāvaraṇātmakam //
meaning:
तम् अनाचारसंयुक्तं दुरात्मानं कुलाधमम्
लोकान् सर्वान् पीडयन्तं सर्वाङ्गावरणात्मकम् //
text_mt: him of immoral conduct, evil-minded, the vilest of his family, / afflicting all the worlds, whose nature envelops all limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ vighnakartāraṃ niyamānāṃ vrataiḥ saha
cakrāhvayasya rūpeṇa ratyā saha samāgatam //
meaning:
ऋषीणां विघ्नकर्तारं नियमानां व्रतैः सह
चक्राह्वयस्य रूपेण रत्या सह समागतम् //
text_mt: who obstructs the sages' restraints along with their vows, / who had come together with Rati in the form of a ruddy goose.

sanskrit_iast:
athātatāyinaṃ viprā veddhukāmaṃ sureśvaraḥ
nayanena tṛtīyena sāvajñaṃ samavaikṣata //
meaning:
अथाततायिनं विप्रा वेद्धुकामं सुरेश्वरः
नयनेन तृतीयेन सावज्ञं समवैक्षत //
text_mt: Then, O brahmins, the lord of the gods scornfully looked upon the felon, / who was eager to pierce [him], with his third eye.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sya netrajo vahnir jvālāmālāsahasravān
sahasā ratibhartāram adahat saparicchadam //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्य नेत्रजो वह्निर् ज्वालामालासहस्रवान्
सहसा रतिभर्तारम् अदहत् सपरिच्छदम् //
text_mt: Then the fire born of his eye, possessing thousands of garland-like flames, / suddenly burned Rati's husband along with his equipment.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dahyamānaḥ karuṇam ārto 'krośata visvaram
prasādayaṃś ca taṃ devaṃ papāta dharaṇītale //
meaning:
स दह्यमानः करुणम् आर्तो ऽक्रोशत विस्वरम्
प्रसादयंश् च तं देवं पपात धरणीतले //
text_mt: Being burned, afflicted, he cried out pitifully and dissonantly, / and propitiating that god, he fell to the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
atha so 'gniparītāṅgo manmatho lokatāpanaḥ
papāta sahasā mūrchāṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata //
meaning:
अथ सो ऽग्निपरीताङ्गो मन्मथो लोकतापनः
पपात सहसा मूर्छां क्षणेन समपद्यत //
text_mt: Then Manmatha, the tormentor of the worlds, his limbs encompassed by fire, / fell down suddenly and fainted within a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
patnī tu karuṇaṃ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā
devīṃ devaṃ ca duḥkhārtā ayācat karuṇāvatī //
meaning:
पत्नी तु करुणं तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता
देवीं देवं च दुःखार्ता अयाचत् करुणावती //
text_mt: His wife, however, lamented piteously in great sorrow; / stricken with grief, compassionate, she pleaded with the goddess and the god.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāś ca karuṇāṃ jñātvā devau tau karuṇātmakau
ūcatus tāṃ samālokya samāśvāsya ca duḥkhitām //
meaning:
तस्याश् च करुणां ज्ञात्वा देवौ तौ करुणात्मकौ
ऊचतुस् तां समालोक्य समाश्वास्य च दुःखिताम् //
text_mt: Knowing her pity, those two gods, full of compassion, / looked at that sorrowful woman, consoled her, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvarāv ūcatuḥ
dagdha eva dhruvaṃ bhadre nāsyotpattir iheṣyate
aśarīro 'pi te bhadre kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati //
meaning:
उमामहेश्वराव् ऊचतुः
दग्ध एव ध्रुवं भद्रे नास्योत्पत्तिर् इहेष्यते
अशरीरो ऽपि ते भद्रे कार्यं सर्वं करिष्यति //
text_mt:
Umā and Maheśvara said:
He is indeed burned, blessed lady; his rebirth here is not desired. / Even though bodiless, blessed lady, he will accomplish all your desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu viṣṇur bhagavān vasudevasutaḥ śubhe
tadā tasya suto yaś ca patis te saṃbhaviṣyati //
meaning:
यदा तु विष्णुर् भगवान् वसुदेवसुतः शुभे
तदा तस्य सुतो यश् च पतिस् ते संभविष्यति //
text_mt: When, however, the blessed Viṣṇu becomes the son of Vasudeva, O auspicious one, / then his son will be born as your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ sā tu varaṃ labdhvā kāmapatnī śubhānanā
jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ prītiyuktā gataklamā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः सा तु वरं लब्ध्वा कामपत्नी शुभानना
जगामेष्टं तदा देशं प्रीतियुक्ता गतक्लमा //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Then, having obtained the boon, that fair-faced wife of Kāma, / filled with affection and freed from weariness, went to her desired place.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā kāmaṃ tato viprāḥ sa tu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ
reme tatromayā sārdhaṃ prahṛṣṭas tu himācale //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा कामं ततो विप्राः स तु देवो वृषध्वजः
रेमे तत्रोमया सार्धं प्रहृष्टस् तु हिमाचले //
text_mt: Then, having burned Kāma, O brahmins, that bull-bannered god, / filled with delight, sported there on the Himālaya with Umā,

sanskrit_iast:
kandareṣu ca ramyeṣu padminīṣu guhāsu ca
nirjhareṣu ca ramyeṣu karṇikāravaneṣu ca //
meaning:
कन्दरेषु च रम्येषु पद्मिनीषु गुहासु च
निर्झरेषु च रम्येषु कर्णिकारवनेषु च //
text_mt: in delightful chasms, lotus ponds, and caves, / by pleasant waterfalls, and in karṇikāra groves,

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīreṣu kānteṣu kiṃnarācariteṣu ca
śṛṅgeṣu śailarājasya taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca //
meaning:
नदीतीरेषु कान्तेषु किंनराचरितेषु च
शृङ्गेषु शैलराजस्य तडागेषु सरःसु च //
text_mt: on lovely riverbanks frequented by kiṃnaras, / on the peaks of the mountain king, and by ponds and lakes,

sanskrit_iast:
vanarājiṣu ramyāsu nānāpakṣiruteṣu ca
tīrtheṣu puṇyatoyeṣu munīnām āśrameṣu ca //
meaning:
वनराजिषु रम्यासु नानापक्षिरुतेषु च
तीर्थेषु पुण्यतोयेषु मुनीनाम् आश्रमेषु च //
text_mt: in beautiful rows of forests resounding with the cries of various birds, / at holy bathing places of sacred water, and in the hermitages of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣu puṇyeṣu manohareṣu
deśeṣu vidyādharabhūṣiteṣu
gandharvayakṣāmaraseviteṣu
reme sa devyā sahitas trinetraḥ
meaning:
एतेषु पुण्येषु मनोहरेषु
देशेषु विद्याधरभूषितेषु
गन्धर्वयक्षामरसेवितेषु
रेमे स देव्या सहितस् त्रिनेत्रः
text_mt: In these sacred and delightful / places adorned by vidyādharas, / frequented by gandharvas, yakṣas, and immortals, / the three-eyed one sported along with the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
devaiḥ sahendrair muniyakṣasiddhair
gandharvavidyādharadaityamukhyaiḥ
anyaiś ca sarvair vividhair vṛto 'sau
tasmin nage harṣam avāpa śaṃbhuḥ
meaning:
देवैः सहेन्द्रैर् मुनियक्षसिद्धैर्
गन्धर्वविद्याधरदैत्यमुख्यैः
अन्यैश् च सर्वैर् विविधैर् वृतो ऽसौ
तस्मिन् नगे हर्षम् अवाप शंभुः
text_mt: Accompanied by gods led by Indra, by sages, yakṣas, and siddhas, / by leaders of gandharvas, vidyādharas, and daityas, / and surrounded by various other beings of every kind, / Śambhu found delight on that mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyanti tatrāpsarasaḥ sureśā
gāyanti gandharvagaṇāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ
divyāni vādyāny atha vādayanti
kecid drutaṃ devavaraṃ stuvanti
meaning:
नृत्यन्ति तत्राप्सरसः सुरेशा
गायन्ति गन्धर्वगणाः प्रहृष्टाः
दिव्यानि वाद्यान्य् अथ वादयन्ति
केचिद् द्रुतं देववरं स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: There apsarases danced before the lord of the gods, / delighted troops of gandharvas sang, / they played celestial instruments, / and some hastily praised the foremost of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa devaḥ svagaṇair upeto
mahābalaiḥ śakrayamāgnitulyaiḥ
devyāḥ priyārthaṃ bhaganetrahantā
giriṃ na tatyāja tadā mahātmā
meaning:
एवं स देवः स्वगणैर् उपेतो
महाबलैः शक्रयमाग्नितुल्यैः
देव्याः प्रियार्थं भगनेत्रहन्ता
गिरिं न तत्याज तदा महात्मा
text_mt: Thus accompanied by his own attendants, / mighty and equal to Śakra, Yama, and Agni, / that great-souled slayer of Bhaga's eyes / did not leave the mountain then, for the sake of pleasing the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
devyāḥ samaṃ tu bhagavāṃs tiṣṭhaṃs tatra sa kāmahā
akarot kiṃ mahādeva etad icchāma veditum //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
देव्याः समं तु भगवांस् तिष्ठंस् तत्र स कामहा
अकरोत् किं महादेव एतद् इच्छाम वेदितुम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
Remaining there together with the goddess, O lord, what did he, / the slayer of Kāma, Mahādeva, do? We wish to know this.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
bhagavān himavacchṛṅge sa hi devyāḥ priyecchayā
gaṇeśair vividhākārair hāsaṃ saṃjanayan muhuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
भगवान् हिमवच्छृङ्गे स हि देव्याः प्रियेच्छया
गणेशैर् विविधाकारैर् हासं संजनयन् मुहुः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
The lord, out of a desire to please the goddess on the peak of the Himālaya, / repeatedly caused laughter by means of troop-leaders of diverse forms.

sanskrit_iast:
devīṃ bālendutilako ramayaṃś ca rarāma ca
mahānubhāvaiḥ sarvajñaiḥ kāmarūpadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
देवीं बालेन्दुतिलको रमयंश् च रराम च
महानुभावैः सर्वज्ञैः कामरूपधरैः शुभैः //
text_mt: Delighting the goddess, he whose forehead-mark is the crescent moon also took delight, / [surrounded] by noble, omniscient, shapeshifting, auspicious [attendants].

sanskrit_iast:
atha devy āsasādaikā mātaraṃ parameśvarī
āsīnāṃ kāñcane śubhra āsane paramādbhute //
meaning:
अथ देव्य् आससादैका मातरं परमेश्वरी
आसीनां काञ्चने शुभ्र आसने परमाद्भुते //
text_mt: Then the supreme goddess, alone, approached her mother, / who was seated on a radiant, golden, exceedingly wonderful throne.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dṛṣṭvā satīṃ devīm āgatāṃ surarūpiṇīm
āsanena mahārheṇa śaṃpādayad aninditām
āsīnāṃ tām athovāca menā himavataḥ priyā //
meaning:
अथ दृष्ट्वा सतीं देवीम् आगतां सुररूपिणीम्
आसनेन महार्हेण शंपादयद् अनिन्दिताम्
आसीनां ताम् अथोवाच मेना हिमवतः प्रिया //
text_mt: Then, seeing that virtuous goddess arrived, of divine form, / Menā, the beloved of the Himavat, provided the blameless lady / with an expensive seat and said to her as she sat:

sanskrit_iast:
menovāca
cirasyāgamanaṃ te 'dya vada putri śubhekṣaṇe
daridrā krīḍanais tvaṃ hi bhartrā krīḍasi saṃgatā //
meaning:
मेनोवाच
चिरस्यागमनं ते ऽद्य वद पुत्रि शुभेक्षणे
दरिद्रा क्रीडनैस् त्वं हि भर्त्रा क्रीडसि संगता //
text_mt:
Menā said:
Tell me, daughter of auspicious eyes, why have you come after so long? / Indeed, poor as you are, you play with toys, joined with your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
ye daridrā bhavanti sma tathaiva ca nirāśrayāḥ
ume ta evaṃ krīḍanti yathā tava patiḥ śubhe //
meaning:
ये दरिद्रा भवन्ति स्म तथैव च निराश्रयाः
उमे त एवं क्रीडन्ति यथा तव पतिः शुभे //
text_mt: Those who are poor and likewise shelterless, / O Umā, they play in such a manner, just as your husband does, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
saivam uktātha mātrā tu nātihṛṣṭamanā bhavat
mahatyā kṣamayā yuktā na kiṃcit tām uvāca ha
visṛṣṭā ca tadā mātrā gatvā devam uvāca ha //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सैवम् उक्ताथ मात्रा तु नातिहृष्टमना भवत्
महत्या क्षमया युक्ता न किंचित् ताम् उवाच ह
विसृष्टा च तदा मात्रा गत्वा देवम् उवाच ह //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Being spoken to thus by her mother, she did not become very joyful in mind. / Endowed with great patience, she said nothing to her at all; / and dismissed then by her mother, she went and said to the god:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvaty uvāca
bhagavan devadeveśa neha vatsyāmi bhūdhare
anyaṃ kuru mamāvāsaṃ bhuvaneṣu mahādyute //
meaning:
पार्वत्य् उवाच
भगवन् देवदेवेश नेह वत्स्यामि भूधरे
अन्यं कुरु ममावासं भुवनेषु महाद्युते //
text_mt:
Pārvatī said:
O lord, lord of the god of gods, I will not dwell here on this mountain. / Make another dwelling for me among the worlds, O greatly radiant one!

sanskrit_iast:
deva uvāca
sadā tvam ucyamānā vai mayā vāsārtham īśvari
anyaṃ na rocitavatī vāsaṃ vai devi karhicit //
meaning:
देव उवाच
सदा त्वम् उच्यमाना वै मया वासार्थम् ईश्वरि
अन्यं न रोचितवती वासं वै देवि कर्हिचित् //
text_mt:
The god said:
Though you were always spoken to by me regarding a dwelling, O sovereign lady, / you never found any other dwelling pleasing, O goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ svayam eva tvaṃ vāsam anyatra śobhane
kasmān mṛgayase devi brūhi tan me śucismite //
meaning:
इदानीं स्वयम् एव त्वं वासम् अन्यत्र शोभने
कस्मान् मृगयसे देवि ब्रूहि तन् मे शुचिस्मिते //
text_mt: Why do you now yourself seek a dwelling elsewhere, / O fair lady? Tell me that, O goddess of pure smiles!

sanskrit_iast:
devy uvāca
gṛhaṃ gatāsmi deveśa pitur adya mahātmanaḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca tatra me mātā vijane lokabhāvane //
meaning:
देव्य् उवाच
गृहं गतास्मि देवेश पितुर् अद्य महात्मनः
दृष्ट्वा च तत्र मे माता विजने लोकभावने //
text_mt:
The goddess said:
O lord of gods, creator of the worlds, today I went to the house of my great-souled father; / and seeing me there in private, my mother,

sanskrit_iast:
āsanādibhir abhyarcya sā mām evam abhāṣata
ume tava sadā bhartā daridraḥ krīḍanaiḥ śubhe //
meaning:
आसनादिभिर् अभ्यर्च्य सा माम् एवम् अभाषत
उमे तव सदा भर्ता दरिद्रः क्रीडनैः शुभे //
text_mt: having honored me with a seat and other offerings, spoke to me thus: / 'O Umā, your husband is always poor, playing with toys, O auspicious one;

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍate nahi devānāṃ krīḍā bhavati tādṛśī
yat kila tvaṃ mahādeva gaṇaiś ca vividhais tathā
ramase tad aniṣṭaṃ hi mama mātur vṛṣadhvaja //
meaning:
क्रीडते नहि देवानां क्रीडा भवति तादृशी
यत् किल त्वं महादेव गणैश् च विविधैस् तथा
रमसे तद् अनिष्टं हि मम मातुर् वृषध्वज //
text_mt: he plays, for such is not the play of the gods.' / Inasmuch as you, O Mahādeva, sport thus with various attendants, / that, O bull-bannered one, is indeed distasteful to my mother.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tato devaḥ prahasyāha devīṃ hāsayituṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो देवः प्रहस्याह देवीं हासयितुं प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Then the lord, laughing, said to the goddess to make her laugh:

sanskrit_iast:
deva uvāca
evam eva na saṃdehaḥ kasmān manyur abhūt tava
kṛttivāsā hy avāsāś ca śmaśānanilayaś ca ha //
meaning:
देव उवाच
एवम् एव न संदेहः कस्मान् मन्युर् अभूत् तव
कृत्तिवासा ह्य् अवासाश् च श्मशाननिलयश् च ह //
text_mt:
The god said:
It is just so, there is no doubt; why has anger arisen in you? / For I am clad in an animal skin, without garments, and my abode is the cremation ground;

sanskrit_iast:
aniketo hy araṇyeṣu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca
vicarāmi gaṇair nagnair vṛto 'mbhojavilocane //
meaning:
अनिकेतो ह्य् अरण्येषु पर्वतानां गुहासु च
विचरामि गणैर् नग्नैर् वृतो ऽम्भोजविलोचने //
text_mt: homeless indeed, in forests and in mountain caves / I wander, surrounded by naked attendants, O lotus-eyed lady.

sanskrit_iast:
mā krudho devi mātre tvaṃ tathyaṃ mātāvadat tava
nahi mātṛsamo bandhur jantūnām asti bhūtale //
meaning:
मा क्रुधो देवि मात्रे त्वं तथ्यं मातावदत् तव
नहि मातृसमो बन्धुर् जन्तूनाम् अस्ति भूतले //
text_mt: Do not be angry with your mother, O goddess; your mother spoke the truth. / For there is no relative equal to a mother for living creatures on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
devy uvāca
na me 'sti bandhubhiḥ kiṃcit kṛtyaṃ suravareśvara
tathā kuru mahādeva yathāhaṃ sukham āpnuyām //
meaning:
देव्य् उवाच
न मे ऽस्ति बन्धुभिः किंचित् कृत्यं सुरवरेश्वर
तथा कुरु महादेव यथाहं सुखम् आप्नुयाम् //
text_mt:
The goddess said:
I have nothing to do with relatives, O lord of the foremost gods! / Act in such a way, O Mahādeva, that I may find happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
śrutvā sa devyā vacanaṃ sureśas
tasyāḥ priyārthe svagiriṃ vihāya
jagāma meruṃ surasiddhasevitaṃ
bhāryāsahāyaḥ svagaṇaiś ca yuktaḥ
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
श्रुत्वा स देव्या वचनं सुरेशस्
तस्याः प्रियार्थे स्वगिरिं विहाय
जगाम मेरुं सुरसिद्धसेवितं
भार्यासहायः स्वगणैश् च युक्तः
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard the goddess's word, the lord of gods, / to please her, abandoned his own mountain / and went to Meru, frequented by gods and siddhas, / accompanied by his wife and joined by his own attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
prācetasasya dakṣasya kathaṃ vaivasvate 'ntare
vināśam agamad brahman hayamedhaḥ prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
प्राचेतसस्य दक्षस्य कथं वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे
विनाशम् अगमद् ब्रह्मन् हयमेधः प्रजापतेः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
How did the horse-sacrifice of Dakṣa, son of Pracetas, / the lord of creatures, meet with destruction during the Vaivasvata interval, O Brahmā?

sanskrit_iast:
devyā manyukṛtaṃ buddhvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ
kathaṃ vināśito yajño dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
mahādevena roṣād vai tan naḥ prabrūhi vistarāt //
meaning:
देव्या मन्युकृतं बुद्ध्वा क्रुद्धः सर्वात्मकः प्रभुः
कथं विनाशितो यज्ञो दक्षस्यामिततेजसः
महादेवेन रोषाद् वै तन् नः प्रब्रूहि विस्तरात् //
text_mt: Knowing that [the destruction] was brought about by the goddess's resentment, how was the sacrifice / of Dakṣa of immeasurable splendor destroyed in anger by Mahādeva, the all-pervading lord? / Tell us that in detail!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
varṇayiṣyāmi vo viprā mahādevena vai yathā
krodhād vidhvaṃsito yajño devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वर्णयिष्यामि वो विप्रा महादेवेन वै यथा
क्रोधाद् विध्वंसितो यज्ञो देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
I will describe to you, O brahmins, how indeed the sacrifice / was destroyed in anger by Mahādeva out of a desire to please the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
purā meror dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṅgaṃ trailokyapūjitam
jyotiḥsthalaṃ nāma citraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam //
meaning:
पुरा मेरोर् द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शृङ्गं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्
ज्योतिःस्थलं नाम चित्रं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् //
text_mt: Formerly, O best among the twice-born, on a peak of Meru worshipped by the three worlds, / known as Jyotiḥsthala, wondrous, adorned with all jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyam anādhṛṣyaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam
tatra devo giritaṭe sarvadhātuvicitrite //
meaning:
अप्रमेयम् अनाधृष्यं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्
तत्र देवो गिरितटे सर्वधातुविचित्रिते //
text_mt: immeasurable, unassailable, venerated by all the worlds, / there on the mountain slope variegated with all minerals,

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṅka iva vistīrṇa upaviṣṭo babhūva ha
śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṃ pārśvasthitābhavat //
meaning:
पर्यङ्क इव विस्तीर्ण उपविष्टो बभूव ह
शैलराजसुता चास्य नित्यं पार्श्वस्थिताभवत् //
text_mt: the god sat as if upon an expansive couch, / and the daughter of the mountain king was ever by his side.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityāś ca mahātmāno vasavaś ca mahaujasaḥ
tathaiva ca mahātmānāv aśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau //
meaning:
आदित्याश् च महात्मानो वसवश् च महौजसः
तथैव च महात्मानाव् अश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ //
text_mt: The great-souled Ādityas, the Vasus of mighty energy, / and likewise the great-souled Aśvins, best of physicians,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā guhyakaiḥ parivāritaḥ
yakṣāṇām īśvaraḥ śrīmān kailāsanilayaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
तथा वैश्रवणो राजा गुह्यकैः परिवारितः
यक्षाणाम् ईश्वरः श्रीमान् कैलासनिलयः प्रभुः //
text_mt: So too King Vaiśravaṇa, surrounded by Guhyakas, / the glorious lord of Yakṣas, the master residing on Kailāsa;

sanskrit_iast:
upāsate mahātmānam uśanā ca mahāmuniḥ
sanatkumārapramukhās tathaiva paramarṣayaḥ //
meaning:
उपासते महात्मानम् उशना च महामुनिः
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास् तथैव परमर्षयः //
text_mt: the great sage Uśanas attended upon the great-souled one, / and likewise the supreme sages headed by Sanatkumāra;

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgiraḥpramukhāś caiva tathā devarṣayo 'pi ca
viśvāvasuś ca gandharvas tathā nāradaparvatau //
meaning:
अङ्गिरःप्रमुखाश् चैव तथा देवर्षयो ऽपि च
विश्वावसुश् च गन्धर्वस् तथा नारदपर्वतौ //
text_mt: and the divine sages headed by Aṅgiras as well; / and the gandharva Viśvāvasu, and Nārada and Parvata;

sanskrit_iast:
apsarogaṇasaṃghāś ca samājagmur anekaśaḥ
vavau sukhaśivo vāyur nānāgandhavahaḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
अप्सरोगणसंघाश् च समाजग्मुर् अनेकशः
ववौ सुखशिवो वायुर् नानागन्धवहः शुचिः //
text_mt: and troops of apsarases arrived in large numbers. / A pleasant and auspicious wind blew, fragrant and pure;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvartukusumopetaḥ puṣpavanto 'bhavan drumāḥ
tathā vidyādharāḥ sādhyāḥ siddhāś caiva tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेतः पुष्पवन्तो ऽभवन् द्रुमाः
तथा विद्याधराः साध्याः सिद्धाश् चैव तपोधनाः //
text_mt: the trees bore blossoms, endowed with flowers of every season; / likewise the vidyādharas, sādhyas, and siddhas rich in ascetic power,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaṃ paśupatiṃ paryupāsata tatra vai
bhūtāni ca tathānyāni nānārūpadharāṇy atha //
meaning:
महादेवं पशुपतिं पर्युपासत तत्र वै
भूतानि च तथान्यानि नानारूपधराण्य् अथ //
text_mt: attended there upon Mahādeva, the lord of beasts; / and then other creatures assuming various forms;

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasāś ca mahāraudrāḥ piśācāś ca mahābalāḥ
bahurūpadharā dhṛṣṭā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
राक्षसाश् च महारौद्राः पिशाचाश् च महाबलाः
बहुरूपधरा धृष्टा नानाप्रहरणायुधाः //
text_mt: terrible rākṣasas and mighty piśācas, / assuming multiform shapes, bold, armed with diverse weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
devasyānucarās tatra tasthur vaiśvānaropamāḥ
nandīśvaraś ca bhagavān devasyānumate sthitaḥ //
meaning:
देवस्यानुचरास् तत्र तस्थुर् वैश्वानरोपमाः
नन्दीश्वरश् च भगवान् देवस्यानुमते स्थितः //
text_mt: attendants of the god, resembling blazing fire, stood there; / and the venerable Nandīśvara stood by the command of the god,

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya jvalitaṃ śūlaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā
gaṅgā ca saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthajalodbhavā //
meaning:
प्रगृह्य ज्वलितं शूलं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवा //
text_mt: holding a flaming trident that blazed with its own radiance; / and the Gaṅgā, the foremost of rivers, source of the waters of all holy sites,

sanskrit_iast:
paryupāsata taṃ devaṃ rūpiṇī dvijasattamāḥ
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃs tatra pūjyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
पर्युपासत तं देवं रूपिणी द्विजसत्तमाः
एवं स भगवांस् तत्र पूज्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः //
text_mt: attended upon that god in embodied form, O best of the twice-born. / Thus that blessed lord, being worshipped there by the divine sages

sanskrit_iast:
devaiś ca sumahābhāgair mahādevo vyatiṣṭhata
kasyacit tv atha kālasya dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
देवैश् च सुमहाभागैर् महादेवो व्यतिष्ठत
कस्यचित् त्व् अथ कालस्य दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: and by the most fortunate gods, Mahādeva remained. / Then, after some time, the prajāpati named Dakṣa

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktena vidhānena yakṣyamāṇo 'bhyapadyata
tatas tasya makhe devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन यक्ष्यमाणो ऽभ्यपद्यत
ततस् तस्य मखे देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: undertook to perform a sacrifice according to the previously stated rite. / Then all the gods, led by Śakra, to his sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
svargasthānād athāgamya dakṣam āpedire tathā
te vimānair mahātmāno jvaladbhir jvalanaprabhāḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्गस्थानाद् अथागम्य दक्षम् आपेदिरे तथा
ते विमानैर् महात्मानो ज्वलद्भिर् ज्वलनप्रभाः //
text_mt: having arrived from the abode of heaven, approached Dakṣa. / Those great-souled ones, radiant as blazing fire, in shining aerial chariots,

sanskrit_iast:
devasyānumate 'gacchan gaṅgādvāram iti śrutiḥ
gandharvāpsarasākīrṇaṃ nānādrumalatāvṛtam //
meaning:
देवस्यानुमते ऽगच्छन् गङ्गाद्वारम् इति श्रुतिः
गन्धर्वाप्सरसाकीर्णं नानाद्रुमलतावृतम् //
text_mt: went by the god’s command to Gaṅgādvāra, so it is heard, / which was crowded with gandharvas and apsarases, and filled with various trees and creepers.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣisiddhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ dakṣaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam
pṛthivyām antarikṣe ca ye ca svarlokavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिसिद्धैः परिवृतं दक्षं धर्मभृतां वरम्
पृथिव्याम् अन्तरिक्षे च ये च स्वर्लोकवासिनः //
text_mt: [They approached] Dakṣa, the best of the upholders of dharma, surrounded by sages and siddhas. / Those on earth and in the intermediate space, and those who dwell in the celestial world,

sanskrit_iast:
sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā upatasthuḥ prajāpatim
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāḥ sarve marudgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा उपतस्थुः प्रजापतिम्
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याः सर्वे मरुद्गणाः //
text_mt: all joined their hands in reverence and approached the prajāpati: / the ādityas, vasus, rudras, sādhyas, and all the host of maruts,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā sahitāḥ sarva āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ
ūṣmapā dhūmapāś caiva ājyapāḥ somapās tathā //
meaning:
विष्णुना सहिताः सर्व आगता यज्ञभागिनः
ऊष्मपा धूमपाश् चैव आज्यपाः सोमपास् तथा //
text_mt: all gathered together with Viṣṇu to receive their share of the sacrifice; / the Ūṣmapas and Dhūmapas, the Ājyapas and the Somapas,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvinau marutaś caiva nānādevagaṇaiḥ saha
ete cānye ca bahavo bhūtagrāmās tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अश्विनौ मरुतश् चैव नानादेवगणैः सह
एते चान्ये च बहवो भूतग्रामास् तथैव च //
text_mt: the Aśvins and the maruts along with various hosts of gods; / these and many other multitudes of living beings;

sanskrit_iast:
jarāyujāṇḍajāś caiva tathaiva svedajodbhidaḥ
āgatāḥ sattriṇaḥ sarve devāḥ strībhiḥ saharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
जरायुजाण्डजाश् चैव तथैव स्वेदजोद्भिदः
आगताः सत्त्रिणः सर्वे देवाः स्त्रीभिः सहर्षिभिः //
text_mt: the womb-born and the egg-born, and likewise the sweat-born and the sprout-born. / All the sacrificers arrived, the gods along with their wives and with sages.

sanskrit_iast:
virājante vimānasthā dīpyamānā ivāgnayaḥ
tān dṛṣṭvā manyunāviṣṭo dadhīcir vākyam abravīt //
meaning:
विराजन्ते विमानस्था दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः
तान् दृष्ट्वा मन्युनाविष्टो दधीचिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Seated in their aerial chariots, they shone like blazing fires. / Seeing them, Dadhīca, filled with anger, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcir uvāca
apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpy apūjane
naraḥ pāpam avāpnoti mahad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
दधीचिर् उवाच
अपूज्यपूजने चैव पूज्यानां चाप्य् अपूजने
नरः पापम् अवाप्नोति महद् वै नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / In worshipping what should not be worshipped, and in not worshipping the venerable, / a person incurs great sin indeed; there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā tu viprarṣiḥ punar dakṣam abhāṣata //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिः पुनर् दक्षम् अभाषत //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, the brahmarṣi addressed Dakṣa again:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcir uvāca
pūjyaṃ ca paśubhartāraṃ kasmān nārcayase prabhum //
meaning:
दधीचिर् उवाच
पूज्यं च पशुभर्तारं कस्मान् नार्चयसे प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / Why do you not worship the master, the venerable protector of creatures?

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca
santi me bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ
ekādaśasthānagatā nānyaṃ vidmo maheśvaram //
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच
सन्ति मे बहवो रुद्राः शूलहस्ताः कपर्दिनः
एकादशस्थानगता नान्यं विद्मो महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / There are many rudras for me, trident-bearers with matted hair, / assigned to eleven places; we know no other supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcir uvāca
sarveṣām ekamantro 'yaṃ mameśo na nimantritaḥ
yathāhaṃ śaṃkarād ūrdhvaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi daivatam
tathā dakṣasya vipulo yajño 'yaṃ na bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
दधीचिर् उवाच
सर्वेषाम् एकमन्त्रो ऽयं ममेशो न निमन्त्रितः
यथाहं शंकराद् ऊर्ध्वं नान्यं पश्यामि दैवतम्
तथा दक्षस्य विपुलो यज्ञो ऽयं न भविष्यति //
text_mt: Dadhīca said: / This single formula is for all; my Lord has not been invited. / Just as I see no deity higher than Śaṅkara, / so shall this vast sacrifice of Dakṣa not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣa uvāca dakṣa uvāca
viṣṇoś ca bhāgā vividhāḥ pradattās
tathā ca rudrebhya uta pradattāḥ
anye 'pi devā nijabhāgayuktā
dadāmi bhāgaṃ na tu śaṃkarāya
meaning:
दक्ष उवाच दक्ष उवाच
विष्णोश् च भागा विविधाः प्रदत्तास्
तथा च रुद्रेभ्य उत प्रदत्ताः
अन्ये ऽपि देवा निजभागयुक्ता
ददामि भागं न तु शंकराय
text_mt: Dakṣa said: / Diverse shares have been given to Viṣṇu, / and shares have likewise been given to the rudras; / other gods also are provided with their respective shares; / but to Śaṅkara I give no share.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
gatās tu devatā jñātvā śailarājasutā tadā
uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
गतास् तु देवता ज्ञात्वा शैलराजसुता तदा
उवाच वचनं शर्वं देवं पशुपतिं पतिम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Knowing that the deities had gone, the daughter of the mountain king then / spoke these words to Śarva, the god, the lord of creatures, her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
umovāca
bhagavan kutra yānty ete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahān ayam //
meaning:
उमोवाच
भगवन् कुत्र यान्त्य् एते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन तत्त्वज्ञ संशयो मे महान् अयम् //
text_mt: Umā said: / O Blessed One, where are these gods led by Śakra going? / Tell me truly, O knower of reality; this is a great doubt of mine.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca
dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patir uttamaḥ
hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच
दक्षो नाम महाभागे प्रजानां पतिर् उत्तमः
हयमेधेन यजते तत्र यान्ति दिवौकसः //
text_mt: Maheśvara said: / O most fortunate lady, the highest lord of creatures named Dakṣa / is performing a horse sacrifice; the dwellers of heaven are going there.

sanskrit_iast:
devy uvāca
yajñam etaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nānugacchasi
kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate //
meaning:
देव्य् उवाच
यज्ञम् एतं महाभाग किमर्थं नानुगच्छसि
केन वा प्रतिषेधेन गमनं ते न विद्यते //
text_mt: The goddess said: / O most fortunate one, why do you not attend this sacrifice? / Or by what exclusion is your going forbidden?

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca
surair eva mahābhāge sarvam etad anuṣṭhitam
yajñeṣu mama sarveṣu na bhāga upakalpitaḥ //
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच
सुरैर् एव महाभागे सर्वम् एतद् अनुष्ठितम्
यज्ञेषु मम सर्वेषु न भाग उपकल्पितः //
text_mt: Maheśvara said: / All this has been established by the gods themselves, O most fortunate lady; / in all sacrifices, no share has been allotted to me.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāgatena gantavyaṃ mārgeṇa varavarṇini
na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वागतेन गन्तव्यं मार्गेण वरवर्णिनि
न मे सुराः प्रयच्छन्ति भागं यज्ञस्य धर्मतः //
text_mt: One must go by the path established of old, O fair-complexioned lady; / the gods do not grant me a share of the sacrifice according to dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
umovāca
bhagavan sarvadeveṣu prabhāvābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ
ajeyaś cāpy adhṛṣyaś ca tejasā yaśasā śriyā //
meaning:
उमोवाच
भगवन् सर्वदेवेषु प्रभावाभ्यधिको गुणैः
अजेयश् चाप्य् अधृष्यश् च तेजसा यशसा श्रिया //
text_mt: Umā said: / O Blessed One, you surpass all gods in power and virtues; / you are unconquerable and unassailable in splendor, fame, and majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
anena tu mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ
atīva duḥkham āpannā vepathuś ca mahān ayam //
meaning:
अनेन तु महाभाग प्रतिषेधेन भागतः
अतीव दुःखम् आपन्ना वेपथुश् च महान् अयम् //
text_mt: Yet by this exclusion from the sacrificial share, O most fortunate one, / I have fallen into extreme grief, and this great trembling [has seized me].

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ nāma dānaṃ niyamaṃ tapo vā
kuryām ahaṃ yena patir mamādya
labheta bhāgaṃ bhagavān acintyo
yajñasya cendrādyamarair vicitram
meaning:
किं नाम दानं नियमं तपो वा
कुर्याम् अहं येन पतिर् ममाद्य
लभेत भागं भगवान् अचिन्त्यो
यज्ञस्य चेन्द्राद्यमरैर् विचित्रम्
text_mt: What gift, vow, or ascetic discipline / could I perform today so that my husband, / the blessed, inconceivable lord, may obtain / a splendid share of the sacrifice along with the immortals headed by Indra?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca maheśvara uvāca
ahaṃ vijānāmi viśālanetre
dhyānena sarve ca vidanti santaḥ
tavādya mohena sahendradevā
lokatrayaṃ sarvam atho vinaṣṭam
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच महेश्वर उवाच
अहं विजानामि विशालनेत्रे
ध्यानेन सर्वे च विदन्ति सन्तः
तवाद्य मोहेन सहेन्द्रदेवा
लोकत्रयं सर्वम् अथो विनष्टम्
text_mt:
I know, O wide-eyed lady;
and all virtuous people know through meditation.
Now, through your delusion, together with the gods led by Indra,
the entire triple world is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
mām adhvareśaṃ nitarāṃ stuvanti
rathaṃtaraṃ sāma gāyanti mahyam
māṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantrair yajanti
mamādhvaryavaḥ kalpayante ca bhāgam
meaning:
माम् अध्वरेशं नितरां स्तुवन्ति
रथंतरं साम गायन्ति मह्यम्
मां ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्ममन्त्रैर् यजन्ति
ममाध्वर्यवः कल्पयन्ते च भागम्
text_mt: They praise me above all as the lord of the sacrifice; / they sing the Rathaṃtara Sāman for me; / the brahmins sacrifice to me with the sacred formulas of Brahmā; / and the Adhvaryu priests assign a share to me.

sanskrit_iast:
devy uvāca
vikatthase prākṛtavat sarvastrījanasaṃsadi
stauṣi garvāyase cāpi svam ātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
देव्य् उवाच
विकत्थसे प्राकृतवत् सर्वस्त्रीजनसंसदि
स्तौषि गर्वायसे चापि स्वम् आत्मानं न संशयः //
text_mt: The goddess said: / You boast like an ordinary man in an assembly of women; / you praise and take pride in yourself, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavān uvāca
nātmānaṃ staumi deveśi yathā tvam anugacchasi
saṃsrakṣyāmi varārohe bhāgārthe varavarṇini //
meaning:
भगवान् उवाच
नात्मानं स्तौमि देवेशि यथा त्वम् अनुगच्छसि
संस्रक्ष्यामि वरारोहे भागार्थे वरवर्णिनि //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / I do not praise myself, O goddess of gods, as you assume; / I shall create [a being], O fair-hipped, fair-complexioned lady, for the sake of the share.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā bhagavān patnīm umāṃ prāṇair api priyām
so 'sṛjad bhagavān vaktrād bhūtaṃ krodhāgnisaṃbhavam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् पत्नीम् उमां प्राणैर् अपि प्रियाम्
सो ऽसृजद् भगवान् वक्त्राद् भूतं क्रोधाग्निसंभवम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus to his wife Umā, who was dearer to him than his own life-breaths, / the Blessed Lord brought forth from his mouth a being born from the fire of wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
tam uvāca makhaṃ gaccha dakṣasya tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ
nāśayāśu kratuṃ tasya dakṣasya madanujñayā //
meaning:
तम् उवाच मखं गच्छ दक्षस्य त्वं महेश्वरः
नाशयाशु क्रतुं तस्य दक्षस्य मदनुज्ञया //
text_mt: He, the supreme lord, said to him: 'Go to Dakṣa's sacrifice; / destroy quickly that sacrifice of Dakṣa by my command.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tato rudraprayuktena siṃhaveṣeṇa līlayā
devyā manyukṛtaṃ jñātvā hato dakṣasya sa kratuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो रुद्रप्रयुक्तेन सिंहवेषेण लीलया
देव्या मन्युकृतं ज्ञात्वा हतो दक्षस्य स क्रतुः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then, by that [being] dispatched by Rudra, in the guise of a lion, as if in sport, / knowing it was done out of the goddess's anger, that sacrifice of Dakṣa was destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
manyunā ca mahābhīmā bhadrakālī maheśvarī
ātmanaḥ karmasākṣitve tena sārdhaṃ sahānugā //
meaning:
मन्युना च महाभीमा भद्रकाली महेश्वरी
आत्मनः कर्मसाक्षित्वे तेन सार्धं सहानुगा //
text_mt: And from anger, the exceedingly dreadful Bhadrakālī, the supreme goddess, / went along with him together with her followers, to bear witness to her own deed.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eṣa bhagavān krodhaḥ pretāvāsakṛtālayaḥ
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto devyā manyupramārjakaḥ //
meaning:
स एष भगवान् क्रोधः प्रेतावासकृतालयः
वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जकः //
text_mt: This very Lord of Wrath, whose abode was made in the dwelling-place of the spirits, / known as Vīrabhadra, was the dispeller of the goddess's anger.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'sṛjad romakūpebhya ātmanaiva gaṇeśvarān
rudrānugān gaṇān raudrān rudravīryaparākramān //
meaning:
सो ऽसृजद् रोमकूपेभ्य आत्मनैव गणेश्वरान्
रुद्रानुगान् गणान् रौद्रान् रुद्रवीर्यपराक्रमान् //
text_mt: From his own hair-pores he created leaders of the troops: / fearsome hosts, followers of Rudra, having the power and prowess of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasyānucarāḥ sarve sarve rudraparākramāḥ
te nipetus tatas tūrṇaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रस्यानुचराः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रपराक्रमाः
ते निपेतुस् ततस् तूर्णं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः //
text_mt: All the attendants of Rudra, every one of them having the prowess of Rudra, / then swooped down swiftly by the hundreds and by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kilakilāśabda ākāśaṃ pūrayann iva
samabhūt sumahān viprāḥ sarvarudragaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाशं पूरयन्न् इव
समभूत् सुमहान् विप्राः सर्वरुद्रगणैः कृतः //
text_mt: Then a tumultuous roar, as if filling the sky, / arose, O Brahmins, raised by all the hosts of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tena śabdena mahatā trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ
parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta cakampe ca vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
तेन शब्देन महता त्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः
पर्वताश् च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुंधरा //
text_mt: Frightened by that great roar, all the sky-dwellers trembled; / mountains crumbled, and the earth shook.

sanskrit_iast:
marutaś ca vavuḥ krūrāś cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ
agnayo vai na dīpyante na cādīpyata bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
मरुतश् च ववुः क्रूराश् चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः
अग्नयो वै न दीप्यन्ते न चादीप्यत भास्करः //
text_mt: Fierce winds blew, and the abode of Varuṇa was agitated; / the fires indeed did not burn, nor did the sun shine.

sanskrit_iast:
grahā naiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na tārakāḥ
ṛṣayo na prabhāsante na devā na ca dānavāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहा नैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि न तारकाः
ऋषयो न प्रभासन्ते न देवा न च दानवाः //
text_mt: The planets did not shine at all, nor the constellations, nor the stars; / the ṛṣis did not radiant shine, nor the gods, nor the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi timirībhūte nirdahanti gaṇeśvarāḥ
prabhañjanty apare yūpān ghorān utpāṭayanti ca //
meaning:
एवं हि तिमिरीभूते निर्दहन्ति गणेश्वराः
प्रभञ्जन्त्य् अपरे यूपान् घोरान् उत्पाटयन्ति च //
text_mt: When darkness had thus fallen, the lords of the gaṇas burned everything down; / others shattered the sacrificial posts and uprooted the terrifying ones.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇadanti tathā cānye vikurvanti tathā pare
tvaritaṃ vai pradhāvanti vāyuvegā manojavāḥ //
meaning:
प्रणदन्ति तथा चान्ये विकुर्वन्ति तथा परे
त्वरितं वै प्रधावन्ति वायुवेगा मनोजवाः //
text_mt: And others roared loudly; still others assumed strange forms; / swift as the wind and swift as thought, they rushed forward at full speed.

sanskrit_iast:
cūrṇyante yajñapātrāṇi yajñasyāyatanāni ca
śīryamāṇāny adṛśyanta tārā iva nabhastalāt //
meaning:
चूर्ण्यन्ते यज्ञपात्राणि यज्ञस्यायतनानि च
शीर्यमाणान्य् अदृश्यन्त तारा इव नभस्तलात् //
text_mt: The sacrificial vessels and the shrines of the sacrifice were crushed; / being shattered, they were seen falling like stars from the vault of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
divyānnapānabhakṣyāṇāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ
kṣīranadyas tathā cānyā ghṛtapāyasakardamāḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यान्नपानभक्ष्याणां राशयः पर्वतोपमाः
क्षीरनद्यस् तथा चान्या घृतपायसकर्दमाः //
text_mt: There were heaps of divine foods, drinks, and edibles resembling mountains; / and other rivers of milk with mud of ghee and milk-rice pudding;

sanskrit_iast:
madhumaṇḍodakā divyāḥ khaṇḍaśarkaravālukāḥ
ṣaḍrasān nivahanty anyā guḍakulyā manoramāḥ //
meaning:
मधुमण्डोदका दिव्याः खण्डशर्करवालुकाः
षड्रसान् निवहन्त्य् अन्या गुडकुल्या मनोरमाः //
text_mt: divine waters of honey-scum, with sands of granulated sugar; / and other delightful streams of jaggery, carrying along the six flavors.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca
yāni kāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca //
meaning:
उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च
यानि कानि च दिव्यानि लेह्यचोष्याणि यानि च //
text_mt: Meats of all sorts, various kinds of foods, / whatever was divine, both licked and sucked—

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjanti vividhair vaktrair vilumpanti kṣipanti ca
rudrakopā mahākopāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ //
meaning:
भुञ्जन्ति विविधैर् वक्त्रैर् विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च
रुद्रकोपा महाकोपाः कालाग्निसदृशोपमाः //
text_mt: they devoured with various mouths, plundered, and flung about, / those [attendants] born of Rudra’s wrath, highly enraged, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayanto 'tha śailābhā bhīṣayantaś ca sarvataḥ
krīḍanti vividhākārāś cikṣipuḥ surayoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
भक्षयन्तो ऽथ शैलाभा भीषयन्तश् च सर्वतः
क्रीडन्ति विविधाकाराश् चिक्षिपुः सुरयोषितः //
text_mt: Devouring, mountain-like, terrifying [everyone] on all sides, / assuming diverse forms, they sported and tossed about the women of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gaṇāś ca tair yukto vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān
rudrakopaprayuktaś ca sarvadevaiḥ surakṣitam //
meaning:
एवं गणाश् च तैर् युक्तो वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान्
रुद्रकोपप्रयुक्तश् च सर्वदेवैः सुरक्षितम् //
text_mt: Thus the hosts, and accompanied by them the valorous Vīrabhadra, / dispatched by the wrath of Rudra, [attacked] that sacrifice well protected by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ yajñam adahac chīghraṃ bhadrakālyāḥ samīpataḥ
cakrur anye tathā nādān sarvabhūtabhayaṃkarān //
meaning:
तं यज्ञम् अदहच् छीघ्रं भद्रकाल्याः समीपतः
चक्रुर् अन्ये तथा नादान् सर्वभूतभयंकरान् //
text_mt: Quickly he burned that sacrifice near Bhadrakālī; / others likewise raised roars terrifying to all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
chittvā śiro 'nye yajñasya vyanadanta bhayaṃkaram
tataḥ śakrādayo devā dakṣaś caiva prajāpatiḥ
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kathyatāṃ ko bhavān iti //
meaning:
छित्त्वा शिरो ऽन्ये यज्ञस्य व्यनदन्त भयंकरम्
ततः शक्रादयो देवा दक्षश् चैव प्रजापतिः
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा कथ्यतां को भवान् इति //
text_mt: Cutting off the head of the Sacrifice, others roared frightfully. / Then the gods headed by Śakra, and Dakṣa the lord of creatures, / joining their hands in reverence, said: “Tell us, who are you?”

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadra uvāca
nāhaṃ devo na daityo vā na ca bhoktum ihāgataḥ
naiva draṣṭuṃ ca devendrā na ca kautūhalānvitāḥ //
meaning:
वीरभद्र उवाच
नाहं देवो न दैत्यो वा न च भोक्तुम् इहागतः
नैव द्रष्टुं च देवेन्द्रा न च कौतूहलान्विताः //
text_mt: Vīrabhadra said: / “I am neither a god nor a Daitya, nor have I come here to eat, / nor to see, O lords of gods, nor out of curiosity.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣayajñavināśārthaṃ saṃprāpto 'haṃ surottamāḥ
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto rudrakopād viniḥsṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षयज्ञविनाशार्थं संप्राप्तो ऽहं सुरोत्तमाः
वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो रुद्रकोपाद् विनिःसृतः //
text_mt: I have arrived to destroy the sacrifice of Dakṣa, O best of gods! / Known as Vīrabhadra, I have sprung from the wrath of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakālī ca vikhyātā devyāḥ krodhād vinirgatā
preṣitā devadevena yajñāntikam upāgatā //
meaning:
भद्रकाली च विख्याता देव्याः क्रोधाद् विनिर्गता
प्रेषिता देवदेवेन यज्ञान्तिकम् उपागता //
text_mt: And she is known as Bhadrakālī, issued from the anger of the goddess; / sent by the god of gods, she has come near the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ gaccha rājendra devadevam umāpatim
varaṃ krodho 'pi devasya na varaḥ paricārakaiḥ //
meaning:
शरणं गच्छ राजेन्द्र देवदेवम् उमापतिम्
वरं क्रोधो ऽपि देवस्य न वरः परिचारकैः //
text_mt: Seek refuge, O king of kings, with the god of gods, the lord of Umā! / Even the wrath of the god is a blessing; not so [the favor] of his servants.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
nikhātotpāṭitair yūpair apaviddhais tatas tataḥ
utpatadbhiḥ patadbhiś ca gṛdhrair āmiṣagṛdhnubhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
निखातोत्पाटितैर् यूपैर् अपविद्धैस् ततस् ततः
उत्पतद्भिः पतद्भिश् च गृध्रैर् आमिषगृध्नुभिः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / “With its sacrificial posts driven down, uprooted, and scattered here and there, / with vultures greedy for flesh flying up and swooping down,

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣavātavinirdhūtaiḥ śivārutavināditaiḥ
sa tasya yajño nṛpater bādhyamānas tadā gaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
पक्षवातविनिर्धूतैः शिवारुतविनादितैः
स तस्य यज्ञो नृपतेर् बाध्यमानस् तदा गणैः //
text_mt: buffeted by the wind of their wings, echoing with the howls of jackals, / that sacrifice of the king, being assaulted then by the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai kham evābhyapatat tadā
taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantam upalabhya saḥ //
meaning:
आस्थाय मृगरूपं वै खम् एवाभ्यपतत् तदा
तं तु यज्ञं तथारूपं गच्छन्तम् उपलभ्य सः //
text_mt: assuming the form of a deer, flew right up into the sky. / But perceiving that sacrifice fleeing in such a form, he,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanur ādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadartham agamat prabhuḥ
tatas tasya gaṇeśasya krodhād amitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
धनुर् आदाय बाणं च तदर्थम् अगमत् प्रभुः
ततस् तस्य गणेशस्य क्रोधाद् अमिततेजसः //
