किं कार्यं बहुभिर् मन्त्रैर् मनोविभ्रमकारकैः
ओं नमो नारायणायेति मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः //
text_mt:
What need is there for many mantras that cause mental confusion?
The mantra 'Oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya' accomplishes all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo narasya sūnutvān nārā itīha kīrtitāḥ
viṣṇos tās tv ayanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आपो नरस्य सूनुत्वान् नारा इतीह कीर्तिताः
विष्णोस् तास् त्व् अयनं पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
The waters, being the offspring of Nara, are called 'nārāḥ' here [in this world];
they were formerly the resting place (ayana) of Viṣṇu, hence he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā dvijāḥ
nārāyaṇaparā yajñā nārāyaṇaparāḥ kriyāḥ //
meaning:
नारायणपरा वेदा नारायणपरा द्विजाः
नारायणपरा यज्ञा नारायणपराः क्रियाः //
text_mt:
The Vedas are dedicated to Nārāyaṇa; the twice-born are dedicated to Nārāyaṇa;
sacrifices are dedicated to Nārāyaṇa; ritual acts are dedicated to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaparā pṛthvī nārāyaṇaparaṃ jalam
nārāyaṇaparo vahnir nārāyaṇaparaṃ nabhaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणपरा पृथ्वी नारायणपरं जलम्
नारायणपरो वह्निर् नारायणपरं नभः //
text_mt:
The earth is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa; the water is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa;
fire is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa; the sky is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaparo vāyur nārāyaṇaparaṃ manaḥ
ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca ubhe nārāyaṇātmake //
meaning:
नारायणपरो वायुर् नारायणपरं मनः
अहंकारश् च बुद्धिश् च उभे नारायणात्मके //
text_mt:
The wind is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa; the mind is dedicated to Nārāyaṇa;
both the ego-principle and the intellect-principle are of the nature of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñitam
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam //
meaning:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञितम्
स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चैव सर्वं नारायणात्मकम् //
text_mt:
Past, present, and future, and whatever is called living,
gross, subtle, and supreme—all is of the nature of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdādyā viṣayāḥ sarve śrotrādīnīndriyāṇi ca
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaś caiva sarve nārāyaṇātmakāḥ //
meaning:
शब्दाद्या विषयाः सर्वे श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाणि च
प्रकृतिः पुरुषश् चैव सर्वे नारायणात्मकाः //
text_mt:
All sense objects such as sound, all sense faculties such as hearing,
primordial nature (prakṛti) and the puruṣa—all are of the nature of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jale sthale ca pātāle svargaloke 'mbare nage
avaṣṭabhya idaṃ sarvam āste nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
जले स्थले च पाताले स्वर्गलोके ऽम्बरे नगे
अवष्टभ्य इदं सर्वम् आस्ते नारायणः प्रभुः //
text_mt:
In water, on land, in the netherworld, in heaven, in the sky, on a mountain—
the Lord Nārāyaṇa abides, pervading all this.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena jagad etac carācaram
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam //
meaning:
किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन जगद् एतच् चराचरम्
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं नारायणात्मकम् //
text_mt:
Moreover, what need is there to say much here? This entire moving and unmoving world,
from Brahmā down to a blade of grass, is of the nature of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇāt paraṃ kiṃcin neha paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ
tena vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ carācaram //
meaning:
नारायणात् परं किंचिन् नेह पश्यामि भो द्विजाः
तेन व्याप्तम् इदं सर्वं दृश्यादृश्यं चराचरम् //
text_mt:
I see nothing higher than Nārāyaṇa here, O twice-born ones;
by him all this is pervaded—visible and invisible, moving and unmoving.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo hy āyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa ca evāmbhasāṃ patiḥ
tasmād apsu smaren nityaṃ nārāyaṇam aghāpaham //
meaning:
आपो ह्य् आयतनं विष्णोः स च एवाम्भसां पतिः
तस्माद् अप्सु स्मरेन् नित्यं नारायणम् अघापहम् //
text_mt:
For the waters are the abode of Viṣṇu, and he indeed is the lord of the waters;
therefore, in water, one should always remember Nārāyaṇa, the remover of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
snānakāle viśeṣeṇa copasthāya jale śuciḥ
smaren nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyed dhaste kāye ca vinyaset //
meaning:
स्नानकाले विशेषेण चोपस्थाय जले शुचिः
स्मरेन् नारायणं ध्यायेद् धस्ते काये च विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
Especially at the time of bathing, standing in water, pure,
one should remember Nārāyaṇa, meditate on him, and place [his mantra] on the hand and body.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca aṅguṣṭhe hastayor nyaset
śeṣair hastatalaṃ yāvat tarjanyādiṣu vinyaset //
meaning:
ओंकारं च नकारं च अङ्गुष्ठे हस्तयोर् न्यसेत्
शेषैर् हस्ततलं यावत् तर्जन्यादिषु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
One should place the syllable 'Oṃ' and the syllable 'na' on the thumb of both hands,
and the remaining [syllables] on the forefinger and other [fingers] up to the palm of the hand.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkāraṃ vāmapāde tu nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset
mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ tu nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset //
meaning:
ओंकारं वामपादे तु नकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत्
मोकारं वामकट्यां तु नाकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् //
text_mt:
One should place the syllable 'oṃ' on the left foot, and the syllable 'na' on the right;
the syllable 'mo' on the left waist, and the syllable 'nā' on the right;

sanskrit_iast:
rākāraṃ nābhideśe tu yakāraṃ vāmabāhuke
ṇākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyaset //
meaning:
राकारं नाभिदेशे तु यकारं वामबाहुके
णाकारं दक्षिणे न्यस्य यकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
the syllable 'rā' in the region of the navel, and the syllable 'ya' on the left arm;
having placed the syllable 'ṇa' on the right, one should place the syllable 'ya' on the head.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaś cordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'grataḥ
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ paścād ārabhet kavacaṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
अधश् चोर्ध्वं च हृदये पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतो ऽग्रतः
ध्यात्वा नारायणं पश्चाद् आरभेत् कवचं बुधः //
text_mt:
Below, above, in the heart, on the sides, behind, and in front—
having meditated on Nārāyaṇa, the wise person should then begin the protective armor (kavaca):

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve māṃ pātu govindo dakṣiṇe madhusūdanaḥ
paścime śrīdharo devaḥ keśavas tu tathottare //
meaning:
पूर्वे मां पातु गोविन्दो दक्षिणे मधुसूदनः
पश्चिमे श्रीधरो देवः केशवस् तु तथोत्तरे //
text_mt:
"May Govinda protect me in the east; Madhusūdana in the south;
the divine Śrīdhara in the west; and Keśava in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
pātu viṣṇus tathāgneye nairṛte mādhavo 'vyayaḥ
vāyavye tu hṛṣīkeśas tatheśāne ca vāmanaḥ //
meaning:
पातु विष्णुस् तथाग्नेये नैरृते माधवो ऽव्ययः
वायव्ये तु हृषीकेशस् तथेशाने च वामनः //
text_mt:
May Viṣṇu likewise protect [me] in the south-east; the imperishable Mādhava in the south-west;
Hṛṣīkeśa in the north-west; and Vāmana in the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtale pātu vārāhas tathordhvaṃ ca trivikramaḥ
kṛtvaivaṃ kavacaṃ paścād ātmānaṃ cintayet tataḥ //
meaning:
भूतले पातु वाराहस् तथोर्ध्वं च त्रिविक्रमः
कृत्वैवं कवचं पश्चाद् आत्मानं चिन्तयेत् ततः //
text_mt:
May Vārāha protect on the surface of the earth, and Trivikrama above."
Having made this armor, one should then meditate upon oneself:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
evaṃ dhyātvā tadātmānam imaṃ mantram udīrayet //
meaning:
अहं नारायणो देवः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
एवं ध्यात्वा तदात्मानम् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत् //
text_mt:
"I am the divine Nārāyaṇa, holding the conch, discus, and mace."
Having meditated on oneself as him in this way, one should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
tvam agnir dvipadāṃ nātha retodhāḥ kāmadīpanaḥ
pradhānaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ prabhur avyayaḥ //
meaning:
त्वम् अग्निर् द्विपदां नाथ रेतोधाः कामदीपनः
प्रधानः सर्वभूतानां जीवानां प्रभुर् अव्ययः //
text_mt:
"You are the fire, O lord of two-footed beings, the placer of seed, the kindler of desire,
the foremost of all beings, the imperishable lord of the living.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtasyāraṇis tvaṃ hi devayonir apāṃ pate
vṛjinaṃ hara me sarvaṃ tīrtharāja namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अमृतस्यारणिस् त्वं हि देवयोनिर् अपां पते
वृजिनं हर मे सर्वं तीर्थराज नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
For you are the fire-stick of nectar, the source of the gods, O lord of waters;
remove all my distress; O king of sacred places, homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
evam uccārya vidhivat tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret
anyathā bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snānaṃ tatra na śasyate //
meaning:
एवम् उच्चार्य विधिवत् ततः स्नानं समाचरेत्
अन्यथा भो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः स्नानं तत्र न शस्यते //
text_mt:
Having recited thus according to rule, one should then perform the bath;
otherwise, O best of twice-born ones, bathing there is not commended.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu vaidikair mantrair abhiṣekaṃ ca mārjanam
antar jale japet paścāt trir āvṛttyāghamarṣaṇam //
meaning:
कृत्वा तु वैदिकैर् मन्त्रैर् अभिषेकं च मार्जनम्
अन्तर् जले जपेत् पश्चात् त्रिर् आवृत्त्याघमर्षणम् //
text_mt:
Having performed the consecration and sprinkling with Vedic mantras,
one should then mutter the Aghamarṣaṇa [hymn] three times underwater.

sanskrit_iast:
hayamedho yathā viprāḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ kratuḥ
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cātra sūktaṃ sarvāghanāśanam //
meaning:
हयमेधो यथा विप्राः सर्वपापहरः क्रतुः
तथाघमर्षणं चात्र सूक्तं सर्वाघनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Just as the horse sacrifice is the rite that removes all sins, O twice-born ones,
so here the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
uttīrya vāsasī dhaute nirmale paridhāya vai
prāṇān āyamya cācamya saṃdhyāṃ copāsya bhāskaram //
meaning:
उत्तीर्य वाससी धौते निर्मले परिधाय वै
प्राणान् आयम्य चाचम्य संध्यां चोपास्य भास्करम् //
text_mt:
Having emerged [from the water], having put on two washed, clean garments,
having restrained the breaths and sipped water, and having attended to the dawn/dusk ritual for the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhet tataś cordhvaṃ kṣiptvā puṣpajalāñjalim
upasthāyordhvabāhuś ca talliṅgair bhāskaraṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
उपतिष्ठेत् ततश् चोर्ध्वं क्षिप्त्वा पुष्पजलाञ्जलिम्
उपस्थायोर्ध्वबाहुश् च तल्लिङ्गैर् भास्करं ततः //
text_mt:
one should then stand facing upward, having offered a handful of flowers and water,
and having stood facing the sun with raised arms, [worship him] with mantras addressed to him.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam
anyāṃś ca sauramantrāṃś ca japtvā tiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
गायत्रीं पावनीं देवीं जपेद् अष्टोत्तरं शतम्
अन्यांश् च सौरमन्त्रांश् च जप्त्वा तिष्ठन् समाहितः //
text_mt:
One should mutter the purifying goddess Gāyatrī a hundred and eight times;
and having muttered other solar mantras, standing concentrated,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sūryaṃ namaskṛtyopaviśya ca
svādhyāyaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtvā tarpayed daivatāny ṛṣīn //
meaning:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं सूर्यं नमस्कृत्योपविश्य च
स्वाध्यायं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा तर्पयेद् दैवतान्य् ऋषीन् //
text_mt:
having circumambulated the sun, bowed to him, and sat down,
having performed one's daily Vedic recitation facing east, one should offer water to the deities and sages,

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝṃś cānyān nāmagotreṇa mantravit
toyena tilamiśreṇa vidhivat susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
मनुष्यांश् च पितॄंश् चान्यान् नामगोत्रेण मन्त्रवित्
तोयेन तिलमिश्रेण विधिवत् सुसमाहितः //
text_mt:
and to human beings and ancestors and others, by name and gotra, knowing the mantras,
with water mixed with sesame seeds, properly and well-composed.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūrvaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ
adhikārī bhavet paścāt pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe dvijaḥ //
meaning:
तर्पणं देवतानां च पूर्वं कृत्वा समाहितः
अधिकारी भवेत् पश्चात् पितॄणां तर्पणे द्विजः //
text_mt:
Having first offered water to the deities with concentration,
the twice-born person becomes qualified thereafter for the water-offering to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe havanakāle ca pāṇinaikena nirvapet
tarpaṇe tūbhayaṃ kuryād eṣa eva vidhiḥ sadā //
meaning:
श्राद्धे हवनकाले च पाणिनैकेन निर्वपेत्
तर्पणे तूभयं कुर्याद् एष एव विधिः सदा //
text_mt:
At an ancestral offering (śrāddha) and at the time of offering oblations into fire, one should offer with one hand;
but in a water-offering (tarpaṇa), one should use both hands—this is the eternal rule.

sanskrit_iast:
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu
tṛpyatām iti siñcet tu nāmagotreṇa vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
अन्वारब्धेन सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु
तृप्यताम् इति सिञ्चेत् तु नामगोत्रेण वाग्यतः //
text_mt:
With the right hand supported by the left hand,
one should pour out [water], saying 'may [they] be pleased', with name and gotra, keeping silence.

sanskrit_iast:
kāyasthair yas tilair mohāt karoti pitṛtarpaṇam
tarpitās tena pitaras tvaṅmāṃsarudhirāsthibhiḥ //
meaning:
कायस्थैर् यस् तिलैर् मोहात् करोति पितृतर्पणम्
तर्पितास् तेन पितरस् त्वङ्मांसरुधिरास्थिभिः //
text_mt:
He who out of delusion makes the ancestral offering with sesame seeds placed on his body—
by him the ancestors are satiated with skin, flesh, blood, and bones.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgasthair na tilaiḥ kuryād devatāpitṛtarpaṇam
rudhiraṃ tad bhavet toyaṃ pradātā kilbiṣī bhavet //
meaning:
अङ्गस्थैर् न तिलैः कुर्याद् देवतापितृतर्पणम्
रुधिरं तद् भवेत् तोयं प्रदाता किल्बिषी भवेत् //
text_mt:
One should not perform the water-offering to deities and ancestors with sesame seeds resting on the body;
that water becomes blood, and the giver incurs sin.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmyāṃ yad dīyate toyaṃ dātā caiva jale sthitaḥ
vṛthā tan muniśārdūlā nopatiṣṭhati kasyacit //
meaning:
भूम्यां यद् दीयते तोयं दाता चैव जले स्थितः
वृथा तन् मुनिशार्दूला नोपतिष्ठति कस्यचित् //
text_mt:
When water is offered on dry ground while the giver stands in water,
that is in vain, O tigers among sages; it does not reach anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
sthale sthitvā jale yas tu prayacched udakaṃ naraḥ
pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭheta salilaṃ tan nirarthakam //
meaning:
स्थले स्थित्वा जले यस् तु प्रयच्छेद् उदकं नरः
पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठेत सलिलं तन् निरर्थकम् //
text_mt:
A man who stands on dry ground and offers water into the water—
that water does not reach the ancestors; it is useless.

sanskrit_iast:
udake nodakaṃ kuryāt pitṛbhyaś ca kadācana
uttīrya tu śucau deśe kuryād udakatarpaṇam //
meaning:
उदके नोदकं कुर्यात् पितृभ्यश् च कदाचन
उत्तीर्य तु शुचौ देशे कुर्याद् उदकतर्पणम् //
text_mt:
One should never make a water-offering to the ancestors in water;
having stepped out [of the water], onto pure ground, one should make the water-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
nodakeṣu na pātreṣu na kruddho naikapāṇinā
nopatiṣṭhati tat toyaṃ yad bhūmyāṃ na pradīyate //
meaning:
नोदकेषु न पात्रेषु न क्रुद्धो नैकपाणिना
नोपतिष्ठति तत् तोयं यद् भूम्यां न प्रदीयते //
text_mt:
Neither in waters, nor in vessels, nor when angry, nor with a single hand—
that water which is not offered on the ground does not reach [the ancestors].

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇām akṣayaṃ sthānaṃ mahī dattā mayā dvijāḥ
tasmāt tatraiva dātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītim icchatā //
meaning:
पितॄणाम् अक्षयं स्थानं मही दत्ता मया द्विजाः
तस्मात् तत्रैव दातव्यं पितॄणां प्रीतिम् इच्छता //
text_mt:
The earth has been given by me as an imperishable abode for the ancestors, O twice-born ones;
therefore, it should be given only there by one desiring the satisfaction of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmipṛṣṭhe samutpannā bhūmyāṃ caiva ca saṃsthitāḥ
bhūmyāṃ caiva layaṃ yātā bhūmau dadyāt tato jalam //
meaning:
भूमिपृष्ठे समुत्पन्ना भूम्यां चैव च संस्थिताः
भूम्यां चैव लयं याता भूमौ दद्यात् ततो जलम् //
text_mt: [The ancestors] are born on the surface of the earth, dwell on the earth, / and dissolve into the earth; therefore, one should offer the water on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
āstīrya ca kuśān sāgrāṃs tān āvāhya svamantrataḥ
prācīnāgreṣu vai devān yāmyāgreṣu tathā pitṝn //
meaning:
आस्तीर्य च कुशान् साग्रांस् तान् आवाह्य स्वमन्त्रतः
प्राचीनाग्रेषु वै देवान् याम्याग्रेषु तथा पितॄन् //
text_mt: And spreading out kuśa grass with the tips intact, having invoked them with their respective mantras: / the gods upon those with tips pointing eastward, and likewise the ancestors upon those with tips pointing southward.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
devān pitṝṃs tathā cānyān saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ
hastamātraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
देवान् पितॄंस् तथा चान्यान् संतर्प्याचम्य वाग्यतः
हस्तमात्रं चतुष्कोणं चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having satiated the gods, ancestors, and others, having sipped water, restrained in speech, / [one should draw] a beautiful square four-portal city, one cubit in measure,

sanskrit_iast:
puraṃ vilikhya bho viprās tīre tasya mahodadheḥ
madhye tatra likhet padmam aṣṭapattraṃ sakarṇikam //
meaning:
पुरं विलिख्य भो विप्रास् तीरे तस्य महोदधेः
मध्ये तत्र लिखेत् पद्मम् अष्टपत्त्रं सकर्णिकम् //
text_mt: having drawn it, O brahmins, on the shore of that great ocean; / there in the center one should draw an eight-petaled lotus with a pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ maṇḍalam ālikhya pūjayet tatra bho dvijāḥ
aṣṭākṣaravidhānena nārāyaṇam ajaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
एवं मण्डलम् आलिख्य पूजयेत् तत्र भो द्विजाः
अष्टाक्षरविधानेन नारायणम् अजं विभुम् //
text_mt: Having thus drawn the maṇḍala, one should worship there, O twice-born, / through the rite of the eight-syllable [mantra], the unborn, all-pervading Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāyaśodhanam uttamam
akāraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā cakrarekhāsamanvitam //
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कायशोधनम् उत्तमम्
अकारं हृदये ध्यात्वा चक्ररेखासमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Next, I shall explain the supreme purification of the body: / meditating in the heart upon the letter 'a', endowed with the line of a discus,

sanskrit_iast:
jvalantaṃ triśikhaṃ caiva dahantaṃ pāpanāśanam
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rākāraṃ mūrdhni cintayet //
meaning:
ज्वलन्तं त्रिशिखं चैव दहन्तं पापनाशनम्
चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं राकारं मूर्ध्नि चिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: blazing, three-crested, burning, destroying sin; / one should contemplate the letter 'ra' upon the head, situated within the orb of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavarṇaṃ pravarṣantam amṛtaṃ plāvayan mahīm
evaṃ nirdhūtapāpas tu divyadehas tato bhavet //
meaning:
शुक्लवर्णं प्रवर्षन्तम् अमृतं प्लावयन् महीम्
एवं निर्धूतपापस् तु दिव्यदेहस् ततो भवेत् //
text_mt: white-colored, showering nectar, flooding the earth. / Having thus washed away his sins, one then becomes possessed of a divine body.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ nyased evātmano budhaḥ
vāmapādaṃ samārabhya kramaśaś caiva vinyaset //
meaning:
अष्टाक्षरं ततो मन्त्रं न्यसेद् एवात्मनो बुधः
वामपादं समारभ्य क्रमशश् चैव विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: The wise man should then impose the eight-syllable mantra upon himself; / beginning from the left foot, he should deposit it in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva caturvyūhaṃ tathaiva ca
karaśuddhiṃ prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गं वैष्णवं चैव चतुर्व्यूहं तथैव च
करशुद्धिं प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण साधकः //
text_mt: The five-limbed [nyāsa], that of Viṣṇu, and likewise that of the four emanations: / the practitioner should perform the purification of hands with the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ caiva varṇaṃ tu aṅgulīṣu pṛthak pṛthak
oṃkāraṃ pṛthivīṃ śuklāṃ vāmapāde tu vinyaset //
meaning:
एकैकं चैव वर्णं तु अङ्गुलीषु पृथक् पृथक्
ओंकारं पृथिवीं शुक्लां वामपादे तु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: One letter at a time, separately on the fingers: / one should place the syllable 'oṃ', [representing] the white earth, on the left foot;

sanskrit_iast:
nakāraḥ śāṃbhavaḥ śyāmo dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitaḥ
mokāraṃ kālam evāhur vāmakaṭyāṃ nidhāpayet //
meaning:
नकारः शांभवः श्यामो दक्षिणे तु व्यवस्थितः
मोकारं कालम् एवाहुर् वामकट्यां निधापयेत् //
text_mt: the syllable 'na', connected with Śambhu, dark, is placed on the right [foot]; / they say the syllable 'mo' is time: one should place it on the left hip;

sanskrit_iast:
nākāraḥ sarvabījaṃ tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ
rākāras teja ity āhur nābhideśe vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
नाकारः सर्वबीजं तु दक्षिणस्यां व्यवस्थितः
राकारस् तेज इत्य् आहुर् नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: the syllable 'nā', the universal seed, is situated on the right [hip]; / they say the syllable 'rā' is fire: it is situated in the region of the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyo 'yaṃ yakāras tu vāmaskandhe samāśritaḥ
ṇākāraḥ sarvago jñeyo dakṣiṇāṃse vyavasthitaḥ
yakāro 'yaṃ śirasthaś ca yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
वायव्यो ऽयं यकारस् तु वामस्कन्धे समाश्रितः
णाकारः सर्वगो ज्ञेयो दक्षिणांसे व्यवस्थितः
यकारो ऽयं शिरस्थश् च यत्र लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः //
text_mt: this syllable 'ya' belongs to the wind and rests on the left shoulder; / the syllable 'ṇa' is known as all-pervading and is placed on the right shoulder; / and this syllable 'ya' rests on the head, where the worlds are established.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ śiraḥ oṃ jvalanāya namaḥ śikhā | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ kavacam oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ sphuraṇaṃ diśobandhāya | oṃ huṃphaḍastram oṃ śirasi śuklo vāsudeva iti | oṃ āṃ lalāṭe raktaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo garutmān vahnis teja āditya iti | oṃ āṃ grīvāyāṃ pītaḥ pradyumno vāyumegha iti | oṃ āṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo 'niruddhaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvita iti | evaṃ caturvyūham ātmānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma samācaret ||
meaning: ओं विष्णवे नमः शिरः ओं ज्वलनाय नमः शिखा | ओं विष्णवे नमः कवचम् ओं विष्णवे नमः स्फुरणं दिशोबन्धाय | ओं हुंफडस्त्रम् ओं शिरसि शुक्लो वासुदेव इति | ओं आं ललाटे रक्तः संकर्षणो गरुत्मान् वह्निस् तेज आदित्य इति | ओं आं ग्रीवायां पीतः प्रद्युम्नो वायुमेघ इति | ओं आं हृदये कृष्णो ऽनिरुद्धः सर्वशक्तिसमन्वित इति | एवं चतुर्व्यूहम् आत्मानं कृत्वा ततः कर्म समाचरेत् ||
text_mt: 'Oṃ, obeisance to Viṣṇu', the head; 'Oṃ, obeisance to the blazing one', the crest; 'Oṃ, obeisance to Viṣṇu', the armor; 'Oṃ, obeisance to Viṣṇu', the flash for binding the directions; 'Oṃ huṃ phaṭ', the weapon; 'Oṃ, white Vāsudeva on the head'; 'Oṃ āṃ, red Saṃkarṣaṇa on the forehead, Garuḍa, fire, splendor, the sun'; 'Oṃ āṃ, yellow Pradyumna at the throat, wind, cloud'; 'Oṃ āṃ, black Aniruddha in the heart, endowed with all powers'. Having thus made himself into the four emanations, he should then undertake the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāgre 'vasthito viṣṇuḥ pṛṣṭhataś cāpi keśavaḥ
govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme tu madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
ममाग्रे ऽवस्थितो विष्णुः पृष्ठतश् चापि केशवः
गोविन्दो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे तु मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Viṣṇu stands before me, and Keśava behind; / Govinda is at my right side, and Madhusūdana at my left;

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāt tu vaikuṇṭho vārāhaḥ pṛthivītale
avāntaradiśo yās tu tāsu sarvāsu mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
उपरिष्टात् तु वैकुण्ठो वाराहः पृथिवीतले
अवान्तरदिशो यास् तु तासु सर्वासु माधवः //
text_mt: Vaikuṇṭha is above, the Boar is on the surface of the earth; / and Mādhava is present in all the intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato 'pi vā
narasiṃhakṛtā guptir vāsudevamayo hy aham //
meaning:
गच्छतस् तिष्ठतो वापि जाग्रतः स्वपतो ऽपि वा
नरसिंहकृता गुप्तिर् वासुदेवमयो ह्य् अहम् //
text_mt: Whether walking or standing, waking or sleeping, / protection is made by Narasiṃha; indeed, I consist of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet
yathā dehe tathā deve sarvatattvāni yojayet //
meaning:
एवं विष्णुमयो भूत्वा ततः कर्म समारभेत्
यथा देहे तथा देवे सर्वतत्त्वानि योजयेत् //
text_mt: Having thus become composed of Viṣṇu, one should then begin the rite: / as in the body, so in the deity one should join all the principles of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
tataś caiva prakurvīta prokṣaṇaṃ praṇavena tu
phaṭkārāntaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvavighnaharaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ततश् चैव प्रकुर्वीत प्रोक्षणं प्रणवेन तु
फट्कारान्तं समुद्दिष्टं सर्वविघ्नहरं शुभम् //
text_mt: And then one should perform sprinkling with the praṇava, / taught as ending with the sound 'phaṭ', which removes all obstacles and is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayet
padmamadhye nyased viṣṇuṃ pavanasyāmbarasya ca //
meaning:
तत्रार्कचन्द्रवह्नीनां मण्डलानि विचिन्तयेत्
पद्ममध्ये न्यसेद् विष्णुं पवनस्याम्बरस्य च //
text_mt: There one should contemplate the orbs of the sun, moon, and fire; / in the center of the lotus one should place Viṣṇu, and those of the wind and space.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vicintya hṛdaya oṃkāraṃ jyotīrūpiṇam
karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
ततो विचिन्त्य हृदय ओंकारं ज्योतीरूपिणम्
कर्णिकायां समासीनं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् //
text_mt: Then having contemplated in the heart the syllable 'oṃ', whose form is light, / seated in the pericarp, the eternal one whose form is light,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ vinyasec ca yathākramam
tena vyastasamastena pūjanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
अष्टाक्षरं ततो मन्त्रं विन्यसेच् च यथाक्रमम्
तेन व्यस्तसमस्तेन पूजनं परमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: one should then deposit the eight-syllable mantra in proper order; / worship done with it, divided and combined, is recorded as supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa yajed devaṃ sanātanam
tato 'vadhārya hṛdaye karṇikāyāṃ bahir nyaset //
meaning:
द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्रेण यजेद् देवं सनातनम्
ततो ऽवधार्य हृदये कर्णिकायां बहिर् न्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should worship the eternal deity with the twelve-syllable mantra; / then, having grasped him in the heart, one should place him externally on the pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaṃ mahāsattvaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham
cintayitvā mahāyogaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam
tataś cāvāhayen mantraṃ krameṇācintya mānase //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजं महासत्त्वं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्
चिन्तयित्वा महायोगं ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम्
ततश् चावाहयेन् मन्त्रं क्रमेणाचिन्त्य मानसे //
text_mt: Having contemplated the four-armed one of great being, equal in radiance to ten million suns, / of great yoga, the eternal one whose form is light, / one should then invoke the mantra in the mind, meditating [upon him] in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanamantraḥ: mīnarūpo varāhaś ca narasiṃho 'tha vāmanaḥ | āyātu devo varado mama nārāyaṇo 'grataḥ ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
आवाहनमन्त्रः: मीनरूपो वराहश् च नरसिंहो ऽथ वामनः | आयातु देवो वरदो मम नारायणो ऽग्रतः ||
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Invocation mantra: 'The Fish-form, the Boar, Narasiṃha, and Vāmana— / may the boon-giving god Nārāyaṇa come before me! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāyāṃ supīṭhe 'tra padmakalpitam āsanam
sarvasattvahitārthāya tiṣṭha tvaṃ madhusūdana //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
कर्णिकायां सुपीठे ऽत्र पद्मकल्पितम् आसनम्
सर्वसत्त्वहितार्थाय तिष्ठ त्वं मधुसूदन //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: 'Here upon the auspicious seat on the pericarp, the seat fashioned as a lotus, / stand for the sake of the welfare of all beings, O Madhusūdana! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast: arghamantraḥ: oṃ trailokyapatīnāṃ pataye devadevāya hṛṣīkeśāya viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning: अर्घमन्त्रः: ओं त्रैलोक्यपतीनां पतये देवदेवाय हृषीकेशाय विष्णवे नमः | ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Water-offering mantra: 'Oṃ, obeisance to the lord of the lords of the three worlds, to the god of gods, to Hṛṣīkeśa, to Viṣṇu! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ pādyaṃ pādayor deva padmanābha sanātana
viṣṇo kamalapattrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdana //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
ओं पाद्यं पादयोर् देव पद्मनाभ सनातन
विष्णो कमलपत्त्राक्ष गृहाण मधुसूदन //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: 'Oṃ, this water for the feet is for your feet, O god, lotus-navelled, eternal one! / O Viṣṇu with eyes like lotus petals, accept it, O Madhusūdana! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkaṃ mahādeva brahmādyaiḥ kalpitaṃ tava
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottama //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
मधुपर्कं महादेव ब्रह्माद्यैः कल्पितं तव
मया निवेदितं भक्त्या गृहाण पुरुषोत्तम //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: 'The honey-mixture, O great god, fashioned for you by Brahmā and the others, / is offered by me with devotion; accept it, O Puruṣottama! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
ācamanīyamantraḥ
mandākinyāḥ sitaṃ vāri sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam
gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
आचमनीयमन्त्रः
मन्दाकिन्याः सितं वारि सर्वपापहरं शिवम्
गृहाणाचमनीयं त्वं मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Sipping-water mantra: / 'The white, auspicious water of the Mandākinī, removing all sins— / accept this sipping water offered by me with devotion! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
snānamantraḥ
tvam āpaḥ pṛthivī caiva jyotis tvaṃ vāyur eva ca
lokeśa vṛttimātreṇa vāriṇā snāpayāmy aham //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
स्नानमन्त्रः
त्वम् आपः पृथिवी चैव ज्योतिस् त्वं वायुर् एव च
लोकेश वृत्तिमात्रेण वारिणा स्नापयाम्य् अहम् //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Bathing mantra: / 'You are the waters, the earth, the light, and the wind; / O lord of the world, I bathe you merely as an observance with water! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
vastramantraḥ
devatattvasamāyukta yajñavarṇasamanvita
svarṇavarṇaprabhe deva vāsasī tava keśava //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
वस्त्रमन्त्रः
देवतत्त्वसमायुक्त यज्ञवर्णसमन्वित
स्वर्णवर्णप्रभे देव वाससी तव केशव //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Garment mantra: / 'Endowed with divine reality, possessed of the sacrificial color, / radiant with a golden color, O god, these two garments are yours, O Keśava! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
vilepanamantraḥ
śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ caiva ca keśava
mayā nivedito gandhaḥ pratigṛhya vilipyatām //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
विलेपनमन्त्रः
शरीरं ते न जानामि चेष्टां चैव च केशव
मया निवेदितो गन्धः प्रतिगृह्य विलिप्यताम् //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Ointment mantra: / 'I do not know your body nor your actions, O Keśava; / accept this fragrant paste offered by me and let it be smeared on! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
upavītamantraḥ
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantreṇa trivṛtaṃ padmayoninā
sāvitrīgranthisaṃyuktam upavītaṃ tavārpaye //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
उपवीतमन्त्रः
ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रेण त्रिवृतं पद्मयोनिना
सावित्रीग्रन्थिसंयुक्तम् उपवीतं तवार्पये //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Sacred thread mantra: / 'Threefold through the mantras of the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma, by the lotus-born [Brahmā], / joined with the knot of Sāvitrī, I offer this sacred thread to you! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkāramantraḥ
divyaratnasamāyukta vahnibhānusamaprabha
gātrāṇi tava śobhantu sālaṃkārāṇi mādhava //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
oṃ nama iti pratyakṣaraṃ samastena mūlamantreṇa vā pūjayet ||
meaning:
अलंकारमन्त्रः
दिव्यरत्नसमायुक्त वह्निभानुसमप्रभ
गात्राणि तव शोभन्तु सालंकाराणि माधव //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
ओं नम इति प्रत्यक्षरं समस्तेन मूलमन्त्रेण वा पूजयेत् ||
text_mt:
Ornament mantra: / 'Endowed with divine jewels, equal in radiance to fire and the sun, / may your limbs shine, adorned with ornaments, O Mādhava! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

One should worship syllable by syllable with 'Oṃ, obeisance', or with the complete root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpamantraḥ
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyaḥ surabhiś ca te
mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
धूपमन्त्रः
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यः सुरभिश् च ते
मया निवेदितो भक्त्या धूपो ऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Incense mantra: / 'The divine sap of trees, rich in fragrance and aromatic to you, / this incense offered by me with devotion, let it be accepted! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
dīpamantraḥ
sūryacandrasamo jyotir vidyudagnyos tathaiva ca
tvam eva jyotiṣāṃ deva dīpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
दीपमन्त्रः
सूर्यचन्द्रसमो ज्योतिर् विद्युदग्न्योस् तथैव च
त्वम् एव ज्योतिषां देव दीपो ऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Mantra for the lamp: / Light equal to the sun and moon, and likewise to lightning and fire; / you alone are the god of lights: may this lamp be accepted! / *oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ*.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyamantraḥ
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ caiva rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ tava keśava //
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||
meaning:
नैवेद्यमन्त्रः
अन्नं चतुर्विधं चैव रसैः षड्भिः समन्वितम्
मया निवेदितं भक्त्या नैवेद्यं तव केशव //
ओं नमो नारायणाय नमः ||
text_mt: Food offering mantra: / 'The four kinds of food endowed with the six flavors, / this food offering is presented by me with devotion to you, O Keśava! / Oṃ, obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve dale vāsudevaṃ yāmye saṃkarṣaṇaṃ nyaset
pradyumnaṃ paścime kuryād aniruddhaṃ tathottare //
meaning:
पूर्वे दले वासुदेवं याम्ये संकर्षणं न्यसेत्
प्रद्युम्नं पश्चिमे कुर्याद् अनिरुद्धं तथोत्तरे //
text_mt: On the eastern petal one should place Vāsudeva, on the southern Saṃkarṣaṇa, / on the western one should place Pradyumna, and likewise Aniruddha on the northern.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhaṃ ca tathāgneye narasiṃhaṃ ca nairṛte
vāyavye mādhavaṃ caiva tathaiśāne trivikramam //
meaning:
वाराहं च तथाग्नेये नरसिंहं च नैरृते
वायव्ये माधवं चैव तथैशाने त्रिविक्रमम् //
text_mt: And likewise the Boar on the south-eastern, Narasiṃha on the south-western, / Mādhava on the north-western, and likewise Trivikrama on the north-eastern.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāṣṭākṣaradevasya garuḍaṃ purato nyaset
vāmapārśve tathā cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset //
meaning:
तथाष्टाक्षरदेवस्य गरुडं पुरतो न्यसेत्
वामपार्श्वे तथा चक्रं शङ्खं दक्षिणतो न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Likewise, in front of the eight-syllabled deity one should place Garuḍa; / on the left flank one should place the discus, and on the right the conch.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā mahāgadāṃ caiva nyased devasya dakṣiṇe
tataḥ śārṅgaṃ dhanur vidvān nyased devasya vāmataḥ //
meaning:
तथा महागदां चैव न्यसेद् देवस्य दक्षिणे
ततः शार्ङ्गं धनुर् विद्वान् न्यसेद् देवस्य वामतः //
text_mt: Likewise, one should place the great mace on the deity's right; / then the wise man should place the bow Śārṅga on the deity's left.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇeneṣudhī divye khaḍgaṃ vāme ca vinyaset
śriyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sthāpya puṣṭim uttarato nyaset //
meaning:
दक्षिणेनेषुधी दिव्ये खड्गं वामे च विन्यसेत्
श्रियं दक्षिणतः स्थाप्य पुष्टिम् उत्तरतो न्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should place two divine quivers on the right and a sword on the left; / having established Śrī on the right, one should place Puṣṭi on the north.

sanskrit_iast:
vanamālāṃ ca puratas tataḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau
vinyased dhṛdayādīni pūrvādiṣu caturdiśam //
meaning:
वनमालां च पुरतस् ततः श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभौ
विन्यसेद् धृदयादीनि पूर्वादिषु चतुर्दिशम् //
text_mt: And the forest garland in front, and after that the Śrīvatsa and the Kaustubha; / one should place [the limbs] beginning with the heart in the four directions starting with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'straṃ devadevasya koṇe caiva tu vinyaset
indram agniṃ yamaṃ caiva nairṛtaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्त्रं देवदेवस्य कोणे चैव तु विन्यसेत्
इन्द्रम् अग्निं यमं चैव नैरृतं वरुणं तथा //
text_mt: Then one should place the weapon of the god of gods in the corner; / [and] Indra, Agni, Yama, and Nairṛta, and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuṃ dhanadam īśānam anantaṃ brahmaṇā saha
pūjayet tāntrikair mantrair adhaś cordhvaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
वायुं धनदम् ईशानम् अनन्तं ब्रह्मणा सह
पूजयेत् तान्त्रिकैर् मन्त्रैर् अधश् चोर्ध्वं तथैव च //
text_mt: Vāyu, the giver of wealth, Īśāna, and Ananta together with Brahmā; / one should worship [them] with Tantric mantras below and likewise above.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam
labhed abhimatān kāmān naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य देवेशं मण्डलस्थं जनार्दनम्
लभेद् अभिमतान् कामान् नरो नास्त्य् अत्र संशयः //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the lord of gods, Janārdana situated in the mandala, / a man attains his desired wishes; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam
pūjitaṃ yaḥ saṃpaśyeta sa viśed viṣṇum avyayam //
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन मण्डलस्थं जनार्दनम्
पूजितं यः संपश्येत स विशेद् विष्णुम् अव्ययम् //
text_mt: Whoever sees Janārdana situated in the mandala, / worshipped according to this very procedure, enters the imperishable Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛd apy arcito yena vidhinānena keśavaḥ
janmamṛtyujarāṃ tīrtvā sa viṣṇoḥ padam āpnuyāt //
meaning:
सकृद् अप्य् अर्चितो येन विधिनानेन केशवः
जन्ममृत्युजरां तीर्त्वा स विष्णोः पदम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt: The one by whom Keśava has been worshipped even once according to this procedure, / having crossed over birth, death, and old age, reaches Viṣṇu's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ smaret satataṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇam atandritaḥ
anvahaṃ tasya vāsāya śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥ //
meaning:
यः स्मरेत् सततं भक्त्या नारायणम् अतन्द्रितः
अन्वहं तस्य वासाय श्वेतद्वीपः प्रकल्पितः //
text_mt: For the one who unflaggingly remembers Nārāyaṇa continuously with devotion, / Śvetadvīpa is ordained for his daily dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkārādisamāyuktaṃ namaḥkārāntadīpitam
tannāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ity abhidhīyate //
meaning:
ओंकारादिसमायुक्तं नमःकारान्तदीपितम्
तन्नाम सर्वतत्त्वानां मन्त्र इत्य् अभिधीयते //
text_mt: Joined with 'oṃ' at the beginning and illuminated by 'namaḥ' at the end, / that name of all principles is termed a mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet
ekaikasya prakurvīta yathoddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa tu //
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन गन्धपुष्पं निवेदयेत्
एकैकस्य प्रकुर्वीत यथोद्दिष्टं क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: By this very rite one should offer fragrant paste and flowers; / one should perform [it] for each one in succession, as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrās tato nibadhnīyād yathoktakramacoditāḥ
japaṃ caiva prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa mantravit //
meaning:
मुद्रास् ततो निबध्नीयाद् यथोक्तक्रमचोदिताः
जपं चैव प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Then one should form the mudrās prescribed in the stated order; / and the knower of mantras should recite the primary mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāviṃśatim aṣṭau vā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tathā
kāmeṣu ca yathāproktaṃ yathāśakti samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टाविंशतिम् अष्टौ वा शतम् अष्टोत्तरं तथा
कामेषु च यथाप्रोक्तं यथाशक्ति समाहितः //
text_mt: Twenty-eight, or eight, or a hundred and eight [times], / and for wishes as stated, concentrated according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
padmaṃ śaṅkhaś ca śrīvatso gadā garuḍa eva ca
cakraṃ khaḍgaś ca śārṅgaṃ ca aṣṭau mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
पद्मं शङ्खश् च श्रीवत्सो गदा गरुड एव च
चक्रं खड्गश् च शार्ङ्गं च अष्टौ मुद्राः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Lotus, conch, Śrīvatsa, mace, and Garuḍa, / discus, sword, and Śārṅga: eight mudrās are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjanamantraḥ
gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama
yatra brahmādayo devā vindanti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
विसर्जनमन्त्रः
गच्छ गच्छ परं स्थानं पुराणपुरुषोत्तम
यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा विन्दन्ति परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Mantra for dismissal: / Go, go to the supreme abode, ancient Puruṣottama, / where Brahmā and the other gods attain the supreme rank.

sanskrit_iast:
arcanaṃ ye na jānanti harer mantrair yathoditam
te tatra mūlamantreṇa pūjayantv acyutaṃ sadā //
meaning:
अर्चनं ये न जानन्ति हरेर् मन्त्रैर् यथोदितम्
ते तत्र मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयन्त्व् अच्युतं सदा //
text_mt: Those who do not know the worship of Hari with the mantras as described / should constantly worship Acyuta there with the primary mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad bhaktyā taṃ puruṣottamam
praṇamya śirasā paścāt sāgaraṃ ca prasādayet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवं संपूज्य विधिवद् भक्त्या तं पुरुषोत्तमम्
प्रणम्य शिरसा पश्चात् सागरं च प्रसादयेत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having thus worshipped that Puruṣottama according to rule with devotion, / having bowed with the head, one should afterwards propitiate the ocean:

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇas tvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniś ca saritāṃ pate
tīrtharāja namas te 'stu trāhi mām acyutapriya //
meaning:
प्राणस् त्वं सर्वभूतानां योनिश् च सरितां पते
तीर्थराज नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्राहि माम् अच्युतप्रिय //
text_mt: "You are the vital breath of all living beings and the source of streams, O lord of rivers! / O king of holy places, obeisance to you; protect me, O beloved of Acyuta!"

sanskrit_iast:
snātvaivaṃ sāgare samyak tasmin kṣetravare dvijāḥ
tīre cābhyarcya vidhivan nārāyaṇam anāmayam //
meaning:
स्नात्वैवं सागरे सम्यक् तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे द्विजाः
तीरे चाभ्यर्च्य विधिवन् नारायणम् अनामयम् //
text_mt: Having bathed thus properly in the ocean in that best of holy fields, O twice-born, / and having worshipped the flawless Nārāyaṇa on the shore according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca praṇipatya ca sāgaram
śatānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
रामं कृष्णं सुभद्रां च प्रणिपत्य च सागरम्
शतानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः //
text_mt: and having bowed down to Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Subhadrā, and the ocean, / a human being attains the fruit of a hundred horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ
vṛndāraka iva śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः
वृन्दारक इव श्रीमान् रूपयौवनगर्वितः //
text_mt: Freed from all sins, completely devoid of all sorrows, / like a god, glorious, proud of his beauty and youth,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānenārkavarṇena divyagandharvanādinā
kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन दिव्यगन्धर्वनादिना
कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: by means of a flying chariot radiant as the sun, resounding with heavenly gandharvas, / having delivered twenty-one generations of his family, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍitvā cāpsaraiḥ saha
manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् क्रीडित्वा चाप्सरैः सह
मन्वन्तरशतं साग्रं जरामृत्युविवर्जितः //
text_mt: Having enjoyed excellent delights there and sported with apsarases / for a full hundred Manvantaras, free from old age and death,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ kule sarvaguṇānvite
rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān satyavādī jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः कुले सर्वगुणान्विते
रूपवान् सुभगः श्रीमान् सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: having arrived back here through the exhaustion of merit, in a family endowed with all good qualities, / handsome, fortunate, glorious, truthful, with senses mastered,

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrārthavid vipro bhaved yajvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ
yogaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रार्थविद् विप्रो भवेद् यज्वा तु वैष्णवः
योगं च वैष्णवं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: a twice-born knower of the meaning of the Vedas and treatises, a performer of sacrifices and a devotee of Viṣṇu, / and having attained the yoga of Viṣṇu, he then attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
grahoparāge saṃkrāntyām ayane viṣuve tathā
yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatīpāte dinakṣaye //
meaning:
ग्रहोपरागे संक्रान्त्याम् अयने विषुवे तथा
युगादिषु षडशीत्यां व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये //
text_mt: During an eclipse of the planets, at a solstice, at an equinox, / at the beginnings of yugas, at a Saḍaśīti, at a Vyatīpāta, on a Dinakṣaya,

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhyāṃ caiva kārttikyāṃ māghyāṃ vānye śubhe tithau
ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti sumedhasaḥ //
meaning:
आषाढ्यां चैव कार्त्तिक्यां माघ्यां वान्ये शुभे तिथौ
ये तत्र दानं विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति सुमेधसः //
text_mt: on the full moon of Āṣāḍha, Kārttika, or Māgha, or on another auspicious lunar day, / the wise ones who offer gifts there to the twice-born

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ sahasraguṇitam anyatīrthāl labhanti te
pitṝṇāṃ ye prayacchanti piṇḍaṃ tatra vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
फलं सहस्रगुणितम् अन्यतीर्थाल् लभन्ति ते
पितॄणां ये प्रयच्छन्ति पिण्डं तत्र विधानतः //
text_mt: receive a reward a thousandfold greater than at any other holy place. / Those who offer rice balls there to the ancestors according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayāṃ pitaras teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ saṃprāpnuvanti vai
evaṃ snānaphalaṃ samyak sāgarasya mayoditam //
meaning:
अक्षयां पितरस् तेषां तृप्तिं संप्राप्नुवन्ति वै
एवं स्नानफलं सम्यक् सागरस्य मयोदितम् //
text_mt: their ancestors indeed obtain inexhaustible satisfaction. / Thus has the complete fruit of bathing in the ocean been spoken by me,

sanskrit_iast:
dānasya ca phalaṃ viprāḥ piṇḍadānasya caiva hi
dharmārthamokṣaphaladam āyuṣkīrtiyaśaskaram //
meaning:
दानस्य च फलं विप्राः पिण्डदानस्य चैव हि
धर्मार्थमोक्षफलदम् आयुष्कीर्तियशस्करम् //
text_mt: as well as the fruit of giving, O twice-born, and of offering rice balls, / which grants the fruits of dharma, wealth, and liberation, and produces longevity, renown, and fame;

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam //
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं नॄणां धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम्
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: which yields worldly enjoyment and release for humans, is auspicious, destroys bad dreams, / removes all sins, is holy, and grants the fruits of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ
tāvad garjanti tīrthāni māhātmyaiḥ svaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
नास्तिकाय न वक्तव्यं पुराणं च द्विजोत्तमाः
तावद् गर्जन्ति तीर्थानि माहात्म्यैः स्वैः पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: This Purāṇa must not be spoken to an unbeliever, O best of the twice-born! / Holy places roar with their separate greatnesses only so long

sanskrit_iast:
yāvan na tīrtharājasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate dvijāḥ
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni prayacchanti svakaṃ phalam //
meaning:
यावन् न तीर्थराजस्य माहात्म्यं वर्ण्यते द्विजाः
पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि प्रयच्छन्ति स्वकं फलम् //
text_mt: as the greatness of the king of holy places is not described, O twice-born! / Holy places such as Puṣkara grant their respective rewards,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtharājas tu sa punaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ
bhūtale yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca //
meaning:
तीर्थराजस् तु स पुनः सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदः
भूतले यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च //
text_mt: but the king of holy places, on the other hand, bestows the fruit of all holy places. / Whatever holy places, rivers, and lakes there are on the earth

sanskrit_iast:
viśanti sāgare tāni tenāsau śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ
rājā samastatīrthānāṃ sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ //
meaning:
विशन्ति सागरे तानि तेनासौ श्रेष्ठतां गतः
राजा समस्ततीर्थानां सागरः सरितां पतिः //
text_mt: enter the ocean; therefore it has attained preeminence. / The ocean, the lord of rivers, is the king of all holy places;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt samastatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho 'sau sarvakāmadaḥ
tamo nāśaṃ yathābhyeti bhāskare 'bhyudite dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् समस्ततीर्थेभ्यः श्रेष्ठो ऽसौ सर्वकामदः
तमो नाशं यथाभ्येति भास्करे ऽभ्युदिते द्विजाः //
text_mt: therefore it is superior to all holy places, the granter of all desires. / Just as darkness goes to destruction when the sun rises, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
snānena tīrtharājasya tathā pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ
tīrtharājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
स्नानेन तीर्थराजस्य तथा पापस्य संक्षयः
तीर्थराजसमं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति //
text_mt: so is sin destroyed by bathing in the king of holy places. / A holy place equal to the king of holy places never was, nor ever will be.

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhānaṃ yadā yatra prabhor nārāyaṇasya vai
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tīrtharājasya bho dvijāḥ //
meaning:
अधिष्ठानं यदा यत्र प्रभोर् नारायणस्य वै
कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं तीर्थराजस्य भो द्विजाः //
text_mt: When and where the residence of the lord Nārāyaṇa is truly there, / who is capable of describing the virtues of the king of holy places, O twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
koṭyo navanavatyas tu yatra tīrthāni santi vai
tasmāt snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca homaṃ japyaṃ surārcanam
yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra cākṣayaṃ kriyate dvijāḥ //
meaning:
कोट्यो नवनवत्यस् तु यत्र तीर्थानि सन्ति वै
तस्मात् स्नानं च दानं च होमं जप्यं सुरार्चनम्
यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र चाक्षयं क्रियते द्विजाः //
text_mt: Where ninety-nine crores of holy places indeed exist, / therefore whatever bathing, giving, fire-offering, recitation, and worship of gods / is performed there, O twice-born, is made imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tato gacched dvijaśreṣṭhās tīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam
indradyumnasaro nāma yatrāste pāvanaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो गच्छेद् द्विजश्रेष्ठास् तीर्थं यज्ञाङ्गसंभवम्
इन्द्रद्युम्नसरो नाम यत्रास्ते पावनं शुभम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then, O best of the twice-born, one should go to the holy place born of a part of the sacrifice, / named Indradyumna Lake, where the purifying, auspicious [water] resides.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā tatra śucir dhīmān ācamya manasā harim
dhyātvopasthāya ca jalam imaṃ mantram udīrayet //
meaning:
गत्वा तत्र शुचिर् धीमान् आचम्य मनसा हरिम्
ध्यात्वोपस्थाय च जलम् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत् //
text_mt: Having gone there, pure and wise, having sipped water, having mentally / meditated upon Hari and approached the water, one should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhāṅgasaṃbhūta tīrtha sarvāghanāśana
snānaṃ tvayi karomy adya pāpaṃ hara namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अश्वमेधाङ्गसंभूत तीर्थ सर्वाघनाशन
स्नानं त्वयि करोम्य् अद्य पापं हर नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: "O holy place born of an element of the horse sacrifice, destroyer of all sins, / I perform a bath in you today; take away sin, obeisance to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
evam uccārya vidhivat snātvā devān ṛṣīn pitṝn
tilodakena cānyāṃś ca saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
एवम् उच्चार्य विधिवत् स्नात्वा देवान् ऋषीन् पितॄन्
तिलोदकेन चान्यांश् च संतर्प्याचम्य वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus according to rule and bathed, having gratified the gods, sages, ancestors, / and others with sesame-water, and having sipped water, restrained in speech,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍāṃś ca saṃpūjya puruṣottamam
daśāśvamedhikaṃ samyak phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
दत्त्वा पितॄणां पिण्डांश् च संपूज्य पुरुषोत्तमम्
दशाश्वमेधिकं सम्यक् फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः //
text_mt: Offering rice-balls to the ancestors and worshipping Puruṣottama, / a human being duly obtains the fruit of ten horse-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya devavat
kāmagena vimānena viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् वंशान् उद्धृत्य देववत्
कामगेन विमानेन विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Having delivered seven previous and seven subsequent generations, / he goes like a god to the world of Viṣṇu in a wish-moving aerial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tatra sukhān bhogān yāvac candrārkatārakam
cyutas tasmād ihāyāto mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तत्र सुखान् भोगान् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
च्युतस् तस्माद् इहायातो मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Having enjoyed pleasant pleasures there as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure, / falling from there and returning here, he surely attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā pañcatīrthīm ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ
jyeṣṭhaśuklapañcadaśyāṃ yaḥ paśyet puruṣottamam //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा पञ्चतीर्थीम् एकादश्याम् उपोषितः
ज्येष्ठशुक्लपञ्चदश्यां यः पश्येत् पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the pilgrimage to the five sacred sites, fasting on the eleventh day, / whoever beholds Puruṣottama on the fifteenth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
sa pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ prāpya krīḍitvā vācyutālaye
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ //
meaning:
स पूर्वोक्तं फलं प्राप्य क्रीडित्वा वाच्युतालये
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यस्मान् नावर्तते पुनः //
text_mt: attaining that aforementioned fruit and sporting in the abode of Acyuta, / goes to the supreme state from which he does not return again.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
māsān anyān parityajya māghādīn prapitāmaha
praśaṃsasi kathaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ prabho //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
मासान् अन्यान् परित्यज्य माघादीन् प्रपितामह
प्रशंससि कथं ज्येष्ठं ब्रूहि तत्कारणं प्रभो //
text_mt: The sages said: / Leaving aside other months, such as Māgha and the rest, O great-grandfather, / why do you praise Jyeṣṭha? Tell us the reason for that, O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
jyeṣṭhaṃ māsaṃ yathā tebhyaḥ praśaṃsāmi punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः
ज्येष्ठं मासं यथा तेभ्यः प्रशंसामि पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen, O tigers among sages; I shall explain in brief / why I praise the month of Jyeṣṭha above them again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
puṣkariṇyas taḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpās tathā hradāḥ //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
पुष्करिण्यस् तडागानि वाप्यः कूपास् तथा ह्रदाः //
text_mt: Whatever sacred places, rivers, and lakes are on the earth, / lotus ponds, reservoirs, stepwells, wells, and pools,

sanskrit_iast:
nānānadyaḥ samudrāś ca saptāhaṃ puruṣottame
jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyādi pratyakṣaṃ yānti sarvadā //
meaning:
नानानद्यः समुद्राश् च सप्ताहं पुरुषोत्तमे
ज्येष्ठशुक्लदशम्यादि प्रत्यक्षं यान्ति सर्वदा //
text_mt: various streams and oceans, for seven days in Puruṣottama, / from the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha onwards, are always visibly present.

sanskrit_iast:
snānadānādikaṃ tasmād devatāprekṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥ
yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra tasmin kāle 'kṣayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
स्नानदानादिकं तस्माद् देवताप्रेक्षणं द्विजाः
यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र तस्मिन् काले ऽक्षयं भवेत् //
text_mt: Therefore, O twice-born, bathing, giving gifts, and the like, and the beholding of the deity— / whatever little is done there at that time becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣasya daśamī jyeṣṭhe māsi dvijottamāḥ
harate daśa pāpāni tasmād daśaharā smṛtā //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षस्य दशमी ज्येष्ठे मासि द्विजोत्तमाः
हरते दश पापानि तस्माद् दशहरा स्मृता //
text_mt: The tenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Jyeṣṭha, O best of the twice-born, / removes ten sins; therefore it is traditionally called Daśaharā.

sanskrit_iast:
yas tasyāṃ halinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyed bhadrāṃ susaṃyataḥ
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ //
meaning:
यस् तस्यां हलिनं कृष्णं पश्येद् भद्रां सुसंयतः
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः //
text_mt: A man who, well-restrained, beholds on it the plow-holder, Kṛṣṇa, and Bhadrā, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare dakṣiṇe viprās tv ayane puruṣottamam
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ //
meaning:
उत्तरे दक्षिणे विप्रास् त्व् अयने पुरुषोत्तमम्
दृष्ट्वा रामं सुभद्रां च विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः //
text_mt: At the northern and the southern solstices, O brahmins, / a man who beholds Puruṣottama, Rāma, and Subhadrā goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
naro dolāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā govindaṃ puruṣottamam
phālgunyāṃ prayato bhūtvā govindasya puraṃ vrajet //
meaning:
नरो दोलागतं दृष्ट्वा गोविन्दं पुरुषोत्तमम्
फाल्गुन्यां प्रयतो भूत्वा गोविन्दस्य पुरं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: A man who, having become restrained, beholds Govinda, Puruṣottama, seated on a swing / on the full-moon day of Phālguna, goes to the city of Govinda.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣuvaddivase prāpte pañcatīrthīṃ vidhānataḥ
kṛtvā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ //
meaning:
विषुवद्दिवसे प्राप्ते पञ्चतीर्थीं विधानतः
कृत्वा संकर्षणं कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा भद्रां च भो द्विजाः //
text_mt: When the day of the equinox arrives, having performed the pilgrimage to the five sacred sites according to rule / and beheld Saṃkarṣaṇa, Kṛṣṇa, and Bhadrā, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
naraḥ samastayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti durlabham
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati //
meaning:
नरः समस्तयज्ञानां फलं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभम्
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति //
text_mt: a man obtains the hard-to-attain fruit of all sacrifices; / freed from all sins, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paśyati tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ candanarūṣitam
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe sa yāty acyutamandiram //
meaning:
यः पश्यति तृतीयायां कृष्णं चन्दनरूषितम्
वैशाखस्यासिते पक्षे स यात्य् अच्युतमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: He who beholds Kṛṣṇa smeared with sandalwood on the third day / in the dark fortnight of Vaiśākha, goes to the abode of Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
jyaiṣṭhyāṃ jyeṣṭharkṣayuktāyāṃ yaḥ paśyet puruṣottamam
kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
ज्यैष्ठ्यां ज्येष्ठर्क्षयुक्तायां यः पश्येत् पुरुषोत्तमम्
कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: He who beholds Puruṣottama on the full moon of Jyeṣṭha joined with the lunar mansion Jyeṣṭhā, / having delivered twenty-one generations of his family, goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
yadā bhaven mahājyaiṣṭhī rāśinakṣatrayogataḥ
prayatnena tadā martyair gantavyaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
यदा भवेन् महाज्यैष्ठी राशिनक्षत्रयोगतः
प्रयत्नेन तदा मर्त्यैर् गन्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When there occurs the Mahājyaiṣṭhī due to the conjunction of the zodiac sign and lunar mansion, / Puruṣottama should then be visited with great effort by mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
naro dvādaśayātrāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam //
meaning:
कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा महाज्यैष्ठ्यां रामं भद्रां च भो द्विजाः
नरो द्वादशयात्रायाः फलं प्राप्नोति चाधिकम् //
text_mt: Having beheld Kṛṣṇa, Rāma, and Bhadrā on the Mahājyaiṣṭhī, O twice-born, / a man obtains a fruit greater than [that of] the twelve festivals.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāge ca kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare gaye
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame //
meaning:
प्रयागे च कुरुक्षेत्रे नैमिषे पुष्करे गये
गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्ते गङ्गासागरसंगमे //
text_mt: At Prayāga, Kurukṣetra, Naimiṣa, Puṣkara, Gayā, / Gaṅgādvāra, Kuśāvarta, the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean;

sanskrit_iast:
kokāmukhe śūkare ca mathurāyāṃ marusthale
śālagrāme vāyutīrthe mandare sindhusāgare //
meaning:
कोकामुखे शूकरे च मथुरायां मरुस्थले
शालग्रामे वायुतीर्थे मन्दरे सिन्धुसागरे //
text_mt: at Kokāmukha, Śūkara, Mathurā, Marusthala, / Śālagrāma, Vāyutīrtha, Mandara, the Sindhu ocean;

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍārake citrakūṭe prabhāse kanakhale dvijāḥ
śaṅkhoddhāre dvārakāyāṃ tathā badarikāśrame //
meaning:
पिण्डारके चित्रकूटे प्रभासे कनखले द्विजाः
शङ्खोद्धारे द्वारकायां तथा बदरिकाश्रमे //
text_mt: at Piṇḍāraka, Citrakūṭa, Prabhāsa, Kanakhala, O twice-born; / at Śaṅkhoddhāra, Dvārakā, and likewise at Badarikāśrama;

sanskrit_iast:
lohakuṇḍe cāśvatīrthe sarvapāpapramocane
kāmālaye koṭitīrthe tathā cāmarakaṇṭake //
meaning:
लोहकुण्डे चाश्वतीर्थे सर्वपापप्रमोचने
कामालये कोटितीर्थे तथा चामरकण्टके //
text_mt: at Lohakuṇḍa, Aśvatīrtha, Sarvapāpapramocana, / Kāmālaya, Koṭitīrtha, and likewise at Amarakaṇṭaka;

sanskrit_iast:
lohārgale jambumārge somatīrthe pṛthūdake
utpalāvartake caiva pṛthutuṅge sukubjake //
meaning:
लोहार्गले जम्बुमार्गे सोमतीर्थे पृथूदके
उत्पलावर्तके चैव पृथुतुङ्गे सुकुब्जके //
text_mt: at Lohārgala, Jambumārga, Somatīrtha, Pṛthūdaka, / Utpalāvartaka, Pṛthutuṅga, Sukubjaka;

sanskrit_iast:
ekāmrake ca kedāre kāśyāṃ ca viraje dvijāḥ
kālañjare ca gokarṇe śrīśaile gandhamādane //
meaning:
एकाम्रके च केदारे काश्यां च विरजे द्विजाः
कालञ्जरे च गोकर्णे श्रीशैले गन्धमादने //
text_mt: at Ekāmraka, Kedāra, Kāśī, and Viraja, O twice-born; / at Kālañjara, Gokarṇa, Śrīśaila, Gandhamādana;

sanskrit_iast:
mahendre malaye vindhye pāriyātre himālaye
sahye ca śuktimante ca gomante cārbude tathā //
meaning:
महेन्द्रे मलये विन्ध्ये पारियात्रे हिमालये
सह्ये च शुक्तिमन्ते च गोमन्ते चार्बुदे तथा //
text_mt: on the Mahendra, Malaya, Vindhya, Pāriyātra, and Himālaya [mountains]; / on the Sahya, Śuktimat, Gomanta, and Arbuda;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yāmuneṣu ca bho dvijāḥ
sārasvateṣu gomatyāṃ brahmaputreṣu saptasu //
meaning:
गङ्गायां सर्वतीर्थेषु यामुनेषु च भो द्विजाः
सारस्वतेषु गोमत्यां ब्रह्मपुत्रेषु सप्तसु //
text_mt: at the Gaṅgā, at all sacred places at the Yamunā, O twice-born, / at those along the Sarasvatī, at the Gomatī, and at the seven Brahmaputras;

sanskrit_iast:
godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca narmadā
tāpī payouṣṇī kāverī śiprā carmaṇvatī dvijāḥ //
meaning:
गोदावरी भीमरथी तुङ्गभद्रा च नर्मदा
तापी पयोउष्णी कावेरी शिप्रा चर्मण्वती द्विजाः //
text_mt: at the Godāvarī, Bhīmarathī, Tuṅgabhadrā, and Narmadā; / Tāpī, Payoṣṇī, Kāverī, Śiprā, and Carmaṇvatī, O twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
vitastā candrabhāgā ca śatadrur bāhudā tathā
ṛṣikulyā kumārī ca vipāśā ca dṛṣadvatī //
meaning:
वितस्ता चन्द्रभागा च शतद्रुर् बाहुदा तथा
ऋषिकुल्या कुमारी च विपाशा च दृषद्वती //
text_mt: at the Vitastā, Candrabhāgā, Śatadru, and Bāhudā; / Ṛṣikulyā, Kumārī, Vipāśā, and Dṛṣadvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
śarayūr nākagaṅgā ca gaṇḍakī ca mahānadī
kauśikī karatoyā ca trisrotā madhuvāhinī //
meaning:
शरयूर् नाकगङ्गा च गण्डकी च महानदी
कौशिकी करतोया च त्रिस्रोता मधुवाहिनी //
text_mt: at the Śarayū, Nākagaṅgā, Gaṇḍakī, and Mahānadī; / Kauśikī, Karatoyā, Trisrotas, and Madhuvāhinī;

sanskrit_iast:
mahānadī vaitaraṇī yāś cānyā nānukīrtitāḥ
athavā kiṃ bahūktena bhāṣitena dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
महानदी वैतरणी याश् चान्या नानुकीर्तिताः
अथवा किं बहूक्तेन भाषितेन द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: at the Mahānadī, Vaitaraṇī, and the others not mentioned— / or what need is there to speak at great length, O best of the twice-born?

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarveṣv āyataneṣu ca
sāgareṣu ca śaileṣu nadīṣu ca saraḥsu ca //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वेष्व् आयतनेषु च
सागरेषु च शैलेषु नदीषु च सरःसु च //
text_mt: At all the sacred sites on earth, and in all temples, / in oceans, on mountains, in rivers, and in lakes,

sanskrit_iast:
yat phalaṃ snānadānena rāhugraste divākare
tat phalaṃ kṛṣṇam ālokya mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ labhen naraḥ //
meaning:
यत् फलं स्नानदानेन राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे
तत् फलं कृष्णम् आलोक्य महाज्यैष्ठ्यां लभेन् नरः //
text_mt: whatever fruit [is gained] by bathing and giving gifts when the sun is seized by Rāhu, / a man obtains that fruit upon beholding Kṛṣṇa on the Mahājyaiṣṭhī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gantavyaṃ puruṣottame
mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्तव्यं पुरुषोत्तमे
महाज्यैष्ठ्यां मुनिश्रेष्ठा सर्वकामफलेप्सुभिः //
text_mt: Therefore, by every effort, Puruṣottama should be visited / on the Mahājyaiṣṭhī, O best of sages, by those desiring the fruit of all wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mahājyeṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrayā saha
viṣṇulokaṃ naro yāti samuddhṛtya samaṃ kulam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा रामं महाज्येष्ठं कृष्णं सुभद्रया सह
विष्णुलोकं नरो याति समुद्धृत्य समं कुलम् //
text_mt: Having beheld Rāma, the eldest, [and] Kṛṣṇa together with Subhadrā, / a man goes to the world of Viṣṇu, having thoroughly delivered his entire family.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
पुण्यक्षयाद् इहागत्य चतुर्वेदी द्विजो भवेत् //
text_mt: Having enjoyed excellent pleasures there until the cosmic dissolution, / coming here upon the exhaustion of his merit, he becomes a twice-born master of the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmanirataḥ śāntaḥ kṛṣṇabhakto jitendriyaḥ
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
स्वधर्मनिरतः शान्तः कृष्णभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः
वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Devoted to his own dharma, tranquil, devoted to Kṛṣṇa, with senses conquered, / resorting to Vaiṣṇava yoga, he then attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
kasmin kāle bhavet snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya kamalodbhava
vidhinā kena tad brūhi tato vidhividāṃ vara //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
कस्मिन् काले भवेत् स्नानं कृष्णस्य कमलोद्भव
विधिना केन तद् ब्रूहि ततो विधिविदां वर //
text_mt: The sages said: / At what time does the bathing of Kṛṣṇa take place, O lotus-born one, / and by what rite? Tell us that then, O best among those who know ritual!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vadato mama
rāmasya ca subhadrāyāḥ puṇyaṃ sarvāghanāśanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शृणुध्वं मुनयः स्नानं कृष्णस्य वदतो मम
रामस्य च सुभद्रायाः पुण्यं सर्वाघनाशनम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Listen, O sages, as I declare the bathing of Kṛṣṇa, / of Rāma, and of Subhadrā—auspicious and destroying all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi jyeṣṭhe ca saṃprāpte nakṣatre candradaivate
paurṇamāsyāṃ tadā snānaṃ sarvakālaṃ harer dvijāḥ //
meaning:
मासि ज्येष्ठे च संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे चन्द्रदैवते
पौर्णमास्यां तदा स्नानं सर्वकालं हरेर् द्विजाः //
text_mt: When the month of Jyeṣṭha arrives, under the lunar mansion whose deity is the Moon, / on the full-moon day, then is the bathing of Hari for all time, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatīrthamayaḥ kūpas tatrāste nirmalaḥ śuciḥ
tadā bhogavatī tatra pratyakṣā bhavati dvijāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वतीर्थमयः कूपस् तत्रास्ते निर्मलः शुचिः
तदा भोगवती तत्र प्रत्यक्षा भवति द्विजाः //
text_mt: There is a pure, clean well there, containing all sacred waters; / then the Bhogavatī becomes visibly manifest there, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyāṃ samuddhṛtya haimāḍhyaiḥ kalaśair jalam
kṛṣṇarāmābhiṣekārthaṃ subhadrāyāś ca bho dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यां समुद्धृत्य हैमाढ्यैः कलशैर् जलम्
कृष्णरामाभिषेकार्थं सुभद्रायाश् च भो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Drawing water from it on the full moon of Jyeṣṭha with pitchers adorned with gold / for the consecration of Kṛṣṇa and Rāma, and of Subhadrā, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā suśobhanaṃ mañcaṃ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam
sudṛḍhaṃ sukhasaṃcāraṃ vastraiḥ puṣpair alaṃkṛtam //
meaning:
कृत्वा सुशोभनं मञ्चं पताकाभिर् अलंकृतम्
सुदृढं सुखसंचारं वस्त्रैः पुष्पैर् अलंकृतम् //
text_mt: having constructed a very splendid platform adorned with flags, / very firm, allowing easy movement, embellished with garments and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇaṃ dhūpitaṃ dhūpaiḥ snānārthaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ
sitavastraparicchannaṃ muktāhārāvalambitam //
meaning:
विस्तीर्णं धूपितं धूपैः स्नानार्थं रामकृष्णयोः
सितवस्त्रपरिच्छन्नं मुक्ताहारावलम्बितम् //
text_mt: spacious, perfumed with incense, for the bathing of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, / covered with white cloth and hung with pearl necklaces—

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nānāvidhair vādyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ dvijāḥ
madhye subhadrāṃ cāsthāpya jayamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्र नानाविधैर् वाद्यैः कृष्णं नीलाम्बरं द्विजाः
मध्ये सुभद्रां चास्थाप्य जयमङ्गलनिस्वनैः //
text_mt: placing Kṛṣṇa, [Rāma] clad in blue garments, and Subhadrā in the middle there / with various musical instruments and shouts of victory and blessing, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś cānyaiś ca jātibhiḥ
anekaśatasāhasrair vṛtaṃ strīpuruṣair dvijāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर् वैश्यैः शूद्रैश् चान्यैश् च जातिभिः
अनेकशतसाहस्रैर् वृतं स्त्रीपुरुषैर् द्विजाः //
text_mt: surrounded by brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and other classes, / by many hundreds of thousands of men and women, O twice-born—

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthāḥ snātakāś caiva yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ
snāpayanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ mañcasthaṃ sahalāyudham //
meaning:
गृहस्थाः स्नातकाश् चैव यतयो ब्रह्मचारिणः
स्नापयन्ति तदा कृष्णं मञ्चस्थं सहलायुधम् //
text_mt:
Householders, snātakas, ascetics, and brahmacārins
then bathe Kṛṣṇa, standing upon the dais together with Halāyudha.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā samastatīrthāni pūrvoktāni dvijottamāḥ
svodakaiḥ puṣpamiśraiś ca snāpayanti pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
तथा समस्ततीर्थानि पूर्वोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमाः
स्वोदकैः पुष्पमिश्रैश् च स्नापयन्ति पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt:
Likewise, O best of twice-borns, all the previously mentioned sacred pilgrimage sites
bathe [them] individually with their own waters mixed with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāt paṭahaśaṅkhādyair bherīmurajanisvanaiḥ
kāhalais tālaśabdaiś ca mṛdaṅgair jharjharais tathā //
meaning:
पश्चात् पटहशङ्खाद्यैर् भेरीमुरजनिस्वनैः
काहलैस् तालशब्दैश् च मृदङ्गैर् झर्झरैस् तथा //
text_mt:
Afterwards, with kettle-drums, conches, and other instruments, with the sounds of bherī and muraja drums,
with trumpets and the sounds of cymbals, with mṛdaṅgas and jharjharas,

sanskrit_iast:
anyaiś ca vividhair vādyair ghaṇṭāsvanavibhūṣitaiḥ
strīṇāṃ maṅgalaśabdaiś ca stutiśabdair manoharaiḥ //
meaning:
अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वाद्यैर् घण्टास्वनविभूषितैः
स्त्रीणां मङ्गलशब्दैश् च स्तुतिशब्दैर् मनोहरैः //
text_mt:
and with various other musical instruments adorned by the sound of bells,
with the auspicious sounds of women and enchanting sounds of praise,

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśabdais tathā stotrair vīṇāveṇunināditaiḥ
śrūyate sumahāñ śabdaḥ sāgarasyeva garjataḥ //
meaning:
जयशब्दैस् तथा स्तोत्रैर् वीणावेणुनिनादितैः
श्रूयते सुमहाञ् शब्दः सागरस्येव गर्जतः //
text_mt:
with shouts of victory, hymns, and the melodious sounds of lute and flute,
a tremendous roar is heard, like that of the roaring ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
munīnāṃ vedaśabdena mantraśabdais tathāparaiḥ
nānāstotraravaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sāmaśabdopabṛṃhitaiḥ //
meaning:
मुनीनां वेदशब्देन मन्त्रशब्दैस् तथापरैः
नानास्तोत्ररवैः पुण्यैः सामशब्दोपबृंहितैः //
text_mt:
Through the sound of the Vedas of the sages, and through other mantra-sounds,
through the holy sounds of various hymns, magnified by the sounds of the Sāman chants,

sanskrit_iast:
yatibhiḥ snātakaiś caiva gṛhasthair brahmacāribhiḥ
snānakāle suraśreṣṭha stuvanti parayā mudā //
meaning:
यतिभिः स्नातकैश् चैव गृहस्थैर् ब्रह्मचारिभिः
स्नानकाले सुरश्रेष्ठ स्तुवन्ति परया मुदा //
text_mt:
by ascetics, snātakas, householders, and brahmacārins,
at the time of the bath, O best among the gods, they praise [him] with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmair veśyājanaiś caiva kucabhārāvanāmibhiḥ
pītaraktāmbarābhiś ca mālyadāmāvanāmibhiḥ //
meaning:
श्यामैर् वेश्याजनैश् चैव कुचभारावनामिभिः
पीतरक्ताम्बराभिश् च माल्यदामावनामिभिः //
text_mt:
By dark-complexioned courtesans bending under the weight of their breasts,
wearing yellow and red garments, bending under strings of flower-garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
saratnakuṇḍalair divyaiḥ suvarṇastabakānvitaiḥ
cāmarai ratnadaṇḍaiś ca vījyete rāmakeśavau //
meaning:
सरत्नकुण्डलैर् दिव्यैः सुवर्णस्तबकान्वितैः
चामरै रत्नदण्डैश् च वीज्येते रामकेशवौ //
text_mt:
with divine jewel-studded earrings and adorned with golden clusters,
with chowries having jeweled handles, Rāma and Keśava are fanned.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣavidyādharaiḥ siddhaiḥ kiṃnaraiś cāpsarogaṇaiḥ
parivāryāmbaragatair devagandharvacāraṇaiḥ //
meaning:
यक्षविद्याधरैः सिद्धैः किंनरैश् चाप्सरोगणैः
परिवार्याम्बरगतैर् देवगन्धर्वचारणैः //
text_mt:
By Yakṣas, Vidyādharas, Siddhas, Kiṃnaras, and troops of Apsarases,
standing in the sky and surrounding [them], by celestial Gandharvas and Cāraṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ
lokapālās tathā cānye stuvanti puruṣottamam //
meaning:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणाः
लोकपालास् तथा चान्ये स्तुवन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sādhyas, Viśvedevas, Marut-troops,
and the world-guardians and others praise Puruṣottama:

sanskrit_iast:
namas te devadeveśa purāṇa puruṣottama
sargasthityantakṛd deva lokanātha jagatpate //
meaning:
नमस् ते देवदेवेश पुराण पुरुषोत्तम
सर्गस्थित्यन्तकृद् देव लोकनाथ जगत्पते //
text_mt:
"Homage to you, O Lord of the gods of gods, ancient one, O Puruṣottama,
O God, creator of primary creation, preservation, and dissolution, protector of the world, Lord of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyadhāriṇaṃ devaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ mokṣakāraṇam
taṃ namasyāmahe bhaktyā sarvakāmaphalapradam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यधारिणं देवं ब्रह्मण्यं मोक्षकारणम्
तं नमस्यामहे भक्त्या सर्वकामफलप्रदम् //
text_mt:
The god who upholds the three worlds, benevolent to brāhmaṇas, the cause of liberation,
to him we bow in devotion, the granter of the fruit of all desires!"

sanskrit_iast:
stutvaivaṃ vibudhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ caiva mahābalam
subhadrāṃ ca muniśreṣṭhās tadākāśe vyavasthitāḥ //
meaning:
स्तुत्वैवं विबुधाः कृष्णं रामं चैव महाबलम्
सुभद्रां च मुनिश्रेष्ठास् तदाकाशे व्यवस्थिताः //
text_mt:
Having thus praised Kṛṣṇa, the mighty Rāma,
and Subhadrā, the gods, O best of sages, stood there in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyanti devagandharvā nṛtyanty apsarasas tathā
devatūryāṇy avādyanta vātā vānti suśītalāḥ //
meaning:
गायन्ति देवगन्धर्वा नृत्यन्त्य् अप्सरसस् तथा
देवतूर्याण्य् अवाद्यन्त वाता वान्ति सुशीतलाः //
text_mt:
The celestial Gandharvas sing, and the Apsarases dance;
celestial musical instruments were sounded, and very cool breezes blow.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamiśraṃ tadā meghā varṣanty ākāśagocarāḥ
jayaśabdaṃ ca kurvanti munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पमिश्रं तदा मेघा वर्षन्त्य् आकाशगोचराः
जयशब्दं च कुर्वन्ति मुनयः सिद्धचारणाः //
text_mt:
Then the clouds moving in the sky shower [rain] mixed with flowers,
and the sages, Siddhas, and Cāraṇas utter cries of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrādyā vibudhāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ pitaras tathā
prajānāṃ patayo nāgā ye cānye svargavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
शक्राद्या विबुधाः सर्व ऋषयः पितरस् तथा
प्रजानां पतयो नागा ये चान्ये स्वर्गवासिनः //
text_mt:
All the gods led by Śakra, the ṛṣis, the ancestors,
the lords of creatures, the serpents, and whatever other dwellers of heaven there are—

sanskrit_iast:
tato maṅgalasaṃbhārair vidhimantrapuraskṛtam
ābhiṣecanikaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā devatāgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
ततो मङ्गलसंभारैर् विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्
आभिषेचनिकं द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा देवतागणाः //
text_mt:
then the hosts of deities, taking the ingredients for consecration
accompanied by auspicious preparations and preceded by Vedic rites and mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
indro viṣṇur mahāvīryaḥ sūryācandramasau tathā
dhātā caiva vidhātā ca tathā caivānilānalau //
meaning:
इन्द्रो विष्णुर् महावीर्यः सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा
धाता चैव विधाता च तथा चैवानिलानलौ //
text_mt:
Indra, Viṣṇu of great prowess, and the sun and moon,
Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ, and also wind and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
pūṣā bhago 'ryamā tvaṣṭā aṃśunaiva vivasvatā
patnībhyāṃ sahito dhīmān mitreṇa varuṇena ca //
meaning:
पूषा भगो ऽर्यमा त्वष्टा अंशुनैव विवस्वता
पत्नीभ्यां सहितो धीमान् मित्रेण वरुणेन च //
text_mt:
Pūṣan, Bhaga, Aryaman, Tvaṣṭṛ, along with Aṃśu and Vivasvat,
accompanied by his two wives, the wise one, along with Mitra and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrair vasubhir ādityair aśvibhyāṃ ca vṛtaḥ prabhuḥ
viśvair devair marudbhiś ca sādhyaiś ca pitṛbhiḥ saha //
meaning:
रुद्रैर् वसुभिर् आदित्यैर् अश्विभ्यां च वृतः प्रभुः
विश्वैर् देवैर् मरुद्भिश् च साध्यैश् च पितृभिः सह //
text_mt:
the Lord surrounded by the Rudras, Vasus, Ādityas, and the two Aśvins,
along with the Viśvedevas, Maruts, Sādhyas, and Pitṛs,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvair apsarobhiś ca yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ
devarṣibhir asaṃkhyeyais tathā brahmarṣibhir varaiḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिश् च यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः
देवर्षिभिर् असंख्येयैस् तथा ब्रह्मर्षिभिर् वरैः //
text_mt:
with Gandharvas, Apsarases, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and Pannagas,
with countless divine sages, and also with excellent brahmarṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikhānasair vālakhilyair vāyvāhārair marīcipaiḥ
bhṛgubhiś cāṅgirobhiś ca sarvavidyāsuniṣṭhitaiḥ //
meaning:
वैखानसैर् वालखिल्यैर् वाय्वाहारैर् मरीचिपैः
भृगुभिश् चाङ्गिरोभिश् च सर्वविद्यासुनिष्ठितैः //
text_mt:
with the Vaikhānasa and Vālakhilya hermits, those feeding on air, those drinking rays of light,
with the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases, completely established in all knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavidyādharaiḥ puṇyair yogasiddhibhir āvṛtaḥ
pitāmahaḥ pulastyaś ca pulahaś ca mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वविद्याधरैः पुण्यैर् योगसिद्धिभिर् आवृतः
पितामहः पुलस्त्यश् च पुलहश् च महातपाः //
text_mt:
surrounded by all the holy Vidyādharas endowed with yogic perfections,
the Grandfather [Brahmā], Pulastya, and Pulaha of great ascetic austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāḥ kaśyapo 'triś ca marīcir bhṛgur eva ca
kratur haraḥ pracetāś ca manur dakṣas tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अङ्गिराः कश्यपो ऽत्रिश् च मरीचिर् भृगुर् एव च
क्रतुर् हरः प्रचेताश् च मनुर् दक्षस् तथैव च //
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Kaśyapa, Atri, Marīci, and Bhṛgu,
Kratu, Hara, Pracetas, Manu, and likewise Dakṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtavaś ca grahāś caiva jyotīṃṣi ca dvijottamāḥ
mūrtimatyaś ca sarito devāś caiva sanātanāḥ //
meaning:
ऋतवश् च ग्रहाश् चैव ज्योतींषि च द्विजोत्तमाः
मूर्तिमत्यश् च सरितो देवाश् चैव सनातनाः //
text_mt:
and the seasons, the planets, the luminous bodies, O best of twice-borns,
and the rivers in embodied form, and the eternal gods,

sanskrit_iast:
samudrāś ca hradāś caiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca
pṛthivī dyaur diśaś caiva pādapāś ca dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
समुद्राश् च ह्रदाश् चैव तीर्थानि विविधानि च
पृथिवी द्यौर् दिशश् चैव पादपाश् च द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
oceans, lakes, and various sacred pilgrimage sites,
the earth, sky, directions, and trees, O best of twice-borns,

sanskrit_iast:
aditir devamātā ca hrīḥ śrīḥ svāhā sarasvatī
umā śacī sinīvālī tathā cānumatiḥ kuhūḥ //
meaning:
अदितिर् देवमाता च ह्रीः श्रीः स्वाहा सरस्वती
उमा शची सिनीवाली तथा चानुमतिः कुहूः //
text_mt:
Aditi the mother of the gods, Hrī, Śrī, Svāhā, Sarasvatī,
Umā, Śacī, Sinīvālī, and Anumati, and Kuhū,

sanskrit_iast:
rākā ca dhiṣaṇā caiva patnyaś cānyā divaukasām
himavāṃś caiva vindhyaś ca meruś cānekaśṛṅgavān //
meaning:
राका च धिषणा चैव पत्न्यश् चान्या दिवौकसाम्
हिमवांश् चैव विन्ध्यश् च मेरुश् चानेकशृङ्गवान् //
text_mt:
Rākā, Dhiṣaṇā, and the other wives of the dwellers in heaven,
Himavat, Vindhya, and Meru of many peaks,

sanskrit_iast:
airāvataḥ sānucaraḥ kalākāṣṭhās tathaiva ca
māsārdhaṃ māsa-ṛtavas tathā rātryahanī samāḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतः सानुचरः कलाकाष्ठास् तथैव च
मासार्धं मास-ऋतवस् तथा रात्र्यहनी समाः //
text_mt:
Airāvata with his attendants, and likewise the measures of time from kalās and kāṣṭhās,
half-months, months, seasons, as well as nights, days, and years,

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭho nāgarājaś ca vāmanaḥ
aruṇo garuḍaś caiva vṛkṣāś cauṣadhibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवा हयश्रेष्ठो नागराजश् च वामनः
अरुणो गरुडश् चैव वृक्षाश् चौषधिभिः सह //
text_mt:
Uccaiḥśravas the best of steeds, the serpent-king Vāmana,
Aruṇa, and Garuḍa, and the trees along with medicinal herbs,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaś ca bhagavān devaḥ samājagmur hi saṃgatāḥ
kālo yamaś ca mṛtyuś ca yamasyānucarāś ca ye //
meaning:
धर्मश् च भगवान् देवः समाजग्मुर् हि संगताः
कालो यमश् च मृत्युश् च यमस्यानुचराश् च ये //
text_mt:
and the divine Lord Dharma indeed assembled together;
Time, Yama, Death, and the attendants of Yama,

sanskrit_iast:
bahulatvāc ca noktā ye vividhā devatāgaṇāḥ
te devasyābhiṣekārthaṃ samāyānti tatas tataḥ //
meaning:
बहुलत्वाच् च नोक्ता ये विविधा देवतागणाः
ते देवस्याभिषेकार्थं समायान्ति ततस् ततः //
text_mt:
and the various hosts of deities who are not mentioned due to their abundance—
they arrive from here and there for the consecration of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā te tadā viprāḥ sarve devā divaukasaḥ
ābhiṣecanikaṃ dravyaṃ maṅgalāni ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा ते तदा विप्राः सर्वे देवा दिवौकसः
आभिषेचनिकं द्रव्यं मङ्गलानि च सर्वशः //
text_mt:
Then, O brāhmaṇas, all those gods, the dwellers of heaven,
having taken the material for the consecration and auspicious items on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
divyasaṃbhārasaṃyuktaiḥ kalaśaiḥ kāñcanair dvijāḥ
sārasvatībhiḥ puṇyābhir divyatoyābhir eva ca //
meaning:
दिव्यसंभारसंयुक्तैः कलशैः काञ्चनैर् द्विजाः
सारस्वतीभिः पुण्याभिर् दिव्यतोयाभिर् एव च //
text_mt:
with golden jars furnished with divine provisions, O twice-borns,
with the sacred waters of the Sarasvatī and divine waters,

sanskrit_iast:
toyenākāśagaṅgāyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam
sapuṣpaiḥ kāñcanaiḥ kumbhaiḥ snāpayanty avanisthitāḥ //
meaning:
तोयेनाकाशगङ्गायाः कृष्णं रामेण संगतम्
सपुष्पैः काञ्चनैः कुम्भैः स्नापयन्त्य् अवनिस्थिताः //
text_mt:
and with the water of the heavenly Gaṅgā, they bathe Kṛṣṇa joined with Rāma,
standing upon the earth, using golden pitchers mixed with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcaranti vimānāni devānām ambare tathā
uccāvacāni divyāni kāmagāni sthirāṇi ca //
meaning:
संचरन्ति विमानानि देवानाम् अम्बरे तथा
उच्चावचानि दिव्यानि कामगानि स्थिराणि च //
text_mt:
Then celestial chariots of the gods move about in the sky,
of various kinds, divine, moving at will, and steady,

sanskrit_iast:
divyaratnavicitrāṇi sevitāny apsarogaṇaiḥ
gītair vādyaiḥ patākābhiḥ śobhitāni samantataḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यरत्नविचित्राणि सेवितान्य् अप्सरोगणैः
गीतैर् वाद्यैः पताकाभिः शोभितानि समन्ततः //
text_mt:
variegated with divine jewels, frequented by groups of Apsarases,
and adorned all around with songs, musical instruments, and banners.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tadā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam
snāpayitvā subhadrāṃ ca saṃstuvanti mudānvitāḥ //
meaning:
एवं तदा मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कृष्णं रामेण संगतम्
स्नापयित्वा सुभद्रां च संस्तुवन्ति मुदान्विताः //
text_mt:
Thus then, O best of sages, having bathed Kṛṣṇa joined with Rāma,
and Subhadrā, they praise [them] filled with joy:

sanskrit_iast:
jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya saṃkarṣaṇānuja
jaya padmapalāśākṣa jaya vāñchāphalaprada //
meaning:
जय कृष्ण जगन्नाथ जय संकर्षणानुज
जय पद्मपलाशाक्ष जय वाञ्छाफलप्रद //
text_mt:
"Victory, O Kṛṣṇa, Lord of the Universe! Victory, O younger brother of Saṃkarṣaṇa!
Victory, O lotus-petal-eyed one! Victory, O bestower of the fruits of desires!

sanskrit_iast:
jaya mālāvṛtoraska jaya cakragadādhara
jaya padmālayākānta jaya viṣṇo namo 'stu te //
meaning:
जय मालावृतोरस्क जय चक्रगदाधर
जय पद्मालयाकान्त जय विष्णो नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
Victory, O one whose chest is encircled by garlands! Victory, O holder of the discus and mace!
Victory, O beloved of the one dwelling in a lotus! Victory, O Viṣṇu! Homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evaṃ stutvā tadā devāḥ śakrādyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ
siddhacāraṇasaṃghāś ca ye cānye svargavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
