text_mt: Those worlds in heaven that are heard of for people of meritorious deeds / do not equal a sixteenth part of Viṣṇu's realm, O Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hareḥ purasthānaṃ sarvabhogaguṇānvitam
sarvasaukhyakaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
एवं हरेः पुरस्थानं सर्वभोगगुणान्वितम्
सर्वसौख्यकरं पुण्यं सर्वाश्चर्यमयं द्विजाः //
text_mt: Thus the city and abode of Hari is endowed with all qualities of enjoyment, / conferring all happiness, meritorious, full of all wonders, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatra nāstikā yānti puruṣā viṣayātmakāḥ
na kṛtaghnā na piśunā no stenā nājitendriyāḥ //
meaning:
न तत्र नास्तिका यान्ति पुरुषा विषयात्मकाः
न कृतघ्ना न पिशुना नो स्तेना नाजितेन्द्रियाः //
text_mt: Atheists and men attached to sensual objects do not go there, / nor the ungrateful, nor slanderers, nor thieves, nor those with uncontrolled senses.

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'rcayanti sadā bhaktyā vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum
te tatra vaiṣṇavā yānti viṣṇulokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ये ऽर्चयन्ति सदा भक्त्या वासुदेवं जगद्गुरुम्
ते तत्र वैष्णवा यान्ति विष्णुलोकं न संशयः //
text_mt: Those Vaiṣṇavas who always worship Vāsudeva, the teacher of the world, with devotion, / go there to the realm of Viṣṇu; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre kṣetre paramadurlabhe
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणस्योदधेस् तीरे क्षेत्रे परमदुर्लभे
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं च रामं च सुभद्रां च द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: On the shore of the southern ocean, in that supreme, rare sacred field, / having seen Kṛṣṇa, Rāma, and Subhadrā, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpavṛkṣasamīpe tu ye tyajanti kalevaram
te tatra manujā yānti mṛtā ye puruṣottame //
meaning:
कल्पवृक्षसमीपे तु ये त्यजन्ति कलेवरम्
ते तत्र मनुजा यान्ति मृता ये पुरुषोत्तमे //
text_mt: those mortals who abandon their body near the wish-fulfilling tree, / having died in Puruṣottama, go there.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭasāgarayor madhye yaḥ smaret puruṣottamam
te 'pi tatra narā yānti ye mṛtāḥ puruṣottame //
meaning:
वटसागरयोर् मध्ये यः स्मरेत् पुरुषोत्तमम्
ते ऽपि तत्र नरा यान्ति ये मृताः पुरुषोत्तमे //
text_mt: Whoever remembers Puruṣottama between the banyan tree and the ocean, / those men too who have died in Puruṣottama go there;

sanskrit_iast:
te 'pi tatra paraṃ sthānaṃ yānti nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā viṣṇulokaḥ sanātanaḥ
sarvānandakaraḥ prokto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
ते ऽपि तत्र परं स्थानं यान्ति नास्त्य् अत्र संशयः
एवं मया मुनिश्रेष्ठा विष्णुलोकः सनातनः
सर्वानन्दकरः प्रोक्तो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः //
text_mt: they too go to that supreme place; there is no doubt about this. / Thus by me, O best of sages, the eternal realm of Viṣṇu has been proclaimed, / which brings all bliss and yields the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
bahvāścaryas tvayā prokto viṣṇuloko jagatpate
nityānandakaraḥ śrīmān bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
बह्वाश्चर्यस् त्वया प्रोक्तो विष्णुलोको जगत्पते
नित्यानन्दकरः श्रीमान् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः //
text_mt: The sages said: / You have described the realm of Viṣṇu, full of many wonders, O lord of the world, / conferring eternal bliss, glorious, yielding the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ ca durlabhaṃ loke kīrtitaṃ puruṣottamam
tyaktvā yatra naro dehaṃ yāti sālokyatāṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रं च दुर्लभं लोके कीर्तितं पुरुषोत्तमम्
त्यक्त्वा यत्र नरो देहं याति सालोक्यतां हरेः //
text_mt: And the rare sacred field in the world called Puruṣottama has been extolled, / abandoning his body in which a man goes to residence in the same world as Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
samyak kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā samyak prakīrtitam
yatra svadehasaṃtyāgād viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ //
meaning:
सम्यक् क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं त्वया सम्यक् प्रकीर्तितम्
यत्र स्वदेहसंत्यागाद् विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः //
text_mt: The greatness of the sacred field has been fully proclaimed by you, / where, through abandoning his own body, a man may go to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
aho mokṣasya mārgo 'yaṃ dehatyāgas tvayoditaḥ
narāṇām upakārāya puruṣākhye na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अहो मोक्षस्य मार्गो ऽयं देहत्यागस् त्वयोदितः
नराणाम् उपकाराय पुरुषाख्ये न संशयः //
text_mt: Ah, this path of liberation through casting off the body has been declared by you / for the benefit of men in [the field] named Puruṣa; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
anāyāsena deveśa dehaṃ tyaktvā narottamāḥ
tasmin kṣetre paraṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yānti nirāmayam //
meaning:
अनायासेन देवेश देहं त्यक्त्वा नरोत्तमाः
तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे परं विष्णोः पदं यान्ति निरामयम् //
text_mt: Having cast off their body effortlessly, O lord of gods, the best of men / in that sacred field attain Viṣṇu's supreme, disease-free abode.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vismayo no mahān abhūt
prayāgapuṣkarādīni kṣetrāṇy āyatanāni ca //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं विस्मयो नो महान् अभूत्
प्रयागपुष्करादीनि क्षेत्राण्य् आयतनानि च //
text_mt: Hearing the greatness of that sacred field, our wonder became great. / Sacred fields and shrines such as Prayāga and Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
na tathā tāni sarvāṇi praśaṃsasi surottama //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
न तथा तानि सर्वाणि प्रशंससि सुरोत्तम //
text_mt: all the tīrthas on the earth, rivers and lakes— / you do not praise all those in such a manner, O best of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ puruṣākhyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
jñāto 'smābhir abhiprāyas tavedānīṃ pitāmaha //
meaning:
यथा प्रशंससि क्षेत्रं पुरुषाख्यं पुनः पुनः
ज्ञातो ऽस्माभिर् अभिप्रायस् तवेदानीं पितामह //
text_mt: as you praise again and again the sacred field named Puruṣa. / Now your intention has been understood by us, O grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
yena praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam
puruṣākhyasamaṃ nūnaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsti mahītale
tena tvaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭha praśaṃsasi punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
येन प्रशंससि क्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं पुरुषोत्तमम्
पुरुषाख्यसमं नूनं क्षेत्रं नास्ति महीतले
तेन त्वं विबुधश्रेष्ठ प्रशंससि पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: the reason why you praise the sacred field Puruṣottama which gives liberation / is that there is surely no sacred field on the surface of the earth equal to that named Puruṣa; / therefore, O best of gods, you praise it again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
satyaṃ satyaṃ muniśreṣṭhā bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtam
puruṣākhyasamaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsty atra pṛthivītale //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सत्यं सत्यं मुनिश्रेष्ठा भवद्भिः समुदाहृतम्
पुरुषाख्यसमं क्षेत्रं नास्त्य् अत्र पृथिवीतले //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Truly, truly, O best of sages, what you have stated is correct!
There is no sacred place here on the surface of the earth equal to that called Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
santi yāni tu tīrthāni puṇyāny āyatanāni ca
tāni śrīpuruṣākhyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
सन्ति यानि तु तीर्थानि पुण्यान्य् आयतनानि च
तानि श्रीपुरुषाख्यस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् //
text_mt:
Whatever holy bathing-places and holy sanctuaries there are,
they do not equal a sixteenth part of the holy place named Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā sarveśvaro viṣṇuḥ sarvalokottamottamaḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
यथा सर्वेश्वरो विष्णुः सर्वलोकोत्तमोत्तमः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Viṣṇu, the lord of all, is highest of all the worlds,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityānāṃ yathā viṣṇuḥ śreṣṭhatve samudāhṛtaḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
आदित्यानां यथा विष्णुः श्रेष्ठत्वे समुदाहृतः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Viṣṇu is proclaimed the foremost among the Ādityas,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā somaḥ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
नक्षत्राणां यथा सोमः सरसां सागरो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Soma is [foremost] among the lunar mansions, and the ocean among lakes,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
vasūnāṃ pāvako yadvad rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaro yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
वसूनां पावको यद्वद् रुद्राणां शंकरो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as fire is [foremost] among the Vasus, and Śaṅkara among the Rudras,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvad vainateyaś ca pakṣiṇām
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यद्वद् वैनतेयश् च पक्षिणाम्
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the brāhmaṇa is [foremost] among the castes, and the son of Vinatā among birds,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhariṇāṃ yathā meruḥ parvatānāṃ himālayaḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
शिखरिणां यथा मेरुः पर्वतानां हिमालयः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Meru is [foremost] among peaks, and the Himālaya among mountains,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
pramadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīḥ saritāṃ jāhnavī yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
प्रमदानां यथा लक्ष्मीः सरितां जाह्नवी यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Lakṣmī is [foremost] among women, and the Jāhnavī among rivers,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgur yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां महर्षीणां भृगुर् यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Airāvata is [foremost] among lordly elephants, and Bhṛgu among the great sages,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
senānīnāṃ yathā skandaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
सेनानीनां यथा स्कन्दः सिद्धानां कपिलो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Skanda is [foremost] among generals, and Kapila among the perfected beings,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravā yathāśvānāṃ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवा यथाश्वानां कवीनाम् उशना कविः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Uccaiḥśravas is [foremost] among horses, and the sage Uśanas among poets,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
munīnāṃ ca yathā vyāsaḥ kubero yakṣarakṣasām
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
मुनीनां च यथा व्यासः कुबेरो यक्षरक्षसाम्
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Vyāsa is [foremost] among sages, and Kubera among Yakṣas and Rākṣasas,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyāṇāṃ mano yadvad bhūtānām avanī yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
इन्द्रियाणां मनो यद्वद् भूतानाम् अवनी यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the mind is [foremost] among the sense-faculties, and the earth among the elements,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ pavanaḥ plavatāṃ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां पवनः प्लवतां यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the holy fig tree is [foremost] among all trees, and the wind among sweeping things,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yathā cūḍāmaṇir dvijāḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
भूषणानां तु सर्वेषां यथा चूडामणिर् द्विजाः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the crest-jewel, O twice-born ones, is [foremost] among all ornaments,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ śastrāṇāṃ kuliśo yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः शस्त्राणां कुलिशो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Citraratha is [foremost] among the Gandharvas, and the thunderbolt among weapons,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
akāraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
अकारः सर्ववर्णानां गायत्री छन्दसां यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the letter 'A' is [foremost] among all letters, and the Gāyatrī among metres,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgebhyo yathā śreṣṭham uttamāṅgaṃ dvijottamāḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गेभ्यो यथा श्रेष्ठम् उत्तमाङ्गं द्विजोत्तमाः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the head is the highest among all limbs, O best of the twice-born,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatī yathā strīṇāṃ satīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat puruṣottamam //
meaning:
अरुन्धती यथा स्त्रीणां सतीनां श्रेष्ठतां गता
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां श्रेष्ठं तत् पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Arundhatī has attained pre-eminence among virtuous women,
so that Puruṣottama is the best among all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā samastavidyānāṃ mokṣavidyā parā smṛtā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat puruṣottamam //
meaning:
यथा समस्तविद्यानां मोक्षविद्या परा स्मृता
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां श्रेष्ठं तत् पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the science of liberation is considered supreme among all sciences,
so that Puruṣottama is the best among all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ yathā rājā dhenūnām api kāmadhuk
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
मनुष्याणां यथा राजा धेनूनाम् अपि कामधुक्
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the king is [foremost] among human beings, and the wish-yielding cow among cows,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇaṃ sarvaratnānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ vāsukir yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
सुवर्णं सर्वरत्नानां सर्पाणां वासुकिर् यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as gold is [foremost] among all jewels, and Vāsuki among serpents,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādaḥ sarvadaityānāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
प्रह्लादः सर्वदैत्यानां रामः शस्त्रभृतां यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Prahlāda is [foremost] among all Daityas, and Rāma among weapon-bearers,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaro yadvan mṛgāṇāṃ mṛgarāḍ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
झषाणां मकरो यद्वन् मृगाणां मृगराड् यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the Makara is [foremost] among water-creatures, and the lion among beasts,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
samudrāṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrodaḥ saritāṃ patiḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
समुद्राणां यथा श्रेष्ठः क्षीरोदः सरितां पतिः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the Milk Ocean, the lord of rivers, is the best among oceans,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇo yādasāṃ yadvad yamaḥ saṃyamināṃ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
वरुणो यादसां यद्वद् यमः संयमिनां यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Varuṇa is [foremost] among aquatic creatures, and Yama among the self-controlled,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣīṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭho nārado munisattamāḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
देवर्षीणां यथा श्रेष्ठो नारदो मुनिसत्तमाः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Nārada is the best among divine sages, O best of sages,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātūnāṃ kāñcanaṃ yadvat pavitrāṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
धातूनां काञ्चनं यद्वत् पवित्राणां च दक्षिणा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as gold is [foremost] among metals, and the sacrificial fee among purifying things,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatir yathā dakṣa ṛṣīṇāṃ kaśyapo yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
प्रजापतिर् यथा दक्ष ऋषीणां कश्यपो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Dakṣa is [foremost] among the lords of creatures, and Kaśyapa among the sages,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ bhāskaro yadvan mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
ग्रहाणां भास्करो यद्वन् मन्त्राणां प्रणवो यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as the sun is [foremost] among the planets, and the Praṇava among mantras,
so Puruṣottama is the most eminent of all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhas tu yajñānāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ kṣetraṃ ca tad dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
अश्वमेधस् तु यज्ञानां यथा श्रेष्ठः प्रकीर्तितः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां क्षेत्रं च तद् द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
Just as the horse-sacrifice is celebrated as the best among sacrifices,
so is that sacred place among all holy bathing-places, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhīnāṃ yathā dhānyaṃ tṛṇeṣu tṛṇarāḍ yathā
tathā samastatīrthānām uttamaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
ओषधीनां यथा धान्यं तृणेषु तृणराड् यथा
तथा समस्ततीर्थानाम् उत्तमं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as grain is [foremost] among plants, and the sugarcane among grasses,
so Puruṣottama is the best among all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā samastatīrthānāṃ dharmaḥ saṃsāratārakaḥ
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat puruṣottamam //
meaning:
यथा समस्ततीर्थानां धर्मः संसारतारकः
तथा समस्ततीर्थानां श्रेष्ठं तत् पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as dharma is what delivers [all] from cyclical existence above all holy bathing-places,
so that Puruṣottama is the best among all holy bathing-places.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
sarveṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ
japahomavratānāṃ ca tapodānaphalāni ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सर्वेषां चैव तीर्थानां क्षेत्राणां च द्विजोत्तमाः
जपहोमव्रतानां च तपोदानफलानि च //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
[Among] the fruits of all holy bathing-places and sacred sites, O best of the twice-born,
and of muttered prayers, fire-offerings, vows, asceticism, and gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
na tat paśyāmi bho viprā yat tena sadṛśaṃ bhuvi
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
न तत् पश्यामि भो विप्रा यत् तेन सदृशं भुवि
किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
I do not see that which is equal to it on earth, O brāhmaṇas!
What is the use of much being spoken and repeated again and again?

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tat paramaṃ mahat
puruṣākhyaṃ sakṛd dṛṣṭvā sāgarāmbhaḥsamāplutam //
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं क्षेत्रं तत् परमं महत्
पुरुषाख्यं सकृद् दृष्ट्वा सागराम्भःसमाप्लुतम् //
text_mt:
Truly, truly, and truly again: having beheld once that supreme, great sacred place
called Puruṣa, surrounded by the waters of the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavidyāṃ sakṛj jñātvā garbhavāso na vidyate
hareḥ saṃnihite sthāna uttame puruṣottame //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविद्यां सकृज् ज्ञात्वा गर्भवासो न विद्यते
हरेः संनिहिते स्थान उत्तमे पुरुषोत्तमे //
text_mt:
or having realized the knowledge of Brahman once, there is no more dwelling in a womb,
in the presence of Hari, in the highest dwelling of Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaram upāsīta māsamātram athāpi vā
tena japtaṃ hutaṃ tena tena taptaṃ tapo mahat //
meaning:
संवत्सरम् उपासीत मासमात्रम् अथापि वा
तेन जप्तं हुतं तेन तेन तप्तं तपो महत् //
text_mt:
Should one wait upon it for a year, or even for just a month,
by him the prayers have been muttered, the fire-offerings made, and great austerity performed.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ
bhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃś ca devayoṣitsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र योगेश्वरो हरिः
भुक्त्वा भोगान् विचित्रांश् च देवयोषित्समन्वितः //
text_mt:
He goes to the supreme abode where Hari, the lord of yoga, dwells,
having enjoyed diverse pleasures accompanied by celestial women.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpānte punar āgatya martyaloke narottamaḥ
jāyate yogināṃ viprā jñānajñeyodyato gṛhe //
meaning:
कल्पान्ते पुनर् आगत्य मर्त्यलोके नरोत्तमः
जायते योगिनां विप्रा ज्ञानज्ञेयोद्यतो गृहे //
text_mt:
Returning at the end of the kalpa to the mortal world as the best of men,
he is born, O brāhmaṇas, in a family of yogins, intent on knowledge and what is to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ hareḥ svacchandatāṃ vrajet
kalpavṛkṣasya rāmasya kṛṣṇasya bhadrayā saha //
meaning:
संप्राप्य वैष्णवं योगं हरेः स्वच्छन्दतां व्रजेत्
कल्पवृक्षस्य रामस्य कृष्णस्य भद्रया सह //
text_mt:
Having attained Vaiṣṇava yoga, he reaches freedom of will with Hari.
[The greatness] of the wish-granting tree, of Rāma, and of Kṛṣṇa along with Bhadrā,

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyendradyumnasya māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya ca
svargadvārasya māhātmyaṃ sāgarasya vidhiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयेन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यं माधवस्य च
स्वर्गद्वारस्य माहात्म्यं सागरस्य विधिः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
the greatness of Mārkaṇḍeya and Indradyumna, and of Mādhava,
the greatness of Svargadvāra, the ocean-ritual in proper sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
mārjanasya yathākāle bhāgīrathyāḥ samāgamam
sarvam etan mayā khyātaṃ yat paraṃ śrotum icchatha //
meaning:
मार्जनस्य यथाकाले भागीरथ्याः समागमम्
सर्वम् एतन् मया ख्यातं यत् परं श्रोतुम् इच्छथ //
text_mt:
the ritual ablution at the proper time, and the confluence of the Bhāgīrathī:
all this has been declared by me. What further do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumnasya māhātmyam etac ca kathitaṃ mayā
sarvāścaryaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ puruṣottamam
purāṇaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāramocanam //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यम् एतच् च कथितं मया
सर्वाश्चर्यं समाख्यातं रहस्यं पुरुषोत्तमम्
पुराणं परमं गुह्यं धन्यं संसारमोचनम् //

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
nahi nas tṛptir astīha śṛṇvatāṃ tīrthavistaram
punar eva paraṃ guhyaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ
paraṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
नहि नस् तृप्तिर् अस्तीह शृण्वतां तीर्थविस्तरम्
पुनर् एव परं गुह्यं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः
परं तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
Indeed, there is no satiety for us here as we listen to the full account of the holy bathing-place.
You ought to speak once more in full of the supreme secret,
the supreme greatness of the holy bathing-place, the best among all holy bathing-places!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
imam eva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo 'smi dvijasattamāḥ
nāradena prayatnena tadā taṃ proktavān aham //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इमम् एव पुरा प्रश्नं पृष्टो ऽस्मि द्विजसत्तमाः
नारदेन प्रयत्नेन तदा तं प्रोक्तवान् अहम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
In former times, best of the twice-born, I was asked this very question / by Nārada with great persistence; then I declared it to him.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
tapaso yajñadānānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam
sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tvatto jagadyone jagatpate //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
तपसो यज्ञदानानां तीर्थानां पावनं स्मृतम्
सर्वं श्रुतं मया त्वत्तो जगद्योने जगत्पते //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
The purifying power of asceticism, sacrifices, gifts, and tīrthas / has been traditionally taught; all this I have heard from you, O womb of the world, O lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
kiyanti santi tīrthāni svargamartyarasātale
sarveṣām eva tīrthānāṃ sarvadā kiṃ viśiṣyate //
meaning:
कियन्ति सन्ति तीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले
सर्वेषाम् एव तीर्थानां सर्वदा किं विशिष्यते //
text_mt: How many tīrthas are there in heaven, earth, and the underworld? / Among all tīrthas whatsoever, which one is always preeminent?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
caturvidhāni tīrthāni svarge martye rasātale
daivāni muniśārdūla āsurāṇy āruṣāṇi ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
चतुर्विधानि तीर्थानि स्वर्गे मर्त्ये रसातले
दैवानि मुनिशार्दूल आसुराण्य् आरुषाणि च //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There are four kinds of tīrthas in heaven, earth, and the underworld, / O tiger among sages: divine, asuric, and those of the ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣāṇi trilokeṣu vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ
mānuṣebhyaś ca tīrthebhya ārṣaṃ tīrtham anuttamam //
meaning:
मानुषाणि त्रिलोकेषु विख्यातानि सुरादिभिः
मानुषेभ्यश् च तीर्थेभ्य आर्षं तीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: and human ones, proclaimed across the three worlds by the gods and others. / Better than human tīrthas is an unexcelled ṛṣi tīrtha;

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣebhyaś caiva tīrthebhya āsuraṃ bahupuṇyadam
āsurebhyas tathā puṇyaṃ daivaṃ tat sārvakāmikam //
meaning:
आर्षेभ्यश् चैव तीर्थेभ्य आसुरं बहुपुण्यदम्
आसुरेभ्यस् तथा पुण्यं दैवं तत् सार्वकामिकम् //
text_mt: and yielding far more merit than ṛṣi tīrthas is an asuric one; / and holier than asuric ones is a divine one, which grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivaiś caiva nirmitaṃ daivam ucyate
tribhyo yad ekaṃ jāyeta tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवैश् चैव निर्मितं दैवम् उच्यते
त्रिभ्यो यद् एकं जायेत तस्मान् नातः परं विदुः //
text_mt: One made by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva is called divine; / that which arises from the three as one—they know nothing superior to that.

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇām api lokānāṃ tīrthaṃ medhyam udāhṛtam
tatrāpi jāmbavaṃ dvīpaṃ tīrthaṃ bahuguṇodayam //
meaning:
त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां तीर्थं मेध्यम् उदाहृतम्
तत्रापि जाम्बवं द्वीपं तीर्थं बहुगुणोदयम् //
text_mt: The holy place for all three worlds is declared to be [earth]; / and even there, the continent of Jambū is a tīrtha giving rise to many virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmbave bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
karmabhūmir yataḥ putra tasmāt tīrthaṃ tad ucyate //
meaning:
जाम्बवे भारतं वर्षं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्
कर्मभूमिर् यतः पुत्र तस्मात् तीर्थं तद् उच्यते //
text_mt: In Jambū[dvīpa], Bhāratavarṣa is a tīrtha celebrated in the three worlds; / because it is the land of action, my son, it is therefore called a tīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva yāni tīrthāni yāny uktāni mayā tava
himavadvindhyayor madhye ṣaṇnadyo devasaṃbhavāḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव यानि तीर्थानि यान्य् उक्तानि मया तव
हिमवद्विन्ध्ययोर् मध्ये षण्नद्यो देवसंभवाः //
text_mt: Right there are the tīrthas which were spoken of to you by me; / between the Himavat and Vindhya are six rivers born of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva devajā brahman dakṣiṇārṇavavindhyayoḥ
etā dvādaśa nadyas tu prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
तथैव देवजा ब्रह्मन् दक्षिणार्णवविन्ध्ययोः
एता द्वादश नद्यस् तु प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: and likewise [six] born of the gods between the southern ocean and the Vindhya, O brahmin; / these twelve rivers are proclaimed as foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
abhisaṃpūjitaṃ yasmād bhārataṃ bahupuṇyadam
karmabhūmir ato devair varṣaṃ tasmāt prakīrtitam //
meaning:
अभिसंपूजितं यस्माद् भारतं बहुपुण्यदम्
कर्मभूमिर् अतो देवैर् वर्षं तस्मात् प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Because it is venerated, yielding abundant merit, / and is the land of action, it is therefore celebrated by the gods as the [supreme] realm.

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣāṇi caiva tīrthāni devajāni kvacit kvacit
āsurair āvṛtāny āsaṃs tad evāsuram ucyate //
meaning:
आर्षाणि चैव तीर्थानि देवजानि क्वचित् क्वचित्
आसुरैर् आवृतान्य् आसंस् तद् एवासुरम् उच्यते //
text_mt: The ṛṣi tīrthas and those born of the gods were here and there / occupied by asuras; such a one is called asuric.

sanskrit_iast:
daiveṣv eva pradeśeṣu tapas taptvā maharṣayaḥ
daivaprabhāvāt tapasa ārṣāṇy api ca tāny api //
meaning:
दैवेष्व् एव प्रदेशेषु तपस् तप्त्वा महर्षयः
दैवप्रभावात् तपस आर्षाण्य् अपि च तान्य् अपि //
text_mt: In the very divine realms, having performed austerities, the great sages, / through the divine power of asceticism, made those into ṛṣi tīrthas as well.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaḥ śreyase muktyai pūjāyai bhūtaye 'thavā
ātmanaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ yaśaso 'vāptaye punaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनः श्रेयसे मुक्त्यै पूजायै भूतये ऽथवा
आत्मनः फलभूत्यर्थं यशसो ऽवाप्तये पुनः //
text_mt: For one's own welfare, liberation, worship, or prosperity, / or for the realization of one's own fruits, or again for the acquisition of fame,

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣaiḥ kāritāny āhur mānuṣāṇīti nārada
evaṃ caturvidho bhedas tīrthānāṃ munisattama //
meaning:
मानुषैः कारितान्य् आहुर् मानुषाणीति नारद
एवं चतुर्विधो भेदस् तीर्थानां मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: those established by men are called human tīrthas, O Nārada. / Such is the fourfold division of tīrthas, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
bhedaṃ na kaścij jānāti śrotuṃ yukto 'si nārada
bahavaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca
sukṛtī ko 'pi jānāti vaktuṃ śrotuṃ nijair guṇaiḥ //
meaning:
भेदं न कश्चिज् जानाति श्रोतुं युक्तो ऽसि नारद
बहवः पण्डितंमन्याः शृण्वन्ति कथयन्ति च
सुकृती को ऽपि जानाति वक्तुं श्रोतुं निजैर् गुणैः //
text_mt: No one knows this division; you are worthy to hear it, O Nārada. / Many who fancy themselves learned listen and recite, / but only some meritorious person, through his own virtues, knows how to speak and hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ bhedaṃ ca śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
yac chrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
तेषां स्वरूपं भेदं च श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः
यच् छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
I wish to hear in truth their nature and division, / by hearing which one is freed from all sins, of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
brahman kṛtayugādau tu upāyo 'nyo na vidyate
tīrthasevāṃ vinā svalpāyāsenābhīṣṭadāyinīm //
meaning:
ब्रह्मन् कृतयुगादौ तु उपायो ऽन्यो न विद्यते
तीर्थसेवां विना स्वल्पायासेनाभीष्टदायिनीम् //
text_mt: O Brahmā, in the Kṛta age and others, there is found no other means / yielding desired ends with little effort, apart from the service of tīrthas.

sanskrit_iast:
na tvayā sadṛśo dhātar vaktā jñātāthavā kvacit
tvaṃ nābhikamale viṣṇoḥ saṃjāto 'khilapūrvajaḥ //
meaning:
न त्वया सदृशो धातर् वक्ता ज्ञाताथवा क्वचित्
त्वं नाभिकमले विष्णोः संजातो ऽखिलपूर्वजः //
text_mt: There is no speaker or knower anywhere equal to you, O Creator; / you were born from the navel-lotus of Viṣṇu, the firstborn of all.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca veṇikā
tāpī payouṣṇī vindhyasya dakṣiṇe tu prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
गोदावरी भीमरथी तुङ्गभद्रा च वेणिका
तापी पयोउष्णी विन्ध्यस्य दक्षिणे तु प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
The Godāvarī, the Bhīmarathī, the Tuṅgabhadrā, and the Veṇikā, / the Tāpī, and the Payoṣṇī are proclaimed south of the Vindhya.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgīrathī narmadā tu yamunā ca sarasvatī
viśokā ca vitastā ca himavatparvatāśritāḥ //
meaning:
भागीरथी नर्मदा तु यमुना च सरस्वती
विशोका च वितस्ता च हिमवत्पर्वताश्रिताः //
text_mt: The Bhāgīrathī, the Narmadā, the Yamunā, and the Sarasvatī, / the Viśokā, and the Vitastā abide in the Himavat mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
etā nadyaḥ puṇyatamā devatīrthāny udāhṛtāḥ
gayaḥ kollāsuro vṛtras tripuro hy andhakas tathā //
meaning:
एता नद्यः पुण्यतमा देवतीर्थान्य् उदाहृताः
गयः कोल्लासुरो वृत्रस् त्रिपुरो ह्य् अन्धकस् तथा //
text_mt: These most sacred rivers are declared to be divine tīrthas. / Gaya, Kollāsura, Vṛtra, Tripura, and also Andhaka,

sanskrit_iast:
hayamūrdhā ca lavaṇo namuciḥ śṛṅgakas tathā
yamaḥ pātālaketuś ca mayaḥ puṣkara eva ca //
meaning:
हयमूर्धा च लवणो नमुचिः शृङ्गकस् तथा
यमः पातालकेतुश् च मयः पुष्कर एव च //
text_mt: Hayamūrdhan, Lavaṇa, Namuci, and also Śṛṅgaka, / Yama, Pātālaketu, Maya, and Puṣkara—

sanskrit_iast:
etair āvṛtatīrthāni āsurāṇi śubhāni ca
prabhāso bhārgavo 'gastir naranārāyaṇau tathā //
meaning:
एतैर् आवृततीर्थानि आसुराणि शुभानि च
प्रभासो भार्गवो ऽगस्तिर् नरनारायणौ तथा //
text_mt: the tīrthas occupied by these are auspicious asuric tīrthas. / Prabhāsa, Bhārgava, Agasti, and Nara-Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhaś ca bharadvājo gotamaḥ kaśyapo manuḥ
ityādimunijuṣṭāni ṛṣitīrthāni nārada //
meaning:
वसिष्ठश् च भरद्वाजो गोतमः कश्यपो मनुः
इत्यादिमुनिजुष्टानि ऋषितीर्थानि नारद //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, Bharadvāja, Gotama, Kaśyapa, and Manu— / the tīrthas frequented by such sages are ṛṣi tīrthas, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
ambarīṣo hariścandro māndhātā manur eva ca
kuruḥ kanakhalaś caiva bhadrāśvaḥ sagaras tathā //
meaning:
अम्बरीषो हरिश्चन्द्रो मान्धाता मनुर् एव च
कुरुः कनखलश् चैव भद्राश्वः सगरस् तथा //
text_mt: Ambarīṣa, Hariścandra, Māndhātṛ, Manu, / Kuru, Kanakhala, Bhadrāśva, and Sagara,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvayūpo nāciketā vṛṣākapir ariṃdamaḥ
ityādimānuṣair vipra nirmitāni śubhāni ca //
meaning:
अश्वयूपो नाचिकेता वृषाकपिर् अरिंदमः
इत्यादिमानुषैर् विप्र निर्मितानि शुभानि च //
text_mt: Aśvayūpa, Nāciketa, Vṛṣākapi, Ariṃdama— / auspicious ones constructed by such mortals, O brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśasaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ nirmitānīha nārada
svatoudbhūtāni daivāni yatra kvāpi jagattraye
puṇyatīrthāni tāny āhus tīrthabhedo mayoditaḥ //
meaning:
यशसः फलभूत्यर्थं निर्मितानीह नारद
स्वतोउद्भूतानि दैवानि यत्र क्वापि जगत्त्रये
पुण्यतीर्थानि तान्य् आहुस् तीर्थभेदो मयोदितः //
text_mt: constructed here for the attainment of fame and fruits, O Nārada. / Those arising spontaneously anywhere in the three worlds are divine; / they are called sacred tīrthas. Thus the division of tīrthas has been stated by me.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
tridaivatyaṃ tu yat tīrthaṃ sarvebhyo hy uktam uttamam
tasya svarūpabhedaṃ ca vistareṇa bravītu me //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
त्रिदैवत्यं तु यत् तीर्थं सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् उक्तम् उत्तमम्
तस्य स्वरूपभेदं च विस्तरेण ब्रवीतु मे //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
The tīrtha belonging to the three deities was declared the best of all; / let [the lord] tell me in detail its true nature and varieties.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tāvad anyāni tīrthāni tāvat tāḥ puṇyabhūmayaḥ
tāvad yajñādayo yāvat tridaivatyaṃ na dṛśyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तावद् अन्यानि तीर्थानि तावत् ताः पुण्यभूमयः
तावद् यज्ञादयो यावत् त्रिदैवत्यं न दृश्यते //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Other tīrthas last only so long, those sacred lands last only so long, / sacrifices and the like last only so long, as the shrine of the three deities is not seen.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgeyaṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvakāmapradāyinī
tridaivatyā muniśreṣṭha tadutpattim ataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
गङ्गेयं सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वकामप्रदायिनी
त्रिदैवत्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ तदुत्पत्तिम् अतः शृणु //
text_mt: This Gaṅgā is the foremost of rivers, bestowing all desires, / belonging to the three deities, O best of sages; hear now its origin.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇām ayutāt pūrvaṃ devakārya upasthite
tārako balavān āsīn madvarād atigarvitaḥ //
meaning:
वर्षाणाम् अयुतात् पूर्वं देवकार्य उपस्थिते
तारको बलवान् आसीन् मद्वराद् अतिगर्वितः //
text_mt: Ten thousand years ago, when the business of the gods was at hand, / Tāraka was mighty, excessively arrogant on account of my boon.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ paramaiśvaryaṃ hṛtaṃ tena balīyasā
tatas te śaraṇaṃ jagmur devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
देवानां परमैश्वर्यं हृतं तेन बलीयसा
ततस् ते शरणं जग्मुर् देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: The supreme sovereignty of the gods was seized by that powerful one; / then the gods, led by Indra, went for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ devaṃ jagatāṃ prapitāmaham
kṛtāñjalipuṭā devā viṣṇum ūcur ananyagāḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरोदशायिनं देवं जगतां प्रपितामहम्
कृताञ्जलिपुटा देवा विष्णुम् ऊचुर् अनन्यगाः //
text_mt: To the god resting upon the Milk Ocean, the great-grandfather of the worlds, / with folded palms, the gods, having no other recourse, spoke to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
tvaṃ trātā jagatāṃ nātha devānāṃ kīrtivardhana
sarveśvara jagadyone trayīmūrte namo 'stu te //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
त्वं त्राता जगतां नाथ देवानां कीर्तिवर्धन
सर्वेश्वर जगद्योने त्रयीमूर्ते नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
The gods said:
You are the protector, O lord of the worlds, increaser of the renown of the gods; / O lord of all, womb of the universe, embodiment of the three Vedas, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
lokasraṣṭāsurān hantā tvam eva jagatāṃ patiḥ
sthityutpattivināśānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ jaganmaya //
meaning:
लोकस्रष्टासुरान् हन्ता त्वम् एव जगतां पतिः
स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशानां कारणं त्वं जगन्मय //
text_mt: You are the creator of the worlds, slayer of asuras, the very lord of the universe; / you are the cause of maintenance, origination, and destruction, O you who are made of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
trātā na kopy asti jagattraye 'pi
śarīriṇāṃ sarvavipadgatānām
tvayā vinā vārijapattranetra
tāpatrayāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ na cānyat
meaning:
त्राता न कोप्य् अस्ति जगत्त्रये ऽपि
शरीरिणां सर्वविपद्गतानाम्
त्वया विना वारिजपत्त्रनेत्र
तापत्रयाणां शरणं न चान्यत्
text_mt: There is no protector anywhere in the three worlds / for embodied beings fallen into every calamity; / apart from you, O lotus-petal-eyed one, / there is no other refuge from the threefold afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā ca mātā jagato 'khilasya
tvam eva sevāsulabho 'si viṣṇo
prasīda pāhīśa mahābhayebhyo
śmadārtihantā vada kas tvadanyaḥ
meaning:
पिता च माता जगतो ऽखिलस्य
त्वम् एव सेवासुलभो ऽसि विष्णो
प्रसीद पाहीश महाभयेभ्यो
श्मदार्तिहन्ता वद कस् त्वदन्यः
text_mt: You alone are both father and mother of the entire universe, / easily attained through devotion, O Viṣṇu! / Be gracious, protect us, O Lord, from great terrors! / Tell us, who other than you is the destroyer of our distress?

sanskrit_iast:
ādikartā varāhas tvaṃ matsyaḥ kūrmas tathaiva ca
ityādirūpabhedair no rakṣase bhaya āgate //
meaning:
आदिकर्ता वराहस् त्वं मत्स्यः कूर्मस् तथैव च
इत्यादिरूपभेदैर् नो रक्षसे भय आगते //
text_mt: You are the primeval creator, the Boar, the Fish, and likewise the Tortoise; / by these and other various forms you protect us when danger has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtasvāmyān suragaṇān hṛtadārān gatāpadaḥ
kasmān na rakṣase deva ananyaśaraṇān hare //
meaning:
हृतस्वाम्यान् सुरगणान् हृतदारान् गतापदः
कस्मान् न रक्षसे देव अनन्यशरणान् हरे //
text_mt: Why do you not protect the hosts of gods, whose sovereignty has been stripped away, / whose wives have been seized, who are afflicted with disaster, having no other refuge, O Hari, O god?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ provāca bhagavāñ śeṣaśāyī jagatpatiḥ
kasmāc ca bhayam āpannaṃ tad bruvantu gatajvarāḥ
tataḥ śriyaḥ patiṃ prāhus taṃ tārakavadhaṃ prati //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः प्रोवाच भगवाञ् शेषशायी जगत्पतिः
कस्माच् च भयम् आपन्नं तद् ब्रुवन्तु गतज्वराः
ततः श्रियः पतिं प्राहुस् तं तारकवधं प्रति //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Then the Lord, who rests on Śeṣa, the ruler of the universe, spoke: / "From what has fear arisen? Let [you], freed from anxiety, tell that." / Then they spoke to the husband of Śrī regarding the slaying of Tāraka.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
tārakād bhayam āpannaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam
na yuddhais tapasā śāpair hantuṃ naiva kṣamā vayam //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
तारकाद् भयम् आपन्नं भीषणं रोमहर्षणम्
न युद्धैस् तपसा शापैर् हन्तुं नैव क्षमा वयम् //
text_mt:
The gods said:
Fear has arisen from Tāraka, terrible and hair-raising; / we are not able to kill him by battles, by austerity, or by curses.

sanskrit_iast:
arvāgdaśāhād yo bālas tasmān mṛtyum avāpsyati
tasmād deva na cānyebhyas tatra nītir vidhīyatām //
meaning:
अर्वाग्दशाहाद् यो बालस् तस्मान् मृत्युम् अवाप्स्यति
तस्माद् देव न चान्येभ्यस् तत्र नीतिर् विधीयताम् //
text_mt: He shall meet death [only] from a child who is less than ten days old; / therefore, O Lord, not by others. Let the policy for that be ordained!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
punar nārāyaṇaḥ prāha nāhaṃ balotkaṭaḥ surāḥ
na matto madapatyāc ca na devebhyo vadho bhavet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पुनर् नारायणः प्राह नाहं बलोत्कटः सुराः
न मत्तो मदपत्याच् च न देवेभ्यो वधो भवेत् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Again Nārāyaṇa spoke: "I am not vehemently strong [in this], O gods; / the slaying cannot be by me, nor from my offspring, nor from the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarād yadi jāyeta apatyaṃ bahuśaktikam
tasmād vadham avāpnoti tārako lokadāruṇaḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वराद् यदि जायेत अपत्यं बहुशक्तिकम्
तस्माद् वधम् अवाप्नोति तारको लोकदारुणः //
text_mt: "If a child endowed with great power should be born from the Lord, / from him Tāraka, the terror of the worlds, will meet his death.

sanskrit_iast:
tad gacchāmaḥ surāḥ sarve yatitum ṛṣibhiḥ saha
bhāryārthaṃ prathamo yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ prabhaviṣṇubhiḥ //
meaning:
तद् गच्छामः सुराः सर्वे यतितुम् ऋषिभिः सह
भार्यार्थं प्रथमो यत्नः कर्तव्यः प्रभविष्णुभिः //
text_mt: Therefore, O gods, let us all go to strive together with the sages; / an effort for a wife must first be made by the capable ones."

sanskrit_iast:
tathety uktvā suragaṇā jagmus te ca nagottamam
himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ menāṃ ca himavatpriyām //
meaning:
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणा जग्मुस् ते च नगोत्तमम्
हिमवन्तं रत्नमयं मेनां च हिमवत्प्रियाम् //
text_mt: Saying "So be it," the hosts of gods went to the best of mountains, / Himavat, filled with gems, and to Menā, beloved of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast: idam ūcuḥ sarva eva sabhāryaṃ tuhinaṃ girim //
meaning: इदम् ऊचुः सर्व एव सभार्यं तुहिनं गिरिम् //
text_mt: All of them together addressed the snowy mountain, along with his wife:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
dākṣāyaṇī lokamātā yā śaktiḥ saṃsthitā girau
buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtir medhā lajjā puṣṭiḥ sarasvatī //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
दाक्षायणी लोकमाता या शक्तिः संस्थिता गिरौ
बुद्धिः प्रज्ञा धृतिर् मेधा लज्जा पुष्टिः सरस्वती //
text_mt: The gods said: / "Daughter of Dakṣa, Mother of the Worlds, the power who resides on the mountain, / intelligence, wisdom, fortitude, intellect, modesty, nourishment, Sarasvatī—

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tv anekadhā loke yā sthitā lokapāvanī
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yuvayor garbham āviśat //
meaning:
एवं त्व् अनेकधा लोके या स्थिता लोकपावनी
देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं युवयोर् गर्भम् आविशत् //
text_mt: she who thus abides in many ways in the world, the purifier of the worlds, / has entered your womb for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
samutpannā jaganmātā śaṃbhoḥ patnī bhaviṣyati
asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ cāpi pālanī ca bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
समुत्पन्ना जगन्माता शंभोः पत्नी भविष्यति
अस्माकं भवतां चापि पालनी च भविष्यति //
text_mt: Born as the Mother of the Universe, she will become the wife of Śambhu, / and she will be the protector of both us and you."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
himavān api tad vākyaṃ surāṇām abhinandya ca
menā cāpi mahotsāhā astv ity evaṃ vaco 'bravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
हिमवान् अपि तद् वाक्यं सुराणाम् अभिनन्द्य च
मेना चापि महोत्साहा अस्त्व् इत्य् एवं वचो ऽब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Himavat too, welcoming those words of the gods, / and Menā with great joy, spoke this word: "So be it!"

sanskrit_iast:
tadotpannā jagaddhātrī gaurī himavato gṛhe
śivadhyānaratā nityaṃ tanniṣṭhā tanmanogatā //
meaning:
तदोत्पन्ना जगद्धात्री गौरी हिमवतो गृहे
शिवध्यानरता नित्यं तन्निष्ठा तन्मनोगता //
text_mt: Then Gaurī, the bearer of the universe, was born in the house of Himavat, / constantly devoted to meditation on Śiva, intent on him, her mind fixed on him.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ vai procuḥ suragaṇā īśārthe tapa āviśa
tathā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe gaurī tepe tapo mahat //
meaning:
तां वै प्रोचुः सुरगणा ईशार्थे तप आविश
तथा हिमवतः पृष्ठे गौरी तेपे तपो महत् //
text_mt: The hosts of gods said to her: "Undertake austerities for the sake of the Lord!" / Accordingly, Gaurī performed great austerities on the back of Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ saṃmantrayām āsur īśo dhyāyati tāṃ śivām
ātmānaṃ vā tathānyad vā na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ bhavaḥ //
meaning:
पुनः संमन्त्रयाम् आसुर् ईशो ध्यायति तां शिवाम्
आत्मानं वा तथान्यद् वा न जानीमः कथं भवः //
text_mt: Again they deliberated: "Does the Lord meditate on that auspicious lady, / or on himself, or on something else? We do not know how Bhava acts.

sanskrit_iast:
menakāyāḥ sutāyāṃ tu cittaṃ dadhyāt sureśvaraḥ
tatra nītir vidhātavyā tataḥ śraiṣṭhyam avāpsyatha
tataḥ prāha mahābuddhir vācaspatir udāradhīḥ //
meaning:
मेनकायाः सुतायां तु चित्तं दध्यात् सुरेश्वरः
तत्र नीतिर् विधातव्या ततः श्रैष्ठ्यम् अवाप्स्यथ
ततः प्राह महाबुद्धिर् वाचस्पतिर् उदारधीः //
text_mt: A policy must be devised so that the Lord of Gods / may fix his mind upon the daughter of Menakā; then you will achieve success." / Then the great-minded, generous-hearted Vācaspati spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatir uvāca
yas tv ayaṃ madano dhīmān kandarpaḥ puṣpacāpadhṛk
sa vidhyatu śivaṃ śāntaṃ bāṇaiḥ puṣpamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिर् उवाच
यस् त्व् अयं मदनो धीमान् कन्दर्पः पुष्पचापधृक्
स विध्यतु शिवं शान्तं बाणैः पुष्पमयैः शुभैः //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "Let wise Madana here, Kandarpa who holds the flower-bow, / pierce peaceful Śiva with his auspicious flower-arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tena viddhas trinetro 'pi īśāyāṃ buddhim ādadhet
pariṇeṣyaty asau nūnaṃ tadā tāṃ girijāṃ haraḥ //
meaning:
तेन विद्धस् त्रिनेत्रो ऽपि ईशायां बुद्धिम् आदधेत्
परिणेष्यत्य् असौ नूनं तदा तां गिरिजां हरः //
text_mt: Pierced by him, even the Three-Eyed Lord will direct his thoughts toward the Goddess; / then Hara will certainly take the Mountain's Daughter in marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
jayinaḥ pañcabāṇasya na bāṇāḥ kvāpi kuṇṭhitāḥ
tathoḍhāyāṃ jagaddhātryāṃ śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
जयिनः पञ्चबाणस्य न बाणाः क्वापि कुण्ठिताः
तथोढायां जगद्धात्र्यां शंभोः पुत्रो भविष्यति //
text_mt: The arrows of the victorious Five-Arrowed One are nowhere blunted; / and when the bearer of the universe is thus wedded, Śambhu will have a son.

sanskrit_iast:
jātaḥ putras trinetrasya tārakaṃ sa haniṣyati
vasantaṃ ca sahāyārthaṃ śobhiṣṭhaṃ kusumākaram //
meaning:
जातः पुत्रस् त्रिनेत्रस्य तारकं स हनिष्यति
वसन्तं च सहायार्थं शोभिष्ठं कुसुमाकरम् //
text_mt: The son born to the Three-Eyed Lord will slay Tāraka. / And as a companion, give him spring, most lovely, the season of flowers,

sanskrit_iast: āhlādanaṃ ca manasā kāmāyainaṃ prayacchatha //
meaning: आह्लादनं च मनसा कामायैनं प्रयच्छथ //
text_mt: delighting the mind—grant him to Kāma!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tathety uktvā suragaṇā madanaṃ kusumākaram
preṣayām āsur avyagrāḥ śivāntikam ariṃdamāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणा मदनं कुसुमाकरम्
प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अव्यग्राः शिवान्तिकम् अरिंदमाः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Saying "So be it," the hosts of gods, subduers of their foes, / sent Madana along with the season of flowers without hesitation to the presence of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jagāma tvarā kāmo dhṛtacāpo samādhavaḥ
ratyā ca sahitaḥ kāmaḥ kartuṃ karma suduṣkaram //
meaning:
स जगाम त्वरा कामो धृतचापो समाधवः
रत्या च सहितः कामः कर्तुं कर्म सुदुष्करम् //
text_mt: Kāma went in haste, holding his bow, accompanied by spring / and together with Ratī, to perform an exceedingly difficult deed.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpam idaṃ tasya mano 'bhavat
mayā vedhyas tv avedhyo vai śaṃbhur lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा सशरं चापम् इदं तस्य मनो ऽभवत्
मया वेध्यस् त्व् अवेध्यो वै शंभुर् लोकगुरुः प्रभुः //
text_mt: Taking his bow along with the arrow, this thought arose in his mind: / "Śambhu, the master and teacher of the world, is indeed invulnerable, yet he must be pierced by me!

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyajayino bāṇāḥ śaṃbhau me kiṃ dṛḍhā na vā
tenāsau cāgninetreṇa bhasmaśeṣas tadā kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यजयिनो बाणाः शंभौ मे किं दृढा न वा
तेनासौ चाग्निनेत्रेण भस्मशेषस् तदा कृतः //
text_mt: Are my arrows, conquerors of the three worlds, firm against Śambhu or not?" / Thereupon he was reduced to ashes by the Lord's fire-eye.

sanskrit_iast:
tad eva karma sudṛḍham īkṣituṃ surasattamāḥ
ājagmus tatra yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu vismayakārakam //
meaning:
तद् एव कर्म सुदृढम् ईक्षितुं सुरसत्तमाः
आजग्मुस् तत्र यद् वृत्तं शृणु विस्मयकारकम् //
text_mt: The foremost gods had arrived there to witness that very steadfast deed; / hear what happened there, which caused astonishment!

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbhuṃ dṛṣṭvā suragaṇā yāvat paśyanti manmatham
tāvac ca bhasmasādbhūtaṃ kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayāturāḥ
tuṣṭuvus tridaśeśānaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
शंभुं दृष्ट्वा सुरगणा यावत् पश्यन्ति मन्मथम्
तावच् च भस्मसाद्भूतं कामं दृष्ट्वा भयातुराः
तुष्टुवुस् त्रिदशेशानं कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सुराः //
text_mt: When the hosts of gods, having looked at Śambhu, turned their eyes to Manmatha, / seeing Kāma reduced to ashes, distressed with fear, / the gods praised the Lord of the Thirty with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
tārakād bhayam āpannaṃ kuru patnīṃ gireḥ sutām //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
तारकाद् भयम् आपन्नं कुरु पत्नीं गिरेः सुताम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / "Fear has befallen us from Tāraka; make the daughter of the mountain your wife!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
viddhacitto haro 'py āśu mene vākyaṃ suroditam
arundhatīṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca māṃ tu cakradharaṃ tathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
विद्धचित्तो हरो ऽप्य् आशु मेने वाक्यं सुरोदितम्
अरुन्धतीं वसिष्ठं च मां तु चक्रधरं तथा //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hara, his mind already pierced, swiftly accepted the word spoken by the gods. / The immortals sent Arundhatī, Vasiṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
preṣayām āsur amarā vivāhāya parasparam
saṃbandho 'pi tathāpy āsīd dhimavallokanāthayoḥ //
meaning:
प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अमरा विवाहाय परस्परम्
संबन्धो ऽपि तथाप्य् आसीद् धिमवल्लोकनाथयोः //
text_mt: me, and the Bearer of the Discus to one another for the marriage; / and thus the alliance was formed between Himavat and the Lord of the Worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
himavatparvate śreṣṭhe nānāratnavicitrite
nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānādvijaniṣevite //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
हिमवत्पर्वते श्रेष्ठे नानारत्नविचित्रिते
नानावृक्षलताकीर्णे नानाद्विजनिषेविते //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / On the excellent mountain Himavat, variegated with many gems, / crowded with various trees and creepers, frequented by various birds,

sanskrit_iast:
nadīnadasaraḥkūpataḍāgādibhir āvṛte
devagandharvayakṣādisiddhacāraṇasevite //
meaning:
नदीनदसरःकूपतडागादिभिर् आवृते
देवगन्धर्वयक्षादिसिद्धचारणसेविते //
text_mt: surrounded by rivers, streams, lakes, wells, and ponds, / attended by gods, gandharvas, yakṣas, siddhas, and cāraṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhamārutasaṃpanne harṣotkarṣaikakāraṇe
merumandarakailāsamainākādinagair vṛte //
meaning:
शुभमारुतसंपन्ने हर्षोत्कर्षैककारणे
मेरुमन्दरकैलासमैनाकादिनगैर् वृते //
text_mt: blessed with auspicious breezes, the sole cause of heights of joy, / surrounded by mountains such as Meru, Mandara, Kailāsa, and Maināka,

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhāgastyapaulastyalomaśādibhir āvṛte
mahotsave vartamāne vivāhaḥ samajāyata //
meaning:
वसिष्ठागस्त्यपौलस्त्यलोमशादिभिर् आवृते
महोत्सवे वर्तमाने विवाहः समजायत //
text_mt: thronged by Vasiṣṭha, Agastya, Paulastya, Lomaśa, and others, / while a great festival was underway, the marriage took place.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vedī ratnamayī śobhitā svarṇabhūṣitā
vajramāṇikyavaidūryatanmayastambhaśobhitā //
meaning:
तत्र वेदी रत्नमयी शोभिता स्वर्णभूषिता
वज्रमाणिक्यवैदूर्यतन्मयस्तम्भशोभिता //
text_mt: There stood an altar made of jewels, splendid, adorned with gold, / beautified by pillars made of diamonds, rubies, and lapis lazuli,

sanskrit_iast:
jayālakṣmīśubhākṣāntikīrtipuṣṭyādisaṃvṛtā
merumandarakailāsaraivataiḥ pariśobhitaiḥ //
meaning:
जयालक्ष्मीशुभाक्षान्तिकीर्तिपुष्ट्यादिसंवृता
मेरुमन्दरकैलासरैवतैः परिशोभितैः //
text_mt: attended by Jayā, Lakṣmī, Śubhā, Kṣānti, Kīrti, Puṣṭi, and others, / adorned by Meru, Mandara, Kailāsa, and Raivata.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjito lokanāthena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
mainākaḥ parvataśreṣṭho reje 'tīva hiraṇmayaḥ //
meaning:
पूजितो लोकनाथेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना
मैनाकः पर्वतश्रेष्ठो रेजे ऽतीव हिरण्मयः //
text_mt: Honored by Viṣṇu, the almighty Lord of the Worlds, / Maināka, the best of mountains, shone exceedingly, golden in splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayo lokapālāś ca ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ
vivāhe vedikāṃ cakrur devadevasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषयो लोकपालाश् च आदित्याः समरुद्गणाः
विवाहे वेदिकां चक्रुर् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt: The sages, the world-guardians, the Ādityas along with the hosts of Maruts, / prepared the altar for the marriage of the trident-bearing God of Gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmā svayaṃ tvaṣṭā vedīṃ cakre satoraṇām
surabhī nandinī nandā sunandā kāmadohinī //
meaning:
विश्वकर्मा स्वयं त्वष्टा वेदीं चक्रे सतोरणाम्
सुरभी नन्दिनी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदोहिनी //
text_mt: Viśvakarman, Tvaṣṭṛ himself, made the altar with archways; / Surabhī, Nandinī, Nandā, Sunandā, and Kāmadohinī—

sanskrit_iast:
ābhis tu śobhiteśānyā vivāhaḥ samajāyata
samudrāḥ sarito nāgā oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ //
meaning:
आभिस् तु शोभितेशान्या विवाहः समजायत
समुद्राः सरितो नागा ओषध्यो लोकमातरः //
text_mt: with these adorning the northeastern quarter, the marriage took place. / Oceans, rivers, nāgas, medicinal plants, the mothers of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
savanaspatibījāś ca sarve tatra samāyayuḥ
bhuvaḥ karma ilā cakre oṣadhyas tv annakarma ca //
meaning:
सवनस्पतिबीजाश् च सर्वे तत्र समाययुः
भुवः कर्म इला चक्रे ओषध्यस् त्व् अन्नकर्म च //
text_mt: together with trees and seeds—all came together there. / Ilā performed the service of the earth, and the medicinal plants performed the service of food;

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaḥ pānakarmāṇi dānakarma dhanādhipaḥ
agniś cakāra tatrānnaṃ yac ceṣṭaṃ lokanāthayoḥ //
meaning:
वरुणः पानकर्माणि दानकर्म धनाधिपः
अग्निश् चकार तत्रान्नं यच् चेष्टं लोकनाथयोः //
text_mt: Varuṇa took charge of drinks, and the Lord of Wealth took charge of gifts; / Agni prepared the food there which was dear to the two Lords of the World.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatra pṛthak pūjāṃ cakre viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
vedāś ca sarahasyā vai gāyanti ca hasanti ca //
meaning:
तत्र तत्र पृथक् पूजां चक्रे विष्णुः सनातनः
वेदाश् च सरहस्या वै गायन्ति च हसन्ति च //
text_mt: Everywhere eternal Viṣṇu offered worship separately, / while the Vedas together with their secret teachings sang and laughed;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyanty apsarasaḥ sarvā jagur gandharvakiṃnarāḥ
lājādhṛk cāpi maināko babhūva munisattama //
meaning:
नृत्यन्त्य् अप्सरसः सर्वा जगुर् गन्धर्वकिंनराः
लाजाधृक् चापि मैनाको बभूव मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: all the apsarases danced, and the gandharvas and kiṃnaras sang. / Maināka became the bearer of the parched grain, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāhavācanaṃ vṛttam antarveśmani nārada
vedikāyām upāviṣṭau daṃpatī surasattamau //
meaning:
पुण्याहवाचनं वृत्तम् अन्तर्वेश्मनि नारद
वेदिकायाम् उपाविष्टौ दंपती सुरसत्तमौ //
text_mt: The recitation of auspicious day was performed within the house, O Nārada; / the couple, foremost among gods, sat upon the altar.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpyāgniṃ vidhivad aśmānaṃ cāpi putraka
hutvā lājāṃś ca vidhivat pradakṣiṇam athākarot //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्याग्निं विधिवद् अश्मानं चापि पुत्रक
हुत्वा लाजांश् च विधिवत् प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत् //
text_mt: Having duly established the fire and the stone, O son, / and having duly offered parched grain into the fire, he then circumambulated it.

sanskrit_iast:
aśmanaḥ sparśahetoś ca devyaṅguṣṭhaṃ kare 'spṛśat
viṣṇunā preritaḥ śaṃbhur dakṣiṇasya padasya ca //
meaning:
अश्मनः स्पर्शहेतोश् च देव्यङ्गुष्ठं करे ऽस्पृशत्
विष्णुना प्रेरितः शंभुर् दक्षिणस्य पदस्य च //
text_mt: Prompted by Viṣṇu, Śambhu touched the toe / of the goddess's right foot with his hand for the purpose of touching the stone.

sanskrit_iast:
tām adarśam ahaṃ tatra homaṃ kurvan harāntike
dṛṣṭe 'ṅguṣṭhe duṣṭabuddhyā vīryaṃ susrāva me tadā //
meaning:
ताम् अदर्शम् अहं तत्र होमं कुर्वन् हरान्तिके
दृष्टे ऽङ्गुष्ठे दुष्टबुद्ध्या वीर्यं सुस्राव मे तदा //
text_mt: As I was offering the oblation there near Hara, I saw her; / when her big toe was seen, my semen flowed on account of a depraved mind.

sanskrit_iast:
lajjayā kaluṣībhūtaḥ skannaṃ vīryam acūrṇayam
madvīryāc cūrṇitāt sūkṣmād vālakhilyās tu jajñire //
meaning:
लज्जया कलुषीभूतः स्कन्नं वीर्यम् अचूर्णयम्
मद्वीर्याच् चूर्णितात् सूक्ष्माद् वालखिल्यास् तु जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Confused with shame, I crushed the fallen semen into powder; / from my semen crushed into minute particles, the Vālakhilyas were born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mahān abhūt tatra hāhākāraḥ suroditaḥ
lajjayā paribhūto 'haṃ nirgatas tu tadāsanāt //
meaning:
ततो महान् अभूत् तत्र हाहाकारः सुरोदितः
लज्जया परिभूतो ऽहं निर्गतस् तु तदासनात् //
text_mt: Then a great cry of dismay arose there, lamented loudly; / overcome with shame, I departed from that seat.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu nārada
gacchantaṃ māṃ mahādevo dṛṣṭvā nandinam abravīt //
meaning:
पश्यत्सु देवसंघेषु तूष्णींभूतेषु नारद
गच्छन्तं मां महादेवो दृष्ट्वा नन्दिनम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: While the hosts of gods looked on in silence, O Nārada, / Mahādeva, seeing me leaving, spoke to Nandin:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
brahmāṇam āhvayasveha gatapāpaṃ karomy aham
kṛtāparādhe 'pi jane santaḥ sakṛpamānasāḥ
mohayanty api vidvāṃsaṃ viṣayāṇām iyaṃ sthitiḥ //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
ब्रह्माणम् आह्वयस्वेह गतपापं करोम्य् अहम्
कृतापराधे ऽपि जने सन्तः सकृपमानसाः
मोहयन्त्य् अपि विद्वांसं विषयाणाम् इयं स्थितिः //
text_mt:
Śiva said:
"Call Brahmā here; I shall make him free from sin.
Even toward a person who has committed an offense, the virtuous are compassionate at heart.
Such is the nature of sensory objects: they bewilder even a learned man."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā sa bhagavān umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ
mamānukampayā caiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा स भगवान् उमया सहितः शिवः
ममानुकम्पया चैव लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus, the blessed Lord Śiva, together with Umā,
out of compassion for me and wishing for the welfare of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
etac cakāra lokeśaḥ śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ
pāpināṃ pāpamokṣāya bhūmir āpo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
एतच् चकार लोकेशः शृणु नारद यत्नतः
पापिनां पापमोक्षाय भूमिर् आपो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
The lord of the worlds did this; listen attentively, Nārada:
'For the release of sinners from sin, the earth will become water,

sanskrit_iast:
tayoś ca sārasarvasvam āhariṣyāmi pāvanam
evaṃ niścitya bhagavāṃs tayoḥ sāraṃ samāharat //
meaning:
तयोश् च सारसर्वस्वम् आहरिष्यामि पावनम्
एवं निश्चित्य भगवांस् तयोः सारं समाहरत् //
text_mt:
And I will extract the purifying essence of all things from both.'
Having so resolved, the Blessed One extracted the essence of both.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ kṛtvā tatrāpaḥ saṃniveśya ca
pāvamānyādibhiḥ sūktair abhimantrya ca yatnataḥ //
meaning:
भूमिं कमण्डलुं कृत्वा तत्रापः संनिवेश्य च
पावमान्यादिभिः सूक्तैर् अभिमन्त्र्य च यत्नतः //
text_mt:
Making the earth into a water-pot and placing the waters therein,
and consecrating them with care by means of the Pāvamānī and other hymns,

sanskrit_iast:
trijagatpāvanīṃ śaktiṃ tatra sasmāra pāpahā
mām uvāca sa lokeśo gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum //
meaning:
त्रिजगत्पावनीं शक्तिं तत्र सस्मार पापहा
माम् उवाच स लोकेशो गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम् //
text_mt:
The destroyer of sin remembered there the power that purifies the three worlds.
That lord of the worlds said to me: 'Take this water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo vai mātaro devyo bhūmir mātā tathāparā
sthityutpattivināśānāṃ hetutvam ubhayoḥ sthitam //
meaning:
आपो वै मातरो देव्यो भूमिर् माता तथापरा
स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशानां हेतुत्वम् उभयोः स्थितम् //
text_mt:
Water is indeed the divine mother, and earth is another mother;
the cause of preservation, origination, and destruction resides in both.

sanskrit_iast:
atra pratiṣṭhito dharmo hy atra yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ
atra bhuktiś ca muktiś ca sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अत्र प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो ह्य् अत्र यज्ञः सनातनः
अत्र भुक्तिश् च मुक्तिश् च स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा //
text_mt:
Here dharma is established, and here is the eternal sacrifice;
here are enjoyment and liberation, as well as the immobile and the mobile.

sanskrit_iast:
smaraṇān mānasaṃ pāpaṃ vacanād vācikaṃ tathā
snānapānābhiṣekāc ca praṇaśyaty api kāyikam //
meaning:
स्मरणान् मानसं पापं वचनाद् वाचिकं तथा
स्नानपानाभिषेकाच् च प्रणश्यत्य् अपि कायिकम् //
text_mt:
By remembering it, mental sin is destroyed; by speaking [its name], sin of speech;
and through bathing, drinking, and consecrating oneself, bodily sin also vanishes.

sanskrit_iast:
etad evāmṛtaṃ loke naitasmāt pāvanaṃ param
mayābhimantritaṃ brahman gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum //
meaning:
एतद् एवामृतं लोके नैतस्मात् पावनं परम्
मयाभिमन्त्रितं ब्रह्मन् गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम् //
text_mt:
This alone is nectar in the world; there is nothing more purifying than this.
It has been consecrated by me, O Brahmā; take this water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
atratyaṃ vāri yaḥ kaścit smared api paṭhed api
sa sarvakāmān āpnoti gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum //
meaning:
अत्रत्यं वारि यः कश्चित् स्मरेद् अपि पठेद् अपि
स सर्वकामान् आप्नोति गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम् //
text_mt:
Whosoever remembers or recites [the glory of] the water herein
attains all desires; take this water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtebhyaś cāpi pañcabhya āpo bhūtaṃ mahoditam
tāsām utkṛṣṭam etasmād gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum //
meaning:
भूतेभ्यश् चापि पञ्चभ्य आपो भूतं महोदितम्
तासाम् उत्कृष्टम् एतस्माद् गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम् //
text_mt:
And among the five gross elements, water is declared to be the greatest element;
from that comes this supreme [essence]; take this water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
atra yad vāri śobhiṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanam eva ca
spṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahman pāpād vimokṣyase //
meaning:
अत्र यद् वारि शोभिष्ठं पुण्यं पावनम् एव च
स्पृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च ब्रह्मन् पापाद् विमोक्ष्यसे //
text_mt:
By touching, remembering, and seeing the water herein,
which is most splendid, meritorious, and purifying, O Brahmā, you will be freed from sin.'

sanskrit_iast:
evam uktvā mahādevaḥ prādān mama kamaṇḍalum
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve bhaktyā procuḥ sureśvaram
āhlādaś ca mahāṃs tatra jayaśabdo vyavartata //
meaning:
एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवः प्रादान् मम कमण्डलुम्
ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे भक्त्या प्रोचुः सुरेश्वरम्
आह्लादश् च महांस् तत्र जयशब्दो व्यवर्तत //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Mahādeva gave me the water-pot.
Then all the hosts of gods spoke with devotion to the lord of the gods,
and there arose great rejoicing and shouts of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
devotsave mātur ajaḥ padāgraṃ
samīkṣya pāpāt patitatvam āpa
prādāt kṛpāluḥ smaraṇāt pavitrāṃ
gaṅgāṃ pitā puṇyakamaṇḍalusthām
meaning:
देवोत्सवे मातुर् अजः पदाग्रं
समीक्ष्य पापात् पतितत्वम् आप
प्रादात् कृपालुः स्मरणात् पवित्रां
गङ्गां पिता पुण्यकमण्डलुस्थाम्

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kamaṇḍalusthitā devī tava puṇyavivardhinī
yathā martyaṃ gatā nātha tan me vistarato vada //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कमण्डलुस्थिता देवी तव पुण्यविवर्धिनी
यथा मर्त्यं गता नाथ तन् मे विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
O lord, tell me in detail how that goddess, residing in the water-pot
and increasing your merit, went to the mortal realm.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
balir nāma mahādaityo devārir aparājitaḥ
dharmeṇa yaśasā caiva prajāsaṃrakṣaṇena ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
बलिर् नाम महादैत्यो देवारिर् अपराजितः
धर्मेण यशसा चैव प्रजासंरक्षणेन च //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There was a great daitya named Bali, an invincible enemy of the gods,
who, through dharma, renown, and the protection of his subjects,

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhaktyā ca satyena vīryeṇa ca balena ca
tyāgena kṣamayā caiva trailokye nopamīyate //
meaning:
गुरुभक्त्या च सत्येन वीर्येण च बलेन च
त्यागेन क्षमया चैव त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते //
text_mt:
As well as devotion to his guru, truthfulness, heroism, strength,
renunciation, and forbearance, was unequalled in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyarddhim unnatāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāś cintāparāyaṇāḥ
mithaḥ samūcur amarā jeṣyāmo vai kathaṃ balim //
meaning:
तस्यर्द्धिम् उन्नतां दृष्ट्वा देवाश् चिन्तापरायणाः
मिथः समूचुर् अमरा जेष्यामो वै कथं बलिम् //
text_mt:
Seeing his lofty prosperity, the gods were filled with anxiety;
the immortals said to one another, 'How indeed shall we conquer Bali?'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiñ śāsati rājyaṃ tu trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam
nārayo vyādhayo vāpi nādhayo vā kathaṃcana //
meaning:
तस्मिञ् शासति राज्यं तु त्रैलोक्यं हतकण्टकम्
नारयो व्याधयो वापि नाधयो वा कथंचन //
text_mt:
While he ruled the kingdom, the three worlds were free of thorns;
there were neither enemies nor diseases, nor mental afflictions of any kind.

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛṣṭir adharmo vā nāstiśabdo na durjanaḥ
svapne 'pi naiva dṛśyeta balau rājyaṃ praśāsati //
meaning:
अनावृष्टिर् अधर्मो वा नास्तिशब्दो न दुर्जनः
स्वप्ने ऽपि नैव दृश्येत बलौ राज्यं प्रशासति //
text_mt:
Drought or adharma, the words 'there is none', or a wicked person
were not seen even in a dream while Bali ruled the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyonnatiśarair bhagnāḥ kīrtikhaḍgadvidhākṛtāḥ
tasyājñāśaktibhinnāṅgā devāḥ śarma na lebhire //
meaning:
तस्योन्नतिशरैर् भग्नाः कीर्तिखड्गद्विधाकृताः
तस्याज्ञाशक्तिभिन्नाङ्गा देवाः शर्म न लेभिरे //
text_mt:
Broken by the arrows of his elevation, cleaved in two by the sword of his fame,
their limbs pierced by the spear of his command, the gods found no ease.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃmantrayām āsuḥ kṛtvā mātsaryam agrataḥ
tadyaśognipradīptāṅgā viṣṇuṃ jagmuḥ suvihvalāḥ //
meaning:
ततः संमन्त्रयाम् आसुः कृत्वा मात्सर्यम् अग्रतः
तद्यशोग्निप्रदीप्ताङ्गा विष्णुं जग्मुः सुविह्वलाः //
text_mt:
Then they took counsel together, putting jealousy in front;
their limbs scorched by the fire of his fame, utterly distraught, they went to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
ārtāḥ sma gatasattvāḥ sma śaṅkhacakragadādhara
asmadarthe bhavān nityam āyudhāni bibharti ca //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
आर्ताः स्म गतसत्त्वाः स्म शङ्खचक्रगदाधर
अस्मदर्थे भवान् नित्यम् आयुधानि बिभर्ति च //
text_mt:
The gods said:
"We are afflicted, our vitality is gone, O wielder of the conch, discus, and mace!
For our sake you constantly bear weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi nāthe jagannātha asmākaṃ duḥkham īdṛśam
tvāṃ tu praṇamatī vāṇī kathaṃ daityaṃ namasyati //
meaning:
त्वयि नाथे जगन्नाथ अस्माकं दुःखम् ईदृशम्
त्वां तु प्रणमती वाणी कथं दैत्यं नमस्यति //
text_mt:
While you are our lord, O Lord of the Universe, such is our sorrow!
How can the voice that bows to you offer homage to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
manasā karmaṇā vācā tvām eva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
tvadaṅghriśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा त्वाम् एव शरणं गताः
त्वदङ्घ्रिशरणाः सन्तः कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
With mind, deed, and speech we have taken refuge in you alone;
having your feet as our refuge, how can we bow to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
yajāmas tvāṃ mahāyajñair vadāmo vāgbhir acyuta
tvadekaśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
यजामस् त्वां महायज्ञैर् वदामो वाग्भिर् अच्युत
त्वदेकशरणाः सन्तः कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
We worship you with great sacrifices, we praise you with our words, O Acyuta;
having you as our sole refuge, how can we bow to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvīryam āśritā nityaṃ devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ
tvayā dattaṃ padaṃ prāpya kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
त्वद्वीर्यम् आश्रिता नित्यं देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
त्वया दत्तं पदं प्राप्य कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
Ever relying on your valour, the gods with Indra at their head,
having attained the status granted by you, how can we bow to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
sraṣṭā tvaṃ brahmamūrtyā tu viṣṇur bhūtvā tu rakṣasi
saṃhartā rudraśaktyā tvaṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
स्रष्टा त्वं ब्रह्ममूर्त्या तु विष्णुर् भूत्वा तु रक्षसि
संहर्ता रुद्रशक्त्या त्वं कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
You are the creator in the form of Brahmā, yet becoming Viṣṇu you protect,
and you are the destroyer by the power of Rudra; how can we bow to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke vinaiśvaryaṃ tu kiṃ phalam
hataiśvaryāḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यं कारणं लोके विनैश्वर्यं तु किं फलम्
हतैश्वर्याः सुरेशान कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
Sovereignty is the ground [of all] in the world; without sovereignty, what is the fruit?
Robbed of our sovereignty, O Lord of the gods, how can we bow to a daitya?

sanskrit_iast:
anādis tvaṃ jagaddhātar anantas tvaṃ jagadguruḥ
antavantam amuṃ śatruṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
अनादिस् त्वं जगद्धातर् अनन्तस् त्वं जगद्गुरुः
अन्तवन्तम् अमुं शत्रुं कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
You are beginningless, O supporter of the universe! You are endless, the teacher of the universe!
How can we bow to a daitya, to this mortal enemy?

sanskrit_iast:
tavaiśvaryeṇa puṣṭāṅgā jitvā trailokyam ojasā
sthirāḥ syāmaḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi //
meaning:
तवैश्वर्येण पुष्टाङ्गा जित्वा त्रैलोक्यम् ओजसा
स्थिराः स्यामः सुरेशान कथं दैत्यं नमेमहि //
text_mt:
May we, our limbs nourished by your majesty, having conquered the three worlds with your power,
stand firm, O Lord of the gods! How can we bow to a daitya?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity etad eva vacanaṃ śrutvā daiteyasūdanaḥ
uvāca sarvān amarān devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् एतद् एव वचनं श्रुत्वा दैतेयसूदनः
उवाच सर्वान् अमरान् देवानां कार्यसिद्धये //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing these very words, the slayer of the Daityas
spoke to all the immortals for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavān uvāca
madbhakto 'sau balir daityo hy avadhyo 'sau surāsuraiḥ
yathā bhavanto matpoṣyās tathā poṣyo balir mama //
meaning:
श्रीभगवान् उवाच
मद्भक्तो ऽसौ बलिर् दैत्यो ह्य् अवध्यो ऽसौ सुरासुरैः
यथा भवन्तो मत्पोष्यास् तथा पोष्यो बलिर् मम //
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
"That daitya Bali is my devotee; indeed, he is unslayable by gods or asuras.
Just as you are to be nurtured by me, so is Bali to be nurtured by me.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā tu saṃgaraṃ devā hatvā rājyaṃ triviṣṭape
baliṃ nibadhya mantroktyā rājyaṃ vaḥ pradadāmy aham //
meaning:
विना तु संगरं देवा हत्वा राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे
बलिं निबध्य मन्त्रोक्त्या राज्यं वः प्रददाम्य् अहम् //
text_mt:
Yet without a battle, O gods, having destroyed [his] rule in heaven
and having bound Bali by the utterance of mantras, I shall bestow the kingdom upon you."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ saṃjagmur divam eva hi
bhagavān api deveśo hy adityā garbham āviśat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः संजग्मुर् दिवम् एव हि
भगवान् अपि देवेशो ह्य् अदित्या गर्भम् आविशत् //

sanskrit_iast:
tasminn utpadyamāne tu utsavāś ca babhūvire
jāto 'sau vāmano brahman yajñeśo yajñapūruṣaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्न् उत्पद्यमाने तु उत्सवाश् च बभूविरे
जातो ऽसौ वामनो ब्रह्मन् यज्ञेशो यज्ञपूरुषः //
text_mt:
While he was being born, festivities occurred;
he was born as the Dwarf, O Nārada, the lord of sacrifice, the sacrificial Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn antare brahman hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ
balir balavatāṃ śreṣṭha ṛṣimukhyaiḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन् हयमेधाय दीक्षितः
बलिर् बलवतां श्रेष्ठ ऋषिमुख्यैः समाहितः //
text_mt:
In the meantime, O Nārada, consecrated for a horse-sacrifice
was Bali, the foremost of the mighty, attended by eminent sages

sanskrit_iast:
purodhasā ca śukreṇa vedavedāṅgavedinā
makhe tasmin vartamāne yajamāne balau tathā //
meaning:
पुरोधसा च शुक्रेण वेदवेदाङ्गवेदिना
मखे तस्मिन् वर्तमाने यजमाने बलौ तथा //
text_mt:
And by his family priest Śukra, who knew the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas.
While that sacrifice was proceeding, with Bali as the sacrificer,

sanskrit_iast:
ārtvijya ṛṣimukhye tu śukre tatra purodhasi
havirbhāgārtham āsannadevagandharvapannage //
meaning:
आर्त्विज्य ऋषिमुख्ये तु शुक्रे तत्र पुरोधसि
हविर्भागार्थम् आसन्नदेवगन्धर्वपन्नगे //
text_mt:
With eminent sages acting as priests, Śukra as the family priest,
and gods, gandharvas, and pannagas present for their share of the oblations,

sanskrit_iast:
dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ pūjā kriyatāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak
paripūrṇaṃ punaḥ pūrṇam evaṃ vākye pravartati //
meaning:
दीयतां भुज्यतां पूजा क्रियतां च पृथक् पृथक्
परिपूर्णं पुनः पूर्णम् एवं वाक्ये प्रवर्तति //
text_mt:
While the words 'Let it be given!', 'Let it be eaten!', 'Let worship be performed separately!',
and 'Full, full again!' were ringing out,

sanskrit_iast:
śanais taddeśam abhyāgād vāmanaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ
yajñavāṭam anuprāpto vāmanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
शनैस् तद्देशम् अभ्यागाद् वामनः सामगायनः
यज्ञवाटम् अनुप्राप्तो वामनश् चित्रकुण्डलः //
text_mt:
Slowly the Dwarf chanting the Sāman hymns came to that region;
the Dwarf, wearing splendid earrings, arrived at the sacrificial enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
praśaṃsamānas taṃ yajñaṃ vāmanaṃ prekṣya bhārgavaḥ
brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ vāmanaṃ daityasūdanam //
meaning:
प्रशंसमानस् तं यज्ञं वामनं प्रेक्ष्य भार्गवः
ब्रह्मरूपधरं देवं वामनं दैत्यसूदनम् //
text_mt:
Seeing the Dwarf who was praising that sacrifice,
Bhārgava, observing the god disguised as a brāhmaṇa, the Dwarf who slays the daityas,

sanskrit_iast:
dātāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ phalaṃ hantāraṃ rakṣasām
jñātvā tvarann athovāca rājānaṃ bhūritejasam //
meaning:
दातारं यज्ञतपसां फलं हन्तारं रक्षसाम्
ज्ञात्वा त्वरन्न् अथोवाच राजानं भूरितेजसम् //
text_mt:
The giver of the fruit of sacrifices and austerities, the destroyer of rakṣasas,
recognized him and hurriedly addressed the king of immense splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
jetāraṃ kṣatradharmeṇa dātāraṃ bhaktito dhanam
baliṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāryaṃ dīkṣitaṃ makhe //
meaning:
जेतारं क्षत्रधर्मेण दातारं भक्तितो धनम्
बलिं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं सभार्यं दीक्षितं मखे //
text_mt:
The conqueror through warrior-dharma, the giver of wealth out of devotion,
Bali, foremost of the strong, consecrated in the sacrifice together with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyantaṃ yajñapuruṣam utsṛjantaṃ haviḥ pṛthak
tam āha bhṛguśārdūlaḥ śukraḥ paramabuddhimān //
meaning:
ध्यायन्तं यज्ञपुरुषम् उत्सृजन्तं हविः पृथक्
तम् आह भृगुशार्दूलः शुक्रः परमबुद्धिमान् //
text_mt: To him, who was meditating upon the Yajñapuruṣa and pouring out oblation after oblation, / that tiger among the Bhṛgus, the supremely wise Śukra, said:

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca
yo 'sau tava makhaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vāmanākṛtiḥ
nāsau vipro bale satyaṃ yajñeśo yajñavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच
यो ऽसौ तव मखं प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणो वामनाकृतिः
नासौ विप्रो बले सत्यं यज्ञेशो यज्ञवाहनः //
text_mt: Śukra said: / 'That brāhmaṇa who has arrived at your sacrifice in the form of a dwarf / is no mere twice-born, Bali, in truth, but the Lord of Sacrifice who is borne by the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśus tvāṃ yācituṃ prāpto nūnaṃ devahitāya hi
mayā ca saha saṃmantrya paścād deyaṃ tvayā prabho //
meaning:
शिशुस् त्वां याचितुं प्राप्तो नूनं देवहिताय हि
मया च सह संमन्त्र्य पश्चाद् देयं त्वया प्रभो //
text_mt: A child has arrived to beg of you, surely for the sake of the gods. / You must consult with me first, O lord, and only then grant a gift.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
balis tu bhārgavaṃ prāha purodhasam ariṃdamaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
बलिस् तु भार्गवं प्राह पुरोधसम् अरिंदमः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / But Bali, the subduer of enemies, spoke to the descendant of Bhṛgu, his family priest:

sanskrit_iast:
balir uvāca
dhanyo 'haṃ mama yajñeśo gṛham āyāti mūrtimān
āgatya yācate kiṃcit kiṃ mantryam avaśiṣyate //
meaning:
बलिर् उवाच
धन्यो ऽहं मम यज्ञेशो गृहम् आयाति मूर्तिमान्
आगत्य याचते किंचित् किं मन्त्र्यम् अवशिष्यते //
text_mt: Bali said: / 'Blessed am I that the Lord of Sacrifice comes embodied to my house. / Having arrived, he begs for something; what remains there to consult about?'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā sabhāryo 'sau śukreṇa ca purodhasā
jagāma yatra viprendro vāmano 'ditinandanaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा सभार्यो ऽसौ शुक्रेण च पुरोधसा
जगाम यत्र विप्रेन्द्रो वामनो ऽदितिनन्दनः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, he, accompanied by his wife and the priest Śukra, / went to where the foremost of twice-born, the dwarf born of Aditi, was.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā kenārthitvaṃ tad ucyatām
vāmano 'pi tadā prāha padatrayamitāṃ bhuvam //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा केनार्थित्वं तद् उच्यताम्
वामनो ऽपि तदा प्राह पदत्रयमितां भुवम् //
text_mt: Having folded his hands in reverence, [he said,] 'Tell me what you desire.' / The dwarf then said, 'Ground measured by three strides.

sanskrit_iast:
dehi rājendra nānyena kāryam asti dhanena kim
tathety uktvā tu kalaśān nānāratnavibhūṣitāt //
meaning:
देहि राजेन्द्र नान्येन कार्यम् अस्ति धनेन किम्
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा तु कलशान् नानारत्नविभूषितात् //
text_mt: Give it to me, O king of kings; I have no need of any other wealth.' / Having said, 'So be it,' from a water-pot adorned with various jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
vāridhārāṃ puraskṛtya vāmanāya bhuvaṃ dadau
paśyatsu ṛṣimukhyeṣu śukre caiva purodhasi //
meaning:
वारिधारां पुरस्कृत्य वामनाय भुवं ददौ
पश्यत्सु ऋषिमुख्येषु शुक्रे चैव पुरोधसि //
text_mt: preceding it with a stream of water, he gave the earth to the dwarf, / while the foremost sages looked on, and the priest Śukra as well;

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatsu lokanātheṣu vāmanāya bhuvaṃ dadau
paśyatsu daityasaṃgheṣu jayaśabde pravartati //
meaning:
पश्यत्सु लोकनाथेषु वामनाय भुवं ददौ
पश्यत्सु दैत्यसंघेषु जयशब्दे प्रवर्तति //
text_mt: while the guardians of the world looked on, he gave the earth to the dwarf; / while the hosts of Daityas looked on, as the cry of 'Victory!' resounded.

sanskrit_iast:
śanais tu vāmanaḥ prāha svasti rājan sukhī bhava
dehi me saṃmitāṃ bhūmiṃ tripadām āśu gamyate //
meaning:
शनैस् तु वामनः प्राह स्वस्ति राजन् सुखी भव
देहि मे संमितां भूमिं त्रिपदाम् आशु गम्यते //
text_mt: Then the dwarf spoke softly, 'Hail, O king! Be happy! / Give me the measured earth; three strides will soon be taken.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathety uvāca daityeśo yāvat paśyati vāmanam
yajñeśo yajñapuruṣaś candrādityau stanāntare //
meaning:
तथेत्य् उवाच दैत्येशो यावत् पश्यति वामनम्
यज्ञेशो यज्ञपुरुषश् चन्द्रादित्यौ स्तनान्तरे //
text_mt: 'So be it,' said the lord of the Daityas. As he looked upon the dwarf, / the Lord of Sacrifice, the Yajñapuruṣa, grew into the form of the striding god,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā syātāṃ surā mūrdhni vavṛdhe vikramākṛtiḥ
anantaś cācyuto devo vikrānto vikramākṛtiḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā daityarāṭ prāha sabhāryo vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
यथा स्यातां सुरा मूर्ध्नि ववृधे विक्रमाकृतिः
अनन्तश् चाच्युतो देवो विक्रान्तो विक्रमाकृतिः
तं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यराट् प्राह सभार्यो विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: so that the sun and the moon were between his breasts and the gods were at his crown. / The infinite, unfailing god strode forth, in the form of the striding one. / Seeing him, the king of the Daityas, accompanied by his wife and filled with humility, said:

sanskrit_iast:
balir uvāca
kramasva viṣṇo lokeśa yāvacchaktyā jaganmaya
jitaṃ mayā sureśāna sarvabhāvena viśvakṛt //
meaning:
बलिर् उवाच
क्रमस्व विष्णो लोकेश यावच्छक्त्या जगन्मय
जितं मया सुरेशान सर्वभावेन विश्वकृत् //
text_mt: Bali said: / 'Stride forth, O Viṣṇu, O lord of the world, as much as you can, O you whose self is the world! / I have conquered, O lord of the gods, creator of all, with all my heart!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu viṣṇuḥ prāha mahākratuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु विष्णुः प्राह महाक्रतुः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / At the very time of his speech, Viṣṇu, the embodiment of the great sacrifice, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇur uvāca
daityeśvara mahābāho kramiṣye paśya daityarāṭ //
meaning:
विष्णुर् उवाच
दैत्येश्वर महाबाहो क्रमिष्ये पश्य दैत्यराट् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / 'O lord of the Daityas, O mighty-armed one, I shall stride forth; look, O king of the Daityas!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evaṃ vadantaṃ sa prāha krama viṣṇo punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवं वदन्तं स प्राह क्रम विष्णो पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / To him who was speaking thus, he said, 'Stride forth, O Viṣṇu, again and again!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kūrmapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyasya baliyajñe padaṃ nyasat
dvitīyaṃ tu padaṃ prāpa brahmalokaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
कूर्मपृष्ठे पदं न्यस्य बलियज्ञे पदं न्यसत्
द्वितीयं तु पदं प्राप ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Placing one foot on the back of the tortoise, he placed a foot upon Bali’s sacrifice. / His second foot reached the eternal world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyasya padasyātra sthānaṃ nāsty asureśvara
kva kramiṣye bhuvaṃ dehi baliṃ taṃ harir abravīt
vihasya balir apy āha sabhāryaḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयस्य पदस्यात्र स्थानं नास्त्य् असुरेश्वर
क्व क्रमिष्ये भुवं देहि बलिं तं हरिर् अब्रवीत्
विहस्य बलिर् अप्य् आह सभार्यः स कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: 'There is no place for a third foot here, O lord of the Asuras. / Where shall I step? Give me ground!' Hari said to Bali. / Bali too, smiling, along with his wife, with folded hands, replied:

sanskrit_iast:
balir uvāca
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ na sraṣṭāhaṃ sureśvara
tvaddoṣād alpam abhavat kiṃ karomi jaganmaya //
meaning:
बलिर् उवाच
त्वया सृष्टं जगत् सर्वं न स्रष्टाहं सुरेश्वर
त्वद्दोषाद् अल्पम् अभवत् किं करोमि जगन्मय //
