text_mt: Bali said: / 'The entire universe was created by you; I am not its creator, O lord of gods. / Through your own fault it became small; what can I do, O you whose self is the universe?

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi nānṛtapūrvaṃ kadācid vacmi keśava
satyavākyaṃ ca māṃ kurvan matpṛṣṭhe hi padaṃ nyasa //
meaning:
तथापि नानृतपूर्वं कदाचिद् वच्मि केशव
सत्यवाक्यं च मां कुर्वन् मत्पृष्ठे हि पदं न्यस //
text_mt: Even so, I have never spoken falsehood before, O Keśava. / Making me true to my word, place your foot upon my back!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃs trayīmūrtiḥ surārcitaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवांस् त्रयीमूर्तिः सुरार्चितः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then the blessed lord, whose form is the three Vedas and who is worshipped by the gods, was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavān uvāca
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te bhaktyā prīto 'smi daityarāṭ //
meaning:
भगवान् उवाच
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते भक्त्या प्रीतो ऽस्मि दैत्यराट् //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Choose a boon; may good fortune be yours! I am pleased with your devotion, O king of the Daityas!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
sa tu prāha jagannāthaṃ na yāce tvāṃ trivikramam
sa tu prādāt svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ prītaḥ san manasepsitam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
स तु प्राह जगन्नाथं न याचे त्वां त्रिविक्रमम्
स तु प्रादात् स्वयं विष्णुः प्रीतः सन् मनसेप्सितम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / He spoke to the lord of the world: 'I ask nothing of you, the three-striding one.' / Yet Viṣṇu himself, being pleased, granted the desire of his heart:

sanskrit_iast:
rasātalapatitvaṃ ca bhāvi cendrapadaṃ punaḥ
ātmādhipatyaṃ ca harir avināśi yaśo vibhuḥ //
meaning:
रसातलपतित्वं च भावि चेन्द्रपदं पुनः
आत्माधिपत्यं च हरिर् अविनाशि यशो विभुः //
text_mt: sovereignty over Rasātala, and the future position of Indra, / Hari, the all-pervading lord, granted him his own sovereignty and imperishable renown.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā baleḥ sarvaṃ sasutaṃ bhāryayānvitam
rasātale hariḥ sthāpya baliṃ tv amaravairiṇam //
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा बलेः सर्वं ससुतं भार्ययान्वितम्
रसातले हरिः स्थाप्य बलिं त्व् अमरवैरिणम् //
text_mt: Having thus given everything to Bali, Hari established Bali, the enemy of the immortals, / together with his son and accompanied by his wife, in Rasātala.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakratos tathā prādāt surarājyaṃ yathābhavam
etasminn antare tatra padaṃ prāgāt surārcitam //
meaning:
शतक्रतोस् तथा प्रादात् सुरराज्यं यथाभवम्
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र पदं प्रागात् सुरार्चितम् //
text_mt: And likewise he gave the kingdom of the gods to Śatakratu, as it had been before. / In the meantime, that foot worshipped by the gods reached there—

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ tat padaṃ viṣṇoḥ pitur mama mahāmate
yat padaṃ samanuprāptaṃ gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvāpy acintayam //
meaning:
द्वितीयं तत् पदं विष्णोः पितुर् मम महामते
यत् पदं समनुप्राप्तं गृहं दृष्ट्वाप्य् अचिन्तयम् //
text_mt: that second foot of Viṣṇu, my father, O highly wise one. / Seeing that foot that had arrived at my abode, I thought:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kṛtyaṃ yac chubhaṃ me syāt pade viṣṇoḥ samāgate
sarvasvaṃ ca samālokya śreṣṭho me syāt kamaṇḍaluḥ //
meaning:
किं कृत्यं यच् छुभं मे स्यात् पदे विष्णोः समागते
सर्वस्वं च समालोक्य श्रेष्ठो मे स्यात् कमण्डलुः //
text_mt: 'What auspicious thing should be done by me when the foot of Viṣṇu has arrived?' / Looking at all my possessions, [I thought] my water-pot would be the best,

sanskrit_iast:
tad vāri yat puṇyatamaṃ dattaṃ ca tripurāriṇā
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varaṃ śāntikaraṃ param //
meaning:
तद् वारि यत् पुण्यतमं दत्तं च त्रिपुरारिणा
वरं वरेण्यं वरदं वरं शान्तिकरं परम् //
text_mt: and the water within it, most holy, given by the enemy of Tripura, / excellent, worthy of choice, boon-granting, supreme, bringing peace, transcendent,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaṃ ca śubhadaṃ nityaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam
mātṛsvarūpaṃ lokānām amṛtaṃ bheṣajaṃ śuci //
meaning:
शुभं च शुभदं नित्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
मातृस्वरूपं लोकानाम् अमृतं भेषजं शुचि //
text_mt: auspicious and always granting good fortune, bestowing enjoyment and liberation, / embodying motherhood for the worlds, nectar, medicine, pure,

sanskrit_iast:
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ pūjyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ guṇānvitam
smaraṇād eva lokānāṃ pāvanaṃ kiṃ nu darśanāt //
meaning:
पवित्रं पावनं पूज्यं ज्येष्ठं श्रेष्ठं गुणान्वितम्
स्मरणाद् एव लोकानां पावनं किं नु दर्शनात् //
text_mt: holy, purifying, worshipful, foremost, best, endowed with virtues, / purifying for the worlds merely by remembrance, what then by sight?

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛg vāri śucir bhūtvā kalpaye 'rghāya me pituḥ
iti saṃcintya tad vāri gṛhītvārghāya kalpitam //
meaning:
तादृग् वारि शुचिर् भूत्वा कल्पये ऽर्घाय मे पितुः
इति संचिन्त्य तद् वारि गृहीत्वार्घाय कल्पितम् //
text_mt: 'Becoming pure, let me offer such water as a guest-offering for my father.' / Reflecting thus, taking that water, it was prepared for a guest-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoḥ pāde tu patitam arghavāri sumantritam
tad vāri patitaṃ merau caturdhā vyagamad bhuvam //
meaning:
विष्णोः पादे तु पतितम् अर्घवारि सुमन्त्रितम्
तद् वारि पतितं मेरौ चतुर्धा व्यगमद् भुवम् //
text_mt: The guest-offering water, consecrated with mantras, fell upon Viṣṇu’s foot. / That water, falling on Mount Meru, went in four directions upon the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve tu dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā
dakṣiṇe yat tu patitaṃ jaṭābhiḥ śaṃkaro mune //
meaning:
पूर्वे तु दक्षिणे चैव पश्चिमे चोत्तरे तथा
दक्षिणे यत् तु पतितं जटाभिः शंकरो मुने //
text_mt: to the east, to the south, to the west, and to the north. / That which fell to the south, O sage, Śaṅkara caught with his matted hair;

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha paścime yat tu punaḥ prāyāt kamaṇḍalum
uttare patitaṃ yat tu viṣṇur jagrāha taj jalam //
meaning:
जग्राह पश्चिमे यत् तु पुनः प्रायात् कमण्डलुम्
उत्तरे पतितं यत् तु विष्णुर् जग्राह तज् जलम् //
text_mt: that which fell to the west returned again into the water-pot; / that water which fell to the north, Viṣṇu caught;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasminn ṛṣayo devā pitaro lokapālakāḥ
jagṛhuḥ śubhadaṃ vāri tasmāc chreṣṭhaṃ tad ucyate //
meaning:
पूर्वस्मिन्न् ऋषयो देवा पितरो लोकपालकाः
जगृहुः शुभदं वारि तस्माच् छ्रेष्ठं तद् उच्यते //
text_mt: in the east, the sages, gods, ancestors, and world-guardians / took the auspicious water; therefore it is said to be the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
yā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ prāptā āpo vai lokamātaraḥ
viṣṇupādaprasūtās tā brahmaṇyā lokamātaraḥ //
meaning:
या दक्षिणां दिशं प्राप्ता आपो वै लोकमातरः
विष्णुपादप्रसूतास् ता ब्रह्मण्या लोकमातरः //
text_mt: The waters that went in the southern direction are indeed the mothers of the world; / born from the foot of Viṣṇu, they are sacred, the mothers of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvarajaṭāsaṃsthāḥ parvajātaśubhodayāḥ
tāsāṃ prabhāvasmaraṇāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
महेश्वरजटासंस्थाः पर्वजातशुभोदयाः
तासां प्रभावस्मरणात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: resting in the matted locks of Maheśvara, yielding auspicious rise at seasonal conjunctions. / From the remembrance of their majesty, one obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kamaṇḍalusthitā devī maheśvarajaṭāgatā
śrutā deva yathā martyam āgatā tad bravītu me //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कमण्डलुस्थिता देवी महेश्वरजटागता
श्रुता देव यथा मर्त्यम् आगता तद् ब्रवीतु मे //
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'The goddess who was in the water-pot and reached the matted locks of Maheśvara / has been heard of, O god; tell me how she came to the mortal realm.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā āpo devyo mahāmate
tāsāṃ ca dvividho bheda āhartur dvayakāraṇāt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
महेश्वरजटास्था या आपो देव्यो महामते
तासां च द्विविधो भेद आहर्तुर् द्वयकारणात् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Those divine waters resting in Maheśvara’s matted locks, O highly wise one, / have a twofold division on account of two bringers.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃśo brāhmaṇenātra vratadānasamādhinā
gotamena śivaṃ pūjya āhṛto lokaviśrutaḥ //
meaning:
एकांशो ब्राह्मणेनात्र व्रतदानसमाधिना
गोतमेन शिवं पूज्य आहृतो लोकविश्रुतः //
text_mt: One part was brought here by a brāhmaṇa, Gotama, renowned in the world, / after worshipping Śiva through vows, gifts, and meditative absorption.

sanskrit_iast:
aparas tu mahāprājña kṣatriyeṇa balīyasā
ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ tapobhir niyamais tathā //
meaning:
अपरस् तु महाप्राज्ञ क्षत्रियेण बलीयसा
आराध्य शंकरं देवं तपोभिर् नियमैस् तथा //
text_mt: The other part, O highly intelligent one, was brought by a mighty kṣatriya, / having propitiated the god Śaṅkara through austerities and observances—

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathena bhūpena āhṛto 'ṃśo 'paras tathā
evaṃ dvairūpyam abhavad gaṅgāyā munisattama //
meaning:
भगीरथेन भूपेन आहृतो ऽंशो ऽपरस् तथा
एवं द्वैरूप्यम् अभवद् गङ्गाया मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: the other part was thus brought by King Bhagīratha. / In this way there was a twofold nature of Gaṅgā, O best of sages.'

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā hetunā kena gautamaḥ
āhartā kṣatriyeṇāpi āhṛtā kena tad vada //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
महेश्वरजटास्था या हेतुना केन गौतमः
आहर्ता क्षत्रियेणापि आहृता केन तद् वद //
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'For what reason did Gautama bring the one that rested in Maheśvara’s matted locks? / And for what reason was [the other] brought by the kṣatriya? Tell me that!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
yathānītā purā vatsa brāhmaṇenetareṇa vā
tat sarvaṃ vistareṇāhaṃ vadiṣye prītaye tava //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
यथानीता पुरा वत्स ब्राह्मणेनेतरेण वा
तत् सर्वं विस्तरेणाहं वदिष्ये प्रीतये तव //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'How it was brought long ago, dear child, by the brāhmaṇa and by the other, / all that I shall tell in detail for your pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin kāle sureśasya umā patny abhavat priyā
tasminn evābhavad gaṅgā priyā śaṃbhor mahāmate //
meaning:
यस्मिन् काले सुरेशस्य उमा पत्न्य् अभवत् प्रिया
तस्मिन्न् एवाभवद् गङ्गा प्रिया शंभोर् महामते //
text_mt: At the time when Umā became the beloved wife of the lord of the gods, / at that very time, O highly wise one, Gaṅgā became the beloved of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
mama doṣāpanodāya cintayānaḥ śivas tadā
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān devīṃ prekṣya viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
मम दोषापनोदाय चिन्तयानः शिवस् तदा
उमया सहितः श्रीमान् देवीं प्रेक्ष्य विशेषतः //
text_mt: Meditating at that time upon the removal of my fault, the glorious Śiva, / together with Umā, looking especially upon the goddess—'

sanskrit_iast:
rasavṛttau sthito yasmān nirmame rasam uttamam
rasikatvāt priyatvāc ca straiṇatvāt pāvanatvataḥ //
meaning:
रसवृत्तौ स्थितो यस्मान् निर्ममे रसम् उत्तमम्
रसिकत्वात् प्रियत्वाच् च स्त्रैणत्वात् पावनत्वतः //
text_mt: Because he was engaged in an impassioned mood, he created the highest water; / out of connoisseurship, dear affection, fondness for women, and purity,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhyo hy adhikaprītir gaṅgābhūd dvijasattama
saivodbhūtā jaṭāmārgāt kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare
sa tu saṃgopayām āsa gaṅgāṃ śaṃbhur jaṭāgatām //
meaning:
सर्वाभ्यो ह्य् अधिकप्रीतिर् गङ्गाभूद् द्विजसत्तम
सैवोद्भूता जटामार्गात् कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे
स तु संगोपयाम् आस गङ्गां शंभुर् जटागताम् //
text_mt: the Gaṅgā became dearer to him than all others, O best of the twice-born. / She indeed emerged from the path of his matted hair on account of a certain other reason, / but Śaṃbhu concealed the Gaṅgā who had entered his matted hair.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasā ca dhṛtāṃ jñātvā na śaśāka umā tadā
soḍhuṃ brahmañ jaṭājūṭe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
शिरसा च धृतां ज्ञात्वा न शशाक उमा तदा
सोढुं ब्रह्मञ् जटाजूटे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Knowing that she was held on his head, Umā was unable / to bear it, O Brahmā, seeing her again and again standing in his mass of matted hair.

sanskrit_iast:
amarṣeṇa bhavaṃ gorī prerayasvety abhāṣata
naivāsau prairayac chaṃbhū rasiko rasam uttamam //
meaning:
अमर्षेण भवं गोरी प्रेरयस्वेत्य् अभाषत
नैवासौ प्रैरयच् छंभू रसिको रसम् उत्तमम् //
text_mt: In indignation Gaurī spoke to Bhava: “Send [her] away!” / But Śaṃbhu, the connoisseur of pleasure, did not at all send away that supreme water.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāsv eva tadā devīṃ gopāyantaṃ vimṛśya sā
vināyakaṃ jayāṃ skandaṃ raho vacanam abravīt //
meaning:
जटास्व् एव तदा देवीं गोपायन्तं विमृश्य सा
विनायकं जयां स्कन्दं रहो वचनम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Considering that he was concealing the goddess in his matted locks, / she spoke words in secret to Vināyaka, Jayā, and Skanda:

sanskrit_iast:
naivāyaṃ tridaśeśāno gaṅgāṃ tyajati kāmukaḥ
sāpi priyā śivasyādya kathaṃ tyajati tāṃ priyām //
meaning:
नैवायं त्रिदशेशानो गङ्गां त्यजति कामुकः
सापि प्रिया शिवस्याद्य कथं त्यजति तां प्रियाम् //
text_mt: “This passionate lord of the thirty [gods] does not let go of the Gaṅgā at all. / She too is dear to Śiva today; how will he abandon her who is so dear?

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vimṛśya bahuśo gaurī cāha vināyakam //
meaning: एवं विमृश्य बहुशो गौरी चाह विनायकम् //
text_mt: Having reflected thus many times, Gaurī said to Vināyaka:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvaty uvāca
na devair nāsurair yakṣair na siddhair bhavatāpi ca
na rājabhir athānyair vā na gaṅgāṃ tyajati prabhuḥ //
meaning:
पार्वत्य् उवाच
न देवैर् नासुरैर् यक्षैर् न सिद्धैर् भवतापि च
न राजभिर् अथान्यैर् वा न गङ्गां त्यजति प्रभुः //
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / “Not by the gods, not by the asuras, not by the yakṣas, nor by the siddhas, nor even by you, / nor by kings or others, will the lord abandon the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
punas tapsyāmi vā gatvā himavantaṃ nagottamam
athavā brāhmaṇaiḥ puṇyais tapobhir hatakalmaṣaiḥ //
meaning:
पुनस् तप्स्यामि वा गत्वा हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम्
अथवा ब्राह्मणैः पुण्यैस् तपोभिर् हतकल्मषैः //
text_mt: Either I will go again to Himavat, the highest of mountains, and perform austerities, / or else through meritorious brāhmaṇas whose taints are destroyed by their austerities—

sanskrit_iast: tair vā jaṭāsthitā gaṅgā prārthitā bhuvam āpnuyāt //
meaning: तैर् वा जटास्थिता गङ्गा प्रार्थिता भुवम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt: entreated by them, the Gaṅgā stationed in his matted hair might reach the earth.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etac chrutvā mātṛvākyaṃ mātaraṃ prāha vighnarāṭ
bhrātrā skandena jayayā saṃmantryeha ca yujyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतच् छ्रुत्वा मातृवाक्यं मातरं प्राह विघ्नराट्
भ्रात्रा स्कन्देन जयया संमन्त्र्येह च युज्यते //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing this word of his mother, the king of obstacles said to his mother: / “Consulting here with my brother Skanda and Jayā, this is fitting:

sanskrit_iast:
tat kurmo mastakād gaṅgāṃ yathā tyajati me pitā
etasminn antare brahmann anāvṛṣṭir ajāyata //
meaning:
तत् कुर्मो मस्तकाद् गङ्गां यथा त्यजति मे पिता
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन्न् अनावृष्टिर् अजायत //
text_mt: we shall act so that my father lets go of the Gaṅgā from his head.” / In the meantime, O Brahmā, a drought occurred,

sanskrit_iast:
dvir dvādaśa samā martye sarvaprāṇibhayāvahā
tato vinaṣṭam abhavaj jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
द्विर् द्वादश समा मर्त्ये सर्वप्राणिभयावहा
ततो विनष्टम् अभवज् जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: bringing fear to all living beings in the mortal world for twice twelve years. / Consequently, the world of mobile and immobile beings perished,

sanskrit_iast:
vinā tu gautamaṃ puṇyam āśramaṃ sarvakāmadam
sraṣṭukāmaḥ purā putra sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā //
meaning:
विना तु गौतमं पुण्यम् आश्रमं सर्वकामदम्
स्रष्टुकामः पुरा पुत्र स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा //
text_mt: except for the meritorious hermitage of Gautama which fulfills all desires. / In ancient times, wishing to create the immobile and mobile beings, O son,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛto yajño mayā pūrvaṃ sa devayajano giriḥ
mannāmā tatra vikhyātas tato brahmagiriḥ sadā //
meaning:
कृतो यज्ञो मया पूर्वं स देवयजनो गिरिः
मन्नामा तत्र विख्यातस् ततो ब्रह्मगिरिः सदा //
text_mt: a sacrifice was performed by me formerly. That mountain was the sacrificial ground of the gods; / well-known there by my name, it has ever since been called Brahmagiri.

sanskrit_iast:
tam āśritya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvadāste sa gautamaḥ
tasyāśrame mahāpuṇye śreṣṭhe brahmagirau śubhe //
meaning:
तम् आश्रित्य नगश्रेष्ठं सर्वदास्ते स गौतमः
तस्याश्रमे महापुण्ये श्रेष्ठे ब्रह्मगिरौ शुभे //
text_mt: Relying upon that best of mountains, Gautama always resides [there]. / In his most meritorious, excellent, and auspicious hermitage on Brahmagiri,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhayo vyādhayo vāpi durbhikṣaṃ vāpy avarṣaṇam
bhayaśokau ca dāridryaṃ na śrūyante kadācana //
meaning:
आधयो व्याधयो वापि दुर्भिक्षं वाप्य् अवर्षणम्
भयशोकौ च दारिद्र्यं न श्रूयन्ते कदाचन //
text_mt: mental afflictions or bodily diseases, famine or lack of rain, / fear, grief, and poverty are never heard of.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāśramaṃ vinānyatra havyaṃ vā kavyam eva ca
nāsti putra tathā dātā hotā yaṣṭā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
तदाश्रमं विनान्यत्र हव्यं वा कव्यम् एव च
नास्ति पुत्र तथा दाता होता यष्टा तथैव च //
text_mt: Except for his hermitage, nowhere else was there an offering to gods or ancestors, / nor, O son, was there a donor, an invoker, or a sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast:
yadaiva gautamo vipro dadāti ca juhoti ca
tadaivāpy ayanaṃ svarge surāṇām api nānyataḥ //
meaning:
यदैव गौतमो विप्रो ददाति च जुहोति च
तदैवाप्य् अयनं स्वर्गे सुराणाम् अपि नान्यतः //
text_mt: Only whenever the brāhmaṇa Gautama gives and makes offerings / is there nourishment even for the gods in heaven, not from anywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
devaloke 'pi martye vā śrūyate gautamo muniḥ
hotā dātā ca bhoktā ca sa eveti janā viduḥ //
meaning:
देवलोके ऽपि मर्त्ये वा श्रूयते गौतमो मुनिः
होता दाता च भोक्ता च स एवेति जना विदुः //
text_mt: Both in the realm of the gods and in the mortal world, the sage Gautama is celebrated; / people knew that he alone was the invoker, the donor, and the enjoyer.

sanskrit_iast:
tac chrutvā munayaḥ sarve nānāśramanivāsinaḥ
gautamāśramam āpṛcchann āgacchantas tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
तच् छ्रुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे नानाश्रमनिवासिनः
गौतमाश्रमम् आपृच्छन्न् आगच्छन्तस् तपोधनाः //
text_mt: Hearing that, all the sages residing in various hermitages, / rich in austerities, came inquiring about Gautama’s hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ munīnāṃ sarveṣām āgatānāṃ sa gautamaḥ
śiṣyavat putravad bhaktyā pitṛvat poṣako 'bhavat //
meaning:
तेषां मुनीनां सर्वेषाम् आगतानां स गौतमः
शिष्यवत् पुत्रवद् भक्त्या पितृवत् पोषको ऽभवत् //
text_mt: To all those sages who had arrived, that Gautama / became a nourisher like a father, with devotion like a disciple or a son.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yathepsitaṃ kāmaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam
yathānurūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ śuśrūṣām akaron muniḥ //
meaning:
यस्य यथेप्सितं कामं यथायोग्यं यथाक्रमम्
यथानुरूपं सर्वेषां शुश्रूषाम् अकरोन् मुनिः //
text_mt: According to each one’s desired wish, suitably, in due order, / and appropriately, the sage served them all.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñayā gautamasyāsann oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ
ārādhitāḥ punas tena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ //
meaning:
आज्ञया गौतमस्यासन्न् ओषध्यो लोकमातरः
आराधिताः पुनस् तेन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः //
text_mt: By Gautama's command, the nourishing plants became the mothers of the world. / Moreover, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara were worshipped by him.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyante ca tadauṣadhyo lūyante ca tadaiva hi
saṃpatsyante tadopyante gautamasya tapobalāt //
meaning:
जायन्ते च तदौषध्यो लूयन्ते च तदैव हि
संपत्स्यन्ते तदोप्यन्ते गौतमस्य तपोबलात् //
text_mt: Plants grew immediately and were harvested at that very time; / they ripened and were sown immediately, through the power of Gautama’s austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāḥ samṛddhayas tasya saṃsidhyante manogatāḥ
pratyahaṃ vakti vinayād gautamas tv āgatān munīn //
meaning:
सर्वाः समृद्धयस् तस्य संसिध्यन्ते मनोगताः
प्रत्यहं वक्ति विनयाद् गौतमस् त्व् आगतान् मुनीन् //
text_mt: All the bounties conceived in his mind were accomplished. / Everyday, Gautama spoke with humility to the sages who had arrived:

sanskrit_iast:
putravac chiṣyavac caiva preṣyavat karavāṇi kim
pitṛvat poṣayām āsa saṃvatsaragaṇān bahūn //
meaning:
पुत्रवच् छिष्यवच् चैव प्रेष्यवत् करवाणि किम्
पितृवत् पोषयाम् आस संवत्सरगणान् बहून् //
text_mt: “Like a son, like a disciple, and like a servant, what may I do [for you]?” / He nourished them like a father for many years.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vasatsu muniṣu trailokye khyātir āśrayāt
tato vināyakaḥ prāha mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ jayām //
meaning:
एवं वसत्सु मुनिषु त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातिर् आश्रयात्
ततो विनायकः प्राह मातरं भ्रातरं जयाम् //
text_mt: While the sages were residing thus, his fame spread in the three worlds because of their refuge. / Then Vināyaka spoke to his mother, his brother, and Jayā:

sanskrit_iast:
vināyaka uvāca
devānāṃ sadane mātar gīyate gautamo dvijaḥ
yan na sādhyaṃ suragaṇair gautamaḥ kṛtavān iti //
meaning:
विनायक उवाच
देवानां सदने मातर् गीयते गौतमो द्विजः
यन् न साध्यं सुरगणैर् गौतमः कृतवान् इति //
text_mt: Vināyaka said: / “In the abode of the gods, O mother, the twice-born Gautama is praised, / [saying] that Gautama has accomplished what could not be achieved by the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śrutaṃ mayā devi brāhmaṇasya tapobalam
sa vipraś cālayed enāṃ mātar gaṅgāṃ jaṭāgatām //
meaning:
एवं श्रुतं मया देवि ब्राह्मणस्य तपोबलम्
स विप्रश् चालयेद् एनां मातर् गङ्गां जटागताम् //
text_mt: Such is the power of the brāhmaṇa’s austerities heard by me, O goddess! / That brāhmaṇa could move this Gaṅgā who has entered the matted hair, O mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā vānyato vāpi pūjayitvā trilocanam
sa eva cyāvayed enāṃ jaṭāsthāṃ me pitṛpriyām //
meaning:
तपसा वान्यतो वापि पूजयित्वा त्रिलोचनम्
स एव च्यावयेद् एनां जटास्थां मे पितृप्रियाम् //
text_mt: Either through austerities or otherwise, having worshipped the three-eyed god, / he alone can dislodge her who stays in the matted locks, the beloved of my father.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nītir vidhātavyā tāṃ vipro yācayed yathā
tatprabhāvāt saricchreṣṭhā śiraso 'vataraty api //
meaning:
तत्र नीतिर् विधातव्या तां विप्रो याचयेद् यथा
तत्प्रभावात् सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा शिरसो ऽवतरत्य् अपि //
text_mt: A strategy must be devised there so that the brāhmaṇa will ask for her; / by his power, the best of rivers will indeed descend from the head.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā mātaraṃ bhrātrā jayayā saha vighnarāṭ
jagāma gautamo yatra brahmasūtradharaḥ kṛśaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा मातरं भ्रात्रा जयया सह विघ्नराट्
जगाम गौतमो यत्र ब्रह्मसूत्रधरः कृशः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus to his mother, the king of obstacles, together with his brother and Jayā, / went to where Gautama, wearing the sacred thread and emaciated, was residing.

sanskrit_iast:
vasan katipayāhaḥsu gautamāśramamaṇḍale
uvāca brāhmaṇān sarvāṃs tatra tatra ca vighnarāṭ //
meaning:
वसन् कतिपयाहःसु गौतमाश्रममण्डले
उवाच ब्राह्मणान् सर्वांस् तत्र तत्र च विघ्नराट् //
text_mt: Residing for a few days in the precinct of Gautama’s hermitage, / the king of obstacles spoke to all the brāhmaṇas here and there:

sanskrit_iast:
gacchāmaḥ svam adhiṣṭhānam āśramāṇi śucīni ca
puṣṭāḥ sma gautamānnena pṛcchāmo gautamaṃ munim //
meaning:
गच्छामः स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् आश्रमाणि शुचीनि च
पुष्टाः स्म गौतमान्नेन पृच्छामो गौतमं मुनिम् //
text_mt: “Let us go to our own abode and pure hermitages; / we have been nourished by Gautama’s food. Let us ask leave of the sage Gautama.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃmantrya pṛcchanti munayo munisattamāḥ
sa tān nivārayām āsa snehabuddhyā munīn pṛthak //
meaning:
इति संमन्त्र्य पृच्छन्ति मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः
स तान् निवारयाम् आस स्नेहबुद्ध्या मुनीन् पृथक् //
text_mt: Having deliberated thus, the sages, the best of sages, asked him; / but he restrained those sages individually with an attitude of affection.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
kṛtāñjaliḥ savinayam āsadhvam iha caiva hi
yuṣmaccaraṇaśuśrūṣāṃ karomi munipuṃgavāḥ //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
कृताञ्जलिः सविनयम् आसध्वम् इह चैव हि
युष्मच्चरणशुश्रूषां करोमि मुनिपुंगवाः //
text_mt: Gautama said / with folded hands and humility: “Remain right here; / I shall attend to the service of your feet, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣau putravan nityaṃ mayi tiṣṭhati nocitam
bhavatāṃ bhūmidevānām āśramāntarasevanam //
meaning:
शुश्रूषौ पुत्रवन् नित्यं मयि तिष्ठति नोचितम्
भवतां भूमिदेवानाम् आश्रमान्तरसेवनम् //
text_mt: While I am constantly present, eager to serve like a son, it is not proper / for you, the gods of the earth, to resort to another hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
idam evāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarveṣām iti me matiḥ
alam anyena munaya āśrameṇa gatena vā //
meaning:
इदम् एवाश्रमं पुण्यं सर्वेषाम् इति मे मतिः
अलम् अन्येन मुनय आश्रमेण गतेन वा //
text_mt: This very hermitage is meritorious for all—such is my conviction. / Enough of going to any other hermitage, O sages!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā muner vākyaṃ vighnakṛtyam anusmaran
uvāca prāñjalir bhūtvā brāhmaṇān sa gaṇādhipaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा मुनेर् वाक्यं विघ्नकृत्यम् अनुस्मरन्
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर् भूत्वा ब्राह्मणान् स गणाधिपः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing this statement of the sage and keeping his hindering mission in mind, / that leader of the gaṇas folded his hands and spoke to the brāhmaṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇādhipa uvāca
annakrītā vayaṃ kiṃ no nivārayata gautamaḥ
sāmnā naiva vayaṃ śaktā gantuṃ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam //
meaning:
गणाधिप उवाच
अन्नक्रीता वयं किं नो निवारयत गौतमः
साम्ना नैव वयं शक्ता गन्तुं स्वं स्वं निवेशनम् //
text_mt: The leader of the gaṇas said: / “Are we bought by his food that Gautama holds us back? / By peaceful persuasion we are not able to go each to our own dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
nāyam arhati daṇḍaṃ vā upakārī dvijottamaḥ
tasmād buddhyā vyavasyāmi tat sarvair anumanyatām //
meaning:
नायम् अर्हति दण्डं वा उपकारी द्विजोत्तमः
तस्माद् बुद्ध्या व्यवस्यामि तत् सर्वैर् अनुमन्यताम् //
text_mt: This best of twice-born is a benefactor and does not deserve punishment; / therefore, I shall resolve [this] through intellect; let that be agreed upon by all.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ sarve dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kriyatām ity anubruvan
etasya tūpakārāya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः सर्वे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः क्रियताम् इत्य् अनुब्रुवन्
एतस्य तूपकाराय लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then all the best twice-born said, “Let it be done / for his benefit, and with the desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śreyo yat syāt tathā kuru
brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā mene vākyaṃ gaṇādhipaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां च सर्वेषां श्रेयो यत् स्यात् तथा कुरु
ब्राह्मणानां वचः श्रुत्वा मेने वाक्यं गणाधिपः //
text_mt: Act in such a way that there may be the highest good for all the brāhmaṇas.” / Hearing the words of the brāhmaṇas, the leader of the gaṇas accepted their speech.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyaka uvāca
kriyate guṇarūpaṃ yad gautamasya viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
विनायक उवाच
क्रियते गुणरूपं यद् गौतमस्य विशेषतः //
text_mt: Vināyaka said: / “Whatever is done shall especially have the nature of a virtue for Gautama.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
anumānya dvijān sarvān punaḥ punar udāradhīḥ
svayaṃ ca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā praṇamya brāhmaṇān punaḥ
mātur mate sthito vidvāñ jayāṃ prāha gaṇeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अनुमान्य द्विजान् सर्वान् पुनः पुनर् उदारधीः
स्वयं च ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा प्रणम्य ब्राह्मणान् पुनः
मातुर् मते स्थितो विद्वाञ् जयां प्राह गणेश्वरः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having obtained the assent of all the twice-born again and again, the noble-minded one / himself became a brāhmaṇa; and having bowed to the brāhmaṇas again, / conforming to his mother’s wish, the wise lord of the gaṇas said to Jayā:

sanskrit_iast:
vināyaka uvāca
yathā nānyo vijānīte tathā kuru śubhānane
gorūpadhāriṇī gaccha gautamo yatra tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
विनायक उवाच
यथा नान्यो विजानीते तथा कुरु शुभानने
गोरूपधारिणी गच्छ गौतमो यत्र तिष्ठति //
text_mt: Vināyaka said: / “Act in such a way that no one else knows, O fair-faced one! / Assuming the form of a cow, go to where Gautama stands.”

sanskrit_iast:
śālīn khāda vināśyātha vikāraṃ kuru bhāmini
kṛte prahāre huṃkāre prekṣite cāpi kiṃcana
pata dīnaṃ svanaṃ kṛtvā na mriyasva na jīva ca //
meaning:
शालीन् खाद विनाश्याथ विकारं कुरु भामिनि
कृते प्रहारे हुंकारे प्रेक्षिते चापि किंचन
पत दीनं स्वनं कृत्वा न म्रियस्व न जीव च //
text_mt: "Eat the rice, destroy it, and then assume an unnatural state, O lovely lady! / When struck, threatened with a 'huṃ,' or even looked at in any way, / fall down uttering a piteous cry, neither dying nor remaining alive!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tathā cakāra vijayā vighneśvaramate sthitā
yatrāsīd gautamo vipro jayā gorūpadhāriṇī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथा चकार विजया विघ्नेश्वरमते स्थिता
यत्रासीद् गौतमो विप्रो जया गोरूपधारिणी //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / In this way did Vijayā act, abiding by the advice of the Lord of Obstacles; / Jayā, assuming the form of a cow, [went] to where the twice-born Gautama was.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma śālīn khādantī tāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ
gāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ vipras tāṃ tṛṇena nyavārayat //
meaning:
जगाम शालीन् खादन्ती तां ददर्श स गौतमः
गां दृष्ट्वा विकृतां विप्रस् तां तृणेन न्यवारयत् //
text_mt: She went, eating the rice; Gautama saw her. / Seeing the cow acting unnaturally, the twice-born turned her away with a blade of grass.

sanskrit_iast:
nivāryamāṇā sā tena svanaṃ kṛtvā papāta gauḥ
tasyāṃ tu patitāyāṃ ca hāhākāro mahān abhūt //
meaning:
निवार्यमाणा सा तेन स्वनं कृत्वा पपात गौः
तस्यां तु पतितायां च हाहाकारो महान् अभूत् //
text_mt: Being turned away by him, the cow uttered a cry and fell down. / And when she had fallen, a great clamor arose.

sanskrit_iast:
svanaṃ śrutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca gautamasya viceṣṭitam
vyathitā brāhmaṇāḥ prāhur vighnarājapuraskṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्वनं श्रुत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च गौतमस्य विचेष्टितम्
व्यथिता ब्राह्मणाः प्राहुर् विघ्नराजपुरस्कृताः //
text_mt: Having heard the cry and seen Gautama's deed, / the distressed brāhmaṇas, headed by the King of Obstacles, said:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ
ito gacchāmahe sarve na sthātavyaṃ tavāśrame
putravat poṣitāḥ sarve pṛṣṭo 'si munipuṃgava //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः
इतो गच्छामहे सर्वे न स्थातव्यं तवाश्रमे
पुत्रवत् पोषिताः सर्वे पृष्टो ऽसि मुनिपुंगव //
text_mt: The brāhmaṇas said: / "We are all departing from here; one must not stay in your hermitage. / We were all nurtured like sons; [yet now] you are questioned, O bull among sages."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā munir vākyaṃ viprāṇāṃ gacchatāṃ tadā
vajrāhata ivāsīt sa viprāṇāṃ purato 'patat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा मुनिर् वाक्यं विप्राणां गच्छतां तदा
वज्राहत इवासीत् स विप्राणां पुरतो ऽपतत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing this speech of the departing twice-born, the sage / became as if struck by a thunderbolt and fell before the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tam ūcur brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paśyemāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi
rudrāṇāṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ jagatāṃ pāvanīṃ priyām //
meaning:
तम् ऊचुर् ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे पश्येमां पतितां भुवि
रुद्राणां मातरं देवीं जगतां पावनीं प्रियाम् //
text_mt: All the brāhmaṇas said to him: "Behold her fallen upon the earth— / the mother of the Rudras, the goddess, the purifier and beloved of the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthadevasvarūpiṇyām asyāṃ gavi vidher balāt
patitāyāṃ muniśreṣṭha gantavyam avaśiṣyate //
meaning:
तीर्थदेवस्वरूपिण्याम् अस्यां गवि विधेर् बलात्
पतितायां मुनिश्रेष्ठ गन्तव्यम् अवशिष्यते //
text_mt: Since this cow, who embodies holy sites and deities, has fallen through the force of fate, / O best of sages, nothing remains for us but to depart.

sanskrit_iast:
cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ kṣayaṃ yāti yathā vāsas tvadāśrame
vayaṃ nānyadhanā brahman kevalaṃ tu tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
चीर्णं व्रतं क्षयं याति यथा वासस् त्वदाश्रमे
वयं नान्यधना ब्रह्मन् केवलं तु तपोधनाः //
text_mt: A vow that has been performed goes to ruin, as does residence in your hermitage. / We have no other wealth, O brāhmaṇa, but only the wealth of asceticism."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sthitvā vinītaḥ prāha gautamaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
विप्राणां पुरतः स्थित्वा विनीतः प्राह गौतमः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Standing before the twice-born, Gautama humbly spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
bhavanta eva śaraṇaṃ pūtaṃ māṃ kartum arhatha //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
भवन्त एव शरणं पूतं मां कर्तुम् अर्हथ //
text_mt: Gautama said: / "You alone are my refuge; you ought to make me pure."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vighnarāḍ brāhmaṇair vṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् विघ्नराड् ब्राह्मणैर् वृतः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then the blessed King of Obstacles, surrounded by the brāhmaṇas, said:

sanskrit_iast:
vighnarāja uvāca
naiveyaṃ mriyate tatra naiva jīvati tatra kim
vadāmo 'smin susaṃdigdhe niṣkṛtiṃ gatim eva vā //
meaning:
विघ्नराज उवाच
नैवेयं म्रियते तत्र नैव जीवति तत्र किम्
वदामो ऽस्मिन् सुसंदिग्धे निष्कृतिं गतिम् एव वा //
text_mt: The King of Obstacles said: / "She is neither dying in this case, nor is she living; in this case, what / expiation or course of action can we declare in a matter so doubtful?"

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
katham utthāsyatīyaṃ gaur atha cāsmiṃś ca niṣkṛtim
vaktum arhatha tat sarvaṃ kariṣye 'ham asaṃśayam //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
कथम् उत्थास्यतीयं गौर् अथ चास्मिंश् च निष्कृतिम्
वक्तुम् अर्हथ तत् सर्वं करिष्ये ऽहम् असंशयम् //
text_mt: Gautama said: / "How will this cow rise up, and what is the expiation for this? / You ought to tell me all that; I will do it without a doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ
sarveṣāṃ ca matenāyaṃ vadiṣyati ca buddhimān
etad vākyam athāsmākaṃ pramāṇaṃ tava gautama //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः
सर्वेषां च मतेनायं वदिष्यति च बुद्धिमान्
एतद् वाक्यम् अथास्माकं प्रमाणं तव गौतम //
text_mt: The brāhmaṇas said: / "With the agreement of all, this wise one will speak. / Then his speech will be our authority and yours, O Gautama."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
brāhmaṇaiḥ preryamāṇo 'sau gautamena balīyasā
vighnakṛd brahmavapuṣā prāha sarvān idaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ब्राह्मणैः प्रेर्यमाणो ऽसौ गौतमेन बलीयसा
विघ्नकृद् ब्रह्मवपुषा प्राह सर्वान् इदं वचः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Urged on by the brāhmaṇas and by the mighty Gautama, / the creator of obstacles, having the form of a brāhmaṇa, spoke this word to all:

sanskrit_iast:
vighnarāja uvāca
sarveṣāṃ ca matenāhaṃ vadiṣyāmi yathārthavat
anumanyantu munayo madvākyaṃ gautamo 'pi ca //
meaning:
विघ्नराज उवाच
सर्वेषां च मतेनाहं वदिष्यामि यथार्थवत्
अनुमन्यन्तु मुनयो मद्वाक्यं गौतमो ऽपि च //
text_mt: The King of Obstacles said: / "With the agreement of all, I shall speak truthfully; / let the sages, and Gautama as well, assent to my word.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvarajaṭājūṭe brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
kamaṇḍalusthitaṃ vāri tiṣṭhatīti hi śuśruma //
meaning:
महेश्वरजटाजूटे ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
कमण्डलुस्थितं वारि तिष्ठतीति हि शुश्रुम //
text_mt: In the matted locks of Maheśvara there resides the water / that was in the water-pot of Brahmā of unmanifest birth—so indeed we have heard.

sanskrit_iast:
tad ānayasva tarasā tapasā niyamena ca
tenābhiṣiñca gām etāṃ bhagavan bhuvam āśritām
tato vatsyāmahe sarve pūrvavat tava veśmani //
meaning:
तद् आनयस्व तरसा तपसा नियमेन च
तेनाभिषिञ्च गाम् एतां भगवन् भुवम् आश्रिताम्
ततो वत्स्यामहे सर्वे पूर्ववत् तव वेश्मनि //
text_mt: Bring that [water] swiftly by means of asceticism and observance! / With it, sprinkle this cow who has taken to the earth, O venerable one; / then we shall all dwell in your abode as before."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktavati viprendre brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi
tatrāpatat puṣpavṛṣṭir jayaśabdo vyavardhata
tataḥ kṛtāñjalir namro gautamo vākyam abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्तवति विप्रेन्द्रे ब्राह्मणानां च संसदि
तत्रापतत् पुष्पवृष्टिर् जयशब्दो व्यवर्धत
ततः कृताञ्जलिर् नम्रो गौतमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / When the foremost twice-born had spoken thus in the assembly of the brāhmaṇas, / a shower of flowers fell there, and the shout of 'victory' increased. / Then, with joined palms, bowed low, Gautama spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
tapasāgniprasādena devabrahmaprasādataḥ
bhavatāṃ ca prasādena matsaṃkalpo 'nusidhyatām //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
तपसाग्निप्रसादेन देवब्रह्मप्रसादतः
भवतां च प्रसादेन मत्संकल्पो ऽनुसिध्यताम् //
text_mt: Gautama said: / "Through asceticism, through the favor of fire, through the favor of the gods and Brahmā, / and through the favor of you all, let my resolve be accomplished!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam astv iti taṃ viprā āpṛcchan munipuṃgavam
svāni sthānāni te jagmuḥ samṛddhāny annavāribhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् अस्त्व् इति तं विप्रा आपृच्छन् मुनिपुंगवम्
स्वानि स्थानानि ते जग्मुः समृद्धान्य् अन्नवारिभिः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Saying 'So be it,' the twice-born took leave of that bull among sages; / they went to their own places, abundant in food and water.

sanskrit_iast:
yāteṣu teṣu vipreṣu bhrātrā saha gaṇeśvaraḥ
jayayā saha suprītaḥ kṛtakṛtyo nyavartata //
meaning:
यातेषु तेषु विप्रेषु भ्रात्रा सह गणेश्वरः
जयया सह सुप्रीतः कृतकृत्यो न्यवर्तत //
text_mt: When those twice-born had departed, the Lord of Gaṇas, along with his brother / and with Jayā, greatly pleased, returned, having accomplished his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu brahmavṛndeṣu gaṇeśe ca gate tathā
gautamo 'pi muniśreṣṭhas tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ //
meaning:
गतेषु ब्रह्मवृन्देषु गणेशे च गते तथा
गौतमो ऽपि मुनिश्रेष्ठस् तपसा हतकल्मषः //
text_mt: When the hosts of brāhmaṇas had gone, and when Gaṇeśa had likewise gone, / Gautama too, the best of sages, whose blemishes were destroyed by asceticism,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyaṃs tadarthaṃ sa muniḥ kim idaṃ mama saṃsthitam
ity evaṃ bahuśo dhyāyañ jñānena jñātavān dvija //
meaning:
ध्यायंस् तदर्थं स मुनिः किम् इदं मम संस्थितम्
इत्य् एवं बहुशो ध्यायञ् ज्ञानेन ज्ञातवान् द्विज //
text_mt: meditating upon the matter, [pondered,] 'What is this situation of mine?' / Meditating thus repeatedly, the twice-born understood it by means of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
niścitya devakāryārtham ātmanaḥ kilbiṣāṃ gatim
lokānām upakāraṃ ca śaṃbhoḥ prīṇanam eva ca //
meaning:
निश्चित्य देवकार्यार्थम् आत्मनः किल्बिषां गतिम्
लोकानाम् उपकारं च शंभोः प्रीणनम् एव च //
text_mt: Having resolved upon the work of the gods, his own sinful state, / the welfare of the worlds, the pleasing of Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
umāyāḥ prīṇanaṃ cāpi gaṅgānayanam eva ca
sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ manye mayi naiva ca kilbiṣam //
meaning:
उमायाः प्रीणनं चापि गङ्गानयनम् एव च
सर्वं श्रेयस्करं मन्ये मयि नैव च किल्बिषम् //
text_mt: and the pleasing of Umā, as well as the bringing of the Gaṅgā: / 'I consider all this to be conducive to the highest good; there is no sin in me at all.'

sanskrit_iast:
ity evaṃ manasā dhyāyan suprīto 'bhūd dvijottamaḥ
ārādhya jagatām īśaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
इत्य् एवं मनसा ध्यायन् सुप्रीतो ऽभूद् द्विजोत्तमः
आराध्य जगताम् ईशं त्रिनेत्रं वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: Meditating thus in his mind, the best of the twice-born became exceedingly pleased. / 'Having propitiated the three-eyed Lord of the worlds, who has the bull for his emblem,

sanskrit_iast:
ānayiṣye saricchreṣṭhāṃ prītā 'stu girijā mama
sapatnī jagadambāyā maheśvarajaṭāsthitā //
meaning:
आनयिष्ये सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां प्रीता ऽस्तु गिरिजा मम
सपत्नी जगदम्बाया महेश्वरजटास्थिता //
text_mt: I shall bring the best of rivers; let the daughter of the mountain be pleased with me— / she who is the co-wife of the Mother of the World, residing in the matted locks of Maheśvara.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi saṃkalpya munipravīraḥ
sa gautamo brahmagirer jagāma
kailāsam ādhiṣṭhitam ugradhanvanā
surārcitaṃ priyayā brahmavṛndaiḥ
meaning:
एवं हि संकल्प्य मुनिप्रवीरः
स गौतमो ब्रह्मगिरेर् जगाम
कैलासम् आधिष्ठितम् उग्रधन्वना
सुरार्चितं प्रियया ब्रह्मवृन्दैः
text_mt: Having thus made his resolve, that hero among sages, / Gautama, went from Brahmagiri / to Kailāsa, presided over by the one who bears the terrible bow, / worshipped by the gods, [accompanied] by his beloved and by hosts of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kailāsaśikharaṃ gatvā gautamo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
kiṃ cakāra tapo vāpi kāṃ cakre stutim uttamām //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कैलासशिखरं गत्वा गौतमो भगवान् ऋषिः
किं चकार तपो वापि कां चक्रे स्तुतिम् उत्तमाम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Having gone to the summit of Kailāsa, what asceticism did the venerable ṛṣi / Gautama perform, or what excellent hymn of praise did he recite?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
giriṃ gatvā tato vatsa vācaṃ saṃyamya gautamaḥ
āstīrya sa kuśān prājñaḥ kailāse parvatottame //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
गिरिं गत्वा ततो वत्स वाचं संयम्य गौतमः
आस्तीर्य स कुशान् प्राज्ञः कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having gone to the mountain, my child, Gautama, restraining his speech, / the wise one, having strewn kuśa grass on Kailāsa, the excellent mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
upaviśya śucir bhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato jagau
apatat puṣpavṛṣṭiś ca stūyamāne maheśvare //
meaning:
उपविश्य शुचिर् भूत्वा स्तोत्रं चेदं ततो जगौ
अपतत् पुष्पवृष्टिश् च स्तूयमाने महेश्वरे //
text_mt: and sat down, having become purified, then sang this hymn of praise; / and a shower of flowers fell while Maheśvara was being praised.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
bhogārthināṃ bhogam abhīpsitaṃ ca
dātuṃ mahānty aṣṭavapūṃṣi dhatte
somo janānāṃ guṇavanti nityaṃ
devaṃ mahādevam iti stuvanti
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
भोगार्थिनां भोगम् अभीप्सितं च
दातुं महान्त्य् अष्टवपूंषि धत्ते
सोमो जनानां गुणवन्ति नित्यं
देवं महादेवम् इति स्तुवन्ति
text_mt: Gautama said: / In order to grant desired enjoyment to those who seek enjoyment, / Soma constantly assumes eight great bodies endowed with qualities for the sake of living beings; / they praise this god as Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
kartuṃ svakīyair viṣayaiḥ sukhāni
bhartuṃ samastaṃ sacarācaraṃ ca
saṃpattaye hy asya vivṛddhaye ca
mahīmayaṃ rūpam itīśvarasya
meaning:
कर्तुं स्वकीयैर् विषयैः सुखानि
भर्तुं समस्तं सचराचरं च
संपत्तये ह्य् अस्य विवृद्धये च
महीमयं रूपम् इतीश्वरस्य
text_mt: To produce pleasures through its own objects, / to sustain all that moves and does not move, / and for its prosperity and growth, / the Lord's form consists of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃharaṇāya bhūmer
ādhāram ādhātum apāṃ svarūpam
bheje śivaḥ śāntatanur janānāṃ
sukhāya dharmāya jagat pratiṣṭhitam
meaning:
सृष्टेः स्थितेः संहरणाय भूमेर्
आधारम् आधातुम् अपां स्वरूपम्
भेजे शिवः शान्ततनुर् जनानां
सुखाय धर्माय जगत् प्रतिष्ठितम्
text_mt: For the creation, preservation, and destruction of the earth, / and to provide a foundation, Śiva, whose body is tranquil, / assumed the nature of water for the happiness of people and for dharma, [upon which] the world is established.

sanskrit_iast:
kālavyavasthām amṛtasravaṃ ca
jīvasthitiṃ sṛṣṭim atho vināśanam
mudaṃ prajānāṃ sukham unnatiṃ ca
cakre 'rkacandrāgnimayaṃ śarīram
meaning:
कालव्यवस्थाम् अमृतस्रवं च
जीवस्थितिं सृष्टिम् अथो विनाशनम्
मुदं प्रजानां सुखम् उन्नतिं च
चक्रे ऽर्कचन्द्राग्निमयं शरीरम्
text_mt: For the division of time and the flowing of nectar, / the sustenance of life, creation, and destruction, / the joy of creatures, their happiness, and their elevation, / he made a body composed of the sun, the moon, and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhiṃ gatiṃ śaktim athākṣarāṇi
jīvavyavasthāṃ mudam apy anekām
sraṣṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vāyur itīśarūpaṃ
tvaṃ vetsi nūnaṃ bhagavan bhavantam
meaning:
वृद्धिं गतिं शक्तिम् अथाक्षराणि
जीवव्यवस्थां मुदम् अप्य् अनेकाम्
स्रष्टुं कृतं वायुर् इतीशरूपं
त्वं वेत्सि नूनं भगवन् भवन्तम्
text_mt: To create growth, movement, power, letters, / the maintenance of living beings, and manifold joy, / the form of the Lord was made as wind; / truly, O Lord, you know yourself.

sanskrit_iast:
bhedair vinā naiva kṛtir na dharmo
nātmīyam anyan na diśo 'ntarikṣam
dyāvāpṛthivyau na ca bhuktimuktī
tasmād idaṃ vyomavapus taveśa
meaning:
भेदैर् विना नैव कृतिर् न धर्मो
नात्मीयम् अन्यन् न दिशो ऽन्तरिक्षम्
द्यावापृथिव्यौ न च भुक्तिमुक्ती
तस्माद् इदं व्योमवपुस् तवेश
text_mt: Without divisions, there is no action, nor dharma, / nor anything of one's own, nor the directions, nor the atmosphere, / nor heaven and earth, nor worldly enjoyment and liberation; / therefore this ether-body is yours, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ vyavasya
ṛksāmaśāstrāṇi yajuś ca śākhāḥ
loke ca gāthāḥ smṛtayaḥ purāṇam
ityādiśabdātmakatām upaiti
meaning:
धर्मं व्यवस्थापयितुं व्यवस्य
ऋक्सामशास्त्राणि यजुश् च शाखाः
लोके च गाथाः स्मृतयः पुराणम्
इत्यादिशब्दात्मकताम् उपैति
text_mt:
Having resolved to establish dharma,
he assumes the nature of sound as the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajur branches,
the treatises, the popular songs in the world,
the Smṛtis, the Purāṇa, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṣṭā kratur yāny api sādhanāni
ṛtvikpradeśaṃ phaladeśakālāḥ
tvam eva śaṃbho paramārthatattvaṃ
vadanti yajñāṅgamayaṃ vapus te
meaning:
यष्टा क्रतुर् यान्य् अपि साधनानि
ऋत्विक्प्रदेशं फलदेशकालाः
त्वम् एव शंभो परमार्थतत्त्वं
वदन्ति यज्ञाङ्गमयं वपुस् ते
text_mt:
The sacrificer, the rite, and whatever implements,
the sacrificial priest, the place, the times and fruits [of rites]—
you alone, O Śambhu, are the highest reality;
they declare that your body consists of the constituents of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kartā pradātā pratibhūḥ pradānaṃ
sarvajñasākṣī puruṣaḥ paraś ca
pratyātmabhūtaḥ paramārtharūpas
tvam eva sarvaṃ kim u vāgvilāsaiḥ
meaning:
कर्ता प्रदाता प्रतिभूः प्रदानं
सर्वज्ञसाक्षी पुरुषः परश् च
प्रत्यात्मभूतः परमार्थरूपस्
त्वम् एव सर्वं किम् उ वाग्विलासैः
text_mt:
The agent, the bestower, the guarantor, the gift,
the omniscient witness, and the supreme puruṣa,
the inner self, possessing the form of ultimate truth,
you alone are everything; what need is there of flourishes of speech?

sanskrit_iast:
na vedaśāstrair gurubhiḥ pradiṣṭo
na nāsi buddhyādibhir apradhṛṣyaḥ
ajo 'prameyaḥ śivaśabdavācyas
tvam asti satyaṃ bhagavan namas te
meaning:
न वेदशास्त्रैर् गुरुभिः प्रदिष्टो
न नासि बुद्ध्यादिभिर् अप्रधृष्यः
अजो ऽप्रमेयः शिवशब्दवाच्यस्
त्वम् अस्ति सत्यं भगवन् नमस् ते
text_mt:
You are not taught by the Vedic scriptures or teachers,
nor are you not invincible to the intellect and other faculties;
unborn, immeasurable, denoted by the word Śiva,
you truly exist, O Lord, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaikatāṃ svaprakṛtiṃ kadācid
aikṣac chivaḥ saṃpad iyaṃ mameti
pṛthak tadaivābhavad apratarkya
acintyaprabhāvo bahuviśvamūrtiḥ
meaning:
आत्मैकतां स्वप्रकृतिं कदाचिद्
ऐक्षच् छिवः संपद् इयं ममेति
पृथक् तदैवाभवद् अप्रतर्क्य
अचिन्त्यप्रभावो बहुविश्वमूर्तिः
text_mt:
Once, Śiva looked upon the oneness of the Self, his own Prakṛti, thinking:
‘This is my abundance!’
Immediately then, inconceivable and of unimaginable majesty,
he became distinct, having many cosmic forms.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāve 'bhivṛddhā ca bhave bhave ca
svakāraṇaṃ kāraṇam āsthitā ca
nityā śivā sarvasulakṣaṇā vā
vilakṣaṇā viśvakarasya śaktiḥ
meaning:
भावे ऽभिवृद्धा च भवे भवे च
स्वकारणं कारणम् आस्थिता च
नित्या शिवा सर्वसुलक्षणा वा
विलक्षणा विश्वकरस्य शक्तिः
text_mt:
Grown in existence, and in every birth and being,
she resides in her own cause, the primal cause;
eternal, auspicious, possessing every auspicious mark,
or beyond all marks: she is the power of the cosmic creator.

sanskrit_iast:
utpādanaṃ saṃsthitir annavṛddhi
layāḥ satāṃ yatra sanātanās te
ekaiva mūrtir na samasti kiṃcid
asādhyam asyā dayitā harasya
meaning:
उत्पादनं संस्थितिर् अन्नवृद्धि
लयाः सतां यत्र सनातनास् ते
एकैव मूर्तिर् न समस्ति किंचिद्
असाध्यम् अस्या दयिता हरस्य
text_mt:
Generation, preservation, increase of sustenance,
and dissolutions, where they are eternal for the good—
her form is single; nothing is impossible
for this beloved of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
yadartham annāni dhanāni jīvā
yacchanti kurvanti tapāṃsi dharmān
sāpīyam ambā jagato janitrī
priyā tu somasya mahāsukīrtiḥ
meaning:
यदर्थम् अन्नानि धनानि जीवा
यच्छन्ति कुर्वन्ति तपांसि धर्मान्
सापीयम् अम्बा जगतो जनित्री
प्रिया तु सोमस्य महासुकीर्तिः
text_mt:
For whose sake living beings give food and wealth,
and perform austerities and virtuous deeds—
she, this mother, the creatress of the universe,
is the beloved of the Moon-crested One, of great and glorious fame.

sanskrit_iast:
yad īkṣitaṃ kāṅkṣati vāsavo 'pi
yannāmato maṅgalam āpnuyāc ca
yā vyāpya viśvaṃ vimalīkaroti
somā sadā somasamānarūpā
meaning:
यद् ईक्षितं काङ्क्षति वासवो ऽपि
यन्नामतो मङ्गलम् आप्नुयाच् च
या व्याप्य विश्वं विमलीकरोति
सोमा सदा सोमसमानरूपा
text_mt:
Whose glance even Indra desires,
from whose name one attains auspiciousness,
who pervades and purifies the universe,
accompanied by the Moon, ever resembling the Moon in form.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādijīvasya carācarasya
buddhyakṣicaitanyamanaḥsukhāni
yasyāḥ prasādāt phalavanti nityaṃ
vāgīśvarī lokaguroḥ suramyā
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिजीवस्य चराचरस्य
बुद्ध्यक्षिचैतन्यमनःसुखानि
यस्याः प्रसादात् फलवन्ति नित्यं
वागीश्वरी लोकगुरोः सुरम्या
text_mt:
Of all moving and unmoving beings, beginning with Brahmā,
the delights of intellect, vision, consciousness, and mind
always bear fruit through her grace;
she is the goddess of speech, the exceedingly beautiful consort of the teacher of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhasyāpi mano malīnaṃ
kim anyajantor iti cintya mātā
gaṅgāvatāraṃ vividhair upāyaiḥ
sarvaṃ jagat pāvayituṃ cakāra
meaning:
चतुर्मुखस्यापि मनो मलीनं
किम् अन्यजन्तोर् इति चिन्त्य माता
गङ्गावतारं विविधैर् उपायैः
सर्वं जगत् पावयितुं चकार
text_mt:
Reflecting: ‘Even the mind of the Four-faced One is sullied,
what then of other creatures?’, the Mother,
in order to purify the entire universe,
brought about the descent of the Gaṅgā by various means.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutīḥ samālakṣya haraprabhutvaṃ
viśvasya lokaḥ sakalaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ
kṛtvā ca dharmān bubhuje ca bhogān
vibhūtir eṣā tu sadāśivasya
meaning:
श्रुतीः समालक्ष्य हरप्रभुत्वं
विश्वस्य लोकः सकलैः प्रमाणैः
कृत्वा च धर्मान् बुभुजे च भोगान्
विभूतिर् एषा तु सदाशिवस्य
text_mt:
Seeing Hara’s lordship over the universe
through the Vedas by all means of valid cognition,
the world performed virtuous acts and enjoyed pleasures;
this indeed is the sovereign glory of Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryakriyākārakasādhanānāṃ
vedoditānām atha laukikānām
yat sādhyam utkṛṣṭatamaṃ priyaṃ ca
proktā ca sā siddhir anādikartuḥ
meaning:
कार्यक्रियाकारकसाधनानां
वेदोदितानाम् अथ लौकिकानाम्
यत् साध्यम् उत्कृष्टतमं प्रियं च
प्रोक्ता च सा सिद्धिर् अनादिकर्तुः
text_mt:
Of effects, actions, agents, and instruments,
whether spoken of in the Vedas or worldly,
that which is to be accomplished, supreme and beloved—
that is declared to be the perfection of the beginningless creator.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā varaṃ brahma paraṃ pradhānaṃ
yat sārabhūtaṃ yad upāsitavyam
yat prāpya muktā na punar bhavanti
sadyogino muktir umāpatiḥ saḥ
meaning:
ध्यात्वा वरं ब्रह्म परं प्रधानं
यत् सारभूतं यद् उपासितव्यम्
यत् प्राप्य मुक्ता न पुनर् भवन्ति
सद्योगिनो मुक्तिर् उमापतिः सः
text_mt:
Having meditated upon the excellent, supreme Brahman, the pradhāna,
that which is the essence, that which is to be worshiped,
having attained which the liberated do not return again—
that liberation for true yogins is the lord of Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā śaṃbhur ameyamāyā
rūpāṇi dhatte jagato hitāya
tadyogayogyāni tathaiva dhatse
pativratātvaṃ tvayi mātar evam
meaning:
यथा यथा शंभुर् अमेयमाया
रूपाणि धत्ते जगतो हिताय
तद्योगयोग्यानि तथैव धत्से
पतिव्रतात्वं त्वयि मातर् एवम्
text_mt:
In whatever ways Śambhu assumes forms
of immeasurable illusory power for the welfare of the world,
in those very ways you assume forms suited to union with him;
such is your wifely devotion, O Mother!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity evaṃ stuvatas tasya purastād vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān gaṇeśādigaṇair vṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् एवं स्तुवतस् तस्य पुरस्ताद् वृषभध्वजः
उमया सहितः श्रीमान् गणेशादिगणैर् वृतः //

sanskrit_iast: sākṣād āgatya taṃ śaṃbhuḥ prasanno vākyam abravīt //
meaning: साक्षाद् आगत्य तं शंभुः प्रसन्नो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Śambhu came in person and, being pleased, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
kiṃ te gautama dāsyāmi bhaktistotravrataiḥ śubhaiḥ
parituṣṭo 'smi yācasva devānām api duṣkaram //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
किं ते गौतम दास्यामि भक्तिस्तोत्रव्रतैः शुभैः
परितुष्टो ऽस्मि याचस्व देवानाम् अपि दुष्करम् //
text_mt:
Śiva said:
What shall I grant you, O Gautama? By your auspicious vows of devotion and praises
I am well pleased; ask even for that which is difficult for the gods to attain!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā jaganmūrter vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
harṣabāṣpaparītāṅgo gautamaḥ paryacintayat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा जगन्मूर्तेर् वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः
हर्षबाष्पपरीताङ्गो गौतमः पर्यचिन्तयत् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing the words of the one whose form is the world, Gautama, skilled in speech,
his limbs bathed in tears of joy, reflected:

sanskrit_iast:
aho daivam aho dharmo hy aho vai viprapūjanam
aho lokagatiś citrā aho dhātar namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अहो दैवम् अहो धर्मो ह्य् अहो वै विप्रपूजनम्
अहो लोकगतिश् चित्रा अहो धातर् नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
Ah, destiny! Ah, dharma! Ah, the worship of brāhmaṇas!
Ah, the wondrous course of the world! Ah, Creator, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
jaṭāsthitāṃ śubhāṃ gaṅgāṃ dehi me tridaśārcita
yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa trayīdhāma namo 'stu te //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
जटास्थितां शुभां गङ्गां देहि मे त्रिदशार्चित
यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश त्रयीधाम नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
Grant me the auspicious Gaṅgā residing in your matted hair, O you who are worshiped by the thirty gods!
If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, abode of the three Vedas, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
trayāṇām upakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitaṃ tvayā
ātmanas tūpakārāya tad yācasvākutobhayaḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
त्रयाणाम् उपकारार्थं लोकानां याचितं त्वया
आत्मनस् तूपकाराय तद् याचस्वाकुतोभयः //

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
stotreṇānena ye bhaktās tvāṃ ca devīṃ stuvanti vai
sarvakāmasamṛddhāḥ syur etad dhi varayāmy aham //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्तास् त्वां च देवीं स्तुवन्ति वै
सर्वकामसमृद्धाः स्युर् एतद् धि वरयाम्य् अहम् //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
May those devotees who praise you and the goddess with this hymn
be enriched with all desires; this indeed is the boon I choose!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam astv iti deveśaḥ parituṣṭo 'bravīd vacaḥ
anyān api varān matto yācasva vigatajvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् अस्त्व् इति देवेशः परितुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् वचः
अन्यान् अपि वरान् मत्तो याचस्व विगतज्वरः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
The Lord of gods, well pleased, said: ‘So be it!’
‘Ask other boons from me as well, free from affliction!’

sanskrit_iast: evam uktas tu harṣeṇa gautamaḥ prāha śaṃkaram //
meaning: एवम् उक्तस् तु हर्षेण गौतमः प्राह शंकरम् //
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus, Gautama joyfully said to Śaṅkara:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
imāṃ devīṃ jaṭāsaṃsthāṃ pāvanīṃ lokapāvanīm
tava priyāṃ jagannātha utsṛja brahmaṇo girau //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
इमां देवीं जटासंस्थां पावनीं लोकपावनीम्
तव प्रियां जगन्नाथ उत्सृज ब्रह्मणो गिरौ //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
This goddess residing in your matted locks, the purifier, the purifier of the world,
your beloved, O Lord of the universe, release upon the mountain of Brahmā!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāṃ tīrthabhūtā tu yāvad gacchati sāgaram
brahmahatyādipāpāni manovākkāyikāni ca //
meaning:
सर्वासां तीर्थभूता तु यावद् गच्छति सागरम्
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि मनोवाक्कायिकानि च //
text_mt:
Becoming the sacred tīrtha for all as long as she flows to the ocean,
may sins such as the killing of a brāhmaṇa, committed in mind, speech, and body,

sanskrit_iast:
snānamātreṇa sarvāṇi vilayaṃ yāntu śaṃkara
candrasūryoparāge ca ayane viṣuve tathā //
meaning:
स्नानमात्रेण सर्वाणि विलयं यान्तु शंकर
चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे च अयने विषुवे तथा //
text_mt:
all dissolve by merely bathing [in her], O Śaṅkara!
And during eclipses of the moon and sun, at the solstices and equinoxes,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau puṇyatīrtheṣv anyeṣu yat phalam
asyās tu smaraṇād eva tat puṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara //
meaning:
संक्रान्तौ वैधृतौ पुण्यतीर्थेष्व् अन्येषु यत् फलम्
अस्यास् तु स्मरणाद् एव तत् पुण्यं जायतां हर //
text_mt:
at the saṃkrānti and the vaidhṛti, whatever fruit there is at other sacred tīrthas,
may that merit arise from merely remembering her, O Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
ślāghyaṃ kṛte tapaḥ proktaṃ tretāyāṃ yajñakarma ca
dvāpare yajñadāne ca dānam eva kalau yuge //
meaning:
श्लाघ्यं कृते तपः प्रोक्तं त्रेतायां यज्ञकर्म च
द्वापरे यज्ञदाने च दानम् एव कलौ युगे //
text_mt:
Austerity is declared praiseworthy in the Kṛta age, sacrificial rites in the Tretā,
sacrifice and charity in the Dvāpara, and charity alone in the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
yugadharmāś ca ye sarve deśadharmās tathaiva ca
deśakālādisaṃyoge yo dharmo yatra śasyate //
meaning:
युगधर्माश् च ये सर्वे देशधर्मास् तथैव च
देशकालादिसंयोगे यो धर्मो यत्र शस्यते //
text_mt:
Whatever are the duties of the ages, and likewise the customs of lands,
whatever duty is commended in a given conjunction of place, time, and circumstances,

sanskrit_iast:
yad anyatra kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānādisaṃyamaiḥ
asyās tu smaraṇād eva tat puṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara //
meaning:
यद् अन्यत्र कृतं पुण्यं स्नानदानादिसंयमैः
अस्यास् तु स्मरणाद् एव तत् पुण्यं जायतां हर //
text_mt:
and whatever merit is acquired elsewhere through baths, gifts, and self-restraint—
may that merit arise from merely remembering her, O Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra tv iyaṃ yāti yāvat sāgaragāminī
tatra tatra tvayā bhāvyam eṣa cāstu varo varaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र यत्र त्व् इयं याति यावत् सागरगामिनी
तत्र तत्र त्वया भाव्यम् एष चास्तु वरो वरः //
text_mt:
Wherever she flows until she reaches the ocean,
there you must be present; let this also be an excellent boon!

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ tūpari tu daśa yāvac ca saṃkhyayā
tadantarapraviṣṭānāṃ mahāpātakinām api //
meaning:
योजनानां तूपरि तु दश यावच् च संख्यया
तदन्तरप्रविष्टानां महापातकिनाम् अपि //
text_mt:
And up to a distance of ten yojanas,
for those who enter within that space, even great sinners,

sanskrit_iast:
tat pitṝṇāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca snānāyāgacchatāṃ śiva
snāne cāpy antare mṛtyor muktibhājo bhavantu vai //
meaning:
तत् पितॄणां च तेषां च स्नानायागच्छतां शिव
स्नाने चाप्य् अन्तरे मृत्योर् मुक्तिभाजो भवन्तु वै //
text_mt:
both for them and for their ancestors, when coming to bathe, O Śiva,
and if they die during the bath, may they indeed attain liberation!

sanskrit_iast:
ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni svargamartyarasātale
eṣā tebhyo viśiṣṭā tu alaṃ śaṃbho namo 'stu te //
meaning:
एकतः सर्वतीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले
एषा तेभ्यो विशिष्टा तु अलं शंभो नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
On one side stand all the tīrthas in heaven, earth, and the netherworld;
she is superior to them. Enough, O Śambhu, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā tathāstv ity abravīc chivaḥ
asyāḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद् गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा तथास्त्व् इत्य् अब्रवीच् छिवः
अस्याः परतरं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing those words of Gautama, Śiva said: ‘So be it!’
There has never been nor will there ever be a tīrtha superior to her.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vede ca pariniṣṭhitam
sarveṣāṃ gautamī puṇyā ity uktvāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं वेदे च परिनिष्ठितम्
सर्वेषां गौतमी पुण्या इत्य् उक्त्वान्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
It is true, true, and true again, firmly established in the Veda:
the Gautamī is holy to all! Having said this, he vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gate bhagavati lokapūjite
tadājñayā pūrṇabalaḥ sa gautamaḥ
jaṭāṃ samādāya saridvarāṃ tāṃ
surair vṛto brahmagiriṃ viveśa
meaning:
ततो गते भगवति लोकपूजिते
तदाज्ञया पूर्णबलः स गौतमः
जटां समादाय सरिद्वरां तां
सुरैर् वृतो ब्रह्मगिरिं विवेश
text_mt:
Then, when the Lord worshiped by the worlds had departed,
Gautama, filled with strength by his command,
took the matted hair [containing] that best of rivers,
and, surrounded by the gods, entered the mountain of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas tu gautame prāpte jaṭām ādāya nārada
puṣpavṛṣṭir abhūt tatra samājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ //
meaning:
ततस् तु गौतमे प्राप्ते जटाम् आदाय नारद
पुष्पवृष्टिर् अभूत् तत्र समाजग्मुः सुरेश्वराः //
text_mt:
Then, when Gautama arrived holding the matted lock, O Nārada,
a rain of flowers fell there, and the chiefs of the gods gathered.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaś ca mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyās tathā
jayaśabdena taṃ vipraṃ pūjayanto mudānvitāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषयश् च महाभागा ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियास् तथा
जयशब्देन तं विप्रं पूजयन्तो मुदान्विताः //
text_mt:
And the eminent sages, the brāhmaṇas and the kṣatriyas,
rejoicing, honored that twice-born with cries of ‘Victory!’

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
maheśvarajaṭājuṭād gaṅgām ādāya gautamaḥ
āgatya brahmaṇaḥ puṇye tataḥ kim akarod girau //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
महेश्वरजटाजुटाद् गङ्गाम् आदाय गौतमः
आगत्य ब्रह्मणः पुण्ये ततः किम् अकरोद् गिरौ //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
Taking the Gaṅgā from the mass of matted hair of the Great Lord
and arriving at the sacred mountain of Brahmā, what did Gautama do then?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ādāya gautamo gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ
pūjito devagandharvais tathā girinivāsibhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
आदाय गौतमो गङ्गां शुचिः प्रयतमानसः
पूजितो देवगन्धर्वैस् तथा गिरिनिवासिभिः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having obtained the Gaṅgā, Gautama, pure and restrained in mind, / worshipped by the gods and gandharvas as well as the dwellers of the mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
girer mūrdhni jaṭāṃ sthāpya smaran devaṃ trilocanam
uvāca prāñjalir bhūtvā gaṅgāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ //
meaning:
गिरेर् मूर्ध्नि जटां स्थाप्य स्मरन् देवं त्रिलोचनम्
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर् भूत्वा गङ्गां स द्विजसत्तमः //
text_mt: placed the matted lock on the crest of the mountain, and remembering the three-eyed god, / that best of the twice-born, with joined palms, spoke to the Gaṅgā:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
trilocanajaṭodbhūte sarvakāmapradāyini
kṣamasva mātaḥ śāntāsi sukhaṃ yāhi hitaṃ kuru //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
त्रिलोचनजटोद्भूते सर्वकामप्रदायिनि
क्षमस्व मातः शान्तासि सुखं याहि हितं कुरु //
text_mt: Gautama said: / "O you who arose from the matted locks of the three-eyed one, granter of all desires, / forgive [me], O mother! You are tranquil; go happily and do good!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktā gautamena gaṅgā provāca gautamam
divyarūpadharā devī divyasraganulepanā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्ता गौतमेन गङ्गा प्रोवाच गौतमम्
दिव्यरूपधरा देवी दिव्यस्रगनुलेपना //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Addressed thus by Gautama, the goddess Gaṅgā, / bearing a divine form and adorned with divine garlands and ointments, spoke to Gautama:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgovāca
gaccheyaṃ devasadanam athavāpi kamaṇḍalum
rasātalaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ jātas tvaṃ satyavāg asi //
meaning:
गङ्गोवाच
गच्छेयं देवसदनम् अथवापि कमण्डलुम्
रसातलं वा गच्छेयं जातस् त्वं सत्यवाग् असि //
text_mt: Gaṅgā said: / I may go to the dwelling of the gods, or to the water-pot, / or I may go to the netherworld; you were born truthful in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
trayāṇām upakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitā mayā
śaṃbhunā ca tathā dattā devi tan nānyathā bhavet //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
त्रयाणाम् उपकारार्थं लोकानां याचिता मया
शंभुना च तथा दत्ता देवि तन् नान्यथा भवेत् //
text_mt: Gautama said: / You were begged for by me for the benefit of the three worlds, / and given accordingly by Śaṃbhu; O goddess, that cannot be otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgā mene dvijeritam
tredhātmānaṃ vibhajyātha svargamartyarasātale //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद् गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा गङ्गा मेने द्विजेरितम्
त्रेधात्मानं विभज्याथ स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of Gautama, Gaṅgā accepted what was spoken by the twice-born. / Then, dividing herself threefold into heaven, earth, and the netherworld,

sanskrit_iast:
svarge caturdhā vyagamat saptadhā martyamaṇḍale
rasātale caturdhaiva saivaṃ pañcadaśākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्गे चतुर्धा व्यगमत् सप्तधा मर्त्यमण्डले
रसातले चतुर्धैव सैवं पञ्चदशाकृतिः //
text_mt: she went fourfold in heaven, sevenfold on the mortal realm, / and fourfold in the netherworld; thus she has fifteen forms.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra sarvabhūtaiva sarvapāpavināśinī
sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ saiva vede pragīyate //
meaning:
सर्वत्र सर्वभूतैव सर्वपापविनाशिनी
सर्वकामप्रदा नित्यं सैव वेदे प्रगीयते //
text_mt: Present everywhere as all beings, destroying all sins, / always granting all desires, she alone is celebrated in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
martyā martyagatām eva paśyanti na talaṃ gatām
naiva svargagatāṃ martyāḥ paśyanty ajñānabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
मर्त्या मर्त्यगताम् एव पश्यन्ति न तलं गताम्
नैव स्वर्गगतां मर्त्याः पश्यन्त्य् अज्ञानबुद्धयः //
text_mt: Mortals see only the one who has gone to the mortal realm, not the one gone to the nether regions; / nor do mortals, their intellects clouded by ignorance, see the one who has gone to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat sāgaragā devī tāvad devamayī smṛtā
utsṛṣṭā gautamenaiva prāyāt pūrvārṇavaṃ prati //
meaning:
यावत् सागरगा देवी तावद् देवमयी स्मृता
उत्सृष्टा गौतमेनैव प्रायात् पूर्वार्णवं प्रति //
text_mt: As far as the goddess goes to the ocean, so far is she remembered as composed of the gods. / Released by Gautama, she flowed toward the eastern ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devarṣibhir juṣṭāṃ mātaraṃ jagataḥ śubhām
gautamo muniśārdūlaḥ pradakṣiṇam athākarot //
meaning:
ततो देवर्षिभिर् जुष्टां मातरं जगतः शुभाम्
गौतमो मुनिशार्दूलः प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत् //
text_mt: Then Gautama, the tiger among sages, circumambulated / the auspicious mother of the world, frequented by divine sages.

sanskrit_iast:
trilocanaṃ sureśānaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya gautamaḥ
ubhayos tīrayoḥ snānaṃ karomīti dadhe matim //
meaning:
त्रिलोचनं सुरेशानं प्रथमं पूज्य गौतमः
उभयोस् तीरयोः स्नानं करोमीति दधे मतिम् //
text_mt: Having first worshipped the three-eyed Lord of the gods, Gautama / resolved: 'I shall bathe on both banks.'

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtamātras tadā tatrāvirāsīt karuṇārṇavaḥ
tatra snānaṃ kathaṃ sidhyed ity evaṃ śarvam abravīt //
meaning:
स्मृतमात्रस् तदा तत्राविरासीत् करुणार्णवः
तत्र स्नानं कथं सिध्येद् इत्य् एवं शर्वम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: The ocean of compassion appeared there the moment he was remembered. / Gautama spoke thus to Śarva, [asking] how bathing there might be accomplished,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamras trilocanam //
meaning: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रस् त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: folding his hands in reverence, bowed down in devotion before the Three-eyed Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
devadeva maheśāna tīrthasnānavidhiṃ mama
brūhi samyaṅ maheśāna lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
देवदेव महेशान तीर्थस्नानविधिं मम
ब्रूहि सम्यङ् महेशान लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Gautama said: / O God of gods, Great Lord, tell me properly / the procedure for bathing in the sacred ford, out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
maharṣe śṛṇu sarvaṃ ca vidhiṃ godāvarībhavam
pūrvaṃ nāndīmukhaṃ kṛtvā dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
महर्षे शृणु सर्वं च विधिं गोदावरीभवम्
पूर्वं नान्दीमुखं कृत्वा देहशुद्धिं विधाय च //
text_mt: Śiva said: / O great sage, listen to the entire rite connected with the Godāvarī: / having first performed the rite for the ancestors and the purification of the body,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca teṣām ājñāṃ pragṛhya ca
brahmacaryeṇa gacchanti patitālāpavarjitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च तेषाम् आज्ञां प्रगृह्य च
ब्रह्मचर्येण गच्छन्ति पतितालापवर्जिताः //
text_mt: and having fed the brāhmaṇas and received their permission, / they proceed in celibacy, avoiding conversation with the fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaś caiva susaṃyatam
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrthaphalam aśnute //
meaning:
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश् चैव सुसंयतम्
विद्या तपश् च कीर्तिश् च स तीर्थफलम् अश्नुते //
text_mt: He whose hands, feet, and mind are well restrained, / who has learning, asceticism, and good repute, enjoys the fruit of the sacred ford.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaduṣṭiṃ parityajya svadharmapariniṣṭhitaḥ
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ kurvan dadyād annaṃ yathocitam //
meaning:
भावदुष्टिं परित्यज्य स्वधर्मपरिनिष्ठितः
श्रान्तसंवाहनं कुर्वन् दद्याद् अन्नं यथोचितम् //
text_mt: Casting aside malice of heart, firmly established in his own dharma, / massaging the weary, he should give food as appropriate.

sanskrit_iast:
akiṃcanebhyaḥ sādhubhyo dadyād vastrāṇi kambalān
śṛṇvan harikathāṃ divyāṃ tathā gaṅgāsamudbhavām
anena vidhinā gacchan samyak tīrthaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
अकिंचनेभ्यः साधुभ्यो दद्याद् वस्त्राणि कम्बलान्
शृण्वन् हरिकथां दिव्यां तथा गङ्गासमुद्भवाम्
अनेन विधिना गच्छन् सम्यक् तीर्थफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: He should give garments and blankets to the destitute and the virtuous, / listening to the divine stories of Hari and the origin of the Gaṅgā; / going by this rule, he obtains the full fruit of the sacred ford.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tryambakaś ca iti prāha gautamaṃ munibhir vṛtam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
त्र्यम्बकश् च इति प्राह गौतमं मुनिभिर् वृतम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Tryambaka said this to Gautama, who was surrounded by sages:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
dvihastamātre tīrthāni saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama
sarvatrāhaṃ saṃnihitaḥ sarvakāmapradas tathā //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
द्विहस्तमात्रे तीर्थानि संभविष्यन्ति गौतम
सर्वत्राहं संनिहितः सर्वकामप्रदस् तथा //
text_mt: Śiva said: / Every two cubits there will be sacred fords, O Gautama; / I am present everywhere, and likewise the granter of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca tathā sāgarasaṃgame
eteṣu puṇyadā puṃsāṃ muktidā sā bhagīrathī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
गङ्गाद्वारे प्रयागे च तथा सागरसंगमे
एतेषु पुण्यदा पुंसां मुक्तिदा सा भगीरथी //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / At Gaṅgādvāra, at Prayāga, and at the confluence with the ocean— / at these [places] that Bhāgīrathī grants merit and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadā tu saricchreṣṭhā parvate 'marakaṇṭake
yamunā saṃgatā tatra prabhāse tu sarasvatī //
meaning:
नर्मदा तु सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके
यमुना संगता तत्र प्रभासे तु सरस्वती //
text_mt: The Narmadā, best of rivers, on Mount Amarakaṇṭaka; / the Yamunā where it conjoins [with the Gaṅgā]; and the Sarasvatī at Prabhāsa;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī caiva tuṅgabhadrā tu nārada
tisṛṇāṃ saṃgamo yatra tat tīrthaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
कृष्णा भीमरथी चैव तुङ्गभद्रा तु नारद
तिसृणां संगमो यत्र तत् तीर्थं मुक्तिदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: and the Kṛṣṇā, the Bhīmarathī, and the Tuṅgabhadrā, O Nārada: / where the confluence of these three is, that sacred ford grants liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
payouṣṇī saṃgatā yatra tatratyā tac ca muktidam
iyaṃ tu gautamī vatsa yatra kvāpi mamājñayā //
meaning:
पयोउष्णी संगता यत्र तत्रत्या तच् च मुक्तिदम्
इयं तु गौतमी वत्स यत्र क्वापि ममाज्ञया //
text_mt: Where the Payoṣṇī has joined, that place too grants liberation. / But this Gautamī, my child, anywhere at all by my command,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nṝṇāṃ snānān muktiṃ pradāsyati
kiṃcitkāle puṇyatamaṃ kiṃcittīrthaṃ surāgame //
meaning:
सर्वेषां सर्वदा नॄणां स्नानान् मुक्तिं प्रदास्यति
किंचित्काले पुण्यतमं किंचित्तीर्थं सुरागमे //
text_mt: will grant liberation to all men at all times through bathing. / At certain times a certain sacred ford is most meritorious, according to the scriptures;

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ sarvadā tīrthaṃ gautamī nātra saṃśayaḥ
tisraḥ koṭyo 'rdhakoṭī ca yojanānāṃ śatadvaye //
meaning:
सर्वेषां सर्वदा तीर्थं गौतमी नात्र संशयः
तिस्रः कोट्यो ऽर्धकोटी च योजनानां शतद्वये //
text_mt: the Gautamī is a sacred ford for all people at all times; there is no doubt of this. / In two hundred yojanas, O tiger among sages, O Gautama,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthāni muniśārdūla saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama
iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā gautamī vaiṣṇavīti ca //
meaning:
तीर्थानि मुनिशार्दूल संभविष्यन्ति गौतम
इयं माहेश्वरी गङ्गा गौतमी वैष्णवीति च //
text_mt: there will be thirty-five million sacred fords. / This is the Māheśvarī Gaṅgā, the Gautamī, the Vaiṣṇavī,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī godāvarī nandā sunandā kāmadāyinī
brahmatejaḥsamānītā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी गोदावरी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदायिनी
ब्रह्मतेजःसमानीता सर्वपापप्रणाशनी //
text_mt: the Brāhmī, the Godāvarī, the Nandā, the Sunandā, the giver of desires, / brought by brahmanical splendor, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
smaraṇād eva pāpaughahantrī mama sadā priyā
pañcānām api bhūtānām āpaḥ śreṣṭhatvam āgatāḥ //
meaning:
स्मरणाद् एव पापौघहन्त्री मम सदा प्रिया
पञ्चानाम् अपि भूतानाम् आपः श्रेष्ठत्वम् आगताः //
text_mt: Destroying heaps of sin merely by remembrance, she is ever dear to me. / Even among the five elements, the waters have attained preeminence;

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi tīrthabhūtās tu tasmād āpaḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥ
tāsāṃ bhāgīrathī śreṣṭhā tābhyo 'pi gautamī tathā //
meaning:
तत्रापि तीर्थभूतास् तु तस्माद् आपः पराः स्मृताः
तासां भागीरथी श्रेष्ठा ताभ्यो ऽपि गौतमी तथा //
text_mt: even among them, those that are sacred fords are remembered as supreme. / Among them, the Bhāgīrathī is best, and even compared to those, the Gautamī is such;

sanskrit_iast:
ānītā sajaṭā gaṅgā asyā nānyac chubhāvaham
svarge bhuvi tale vāpi tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ mune //
meaning:
आनीता सजटा गङ्गा अस्या नान्यच् छुभावहम्
स्वर्गे भुवि तले वापि तीर्थं सर्वार्थदं मुने //
text_mt: the Gaṅgā was brought along with [my] matted locks; there is nothing else as auspicious as her, / a sacred ford granting all ends in heaven, on earth, or in the netherworld, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity etat kathitaṃ putra gautamāya mahātmane
sākṣād dhareṇa tuṣṭena mayā tava niveditam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् एतत् कथितं पुत्र गौतमाय महात्मने
साक्षाद् धरेण तुष्टेन मया तव निवेदितम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Thus this was told to the great-souled Gautama / by Hara himself who was pleased; and by me it has been related to you.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sā gautamī gaṅgā sarvebhyo 'py adhikā matā
tatsvarūpaṃ ca kathitaṃ kuto 'nyā śravaṇaspṛhā //
meaning:
एवं सा गौतमी गङ्गा सर्वेभ्यो ऽप्य् अधिका मता
तत्स्वरूपं च कथितं कुतो ऽन्या श्रवणस्पृहा //
text_mt: Thus that Gautamī Gaṅgā is considered superior to all; / and her true nature has been told. What other desire to hear could there be?

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
dvividhā saiva gaditā ekāpi surasattama
eko bhedas tu kathito brāhmaṇenāhṛto yataḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
द्विविधा सैव गदिता एकापि सुरसत्तम
एको भेदस् तु कथितो ब्राह्मणेनाहृतो यतः //
text_mt: Nārada said: / She has been described as twofold, though she is one, O best of gods; / one division has been told, since it was brought down by the brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyeṇāparo 'py aṃśo jaṭāsv eva vyavasthitaḥ
bhavasya devadevasya āhṛtas tad vadasva me //
meaning:
क्षत्रियेणापरो ऽप्य् अंशो जटास्व् एव व्यवस्थितः
भवस्य देवदेवस्य आहृतस् तद् वदस्व मे //
text_mt: Tell me how the other portion, resting in the matted locks / of Bhava, the God of gods, was brought down by the kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vaivasvatānvaye jāta ikṣvākukulasaṃbhavaḥ
purā vai sagaro nāma rājāsīd atidhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वैवस्वतान्वये जात इक्ष्वाकुकुलसंभवः
पुरा वै सगरो नाम राजासीद् अतिधार्मिकः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Formerly there was a king named Sagara, born in the lineage of Vivasvat / and originating from the race of Ikṣvāku, who was exceedingly righteous,

sanskrit_iast:
yajvā dānaparo nityaṃ dharmācāravicāravān
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsīt patibhaktiparāyaṇam //
meaning:
यज्वा दानपरो नित्यं धर्माचारविचारवान्
तस्य भार्याद्वयं चासीत् पतिभक्तिपरायणम् //
text_mt: a performer of sacrifices, constantly devoted to charity, endowed with judgment in lawful conduct. / He had two wives, who were devoted in service to their husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya vai saṃtatir nābhūd iti cintāparo 'bhavat
vasiṣṭhaṃ gṛham āhūya saṃpūjya vidhivat tataḥ //
meaning:
तस्य वै संततिर् नाभूद् इति चिन्तापरो ऽभवत्
वसिष्ठं गृहम् आहूय संपूज्य विधिवत् ततः //
text_mt: He had no offspring, and so he became filled with anxiety. / Having invited Vasiṣṭha to his house and worshipped him according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā saṃtateḥ kāraṇaṃ prati
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā rājānam abravīt //
meaning:
उवाच वचनं राजा संततेः कारणं प्रति
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ध्यात्वा राजानम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: the king then spoke words concerning the cause of offspring. / Hearing his words and contemplating, he spoke to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
sapatnīkaḥ sadā rājann ṛṣipūjāparo bhava //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
सपत्नीकः सदा राजन्न् ऋषिपूजापरो भव //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Together with your wives, O king, be ever devoted to the worship of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā sa munir vipra yathāsthānaṃ jagāma ha
ekadā tasya rājarṣer gṛham āgāt taponidhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा स मुनिर् विप्र यथास्थानं जगाम ह
एकदा तस्य राजर्षेर् गृहम् आगात् तपोनिधिः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, O twice-born, that sage went to his abode. / Once, a treasury of asceticism came to the royal sage’s house.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sa saṃtuṣṭo 'bravīd vacam
varaṃ brūhi mahābhāgety ukte putrān sa cāvṛṇot //
meaning:
तस्यर्षेः पूजनं चक्रे स संतुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् वचम्
वरं ब्रूहि महाभागेत्य् उक्ते पुत्रान् स चावृणोत् //
text_mt: He worshipped that sage; well-pleased, the sage said: / 'Choose a boon, O fortunate one.' When this was said, he chose sons.

sanskrit_iast:
sa muniḥ prāha rājānam ekasyāṃ vaṃśadhārakaḥ
putro bhūyāt tathānyasyāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrakaṃ sutāḥ //
meaning:
स मुनिः प्राह राजानम् एकस्यां वंशधारकः
पुत्रो भूयात् तथान्यस्यां षष्टिसाहस्रकं सुताः //
text_mt: That sage said to the king: 'On one wife let there be a son / who sustains the lineage, and on the other sixty thousand sons.'

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dattvā munau yāte putrā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ
sa yajñān subahūṃś cakre hayamedhān sudakṣiṇān //
meaning:
वरं दत्त्वा मुनौ याते पुत्रा जाताः सहस्रशः
स यज्ञान् सुबहूंश् चक्रे हयमेधान् सुदक्षिणान् //
text_mt: When the sage had gone after granting the boon, thousands of sons were born. / He performed very many sacrifices, horse sacrifices with generous sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasmin hayamedhe vai dīkṣito vidhivan nṛpaḥ
putrān nyayojayad rājā sasainyān hayarakṣaṇe //
meaning:
एकस्मिन् हयमेधे वै दीक्षितो विधिवन् नृपः
पुत्रान् न्ययोजयद् राजा ससैन्यान् हयरक्षणे //
text_mt: Consecrated according to rule for one horse sacrifice, / the king appointed his sons, accompanied by the army, to protect the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacid antaram āsādya hayaṃ jahre śatakratuḥ
mārgamāṇāś ca te putrā naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā //
meaning:
क्वचिद् अन्तरम् आसाद्य हयं जह्रे शतक्रतुः
मार्गमाणाश् च ते पुत्रा नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा //
text_mt: Finding an opening somewhere, the lord of a hundred sacrifices carried off the horse; / and those sons, searching, did not find the horse then.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭir nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ
teṣu paśyatsu rakṣāṃsi putreṣu sagarasya hi //
meaning:
सहस्राणां तथा षष्टिर् नानायुद्धविशारदाः
तेषु पश्यत्सु रक्षांसि पुत्रेषु सगरस्य हि //
text_mt: The sixty thousand [sons], skilled in various kinds of warfare— / while those sons of Sagara were watching, the demons [stole it].

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣitaṃ tad dhayaṃ nītvā te rasātalam āgaman
rākṣasān māyayā yuktān naivāpaśyanta sāgarāḥ //
meaning:
प्रोक्षितं तद् धयं नीत्वा ते रसातलम् आगमन्
राक्षसान् मायया युक्तान् नैवापश्यन्त सागराः //
text_mt: Taking that consecrated horse, they went to the netherworld. / The sons of Sagara did not see the rākṣasas endowed with illusory power.

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭvā te hayaṃ putrāḥ sagarasya balīyasaḥ
itaś cetaś carantas te naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā //
meaning:
न दृष्ट्वा ते हयं पुत्राः सगरस्य बलीयसः
इतश् चेतश् चरन्तस् ते नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा //
text_mt: Not seeing the horse, the mighty sons of Sagara / wandered here and there, but did not see the horse then.

sanskrit_iast:
devalokaṃ tadā jagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca sarāṃsi ca
vanāni ca vicinvanto naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā //
meaning:
देवलोकं तदा जग्मुः पर्वतांश् च सरांसि च
वनानि च विचिन्वन्तो नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा //
text_mt: Then they went to the world of the gods, and searching mountains, lakes, / and forests, they did not see the horse then.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasvastyayano rājā ṛtvigbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalaḥ
adṛṣṭvā tu paśuṃ ramyaṃ rājā cintām upeyivān //
meaning:
कृतस्वस्त्ययनो राजा ऋत्विग्भिः कृतमङ्गलः
अदृष्ट्वा तु पशुं रम्यं राजा चिन्ताम् उपेयिवान् //
text_mt: The king, for whom rites for welfare and auspicious blessings had been performed by the sacrificial priests, / fell into anxiety upon not seeing the lovely victim.

sanskrit_iast:
aṭantaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve devalokam upāgaman
hayaṃ tam anucinvantas tatrāpi na hayo 'bhavat //
meaning:
अटन्तः सागराः सर्वे देवलोकम् उपागमन्
हयं तम् अनुचिन्वन्तस् तत्रापि न हयो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: All the sons of Sagara, roaming about, reached the world of the gods, / searching for that horse; but the horse was not there either.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mahīṃ samājagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca vanāni ca
tatrāpi ca hayaṃ naiva dṛṣṭavanto nṛpātmajāḥ //
meaning:
ततो महीं समाजग्मुः पर्वतांश् च वनानि च
तत्रापि च हयं नैव दृष्टवन्तो नृपात्मजाः //
text_mt: Then they came to the earth, to the mountains and forests; / there too the king's sons did not see the horse at all.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn antare tatra daivī vāg abhavat tadā
rasātale hayo baddha āste nānyatra sāgarāḥ //
meaning:
