अयम् एव गुरुः श्रेष्ठः कश्यपो वेदपारगः
गुरोर् अस्य प्रसादेन गौतम्याश् च प्रसादतः //
text_mt: This very Kaśyapa, who has mastered the Vedas, is the foremost guru. / By the grace of this guru and by the grace of the Gautamī,

sanskrit_iast:
ekena hayamedhena tatra snānena vā punaḥ
setsyanti tatra yajñāś ca daśamedhāni vājinaḥ //
meaning:
एकेन हयमेधेन तत्र स्नानेन वा पुनः
सेत्स्यन्ति तत्र यज्ञाश् च दशमेधानि वाजिनः //
text_mt: by a single horse sacrifice or, again, by bathing there, / the sacrifices—the ten horse sacrifices—will be accomplished there.”

sanskrit_iast:
tac chrutvā bhauvano rājā gautamītīram abhyagāt
kaśyapena sahāyena hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
तच् छ्रुत्वा भौवनो राजा गौतमीतीरम् अभ्यगात्
कश्यपेन सहायेन हयमेधाय दीक्षितः //
text_mt: Hearing that, King Bhauvana went to the bank of the Gautamī; / with Kaśyapa as his assistant, he was consecrated for the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravṛtte yajñeśe hayamedhe mahākratau
saṃpūrṇe tu tadā rājā pṛthivīṃ dātum udyataḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रवृत्ते यज्ञेशे हयमेधे महाक्रतौ
संपूर्णे तु तदा राजा पृथिवीं दातुम् उद्यतः //
text_mt: Then, when the horse sacrifice, the lord of sacrifices, the great rite, was commenced / and completed, the king was eager to donate the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ntarikṣe vāg uccair uvāca nṛpasattamam
pūjayitvā sthitaṃ viprān ṛtvijo 'tha sadaspatīn //
meaning:
ततो ऽन्तरिक्षे वाग् उच्चैर् उवाच नृपसत्तमम्
पूजयित्वा स्थितं विप्रान् ऋत्विजो ऽथ सदस्पतीन् //
text_mt: Then a voice spoke loudly in the sky to the best of kings, / as he stood having honored the vipras, the sacrificial priests, and the overseers of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśavāg uvāca
purodhase kaśyapāya saśailavanakānanām
pṛthivīṃ dātukāmena dattaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā nṛpa //
meaning:
आकाशवाग् उवाच
पुरोधसे कश्यपाय सशैलवनकाननाम्
पृथिवीं दातुकामेन दत्तं सर्वं त्वया नृप //
text_mt:
The voice from the sky said:
"With the desire to give the earth, with its mountains, forests, and woods, / to your family priest Kaśyapa, everything has been given by you, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidānaspṛhāṃ tyaktvā annaṃ dehi mahāphalam
nānnadānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate //
meaning:
भूमिदानस्पृहां त्यक्त्वा अन्नं देहि महाफलम्
नान्नदानसमं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते //
text_mt: Abandoning your desire for the gift of land, give food, which yields great fruit. / In the three worlds, there is no merit equal to the gift of food.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatas tu gaṅgāyāḥ śraddhayā puline mune
tvayā tu hayamedho 'yaṃ kṛtaḥ sabahudakṣiṇaḥ
kṛtakṛtyo 'si bhadraṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
विशेषतस् तु गङ्गायाः श्रद्धया पुलिने मुने
त्वया तु हयमेधो ऽयं कृतः सबहुदक्षिणः
कृतकृत्यो ऽसि भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Especially with faith upon the sandbank of the Gaṅgā, O sage. / By you this horse-sacrifice has been performed with abundant priestly gifts; / you have achieved your aim, may good fortune be yours; no doubt should be entertained here."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tathāpi dātukāmaṃ taṃ mahī provāca bhauvanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथापि दातुकामं तं मही प्रोवाच भौवनम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Even so, to him who still wished to make the gift, the earth spoke to Bhauvana:

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivy uvāca
viśvakarmaja sārvabhauma mā māṃ dehi punaḥ punaḥ
nimajje 'haṃ salilasya madhye tasmān na dīyatām //
meaning:
पृथिव्य् उवाच
विश्वकर्मज सार्वभौम मा मां देहि पुनः पुनः
निमज्जे ऽहं सलिलस्य मध्ये तस्मान् न दीयताम् //
text_mt:
The earth said:
"O son of Viśvakarman, universal sovereign, do not give me again and again! / I shall sink into the midst of the waters; therefore, do not give [me]."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataś ca bhauvano bhītaḥ kiṃ deyam iti cābravīt
punaś covāca sā pṛthvī bhauvanaṃ brāhmaṇair vṛtam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततश् च भौवनो भीतः किं देयम् इति चाब्रवीत्
पुनश् चोवाच सा पृथ्वी भौवनं ब्राह्मणैर् वृतम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Thereupon Bhauvana was frightened and said, "What should be given?" / And again that earth spoke to Bhauvana, who was surrounded by brāhmaṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmy uvāca
tilā gāvo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yat kiṃcid gautamītaṭe
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ dānaṃ kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi //
meaning:
भूम्य् उवाच
तिला गावो धनं धान्यं यत् किंचिद् गौतमीतटे
सर्वं तद् अक्षयं दानं किं मां भौवन दास्यसि //
text_mt:
The earth said:
"Sesame, cattle, wealth, grain—whatever [is given] on the bank of the Gautamī, / all that is an imperishable gift. Why will you give me, O Bhauvana?

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya grāsam ekaṃ dadāti yaḥ
tenāhaṃ sakalā dattā kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi //
meaning:
गङ्गातीरं समाश्रित्य ग्रासम् एकं ददाति यः
तेनाहं सकला दत्ता किं मां भौवन दास्यसि //
text_mt: Whoever, having resorted to the bank of the Gaṅgā, gives a single mouthful [of food], / by him all of me is given. Why will you give me, O Bhauvana?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tad bhuvo vacanaṃ śrutvā bhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ
tatheti matvā viprebhyo hy annaṃ prādāt suvistaram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद् भुवो वचनं श्रुत्वा भौवनः सार्वभौवनः
तथेति मत्वा विप्रेभ्यो ह्य् अन्नं प्रादात् सुविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard those words of the earth, the universal sovereign Bhauvana, / thinking 'So be it,' gave food in great abundance to the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ daśāśvamedhikaṃ viduḥ
daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ snānād avāpyate //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं दशाश्वमेधिकं विदुः
दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं स्नानाद् अवाप्यते //
text_mt: From that time forward, they know that holy site as Daśāśvamedhika. / The fruit of ten horse-sacrifices is obtained from bathing [there].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
paiśācaṃ tīrtham aparaṃ pūjitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पैशाचं तीर्थम् अपरं पूजितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः
तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि गौतम्या दक्षिणे तटे //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There is another holy site, Paiśāca, worshiped by those who proclaim Brahman; / I shall describe its nature, [situated] on the southern bank of the Gautamī.

sanskrit_iast:
girir brahmagireḥ pārśve añjano nāma nārada
tasmiñ śaile munivara śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā //
meaning:
गिरिर् ब्रह्मगिरेः पार्श्वे अञ्जनो नाम नारद
तस्मिञ् शैले मुनिवर शापभ्रष्टा वराप्सरा //
text_mt: Near the Brahmagiri mountain is a mountain named Añjana, O Nārada. / On that mountain, O best of sages, was an excellent apsaras fallen due to a curse.

sanskrit_iast:
añjanā nāma tatrāsīd uttamāṅgena vānarī
kesarī nāma tadbhartā adriketi tathāparā //
meaning:
अञ्जना नाम तत्रासीद् उत्तमाङ्गेन वानरी
केसरी नाम तद्भर्ता अद्रिकेति तथापरा //
text_mt: She was there by the name of Añjanā, a female monkey in her upper body. / Her husband was named Kesarī; and there was another woman named Adrikā.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi kesariṇo bhāryā śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā
uttamāṅgena mārjārī sāpy āste 'ñjanaparvate //
meaning:
सापि केसरिणो भार्या शापभ्रष्टा वराप्सरा
उत्तमाङ्गेन मार्जारी साप्य् आस्ते ऽञ्जनपर्वते //
text_mt: She too was Kesarī's wife, an excellent apsaras fallen due to a curse, / a female cat in her upper body; she also lived on Mount Añjana.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇārṇavam abhyāgāt kesarī lokaviśrutaḥ
etasminn antare 'gastyo 'ñjanaṃ parvatam abhyagāt //
meaning:
दक्षिणार्णवम् अभ्यागात् केसरी लोकविश्रुतः
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ऽगस्त्यो ऽञ्जनं पर्वतम् अभ्यगात् //
text_mt: Kesarī, renowned in the worlds, went to the southern ocean. / In the meantime, Agastya arrived at Mount Añjana.

sanskrit_iast:
añjanā cādrikā caiva agastyam ṛṣisattamam
pūjayām āsatur ubhe yathānyāyaṃ yathāsukham //
meaning:
अञ्जना चाद्रिका चैव अगस्त्यम् ऋषिसत्तमम्
पूजयाम् आसतुर् उभे यथान्यायं यथासुखम् //
text_mt: Both Añjanā and Adrikā honored Agastya, the best of ṛṣis, / properly and comfortably.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān āhobhe vriyatāṃ varaḥ
te āhatur ubhe 'gastyaṃ putrau dehi munīśvara //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् आहोभे व्रियतां वरः
ते आहतुर् उभे ऽगस्त्यं पुत्रौ देहि मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: Then the blessed one, pleased, said to both, "Choose a boon!" / Both of them said to Agastya, "Grant [us] two sons, O lord of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvebhyo balinau śreṣṭhau sarvalokopakārakau
tathety uktvā muniśreṣṭho jagāmāśāṃ sa dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
सर्वेभ्यो बलिनौ श्रेष्ठौ सर्वलोकोपकारकौ
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो जगामाशां स दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: the strongest of all, the best, benefactors of the whole world!" / Saying "So be it," that best of sages went toward the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kadācit te kāle añjanā cādrikā tathā
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca hāsyaṃ ca kurvatyau girimūrdhani //
meaning:
ततः कदाचित् ते काले अञ्जना चाद्रिका तथा
गीतं नृत्यं च हास्यं च कुर्वत्यौ गिरिमूर्धनि //
text_mt: Then at some time, both Añjanā and Adrikā / were singing, dancing, and laughing on the mountain peak.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuś ca nirṛtiś cāpi te dṛṣṭvā sasmitau surau
kāmākrāntadhiyau cobhau tadā satvaram īyatuḥ //
meaning:
वायुश् च निरृतिश् चापि ते दृष्ट्वा सस्मितौ सुरौ
कामाक्रान्तधियौ चोभौ तदा सत्वरम् ईयतुः //
text_mt: Having seen them, both gods, Vāyu and Nirṛti, smiling / and with their minds overcome by desire, then quickly went [there].

sanskrit_iast:
bhārye bhavetām ubhayor āvāṃ devau varapradau
te apy ūcatur astv etad remāte girimūrdhani //
meaning:
भार्ये भवेताम् उभयोर् आवां देवौ वरप्रदौ
ते अप्य् ऊचतुर् अस्त्व् एतद् रेमाते गिरिमूर्धनि //
text_mt: "Become the wives of us two; we are gods who grant boons." / They two also said, "Let it be so," and they sported on the mountain peak.

sanskrit_iast:
añjanāyāṃ tathā vāyor hanumān samajāyata
adrikāyāṃ ca nirṛter adrir nāma piśācarāṭ //
meaning:
अञ्जनायां तथा वायोर् हनुमान् समजायत
अद्रिकायां च निरृतेर् अद्रिर् नाम पिशाचराट् //
text_mt: From Vāyu, Hanumān was born to Añjanā; / and from Nirṛti, the piśāca-king named Adri was born to Adrikā.

sanskrit_iast:
punas te āhatur ubhe putrau jātau muner varāt
āvayor vikṛtaṃ rūpam uttamāṅgena dūṣitam //
meaning:
पुनस् ते आहतुर् उभे पुत्रौ जातौ मुनेर् वरात्
आवयोर् विकृतं रूपम् उत्तमाङ्गेन दूषितम् //
text_mt: Then both of them said again: "Two sons have been born by the sage's boon. / Our form is deformed, disfigured in the upper body

sanskrit_iast:
śāpāc chacīpates tatra yuvām ājñātum arhathaḥ
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vāyuś ca nirṛtis tathā //
meaning:
शापाच् छचीपतेस् तत्र युवाम् आज्ञातुम् अर्हथः
ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् वायुश् च निरृतिस् तथा //
text_mt: because of the curse of the lord of Śacī; in that regard, you two should give counsel." / Then the blessed Vāyu and Nirṛti spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
gautamyāṃ snānadānābhyāṃ śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati
ity uktvā tāv ubhau prītau tatraivāntaradhīyatām //
meaning:
गौतम्यां स्नानदानाभ्यां शापमोक्षो भविष्यति
इत्य् उक्त्वा ताव् उभौ प्रीतौ तत्रैवान्तरधीयताम् //
text_mt: "By bathing and giving gifts in the Gautamī, release from the curse will take place." / Having spoken thus, both of them, delighted, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ñjanāṃ samādāya adriḥ paiśācamūrtimān
bhrātur hanumataḥ prītyai snāpayām āsa mātaram //
meaning:
ततो ऽञ्जनां समादाय अद्रिः पैशाचमूर्तिमान्
भ्रातुर् हनुमतः प्रीत्यै स्नापयाम् आस मातरम् //
text_mt: Then Adri, possessing a piśāca's form, taking Añjanā / for the pleasure of his brother Hanumān, bathed his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva hanumān gaṅgām ādāyādrim atitvaran
mārjārarūpiṇīṃ nītvā gautamyās tīram āptavān //
meaning:
तथैव हनुमान् गङ्गाम् आदायाद्रिम् अतित्वरन्
मार्जाररूपिणीं नीत्वा गौतम्यास् तीरम् आप्तवान् //
text_mt: In the same manner, Hanumān, having taken Adri in great haste, / bringing the one who had the form of a cat, reached the bank of the Gautamī.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ paiśācaṃ cāñjanaṃ tathā
brahmaṇo girim āsādya sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पैशाचं चाञ्जनं तथा
ब्रह्मणो गिरिम् आसाद्य सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् //
text_mt: From that time forward, having reached Brahmā's mountain, that holy site [is known as] Paiśāca and Añjana, / auspicious and bestowing all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ tripañcāśan mārjāraṃ pūrvato bhavet
mārjārasaṃjñitāt tasmād dhanūmantaṃ vṛṣākapim //
meaning:
योजनानां त्रिपञ्चाशन् मार्जारं पूर्वतो भवेत्
मार्जारसंज्ञितात् तस्माद् धनूमन्तं वृषाकपिम् //
text_mt: Fifty-three yojanas to the east is Mārjāra; / from that [place] named Mārjāra, [and from] Hanūmat, Vṛṣākapi,

sanskrit_iast:
phenāsaṃgamam ākhyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
tasya svarūpaṃ vyuṣṭiś ca tatraiva procyate śubhā //
meaning:
फेनासंगमम् आख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
तस्य स्वरूपं व्युष्टिश् च तत्रैव प्रोच्यते शुभा //
text_mt: the confluence of the Phenā is declared auspicious and granting all desires; / its nature and auspicious reward are proclaimed right there.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kṣudhātīrtham iti khyātaṃ śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ
kathyamānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
क्षुधातीर्थम् इति ख्यातं शृणु नारद तन्मनाः
कथ्यमानं महापुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Listen attentively, O Nārada, to what is called Kṣudhātīrtha, / highly meritorious, granting all desires to men, as it is being related.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣir āsīt purā kaṇvas tapasvī vedavittamaḥ
paribhramann āśramāṇi kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिर् आसीत् पुरा कण्वस् तपस्वी वेदवित्तमः
परिभ्रमन्न् आश्रमाणि क्षुधया परिपीडितः //
text_mt: In ancient times there was a sage, Kaṇva, an ascetic, the foremost knower of the Vedas; / while wandering through hermitages, he was afflicted by hunger.

sanskrit_iast:
gautamasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ samṛddhaṃ cānnavāriṇā
ātmānaṃ ca kṣudhāyuktaṃ samṛddhaṃ cāpi gautamam //
meaning:
गौतमस्याश्रमं पुण्यं समृद्धं चान्नवारिणा
आत्मानं च क्षुधायुक्तं समृद्धं चापि गौतमम् //
text_mt: Gautama's holy hermitage was rich with food and water; / and seeing himself afflicted with hunger, while Gautama was prosperous,

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣya kaṇvo 'tha vaiṣamyaṃ vairāgyam agamat tadā
gautamo 'pi dvijaśreṣṭho hy ahaṃ tapasi niṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
वीक्ष्य कण्वो ऽथ वैषम्यं वैराग्यम् अगमत् तदा
गौतमो ऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठो ह्य् अहं तपसि निष्ठितः //
text_mt: perceiving the disparity, Kaṇva then fell into dejection: / "Gautama is indeed the best of twice-borns, and I am established in asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
samena yācñāyuktā syāt tasmād gautamaveśmani
na bhokṣye 'haṃ kṣudhārto 'pi pīḍite 'pi kalevare //
meaning:
समेन याच्ञायुक्ता स्यात् तस्माद् गौतमवेश्मनि
न भोक्ष्ये ऽहं क्षुधार्तो ऽपि पीडिते ऽपि कलेवरे //
text_mt: Begging should be done from an equal; therefore, in Gautama's house / I shall not eat, though tormented by hunger and though my body is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccheyaṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgām arjayeyaṃ ca saṃpadam
iti niścitya medhāvī gatvā gaṅgāṃ ca pāvanīm //
meaning:
गच्छेयं गौतमीं गङ्गाम् अर्जयेयं च संपदम्
इति निश्चित्य मेधावी गत्वा गङ्गां च पावनीम् //
text_mt: I should go to the Gautamī Gaṅgā and acquire prosperity." / Resolving thus, the wise sage went to the purifying Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā śucir yatamanā upaviśya kuśāsane
tuṣṭāva gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ ca paramāpadam //
meaning:
स्नात्वा शुचिर् यतमना उपविश्य कुशासने
तुष्टाव गौतमीं गङ्गां क्षुधां च परमापदम् //
text_mt: Having bathed, pure and restrained in mind, seated on a kuśa-grass mat, / he praised the Gautamī Gaṅgā and Hunger, the supreme affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇva uvāca
namo 'stu gaṅge paramārtihāriṇi
namaḥ kṣudhe sarvajanārtikāriṇi
namo maheśānajaṭodbhave śubhe
namo mahāmṛtyumukhād vinisṛte
meaning:
कण्व उवाच
नमो ऽस्तु गङ्गे परमार्तिहारिणि
नमः क्षुधे सर्वजनार्तिकारिणि
नमो महेशानजटोद्भवे शुभे
नमो महामृत्युमुखाद् विनिसृते
text_mt:
Kaṇva said:
"Homage to you, O Gaṅgā, remover of supreme affliction! / Homage, O Hunger, causer of distress to all people! / Homage to you, the auspicious one, born from the matted hair of Maheśāna! / Homage to you who have issued from the mouth of Great Death!

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyātmanāṃ śāntarūpe krodharūpe durātmanām
saridrūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpāpahāriṇi //
meaning:
पुण्यात्मनां शान्तरूपे क्रोधरूपे दुरात्मनाम्
सरिद्रूपेण सर्वेषां तापपापापहारिणि //
text_mt: You whose form is peaceful for righteous souls, whose form is wrath for the evil-minded, / who in the form of a river remove the suffering and sins of all!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhārūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpaprade namaḥ
namaḥ śreyaskari devi namaḥ pāpapratardini
namaḥ śāntikari devi namo dāridryanāśini //
meaning:
क्षुधारूपेण सर्वेषां तापपापप्रदे नमः
नमः श्रेयस्करि देवि नमः पापप्रतर्दिनि
नमः शान्तिकरि देवि नमो दारिद्र्यनाशिनि //
text_mt: Homage to you who, in the form of hunger, bring suffering and sin to all! / Homage, O goddess who brings welfare! Homage, O destroyer of sins! / Homage, O goddess who brings peace! Homage, O destroyer of poverty!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity evaṃ stuvatas tasya purastād abhavad dvayam
ekaṃ gāṅgaṃ manohāri hy aparaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛti
punaḥ kṛtāñjalir bhūtvā namaskṛtvā dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् एवं स्तुवतस् तस्य पुरस्ताद् अभवद् द्वयम्
एकं गाङ्गं मनोहारि ह्य् अपरं भीषणाकृति
पुनः कृताञ्जलिर् भूत्वा नमस्कृत्वा द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
As he was praising them in this way, two [forms] appeared before him: / one was from the Gaṅgā, captivating the heart, and the other was of terrible form. / Again folding his hands in reverence and bowing, that best of twice-borns [spoke]:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇva uvāca
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye brāhmi māheśvari śubhe
vaiṣṇavi tryambake devi godāvari namo 'stu te //
meaning:
कण्व उवाच
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये ब्राह्मि माहेश्वरि शुभे
वैष्णवि त्र्यम्बके देवि गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
Kaṇva said:
"O you who are the auspiciousness of all auspicious things, O Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, auspicious one, / Vaiṣṇavī, Tryambakā, O goddess Godāvarī, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tryambakasya jaṭodbhūte gautamasyāghanāśini
saptadhā sāgaraṃ yānti godāvari namo 'stu te //
meaning:
त्र्यम्बकस्य जटोद्भूते गौतमस्याघनाशिनि
सप्तधा सागरं यान्ति गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: Born from the matted hair of Tryambaka, destroyer of Gautama's sins, / going sevenfold to the ocean, O Godāvarī, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpakṛtāṃ pāpe dharmakāmārthanāśini
duḥkhalobhamayi devi kṣudhe tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापकृतां पापे धर्मकामार्थनाशिनि
दुःखलोभमयि देवि क्षुधे तुभ्यं नमो नमः //
text_mt: O sin for those who commit all manner of sins, destroyer of dharma, desire, and wealth, / O goddess composed of misery and greed, O Hunger, homage, homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tat kaṇvavacanaṃ śrutvā suprīte āhatur dvijam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तत् कण्ववचनं श्रुत्वा सुप्रीते आहतुर् द्विजम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard those words of Kaṇva, the two [goddesses], well-pleased, spoke to the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgākṣudhe ūcatuḥ
abhīṣṭaṃ vada kalyāṇa varān varaya suvrata //
meaning:
गङ्गाक्षुधे ऊचतुः
अभीष्टं वद कल्याण वरान् वरय सुव्रत //
text_mt:
Gaṅgā and Hunger said:
"State your desire, O auspicious one! Choose your boons, O you of noble vows!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
provāca praṇato gaṅgāṃ kaṇvaḥ kṣudhāṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
प्रोवाच प्रणतो गङ्गां कण्वः क्षुधां यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Bowing down, Kaṇva addressed Gaṅgā and Hunger in proper order:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇva uvāca
dehi devi manojñāni kāmāni vibhavaṃ mama
āyur vittaṃ ca bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ gaṅge prayaccha me //
meaning:
कण्व उवाच
देहि देवि मनोज्ञानि कामानि विभवं मम
आयुर् वित्तं च भुक्तिं च मुक्तिं गङ्गे प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt:
Kaṇva said:
"O goddess, grant me pleasing desires and power; / give me long life, wealth, enjoyment, and liberation, O Gaṅgā!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ cāha dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा गौतमीं गङ्गां क्षुधां चाह द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus to the Gautamī Gaṅgā, the best of the twice-born said to Hunger:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇva uvāca
mayi madvaṃśaje cāpi kṣudhe tṛṣṇe daridriṇi
yāhi pāpatare rūkṣe na bhūyās tvaṃ kadācana //
meaning:
कण्व उवाच
मयि मद्वंशजे चापि क्षुधे तृष्णे दरिद्रिणि
याहि पापतरे रूक्षे न भूयास् त्वं कदाचन //
text_mt:
Kaṇva said:
"O Hunger, O Thirst, O Poverty! Depart from me and from those born of my lineage! / O extremely sinful, harsh one, may you never be with [us]!

sanskrit_iast:
anena stavena ye vai tvāṃ stuvanti kṣudhāturāḥ
teṣāṃ dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyur varo 'paraḥ //
meaning:
अनेन स्तवेन ये वै त्वां स्तुवन्ति क्षुधातुराः
तेषां दारिद्र्यदुःखानि न भवेयुर् वरो ऽपरः //
text_mt: Those afflicted by hunger who praise you with this hymn— / may they have no miseries of poverty; [this is my] other boon.

sanskrit_iast:
asmiṃs tīrthe mahāpuṇye snānadānajapādikam
ye kurvanti narā bhaktyā lakṣmībhājo bhavantu te //
meaning:
अस्मिंस् तीर्थे महापुण्ये स्नानदानजपादिकम्
ये कुर्वन्ति नरा भक्त्या लक्ष्मीभाजो भवन्तु ते //
text_mt: The people who with devotion perform bathing, giving, recitation, and other rites at this holy ford of great merit— / may they become possessors of fortune!

sanskrit_iast:
yas tv idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ tīrthe vā yadi vā gṛhe
tasya dāridryaduḥkhebhyo na bhayaṃ syād varo 'paraḥ //
meaning:
यस् त्व् इदं पठते स्तोत्रं तीर्थे वा यदि वा गृहे
तस्य दारिद्र्यदुःखेभ्यो न भयं स्याद् वरो ऽपरः //
text_mt: And whoever recites this hymn, whether at the holy ford or at home, / may he have no fear of the miseries of poverty; [this is my] other boon."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam astv iti coktvā te kaṇvaṃ yāte svam ālayam
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kāṇvaṃ gāṅgaṃ kṣudhābhidham
sarvapāpaharaṃ vatsa pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् अस्त्व् इति चोक्त्वा ते कण्वं याते स्वम् आलयम्
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं काण्वं गाङ्गं क्षुधाभिधम्
सर्वपापहरं वत्स पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having said to Kaṇva, "So be it," they went to their own abode. / From that time onward, that holy ford, named Kāṇva, Gāṅga, and Kṣudhā, / removes all sins, my dear, and increases the pleasure of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
asti brahman mahātīrthaṃ cakratīrtham iti śrutam
tatra snānān naro bhaktyā harer lokam avāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अस्ति ब्रह्मन् महातीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम्
तत्र स्नानान् नरो भक्त्या हरेर् लोकम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There is, O brāhmaṇa, a great holy ford known as Cakra-tīrtha; / by bathing there with devotion, a man attains the world of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ tu śuklāyām upoṣya pṛthivīpate
gaṇikāsaṃgame snātvā prāpnuyād akṣayaṃ padam //
meaning:
एकादश्यां तु शुक्लायाम् उपोष्य पृथिवीपते
गणिकासंगमे स्नात्वा प्राप्नुयाद् अक्षयं पदम् //
text_mt: By fasting on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight, O lord of the earth, / and bathing at Gaṇikāsaṅgama, one obtains the imperishable abode.

sanskrit_iast:
purā tatra yathā vṛttaṃ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu
āsīd viśvadharo nāma vaiśyo bahudhanānvitaḥ //
meaning:
पुरा तत्र यथा वृत्तं तन् मे निगदतः शृणु
आसीद् विश्वधरो नाम वैश्यो बहुधनान्वितः //
text_mt: Listen to me as I relate what happened there long ago: / There was a vaiśya named Viśvadhara, endowed with much wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare vayasi śreṣṭhas tasya putro 'bhavad ṛṣe
guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vilāsī śubhadarśanaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तरे वयसि श्रेष्ठस् तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् ऋषे
गुणवान् रूपसंपन्नो विलासी शुभदर्शनः //
text_mt: In his later age, O sage, he had an excellent son, / virtuous, endowed with beauty, playful, and fair to behold.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇebhyo 'pi priyaḥ putraḥ kāle pañcatvam āgataḥ
tathā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ putraṃ daṃpatī duḥkhapīḍitau //
meaning:
प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि प्रियः पुत्रः काले पञ्चत्वम् आगतः
तथा दृष्ट्वा तु तं पुत्रं दंपती दुःखपीडितौ //
text_mt: That son, dearer than his own breaths of life, met his death in the course of time. / Seeing the son thus, the husband and wife, afflicted by grief,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāte sma tadā tena sahaiva maraṇe matim
hā putra hanta kālena pāpena sudurātmanā //
meaning:
कुर्वाते स्म तदा तेन सहैव मरणे मतिम्
हा पुत्र हन्त कालेन पापेन सुदुरात्मना //
text_mt: then resolved upon death together with him: / "Alas, son! Woe! By wicked, most evil-minded Time

sanskrit_iast:
yauvane vartamāno 'pi nīto 'si guṇasāgara
āvayoś ca tathaiva tvaṃ prāṇebhyo 'pi sudurlabhaḥ //
meaning:
यौवने वर्तमानो ऽपि नीतो ऽसि गुणसागर
आवयोश् च तथैव त्वं प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि सुदुर्लभः //
text_mt: you have been carried off though still in your youth, O ocean of virtues! / And to both of us you were far rarer than our very lives!"

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ tu ruditaṃ śrutvā daṃpatyoḥ karuṇaṃ yamaḥ
tyaktvā nijapuraṃ tūrṇaṃ kṛpayāviṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं तु रुदितं श्रुत्वा दंपत्योः करुणं यमः
त्यक्त्वा निजपुरं तूर्णं कृपयाविष्टमानसः //
text_mt: Hearing the piteous lamentation of the husband and wife, Yama, / his mind overcome with compassion, quickly left his own city,

sanskrit_iast:
godāvaryāḥ śubhe tīre sthito dhyāyañ janārdanam
api svalpena kālena prajā vṛddhāḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
गोदावर्याः शुभे तीरे स्थितो ध्यायञ् जनार्दनम्
अपि स्वल्पेन कालेन प्रजा वृद्धाः समन्ततः //
text_mt: and stood on the auspicious bank of the Godāvarī meditating on Janārdana. / In just a short time, living beings multiplied everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
iyata iti me pṛthvī kathyatāṃ kena pūritā
na kaścin mriyate jantur bhārākrāntā vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
इयत इति मे पृथ्वी कथ्यतां केन पूरिता
न कश्चिन् म्रियते जन्तुर् भाराक्रान्ता वसुंधरा //
text_mt: "Tell me, by whom has the earth been filled to such an extent? / Not a single living being dies; the earth is overwhelmed by a burden."

sanskrit_iast:
tato devī gatā tūrṇaṃ vasudhā munisattama
yatrāsti surasaṃyuktaḥ śakraḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
dṛṣṭvā vasuṃdharām indraḥ praṇipatyedam abravīt //
meaning:
ततो देवी गता तूर्णं वसुधा मुनिसत्तम
यत्रास्ति सुरसंयुक्तः शक्रः परपुरंजयः
दृष्ट्वा वसुंधराम् इन्द्रः प्रणिपत्येदम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then, O best of sages, the goddess Earth went quickly / to where Śakra, the conqueror of hostile citadels, was accompanied by the gods. / Seeing the Earth, Indra bowed down and said this:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
kim āgamanakāryaṃ ta iti me pṛthvi kathyatām //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
किम् आगमनकार्यं त इति मे पृथ्वि कथ्यताम् //
text_mt:
Indra said:
"Tell me, O Earth: What is the purpose of your arrival?"

sanskrit_iast:
dharovāca
bhāreṇa guruṇā śakra pīḍitāhaṃ vinā vadham
kāraṇaṃ praṣṭum āyātā kim idaṃ kathyatāṃ mama //
meaning:
धरोवाच
भारेण गुरुणा शक्र पीडिताहं विना वधम्
कारणं प्रष्टुम् आयाता किम् इदं कथ्यतां मम //
text_mt:
Earth said:
"O Śakra, I am afflicted by a heavy burden in the absence of death; / I have come to ask the reason. Tell me what this is!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā mahīvākyam indro vacanam abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा महीवाक्यम् इन्द्रो वचनम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard the words of the earth, Indra spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
kāraṇaṃ yadi nāma syāt tadānīṃ jñāyate mayā
surāṇāṃ hi patir yasmād ahaṃ sarvāsu medini //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
कारणं यदि नाम स्यात् तदानीं ज्ञायते मया
सुराणां हि पतिर् यस्माद् अहं सर्वासु मेदिनि //
text_mt:
Indra said:
"If indeed there is a reason, then it will be known by me, / for I am the lord of the gods in all matters, O Earth."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
atha pṛthvī tadā vākyaṃ śrutvā cāha śacīpatim
yama ādiśyatāṃ tarhi yathā saṃharate prajāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अथ पृथ्वी तदा वाक्यं श्रुत्वा चाह शचीपतिम्
यम आदिश्यतां तर्हि यथा संहरते प्रजाः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Then the earth, having heard his words, said to the husband of Śacī: / "Let Yama be commanded, then, so that he destroys creatures!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vaco mahyā ādiṣṭāḥ siddhakiṃnarāḥ
yamasyānayane śīghraṃ mahendreṇa mahāmune //
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो मह्या आदिष्टाः सिद्धकिंनराः
यमस्यानयने शीघ्रं महेन्द्रेण महामुने //
text_mt: Hearing the words of the earth, siddhas and kiṃnaras were commanded / by Mahendra, O great sage, to fetch Yama quickly.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas te satvaraṃ yātāḥ sarve vaivasvataṃ puram
naivāpaśyan yamaṃ tatra te siddhāḥ saha kiṃnaraiḥ
tathāgatya punar vegād vārttā śakre niveditā //
meaning:
ततस् ते सत्वरं याताः सर्वे वैवस्वतं पुरम्
नैवापश्यन् यमं तत्र ते सिद्धाः सह किंनरैः
तथागत्य पुनर् वेगाद् वार्त्ता शक्रे निवेदिता //
text_mt: Then they all went in haste to the city of the son of Vivasvat. / Those siddhas along with the kiṃnaras did not see Yama there at all; / returning swiftly as before, they reported the news to Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhakiṃnarā ūcuḥ
yamo yamapure nātha asmābhir nāvalokitaḥ
mahatāpi suyatnena vīkṣyamāṇaḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धकिंनरा ऊचुः
यमो यमपुरे नाथ अस्माभिर् नावलोकितः
महतापि सुयत्नेन वीक्ष्यमाणः समन्ततः //
text_mt:
The siddhas and kiṃnaras said:
"O lord, Yama was not seen by us in Yama's city, / although he was searched for all around with great effort."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā vacas teṣāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa vai tadā
savitā sa pitā tasya yamaḥ kutrāsta ity atha //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा वचस् तेषां पृष्टः शक्रेण वै तदा
सविता स पिता तस्य यमः कुत्रास्त इत्य् अथ //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having heard their words, Savitṛ, his father, was questioned by Śakra: / "Where has Yama gone now?"

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya uvāca
śakra godāvarītīre kṛtānto vartate 'dhunā
caraṃs tatra tapas tīvraṃ na jāne kiṃ nu kāraṇam //
meaning:
सूर्य उवाच
शक्र गोदावरीतीरे कृतान्तो वर्तते ऽधुना
चरंस् तत्र तपस् तीव्रं न जाने किं नु कारणम् //
text_mt:
Sūrya said:
"O Śakra, the End-maker is now on the bank of the Godāvarī, / performing severe asceticism there; I do not know what the reason may be."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā vaco bhānoḥ śakraḥ śaṅkām upāviśat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा वचो भानोः शक्रः शङ्काम् उपाविशत् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing the words of the Sun, Śakra was filled with anxiety:

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
aho kaṣṭaṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ naṣṭā me suranāthatā
godāvaryāṃ tapaḥ kuryād yamo vai duṣṭaceṣṭitaḥ
jighṛkṣur matpadaṃ nūnaṃ devā iti matir mama //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
अहो कष्टं महाकष्टं नष्टा मे सुरनाथता
गोदावर्यां तपः कुर्याद् यमो वै दुष्टचेष्टितः
जिघृक्षुर् मत्पदं नूनं देवा इति मतिर् मम //
text_mt:
Śakra said:
"Oh, distress, great distress! My lordship over the gods is lost! / Yama of wicked conduct is performing asceticism on the Godāvarī; / he certainly wishes to seize my station, O gods—this is my opinion."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā sahasendreṇa āhūtaś cāpsarogaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा सहसेन्द्रेण आहूतश् चाप्सरोगणः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having said this, the host of apsarases was summoned by Indra at once.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
kā bhavatīṣu kālasya sthitasya tapasi dviṣaḥ
tapaḥpraṇāśane śaktā iti me śīghram ucyatām //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
का भवतीषु कालस्य स्थितस्य तपसि द्विषः
तपःप्रणाशने शक्ता इति मे शीघ्रम् उच्यताम् //
text_mt:
Indra said:
"Which among you is capable of destroying the asceticism of Death, / our enemy, who is engaged in tapas? Tell me this at once!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śakravacaḥ śrutvā noce kāpi mahāmune
atha śakraḥ prakopeṇa pratyuvācāpsarogaṇam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति शक्रवचः श्रुत्वा नोचे कापि महामुने
अथ शक्रः प्रकोपेण प्रत्युवाचाप्सरोगणम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing Śakra's words, no [apsaras] spoke, O great sage. / Then Śakra spoke angrily in reply to the host of apsarases:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
uttaraṃ nābravīt kiṃcid yāmas tarhi vayaṃ svayam
sajjā bhavantu vibudhāḥ sainyair āyāntu mā ciram
ghātayāmo vayaṃ śatruṃ tapasā svargakāmukam //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
उत्तरं नाब्रवीत् किंचिद् यामस् तर्हि वयं स्वयम्
सज्जा भवन्तु विबुधाः सैन्यैर् आयान्तु मा चिरम्
घातयामो वयं शत्रुं तपसा स्वर्गकामुकम् //
text_mt:
Indra said:
"No one has given an answer! Then we shall go ourselves. / Let the gods be ready and march with their armies without delay; / we shall slay the enemy who desires heaven through asceticism!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity ukte sati devānāṃ senā prādurbabhūva ha
itīndrahṛdayaṃ jñātvā hariṇā lokadhāriṇā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्ते सति देवानां सेना प्रादुर्बभूव ह
इतीन्द्रहृदयं ज्ञात्वा हरिणा लोकधारिणा //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
When this was said, the army of the gods appeared. / Knowing Indra's heart in this matter, Hari, the upholder of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
preṣitaṃ cakriṇā cakraṃ rakṣaṇāya yamasya hi
cakraṃ yatrābhavat tatra cakratīrtham anuttamam //
meaning:
प्रेषितं चक्रिणा चक्रं रक्षणाय यमस्य हि
चक्रं यत्राभवत् तत्र चक्रतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: the wielder of the discus, sent his discus to protect Yama. / Where the discus landed, there arose the unexcelled Cakra-tīrtha.

sanskrit_iast: athendraṃ menakā prāha śaṅkiteti vacas tadā //
meaning: अथेन्द्रं मेनका प्राह शङ्कितेति वचस् तदा //
text_mt: Then Menakā, feeling anxious, spoke these words to Indra:

sanskrit_iast:
menakovāca
kālāvalokane nālaṃ kācid asti sureśvara
maraṇaṃ ca varaṃ deva bhavato na yamāt punaḥ //
meaning:
मेनकोवाच
कालावलोकने नालं काचिद् अस्ति सुरेश्वर
मरणं च वरं देव भवतो न यमात् पुनः //
text_mt:
Menakā said:
"No woman is capable of even looking upon Death, O lord of the gods! / And death, O god, is preferable [from you], but not again from Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanamatteyaṃ gaṇikāyācanaṃ prabho
preṣaṇaṃ tat prayacchaiṣā svāmitvaṃ manyate tvayā //
meaning:
रूपयौवनमत्तेयं गणिकायाचनं प्रभो
प्रेषणं तत् प्रयच्छैषा स्वामित्वं मन्यते त्वया //
text_mt: Here is Gaṇikā, intoxicated with beauty and youth; send her, O lord, / send that dispatch; she considers herself as master through you."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā vacas tasyāḥ śakraḥ suravareśvaraḥ
ādideśābalāṃ kṣāmāṃ satkṛtya gaṇikāṃ tathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा वचस् तस्याः शक्रः सुरवरेश्वरः
आदिदेशाबलां क्षामां सत्कृत्य गणिकां तथा //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing her words, Śakra, the supreme lord of the gods, / honored the slender woman, the courtesan Gaṇikā, and commanded her:

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
gaṇike gaccha me kāryaṃ kuru sundari mā ciram
kṛtakṛtyāgatā bhūyo vallabhā me yathā śacī //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
गणिके गच्छ मे कार्यं कुरु सुन्दरि मा चिरम्
कृतकृत्यागता भूयो वल्लभा मे यथा शची //
text_mt:
Śakra said:
"Go, Gaṇikā, accomplish my mission, O beautiful one, without delay! / When you return having achieved your purpose, you shall be dear to me like Śacī."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity ākarṇya vacaḥ śakrād utpatya gaṇikā diśaḥ
kṣaṇena yamasāṃnidhyam āyātā cārurūpiṇī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् आकर्ण्य वचः शक्राद् उत्पत्य गणिका दिशः
क्षणेन यमसांनिध्यम् आयाता चारुरूपिणी //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing the words from Śakra, the fair-formed Gaṇikā flew through the quarters of the sky / and arrived in an instant into the presence of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāntikam anuprāptā dyotayantī diśo daśa
salīlaṃ lalitaṃ bālā jagau hindolakaṅkalam //
meaning:
यमान्तिकम् अनुप्राप्ता द्योतयन्ती दिशो दश
सलीलं ललितं बाला जगौ हिन्दोलकङ्कलम् //
text_mt: Having arrived near Yama, illuminating the ten directions, / the maiden sang a sweet, swaying song with graceful playfulness.

sanskrit_iast:
tataś cacāla kālasya mano lolaṃ calācalam
athonmīlya yamo netre kāmapāvakapūrite //
meaning:
ततश् चचाल कालस्य मनो लोलं चलाचलम्
अथोन्मील्य यमो नेत्रे कामपावकपूरिते //
text_mt: Then the mind of Death was stirred, wavering and restless; / and Yama, opening his eyes filled with the fire of desire,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ vyāpārayām āsa śreyaḥśatrau mahāmune
tato vilīya sā sadyaḥ sarittvam agamat tadā //
meaning:
तस्यां व्यापारयाम् आस श्रेयःशत्रौ महामुने
ततो विलीय सा सद्यः सरित्त्वम् अगमत् तदा //
text_mt: directed them at her, the enemy of his welfare, O great sage. / Thereupon, dissolving instantly, she then turned into a river.

sanskrit_iast:
gautamyāṃ tu samāgamya gaṇikāgaṇakiṃkaraiḥ
gīyamānā gatā svarge tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
गौतम्यां तु समागम्य गणिकागणकिंकरैः
गीयमाना गता स्वर्गे तस्य तीर्थप्रभावतः //
text_mt: Having merged into the Gautamī, the courtesan, / sung of by attendant hosts, ascended to heaven through the efficacy of that tīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchantīṃ gaṇikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānasthāṃ divaṃ prati
vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ kālas taralalocanaḥ
athādityena cāgatya evam ukto yamas tadā //
meaning:
गच्छन्तीं गणिकां दृष्ट्वा विमानस्थां दिवं प्रति
विस्मयं परमं प्राप्तः कालस् तरललोचनः
अथादित्येन चागत्य एवम् उक्तो यमस् तदा //
text_mt: Seeing the courtesan ascending to heaven situated in a celestial chariot, / Death, his eyes rolling, was filled with supreme astonishment. / Then Āditya approached and addressed Yama thus:

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya uvāca
kuru putra nijaṃ karma prajānāṃ tvaṃ parikṣayam
paśya vātaṃ sadā vāntaṃ sṛjantaṃ vedhasaṃ prajāḥ
paryaṭantaṃ trilokīṃ māṃ vahantīṃ vasudhāṃ prajāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्य उवाच
कुरु पुत्र निजं कर्म प्रजानां त्वं परिक्षयम्
पश्य वातं सदा वान्तं सृजन्तं वेधसं प्रजाः
पर्यटन्तं त्रिलोकीं मां वहन्तीं वसुधां प्रजाः //
text_mt: Sūrya said: / 'Perform your own duty, my son: the destruction of creatures. / Behold the wind constantly blowing, the Creator fashioning creatures, / myself traversing the three worlds, and the earth sustaining living beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
iti śrutvā yamo vākyaṃ pitur vacanam abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इति श्रुत्वा यमो वाक्यं पितुर् वचनम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard this speech, Yama addressed a word to his father:

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
etan na garhitaṃ karma kuryām aham idaṃ dhruvam
karmaṇy asmin mahākrūre samādeṣṭuṃ na vārhasi //
meaning:
यम उवाच
एतन् न गर्हितं कर्म कुर्याम् अहम् इदं ध्रुवम्
कर्मण्य् अस्मिन् महाक्रूरे समादेष्टुं न वार्हसि //
text_mt: Yama said: / 'Surely I would not perform this censured deed. / You ought not to command me in this exceedingly cruel work.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā ca tad vākyaṃ bhānur vacanam abravīt
kiṃ nāma garhitaṃ karma tava kartum alaṃ yama //
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा च तद् वाक्यं भानुर् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
किं नाम गर्हितं कर्म तव कर्तुम् अलं यम //
text_mt: Hearing those words of his, Bhānu spoke this reply: / 'What censured deed indeed is it proper for you to perform, Yama?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na dṛṣṭā tvayā yāntī gaṇikā gaṇakiṃkaraiḥ
gīyamānā divaṃ sadyo gautamītoyam āplutā //
meaning:
किं न दृष्टा त्वया यान्ती गणिका गणकिंकरैः
गीयमाना दिवं सद्यो गौतमीतोयम् आप्लुता //
text_mt: Did you not see the courtesan departing to heaven, / sung of by attendant hosts, having bathed in the waters of the Gautamī?

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā cātra tapas tīvraṃ kṛtaṃ putra suduṣkaram
naivāntaṃ tasya paśyāmi tasmād gaccha nijaṃ puram //
meaning:
त्वया चात्र तपस् तीव्रं कृतं पुत्र सुदुष्करम्
नैवान्तं तस्य पश्यामि तस्माद् गच्छ निजं पुरम् //
text_mt: And you have performed severe, most arduous penance here, my son; / I see no end to it, so depart to your own city.'

sanskrit_iast:
ity uktvā bhagavān bhānus tatra snātvā gato divam
yamo 'pi saṃgame snātvā tato nijapuraṃ yayau //
meaning:
इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् भानुस् तत्र स्नात्वा गतो दिवम्
यमो ऽपि संगमे स्नात्वा ततो निजपुरं ययौ //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the blessed Bhānu bathed there and departed to heaven. / Yama too bathed at the confluence and then went to his own city.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtahāpi tataḥ śaṅkāṃ tatyāja ca mahāmune
tathā dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ yāntaṃ cakre cakraṃ prayāṇakam //
meaning:
भूतहापि ततः शङ्कां तत्याज च महामुने
तथा दृष्ट्वा यमं यान्तं चक्रे चक्रं प्रयाणकम् //
text_mt: The destroyer of beings also cast aside his misgiving, O great sage. / Seeing Yama depart thus, he made his journey [to the place]

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavān yatra govindo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ
iti yaḥ śṛṇuyān martyaḥ paṭhed vāpi samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
भगवान् यत्र गोविन्दो वनमालाविभूषितः
इति यः शृणुयान् मर्त्यः पठेद् वापि समाहितः //
text_mt: where the blessed Govinda is adorned with a forest garland. / The mortal who hears this or reads it with concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast: āpadas tasya naśyanti dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt //
meaning: आपदस् तस्य नश्यन्ति दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: his misfortunes perish, and he attains a long life.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ahalyāsaṃgamaṃ ceha tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam
śṛṇu samyaṅ muniśreṣṭha tatra vṛttam idaṃ yathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अहल्यासंगमं चेह तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यपावनम्
शृणु सम्यङ् मुनिश्रेष्ठ तत्र वृत्तम् इदं यथा //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'And here is the tīrtha of Ahalyāsaṃgama, purifier of the three worlds. / Hear duly, O best of sages, how this event took place there.

sanskrit_iast:
kautukenātimahatā mayā pūrvaṃ munīśvara
sṛṣṭā kanyā bahuvidhā rūpavatyo guṇānvitāḥ //
meaning:
कौतुकेनातिमहता मया पूर्वं मुनीश्वर
सृष्टा कन्या बहुविधा रूपवत्यो गुणान्विताः //
text_mt: Long ago, out of great curiosity, O lord of sages, / I created many kinds of maidens endowed with beauty and virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsām ekāṃ śreṣṭhatamāṃ nirmame śubhalakṣaṇām
tāṃ bālāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpaguṇānvitām //
meaning:
तासाम् एकां श्रेष्ठतमां निर्ममे शुभलक्षणाम्
तां बालां चारुसर्वाङ्गीं दृष्ट्वा रूपगुणान्विताम् //
text_mt: Among them, I fashioned one as the most excellent, endowed with auspicious marks. / Seeing that girl, lovely in all her limbs and endowed with beauty and virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
ko vāsyāḥ poṣaṇe śakta iti me buddhir āviśat
na daityānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca na munīnāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
को वास्याः पोषणे शक्त इति मे बुद्धिर् आविशत्
न दैत्यानां सुराणां च न मुनीनां तथैव च //
text_mt: the thought entered my mind: "Who is capable of rearing her?" / Neither among the Daityas nor the gods, nor likewise among the sages,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsty asyāḥ poṣaṇe śaktir iti me buddhir anvabhūt
guṇajyeṣṭhāya viprāya tapoyuktāya dhīmate //
meaning:
नास्त्य् अस्याः पोषणे शक्तिर् इति मे बुद्धिर् अन्वभूत्
गुणज्येष्ठाय विप्राय तपोयुक्ताय धीमते //
text_mt: is there the capacity to rear her—such was the thought that occurred to me. / To a wise twice-born man, pre-eminent in virtues and endowed with austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇayuktāya vedavedāṅgavedine
gautamāya mahāprājñām adadāṃ poṣaṇāya tām //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणयुक्ताय वेदवेदाङ्गवेदिने
गौतमाय महाप्राज्ञाम् अददां पोषणाय ताम् //
text_mt: endowed with all marks, knowing the Vedas and Vedāṅgas— / to Gautama I gave that highly intelligent girl for rearing.

sanskrit_iast:
pālayasva muniśreṣṭha yāvad āpsyati yauvanam
yauvanasthāṃ punaḥ sādhvīm ānayethā mamāntikam //
meaning:
पालयस्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ यावद् आप्स्यति यौवनम्
यौवनस्थां पुनः साध्वीम् आनयेथा ममान्तिकम् //
text_mt: "Protect her, O best of sages, until she attains youth. / When she has reached youth, bring the virtuous girl back to my presence."

sanskrit_iast:
evam uktvā gautamāya prādāṃ kanyāṃ sumadhyamām
tām ādāya muniśreṣṭha tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ //
meaning:
एवम् उक्त्वा गौतमाय प्रादां कन्यां सुमध्यमाम्
ताम् आदाय मुनिश्रेष्ठ तपसा हतकल्मषः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, I gave the slender-waisted maiden to Gautama. / Taking her, O best of sages, his sins destroyed by austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ poṣayitvā vidhivad alaṃkṛtya mamāntikam
nirvikāro muniśreṣṭho hy ahalyām ānayat tadā //
meaning:
तां पोषयित्वा विधिवद् अलंकृत्य ममान्तिकम्
निर्विकारो मुनिश्रेष्ठो ह्य् अहल्याम् आनयत् तदा //
text_mt: the best of sages reared her according to rule, adorned her, / and without any lustful change brought Ahalyā then into my presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve śakrāgnivaruṇādayaḥ
mama deyā sureśāna ity ūcus te pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा विबुधाः सर्वे शक्राग्निवरुणादयः
मम देया सुरेशान इत्य् ऊचुस् ते पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Seeing her, all the gods, Śakra, Agni, Varuṇa, and others, / said individually: "She must be given to me, O lord of the gods!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva munayaḥ sādhyā dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ
tān sarvān āgatān dṛṣṭvā kanyārtham atha saṃgatān //
meaning:
तथैव मुनयः साध्या दानवा यक्षराक्षसाः
तान् सर्वान् आगतान् दृष्ट्वा कन्यार्थम् अथ संगतान् //
text_mt: Likewise the sages, the Sādhyas, Dānavas, Yakṣas, and Rākṣasas. / Seeing them all arrived and assembled for the sake of the maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
indrasya tu viśeṣeṇa mahāṃś cābhūt tadā grahaḥ
gautamasya tu māhātmyaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ dhairyam eva ca //
meaning:
इन्द्रस्य तु विशेषेण महांश् चाभूत् तदा ग्रहः
गौतमस्य तु माहात्म्यं गाम्भीर्यं धैर्यम् एव च //
text_mt: there was an especially great obsession on the part of Indra. / Remembering the greatness, depth, and steadfastness of Gautama,

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtvā suvismito bhūtvā mamaivam abhavat sudhīḥ
deyeyaṃ gautamāyaiva nānyayogyā śubhānanā //
meaning:
स्मृत्वा सुविस्मितो भूत्वा ममैवम् अभवत् सुधीः
देयेयं गौतमायैव नान्ययोग्या शुभानना //
text_mt: being filled with great wonder, a noble thought occurred to me: / "She ought to be given only to Gautama; this fair-faced maiden is not suited for anyone else.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāai eva tu tāṃ dāsye tathāpy evam acintayam
sarveṣāṃ ca matir dhairyaṃ mathitaṃ bālayānayā //
meaning:
तस्माऐ एव तु तां दास्ये तथाप्य् एवम् अचिन्तयम्
सर्वेषां च मतिर् धैर्यं मथितं बालयानया //
text_mt: To him alone shall I give her." Yet I also considered this: / "The mind and fortitude of everyone have been agitated by this girl."

sanskrit_iast:
ahalyeti suraiḥ proktaṃ mayā ca ṛṣibhis tadā
devān ṛṣīṃs tadā vīkṣya mayā tatroktam uccakaiḥ //
meaning:
अहल्येति सुरैः प्रोक्तं मया च ऋषिभिस् तदा
देवान् ऋषींस् तदा वीक्ष्य मया तत्रोक्तम् उच्चकैः //
text_mt: She was named Ahalyā by the gods, by me, and by the ṛṣis then. / Looking at the gods and ṛṣis, I then proclaimed aloud:

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai sā dīyate subhrūr yaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pradakṣiṇām
kṛtvopatiṣṭhate pūrvaṃ na cānyasmai punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मै सा दीयते सुभ्रूर् यः पृथिव्याः प्रदक्षिणाम्
कृत्वोपतिष्ठते पूर्वं न चान्यस्मै पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: "The fair-browed girl shall be given to him who first attends on me / after circumambulating the earth, and to no one else, again and again."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ mayeritam
ahalyārthaṃ surā jagmuḥ pṛthivyāś ca pradakṣiṇe //
meaning:
ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं मयेरितम्
अहल्यार्थं सुरा जग्मुः पृथिव्याश् च प्रदक्षिणे //
text_mt: Thereupon, hearing the words spoken by me, all the hosts of gods, / the gods set out on the circumambulation of the earth for the sake of Ahalyā.

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu surasaṃgheṣu gautamo 'pi munīśvara
prayatnam akarot kiṃcid ahalyārtham imaṃ tathā //
meaning:
गतेषु सुरसंघेषु गौतमो ऽपि मुनीश्वर
प्रयत्नम् अकरोत् किंचिद् अहल्यार्थम् इमं तथा //
text_mt: When the hosts of gods had departed, Gautama too, O lord of sages, / made a certain effort in this way for the sake of Ahalyā.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn antare brahman surabhiḥ sarvakāmadhuk
ardhaprasūtā hy abhavat tāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन् सुरभिः सर्वकामधुक्
अर्धप्रसूता ह्य् अभवत् तां ददर्श स गौतमः //
text_mt: Meanwhile, O brahman, Surabhi, the fulfiller of all desires, / was giving birth; Gautama saw her when her calf was halfway delivered.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakre iyam urvīti saṃsmaran
liṅgasya ca sureśasya pradakṣiṇam athākarot //
meaning:
तस्याः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रे इयम् उर्वीति संस्मरन्
लिङ्गस्य च सुरेशस्य प्रदक्षिणम् अथाकरोत् //
text_mt: Remembering, "This is the earth," he circumambulated her, / and he then circumambulated the liṅga of the Lord of the Gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gautamo munisattamaḥ
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānām ekaṃ cāpi pradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
तयोः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा गौतमो मुनिसत्तमः
सर्वेषां चैव देवानाम् एकं चापि प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Having circumambulated both, Gautama, the best of sages, / and having also performed a single circumambulation of all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
naivābhavad bhuvo gantuḥ saṃjātaṃ dvitayaṃ mama
evaṃ niścitya sa munir mamāntikam athābhyagāt //
meaning:
नैवाभवद् भुवो गन्तुः संजातं द्वितयं मम
एवं निश्चित्य स मुनिर् ममान्तिकम् अथाभ्यगात् //
text_mt: [thought,] "Nothing of the sort occurred to the traveler of the earth; a twofold [fruit] has accrued to me." / Having resolved thus, the sage then came near me.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtvābravīd vākyaṃ gautamo māṃ mahāmatiḥ
kamalāsana viśvātman namas te 'stu punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्वाब्रवीद् वाक्यं गौतमो मां महामतिः
कमलासन विश्वात्मन् नमस् ते ऽस्तु पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Having bowed, the highly intelligent Gautama addressed these words to me: / "O Lotus-seated One, O Soul of the Universe, reverence, reverence to you again and again!

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā brahman mayeyaṃ vasudhākhilā
yad atra yuktaṃ deveśa jānīte tad bhavān svayam //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणीकृता ब्रह्मन् मयेयं वसुधाखिला
यद् अत्र युक्तं देवेश जानीते तद् भवान् स्वयम् //
text_mt: O brahman, this entire earth has been circumambulated by me. / Whatever is proper here, O Lord of the Gods, you yourself know."

sanskrit_iast:
mayā tu dhyānayogena jñātvā gautamam abravam
tavaiva dīyate subhrūḥ pradakṣiṇam idaṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
मया तु ध्यानयोगेन ज्ञात्वा गौतमम् अब्रवम्
तवैव दीयते सुभ्रूः प्रदक्षिणम् इदं कृतम् //
text_mt: Having understood through the yoga of meditation, I said to Gautama: / "The fair-browed one is given to you alone; this circumambulation has been accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ jānīhi viprarṣe durjñeyaṃ nigamair api
ardhaprasūtā surabhiḥ saptadvīpavatī mahī //
meaning:
धर्मं जानीहि विप्रर्षे दुर्ज्ञेयं निगमैर् अपि
अर्धप्रसूता सुरभिः सप्तद्वीपवती मही //
text_mt: Know the dharma, O twice-born ṛṣi, which is difficult to know even through the Vedas. / Surabhi, half-delivered, is the earth with its seven continents.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtā pradakṣiṇā tasyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ sā kṛtā bhavet
liṅgaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tad eva phalam āpnuyāt //
meaning:
कृता प्रदक्षिणा तस्याः पृथिव्याः सा कृता भवेत्
लिङ्गं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तद् एव फलम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Circumambulation of her is circumambulation of the earth. / Having circumambulated the liṅga, one attains that very fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mune gautama suvrata
tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava dhairyeṇa jñānena tapasā tathā //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन मुने गौतम सुव्रत
तुष्टो ऽहं तव धैर्येण ज्ञानेन तपसा तथा //
text_mt: Therefore, with all effort, O sage Gautama of noble vows, / I am pleased with your fortitude, your knowledge, and your austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
datteyam ṛṣiśārdūla kanyā lokavarā mayā
ity uktvāhaṃ gautamāya ahalyām adadāṃ mune //
meaning:
दत्तेयम् ऋषिशार्दूल कन्या लोकवरा मया
इत्य् उक्त्वाहं गौतमाय अहल्याम् अददां मुने //
text_mt: This maiden, the best in the world, is given by me, O tiger among ṛṣis." / Having spoken thus, O sage, I gave Ahalyā to Gautama.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte vivāhe te devāḥ kṛtvelāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam
śanaiḥ śanair athāgatya dadṛśuḥ sarva eva te //
meaning:
जाते विवाहे ते देवाः कृत्वेलायाः प्रदक्षिणम्
शनैः शनैर् अथागत्य ददृशुः सर्व एव ते //
text_mt: When the marriage had taken place, those gods, having circumambulated the earth, / arrived gradually, and all of them beheld

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ gautamam ahalyāṃ ca dāṃpatyaṃ prītivardhanam
te cāgatyātha paśyanto vismitāś cābhavan surāḥ //
meaning:
तं गौतमम् अहल्यां च दांपत्यं प्रीतिवर्धनम्
ते चागत्याथ पश्यन्तो विस्मिताश् चाभवन् सुराः //
text_mt: that Gautama and Ahalyā, a married couple who increased each other's affection; / and having arrived and looking on, the gods were filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
atikrānte vivāhe tu surāḥ sarve divaṃ yayuḥ
samatsaraḥ śacībhartā tām īkṣya ca divaṃ yayau //
meaning:
अतिक्रान्ते विवाहे तु सुराः सर्वे दिवं ययुः
समत्सरः शचीभर्ता ताम् ईक्ष्य च दिवं ययौ //
text_mt: When the wedding had concluded, all the gods went to heaven. / The husband of Śacī, looking upon her with envy, also went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prītamanās tasmai gautamāya mahātmane
prādāṃ brahmagiriṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ततः प्रीतमनास् तस्मै गौतमाय महात्मने
प्रादां ब्रह्मगिरिं पुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् //
text_mt: Then, pleased in mind, I gave to that great-souled Gautama / the holy, auspicious Brahmagiri, which bestows all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ahalyāyāṃ muniśreṣṭho reme tatra sa gautamaḥ
gautamasya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā śakras triviṣṭape //
meaning:
अहल्यायां मुनिश्रेष्ठो रेमे तत्र स गौतमः
गौतमस्य कथां पुण्यां श्रुत्वा शक्रस् त्रिविष्टपे //
text_mt: There that Gautama, the best of sages, took delight with Ahalyā. / Hearing the sacred story of Gautama, Śakra in heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
tam āśramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tasya bhāryām aninditām
bhūtvā brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa draṣṭum āgāc chatakratuḥ //
meaning:
तम् आश्रमं तं च मुनिं तस्य भार्याम् अनिन्दिताम्
भूत्वा ब्राह्मणवेषेण द्रष्टुम् आगाच् छतक्रतुः //
text_mt: disguising himself as a brāhmaṇa, came to see / that hermitage, that sage, and his blameless wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā bhavanaṃ tasya bhāryāṃ ca vibhavaṃ tathā
pāpīyasīṃ matiṃ kṛtvā ahalyāṃ samudaikṣata //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा भवनं तस्य भार्यां च विभवं तथा
पापीयसीं मतिं कृत्वा अहल्यां समुदैक्षत //
text_mt:
Having seen his residence, his wife, and likewise his splendor,
he formed an evil intention and gazed upon Ahalyā.

sanskrit_iast:
nātmānaṃ na paraṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ śāpād ṛṣer bhayam
na bubodha tadā vatsa kāmākṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ //
meaning:
नात्मानं न परं देशं कालं शापाद् ऋषेर् भयम्
न बुबोध तदा वत्स कामाकृष्टः शतक्रतुः //
text_mt:
Neither himself, nor the other, nor place, nor time, nor fear of the sage's curse
did Śatakratu, drawn by desire, recognize then, O dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
taddhyānaparamo nityaṃ surarājyena garvitaḥ
saṃtaptāṅgaḥ kathaṃ kuryāṃ praveśo me kathaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
तद्ध्यानपरमो नित्यं सुरराज्येन गर्वितः
संतप्ताङ्गः कथं कुर्यां प्रवेशो मे कथं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Constantly absorbed in thought of her, arrogant because of his sovereignty over the gods,
with limbs burning with fever [of passion, he thought]: “How might I act? How might my entrance be achieved?”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vasan viprarūpo nāntaraṃ tv adhyagacchata
sa kadācin mahāprājñaḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām //
meaning:
एवं वसन् विप्ररूपो नान्तरं त्व् अध्यगच्छत
स कदाचिन् महाप्राज्ञः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकीं क्रियाम् //
text_mt:
Living thus in the form of a brāhmaṇa, he found no opportunity.
Then once, having performed his morning rite, that sage of great wisdom,

sanskrit_iast:
sahito gautamaḥ śiṣyair nirgataś cāśramād bahiḥ
āśramaṃ gautamīṃ viprān dhānyāni vividhāni ca //
meaning:
सहितो गौतमः शिष्यैर् निर्गतश् चाश्रमाद् बहिः
आश्रमं गौतमीं विप्रान् धान्यानि विविधानि च //
text_mt:
Gautama, accompanied by his disciples, departed outside the hermitage.
To see the hermitage, the Gautamī, the brāhmaṇas, and various crops,

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭuṃ gato munivara indras taṃ samudaikṣata
idam antaram ity uktvā cakre kāryaṃ manaḥpriyam //
meaning:
द्रष्टुं गतो मुनिवर इन्द्रस् तं समुदैक्षत
इदम् अन्तरम् इत्य् उक्त्वा चक्रे कार्यं मनःप्रियम् //
text_mt:
the best of sages went; Indra observed him.
Saying, “This is the opportunity,” he performed the deed pleasing to his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ kṛtvā gautamasya priyepsuḥ sa śatakratuḥ
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīm ahalyāṃ vākyam abravīt //
meaning:
रूपं कृत्वा गौतमस्य प्रियेप्सुः स शतक्रतुः
तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीम् अहल्यां वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Assuming the form of Gautama, desiring the beloved, Śatakratu,
having seen Ahalyā, whose every limb was lovely, spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
ākṛṣṭo 'haṃ tava guṇai rūpaṃ smṛtvā skhalatpadaḥ
iti bruvan hasan hastam ādāyāntaḥ samāviśat //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
आकृष्टो ऽहं तव गुणै रूपं स्मृत्वा स्खलत्पदः
इति ब्रुवन् हसन् हस्तम् आदायान्तः समाविशत् //
text_mt:
Indra said:
“I have been drawn by your virtues; remembering your beauty, my step falters.”
Speaking thus, laughing, he took her hand and entered within.

sanskrit_iast:
na bubodha tv ahalyā taṃ jāraṃ mene tu gautamam
ramamāṇā yathāsaukhyaṃ prāgāc chiṣyaiḥ sa gautamaḥ //
meaning:
न बुबोध त्व् अहल्या तं जारं मेने तु गौतमम्
रममाणा यथासौख्यं प्रागाच् छिष्यैः स गौतमः //
text_mt:
Ahalyā, however, did not know him to be a paramour, but thought he was Gautama.
While she was enjoying pleasure as she wished, that Gautama arrived with his disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchantaṃ nityam eva ahalyā priyavādinī
pratiyāti priyaṃ vakti toṣayantī ca taṃ guṇaiḥ //
meaning:
आगच्छन्तं नित्यम् एव अहल्या प्रियवादिनी
प्रतियाति प्रियं वक्ति तोषयन्ती च तं गुणैः //
text_mt:
When he arrived, Ahalyā, who was ever sweet-spoken,
would go out to meet him, speak lovingly, and delight him with her virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
tām adṛṣṭvā mahāprājño mene tan mahad adbhutam
dvārasthitaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ sarve paśyanti nārada //
meaning:
ताम् अदृष्ट्वा महाप्राज्ञो मेने तन् महद् अद्भुतम्
द्वारस्थितं मुनिश्रेष्ठं सर्वे पश्यन्ति नारद //
text_mt:
Not seeing her, the greatly wise sage considered it a great wonder.
All saw the best of sages standing at the door, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotrasya śālāyā rakṣiṇo gṛhakarmiṇaḥ
ūcur munivaraṃ bhītā gautamaṃ vismayānvitāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रस्य शालाया रक्षिणो गृहकर्मिणः
ऊचुर् मुनिवरं भीता गौतमं विस्मयान्विताः //
text_mt:
The guards of the fire-sacrifice hall and the household servants,
frightened and filled with astonishment, spoke to Gautama, the best of sages:

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣiṇa ūcuḥ
bhagavan kim idaṃ citraṃ bahir antaś ca dṛśyase
priyayāntaḥ praviṣṭo 'si tathaiva ca bahir bhavān
aho tapaḥprabhāvo 'yaṃ nānārūpadharo bhavān //
meaning:
रक्षिण ऊचुः
भगवन् किम् इदं चित्रं बहिर् अन्तश् च दृश्यसे
प्रिययान्तः प्रविष्टो ऽसि तथैव च बहिर् भवान्
अहो तपःप्रभावो ऽयं नानारूपधरो भवान् //
text_mt:
The guards said:
“O venerable one, what wonder is this? You are seen both outside and inside!
You have entered inside with your beloved, and just so you are outside.
Ah, this is the power of your asceticism, you who bear multiple forms!”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tac chrutvā vismitas tv antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ko nu tiṣṭhati
priye ahalye bhavati kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase
ity ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā ahalyā jāram abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मितस् त्व् अन्तः प्रविष्टः को नु तिष्ठति
प्रिये अहल्ये भवति किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे
इत्य् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा अहल्या जारम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing that, he was astonished, [and entered within, thinking,] “Who indeed stands [here]?”
“O dear Ahalyā, lady, why do you not answer me?”
Hearing that word of the sage, Ahalyā spoke to the paramour:

sanskrit_iast:
ahalyovāca
ko bhavān munirūpeṇa pāpaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavān asi
iti bruvatī śayanād utthitā satvaraṃ bhayāt //
meaning:
अहल्योवाच
को भवान् मुनिरूपेण पापं त्वं कृतवान् असि
इति ब्रुवती शयनाद् उत्थिता सत्वरं भयात् //
text_mt:
Ahalyā said:
“Who are you in the guise of the sage? You have committed an evil deed!”
Speaking thus, she rose quickly from the bed in fear.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi pāpakṛc chakro biḍālo 'bhūn muner bhayāt
trastāṃ ca vikṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā svapriyāṃ dūṣitāṃ tadā //
meaning:
स चापि पापकृच् छक्रो बिडालो ऽभून् मुनेर् भयात्
त्रस्तां च विकृतां दृष्ट्वा स्वप्रियां दूषितां तदा //
text_mt:
And he, the evildoer Śakra, became a cat out of fear of the sage.
Then, seeing his beloved terrified, disfigured, and corrupted,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca sa muniḥ kopāt kim idaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛtam
iti bruvantaṃ bhartāraṃ sāpi novāca lajjitā //
meaning:
उवाच स मुनिः कोपात् किम् इदं साहसं कृतम्
इति ब्रुवन्तं भर्तारं सापि नोवाच लज्जिता //
text_mt:
that sage spoke in anger: “What reckless deed is this that has been done?”
To her husband who was speaking thus, she, being ashamed, said nothing.

sanskrit_iast:
anveṣayaṃs tu taṃ jāraṃ biḍālaṃ dadṛśe muniḥ
ko bhavān iti taṃ prāha bhasmīkuryāṃ mṛṣāvadan //
meaning:
अन्वेषयंस् तु तं जारं बिडालं ददृशे मुनिः
को भवान् इति तं प्राह भस्मीकुर्यां मृषावदन् //
text_mt:
Searching for that paramour, however, the sage saw the cat.
“Who are you?” he said to him, “I shall reduce you to ashes if you speak falsely!”

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā caivam āha śacīpatiḥ
śacībhartā purāṃ bhettā tapodhana puruṣṭutaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा चैवम् आह शचीपतिः
शचीभर्ता पुरां भेत्ता तपोधन पुरुष्टुतः //
text_mt:
Indra said:
Joining his hands in reverence, the lord of Śacī spoke thus:
“I am the husband of Śacī, the destroyer of citadels, O ascetic of great wealth, the much-praised one.

sanskrit_iast:
mamedaṃ pāpam āpannaṃ satyam uktaṃ mayānagha
mahadvigarhitaṃ karma kṛtavān asmy ahaṃ mune //
meaning:
ममेदं पापम् आपन्नं सत्यम् उक्तं मयानघ
महद्विगर्हितं कर्म कृतवान् अस्म्य् अहं मुने //
text_mt:
This evil has befallen me; the truth has been spoken by me, O sinless one.
I have committed an act greatly censured [by the wise], O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
smarasāyakanirbhinnahṛdayāḥ kiṃ na kurvate
brahman mayi mahāpāpe kṣamasva karuṇānidhe //
meaning:
स्मरसायकनिर्भिन्नहृदयाः किं न कुर्वते
ब्रह्मन् मयि महापापे क्षमस्व करुणानिधे //
text_mt:
Whose heart is pierced by the arrows of Kāma, what will they not do?
O brāhmaṇa, forgive me, a great sinner, O ocean of compassion!

sanskrit_iast:
santaḥ kṛtāparādhe 'pi na raukṣyaṃ jātu kurvate
niśamya tad vaco vipro harim āha ruṣānvitaḥ //
meaning:
सन्तः कृतापराधे ऽपि न रौक्ष्यं जातु कुर्वते
निशम्य तद् वचो विप्रो हरिम् आह रुषान्वितः //
text_mt:
Good people never show harshness even toward one who has committed an offense.”
Hearing that speech, the twice-born spoke to Hari, filled with fury:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
bhagabhaktyā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sahasrabhagavān bhava
tām apy āha muniḥ kopāt tvaṃ ca śuṣkanadī bhava //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
भगभक्त्या कृतं पापं सहस्रभगवान् भव
ताम् अप्य् आह मुनिः कोपात् त्वं च शुष्कनदी भव //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
“Because of your passion for the female organ you committed this sin; be possessed of a thousand female organs!”
In anger the sage spoke to her as well: “You too become a dried-up river!”

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ prasādayām āsa kathayantī tadākṛtim //
meaning: ततः प्रसादयाम् आस कथयन्ती तदाकृतिम् //
text_mt: Then she appeased him, relating that deception:

sanskrit_iast:
ahalyovāca
manasāpy anyapuruṣaṃ pāpiṣṭhāḥ kāmayanti yāḥ
akṣayān yānti narakāṃs tāsāṃ sarve 'pi pūrvajāḥ //
meaning:
अहल्योवाच
मनसाप्य् अन्यपुरुषं पापिष्ठाः कामयन्ति याः
अक्षयान् यान्ति नरकांस् तासां सर्वे ऽपि पूर्वजाः //
text_mt:
Ahalyā said:
“Those wicked women who desire another man even in thought
go to imperishable hells, and all their ancestors as well.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvā prasanno bhagavann avadhāraya madvacaḥ
tava rūpeṇa cāgatya mām agāt sākṣiṇas tv ime //
meaning:
भूत्वा प्रसन्नो भगवन्न् अवधारय मद्वचः
तव रूपेण चागत्य माम् अगात् साक्षिणस् त्व् इमे //
text_mt:
Become gracious, O venerable one, and consider my word:
having come in your form, he approached me; these guards are witnesses.”

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti rakṣiṇaḥ procur ahalyā satyavādinī
dhyānenāpi munir jñātvā śāntaḥ prāha pativratām //
meaning:
तथेति रक्षिणः प्रोचुर् अहल्या सत्यवादिनी
ध्यानेनापि मुनिर् ज्ञात्वा शान्तः प्राह पतिव्रताम् //
text_mt:
“It was so,” the guards said; Ahalyā had spoken the truth.
Having known it through meditation, the sage was calmed and spoke to the faithful wife:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
yadā tu saṃgatā bhadre gautamyā saridīśayā
nadī bhūtvā punā rūpaṃ prāpsyase priyakṛn mama //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
यदा तु संगता भद्रे गौतम्या सरिदीशया
नदी भूत्वा पुना रूपं प्राप्स्यसे प्रियकृन् मम //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
“When you are united, O fortunate one, with the Gautamī, the queen of rivers,
having become a river, you will attain your form again, doing what pleases me.”

sanskrit_iast:
ity ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā cakre pativratā
tayā tu saṃgatā devyā ahalyā gautamapriyā //
meaning:
इत्य् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा तथा चक्रे पतिव्रता
तया तु संगता देव्या अहल्या गौतमप्रिया //
text_mt:
Hearing that word of the sage, the faithful wife did so.
Joined with that goddess, Ahalyā, the beloved of Gautama,

sanskrit_iast:
punas tad rūpam abhavad yan mayā nirmitaṃ purā
tataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ surarāṭ prāha gautamam //
meaning:
पुनस् तद् रूपम् अभवद् यन् मया निर्मितं पुरा
ततः कृताञ्जलिपुटः सुरराट् प्राह गौतमम् //
text_mt:
again had that form which was fashioned by me in the past.
Then, with hands folded in reverence, the king of the gods spoke to Gautama:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
māṃ pāhi muniśārdūla pāpiṣṭhaṃ gṛham āgatam
pādayoḥ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā prāha gautamaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
मां पाहि मुनिशार्दूल पापिष्ठं गृहम् आगतम्
पादयोः पतितं दृष्ट्वा कृपया प्राह गौतमः //
text_mt:
Indra said:
“Protect me, O tiger among sages, the most wicked one who has come to your house!”
Seeing him fallen at his feet, Gautama said with compassion:

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
gautamīṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te snānaṃ kuru puraṃdara
kṣaṇān nirdhūtapāpas tvaṃ sahasrākṣo bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
गौतमीं गच्छ भद्रं ते स्नानं कुरु पुरंदर
क्षणान् निर्धूतपापस् त्वं सहस्राक्षो भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
Gautama said:
“Go to the Gautamī, may good betide you, and take a bath, O Puraṃdara.
In an instant, your sin washed away, you will become thousand-eyed.”

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayaṃ vismayakaraṃ dṛṣṭavān asmi nārada
ahalyāyāḥ punarbhāvaṃ śacībhartā sahasradṛk //
meaning:
उभयं विस्मयकरं दृष्टवान् अस्मि नारद
अहल्यायाः पुनर्भावं शचीभर्ता सहस्रदृक् //
text_mt:
I beheld both wondrous things, O Nārada:
the restoration of Ahalyā and the husband of Śacī becoming thousand-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ahalyāsaṃgamaṃ śubham
indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अहल्यासंगमं शुभम्
इन्द्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt:
From that time forward, that auspicious sacred ford, Ahalyāsaṃgama,
has been renowned as Indratīrtha, granting all desires to men.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tasmād apy aparaṃ tīrthaṃ janasthānam iti śrutam
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ smaraṇān muktidaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तस्माद् अप्य् अपरं तीर्थं जनस्थानम् इति श्रुतम्
चतुर्योजनविस्तीर्णं स्मरणान् मुक्तिदं नृणाम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Farther from that there is another sacred ford known as Janasthāna,
four yojanas in extent, granting liberation to men merely upon being remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatānvaye jāto rājābhūj janakaḥ purā
so 'pāṃpates tu tanujām upayeme guṇārṇavām //
meaning:
वैवस्वतान्वये जातो राजाभूज् जनकः पुरा
सो ऽपांपतेस् तु तनुजाम् उपयेमे गुणार्णवाम् //
text_mt:
Formerly, there was a king born in the lineage of Vaivasvata named Janaka;
he married the daughter of the lord of waters, an ocean of virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ janakāṃ janako nṛpaḥ
anurūpaguṇatvāc ca tasya bhāryā guṇārṇavā //
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां जनकां जनको नृपः
अनुरूपगुणत्वाच् च तस्य भार्या गुणार्णवा //
text_mt:
King Janaka [engendered a daughter] who produced dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation;
and because of her matching virtues, his wife was an ocean of virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
yājñavalkyaś ca viprendras tasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ
tam apṛcchan nṛpaśreṣṭho yājñavalkyaṃ purohitam //
meaning:
याज्ञवल्क्यश् च विप्रेन्द्रस् तस्य राज्ञः पुरोहितः
तम् अपृच्छन् नृपश्रेष्ठो याज्ञवल्क्यं पुरोहितम् //
text_mt:
And Yājñavalkya, the foremost among twice-borns, was the domestic priest of that king.
The best of kings asked him, the domestic priest Yājñavalkya:

sanskrit_iast:
janaka uvāca
bhuktimuktī ubhe śreṣṭhe nirṇīte munisattamaiḥ
dāsīdāsebhaturagarathādyair bhuktir uttamā //
meaning:
जनक उवाच
भुक्तिमुक्ती उभे श्रेष्ठे निर्णीते मुनिसत्तमैः
दासीदासेभतुरगरथाद्यैर् भुक्तिर् उत्तमा //
text_mt:
Janaka said:
“Both enjoyment and liberation have been determined as excellent by the best of sages.
Enjoyment is highest through female slaves, male slaves, elephants, horses, chariots, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃtv antavirasā bhuktir muktir ekā niratyayā
bhukter muktiḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhuktyā muktiṃ kathaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
किंत्व् अन्तविरसा भुक्तिर् मुक्तिर् एका निरत्यया
भुक्तेर् मुक्तिः श्रेष्ठतमा भुक्त्या मुक्तिं कथं व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
However, enjoyment ends bitterly, whereas liberation alone is without peril.
Liberation is superior to enjoyment; how may one attain liberation through enjoyment?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṅgaparityāgān muktiprāptiḥ suduḥkhataḥ
tad brūhi dvijaśārdūla sukhān muktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
सर्वसङ्गपरित्यागान् मुक्तिप्राप्तिः सुदुःखतः
तद् ब्रूहि द्विजशार्दूल सुखान् मुक्तिः कथं भवेत् //
text_mt:
The attainment of liberation through the abandonment of all attachment comes with great suffering.
Therefore tell me, O tiger among the twice-born, how liberation might come with ease?”

sanskrit_iast:
yājñavalkya uvāca
apāṃpatis tava guruḥ śvaśuraḥ priyakṛt tathā
taṃ gatvā pṛccha nṛpate upadekṣyati te hitam //
meaning:
याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच
अपांपतिस् तव गुरुः श्वशुरः प्रियकृत् तथा
तं गत्वा पृच्छ नृपते उपदेक्ष्यति ते हितम् //

sanskrit_iast:
yājñavalkyaś ca janako rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ tadā
gatvā cocatur avyagrau muktimārgaṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
याज्ञवल्क्यश् च जनको राजानं वरुणं तदा
गत्वा चोचतुर् अव्यग्रौ मुक्तिमार्गं यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
Then Yājñavalkya and Janaka, having gone with composed minds
to King Varuṇa, spoke in due order concerning the path to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇa uvāca
dvidhā tu saṃsthitā muktiḥ karmadvāre 'py akarmaṇi
vede ca niścito mārgaḥ karma jyāyo hy akarmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
वरुण उवाच
द्विधा तु संस्थिता मुक्तिः कर्मद्वारे ऽप्य् अकर्मणि
वेदे च निश्चितो मार्गः कर्म ज्यायो ह्य् अकर्मणः //
text_mt:
Varuṇa said:
“Liberation is established in two ways: through the door of action, and also in non-action.
And in the Veda the path is determined: action is indeed superior to non-action.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ ca karmaṇā baddhaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam
akarmaṇaivāpyata iti muktimārgo mṛṣocyate //
meaning:
सर्वं च कर्मणा बद्धं पुरुषार्थचतुष्टयम्
अकर्मणैवाप्यत इति मुक्तिमार्गो मृषोच्यते //
text_mt:
The entire group of four human goals is bound up with action.
That the path of liberation is attained solely through non-action is falsely stated.”

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā sarvadhānyāni setsyanti nṛpasattama
tasmāt sarvātmanā karma kartavyaṃ vaidikaṃ nṛbhiḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा सर्वधान्यानि सेत्स्यन्ति नृपसत्तम
तस्मात् सर्वात्मना कर्म कर्तव्यं वैदिकं नृभिः //
text_mt: By action all grains [and rewards] are attained, O best of kings; / therefore, with all their heart, men must perform Vedic action.

sanskrit_iast:
tena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca prāpnuvantīha mānavāḥ
akarmaṇaḥ karma puṇyaṃ karma cāpy āśrameṣu ca //
meaning:
तेन भुक्तिं च मुक्तिं च प्राप्नुवन्तीह मानवाः
अकर्मणः कर्म पुण्यं कर्म चाप्य् आश्रमेषु च //
text_mt: Through it mortals attain both enjoyment and liberation in this world. / Action is meritorious rather than inaction, and action [is enjoined] within the life-stages,

sanskrit_iast:
jātyāśritaṃ ca rājendra tatrāpi śṛṇu dharmavit
āśramāṇi ca catvāri karmadvārāṇi mānada //
meaning:
जात्याश्रितं च राजेन्द्र तत्रापि शृणु धर्मवित्
आश्रमाणि च चत्वारि कर्मद्वाराणि मानद //
text_mt: and based upon caste, O king of kings; listen further on this, O knower of dharma! / The four life-stages are the doors to action, O honor-giver,

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthyaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛtam
tasmād bhuktiś ca muktiś ca bhavatīti matir mama //
meaning:
चतुर्णाम् आश्रमाणां च गार्हस्थ्यं पुण्यदं स्मृतम्
तस्माद् भुक्तिश् च मुक्तिश् च भवतीति मतिर् मम //
text_mt: and of the four life-stages, the householder's life is remembered as giving merit. / From that arise both enjoyment and liberation: such is my opinion.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etac chrutvā tu janako yājñavalkyaś ca buddhimān
varuṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu punar vacanam ūcatuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतच् छ्रुत्वा तु जनको याज्ञवल्क्यश् च बुद्धिमान्
वरुणं पूजयित्वा तु पुनर् वचनम् ऊचतुः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard this, Janaka and the wise Yājñavalkya, / having worshipped Varuṇa, spoke these words again:

sanskrit_iast:
ko deśaḥ kiṃ ca tīrthaṃ syād bhuktimuktipradāyakam
tad vadasva suraśreṣṭha sarvajño 'si namo 'stu te //
meaning:
को देशः किं च तीर्थं स्याद् भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
तद् वदस्व सुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वज्ञो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: "What region and what tīrtha grants enjoyment and liberation? / Tell us that, O best of gods; you are all-knowing, homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇa uvāca
pṛthivyāṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ daṇḍakaṃ tatra puṇyadam
tasmin kṣetre kṛtaṃ karma bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
वरुण उवाच
पृथिव्यां भारतं वर्षं दण्डकं तत्र पुण्यदम्
तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे कृतं कर्म भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: Varuṇa said: / "On earth is the land of Bhārata, and there is the merit-giving Daṇḍaka; / action performed in that sacred field grants enjoyment and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ gautamī gaṅgā śreṣṭhā muktipradā nṛṇām
tatra yajñena dānena bhogān muktim avāpsyati //
meaning:
तीर्थानां गौतमी गङ्गा श्रेष्ठा मुक्तिप्रदा नृणाम्
तत्र यज्ञेन दानेन भोगान् मुक्तिम् अवाप्स्यति //
text_mt: Among tīrthas, the Gautamī Gaṅgā is the supreme, granting liberation to men; / through sacrifice and gift-giving there, one will attain pleasures and liberation."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
yājñavalkyaś ca janako vācaṃ śrutvā hy apāṃpateḥ
varuṇena hy anujñātau svapurīṃ jagmatus tadā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
याज्ञवल्क्यश् च जनको वाचं श्रुत्वा ह्य् अपांपतेः
वरुणेन ह्य् अनुज्ञातौ स्वपुरीं जग्मतुस् तदा //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard the speech of the lord of the waters, / permitted by Varuṇa, Yājñavalkya and Janaka then went to their city.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhādikaṃ karma cakāra janako nṛpaḥ
yājayām āsa viprendro yājñavalkyaś ca taṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
अश्वमेधादिकं कर्म चकार जनको नृपः
याजयाम् आस विप्रेन्द्रो याज्ञवल्क्यश् च तं नृपम् //
text_mt: King Janaka performed rites such as the horse-sacrifice, / and Yājñavalkya, the chief of brahmins, officiated for that king.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya yajñān muktim avāpa rāṭ
tathā janakarājāno bahavas tatra karmaṇā //
meaning:
गङ्गातीरं समाश्रित्य यज्ञान् मुक्तिम् अवाप राट्
तथा जनकराजानो बहवस् तत्र कर्मणा //
text_mt: Resorting to the bank of the Gaṅgā, the king attained liberation through sacrifice. / Likewise, many Janaka kings attained liberation there through action,

sanskrit_iast:
muktiṃ prāpur mahābhāgā gautamyāś ca prasādataḥ
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ janasthāneti viśrutam //
meaning:
मुक्तिं प्रापुर् महाभागा गौतम्याश् च प्रसादतः
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं जनस्थानेति विश्रुतम् //
text_mt: those fortunate ones, by the grace of Gautamī. / Thenceforth that tīrtha became renowned as Janasthāna.

sanskrit_iast:
janakānāṃ yajñasado janasthānaṃ prakīrtitam
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ smaraṇāt sarvapāpanut //
meaning:
जनकानां यज्ञसदो जनस्थानं प्रकीर्तितम्
चतुर्योजनविस्तीर्णं स्मरणात् सर्वपापनुत् //
text_mt: The sacrificial arena of the Janakas is proclaimed as Janasthāna; / extending four yojanas, it removes all sins merely by being remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snānena dānena pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇena tu
tīrthasya smaraṇād vāpi gamanād bhaktisevanāt //
meaning:
तत्र स्नानेन दानेन पितॄणां तर्पणेन तु
तीर्थस्य स्मरणाद् वापि गमनाद् भक्तिसेवनात् //
text_mt: By bathing, giving gifts, and offering libations to the ancestors there, / or by remembering the tīrtha, visiting it, and serving it with devotion,

sanskrit_iast: sarvān kāmān avāpnoti muktiṃ ca samavāpnuyāt //
meaning: सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति मुक्तिं च समवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: one attains all desires and fully reaches liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
aruṇā varuṇā caiva nadyau puṇyatare śubhe
tayoś ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāṃ munisattama //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अरुणा वरुणा चैव नद्यौ पुण्यतरे शुभे
तयोश् च संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गायां मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / The Aruṇā and the Varuṇā are two auspicious, most holy rivers, / and their confluence in the Gaṅgā is sacred, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tadutpattiṃ śṛṇuṣveha sarvapāpavināśinīm
kaśyapasya suto jyeṣṭha ādityo lokaviśrutaḥ //
meaning:
तदुत्पत्तिं शृणुष्वेह सर्वपापविनाशिनीम्
कश्यपस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठ आदित्यो लोकविश्रुतः //
text_mt: Listen now to their origin, which destroys all sins: / The eldest son of Kaśyapa is Āditya, renowned throughout the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyacakṣus tīkṣṇāṃśuḥ saptāśvo lokapūjitaḥ
tasya patnī uṣā khyātā tvāṣṭrī trailokyasundarī //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यचक्षुस् तीक्ष्णांशुः सप्ताश्वो लोकपूजितः
तस्य पत्नी उषा ख्याता त्वाष्ट्री त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी //
text_mt: the eye of the three worlds, sharp-rayed, having seven horses, worshipped by all people. / His wife was renowned as Uṣā, the daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ, beautiful in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartuḥ pratāpatīvratvam asahantī sumadhyamā
cintayām āsa kiṃ kṛtyaṃ mama syād iti bhāminī //
meaning:
भर्तुः प्रतापतीव्रत्वम् असहन्ती सुमध्यमा
चिन्तयाम् आस किं कृत्यं मम स्याद् इति भामिनी //
text_mt: Unable to endure the intense blazing heat of her husband, the slender-waisted one, / that radiant woman, pondered: "What should I do?"

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ putrau mahārājñau manur vaivasvato yamaḥ
yamunā ca nadī puṇyā śṛṇu vismayakāraṇam //
meaning:
तस्याः पुत्रौ महाराज्ञौ मनुर् वैवस्वतो यमः
यमुना च नदी पुण्या शृणु विस्मयकारणम् //
text_mt: Her two sons were the great kings Manu Vaivasvata and Yama, / and [her daughter was] the holy river Yamunā. Listen to the cause of wonder!

sanskrit_iast:
sākarod ātmanaś chāyām ātmarūpeṇa yatnataḥ
tām abravīt tataś coṣā tvaṃ ca matsadṛśī bhava //
meaning:
साकरोद् आत्मनश् छायाम् आत्मरूपेण यत्नतः
ताम् अब्रवीत् ततश् चोषा त्वं च मत्सदृशी भव //
text_mt: With effort she made her own shadow into her own form. / Then Uṣā said to her: "Become just like me!

sanskrit_iast:
bhartāraṃ tvam apatyāni pālayasva mamājñayā
yāvad āgamanaṃ me syāt patyus tāvat priyā bhava //
meaning:
भर्तारं त्वम् अपत्यानि पालयस्व ममाज्ञया
यावद् आगमनं मे स्यात् पत्युस् तावत् प्रिया भव //
text_mt: Take care of my husband and my children by my command; / as long as my return may be, be dear to my husband!

sanskrit_iast:
nākhyātavyaṃ tvayā kvāpi apatyānāṃ tathā priye
tathety āha ca sā chāyā nirjagāma gṛhād uṣā //
meaning:
नाख्यातव्यं त्वया क्वापि अपत्यानां तथा प्रिये
तथेत्य् आह च सा छाया निर्जगाम गृहाद् उषा //
text_mt: You must not tell anywhere [about this], nor to the children, O dear one!" / That Shadow said, "So be it," and Uṣā departed from the house.

sanskrit_iast:
ity uktvā sā jagāmāśu śāntaṃ rūpam abhīpsatī
sā gatvoṣā gṛhaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat
tvaṣṭāpi cakitaḥ prāha tāṃ sutāṃ sutavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
इत्य् उक्त्वा सा जगामाशु शान्तं रूपम् अभीप्सती
सा गत्वोषा गृहं त्वष्टुः पित्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत्
त्वष्टापि चकितः प्राह तां सुतां सुतवत्सलः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, she went away quickly, longing for an appeased form. / Having gone to the house of Tvaṣṭṛ, Uṣā reported everything to her father. / Tvaṣṭṛ too, astonished, spoke to his daughter, loving his child:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭovāca
naitad yuktaṃ bhartṛmatyā yat svaireṇa pravartanam
apatyānāṃ kathaṃ vṛttir bhartur vā savitus tava
bibhemi bhadre śiṣṭo 'haṃ bhartur gehaṃ punar vraja //
meaning:
त्वष्टोवाच
नैतद् युक्तं भर्तृमत्या यत् स्वैरेण प्रवर्तनम्
अपत्यानां कथं वृत्तिर् भर्तुर् वा सवितुस् तव
बिभेमि भद्रे शिष्टो ऽहं भर्तुर् गेहं पुनर् व्रज //
text_mt: Tvaṣṭṛ said: / "It is not proper for a married woman to act arbitrarily. / What of the livelihood of your children or of your husband Savitṛ? / I am afraid, gentle one, for I am cultured; return to your husband's home!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktā tu pitrā sā nety uktvā vai punaḥ punaḥ
uttaraṃ ca kuror deśaṃ jagāma tapase tvarā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्ता तु पित्रा सा नेत्य् उक्त्वा वै पुनः पुनः
उत्तरं च कुरोर् देशं जगाम तपसे त्वरा //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Addressed thus by her father, saying "No!" repeatedly, / she hastily went to the land of the northern Kurus to practice austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tepe tapas tīvraṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī
duṣprekṣaṃ taṃ svakaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyantī niścalā uṣā //
meaning:
तत्र तेपे तपस् तीव्रं वडवारूपधारिणी
दुष्प्रेक्षं तं स्वकं कान्तं ध्यायन्ती निश्चला उषा //
text_mt: There she practiced severe austerities, having assumed the form of a mare, / meditating steadfastly, Uṣā, upon her difficult-to-behold beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn antare tāta chāyā coṣāsvarūpiṇī
patyau sā vartayām āsa apatyāny atha jajñire //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तात छाया चोषास्वरूपिणी
पत्यौ सा वर्तयाम् आस अपत्यान्य् अथ जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: In the meantime, my dear, the Shadow, having the form of Uṣā, / attended upon the husband, and then offspring were born:

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇiś ca śaniś caiva viṣṭir yā duṣṭakanyakā
sā chāyā vartayām āsa vaiṣamyeṇaiva nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
सावर्णिश् च शनिश् चैव विष्टिर् या दुष्टकन्यका
सा छाया वर्तयाम् आस वैषम्येणैव नित्यशः //
text_mt: Sāvarṇi, Śani, and Viṣṭi, who was an evil daughter. / That Shadow always acted with partiality

sanskrit_iast:
sveṣv apatyeṣu coṣāyā yamas tatra cukopa ha
vaiṣamyeṇātha vartantīṃ chāyāṃ tāṃ mātaraṃ tadā //
meaning:
स्वेष्व् अपत्येषु चोषाया यमस् तत्र चुकोप ह
वैषम्येणाथ वर्तन्तीं छायां तां मातरं तदा //
text_mt: towards her own children and against those of Uṣā. Yama became angry at that; / then, towards that mother, the Shadow, who was behaving with partiality,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayām āsa pādena dakṣiṇāśāpatir yamaḥ
putradaurjanyasaṃkṣobhāc chāyā vaivasvataṃ yamam //
meaning:
ताडयाम् आस पादेन दक्षिणाशापतिर् यमः
पुत्रदौर्जन्यसंक्षोभाच् छाया वैवस्वतं यमम् //
text_mt: Yama, the lord of the southern quarter, kicked her with his foot. / Agitated by the wickedness of the son, the Shadow cursed Yama Vaivasvata:

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa pāpa te pādo viśīryatu mamājñayā
viśīrṇacaraṇo duḥkhād rudan pitaram abhyagāt
