Bestow the divine weapons, O foremost among sages,
which were deposited with you by the gods!"
Dadhīci, too, said: "Out of fear of the enemies of the gods,
since you did not arrive for a long time,

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇi pītāni śarīrasaṃsthāny
uktāni yuktaṃ mama tad vadantu
śrutvā taduktaṃ vacanaṃ tu devāḥ
procus tam itthaṃ vinayāvanamrāḥ
meaning:
अस्त्राणि पीतानि शरीरसंस्थान्य्
उक्तानि युक्तं मम तद् वदन्तु
श्रुत्वा तदुक्तं वचनं तु देवाः
प्रोचुस् तम् इत्थं विनयावनम्राः
text_mt: "The weapons have been consumed and remain within my body, / as was told; let them tell me what is proper." / Having heard the word he spoke, the gods / answered him, bowed low in reverence:

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇi dehīti ca vaktum etac
chakyaṃ na vānyat prativaktuṃ munīndra
vinā ca taiḥ paribhūyema nityaṃ
puṣṭārayaḥ kva prayāmo munīśa
meaning:
अस्त्राणि देहीति च वक्तुम् एतच्
छक्यं न वान्यत् प्रतिवक्तुं मुनीन्द्र
विना च तैः परिभूयेम नित्यं
पुष्टारयः क्व प्रयामो मुनीश
text_mt: "Neither can we say 'Give us the weapons', / nor can we answer otherwise, O lord of sages. / Yet without them we would be perpetually overthrown; / with our enemies strengthened, where shall we go, O lord among sages?

sanskrit_iast:
na martyaloke na tale na nāke
vāsaḥ surāṇāṃ bhavitādya tāta
tvaṃ vipravaryas tapasā caiva yukto
nānyad vaktuṃ yujyate te purastāt
meaning:
न मर्त्यलोके न तले न नाके
वासः सुराणां भविताद्य तात
त्वं विप्रवर्यस् तपसा चैव युक्तो
नान्यद् वक्तुं युज्यते ते पुरस्तात्
text_mt: Neither in the mortal world, nor in the underworld, nor in heaven / can there be a dwelling for the gods today, father. / You are the best among the twice-born, endowed with austerity; / it is not fitting to speak anything else before you."

sanskrit_iast:
vipras tadovāca madasthisaṃsthāny
astrāṇi gṛhṇantu na saṃśayo 'tra
devās tam apy āhur anena kiṃ no hy
astrair hīnāḥ strītvam āptāḥ surendrāḥ
meaning:
विप्रस् तदोवाच मदस्थिसंस्थान्य्
अस्त्राणि गृह्णन्तु न संशयो ऽत्र
देवास् तम् अप्य् आहुर् अनेन किं नो ह्य्
अस्त्रैर् हीनाः स्त्रीत्वम् आप्ताः सुरेन्द्राः
text_mt: The brahmin then said: "Let them take the weapons / that reside in my bones, of this there is no doubt." / But the gods said to him: "What good is this to us? / Deprived of our weapons, the lords of the gods have attained womanhood."

sanskrit_iast:
punas tadā cāha munipravīras
tyakṣye jīvān daihikān yogayuktaḥ
astrāṇi kurvantu madasthibhūtāny
anuttamāny uttamarūpavanti
meaning:
पुनस् तदा चाह मुनिप्रवीरस्
त्यक्ष्ये जीवान् दैहिकान् योगयुक्तः
अस्त्राणि कुर्वन्तु मदस्थिभूतान्य्
अनुत्तमान्य् उत्तमरूपवन्ति
text_mt: Then the heroic sage spoke once again: / "I shall cast off the bodily vital breaths, absorbed in yoga; / let them fashion weapons from my bones, / unexcelled and possessed of supreme forms."

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva cety āhur adīnasattvaṃ
dadhīcim ity uttaram agnikalpam
tadā tu tasya priyam īrayantī
na sāṃnidhye prātitheyī munīśa
meaning:
कुरुष्व चेत्य् आहुर् अदीनसत्त्वं
दधीचिम् इत्य् उत्तरम् अग्निकल्पम्
तदा तु तस्य प्रियम् ईरयन्ती
न सांनिध्ये प्रातिथेयी मुनीश
text_mt: "Do so!" they replied to Dadhīci of undaunted spirit, / who was equal to fire, with this answer. / At that time, Prātitheyī, who spoke what was dear to him, / was not present, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
te cāpi devās tām adṛṣṭvaiva śīghraṃ
tasyā bhītā vipram ūcuḥ kuruṣva
tatyāja jīvān dustyajān prītiyukto
yathāsukhaṃ deham imaṃ juṣadhvam
meaning:
ते चापि देवास् ताम् अदृष्ट्वैव शीघ्रं
तस्या भीता विप्रम् ऊचुः कुरुष्व
तत्याज जीवान् दुस्त्यजान् प्रीतियुक्तो
यथासुखं देहम् इमं जुषध्वम्
text_mt: And not seeing her, the gods quickly, / afraid of her, said to the brahmin: "Do it!" / Filled with love, he gave up the vital breaths that are hard to abandon, [saying]: / "Enjoy this body as you please!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvāsau baddhapadmāsanastho
nāsāgradattākṣiprakāśaprasannaḥ
vāyuṃ savahniṃ madhyamodghāṭayogān
nītvā śanair daharākāśagarbham
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वासौ बद्धपद्मासनस्थो
नासाग्रदत्ताक्षिप्रकाशप्रसन्नः
वायुं सवह्निं मध्यमोद्घाटयोगान्
नीत्वा शनैर् दहराकाशगर्भम्
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus, sitting in the bound lotus posture, / serene, his gaze fixed on the tip of his nose, / by the yoga of opening the central channel, slowly leading the breath / together with the fire into the hollow of the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
yad aprameyaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ yad
yad brahmarūpaṃ yad upāsitavyam
tatraiva vinyasya dhiyaṃ mahātmā
sāyujyatāṃ brahmaṇo 'sau jagāma
meaning:
यद् अप्रमेयं परमं पदं यद्
यद् ब्रह्मरूपं यद् उपासितव्यम्
तत्रैव विन्यस्य धियं महात्मा
सायुज्यतां ब्रह्मणो ऽसौ जगाम
text_mt: and fixing his thought on that which is immeasurable, / which is the supreme abode, which is of the nature of Brahman, which is to be meditated upon, / that great-souled one attained communion with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjīvatāṃ prāptam abhīkṣya devāḥ
kalevaraṃ tasya surāś ca samyak
tvaṣṭāram apy ūcur atitvarantaḥ
kuruṣva cāstrāṇi bahūni sadyaḥ
meaning:
निर्जीवतां प्राप्तम् अभीक्ष्य देवाः
कलेवरं तस्य सुराश् च सम्यक्
त्वष्टारम् अप्य् ऊचुर् अतित्वरन्तः
कुरुष्व चास्त्राणि बहूनि सद्यः
text_mt: Observing that his body had become lifeless, / the deities and gods, in great haste, / spoke even to Tvaṣṭṛ: / "Fashion many weapons at once!"

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi tān āha kathaṃ nu kāryaṃ
kalevaraṃ brāhmaṇasyeha devāḥ
bibhemi kartuṃ dāruṇaṃ cākṣamo 'haṃ
vidāritāny āyudhāny uttamāni
meaning:
स चापि तान् आह कथं नु कार्यं
कलेवरं ब्राह्मणस्येह देवाः
बिभेमि कर्तुं दारुणं चाक्षमो ऽहं
विदारितान्य् आयुधान्य् उत्तमानि
text_mt: He too said to them: "How should this be done / to the body of a brahmin here, O gods? / I am afraid to do something cruel, and I am unable / to fashion excellent weapons from what has been torn apart."

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
vajraṃ mukhaṃ vaḥ kriyate hitārthaṃ
gāvo devair āyudhārthaṃ kṣaṇena
dadhīcidehaṃ tu vidārya yūyam
asthīni śuddhāni prayacchatādya
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
वज्रं मुखं वः क्रियते हितार्थं
गावो देवैर् आयुधार्थं क्षणेन
दधीचिदेहं तु विदार्य यूयम्
अस्थीनि शुद्धानि प्रयच्छताद्य
text_mt:
The gods said:
"Your mouth is made into a thunderbolt for the sake of benefit; / the cows were created by the gods in an instant for the sake of weapons. / Tearing apart Dadhīci's body, / do you provide clean bones today."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tā devavākyāc ca tathaiva cakruḥ
saṃlihya cāsthīni daduḥ surāṇām
surās tvarā jagmur adīnasattvāḥ
svam ālayaṃ cāpi tathaiva gāvaḥ
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ता देववाक्याच् च तथैव चक्रुः
संलिह्य चास्थीनि ददुः सुराणाम्
सुरास् त्वरा जग्मुर् अदीनसत्त्वाः
स्वम् आलयं चापि तथैव गावः
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
At the word of the gods, they did just so; / licking the bones clean, they gave them to the gods. / With minds relieved, the gods departed in haste, / and the cows likewise went to their own dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tathāstrāṇi ca devatānāṃ
tvaṣṭā jagāmātha surājñayā tadā
tataś cirāc chīlavatī subhadrā
bhartuḥ priyā bālagarbhā tvarantī
meaning:
कृत्वा तथास्त्राणि च देवतानां
त्वष्टा जगामाथ सुराज्ञया तदा
ततश् चिराच् छीलवती सुभद्रा
भर्तुः प्रिया बालगर्भा त्वरन्ती
text_mt: Having fashioned the weapons for the deities, / Tvaṣṭṛ then departed at the gods' command. / Then after a long time, the virtuous and auspicious one, / beloved of her husband and pregnant with a child, hurried along,

sanskrit_iast:
kare gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ vāripūrṇam
umāṃ natvā phalapuṣpaiḥ sametya
agniṃ ca bhartāram athāśramaṃ ca
saṃdraṣṭukāmā hy ājagāmātha śīghram
meaning:
करे गृहीत्वा कलशं वारिपूर्णम्
उमां नत्वा फलपुष्पैः समेत्य
अग्निं च भर्तारम् अथाश्रमं च
संद्रष्टुकामा ह्य् आजगामाथ शीघ्रम्
text_mt: carrying in her hand a pitcher filled with water, / having bowed to Umā, returning with fruits and flowers, / desiring to see the fire, her husband, and the hermitage; / indeed she arrived quickly.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchantīṃ tāṃ prātitheyīṃ tadānīṃ
nivārayām āsa tadolkapātaḥ
sā saṃbhramād āgatā cāśramaṃ svaṃ
naivāpaśyat tatra bhartāram agre
meaning:
आगच्छन्तीं तां प्रातिथेयीं तदानीं
निवारयाम् आस तदोल्कपातः
सा संभ्रमाद् आगता चाश्रमं स्वं
नैवापश्यत् तत्र भर्तारम् अग्रे
text_mt: As Prātitheyī was coming at that time, / the fall of a meteor restrained her then. / Confused, she arrived at her hermitage / and did not see her husband before her.

sanskrit_iast:
kva vā gataś ceti savismayā sā
papraccha cāgniṃ prātitheyī tadānīm
agnis tadovāca savistaraṃ tāṃ
devāgamaṃ yācanaṃ vai śarīre
meaning:
क्व वा गतश् चेति सविस्मया सा
पप्रच्छ चाग्निं प्रातिथेयी तदानीम्
अग्निस् तदोवाच सविस्तरं तां
देवागमं याचनं वै शरीरे
text_mt: Perplexed, Prātitheyī then asked the fire: / "Where has he gone?" / The fire then told her in detail / of the gods' arrival, their begging for the body,

sanskrit_iast:
asthnām upādānam atha prayāṇaṃ
śrutvā sarvaṃ duḥkhitā sā babhūva
duḥkhodvegāt sā papātātha pṛthvyāṃ
mandaṃ mandaṃ vahnināśvāsitā ca
meaning:
अस्थ्नाम् उपादानम् अथ प्रयाणं
श्रुत्वा सर्वं दुःखिता सा बभूव
दुःखोद्वेगात् सा पपाताथ पृथ्व्यां
मन्दं मन्दं वह्निनाश्वासिता च
text_mt: the taking of the bones, and their departure. / Hearing everything, she was filled with sorrow; / from the agitation of grief, she fell to the ground, / and was slowly consoled by the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
prātitheyy uvāca brahmovāca prātitheyy uvāca
utpadyate yat tu vināśi sarvaṃ
na śocyam astīti manuṣyaloke
govipradevārtham iha tyajanti
prāṇān priyān puṇyabhājo manuṣyāḥ
meaning:
प्रातिथेय्य् उवाच ब्रह्मोवाच प्रातिथेय्य् उवाच
उत्पद्यते यत् तु विनाशि सर्वं
न शोच्यम् अस्तीति मनुष्यलोके
गोविप्रदेवार्थम् इह त्यजन्ति
प्राणान् प्रियान् पुण्यभाजो मनुष्याः
text_mt:
Prātitheyī said:
Whatever is born is all perishable;
there is nothing to be mourned in the world of men.
In this world, meritorious men surrender their dear lives
for the sake of cows, brāhmaṇas, and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāracakre parivartamāne
dehaṃ samarthaṃ dharmayuktaṃ tv avāpya
priyān prāṇān devaviprārthahetos
te vai dhanyāḥ prāṇino ye tyajanti
meaning:
संसारचक्रे परिवर्तमाने
देहं समर्थं धर्मयुक्तं त्व् अवाप्य
प्रियान् प्राणान् देवविप्रार्थहेतोस्
ते वै धन्याः प्राणिनो ये त्यजन्ति
text_mt: As the wheel of saṃsāra turns, / having obtained an able body endowed with dharma, / fortunate indeed are those living beings who surrender / their beloved lives for the sake of gods and brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāḥ sarve 'syāpi dehānvitasya
yātāro vai nātra saṃdehaleśaḥ
evaṃ jñātvā vipragodevadīnādy
arthaṃ cainān utsṛjantīśvarās te
meaning:
प्राणाः सर्वे ऽस्यापि देहान्वितस्य
यातारो वै नात्र संदेहलेशः
एवं ज्ञात्वा विप्रगोदेवदीनाद्य्
अर्थं चैनान् उत्सृजन्तीश्वरास् ते
text_mt: All the vital breaths of this embodied one / will surely depart; there is not the slightest doubt of this. / Knowing this, those lords give them up / for the sake of brahmins, cows, gods, and the destitute.

sanskrit_iast:
nivāryamāṇo 'pi mayā prapannayā
cakāra devāstraparigrahaṃ saḥ
manogataṃ vetty athavā vidhātuḥ
ko martyalokātigaceṣṭitasya
meaning:
निवार्यमाणो ऽपि मया प्रपन्नया
चकार देवास्त्रपरिग्रहं सः
मनोगतं वेत्त्य् अथवा विधातुः
को मर्त्यलोकातिगचेष्टितस्य
text_mt: Though restrained by me, who took refuge in him, / he took upon himself the weapons of the gods. / Or who knows the intention of the Ordainer, / whose deeds transcend the mortal world?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity evam uktvāpūjya cāgnīn yathāvad
bhartus tvacā lomabhiḥ sā viveśa
garbhasthitaṃ bālakaṃ prātitheyī
kukṣiṃ vidāryātha kare gṛhītvā
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् एवम् उक्त्वापूज्य चाग्नीन् यथावद्
भर्तुस् त्वचा लोमभिः सा विवेश
गर्भस्थितं बालकं प्रातिथेयी
कुक्षिं विदार्याथ करे गृहीत्वा
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus and properly worshipped the fires, / she entered [the fire] along with her husband's skin and hair. / Slitting her abdomen, Prātitheyī / took in her hand the boy resting in the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
prātitheyy uvāca
pitrā hīno bandhubhir gotrajaiś ca
mātrā hīno bālakaḥ sarva eva
rakṣantu sarve 'pi ca bhūtasaṃghās
tathauṣadhyo bālakaṃ lokapālāḥ
meaning:
प्रातिथेय्य् उवाच
पित्रा हीनो बन्धुभिर् गोत्रजैश् च
मात्रा हीनो बालकः सर्व एव
रक्षन्तु सर्वे ऽपि च भूतसंघास्
तथौषध्यो बालकं लोकपालाः
text_mt:
Prātitheyī said:
"Bereft of father, kinsmen, and agnates, / this child is completely bereft of mother. / Let all the hosts of beings, the herbs, / and the guardians of the world protect the child!

sanskrit_iast:
ye bālakaṃ mātṛpitṛprahīṇaṃ
sanirviśeṣaṃ svatanuprarūḍhaiḥ
paśyanti rakṣanti ta eva nūnaṃ
brahmādikānām api vandanīyāḥ
meaning:
ये बालकं मातृपितृप्रहीणं
सनिर्विशेषं स्वतनुप्ररूढैः
पश्यन्ति रक्षन्ति त एव नूनं
ब्रह्मादिकानाम् अपि वन्दनीयाः
text_mt: Those who look upon and protect a child / bereft of mother and father / without distinction from those sprung from their own body / are truly worthy of worship even by Brahmā and the others."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā cātyajad bālaṃ bhartṛcittaparāyaṇā
pippalānāṃ samīpe tu nyasya bālaṃ namasya ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा चात्यजद् बालं भर्तृचित्तपरायणा
पिप्पलानां समीपे तु न्यस्य बालं नमस्य च //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus, she, devoted in heart to her husband, abandoned the boy, / placing the boy near the pippala trees and bowing down to him.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yajñapātrasamanvitā
viveśāgniṃ prātitheyī bhartrā saha divaṃ yayau //
meaning:
अग्निं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य यज्ञपात्रसमन्विता
विवेशाग्निं प्रातिथेयी भर्त्रा सह दिवं ययौ //
text_mt: Circumambulating the fire, equipped with the sacrificial vessels, / Prātitheyī entered the fire and went to heaven with her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
ruruduś cāśramasthā ye vṛkṣāś ca vanavāsinaḥ
putravat poṣitā yena ṛṣiṇā ca dadhīcinā //
meaning:
रुरुदुश् चाश्रमस्था ये वृक्षाश् च वनवासिनः
पुत्रवत् पोषिता येन ऋषिणा च दधीचिना //
text_mt: And the trees standing in the hermitage, the dwellers in the forest, / who had been nurtured like sons by the sage Dadhīci, wept.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā tena na jīvāmas tayā mātrā vinā tathā
mṛgāś ca pakṣiṇaḥ sarve vṛkṣāḥ procuḥ parasparam //
meaning:
विना तेन न जीवामस् तया मात्रा विना तथा
मृगाश् च पक्षिणः सर्वे वृक्षाः प्रोचुः परस्परम् //
text_mt: "Without him we cannot live, nor without that mother," / so said all the beasts, the birds, and the trees to one another.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣā ūcuḥ
svargam āseduṣoḥ pitros tadapatyeṣv akṛtrimam
ye kurvanty aniśaṃ snehaṃ ta eva kṛtino narāḥ //
meaning:
वृक्षा ऊचुः
स्वर्गम् आसेदुषोः पित्रोस् तदपत्येष्व् अकृत्रिमम्
ये कुर्वन्त्य् अनिशं स्नेहं त एव कृतिनो नराः //
text_mt:
The trees said:
"Those men are truly accomplished who continuously show unfeigned love / towards the offspring of their parents when they have reached heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīciḥ prātitheyī vā vīkṣate 'smān yathā purā
tathā pitā na mātā vā dhig asmān pāpino vayam //
meaning:
दधीचिः प्रातिथेयी वा वीक्षते ऽस्मान् यथा पुरा
तथा पिता न माता वा धिग् अस्मान् पापिनो वयम् //
text_mt: Neither our father nor our mother looks upon us / as Dadhīci or Prātitheyī did in the past; shame on us, we are sinners!

sanskrit_iast:
asmākam api sarveṣām ataḥ prabhṛti niścitam
bālo dadhīciḥ prātitheyī bālo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अस्माकम् अपि सर्वेषाम् अतः प्रभृति निश्चितम्
बालो दधीचिः प्रातिथेयी बालो धर्मः सनातनः //
text_mt: Henceforth, it is decided for all of us as well: / the boy is Dadhīci, Prātitheyī; the boy is eternal dharma."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā tadauṣadhyo vanaspatisamanvitāḥ
somaṃ rājānam abhyetya yācire 'mṛtam uttamam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा तदौषध्यो वनस्पतिसमन्विताः
सोमं राजानम् अभ्येत्य याचिरे ऽमृतम् उत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Having spoken thus, the medicinal herbs along with the lords of the forest / approached King Soma and begged for the excellent nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi dattavāṃs tebhyaḥ somo 'mṛtam anuttamam
dadur bālāya te cāpi amṛtaṃ suravallabham //
meaning:
स चापि दत्तवांस् तेभ्यः सोमो ऽमृतम् अनुत्तमम्
ददुर् बालाय ते चापि अमृतं सुरवल्लभम् //
text_mt: And Soma gave them the unexcelled nectar; / and they gave the nectar dear to the gods to the boy.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena tṛpto vavṛdhe śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī
pippalaiḥ pālito yasmāt pippalādaḥ sa bālakaḥ
pravṛddhaḥ pippalān evam uvāca tv ativismitaḥ //
meaning:
स तेन तृप्तो ववृधे शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी
पिप्पलैः पालितो यस्मात् पिप्पलादः स बालकः
प्रवृद्धः पिप्पलान् एवम् उवाच त्व् अतिविस्मितः //
text_mt: Nourished by that, he grew like the moon in the bright fortnight. / Because he was protected by the pippala trees, that boy was named Pippalāda; / having grown up, he spoke thus to the pippala trees in great wonder:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
mānuṣebhyo mānuṣās tu jāyante pakṣibhiḥ khagāḥ
bījebhyo vīrudho loke vaiṣamyaṃ naiva dṛśyate
vārkṣas tv ahaṃ kathaṃ jāto hastapādādijīvavān //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
मानुषेभ्यो मानुषास् तु जायन्ते पक्षिभिः खगाः
बीजेभ्यो वीरुधो लोके वैषम्यं नैव दृश्यते
वार्क्षस् त्व् अहं कथं जातो हस्तपादादिजीववान् //
text_mt:
Pippalāda said:
"From human beings humans are born; from birds come fowl; / from seeds come climbing plants in the world; no anomaly is seen. / But being born of trees, how am I a living being with hands, feet, and the rest?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vṛkṣās tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvam ūcur yathākramam
dadhīcer maraṇaṃ sādhvyās tathā cāgnipraveśanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वृक्षास् तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वम् ऊचुर् यथाक्रमम्
दधीचेर् मरणं साध्व्यास् तथा चाग्निप्रवेशनम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing his words, the trees told him everything in order: / the death of Dadhīci and the virtuous woman's entry into the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
asthnāṃ saṃharaṇaṃ devair etat sarvaṃ savistaram
śrutvā duḥkhasamāviṣṭo nipapāta tadā bhuvi //
meaning:
अस्थ्नां संहरणं देवैर् एतत् सर्वं सविस्तरम्
श्रुत्वा दुःखसमाविष्टो निपपात तदा भुवि //
text_mt: and the gathering of the bones by the gods—all this in detail. / Hearing it, overwhelmed with sorrow, he fell to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvāsitaḥ punar vṛkṣair vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ
āśvastaḥ sa punaḥ prāha tadauṣadhivanaspatīn //
meaning:
आश्वासितः पुनर् वृक्षैर् वाक्यैर् धर्मार्थसंहितैः
आश्वस्तः स पुनः प्राह तदौषधिवनस्पतीन् //
text_mt: Consoled again by the trees with words endowed with dharma and purpose, / reassured, he then spoke once more to the herbs and lords of the forest:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
pitṛhantṝn haniṣye 'haṃ nānyathā jīvituṃ kṣamaḥ
pitur mitrāṇi śatrūṃś ca tathā putro 'nuvartate //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
पितृहन्तॄन् हनिष्ये ऽहं नान्यथा जीवितुं क्षमः
पितुर् मित्राणि शत्रूंश् च तथा पुत्रो ऽनुवर्तते //
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "I shall kill the murderers of my parents; I am unable to live otherwise. / A son follows his father's friends and enemies alike.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva putro yo 'nyas tu putrarūpo ripuḥ smṛtaḥ
vadanti pitṛmitrāṇi tārayanty ahitān api //
meaning:
स एव पुत्रो यो ऽन्यस् तु पुत्ररूपो रिपुः स्मृतः
वदन्ति पितृमित्राणि तारयन्त्य् अहितान् अपि //
text_mt: He alone is a son; another who merely takes the form of a son is considered an enemy. / They say that a father's friends deliver even those who are hostile."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vṛkṣās taṃ bālam ādāya somāntikam athāyayuḥ
bālavākyaṃ tu te vṛkṣāḥ somāyātha nyavedayan
śrutvā somo 'pi taṃ bālaṃ pippalādam abhāṣata //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वृक्षास् तं बालम् आदाय सोमान्तिकम् अथाययुः
बालवाक्यं तु ते वृक्षाः सोमायाथ न्यवेदयन्
श्रुत्वा सोमो ऽपि तं बालं पिप्पलादम् अभाषत //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Taking the boy with them, the trees then approached Soma. / Those trees reported the boy's words to Soma. / Having heard them, Soma also spoke to the boy Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
soma uvāca
gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ vidhivat samagrāṃ
tapaḥsamṛddhiṃ ca śubhāṃ ca vācam
śauryaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca balaṃ ca buddhiṃ
saṃprāpsyase putra madājñayā tvam
meaning:
सोम उवाच
गृहाण विद्यां विधिवत् समग्रां
तपःसमृद्धिं च शुभां च वाचम्
शौर्यं च रूपं च बलं च बुद्धिं
संप्राप्स्यसे पुत्र मदाज्ञया त्वम्
text_mt: Soma said: / "Accept complete knowledge according to the rules, / the prosperity of austerity, and auspicious speech. / Heroism, beauty, strength, and intellect / you shall obtain by my command, my son."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
pippalādas tam apy āha oṣadhīśaṃ vinītavat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पिप्पलादस् तम् अप्य् आह ओषधीशं विनीतवत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Pippalāda also spoke humbly to that lord of plants:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
sarvam etad vṛthā manye pitṛhantṛviniṣkṛtim
na karomy atra yāvac ca tasmāt tat prathamaṃ vada //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
सर्वम् एतद् वृथा मन्ये पितृहन्तृविनिष्कृतिम्
न करोम्य् अत्र यावच् च तस्मात् तत् प्रथमं वद //
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "I consider all this useless as long as I do not / take vengeance upon the murderers of my parents here; therefore, tell me about that first:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin deśe yatra kāle yasmin deve ca mantrake
yatra tīrthe ca sidhyeta matsaṃkalpaḥ surottama //
meaning:
यस्मिन् देशे यत्र काले यस्मिन् देवे च मन्त्रके
यत्र तीर्थे च सिध्येत मत्संकल्पः सुरोत्तम //
text_mt: in what land, at what time, through which deity and which mantra, / and at which tīrtha my resolve may succeed, O best of gods?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
candraḥ prāha ciraṃ dhyātvā bhuktir vā muktir eva vā
sarvaṃ maheśvarād devāj jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
चन्द्रः प्राह चिरं ध्यात्वा भुक्तिर् वा मुक्तिर् एव वा
सर्वं महेश्वराद् देवाज् जायते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / After contemplating for a long time, the Moon said: "Whether worldly enjoyment or liberation, / everything arises from the god Maheśvara; there is no doubt about this."

sanskrit_iast:
sa somaṃ punar apy āha kathaṃ drakṣye maheśvaram
bālo 'haṃ bālabuddhiś ca na sāmarthyaṃ tapas tathā //
meaning:
स सोमं पुनर् अप्य् आह कथं द्रक्ष्ये महेश्वरम्
बालो ऽहं बालबुद्धिश् च न सामर्थ्यं तपस् तथा //
text_mt: He spoke once more to Soma: "How shall I behold Maheśvara? / I am a boy with a child's understanding; I have neither power nor austerity."

sanskrit_iast:
candra uvāca
gautamīṃ gaccha bhadra tvaṃ stuhi cakreśvaraṃ haram
prasannas tu taveśāno hy alpāyāsena vatsaka //
meaning:
चन्द्र उवाच
गौतमीं गच्छ भद्र त्वं स्तुहि चक्रेश्वरं हरम्
प्रसन्नस् तु तवेशानो ह्य् अल्पायासेन वत्सक //
text_mt: The Moon said: / "Go to the Gautamī, auspicious boy, and praise Hara, the lord of the discus. / For the Lord will be gracious to you with little effort, little one.

sanskrit_iast:
prīto bhaven mahādevaḥ sākṣāt kāruṇikaḥ śivaḥ
āste sākṣātkṛtaḥ śaṃbhur viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā //
meaning:
प्रीतो भवेन् महादेवः साक्षात् कारुणिकः शिवः
आस्ते साक्षात्कृतः शंभुर् विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना //
text_mt: Mahādeva, Śiva himself, full of compassion, will be pleased. / Śambhu abides there, made manifest by Viṣṇu the almighty.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ ca dattavān viṣṇoś cakraṃ ca tridaśārcitam
gaccha tatra mahābuddhe daṇḍake gautamīṃ nadīm //
meaning:
वरं च दत्तवान् विष्णोश् चक्रं च त्रिदशार्चितम्
गच्छ तत्र महाबुद्धे दण्डके गौतमीं नदीम् //
text_mt: And he granted a boon and the discus worshipped by the thirty [gods] to Viṣṇu. / Go there, O highly intelligent one, to the Gautamī river in the Daṇḍaka [Forest].

sanskrit_iast:
cakreśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ jānanty oṣadhayas tu tat
taṃ gatvā stuhi deveśaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṃkaram
sa te prītamanās tāta sarvān kāmān pradāsyati //
meaning:
चक्रेश्वरं नाम तीर्थं जानन्त्य् ओषधयस् तु तत्
तं गत्वा स्तुहि देवेशं सर्वभावेन शंकरम्
स ते प्रीतमनास् तात सर्वान् कामान् प्रदास्यति //
text_mt: The herbs know that tīrtha named Cakreśvara. / Go there and praise the lord of gods, Śaṅkara, with all your being; / he, pleased in his heart, my dear, will grant all your desires."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tad rājavacanād brahman pippalādo mahāmuniḥ
ājagāma jagannātho yatra rudraḥ sa cakradaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद् राजवचनाद् ब्रह्मन् पिप्पलादो महामुनिः
आजगाम जगन्नाथो यत्र रुद्रः स चक्रदः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / At the word of that king [of the stars], O brahmin, the great sage Pippalāda, / the master of the world, went to the place where that Rudra, giver of the discus, resided.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ bālaṃ kṛpayāviṣṭāḥ pippalāḥ svāśramān yayuḥ
godāvaryāṃ tataḥ snātvā natvā tribhuvaneśvaram
tuṣṭāva sarvabhāvena pippalādaḥ śivaṃ śuciḥ //
meaning:
तं बालं कृपयाविष्टाः पिप्पलाः स्वाश्रमान् ययुः
गोदावर्यां ततः स्नात्वा नत्वा त्रिभुवनेश्वरम्
तुष्टाव सर्वभावेन पिप्पलादः शिवं शुचिः //
text_mt: Filled with compassion for the boy, the pippala trees returned to their hermitages. / Then, having bathed in the Godāvarī and bowed down to the lord of the three worlds, / Pippalāda, purified, praised Śiva with all his being:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
sarvāṇi karmāṇi vihāya dhīrās
tyaktaiṣaṇā nirjitacittavātāḥ
yaṃ yānti muktyai śaraṇaṃ prayatnāt
tam ādidevaṃ praṇamāmi śaṃbhum
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
सर्वाणि कर्माणि विहाय धीरास्
त्यक्तैषणा निर्जितचित्तवाताः
यं यान्ति मुक्त्यै शरणं प्रयत्नात्
तम् आदिदेवं प्रणमामि शंभुम्
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "Abandoning all rituals, having cast off cravings, their breath and thoughts subdued, / the steadfast take refuge in him with effort for liberation— / to that primordial god, Śambhu, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvasākṣī sakalāntarātmā
sarveśvaraḥ sarvakalānidhānam
vijñāya maccittagataṃ samastaṃ
sa me smarāriḥ karuṇāṃ karotu
meaning:
यः सर्वसाक्षी सकलान्तरात्मा
सर्वेश्वरः सर्वकलानिधानम्
विज्ञाय मच्चित्तगतं समस्तं
स मे स्मरारिः करुणां करोतु
text_mt: He who is the witness of all, the inner self of all things, / the lord of all, the repository of all arts— / having perceived everything dwelling within my heart, / may that enemy of Smara show compassion to me.

sanskrit_iast:
digīśvarāñ jitya surārcitasya
kailāsam āndolayataḥ purāreḥ
aṅguṣṭhakṛtyaiva rasātalād adho
gatasya tasyaiva daśānanasya
meaning:
दिगीश्वराञ् जित्य सुरार्चितस्य
कैलासम् आन्दोलयतः पुरारेः
अङ्गुष्ठकृत्यैव रसातलाद् अधो
गतस्य तस्यैव दशाननस्य
text_mt: When the ten-necked [Rāvaṇa], having conquered the regents of the directions, / shook Kailāsa, the seat of the enemy of Pura worshipped by the gods, / by merely pressing down your toe, he went / down beneath the underworld.

sanskrit_iast:
ālūnakāyasya giraṃ niśamya
vihasya devyā saha dattam iṣṭam
tasmai prasannaḥ kupito 'pi tadvad
ayuktadātāsi maheśvara tvam
meaning:
आलूनकायस्य गिरं निशम्य
विहस्य देव्या सह दत्तम् इष्टम्
तस्मै प्रसन्नः कुपितो ऽपि तद्वद्
अयुक्तदातासि महेश्वर त्वम्
text_mt: Hearing the cry of him whose body was mutilated, / you smiled with the Goddess and granted him his desire; / pleased with him, though previously angered in that manner, / you are the giver of the unearned, O Maheśvara!

sanskrit_iast:
sautrāmaṇīm ṛddhim adhaḥ sa cakre
yo 'rcāṃ harau nityam atīva kṛtvā
bāṇaḥ praśasyaḥ kṛtavān uccapūjāṃ
ramyāṃ manojñāṃ śaśikhaṇḍamauleḥ
meaning:
सौत्रामणीम् ऋद्धिम् अधः स चक्रे
यो ऽर्चां हरौ नित्यम् अतीव कृत्वा
बाणः प्रशस्यः कृतवान् उच्चपूजां
रम्यां मनोज्ञां शशिखण्डमौलेः
text_mt: Praised is Bāṇa, who placed below him the prosperity of Sautrāmaṇī, / who, constantly making immense worship of Hara, / performed exalted, beautiful, and pleasing worship / of the one whose crest is a crescent moon.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā ripūn devagaṇān prapūjya
guruṃ namaskartum agād viśākhaḥ
cukopa dṛṣṭvā gaṇanātham ūḍham
aṅke tam āropya jahāsa somaḥ
meaning:
जित्वा रिपून् देवगणान् प्रपूज्य
गुरुं नमस्कर्तुम् अगाद् विशाखः
चुकोप दृष्ट्वा गणनाथम् ऊढम्
अङ्के तम् आरोप्य जहास सोमः
text_mt: Having conquered his enemies and worshipped the hosts of gods, / Viśākha went to bow down to his father. / Seeing the lord of gaṇas already seated [there], he grew angry; / lifting him onto his lap, Soma laughed.

sanskrit_iast:
īśāṅkarūḍho 'pi śiśusvabhāvān
na mātur aṅkaṃ pramumoca bālaḥ
kruddhaṃ sutaṃ bodhitum apy aśaktas
tato 'rdhanāritvam avāpa somaḥ
meaning:
ईशाङ्करूढो ऽपि शिशुस्वभावान्
न मातुर् अङ्कं प्रमुमोच बालः
क्रुद्धं सुतं बोधितुम् अप्य् अशक्तस्
ततो ऽर्धनारित्वम् अवाप सोमः
text_mt: Even while seated on the Lord's lap, by a child's nature, / the boy did not leave his mother's lap. / Unable to appease his angry son, / Soma then assumed the form of half-woman."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ svayaṃbhūḥ suprītaḥ pippalādam abhāṣata //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः स्वयंभूः सुप्रीतः पिप्पलादम् अभाषत //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then Svayambhū, deeply pleased, spoke to Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te pippalāda yathepsitam //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
वरं वरय भद्रं ते पिप्पलाद यथेप्सितम् //
text_mt: Śiva said: / "Choose a boon as you desire, Pippalāda; may it be well with you!"

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
hato devair mahādeva pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ
adāmbhikaḥ satyavādī tathā mātā pativratā //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
हतो देवैर् महादेव पिता मम महायशाः
अदाम्भिकः सत्यवादी तथा माता पतिव्रता //
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "O Mahādeva, my renowned father, / unpretentious and truthful, was slain by the gods, and so was my faithful mother.

sanskrit_iast:
devebhyaś ca tayor nāśaṃ śrutvā nātha savistaram
duḥkhakopasamāviṣṭo nāhaṃ jīvitum utsahe //
meaning:
देवेभ्यश् च तयोर् नाशं श्रुत्वा नाथ सविस्तरम्
दुःखकोपसमाविष्टो नाहं जीवितुम् उत्सहे //
text_mt: Hearing in detail of their destruction caused by the gods, O Lord, / I am filled with grief and anger, and I have no desire to live.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmān me dehi sāmarthyaṃ nāśayeyaṃ surān yathā
avadhyasevyas trailokye tvam eva śaśiśekhara //
meaning:
तस्मान् मे देहि सामर्थ्यं नाशयेयं सुरान् यथा
अवध्यसेव्यस् त्रैलोक्ये त्वम् एव शशिशेखर //
text_mt: Therefore, grant me the power so that I may destroy the gods; / you alone, crowned with the crescent moon, are to be served by those who are unslayable in the three worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
tṛtīyaṃ nayanaṃ draṣṭuṃ yadi śaknoṣi me 'nagha
tataḥ samartho bhavitā devāṃś chedayituṃ bhavān //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
तृतीयं नयनं द्रष्टुं यदि शक्नोषि मे ऽनघ
ततः समर्थो भविता देवांश् छेदयितुं भवान् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / "If you are able to behold my third eye, O sinless one, / then you will become capable of destroying the gods."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tato draṣṭuṃ manaś cakre tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ vibhoḥ
na śaśāka tadovāca na śakto 'smīti śaṃkaram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो द्रष्टुं मनश् चक्रे तृतीयं लोचनं विभोः
न शशाक तदोवाच न शक्तो ऽस्मीति शंकरम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then he resolved to behold the third eye of the omnipresent Lord; / he was not able, and then he said to Śaṅkara: 'I am not able.'

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
kiṃcit kuru tapo bāla yadā drakṣyasi locanam
tṛtīyaṃ tvaṃ tadābhīṣṭaṃ prāpsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
किंचित् कुरु तपो बाल यदा द्रक्ष्यसि लोचनम्
तृतीयं त्वं तदाभीष्टं प्राप्स्यसे नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: The Lord said: / "Perform a little austerity, child. When you behold / the third eye, then you will obtain your desire; of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etac chrutveśānavākyaṃ tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ
dadhīcisūnur dharmātmā tatraiva bahulāḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतच् छ्रुत्वेशानवाक्यं तपसे कृतनिश्चयः
दधीचिसूनुर् धर्मात्मा तत्रैव बहुलाः समाः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard these words of the Lord, resolved upon austerity, / the righteous son of Dadhīci spent many years right there.

sanskrit_iast:
śivadhyānaikanirato bālo 'pi balavān iva
pratyahaṃ prātar utthāya snātvā natvā gurūn kramāt //
meaning:
शिवध्यानैकनिरतो बालो ऽपि बलवान् इव
प्रत्यहं प्रातर् उत्थाय स्नात्वा नत्वा गुरून् क्रमात् //
text_mt: Wholly devoted to meditation on Śiva, though a boy, as if strong, / rising daily at dawn, bathing, and bowing to his teachers in order,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhāsīno manaḥ kṛtvā suṣumnāyām ananyadhīḥ
hastasvastikam āropya nābhau vismṛtasaṃsṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सुखासीनो मनः कृत्वा सुषुम्नायाम् अनन्यधीः
हस्तस्वस्तिकम् आरोप्य नाभौ विस्मृतसंसृतिः //
text_mt: comfortably seated, focusing his mind on the suṣumṇā with single-pointed thought, / placing his crossed hands at the navel, forgetting transmigration,

sanskrit_iast:
sthānāt sthānāntarotkarṣān vidadhyau śāṃbhavaṃ mahaḥ
dadarśa cakṣur devasya tṛtīyaṃ pippalāśanaḥ
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vinīta idam abravīt //
meaning:
स्थानात् स्थानान्तरोत्कर्षान् विदध्यौ शांभवं महः
ददर्श चक्षुर् देवस्य तृतीयं पिप्पलाशनः
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा विनीत इदम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: he meditated on the splendor of Śambhu through the elevation from stage to stage; / and that eater of pippala berries saw the third eye of the god. / Folding his hands in reverence, he spoke humbly as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
śaṃbhunā devadevena varo dattaḥ purā mama
tārtīyacakṣuṣo jyotir yadā paśyasi tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
शंभुना देवदेवेन वरो दत्तः पुरा मम
तार्तीयचक्षुषो ज्योतिर् यदा पश्यसि तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "A boon was granted to me formerly by Śambhu, the god of gods: / 'From the moment you behold the splendor of the third eye,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ te prārthitaṃ sidhyed ity āha tridaśeśvaraḥ
tasmād ripuvināśāya hetubhūtāṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
सर्वं ते प्रार्थितं सिध्येद् इत्य् आह त्रिदशेश्वरः
तस्माद् रिपुविनाशाय हेतुभूतां प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: all that you request shall be accomplished'—so said the lord of the thirty [gods]. / Therefore, grant me that which will serve as the cause for the destruction of my enemies."

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva pippalāḥ procur vaḍavāpi mahādyute
mātā tava prātitheyī vadanty evaṃ divaṃ gatā //
meaning:
तदैव पिप्पलाः प्रोचुर् वडवापि महाद्युते
माता तव प्रातिथेयी वदन्त्य् एवं दिवं गता //
text_mt: Just then the pippala trees said: "Even as a mare, O you of great splendor, / your mother, Prātitheyī, saying thus, went to heaven:

sanskrit_iast:
parābhidrohaniratā vismṛtātmahitā narāḥ
itas tato bhrāntacittāḥ patanti narakāvaṭe //
meaning:
पराभिद्रोहनिरता विस्मृतात्महिता नराः
इतस् ततो भ्रान्तचित्ताः पतन्ति नरकावटे //
text_mt: 'Men devoted to injuring others, having forgotten their own welfare, / their minds wandering here and there, fall into the pit of hell.'"

sanskrit_iast:
tan mātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā kupitaḥ pippalāśanaḥ
abhimāne jvalaty antaḥ sādhuvādo nirarthakaḥ //
meaning:
तन् मातृवचनं श्रुत्वा कुपितः पिप्पलाशनः
अभिमाने ज्वलत्य् अन्तः साधुवादो निरर्थकः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of his mother, the eater of pippala berries was enraged; / when pride burns within, good counsel is of no avail.

sanskrit_iast:
dehi dehīti taṃ prāha kṛtyā netravinirgatā
vaḍaveti smaran vipraḥ kṛtyāpi vaḍavākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
देहि देहीति तं प्राह कृत्या नेत्रविनिर्गता
वडवेति स्मरन् विप्रः कृत्यापि वडवाकृतिः //
text_mt: "Give! Give!" said to him the kṛtyā that had come forth from his eye. / Thinking of a mare, the vipra [meditated], and the kṛtyā too took the form of a mare.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasattvavināśāya prabhūtānalagarbhiṇī
gabhastinī bālagarbhā yā mātā pippalāśinaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वसत्त्वविनाशाय प्रभूतानलगर्भिणी
गभस्तिनी बालगर्भा या माता पिप्पलाशिनः //
text_mt: Carrying vast fire within her womb for the destruction of all creatures, / radiant, pregnant with a child, she who was the mother of the consumer of pippala berries (Pippalāda)—

sanskrit_iast:
taddhyānayogāt tu jātā kṛtyā sānalagarbhiṇī
utpannā sā mahāraudrā mṛtyujihveva bhīṣaṇā //
meaning:
तद्ध्यानयोगात् तु जाता कृत्या सानलगर्भिणी
उत्पन्ना सा महारौद्रा मृत्युजिह्वेव भीषणा //
text_mt: from the yoga of his meditation upon her was born that kṛtyā bearing fire in her womb; / exceedingly fierce she arose, terrifying like the tongue of Death.

sanskrit_iast:
avocat pippalādaṃ taṃ kiṃ kṛtyaṃ me vadasva tat
pippalādo 'pi tāṃ prāha devān khāda ripūn mama //
meaning:
अवोचत् पिप्पलादं तं किं कृत्यं मे वदस्व तत्
पिप्पलादो ऽपि तां प्राह देवान् खाद रिपून् मम //
text_mt: She said to that Pippalāda: "Tell me, what is my task?" / And Pippalāda said to her: "Devour the gods, my enemies!"

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha sā tathety uktvā pippalādaṃ purasthitam
sa prāha kim idaṃ kṛtye sā cāpy āha tvayoditam //
meaning:
जग्राह सा तथेत्य् उक्त्वा पिप्पलादं पुरस्थितम्
स प्राह किम् इदं कृत्ये सा चाप्य् आह त्वयोदितम् //
text_mt: Saying "So be it," she seized Pippalāda as he stood before her. / He said: "What is this, kṛtyā?" and she replied: "It was spoken by you—

sanskrit_iast:
devaiś ca nirmitaṃ dehaṃ tato bhītaḥ śivaṃ yayau
tuṣṭāva devaṃ sa muniḥ kṛtyāṃ prāha tadā śivaḥ //
meaning:
देवैश् च निर्मितं देहं ततो भीतः शिवं ययौ
तुष्टाव देवं स मुनिः कृत्यां प्राह तदा शिवः //
text_mt: and the body was fashioned by the gods." Thereupon, terrified, he went to Śiva. / The sage praised the god; then Śiva spoke to the kṛtyā:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
yojanāntaḥsthitāñ jīvān na gṛhāṇa madājñayā
tasmād yāhi tato dūraṃ kṛtye kṛtyaṃ tataḥ kuru //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
योजनान्तःस्थिताञ् जीवान् न गृहाण मदाज्ञया
तस्माद् याहि ततो दूरं कृत्ये कृत्यं ततः कुरु //
text_mt: Śiva said: / "By my command, do not seize living beings situated within a yojana. / Therefore go far from here, kṛtyā, and then do your deed."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tīrthāt tu pippalāt pūrvaṃ yāvad yojanasaṃkhyayā
prātiṣṭhad vaḍavārūpā kṛtyā sā ṛṣinirmitā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तीर्थात् तु पिप्पलात् पूर्वं यावद् योजनसंख्यया
प्रातिष्ठद् वडवारूपा कृत्या सा ऋषिनिर्मिता //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / But to the east of the Pippala tīrtha, as far as the measure of a yojana, / stood that kṛtyā produced by the ṛṣi, in the form of a mare.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jāto mahān agnir lokasaṃharaṇakṣamaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve trastāḥ śaṃbhum upāgaman //
meaning:
तस्यां जातो महान् अग्निर् लोकसंहरणक्षमः
तं दृष्ट्वा विबुधाः सर्वे त्रस्ताः शंभुम् उपागमन् //
text_mt: From her arose a great fire capable of destroying the worlds. / Seeing it, all the gods were terrified and approached Śaṃbhu.

sanskrit_iast:
cakreśvaraṃ pippaleśaṃ pippalādena toṣitam
stuvanto bhītamanasaḥ śaṃbhum ūcur divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
चक्रेश्वरं पिप्पलेशं पिप्पलादेन तोषितम्
स्तुवन्तो भीतमनसः शंभुम् ऊचुर् दिवौकसः //
text_mt: Praising Cakreśvara, Pippaleśa, who had been propitiated by Pippalāda, / the heaven-dwellers, their minds filled with fear, spoke to Śaṃbhu:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
rakṣasva śaṃbho kṛtyāsmān bādhate tadbhavānalaḥ
śaraṇaṃ bhava sarveśa bhītānām abhayaprada //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
रक्षस्व शंभो कृत्यास्मान् बाधते तद्भवानलः
शरणं भव सर्वेश भीतानाम् अभयप्रद //
text_mt: The gods said: / "Protect [us], O Śaṃbhu! The kṛtyā afflicts us; the fire arising from her [threatens us]. / Become a refuge, O lord of all, granter of fearlessness to the frightened!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvataḥ paribhūtānām ārtānāṃ śrāntacetasām
sarveṣām eva jantūnāṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śiva //
meaning:
सर्वतः परिभूतानाम् आर्तानां श्रान्तचेतसाम्
सर्वेषाम् एव जन्तूनां त्वम् एव शरणं शिव //
text_mt: For those humiliated from every side, distressed, their minds exhausted— / for all creatures whatsoever, you alone are the refuge, O Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṇābhyarthitā kṛtyā tvaccakṣurvahninirgatā
sā jighāṃsati lokāṃs trīṃs tvaṃ nas trātā na cetaraḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिणाभ्यर्थिता कृत्या त्वच्चक्षुर्वह्निनिर्गता
सा जिघांसति लोकांस् त्रींस् त्वं नस् त्राता न चेतरः //
text_mt: Entreated by the ṛṣi, the kṛtyā has come forth from the fire of your eye; / she desires to destroy the three worlds. You are our protector, and no other!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tān abravīj jagannātho yojanāntarnivāsinaḥ
na bādhate tv asau kṛtyā tasmād yūyam aharniśam
ihaivāsadhvam amarās tasyā vo na bhayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तान् अब्रवीज् जगन्नाथो योजनान्तर्निवासिनः
न बाधते त्व् असौ कृत्या तस्माद् यूयम् अहर्निशम्
इहैवासध्वम् अमरास् तस्या वो न भयं भवेत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / The lord of the universe spoke to them: "Those who dwell within a yojana / this kṛtyā does not torment. Therefore, O immortals, / dwell day and night right here; you will have no fear of her."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
punar ūcuḥ sureśānaṃ tvayā dattaṃ triviṣṭapam
tat tyaktvātra kathaṃ nātha vatsyāmas tridaśārcita //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पुनर् ऊचुः सुरेशानं त्वया दत्तं त्रिविष्टपम्
तत् त्यक्त्वात्र कथं नाथ वत्स्यामस् त्रिदशार्चित //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / They spoke again to the lord of the gods: "The triple heaven was granted by you. / Abandoning that, how shall we dwell here, O lord worshipped by the thirty [gods]?"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā śivo vākyam athābravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा शिवो वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard the words of the gods, Śiva then spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
devo 'sau viśvataścakṣur yo devo viśvatomukhaḥ
yo raśmibhis tu dhamate nityaṃ yo janako mataḥ //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
देवो ऽसौ विश्वतश्चक्षुर् यो देवो विश्वतोमुखः
यो रश्मिभिस् तु धमते नित्यं यो जनको मतः //
text_mt: Śiva said: / "That god whose eye is everywhere, that god whose face is on all sides, / who radiates heat with his rays, who is considered the eternal progenitor—

sanskrit_iast:
sa sūrya eka evātra sākṣād rūpeṇa sarvadā
sthitiṃ karotu tanmūrtau bhaviṣyanty akhilāḥ sthitāḥ //
meaning:
स सूर्य एक एवात्र साक्षाद् रूपेण सर्वदा
स्थितिं करोतु तन्मूर्तौ भविष्यन्त्य् अखिलाः स्थिताः //
text_mt: let that Sūrya alone constantly make his abode here in visible form; / in his form, all will abide firmly established."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tatheti śaṃbhuvacanāt pārijātataros tadā
devā divākaraṃ cakrus tvaṣṭā bhāskaram abravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथेति शंभुवचनात् पारिजाततरोस् तदा
देवा दिवाकरं चक्रुस् त्वष्टा भास्करम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Saying "So be it" at Śaṃbhu's word, out of a pārijāta tree / the gods then fashioned the Sun. Tvaṣṭṛ spoke to the Sun:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭovāca
ihaivāssva jagatsvāmin rakṣemān vibudhān svayam
svāṃśaiś ca vayam apy atra tiṣṭhāmaḥ śaṃbhusaṃnidhau //
meaning:
त्वष्टोवाच
इहैवास्स्व जगत्स्वामिन् रक्षेमान् विबुधान् स्वयम्
स्वांशैश् च वयम् अप्य् अत्र तिष्ठामः शंभुसंनिधौ //
text_mt: Tvaṣṭṛ said: / "Dwell right here, O master of the universe, and protect these gods yourself; / and we too, through our portions, will dwell here in the presence of Śaṃbhu."

sanskrit_iast:
cakreśvarasya parito yāvad yojanasaṃkhyayā
gaṅgāyā ubhayaṃ tīram āsādyāsan surottamāḥ //
meaning:
चक्रेश्वरस्य परितो यावद् योजनसंख्यया
गङ्गाया उभयं तीरम् आसाद्यासन् सुरोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Around Cakreśvara, as far as the measure of a yojana, / reaching both banks of the Gaṅgā, the foremost of the gods settled.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulyardhārdhamātraṃ tu gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritāḥ
tisraḥ koṭyas tathā pañca śatāni munisattama
tīrthānāṃ tatra vyuṣṭiṃ ca kaḥ śṛṇoti bravīti vā //
meaning:
अङ्गुल्यर्धार्धमात्रं तु गङ्गातीरं समाश्रिताः
तिस्रः कोट्यस् तथा पञ्च शतानि मुनिसत्तम
तीर्थानां तत्र व्युष्टिं च कः शृणोति ब्रवीति वा //
text_mt: Resorting to the bank of the Gaṅgā by merely a quarter of a finger's width, / [there were] thirty million and five hundred [tīrthas], O best of sages; / and who can hear or tell the efficacy of the tīrthas there?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve vinītāḥ śivam abruvan //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे विनीताः शिवम् अब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then all the hosts of gods, humble, spoke to Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
pippalādaṃ sureśāna śamaṃ naya jaganmaya //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
पिप्पलादं सुरेशान शमं नय जगन्मय //
text_mt: The gods said: / "O lord of the gods, O you who consist of the universe, bring Pippalāda to peace!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
om ity uktvā jagannāthaḥ pippalādam avocata //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा जगन्नाथः पिप्पलादम् अवोचत //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Saying "Om," the lord of the universe spoke to Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
nāśiteṣv api deveṣu pitā te nāgamiṣyati
dattāḥ pitrā tava prāṇā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
नाशितेष्व् अपि देवेषु पिता ते नागमिष्यति
दत्ताः पित्रा तव प्राणा देवानां कार्यसिद्धये //
text_mt: Śiva said: / "Even if the gods are destroyed, your father will not return. / Your father gave his life for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
dīnārtakaruṇābandhuḥ ko hi tādṛgbhave bhavet
tathā yātā divaṃ tāta tava mātā pativratā //
meaning:
दीनार्तकरुणाबन्धुः को हि तादृग्भवे भवेत्
तथा याता दिवं तात तव माता पतिव्रता //
text_mt: Who indeed in this world could be such a friend in compassion to the wretched and afflicted? / Likewise, dear boy, your chaste mother has gone to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
samā kāpy atra matayā lopāmudrāpy arundhatī
yad asthibhiḥ surāḥ sarve jayinaḥ sukhinaḥ sadā //
meaning:
समा काप्य् अत्र मतया लोपामुद्राप्य् अरुन्धती
यद् अस्थिभिः सुराः सर्वे जयिनः सुखिनः सदा //
text_mt: In intelligence she is equal to anyone here, even to Lopāmudrā or Arundhatī. / Since by his bones all the gods are always victorious and happy,

sanskrit_iast:
tenāvāptaṃ yaśaḥ sphītaṃ tava mātrākṣayaṃ kṛtam
tvayā putreṇa sarvatra nātaḥ parataraṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
तेनावाप्तं यशः स्फीतं तव मात्राक्षयं कृतम्
त्वया पुत्रेण सर्वत्र नातः परतरं कृतम् //
text_mt: abundant fame was attained by him, and it was made imperishable by your mother. / By you, his son, nothing greater than this has been done anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpratāpabhayāt svargāc cyutāṃs tvaṃ pātum arhasi
kāṃdiśīkāṃs tava bhayād amarāṃs trātum arhasi
nārtatrāṇād abhyadhikaṃ sukṛtaṃ kvāpi vidyate //
meaning:
त्वत्प्रतापभयात् स्वर्गाच् च्युतांस् त्वं पातुम् अर्हसि
कांदिशीकांस् तव भयाद् अमरांस् त्रातुम् अर्हसि
नार्तत्राणाद् अभ्यधिकं सुकृतं क्वापि विद्यते //
text_mt: You ought to protect those fallen from heaven out of fear of your power; / you ought to protect the immortals fleeing in all directions from fear of you. / Nowhere is there any merit superior to the protection of the distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvad yaśaḥ sphurati cāru manuṣyaloke
ahāni tāvanti divaṃ gatasya
dine dine varṣasaṃkhyā parasmiṃl
loke vāso jāyate nirvikāraḥ
meaning:
यावद् यशः स्फुरति चारु मनुष्यलोके
अहानि तावन्ति दिवं गतस्य
दिने दिने वर्षसंख्या परस्मिंल्
लोके वासो जायते निर्विकारः
text_mt: As long as lovely renown shines in the mortal world, / for that many days does one who has gone to heaven / find day after day a changeless dwelling in the higher world, / counted in years.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtās ta evātra yaśo na yeṣām
andhās ta eva śrutavarjitā ye
ye dānaśīlā na napuṃsakās te
ye dharmaśīlā na ta eva śocyāḥ
meaning:
मृतास् त एवात्र यशो न येषाम्
अन्धास् त एव श्रुतवर्जिता ये
ये दानशीला न नपुंसकास् ते
ये धर्मशीला न त एव शोच्याः
text_mt: Only they who have no renown are truly dead here; / only they who are bereft of learning are truly blind; / only they who are not generous are truly eunuchs; / only they who are devoted to dharma are not to be pitied."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
bhāṣitaṃ devadevasya śrutvā śānto 'bhavan muniḥ
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā natvā nātham athābravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
भाषितं देवदेवस्य श्रुत्वा शान्तो ऽभवन् मुनिः
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा नत्वा नाथम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing the speech of the god of gods, the sage became peaceful. / Folding his hands in supplication and bowing to the lord, he then spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
vāgbhir manobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin
mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye
tebhyo hitārthaṃ tv iha cāpareṣāṃ
somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
वाग्भिर् मनोभिः कृतिभिः कदाचिन्
ममोपकुर्वन्ति हिते रता ये
तेभ्यो हितार्थं त्व् इह चापरेषां
सोमं नमस्यामि सुरादिपूज्यम्
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "To those who, devoted to my welfare, ever assist me / with words, thoughts, and deeds, / and for the sake of their welfare and that of others here, / I bow to Soma, who is worshipped by gods and others.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrakṣito yair abhivardhitaś ca
samānagotraś ca samānadharmā
teṣām abhīṣṭāni śivaḥ karotu
bālendumauliṃ praṇato 'smi nityam
meaning:
संरक्षितो यैर् अभिवर्धितश् च
समानगोत्रश् च समानधर्मा
तेषाम् अभीष्टानि शिवः करोतु
बालेन्दुमौलिं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यम्
text_mt: May Śiva grant the desires of those by whom I was protected / and brought up, of the same lineage and of the same dharma; / I bow down constantly to the one who wears the crescent moon on his diadem.

sanskrit_iast:
yair ahaṃ vardhito nityaṃ mātṛvat pitṛvat prabho
tannāmnā jāyatāṃ tīrthaṃ devadeva jagattraye //
meaning:
यैर् अहं वर्धितो नित्यं मातृवत् पितृवत् प्रभो
तन्नाम्ना जायतां तीर्थं देवदेव जगत्त्रये //
text_mt: By whom I was constantly raised like a mother and like a father, O lord, / let a tīrtha be formed in their name in the three worlds, O god of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
yaśas tu teṣāṃ bhavitā tebhyo 'ham anṛṇas tataḥ
yāni kṣetrāṇi devānāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūtale //
meaning:
यशस् तु तेषां भविता तेभ्यो ऽहम् अनृणस् ततः
यानि क्षेत्राणि देवानां यानि तीर्थानि भूतले //
text_mt: Then there will be fame for them, and from that I will be free of debt to them. / Whatever sacred sites of the gods and whatever tīrthas there are upon the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo yad idam adhikam anumanyantu devatāḥ
tataḥ kṣame 'haṃ devānām aparādhaṃ nirañjanaḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो यद् इदम् अधिकम् अनुमन्यन्तु देवताः
ततः क्षमे ऽहं देवानाम् अपराधं निरञ्जनः //
text_mt: let the deities agree that this [place] is superior to them. / Then, spotless, I will forgive the offense of the gods."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tataḥ samakṣaṃ surasākṣarāṃ giraṃ
sahasracakṣuḥpramukhāṃs tathāgrataḥ
uvāca devā api menire vaco
dadhīciputroditam ādareṇa
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः समक्षं सुरसाक्षरां गिरं
सहस्रचक्षुःप्रमुखांस् तथाग्रतः
उवाच देवा अपि मेनिरे वचो
दधीचिपुत्रोदितम् आदरेण
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Then before him he uttered this charming speech in plain words / before the thousand-eyed one [Indra] and the other [gods]; / and the gods also accepted with respect the words / spoken by the son of Dadhīci.

sanskrit_iast:
bālasya buddhiṃ vinayaṃ ca vidyāṃ
śauryaṃ balaṃ sāhasaṃ satyavācam
pitror bhaktiṃ bhāvaśuddhiṃ viditvā
tadāvādīc chaṃkaraḥ pippalādam
meaning:
बालस्य बुद्धिं विनयं च विद्यां
शौर्यं बलं साहसं सत्यवाचम्
पित्रोर् भक्तिं भावशुद्धिं विदित्वा
तदावादीच् छंकरः पिप्पलादम्
text_mt: Recognizing the boy's intellect, modesty, learning, / valour, strength, daring, truthfulness of speech, / devotion to his parents, and purity of heart, / Śaṅkara then said to Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca
vatsa yad vai priyaṃ kāmaṃ yac cāpi suravallabham
prāpsyase vada kalyāṇaṃ nānyathā tvaṃ manaḥ kṛthāḥ //
meaning:
शंकर उवाच
वत्स यद् वै प्रियं कामं यच् चापि सुरवल्लभम्
प्राप्स्यसे वद कल्याणं नान्यथा त्वं मनः कृथाः //
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / "Dear child, whatever is pleasing and desired, and whatever is dear to the gods, / you shall obtain; state your blessing; do not think otherwise!"

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
ye gaṅgāyām āplutā dharmaniṣṭhāḥ
saṃpaśyanti tvatpadābjaṃ maheśa
sarvān kāmān āpnuvantu prasahya
dehānte te padam āyāntu śaivam
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
ये गङ्गायाम् आप्लुता धर्मनिष्ठाः
संपश्यन्ति त्वत्पदाब्जं महेश
सर्वान् कामान् आप्नुवन्तु प्रसह्य
देहान्ते ते पदम् आयान्तु शैवम्
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / "Those who, bathed in the Gaṅgā and steadfast in dharma, / behold your lotus feet, O Maheśa, / may they forcefully attain all their desires, / and at the end of their bodies may they go to the abode of Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
tātaḥ prāptas tvatpadaṃ cāmbikā me
nātha prāptā pippalaś cāmarāś ca
sukhaṃ prāptā nāthanāthaṃ vilokya
tvāṃ paśyeyus tvatpadaṃ te prayāntu
meaning:
तातः प्राप्तस् त्वत्पदं चाम्बिका मे
नाथ प्राप्ता पिप्पलश् चामराश् च
सुखं प्राप्ता नाथनाथं विलोक्य
त्वां पश्येयुस् त्वत्पदं ते प्रयान्तु
text_mt: My father has reached your abode, and my mother, / O lord, has reached it, and the pippala tree and the immortals / have attained happiness having seen the lord of lords; / may they behold you, and may they go to your abode!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tathety uktvā pippalādaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ
abhinandya ca taṃ devaiḥ sārdhaṃ vākyam athābravīt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा पिप्पलादं देवदेवो महेश्वरः
अभिनन्द्य च तं देवैः सार्धं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having said, “So be it,” to Pippalāda, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / after congratulating him, spoke these words together with the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
devā api mudā yuktā nirbhayās tatkṛtād bhayāt
idam ūcuḥ sarva eva dādhīcaṃ śivasaṃnidhau //
meaning:
देवा अपि मुदा युक्ता निर्भयास् तत्कृताद् भयात्
इदम् ऊचुः सर्व एव दाधीचं शिवसंनिधौ //
text_mt: The gods too, filled with joy and freed from fear of the peril he had caused, / all said this to the son of Dadhīci in the presence of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
surāṇāṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ ca tvayā kṛtam asaṃśayam
pālitā devadevasya ājñā trailokyamaṇḍanī //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
सुराणां यद् अभीष्टं च त्वया कृतम् असंशयम्
पालिता देवदेवस्य आज्ञा त्रैलोक्यमण्डनी //
text_mt: The gods said: / What was desired by the gods has undoubtedly been done by you; / the command of the god of gods, which adorns the three worlds, has been obeyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yācitaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ parārthaṃ nātmane dvija
tasmād anyatamaṃ brūhi kiṃcid dāsyāmahe vayam //
meaning:
याचितं च त्वया पूर्वं परार्थं नात्मने द्विज
तस्माद् अन्यतमं ब्रूहि किंचिद् दास्यामहे वयम् //
text_mt: And what you asked for earlier, O twice-born, was for the sake of others, not for yourself. / Therefore, ask for something else, and we will grant it.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
punaḥ punas tad evocuḥ surasaṃghā dvijottamam
kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ pūrvaṃ natvā śaṃbhusurān idam
uvāca pippalādaś ca umāṃ natvā ca pippalān //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पुनः पुनस् तद् एवोचुः सुरसंघा द्विजोत्तमम्
कृताञ्जलिपुटः पूर्वं नत्वा शंभुसुरान् इदम्
उवाच पिप्पलादश् च उमां नत्वा च पिप्पलान् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Again and again the hosts of gods said just that to the best of the twice-born. / With folded hands, having first bowed to Śaṃbhu and the gods, / Pippalāda, having bowed to Umā and to the pippala trees, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
pippalāda uvāca
pitarau draṣṭukāmo 'smi sadā me śabdagocarau
te dhanyāḥ prāṇino loke mātāpitror vaśe sthitāḥ //
meaning:
पिप्पलाद उवाच
पितरौ द्रष्टुकामो ऽस्मि सदा मे शब्दगोचरौ
ते धन्याः प्राणिनो लोके मातापित्रोर् वशे स्थिताः //
text_mt: Pippalāda said: / I desire to see my parents, who are always within the realm of words for me. / Blessed are those living beings in the world who abide under the control of their mother and father,

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ tatpādājñāpratīkṣakāḥ
indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca kulaṃ śaktiṃ dhiyaṃ vapuḥ //
meaning:
शुश्रूषणपरा नित्यं तत्पादाज्ञाप्रतीक्षकाः
इन्द्रियाणि शरीरं च कुलं शक्तिं धियं वपुः //
text_mt: constantly devoted to serving them, awaiting the command of their feet! / Having obtained sense-faculties, a body, family, strength, intellect, and physical form,

sanskrit_iast:
parilabhya tayoḥ kṛtye kṛtakṛtyo bhavet svayam
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi sulabhaṃ mātṛdarśanam //
meaning:
परिलभ्य तयोः कृत्ये कृतकृत्यो भवेत् स्वयम्
पशूनां पक्षिणां चापि सुलभं मातृदर्शनम् //
text_mt: one would become truly fulfilled by acting on their behalf. / The sight of a mother is easily available even to beasts and birds;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ mama tac cāpi pṛcche pāpaphalaṃ nu kim
durlabhaṃ ca tathā cet syāt sarveṣāṃ yasya kasyacit //
meaning:
दुर्लभं मम तच् चापि पृच्छे पापफलं नु किम्
दुर्लभं च तथा चेत् स्यात् सर्वेषां यस्य कस्यचित् //
text_mt: yet it is difficult for me to obtain. I ask: is this the fruit of my sin? / If it were so difficult to obtain, for anyone whomsoever,

sanskrit_iast:
nopapadyeta sulabhaṃ matto nānyo 'sti pāpakṛt
tayor darśanamātraṃ ca yadi prāpsye surottamāḥ //
meaning:
नोपपद्येत सुलभं मत्तो नान्यो ऽस्ति पापकृत्
तयोर् दर्शनमात्रं च यदि प्राप्स्ये सुरोत्तमाः //
text_mt: it would not be so easily available; there is no wrongdoer other than me! / O best of gods, if only I might attain the sight of them both,

sanskrit_iast:
manovākkāyakarmabhyaḥ phalaṃ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati
pitarau ye na paśyanti samutpannā na saṃsṛtau
teṣāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ kaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartum īśvaraḥ //
meaning:
मनोवाक्कायकर्मभ्यः फलं प्राप्तं भविष्यति
पितरौ ये न पश्यन्ति समुत्पन्ना न संसृतौ
तेषां महापातकानां कः संख्यां कर्तुम् ईश्वरः //
text_mt: the fruit of actions of mind, speech, and body will have been achieved. / Who is capable of counting the great sins / of those who, having been born into worldly existence, do not see their parents?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tad ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā mithaḥ saṃmantrya te surāḥ
vimānavaram ārūḍhau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तद् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा मिथः संमन्त्र्य ते सुराः
विमानवरम् आरूढौ पितरौ दंपती शुभौ //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having heard those words of the sage, those gods consulted among themselves, [and said:] / “Mounted upon an excellent celestial chariot, your parents, an auspicious couple,

sanskrit_iast:
tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau drakṣyase vādya niścitam
viṣādaṃ lobhamohau ca tyaktvā cittaṃ śamaṃ naya //
meaning:
तव संदर्शनाकाङ्क्षौ द्रक्ष्यसे वाद्य निश्चितम्
विषादं लोभमोहौ च त्यक्त्वा चित्तं शमं नय //
text_mt: longing to see you, you will certainly see today. / Abandoning dejection, greed, and delusion, lead your mind to peace.

sanskrit_iast:
paśya paśyeti taṃ prāhur dādhīcaṃ surasattamāḥ
vimānavaram ārūḍhau svargiṇau svarṇabhūṣaṇau //
meaning:
पश्य पश्येति तं प्राहुर् दाधीचं सुरसत्तमाः
विमानवरम् आरूढौ स्वर्गिणौ स्वर्णभूषणौ //
text_mt: Behold! Behold!” the best of gods said to that son of Dadhīci. / Mounted upon an excellent celestial chariot, dwellers of heaven adorned with gold,

sanskrit_iast:
tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau
vījyamānau surastrībhiḥ stūyamānau ca kiṃnaraiḥ //
meaning:
तव संदर्शनाकाङ्क्षौ पितरौ दंपती शुभौ
वीज्यमानौ सुरस्त्रीभिः स्तूयमानौ च किंनरैः //
text_mt: longing to see you, an auspicious couple, your parents, / being fanned by celestial women and praised by kiṃnaras!

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sa mātāpitarau nanāma śivasaṃnidhau
harṣabāṣpāśrunayanau sa kathaṃcid uvāca tau //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा स मातापितरौ ननाम शिवसंनिधौ
हर्षबाष्पाश्रुनयनौ स कथंचिद् उवाच तौ //
text_mt: Seeing his mother and father, he bowed down in the presence of Śiva; / with tears of joy in his eyes, he somehow spoke to them both.

sanskrit_iast:
putra uvāca
tārayanty eva pitarāv anye putrāḥ kulodvahāḥ
ahaṃ tu mātur udare kevalaṃ bhedakāraṇam
evaṃbhūto 'pi tau mohāt paśyeyam atidurmatiḥ //
meaning:
पुत्र उवाच
तारयन्त्य् एव पितराव् अन्ये पुत्राः कुलोद्वहाः
अहं तु मातुर् उदरे केवलं भेदकारणम्
एवंभूतो ऽपि तौ मोहात् पश्येयम् अतिदुर्मतिः //
text_mt: The son said: / Other sons who carry forward the lineage deliver their parents; / but I was merely the cause of tearing apart my mother’s womb. / Even being such a one, through delusion might I, utterly wicked, behold them both?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tāv ālokya tato duḥkhād vaktuṃ naiva śaśāka saḥ
devāś ca mātāpitarau pippalādam athābruvan //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ताव् आलोक्य ततो दुःखाद् वक्तुं नैव शशाक सः
देवाश् च मातापितरौ पिप्पलादम् अथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Beholding them both, he was then unable to speak out of grief. / And the gods and his mother and father then said to Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyas tvaṃ putra lokeṣu yasya kīrtir gatā divam
sākṣātkṛtas tvayā tryakṣo devāś cāśvāsitās tvayā
tvayā putreṇa sallokā na kṣīyante kadācana //
meaning:
धन्यस् त्वं पुत्र लोकेषु यस्य कीर्तिर् गता दिवम्
साक्षात्कृतस् त्वया त्र्यक्षो देवाश् चाश्वासितास् त्वया
त्वया पुत्रेण सल्लोका न क्षीयन्ते कदाचन //
text_mt: “Blessed are you, O son, in the worlds, whose fame has reached heaven! / The three-eyed one has been seen directly by you, and the gods have been comforted by you; / by you as a son, the good worlds never perish.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
puṣpavṛṣṭis tadā svargāt papāta tasya mūrdhani
jayaśabdaḥ surair uktaḥ prādurbhūto mahāmune //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पुष्पवृष्टिस् तदा स्वर्गात् पपात तस्य मूर्धनि
जयशब्दः सुरैर् उक्तः प्रादुर्भूतो महामुने //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / A shower of flowers then fell from heaven upon his head; / a cry of victory uttered by the gods arose, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
āśiṣaṃ tu sute dattvā dadhīciḥ saha bhāryayā
śaṃbhuṃ gaṅgāṃ surān natvā putraṃ vākyam athābravīt //
meaning:
आशिषं तु सुते दत्त्वा दधीचिः सह भार्यया
शंभुं गङ्गां सुरान् नत्वा पुत्रं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having bestowed a blessing upon his son, Dadhīci together with his wife, / having bowed to Śaṃbhu, the Gaṅgā, and the gods, then spoke these words to his son:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcir uvāca
prāpya bhāryāṃ śive bhaktiṃ kuru gaṅgāṃ ca sevaya
putrān utpādya vidhivad yajñān iṣṭvā sadakṣiṇān
kṛtakṛtyas tato vatsa ākramasva ciraṃ divam //
meaning:
दधीचिर् उवाच
प्राप्य भार्यां शिवे भक्तिं कुरु गङ्गां च सेवय
पुत्रान् उत्पाद्य विधिवद् यज्ञान् इष्ट्वा सदक्षिणान्
कृतकृत्यस् ततो वत्स आक्रमस्व चिरं दिवम् //
text_mt: Dadhīci said: / Having obtained a wife, practice devotion to Śiva and serve the Gaṅgā. / Having fathered sons according to rule and performed sacrifices with priestly fees, / having achieved your purpose, my child, enter heaven for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
karomy evam iti prāha dadhīciṃ pippalāśanaḥ
dadhīciḥ putram āśvāsya bhāryayā ca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
करोम्य् एवम् इति प्राह दधीचिं पिप्पलाशनः
दधीचिः पुत्रम् आश्वास्य भार्यया च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Pippalāda said to Dadhīci, “I will do so.” / Having comforted his son along with his wife again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātaḥ suragaṇaiḥ punaḥ sa divam ākramat
devā apy ūcire sarve pippalādaṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ //
meaning:
अनुज्ञातः सुरगणैः पुनः स दिवम् आक्रमत्
देवा अप्य् ऊचिरे सर्वे पिप्पलादं ससंभ्रमाः //
text_mt: permitted by the hosts of gods, he entered heaven once more. / All the gods, too, agitated with urgency, said to Pippalāda:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
kṛtyāṃ śamaya bhadraṃ te tad utpannaṃ mahānalam //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
कृत्यां शमय भद्रं ते तद् उत्पन्नं महानलम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / Quench the destructive spirit, may good betide you, and the great fire that arose from her!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
pippalādas tu tān āha na śakto 'haṃ nivāraṇe
asatyaṃ naiva vaktāhaṃ yūyaṃ kṛtyāṃ tu brūta tām //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
पिप्पलादस् तु तान् आह न शक्तो ऽहं निवारणे
असत्यं नैव वक्ताहं यूयं कृत्यां तु ब्रूत ताम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Pippalāda, however, said to them, “I am not able to ward them off. / I will never speak an untruth; speak yourselves to that destructive spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mahāraudrā viparītaṃ kariṣyati
tām eva gatvā vibudhāḥ procus te śāntikāraṇam //
meaning:
मां दृष्ट्वा सा महारौद्रा विपरीतं करिष्यति
ताम् एव गत्वा विबुधाः प्रोचुस् ते शान्तिकारणम् //
text_mt: Seeing me, she, intensely fierce, will do the opposite.” / Going to her, the gods spoke for the sake of pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
analaṃ ca yathāprīti te ubhe nety avocatām
sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇāyaiva sṛṣṭā cāhaṃ dvijanmanā //
meaning:
अनलं च यथाप्रीति ते उभे नेत्य् अवोचताम्
सर्वेषां भक्षणायैव सृष्टा चाहं द्विजन्मना //
text_mt: And to the fire, as kindly as possible, but both of them said, “No. / I was created by the twice-born specifically to devour everyone,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca matprasūto 'gnir anyathā tat kathaṃ bhavet
mahābhūtāni pañcāpi sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तथा च मत्प्रसूतो ऽग्निर् अन्यथा तत् कथं भवेत्
महाभूतानि पञ्चापि स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा //
text_mt: and the fire was born from me; how could it be otherwise? / Even the five gross elements, both the stationary and the moving,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvam asmanmukhe vidyād vaktavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate
mayā saṃmantrya te devāḥ punar ūcur ubhāv api //
meaning:
सर्वम् अस्मन्मुखे विद्याद् वक्तव्यं नावशिष्यते
मया संमन्त्र्य ते देवाः पुनर् ऊचुर् उभाव् अपि //
text_mt: one should know to be entirely in our mouth; nothing remains to be said.” / Having consulted with me, those gods spoke again to both of them:

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayetām ubhau sarvaṃ yathānukramatas tathā
vaḍavāpi surān evam uvāca śṛṇu nārada //
meaning:
भक्षयेताम् उभौ सर्वं यथानुक्रमतस् तथा
वडवापि सुरान् एवम् उवाच शृणु नारद //
text_mt: “Let both of you devour everything in proper order.” / Hear, O Nārada, what Vaḍavā too said to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vaḍavovāca
bhavatām icchayā sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ me surasattamāḥ //
meaning:
वडवोवाच
भवताम् इच्छया सर्वं भक्ष्यं मे सुरसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Vaḍavā said: / In accordance with your wish, everything shall be devoured by me, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vaḍavā sā nadī jātā gaṅgayā saṃgatā mune
tadbhavas tu mahān agnir ya āsīd atibhīṣaṇaḥ
tam āhur amarā vahniṃ bhūtānām ādito viduḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वडवा सा नदी जाता गङ्गया संगता मुने
तद्भवस् तु महान् अग्निर् य आसीद् अतिभीषणः
तम् आहुर् अमरा वह्निं भूतानाम् आदितो विदुः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / That Vaḍavā became a river and joined with the Gaṅgā, O sage; / and the great fire that was born from her, which was extremely terrifying, / the immortals called the fire that exists from the beginning of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
surā ūcuḥ
āpo jyeṣṭhatamā jñeyās tathaiva prathamaṃ bhavān
tatrāpy apāṃpatiṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ samudram aśanaṃ kuru
yathaiva tu vayaṃ brūmo gaccha bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham //
meaning:
सुरा ऊचुः
आपो ज्येष्ठतमा ज्ञेयास् तथैव प्रथमं भवान्
तत्राप्य् अपांपतिं ज्येष्ठं समुद्रम् अशनं कुरु
यथैव तु वयं ब्रूमो गच्छ भुङ्क्ष्व यथासुखम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / Waters should be known as the eldest of all, and likewise you are the first. / Even there, make the ocean, the eldest lord of the waters, your food. / Just as we say, go and consume it at your pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
analas tv amarān āha āpas tatra kathaṃ tv aham
vrajeyaṃ yadi māṃ tatra prāpayanty udakaṃ mahat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अनलस् त्व् अमरान् आह आपस् तत्र कथं त्व् अहम्
व्रजेयं यदि मां तत्र प्रापयन्त्य् उदकं महत् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / The fire said to the immortals, “The waters are there; but how / could I go unless you take me there to the great water?”

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanta eva te 'py āhuḥ kathaṃ te 'gne gatir bhavet
agnir apy āha tān devān kanyā māṃ guṇaśālinī //
meaning:
भवन्त एव ते ऽप्य् आहुः कथं ते ऽग्ने गतिर् भवेत्
अग्निर् अप्य् आह तान् देवान् कन्या मां गुणशालिनी //
text_mt: They too said, “How could your going take place, O fire?” / The fire also said to those gods, “An accomplished maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakalaśe sthāpya nayed yatra gatir mama
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kanyām ūcuḥ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
हिरण्यकलशे स्थाप्य नयेद् यत्र गतिर् मम
तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्याम् ऊचुः सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: having placed me in a golden pot, should take me to where my destination is.” / Having heard his words, they spoke to the maiden Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
nayainam analaṃ śīghraṃ śirasā varuṇālayam //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नयैनम् अनलं शीघ्रं शिरसा वरुणालयम् //
text_mt: The gods said: / Take this fire quickly upon your head to the abode of Varuṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
sarasvatī surān āha naikā śaktā ca dhāraṇe
yuktā catasṛbhiḥ śīghraṃ vaheyaṃ varuṇālayam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सरस्वती सुरान् आह नैका शक्ता च धारणे
युक्ता चतसृभिः शीघ्रं वहेयं वरुणालयम् //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Sarasvatī said to the gods, “Alone I am not able to hold him; / accompanied by four [others], I would quickly carry him to the abode of Varuṇa.”

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā
narmadāṃ tapatīṃ caiva surāḥ procuḥ pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
सरस्वत्या वचः श्रुत्वा गङ्गां च यमुनां तथा
नर्मदां तपतीं चैव सुराः प्रोचुः पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Having heard the words of Sarasvatī, the gods spoke individually / to Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Narmadā, and Tapatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiḥ samanvitovāha hiraṇyakalaśe 'nalam
saṃsthāpya śirasādhārya tā jagmur varuṇālayam //
meaning:
ताभिः समन्वितोवाह हिरण्यकलशे ऽनलम्
संस्थाप्य शिरसाधार्य ता जग्मुर् वरुणालयम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by them, having placed the fire in a golden pot / and bearing it upon their heads, they carried it and went to the abode of Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya yatra deveśaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ
adhyāste vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य यत्र देवेशः सोमनाथो जगत्पतिः
अध्यास्ते विबुधैः सार्धं प्रभासे शशिभूषणः //
text_mt: depositing it where the lord of the gods, Somanātha, the lord of the world, / adorned with the crescent moon, resides together with the gods at Prabhāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpayām āsur analaṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatī
adhyāste ca mahān agniḥ piban vāri śanaiḥ śanaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रापयाम् आसुर् अनलं पञ्चनद्यः सरस्वती
अध्यास्ते च महान् अग्निः पिबन् वारि शनैः शनैः //
text_mt: The five rivers, led by Sarasvatī, brought the fire there; / and the great fire resides there, drinking the water little by little.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve śivam ūcuḥ surottamam //
meaning: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे शिवम् ऊचुः सुरोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Then all the hosts of gods spoke to Śiva, the best of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
asthnāṃ ca pāvanaṃ brūhi asmākaṃ ca gavāṃ tathā //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
अस्थ्नां च पावनं ब्रूहि अस्माकं च गवां तथा //
text_mt:
The gods said:
Tell us the purification for the bones, as well as for us and for the cows.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
śivaḥ prāha tadā sarvān gaṅgām āplutya yatnataḥ
devāś ca gāvas tatpāpān mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
शिवः प्राह तदा सर्वान् गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य यत्नतः
देवाश् च गावस् तत्पापान् मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Śiva then said to all: "By bathing with effort in the Gaṅgā,
the gods and the cows are freed from that sin; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālitāni cāsthīni ṛṣidehabhavāny atha
tāni prakṣālanād eva tatra prāptāni pūtatām //
meaning:
प्रक्षालितानि चास्थीनि ऋषिदेहभवान्य् अथ
तानि प्रक्षालनाद् एव तत्र प्राप्तानि पूतताम् //
text_mt:
And the bones that were born of the sage's body were washed;
by the very washing they achieved purity there.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra devā muktapāpās tat tīrthaṃ pāpanāśanam
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca brahmahatyāvināśanam //
meaning:
यत्र देवा मुक्तपापास् तत् तीर्थं पापनाशनम्
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Where the gods were freed from sin, that tīrtha is the destroyer of sins.
Bathing and giving gifts there destroys [the sin of] murdering a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ ca pāvanaṃ yatra gotīrthaṃ tad udāhṛtam
tatra snānān mahābuddhir gomedhaphalam āpnuyāt //
meaning:
गवां च पावनं यत्र गोतीर्थं तद् उदाहृतम्
तत्र स्नानान् महाबुद्धिर् गोमेधफलम् आप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Where the cows were purified, that is called Gotīrtha.
By bathing there, a person of great intellect obtains the fruit of a cow-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra tadbrāhmaṇāsthīni āsan puṇyāni nārada
pitṛtīrthaṃ tu vai jñeyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam //
meaning:
यत्र तद्ब्राह्मणास्थीनि आसन् पुण्यानि नारद
पितृतीर्थं तु वै ज्ञेयं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् //
text_mt:
Where the bones of that brāhmaṇa became holy, O Nārada,
that is to be known as Pitṛtīrtha, which increases the delight of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāsthinakharomāṇi prāṇino yasya kasyacit
tatra tīrthe saṃkrameran yāvac candrārkatārakam //
meaning:
भस्मास्थिनखरोमाणि प्राणिनो यस्य कस्यचित्
तत्र तीर्थे संक्रमेरन् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम् //
text_mt:
If the ashes, bones, nails, or hair of any living being
should enter that tīrtha, then as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure,

sanskrit_iast:
svarge vāso bhavet tasya api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ
tathā cakreśvarāt tīrthāt trīṇi tīrthāni nārada
tataḥ pūtāḥ suragaṇā gāvaḥ śaṃbhum athābruvan //
meaning:
स्वर्गे वासो भवेत् तस्य अपि दुष्कृतकर्मणः
तथा चक्रेश्वरात् तीर्थात् त्रीणि तीर्थानि नारद
ततः पूताः सुरगणा गावः शंभुम् अथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt:
there will be a dwelling in heaven for that person, even if they committed evil deeds.
Likewise, from the tīrtha of Cakreśvara there are three tīrthas, O Nārada.
Then the purified hosts of gods and the cows spoke to Śambhu:

sanskrit_iast:
gosurā ūcuḥ
yāmaḥ svaṃ svam adhiṣṭhānam atra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
asmin sthite dinakare surāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
गोसुरा ऊचुः
यामः स्वं स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् अत्र सूर्यः प्रतिष्ठितः
अस्मिन् स्थिते दिनकरे सुराः सर्वे प्रतिष्ठिताः //
text_mt:
The cows and gods said:
We shall go each to our own abode. Here the Sun is established.
When this maker of the day is established, all the gods will be established,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaveyur jagatām īśa tad anujñātum arhasi
sūryo hy ātmāsya jagatas tasthuṣaś ca sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
भवेयुर् जगताम् ईश तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
सूर्यो ह्य् आत्मास्य जगतस् तस्थुषश् च सनातनः //
text_mt:
O Lord of the worlds; please permit that.
For the Sun is the eternal self of this moving and unmoving world.

sanskrit_iast:
divākaro devamayas tatrāsmābhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
yatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī yatra vai tryambakaḥ svayam
suravāsaṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhaved yatra ca tryambakam //
meaning:
दिवाकरो देवमयस् तत्रास्माभिः प्रतिष्ठितः
यत्र गङ्गा जगद्धात्री यत्र वै त्र्यम्बकः स्वयम्
सुरवासं प्रतिष्ठानं भवेद् यत्र च त्र्यम्बकम् //
text_mt:
The maker of the day, who consists of the gods, has been established there by us,
where the Gaṅgā, the support of the world, is, and where Tryambaka is in person,
and where Tryambaka becomes an abode of the gods, an established place."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
āpṛcchya pippalādaṃ taṃ surāḥ svaṃ sadanaṃ yayuḥ
pippalāḥ kālaparyāye svargaṃ jagmur athākṣayam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
आपृच्छ्य पिप्पलादं तं सुराः स्वं सदनं ययुः
पिप्पलाः कालपर्याये स्वर्गं जग्मुर् अथाक्षयम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Taking leave of Pippalāda, the gods went to their own abode.
In the course of time, the Pippala trees went to imperishable heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
pādapānāṃ padaṃ vipraḥ pippalādaḥ pratāpavān
kṣetrādhipatye saṃsthāpya pūjayām āsa śaṃkaram //
meaning:
पादपानां पदं विप्रः पिप्पलादः प्रतापवान्
क्षेत्राधिपत्ये संस्थाप्य पूजयाम् आस शंकरम् //
text_mt:
The powerful brāhmaṇa Pippalāda established the place of the trees
in lordship over the holy site, and worshipped Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcisūnur munir ugratejā
avāpya bhāryāṃ gautamasyātmajāṃ ca
putrān athāvāpya śriyaṃ yaśaś ca
suhṛjjanaiḥ svargam avāpa dhīraḥ
meaning:
दधीचिसूनुर् मुनिर् उग्रतेजा
अवाप्य भार्यां गौतमस्यात्मजां च
पुत्रान् अथावाप्य श्रियं यशश् च
सुहृज्जनैः स्वर्गम् अवाप धीरः
text_mt:
The son of Dadhīci, a sage of fierce majesty,
having obtained Gautama's daughter as his wife,
and then having obtained sons, prosperity, and fame,
that steadfast one attained heaven together with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ pippaleśvaram ucyate
sarvakratuphalaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇād aghanāśanam //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पिप्पलेश्वरम् उच्यते
सर्वक्रतुफलं पुण्यं स्मरणाद् अघनाशनम् //
text_mt:
From then on, that holy tīrtha is called Pippaleśvara;
it bestows the fruit of all sacrifices, and destroys sins merely by remembering it.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punaḥ snānadānābhyām ādityasya tu darśanāt
cakreśvaraḥ pippaleśo devadevasya nāmanī //
meaning:
किं पुनः स्नानदानाभ्याम् आदित्यस्य तु दर्शनात्
चक्रेश्वरः पिप्पलेशो देवदेवस्य नामनी //
text_mt:
What then from bathing and giving gifts, and from the sight of the Sun?
Cakreśvara and Pippaleśa are two names of the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarahasyaṃ viditvā tu sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
sūryasya ca pratiṣṭhānāt suravāse pratiṣṭhite
pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ surāṇām api vallabham //
meaning:
सरहस्यं विदित्वा तु सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
सूर्यस्य च प्रतिष्ठानात् सुरवासे प्रतिष्ठिते
प्रतिष्ठानं तु तत् क्षेत्रं सुराणाम् अपि वल्लभम् //
text_mt:
Knowing them together with their secret, one obtains all desires.
And from the establishment of the Sun, when established in the abode of the gods,
that sacred site is Pratiṣṭhāna, beloved even by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
itīdam ākhyānam atīva puṇyaṃ
paṭheta vā yaḥ śṛṇuyāt smared vā
sa dīrghajīvī dhanavān dharmayuktaś
cānte smarañ śaṃbhum upaiti nityam
meaning:
इतीदम् आख्यानम् अतीव पुण्यं
पठेत वा यः शृणुयात् स्मरेद् वा
स दीर्घजीवी धनवान् धर्मयुक्तश्
चान्ते स्मरञ् शंभुम् उपैति नित्यम्
text_mt:
Whoever reads, hears, or remembers
this extremely holy narrative,
he will live long, be wealthy, endowed with dharma,
and at the end, constantly remembering Śambhu, he reaches him.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
nāgatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
yatra nāgeśvaro devaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi vistaram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नागतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
यत्र नागेश्वरो देवः शृणु तस्यापि विस्तरम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
There is the auspicious [tīrtha] known as Nāgatīrtha, which grants all desires,
where the deity Nāgeśvara resides; hear also the detailed account of that.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhānapure rājā śūrasena iti śrutaḥ
somavaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān matimān guṇasāgaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठानपुरे राजा शूरसेन इति श्रुतः
सोमवंशभवः श्रीमान् मतिमान् गुणसागरः //
text_mt:
In the city of Pratiṣṭhāna there was a king famed as Śūrasena,
born in the lunar dynasty, glorious, intelligent, an ocean of virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthaṃ sa mahāyatnam akarot priyayā saha
tasya putraś cirād āsīt sarpo vai bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रार्थं स महायत्नम् अकरोत् प्रियया सह
तस्य पुत्रश् चिराद् आसीत् सर्पो वै भीषणाकृतिः //
text_mt:
Together with his beloved [wife], he made great efforts for the sake of a son.
After a long time, a son was born to him: a serpent of terrifying form.

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ taṃ gopayām āsa śūraseno mahīpatiḥ
rājñaḥ putraḥ sarpa iti na kaścid vindate janaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रं तं गोपयाम् आस शूरसेनो महीपतिः
राज्ञः पुत्रः सर्प इति न कश्चिद् विन्दते जनः //
text_mt:
King Śūrasena kept that son hidden.
No one knew that the king's son was a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
antarvartī paro vāpi mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vinā
dhātreyy api na jānāti nāmātyo na purohitaḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्वर्ती परो वापि मातरं पितरं विना
धात्रेय्य् अपि न जानाति नामात्यो न पुरोहितः //
text_mt:
Whether an inmate of the house or an outsider, no one except the mother and father knew;
not even the wet-nurse knew, nor the minister, nor the family priest.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ sabhāryo nṛpasattamaḥ
saṃtāpaṃ nityam āpnoti sarpād varam aputratā //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा भीषणं सर्पं सभार्यो नृपसत्तमः
संतापं नित्यम् आप्नोति सर्पाद् वरम् अपुत्रता //
text_mt:
Seeing that terrifying serpent, the best of kings, together with his wife,
constantly experienced anguish: "Childlessness is better than a serpent!"

sanskrit_iast:
etad asti mahāsarpo vakti nityaṃ manuṣyavat
sa sarpaḥ pitaraṃ prāha kuru cūḍām api kriyām //
meaning:
एतद् अस्ति महासर्पो वक्ति नित्यं मनुष्यवत्
स सर्पः पितरं प्राह कुरु चूडाम् अपि क्रियाम् //
text_mt:
Nevertheless, this great serpent spoke constantly like a human being.
That serpent said to his father: "Perform for me the tonsure rite,

sanskrit_iast:
tathopanayanaṃ cāpi vedādhyayanam eva ca
yāvad vedaṃ na cādhīte tāvac chūdrasamo dvijaḥ //
meaning:
तथोपनयनं चापि वेदाध्ययनम् एव च
यावद् वेदं न चाधीते तावच् छूद्रसमो द्विजः //
text_mt:
and likewise the sacred thread investiture, and the study of the Veda.
As long as one does not study the Veda, so long is a twice-born equal to a śūdra."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
etac chrutvā putravacaḥ śūraseno 'tiduḥkhitaḥ
brāhmaṇaṃ kaṃcanānīya saṃskārādi tadākarot
adhītavedaḥ sarpo 'pi pitaraṃ cābravīd idam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एतच् छ्रुत्वा पुत्रवचः शूरसेनो ऽतिदुःखितः
ब्राह्मणं कंचनानीय संस्कारादि तदाकरोत्
अधीतवेदः सर्पो ऽपि पितरं चाब्रवीद् इदम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing these words of his son, Śūrasena was deeply distressed.
Bringing some brāhmaṇa, he then performed the rites of passage and other ceremonies.
When he had studied the Veda, the serpent also said this to his father:

sanskrit_iast:
sarpa uvāca
vivāhaṃ kuru me rājan strīkāmo 'haṃ nṛpottama
anyathāpi ca kṛtyaṃ te na sidhyed iti me matiḥ //
meaning:
सर्प उवाच
विवाहं कुरु मे राजन् स्त्रीकामो ऽहं नृपोत्तम
अन्यथापि च कृत्यं ते न सिध्येद् इति मे मतिः //
text_mt:
The serpent said:
Arrange a marriage for me, O king! I desire a wife, O best of kings.
Otherwise, I think, your duty will not be accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
janayitvātmajān vedavidhinākhilasaṃskṛtīḥ
na kuryād yaḥ pitā tasya narakān nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
जनयित्वात्मजान् वेदविधिनाखिलसंस्कृतीः
न कुर्याद् यः पिता तस्य नरकान् नास्ति निष्कृतिः //
text_mt:
The father who begets sons and does not perform all the rites of passage
according to the Vedic injunction—for him there is no release from hell.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
vismitaḥ sa pitā prāha sutaṃ tam uragākṛtim //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
विस्मितः स पिता प्राह सुतं तम् उरगाकृतिम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Astounded, that father spoke to his son who had the form of a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrasena uvāca
yasya śabdād api trāsaṃ yānti śūrāś ca pūruṣāḥ
tasmai kanyāṃ tu ko dadyād vada putra karomi kim //
meaning:
शूरसेन उवाच
यस्य शब्दाद् अपि त्रासं यान्ति शूराश् च पूरुषाः
तस्मै कन्यां तु को दद्याद् वद पुत्र करोमि किम् //
text_mt:
Śūrasena said:
At whose very hiss even heroic men take fright,
who would give a maiden to him? Tell me, son, what shall I do?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā sarpaḥ prāha vicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तत् पितुर् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्पः प्राह विचक्षणः //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
Hearing those words of his father, the discerning serpent said:

sanskrit_iast:
sarpa uvāca
vivāhā bahavo rājan rājñāṃ santi janeśvara
prasahyāharaṇaṃ cāpi śastrair vaivāha eva ca //
meaning:
सर्प उवाच
विवाहा बहवो राजन् राज्ञां सन्ति जनेश्वर
प्रसह्याहरणं चापि शस्त्रैर् वैवाह एव च //
text_mt:
The serpent said:
There are many types of marriage for kings, O ruler of people:
