text_mt: Whatever [fruit] is declared [to come] properly from a sacred site, by vow and observance, / that fruit one who is concentrated and pure obtains there every day.

sanskrit_iast:
yas tu nānāvidhair yajñair yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ
tat phalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
यस् तु नानाविधैर् यज्ञैर् यत् फलं लभते नरः
तत् फलं लभते तत्र प्रत्यहं संयतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Whatever fruit a man obtains through various kinds of sacrifices, / that fruit he whose senses are restrained obtains there every day.

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ tyajanti puruṣās tatra ye puruṣottame
kalpavṛkṣaṃ samāsādya muktās te nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
देहं त्यजन्ति पुरुषास् तत्र ये पुरुषोत्तमे
कल्पवृक्षं समासाद्य मुक्तास् ते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Men who cast off their body there in Puruṣottama, / having approached the wish-fulfilling tree, are liberated; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭasāgarayor madhye ye tyajanti kalevaram
te durlabhaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
वटसागरयोर् मध्ये ये त्यजन्ति कलेवरम्
ते दुर्लभं परं मोक्षं प्राप्नुवन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt: Those who abandon the body between the banyan tree and the ocean / attain supreme, hard-to-reach liberation, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
anicchann api yas tatra prāṇāṃs tyajati mānavaḥ
so 'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām //
meaning:
अनिच्छन्न् अपि यस् तत्र प्राणांस् त्यजति मानवः
सो ऽपि दुःखविनिर्मुक्तो मुक्तिं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभाम् //
text_mt: Even a person who, unwillingly, abandons his life-breaths there, / he too, completely freed from suffering, attains hard-to-reach liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyās tiryagyonigatāś ca ye
tatra dehaṃ parityajya te yānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
कृमिकीटपतंगाद्यास् तिर्यग्योनिगताश् च ये
तत्र देहं परित्यज्य ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Even worms, insects, moths, and those born in animal wombs, / casting off their body there, go to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāntiṃ lokasya paśyadhvam anyatīrthaṃ prati dvijāḥ
puruṣākhyena yat prāptam anyatīrthaphalādikam //
meaning:
भ्रान्तिं लोकस्य पश्यध्वम् अन्यतीर्थं प्रति द्विजाः
पुरुषाख्येन यत् प्राप्तम् अन्यतीर्थफलादिकम् //
text_mt: See the delusion of people regarding other sacred sites, O twice-born: / when the fruit of other sacred sites and more is obtained at the one named Puruṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛt paśyati yo martyaḥ śraddhayā puruṣottamam
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasreṣu sa bhaved uttamaḥ pumān //
meaning:
सकृत् पश्यति यो मर्त्यः श्रद्धया पुरुषोत्तमम्
पुरुषाणां सहस्रेषु स भवेद् उत्तमः पुमान् //
text_mt: Whatever mortal beholds Puruṣottama even once with faith, / he becomes the best among thousands of men.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛteḥ sa paro yasmāt puruṣād api cottamaḥ
tasmād vede purāṇe ca loke 'smin puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकृतेः स परो यस्मात् पुरुषाद् अपि चोत्तमः
तस्माद् वेदे पुराणे च लोके ऽस्मिन् पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: Since he is beyond Prakṛti and superior even to the puruṣa, / he is therefore called Puruṣottama in the Veda, the Purāṇa, and in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sau purāṇe vedānte paramātmety udāhṛtaḥ
āste viśvopakārāya tenāsau puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽसौ पुराणे वेदान्ते परमात्मेत्य् उदाहृतः
आस्ते विश्वोपकाराय तेनासौ पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: He who in the Purāṇa and the Vedānta is declared as the supreme self / resides for the welfare of the universe; therefore he is Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
pāthe śmaśāne gṛhamaṇḍape vā
rathyāpradeśeṣv api yatra kutra
icchann anicchann api tatra dehaṃ
saṃtyajya mokṣaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ
meaning:
पाथे श्मशाने गृहमण्डपे वा
रथ्याप्रदेशेष्व् अपि यत्र कुत्र
इच्छन्न् अनिच्छन्न् अपि तत्र देहं
संत्यज्य मोक्षं लभते मनुष्यः
text_mt: On a road, in a cremation ground, in a porch of a house, / or in public streets, wherever it may be, / willingly or even unwillingly casting off the body there, / a human being attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tasmin kṣetre dvijottamāḥ
dehatyāgo naraiḥ kāryaḥ samyaṅ mokṣābhikāṅkṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तमाः
देहत्यागो नरैः कार्यः सम्यङ् मोक्षाभिकाङ्क्षिभिः //
text_mt: Therefore with every effort, O best of twice-born, / casting off of the body should be performed in that field by men desiring liberation fully.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣākhyasya māhātmyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
tyaktvā yatra naro dehaṃ muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām //
meaning:
पुरुषाख्यस्य माहात्म्यं न भूतं न भविष्यति
त्यक्त्वा यत्र नरो देहं मुक्तिं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभाम् //
text_mt: The majesty of that [place] named Puruṣa has never been, nor ever will be [equaled], / where, having abandoned the body, a man attains hard-to-reach liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇānām ekadeśo 'yaṃ mayā kṣetrasya kīrtitaḥ
kaḥ samastān guṇān vaktuṃ śakto varṣaśatair api //
meaning:
गुणानाम् एकदेशो ऽयं मया क्षेत्रस्य कीर्तितः
कः समस्तान् गुणान् वक्तुं शक्तो वर्षशतैर् अपि //
text_mt: Only a single part of the virtues of this field has been proclaimed by me; / who could be able to speak all its virtues even in hundreds of years?

sanskrit_iast:
yadi yūyaṃ muniśreṣṭhā mokṣam icchatha śāśvatam
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye nivasadhvam atandritāḥ //
meaning:
यदि यूयं मुनिश्रेष्ठा मोक्षम् इच्छथ शाश्वतम्
तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये निवसध्वम् अतन्द्रिताः //
text_mt: If you desire eternal liberation, O best of sages, / dwell unwearied in that holy, excellent field.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
te tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
nivāsaṃ cakrire tatra avāpuḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ते तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
निवासं चक्रिरे तत्र अवापुः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having heard those words of Brahmā, whose birth is from the unmanifest, / they took up residence there and attained the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād yūyaṃ prayatnena nivasadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ
puruṣākhye vare kṣetre yadi muktim abhīpsatha //
meaning:
तस्माद् यूयं प्रयत्नेन निवसध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः
पुरुषाख्ये वरे क्षेत्रे यदि मुक्तिम् अभीप्सथ //
text_mt: Therefore, O best of twice-born, dwell with effort / in the excellent field named Puruṣa, if you desire liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tasmin kṣetre muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvasattvasukhāvahe
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalade puruṣottame //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वसत्त्वसुखावहे
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां फलदे पुरुषोत्तमे //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / In that field which brings joy to all living beings, O best of sages, / in Puruṣottama, which yields the fruit of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇḍur nāma mahātejā ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
satyavādī śucir dāntaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ //
meaning:
कण्डुर् नाम महातेजा ऋषिः परमधार्मिकः
सत्यवादी शुचिर् दान्तः सर्वभूतहिते रतः //
text_mt: a sage named Kaṇḍu, of great splendor, supremely righteous, / speaking truth, pure, self-controlled, devoted to the welfare of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
jitendriyo jitakrodho vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
avāpa paramāṃ siddhim ārādhya puruṣottamam //
meaning:
जितेन्द्रियो जितक्रोधो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः
अवाप परमां सिद्धिम् आराध्य पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: with conquered senses and conquered anger, master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / attained supreme perfection having worshiped Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
anye 'pi tatra saṃsiddhā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ
sarvabhūtahitā dāntā jitakrodhā vimatsarāḥ //
meaning:
अन्ये ऽपि तत्र संसिद्धा मुनयः संशितव्रताः
सर्वभूतहिता दान्ता जितक्रोधा विमत्सराः //
text_mt: Other sages too attained perfection there, firm in their vows, / devoted to the welfare of all beings, self-controlled, free from anger and without envy.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
ko 'sau kaṇḍuḥ kathaṃ tatra jagāma paramāṃ gatim
śrotum icchāmahe tasya caritaṃ brūhi sattama //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
को ऽसौ कण्डुः कथं तत्र जगाम परमां गतिम्
श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे तस्य चरितं ब्रूहि सत्तम //
text_mt: The sages said: / Who is this Kaṇḍu? How did he go to the supreme state there? / We wish to hear of his life; tell [us], O best one!

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ kathāṃ tasya manoharām
pravakṣyāmi samāsena munes tasya viceṣṭitam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः कथां तस्य मनोहराम्
प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन मुनेस् तस्य विचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Listen, O tigers among sages, to his captivating story; / I shall recount in brief the deeds of that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitre gomatītīre vijane sumanohare
kandamūlaphalaiḥ pūrṇe samitpuṣpakuśānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
पवित्रे गोमतीतीरे विजने सुमनोहरे
कन्दमूलफलैः पूर्णे समित्पुष्पकुशान्वितैः //
text_mt: On the holy bank of the Gomatī, solitary and very charming, / filled with tubers, roots, and fruits, supplied with sacrificial wood, flowers, and kuśa grass,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite
nānāpakṣirute ramye nānāmṛgagaṇānvite //
meaning:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पोपशोभिते
नानापक्षिरुते रम्ये नानामृगगणान्विते //
text_mt: abounding with various trees and creepers, adorned with various flowers, / lovely with the sounds of various birds, and filled with various herds of deer,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāśramapadaṃ kaṇḍor babhūva munisattamāḥ
sarvartuphalapuṣpāḍhyaṃ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
तत्राश्रमपदं कण्डोर् बभूव मुनिसत्तमाः
सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पाढ्यं कदलीखण्डमण्डितम् //
text_mt: there was the hermitage of Kaṇḍu, O best of sages, / rich in fruits and flowers of all seasons, adorned with plantain groves.

sanskrit_iast:
tapas tepe munis tatra sumahat paramādbhutam
vratopavāsair niyamaiḥ snānamaunasusaṃyamaiḥ //
meaning:
तपस् तेपे मुनिस् तत्र सुमहत् परमाद्भुतम्
व्रतोपवासैर् नियमैः स्नानमौनसुसंयमैः //
text_mt: There the sage performed immense and most wondrous asceticism / through vows, fasts, observances, ablutions, silence, and rigorous self-restraint.

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣme pañcatapā bhūtvā varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ
ārdravāsās tu hemante sa tepe sumahat tapaḥ //
meaning:
ग्रीष्मे पञ्चतपा भूत्वा वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः
आर्द्रवासास् तु हेमन्ते स तेपे सुमहत् तपः //
text_mt: Practicing the five-fire penance in summer, sleeping on the bare ground in the rainy season, / and wearing wet garments in the winter, he performed immense asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tu tapaso vīryaṃ munes tasya suvismitāḥ
babhūvur devagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharās tathā //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तु तपसो वीर्यं मुनेस् तस्य सुविस्मिताः
बभूवुर् देवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धविद्याधरास् तथा //
text_mt: Seeing the power of that sage's asceticism, the gods and gandharvas, / as well as the siddhas and vidyādharas, were filled with great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ tathāntarikṣaṃ ca divaṃ ca munisattamāḥ
kaṇḍuḥ saṃtāpayām āsa trailokyaṃ tapaso balāt //
meaning:
भूमिं तथान्तरिक्षं च दिवं च मुनिसत्तमाः
कण्डुः संतापयाम् आस त्रैलोक्यं तपसो बलात् //
text_mt: The earth, the mid-region, and heaven, O best of sages— / Kaṇḍu tormented the three worlds by the power of his asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
aho 'sya paramaṃ dhairyam aho 'sya paramaṃ tapaḥ
ity abruvaṃs tadā dṛṣṭvā devās taṃ tapasi sthitam //
meaning:
अहो ऽस्य परमं धैर्यम् अहो ऽस्य परमं तपः
इत्य् अब्रुवंस् तदा दृष्ट्वा देवास् तं तपसि स्थितम् //
text_mt: “Ah, his supreme endurance! Ah, his supreme asceticism!” / So said the gods at that time, seeing him fixed in asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrayām āsur avyagrāḥ śakreṇa sahitās tadā
bhayāt tasya samudvignās tapovighnam abhīpsavaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रयाम् आसुर् अव्यग्राः शक्रेण सहितास् तदा
भयात् तस्य समुद्विग्नास् तपोविघ्नम् अभीप्सवः //
text_mt: Deliberating together with Śakra, untiring, / agitated with fear of him, they then desired an obstacle to his asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā teṣām abhiprāyaṃ śakras tribhuvaneśvaraḥ
pramlocākhyāṃ varārohāṃ rūpayauvanagarvitām //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा तेषाम् अभिप्रायं शक्रस् त्रिभुवनेश्वरः
प्रम्लोचाख्यां वरारोहां रूपयौवनगर्विताम् //
text_mt: Knowing their intention, Śakra, the lord of the three worlds, / [addressed] the one named Pramlocā, slender-waisted and proud of her beauty and youth,

sanskrit_iast:
sumadhyāṃ cārujaṅghāṃ tāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ provāca phalasūdanaḥ //
meaning:
सुमध्यां चारुजङ्घां तां पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम्
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नां प्रोवाच फलसूदनः //
text_mt: With a slender waist, lovely calves, and swelling hips and breasts, / endowed with all auspicious marks; the slayer of Bala spoke to her:

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
pramloce gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ yadāsau tapyate muniḥ
vighnārthaṃ tasya tapasaḥ kṣobhayasvāṃśu suprabhe //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
प्रम्लोचे गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं यदासौ तप्यते मुनिः
विघ्नार्थं तस्य तपसः क्षोभयस्वांशु सुप्रभे //
text_mt: Śakra said: / "Go quickly, Pramlocā, to where this sage performs austerities; / to disrupt his austerities, agitate him quickly, O radiant one!"

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
tava vākyaṃ suraśreṣṭha karomi satataṃ prabho
kiṃtu śaṅkā mamaivātra jīvitasya ca saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
तव वाक्यं सुरश्रेष्ठ करोमि सततं प्रभो
किंतु शङ्का ममैवात्र जीवितस्य च संशयः //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / "I always obey your command, O best of gods, O lord; / yet in this matter there is fear in me, and danger to my very life.

sanskrit_iast:
bibhemi taṃ munivaraṃ brahmacaryavrate sthitam
atyugraṃ dīptatapasaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham //
meaning:
बिभेमि तं मुनिवरं ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितम्
अत्युग्रं दीप्ततपसं ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: I fear that excellent sage who is steadfast in the vow of celibacy, / exceedingly fierce, blazing with austerities, radiating like fire and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā māṃ sa muniḥ krodhād vighnārthaṃ samupāgatām
kaṇḍuḥ paramatejasvī śāpaṃ dāsyati duḥsaham //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा मां स मुनिः क्रोधाद् विघ्नार्थं समुपागताम्
कण्डुः परमतेजस्वी शापं दास्यति दुःसहम् //
text_mt: Knowing that I have come out of wrath to create an obstacle, / Kaṇḍu, supremely energetic, will utter an intolerable curse.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī menakā rambhā ghṛtācī puñjikasthalā
viśvācī sahajanyā ca pūrvacittis tilottamā //
meaning:
उर्वशी मेनका रम्भा घृताची पुञ्जिकस्थला
विश्वाची सहजन्या च पूर्वचित्तिस् तिलोत्तमा //
text_mt: Urvaśī, Menakā, Rambhā, Ghṛtācī, Puñjikasthalā, / Viśvācī, Sahajanyā, Pūrvacitti, Tilottamā,

sanskrit_iast:
alambuṣā miśrakeśī śaśilekhā ca vāmanā
anyāś cāpsarasaḥ santi rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ //
meaning:
अलम्बुषा मिश्रकेशी शशिलेखा च वामना
अन्याश् चाप्सरसः सन्ति रूपयौवनगर्विताः //
text_mt: Alambuṣā, Miśrakeśī, Śaśilekhā, and Vāmanā, / and there are other apsarases proud of their beauty and youth,

sanskrit_iast:
sumadhyāś cāruvadanāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ
kāmapradhānakuśalās tās tatra saṃniyojaya //
meaning:
सुमध्याश् चारुवदनाः पीनोन्नतपयोधराः
कामप्रधानकुशलास् तास् तत्र संनियोजय //
text_mt: Slender-waisted, lovely-faced, with swelling and prominent breasts, / skilled in the chief arts of love—employ them there!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha śacīpatiḥ
tiṣṭhantu nāma cānyās tās tvaṃ cātra kuśalā śubhe //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा पुनः प्राह शचीपतिः
तिष्ठन्तु नाम चान्यास् तास् त्वं चात्र कुशला शुभे //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of hers, the husband of Śacī spoke again: / "Let those other women indeed remain; but you are adept at this, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ vasantaṃ vāyuṃ ca sahāyārthe dadāmi te
taiḥ sārdhaṃ gaccha suśroṇi yatrāste sa mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
कामं वसन्तं वायुं च सहायार्थे ददामि ते
तैः सार्धं गच्छ सुश्रोणि यत्रास्ते स महामुनिः //
text_mt: I give you Kāma, Spring, and the Wind to assist you; / go along with them, O fair-hipped one, to where that great sage dwells."

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tadā sā cārulocanā
jagāmākāśamārgeṇa taiḥ sārdhaṃ cāśramaṃ muneḥ //
meaning:
शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तदा सा चारुलोचना
जगामाकाशमार्गेण तैः सार्धं चाश्रमं मुनेः //
text_mt: Hearing the words of Śakra, that lovely-eyed woman / then went along with them through the path of the sky to the hermitage of the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sā tatra ruciraṃ dadarśa vanam uttamam
muniṃ ca dīptatapasam āśramastham akalmaṣam //
meaning:
गत्वा सा तत्र रुचिरं ददर्श वनम् उत्तमम्
मुनिं च दीप्ततपसम् आश्रमस्थम् अकल्मषम् //
text_mt: Arriving there, she saw a charming, excellent forest, / and the sinless sage blazing with austerities, staying in his hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyat sā vanaṃ ramyaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ nandanopamam
sarvartuvarapuṣpāḍhyaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇākulam //
meaning:
अपश्यत् सा वनं रम्यं तैः सार्धं नन्दनोपमम्
सर्वर्तुवरपुष्पाढ्यं शाखामृगगणाकुलम् //
text_mt: Together with them she saw the delightful forest resembling the Nandana garden, / filled with the choice flowers of all seasons, crowded with troops of monkeys,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaṃ padmabalopetaṃ sapallavamahābalam
śrotraramyān sumadhurāñ śabdān khagamukheritān //
meaning:
पुण्यं पद्मबलोपेतं सपल्लवमहाबलम्
श्रोत्ररम्यान् सुमधुराञ् शब्दान् खगमुखेरितान् //
text_mt: Sacred, endowed with the strength of lotuses, bearing great shoots and foliage, / [echoing with] very sweet sounds pleasing to the ear, uttered from the mouths of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvartuphalabhārāḍhyān sarvartukusumojjvalān
apaśyat pādapāṃś caiva vihaṃgair anunāditān //
meaning:
सर्वर्तुफलभाराढ्यान् सर्वर्तुकुसुमोज्ज्वलान्
अपश्यत् पादपांश् चैव विहंगैर् अनुनादितान् //
text_mt: She saw trees laden with the fruits of all seasons, radiant with flowers of all seasons, / made to resound by birds:

sanskrit_iast:
āmrān āmrātakān bhavyān nārikerān satindukān
atha bilvāṃs tathā jīvān dāḍimān bījapūrakān //
meaning:
आम्रान् आम्रातकान् भव्यान् नारिकेरान् सतिन्दुकान्
अथ बिल्वांस् तथा जीवान् दाडिमान् बीजपूरकान् //
text_mt: Mangoes, hog plums, bhavyas, coconuts, along with tindukas, / then bilvas, as well as jīvas, pomegranates, citrons,

sanskrit_iast:
panasāṃl lakucān nīpāñ śirīṣān sumanoharān
pārāvatāṃs tathā kolān arimedāmlavetasān //
meaning:
पनसांल् लकुचान् नीपाञ् शिरीषान् सुमनोहरान्
पारावतांस् तथा कोलान् अरिमेदाम्लवेतसान् //
text_mt: Jackfruits, monkey jacks, kadambas, most enchanting śirīṣas, / pārāvatas, jujubes, arimedas, and sour docks,

sanskrit_iast:
bhallātakān āmalakāñ śataparṇāṃś ca kiṃśukān
iṅgudān karavīrāṃś ca harītakīvibhītakān //
meaning:
भल्लातकान् आमलकाञ् शतपर्णांश् च किंशुकान्
इङ्गुदान् करवीरांश् च हरीतकीविभीतकान् //
text_mt: Bhallātakas, āmalakas, saptaparṇas, and kiṃśukas, / iṅgudas, oleanders, and yellow and black myrobalans.

sanskrit_iast:
etān anyāṃś ca sā vṛkṣān dadarśa pṛthulocanā
tathaivāśokapuṃnāgaketakībakulān atha //
meaning:
एतान् अन्यांश् च सा वृक्षान् ददर्श पृथुलोचना
तथैवाशोकपुंनागकेतकीबकुलान् अथ //
text_mt: These and other trees the wide-eyed woman saw, / and likewise aśokas, puṃnāgas, ketakīs, and bakulas,

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātān kovidārān mandārendīvarāṃs tathā
pāṭalāḥ puṣpitā ramyā devadārudrumāṃs tathā //
meaning:
पारिजातान् कोविदारान् मन्दारेन्दीवरांस् तथा
पाटलाः पुष्पिता रम्या देवदारुद्रुमांस् तथा //
text_mt: Pārijātas, kovidāras, mandāras, blue lotuses, / blooming, delightful pāṭalās, and deodar trees,

sanskrit_iast:
śālāṃs tālāṃs tamālāṃś ca niculāṃl lomakāṃs tathā
anyāṃś ca pādapaśreṣṭhān apaśyat phalapuṣpitān //
meaning:
शालांस् तालांस् तमालांश् च निचुलांल् लोमकांस् तथा
अन्यांश् च पादपश्रेष्ठान् अपश्यत् फलपुष्पितान् //
text_mt: Śālas, palmyras, tamālas, niculā trees, and lomakas; / she saw other excellent trees bearing fruits and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
cakoraiḥ śatapattraiś ca bhṛṅgarājais tathā śukaiḥ
kokilaiḥ kalaviṅkaiś ca hārītair jīvajīvakaiḥ //
meaning:
चकोरैः शतपत्त्रैश् च भृङ्गराजैस् तथा शुकैः
कोकिलैः कलविङ्कैश् च हारीतैर् जीवजीवकैः //
text_mt: Resided in by cakoras, woodpeckers, bhṛṅgarājas, parrots, / cuckoos, sparrows, green pigeons, and jīvañjīvaka pheasants,

sanskrit_iast:
priyaputraiś cātakaiś ca tathānyair vividhaiḥ khagaiḥ
śrotraramyaṃ sumadhuraṃ kūjadbhiś cāpy adhiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
प्रियपुत्रैश् चातकैश् च तथान्यैर् विविधैः खगैः
श्रोत्ररम्यं सुमधुरं कूजद्भिश् चाप्य् अधिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Priyaputras, cātakas, and various other birds / singing very sweetly and pleasingly to the ear;

sanskrit_iast:
sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasannasalilāni ca
kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
सरांसि च मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च
कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश् च तथा नीलोत्पलैः शुभैः //
text_mt: And charming lakes with clear waters, / covered on all sides with white water-lilies, white lotuses, auspicious blue water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
kahlāraiḥ kamalaiś caiva ācitāni samantataḥ
kādambaiś cakravākaiś ca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ //
meaning:
कह्लारैः कमलैश् चैव आचितानि समन्ततः
कादम्बैश् चक्रवाकैश् च तथैव जलकुक्कुटैः //
text_mt: Kahlāra water-lilies, and lotuses, / and likewise thronged with kādamba geese, cakravāka birds, water fowls,

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇḍavair bakair haṃsaiḥ kūrmair madgubhir eva ca
etaiś cānyaiś ca kīrṇāni samantāj jalacāribhiḥ //
meaning:
कारण्डवैर् बकैर् हंसैः कूर्मैर् मद्गुभिर् एव च
एतैश् चान्यैश् च कीर्णानि समन्ताज् जलचारिभिः //
text_mt: Kāraṇḍava ducks, herons, swans, tortoises, and cormorants, / scattered all around with these and other aquatic creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇaiva tathā sā tu vanaṃ babhrāma taiḥ saha
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā vanaṃ ramyaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
क्रमेणैव तथा सा तु वनं बभ्राम तैः सह
एवं दृष्ट्वा वनं रम्यं तैः सार्धं परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt: In this way she gradually roamed the forest with them. / Having thus seen the delightful and most wonderful forest with them,

sanskrit_iast:
vismayotphullanayanā sā babhūva varāṅganā
provāca vāyuṃ kāmaṃ ca vasantaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना सा बभूव वराङ्गना
प्रोवाच वायुं कामं च वसन्तं च द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Her eyes wide with wonder, that excellent woman, / O best of the twice-born, spoke to the Wind, Kāma, and Spring:

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
kurudhvaṃ mama sāhāyyaṃ yūyaṃ sarve pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
कुरुध्वं मम साहाय्यं यूयं सर्वे पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / "Give me your assistance, each and every one of you!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā tadā sā tu tathety uktā surair dvijāḥ
pratyuvācādya yāsyāmi yatrāsau saṃsthito muniḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा तदा सा तु तथेत्य् उक्ता सुरैर् द्विजाः
प्रत्युवाचाद्य यास्यामि यत्रासौ संस्थितो मुनिः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, O twice-born, and having been told 'So be it' by the gods, / she answered: 'Today I will go to where this sage resides.

sanskrit_iast:
adya taṃ dehayantāraṃ prayuktendriyavājinam
smaraśastragaladraśmiṃ kariṣyāmi kusārathim //
meaning:
अद्य तं देहयन्तारं प्रयुक्तेन्द्रियवाजिनम्
स्मरशस्त्रगलद्रश्मिं करिष्यामि कुसारथिम् //
text_mt: Today I will make him who drives the chariot of the body with harnessed horses of the senses / a poor charioteer whose reins slip before the weapon of Smara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā janārdano vāpi yadi vā nīlalohitaḥ
tathāpy adya kariṣyāmi kāmabāṇakṣatāntaram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनो वापि यदि वा नीललोहितः
तथाप्य् अद्य करिष्यामि कामबाणक्षतान्तरम् //
text_mt: Whether he be Brahmā, or Janārdana, or even Nīlalohita, / I shall nonetheless wound his heart today with the arrows of love.'"

sanskrit_iast:
ity uktvā prayayau sātha yatrāsau tiṣṭhate muniḥ
munes tapaḥprabhāveṇa praśāntaśvāpadāśramam //
meaning:
इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रययौ साथ यत्रासौ तिष्ठते मुनिः
मुनेस् तपःप्रभावेण प्रशान्तश्वापदाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, she went to where that sage stayed, / in the hermitage where wild beasts were pacified by the power of the sage's austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
sā puṃskokilamādhurye nadītīre vyavasthitā
stokamātraṃ sthitā tasmād agāyata varāpsarāḥ //
meaning:
सा पुंस्कोकिलमाधुर्ये नदीतीरे व्यवस्थिता
स्तोकमात्रं स्थिता तस्माद् अगायत वराप्सराः //
text_mt: Stationed on the riverbank sweet with the calls of male cuckoos, / pausing just a little while away from him, the excellent apsaras sang.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vasantaḥ sahasā balaṃ samakarot tadā
kokilārāvamadhuram akālikamanoharam //
meaning:
ततो वसन्तः सहसा बलं समकरोत् तदा
कोकिलारावमधुरम् अकालिकमनोहरम् //
text_mt: Then Spring at once gathered his strength, / sweet with the calling of cuckoos, enchanting out of season.

sanskrit_iast:
vavau gandhavahaś caiva malayādriniketanaḥ
puṣpān uccāvacān medhyān pātayaṃś ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ //
meaning:
ववौ गन्धवहश् चैव मलयाद्रिनिकेतनः
पुष्पान् उच्चावचान् मेध्यान् पातयंश् च शनैः शनैः //
text_mt: The fragrance-bearing wind dwelling on Mount Malaya blew, / gently and steadily scattering pure, diverse flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpabāṇadharaś caiva gatvā tasya samīpataḥ
muneś ca kṣobhayām āsa kāmas tasyāpi mānasam //
meaning:
पुष्पबाणधरश् चैव गत्वा तस्य समीपतः
मुनेश् च क्षोभयाम् आस कामस् तस्यापि मानसम् //
text_mt: Approaching him, the bearer of flower-arrows, / Kāma, agitated the mind of that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gītadhvaniṃ śrutvā munir vismitamānasaḥ
jagāma yatra sā subhrūḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो गीतध्वनिं श्रुत्वा मुनिर् विस्मितमानसः
जगाम यत्र सा सुभ्रूः कामबाणप्रपीडितः //
text_mt: Then, hearing the sound of the song, his mind filled with wonder, / afflicted by the arrows of love, the sage went to where that fair-browed woman was.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tām āha saṃdṛṣṭo vismayotphullalocanaḥ
bhraṣṭottarīyo vikalaḥ pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ताम् आह संदृष्टो विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः
भ्रष्टोत्तरीयो विकलः पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहः //
text_mt: Seeing her, gazing upon her with eyes wide with wonder, / his upper garment slipping down, agitated, his body bristling with horripilation, he said:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣir uvāca
kāsi kasyāsi suśroṇi subhage cāruhāsini
mano harasi me subhru brūhi satyaṃ sumadhyame //
meaning:
ऋषिर् उवाच
कासि कस्यासि सुश्रोणि सुभगे चारुहासिनि
मनो हरसि मे सुभ्रु ब्रूहि सत्यं सुमध्यमे //
text_mt: The ṛṣi said: / "Who are you? Whose are you, O fair-hipped, fortunate, lovely-smiling lady? / You captivate my mind, O fair-browed one! Tell me the truth, O slender-waisted woman!"

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
tava karmakarā cāhaṃ puṣpārtham aham āgatā
ādeśaṃ dehi me kṣipraṃ kiṃ karomi tavājñayā //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
तव कर्मकरा चाहं पुष्पार्थम् अहम् आगता
आदेशं देहि मे क्षिप्रं किं करोमि तवाज्ञया //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / "I am your servant, and I have come for flowers; / give me your command quickly; what shall I do at your bidding?"

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyās tyaktvā dhairyaṃ vimohitaḥ
ādāya haste tāṃ bālāṃ praviveśa svam āśramam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्यास् त्यक्त्वा धैर्यं विमोहितः
आदाय हस्ते तां बालां प्रविवेश स्वम् आश्रमम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Hearing these words of hers, abandoning his steadfastness and deluded, / taking the maiden by the hand, he entered his own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāmaś ca vāyuś ca vasantaś ca dvijottamāḥ
jagmur yathāgataṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyās triviṣṭapam //
meaning:
ततः कामश् च वायुश् च वसन्तश् च द्विजोत्तमाः
जग्मुर् यथागतं सर्वे कृतकृत्यास् त्रिविष्टपम् //
text_mt: Then, O best of the twice-born, Kāma, the Wind, and Spring, / having accomplished their purpose, all departed as they had come to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśaṃsuś ca hariṃ gatvā tasyās tasya ca ceṣṭitam
śrutvā śakras tadā devāḥ prītāḥ sumanaso 'bhavan //
meaning:
शशंसुश् च हरिं गत्वा तस्यास् तस्य च चेष्टितम्
श्रुत्वा शक्रस् तदा देवाः प्रीताः सुमनसो ऽभवन् //
text_mt: Approaching Hari, they reported her conduct and his; / hearing it, Śakra and the gods then became pleased and glad at heart.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca kaṇḍus tayā sārdhaṃ praviśann eva cāśramam
ātmanaḥ paramaṃ rūpaṃ cakāra madanākṛti //
meaning:
स च कण्डुस् तया सार्धं प्रविशन्न् एव चाश्रमम्
आत्मनः परमं रूपं चकार मदनाकृति //
text_mt: And that Kaṇḍu, entering the hermitage along with her, / assumed a supreme form for himself with the appearance of the god of love,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpayauvanasaṃpannam atīva sumanoharam
divyālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśavatsarākṛti //
meaning:
रूपयौवनसंपन्नम् अतीव सुमनोहरम्
दिव्यालंकारसंयुक्तं षोडशवत्सराकृति //
text_mt: Endowed with beauty and youth, exceedingly captivating, / adorned with celestial ornaments, appearing as sixteen years of age.

sanskrit_iast:
divyavastradharaṃ kāntaṃ divyasraggandhabhūṣitam
sarvopabhogasaṃpannaṃ sahasā tapaso balāt //
meaning:
दिव्यवस्त्रधरं कान्तं दिव्यस्रग्गन्धभूषितम्
सर्वोपभोगसंपन्नं सहसा तपसो बलात् //
text_mt: wearing celestial garments, handsome, adorned with divine garlands and perfumes, / endowed with all enjoyments, suddenly, by the power of his austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sā tasya tad vīryaṃ paraṃ vismayam āgatā
aho 'sya tapaso vīryam ity uktvā muditābhavat //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सा तस्य तद् वीर्यं परं विस्मयम् आगता
अहो ऽस्य तपसो वीर्यम् इत्य् उक्त्वा मुदिताभवत् //
text_mt: Seeing that virility of his, she was filled with supreme wonder; / saying, “Ah, the virility of his austerity!” she became delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ devatārcanam
vratopavāsaniyamaṃ dhyānaṃ ca munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
स्नानं संध्यां जपं होमं स्वाध्यायं देवतार्चनम्
व्रतोपवासनियमं ध्यानं च मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Bathing, twilight worship, recitation, fire offering, Vedic study, worship of the gods, / vows, fasts, observances, and meditation, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā sa reme muditas tayā sārdham aharniśam
manmathāviṣṭahṛdayo na bubodha tapaḥkṣayam //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा स रेमे मुदितस् तया सार्धम् अहर्निशम्
मन्मथाविष्टहृदयो न बुबोध तपःक्षयम् //
text_mt: abandoning [all these], he sported with her day and night, delighted. / His heart possessed by love, he did not perceive the loss of his austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyārātridivāpakṣamāsartvayanahāyanam
na bubodha gataṃ kālaṃ viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ //
meaning:
संध्यारात्रिदिवापक्षमासर्त्वयनहायनम्
न बुबोध गतं कालं विषयासक्तमानसः //
text_mt: Twilight, night, day, fortnight, month, season, solstice, and year— / he did not notice time passing, his mind attached to objects of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca taṃ kāmajair bhāvair vidagdhā rahasi dvijāḥ
varayām āsa suśroṇiḥ pralāpakuśalā tadā //
meaning:
सा च तं कामजैर् भावैर् विदग्धा रहसि द्विजाः
वरयाम् आस सुश्रोणिः प्रलापकुशला तदा //
text_mt: And she, clever in amorous emotions, seductive in private, O twice-born, / of fair hips, skilled in sweet talk, then wooed him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kaṇḍus tayā sārdhaṃ varṣāṇām adhikaṃ śatam
atiṣṭhan mandaradroṇyāṃ grāmyadharmarato muniḥ //
meaning:
एवं कण्डुस् तया सार्धं वर्षाणाम् अधिकं शतम्
अतिष्ठन् मन्दरद्रोण्यां ग्राम्यधर्मरतो मुनिः //
text_mt: Thus Kaṇḍu, devoted to the carnal way, / stayed with her for more than a hundred years in the valley of Mount Mandara, the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sā taṃ prāha mahābhāgaṃ gantum icchāmy ahaṃ divam
prasādasumukho brahmann anujñātuṃ tvam arhasi //
meaning:
सा तं प्राह महाभागं गन्तुम् इच्छाम्य् अहं दिवम्
प्रसादसुमुखो ब्रह्मन्न् अनुज्ञातुं त्वम् अर्हसि //
text_mt: She said to that illustrious one: “I wish to go to heaven; / gracious-faced, O Brahmin, you ought to grant me leave.”

sanskrit_iast:
tayaivam uktaḥ sa munis tasyām āsaktamānasaḥ
dināni katicid bhadre sthīyatām ity abhāṣata //
meaning:
तयैवम् उक्तः स मुनिस् तस्याम् आसक्तमानसः
दिनानि कतिचिद् भद्रे स्थीयताम् इत्य् अभाषत //
text_mt: Addressed thus by her, the sage, his mind attached to her, / spoke: “Stay for a few days, fair lady.”

sanskrit_iast:
evam uktā tatas tena sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ punaḥ
bubhuje viṣayāṃs tanvī tena sārdhaṃ mahātmanā //
meaning:
एवम् उक्ता ततस् तेन साग्रं वर्षशतं पुनः
बुभुजे विषयांस् तन्वी तेन सार्धं महात्मना //
text_mt: Spoken to thus by him, the slender woman then / enjoyed sense pleasures again with that great-souled one for fully a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñāṃ dehi bhagavan vrajāmi tridaśālayam
uktas tayeti sa punaḥ sthīyatām ity abhāṣata //
meaning:
अनुज्ञां देहि भगवन् व्रजामि त्रिदशालयम्
उक्तस् तयेति स पुनः स्थीयताम् इत्य् अभाषत //
text_mt: “Grant me permission, lord; let me go to the abode of the gods.” / Addressed thus by her, he spoke again: “Stay!”

sanskrit_iast:
punar gate varṣaśate sādhike sā śubhānanā
yāmy ahaṃ tridivaṃ brahman praṇayasmitaśobhanam //
meaning:
पुनर् गते वर्षशते साधिके सा शुभानना
याम्य् अहं त्रिदिवं ब्रह्मन् प्रणयस्मितशोभनम् //
text_mt: When another hundred years and more had passed, that fair-faced lady [said]: / “I am going to heaven, O Brahmin,” charming with an affectionate smile.

sanskrit_iast:
uktas tayaivaṃ sa muniḥ punar āhāyatekṣaṇām
ihāsyatāṃ mayā subhru ciraṃ kālaṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
उक्तस् तयैवं स मुनिः पुनर् आहायतेक्षणाम्
इहास्यतां मया सुभ्रु चिरं कालं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Addressed thus by her, the sage spoke again to the large-eyed one: / “Stay here with me, fair-browed lady; you shall go after a long time.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchāpabhītā suśroṇī saha tenarṣiṇā punaḥ
śatadvayaṃ kiṃcid ūnaṃ varṣāṇāṃ samatiṣṭhata //
meaning:
तच्छापभीता सुश्रोणी सह तेनर्षिणा पुनः
शतद्वयं किंचिद् ऊनं वर्षाणां समतिष्ठत //
text_mt: Afraid of his curse, the woman of fair hips / stayed with that ṛṣi again for nearly two hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
gamanāya mahābhāgo devarājaniveśanam
proktaḥ proktas tayā tanvyā sthīyatām ity abhāṣata //
meaning:
गमनाय महाभागो देवराजनिवेशनम्
प्रोक्तः प्रोक्तस् तया तन्व्या स्थीयताम् इत्य् अभाषत //
text_mt: Whenever the illustrious one was addressed by that slender woman / to go to the abode of the king of gods, he said: “Stay!”

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śāpabhayād bhīrur dākṣiṇyena ca dakṣiṇā
proktā praṇayabhaṅgārtivedinī na jahau munim //
meaning:
तस्य शापभयाद् भीरुर् दाक्षिण्येन च दक्षिणा
प्रोक्ता प्रणयभङ्गार्तिवेदिनी न जहौ मुनिम् //
text_mt: Afraid of his curse, timid, and courteous out of politeness, / when addressed, understanding the pain of broken love, she did not leave the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā ca ramatas tasya paramarṣer aharniśam
navaṃ navam abhūt prema manmathāsaktacetasaḥ //
meaning:
तया च रमतस् तस्य परमर्षेर् अहर्निशम्
नवं नवम् अभूत् प्रेम मन्मथासक्तचेतसः //
text_mt: And as that supreme ṛṣi sported with her day and night, / his love was ever new, his mind attached to desire.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā tu tvarāyukto niścakrāmoṭajān muniḥ
niṣkrāmantaṃ ca kutreti gamyate prāha sā śubhā //
meaning:
एकदा तु त्वरायुक्तो निश्चक्रामोटजान् मुनिः
निष्क्रामन्तं च कुत्रेति गम्यते प्राह सा शुभा //
text_mt: Once, however, the sage came out of the hut in haste; / and seeing him come out, that fair woman said: “Where are you going?”

sanskrit_iast:
ity uktaḥ sa tayā prāha parivṛttam ahaḥ śubhe
saṃdhyopāstiṃ kariṣyāmi kriyālopo 'nyathā bhavet //
meaning:
इत्य् उक्तः स तया प्राह परिवृत्तम् अहः शुभे
संध्योपास्तिं करिष्यामि क्रियालोपो ऽन्यथा भवेत् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by her, he said: “Fair lady, the day has turned; / I must perform the twilight worship, otherwise my rite would be neglected.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahasya muditā sā taṃ prāha mahāmunim
kim adya sarvadharmajña parivṛttam ahas tava
gatam etan na kurute vismayaṃ kasya kathyate //
meaning:
ततः प्रहस्य मुदिता सा तं प्राह महामुनिम्
किम् अद्य सर्वधर्मज्ञ परिवृत्तम् अहस् तव
गतम् एतन् न कुरुते विस्मयं कस्य कथ्यते //
text_mt: Then, laughing, delighted, she said to that great sage: / “Has only today turned for you, O knower of all dharma? / This [much time] has passed; whose wonder does it not excite? Tell me!”

sanskrit_iast:
munir uvāca
prātas tvam āgatā bhadre nadītīram idaṃ śubham
mayā dṛṣṭāsi suśroṇi praviṣṭā ca mamāśramam //
meaning:
मुनिर् उवाच
प्रातस् त्वम् आगता भद्रे नदीतीरम् इदं शुभम्
मया दृष्टासि सुश्रोणि प्रविष्टा च ममाश्रमम् //
text_mt: The sage said: / “You came this morning, fair lady, to this auspicious riverbank; / you were seen by me, O fair-hipped woman, and you entered my hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ ca vartate saṃdhyā pariṇāmam aho gatam
avahāsaḥ kimartho 'yaṃ sadbhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ mama //
meaning:
इयं च वर्तते संध्या परिणामम् अहो गतम्
अवहासः किमर्थो ऽयं सद्भावः कथ्यतां मम //
text_mt: And now it is twilight; the day has come to its close. / Why this laughter? Tell me the truth!”

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
pratyūṣasy āgatā brahman satyam etan na me mṛṣā
kiṃtv adya tasya kālasya gatāny abdaśatāni te //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
प्रत्यूषस्य् आगता ब्रह्मन् सत्यम् एतन् न मे मृषा
किंत्व् अद्य तस्य कालस्य गतान्य् अब्दशतानि ते //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / “You came at dawn, O Brahmin; this is true, not false of me; / but hundreds of years have passed for you since that time!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sasādhvaso vipras tāṃ papracchāyatekṣaṇām
kathyatāṃ bhīru kaḥ kālas tvayā me ramataḥ sadā //
meaning:
ततः ससाध्वसो विप्रस् तां पप्रच्छायतेक्षणाम्
कथ्यतां भीरु कः कालस् त्वया मे रमतः सदा //
text_mt: Then, filled with dismay, the Brahmin asked that large-eyed one: / “Tell me, timid lady, how much time has passed while I sported with you constantly?”

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
saptottarāṇy atītāni navavarṣaśatāni ca
māsāś ca ṣaṭ tathaivānyat samatītaṃ dinatrayam //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
सप्तोत्तराण्य् अतीतानि नववर्षशतानि च
मासाश् च षट् तथैवान्यत् समतीतं दिनत्रयम् //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / “Nine hundred and seven years have passed, / and six months, and also another three days have elapsed.”

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣir uvāca
satyaṃ bhīru vadasy etat parihāso 'thavā śubhe
dinam ekam ahaṃ manye tvayā sārdham ihoṣitam //
meaning:
ऋषिर् उवाच
सत्यं भीरु वदस्य् एतत् परिहासो ऽथवा शुभे
दिनम् एकम् अहं मन्ये त्वया सार्धम् इहोषितम् //
text_mt: The ṛṣi said: / “Do you speak the truth, timid one, or is this a jest, fair lady? / I think I have lived here with you for a single day!”

sanskrit_iast:
pramlocovāca
vadiṣyāmy anṛtaṃ brahman katham atra tavāntike
viśeṣād adya bhavatā pṛṣṭā mārgānugāminā //
meaning:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
वदिष्याम्य् अनृतं ब्रह्मन् कथम् अत्र तवान्तिके
विशेषाद् अद्य भवता पृष्टा मार्गानुगामिना //
text_mt: Pramlocā said: / “How could I speak an untruth in your presence here, O Brahmin, / especially today when questioned by you who walk in the path [of truth]?”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
niśamya tad vacas tasyāḥ sa munir dvijasattamāḥ
dhig dhiṅ mām ity anācāraṃ vinindyātmānam ātmanā //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
निशम्य तद् वचस् तस्याः स मुनिर् द्विजसत्तमाः
धिग् धिङ् माम् इत्य् अनाचारं विनिन्द्यात्मानम् आत्मना //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Hearing those words of hers, O best of twice-born, the sage / reproached himself, saying, “Fie, fie on me of bad conduct!”

sanskrit_iast:
munir uvāca
tapāṃsi mama naṣṭāni hataṃ brahmavidāṃ dhanam
hṛto vivekaḥ kenāpi yoṣin mohāya nirmitā //
meaning:
मुनिर् उवाच
तपांसि मम नष्टानि हतं ब्रह्मविदां धनम्
हृतो विवेकः केनापि योषिन् मोहाय निर्मिता //
text_mt: The sage said: / “My austerities are ruined; the wealth of those who know brahman is destroyed; / my discernment has been stolen by someone! Woman was created for delusion!

sanskrit_iast:
ūrmiṣaṭkātigaṃ brahma jñeyam ātmajayena me
gatir eṣā kṛtā yena dhik taṃ kāmamahāgraham //
meaning:
ऊर्मिषट्कातिगं ब्रह्म ज्ञेयम् आत्मजयेन मे
गतिर् एषा कृता येन धिक् तं काममहाग्रहम् //
text_mt: Brahman, beyond the six waves [of existence], was to be known by me through mastery of self; / fie on that great eclipse of desire by which this state was brought about!

sanskrit_iast:
vratāni sarvavedāś ca kāraṇāny akhilāni ca
narakagrāmamārgeṇa kāmenādya hatāni me //
meaning:
व्रतानि सर्ववेदाश् च कारणान्य् अखिलानि च
नरकग्राममार्गेण कामेनाद्य हतानि मे //
text_mt: Vows, all the Vedas, and all reasons [for virtue] / have been destroyed today by desire, the path to the hamlet of hell!”

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣir uvāca
na tvāṃ karomy ahaṃ bhasma krodhatīvreṇa vahninā
satāṃ sāptapadaṃ maitryam uṣito 'haṃ tvayā saha //
meaning:
ऋषिर् उवाच
न त्वां करोम्य् अहं भस्म क्रोधतीव्रेण वह्निना
सतां साप्तपदं मैत्र्यम् उषितो ऽहं त्वया सह //
text_mt: I will not reduce you to ashes with the fierce fire of my anger; / friendship among the virtuous is formed in seven steps, and I have lived together with you.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā tava doṣaḥ kaḥ kiṃ vā kuryām ahaṃ tava
mamaiva doṣo nitarāṃ yenāham ajitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
अथवा तव दोषः कः किं वा कुर्याम् अहं तव
ममैव दोषो नितरां येनाहम् अजितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Or rather, what fault is yours? What could I do to you? / The fault is entirely mine, because I failed to conquer my senses.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śakrapriyārthinyā kṛto mattapaso vyayaḥ
tvayā dṛṣṭimahāmohamanunāhaṃ jugupsitaḥ //
meaning:
यथा शक्रप्रियार्थिन्या कृतो मत्तपसो व्ययः
त्वया दृष्टिमहामोहमनुनाहं जुगुप्सितः //
text_mt: Just as you, seeking to please Śakra, caused the ruin of my austerity, / I have been degraded by you through the great delusion that is the charm of sight.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
yāvad itthaṃ sa viprarṣis tāṃ bravīti sumadhyamām
tāvat skhalatsvedajalā sā babhūvātivepathuḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
यावद् इत्थं स विप्रर्षिस् तां ब्रवीति सुमध्यमाम्
तावत् स्खलत्स्वेदजला सा बभूवातिवेपथुः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / While the Brahmin-sage was speaking thus to that slender-waisted woman, / drops of sweat trickled from her, and she began to tremble exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast:
pravepamānāṃ sa ca tāṃ svinnagātralatāṃ satīm
gaccha gaccheti sakrodham uvāca munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
प्रवेपमानां स च तां स्विन्नगात्रलतां सतीम्
गच्छ गच्छेति सक्रोधम् उवाच मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt: And to her, trembling, her creeper-like body sweating, the chaste woman, / the best of sages angrily said: “Go! Go!”

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu nirbhartsitā tena viniṣkramya tadāśramāt
ākāśagāminī svedaṃ mamārja tarupallavaiḥ //
meaning:
सा तु निर्भर्त्सिता तेन विनिष्क्रम्य तदाश्रमात्
आकाशगामिनी स्वेदं ममार्ज तरुपल्लवैः //
text_mt: Rebuked by him, coming out from that hermitage, / moving through the sky, she wiped her sweat on the leaves of the trees.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣād vṛkṣaṃ yayau bālā udagrāruṇapallavaiḥ
nirmamārja ca gātrāṇi galatsvedajalāni vai //
meaning:
वृक्षाद् वृक्षं ययौ बाला उदग्रारुणपल्लवैः
निर्ममार्ज च गात्राणि गलत्स्वेदजलानि वै //
text_mt: The young woman went from tree to tree and with their high reddish sprouts / wiped her limbs, from which streams of sweat were flowing.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṇā yas tadā garbhas tasyā dehe samāhitaḥ
nirjagāma saromāñcasvedarūpī tadaṅgataḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिणा यस् तदा गर्भस् तस्या देहे समाहितः
निर्जगाम सरोमाञ्चस्वेदरूपी तदङ्गतः //
text_mt: The embryo that had then been placed in her body by the ṛṣi / came forth from her limbs in the form of sweat with bristling hair.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ vṛkṣā jagṛhur garbham ekaṃ cakre ca mārutaḥ
somenāpyāyito gobhiḥ sa tadā vavṛddhe śanaiḥ //
meaning:
तं वृक्षा जगृहुर् गर्भम् एकं चक्रे च मारुतः
सोमेनाप्यायितो गोभिः स तदा ववृद्धे शनैः //
text_mt: The trees received that embryo, and the wind gathered it into one; / nourished by Soma with his rays, it then grew slowly.

sanskrit_iast:
māriṣā nāma kanyābhūd vṛkṣāṇāṃ cārulocanā
prācetasānāṃ sā bhāryā dakṣasya jananī dvijāḥ //
meaning:
मारिषा नाम कन्याभूद् वृक्षाणां चारुलोचना
प्राचेतसानां सा भार्या दक्षस्य जननी द्विजाः //
text_mt: She became a lovely-eyed maiden of the trees named Māriṣā; / she was the wife of the Pracetases and mother of Dakṣa, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi bhagavān kaṇḍuḥ kṣīṇe tapasi sattamaḥ
puruṣottamākhyaṃ bho viprā viṣṇor āyatanaṃ yayau //
meaning:
स चापि भगवान् कण्डुः क्षीणे तपसि सत्तमः
पुरुषोत्तमाख्यं भो विप्रा विष्णोर् आयतनं ययौ //
text_mt: And that blessed Kaṇḍu, the best of men, his austerity depleted, / went, O Brahmins, to the abode of Viṣṇu named Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ bhuvi durlabham
dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre sarvakāmaphalapradam //
meaning:
ददर्श परमं क्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं भुवि दुर्लभम्
दक्षिणस्योदधेस् तीरे सर्वकामफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: He saw that supreme sacred field, granting liberation, rare on earth, / on the shore of the southern ocean, granting the fruit of all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
suramyaṃ vālukākīrṇaṃ ketakīvanaśobhitam
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣirutaṃ śivam //
meaning:
सुरम्यं वालुकाकीर्णं केतकीवनशोभितम्
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं नानापक्षिरुतं शिवम् //
text_mt: delightful, strewn with sand, adorned with ketakī groves, / covered with various trees and creepers, resounding with the cries of various birds, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra sukhasaṃcāraṃ sarvartukusumānvitam
sarvasaukhyapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ sarvaguṇākaram //
meaning:
सर्वत्र सुखसंचारं सर्वर्तुकुसुमान्वितम्
सर्वसौख्यप्रदं नॄणां धन्यं सर्वगुणाकरम् //
text_mt: easy to traverse everywhere, endowed with flowers of all seasons, / conferring all happiness on mortals, blessed, a mine of all virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvādyaiḥ sevitaṃ pūrvaṃ munisiddhavarais tathā
gandharvaiḥ kiṃnarair yakṣais tathānyair mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
भृग्वाद्यैः सेवितं पूर्वं मुनिसिद्धवरैस् तथा
गन्धर्वैः किंनरैर् यक्षैस् तथान्यैर् मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः //
text_mt: frequented in earlier times by Bhṛgu and others, and by the best of sages and perfected beings, / by gandharvas, kiṃnaras, yakṣas, and other seekers of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa ca hariṃ tatra devaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtam
brāhmaṇādyais tathā varṇair āśramasthair niṣevitam //
meaning:
ददर्श च हरिं तत्र देवैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतम्
ब्राह्मणाद्यैस् तथा वर्णैर् आश्रमस्थैर् निषेवितम् //
text_mt: And there he saw Hari, adorned by all the gods, / and attended by the castes, beginning with the brāhmaṇas, dwelling in their hermitages.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaiva sa tadā kṣetraṃ devaṃ ca puruṣottamam
kṛtakṛtyam ivātmānaṃ mene sa munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैव स तदा क्षेत्रं देवं च पुरुषोत्तमम्
कृतकृत्यम् इवात्मानं मेने स मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt: As soon as he saw that sacred field and the god Puruṣottama, / that best of sages considered himself to have achieved his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraikāgramanā bhūtvā cakārārādhanaṃ hareḥ
brahmapāramayaṃ kurvañ japam ekāgramānasaḥ
ūrdhvabāhur mahāyogī sthitvāsau munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैकाग्रमना भूत्वा चकाराराधनं हरेः
ब्रह्मपारमयं कुर्वञ् जपम् एकाग्रमानसः
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर् महायोगी स्थित्वासौ मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt: Becoming single-minded there, he worshiped Hari; / standing with arms raised, a great yogin, / that best of sages, his mind concentrated, performed the Brahmapāra recitation:

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
brahmapāraṃ mune śrotum icchāmaḥ paramaṃ śubham
japatā kaṇḍunā devo yenārādhyata keśavaḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
ब्रह्मपारं मुने श्रोतुम् इच्छामः परमं शुभम्
जपता कण्डुना देवो येनाराध्यत केशवः //
text_mt: The sages said: / O sage, we wish to hear the supreme and auspicious Brahmapāra [hymn], / by reciting which the god Keśava was worshiped by Kaṇḍu.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
pāraṃ paraṃ viṣṇur apārapāraḥ
paraḥ parebhyaḥ paramātmarūpaḥ
sa brahmapāraḥ parapārabhūtaḥ
paraḥ parāṇām api pārapāraḥ
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
पारं परं विष्णुर् अपारपारः
परः परेभ्यः परमात्मरूपः
स ब्रह्मपारः परपारभूतः
परः पराणाम् अपि पारपारः
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Viṣṇu is the shore beyond, the supreme, the shore of the shoreless, / higher than the high, whose form is the supreme self; / he is the Brahmapāra, existing as the shore beyond the beyond, / higher than the high, the ultimate shore of even the shores beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kāraṇaṃ kāraṇasaṃśrito 'pi
tasyāpi hetuḥ parahetuhetuḥ
kāryo 'pi caiṣa saha karmakartṛ
rūpair anekair avatīha sarvam
meaning:
स कारणं कारणसंश्रितो ऽपि
तस्यापि हेतुः परहेतुहेतुः
कार्यो ऽपि चैष सह कर्मकर्तृ
रूपैर् अनेकैर् अवतीह सर्वम्
text_mt: He is the cause, though resting in the cause; / he is the reason even of that, the cause of the supreme cause; / though an effect, together with the multiple forms / of action and agent, he protects everything here.

sanskrit_iast:
brahma prabhur brahma sa sarvabhūto
brahma prajānāṃ patir acyuto 'sau
brahmāvyayaṃ nityam ajaṃ sa viṣṇur
apakṣayādyair akhilair asaṅgaḥ
meaning:
ब्रह्म प्रभुर् ब्रह्म स सर्वभूतो
ब्रह्म प्रजानां पतिर् अच्युतो ऽसौ
ब्रह्माव्ययं नित्यम् अजं स विष्णुर्
अपक्षयाद्यैर् अखिलैर् असङ्गः
text_mt: The Lord is Brahman; he is Brahman, having become all beings; / he, Acyuta, is Brahman, the lord of creatures; / Viṣṇu is imperishable, eternal, unborn Brahman, / untouched by decay and all other [modifications].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmākṣaram ajaṃ nityaṃ yathāsau puruṣottamaḥ
tathā rāgādayo doṣāḥ prayāntu praśamaṃ mama //
meaning:
ब्रह्माक्षरम् अजं नित्यं यथासौ पुरुषोत्तमः
तथा रागादयो दोषाः प्रयान्तु प्रशमं मम //
text_mt: Just as this Puruṣottama is imperishable, unborn, and eternal Brahman, / so may my defects, such as passion, come to pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
śrutvā tasya muner jāpyaṃ brahmapāraṃ dvijottamāḥ
bhaktiṃ ca paramāṃ jñātvā sudṛḍhāṃ puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
श्रुत्वा तस्य मुनेर् जाप्यं ब्रह्मपारं द्विजोत्तमाः
भक्तिं च परमां ज्ञात्वा सुदृढां पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having heard the Brahmapāra recitation of that sage, O best of the twice-born, / and knowing his supreme and steadfast devotion, Puruṣottama—

sanskrit_iast:
prītyā sa parayā devas tadāsau bhaktavatsalaḥ
gatvā tasya samīpaṃ tu provāca madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रीत्या स परया देवस् तदासौ भक्तवत्सलः
गत्वा तस्य समीपं तु प्रोवाच मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: that god, fond of his devotees, filled with supreme love— / Madhusūdana went near him and spoke,

sanskrit_iast:
meghagambhīrayā vācā diśaḥ saṃnādayann iva
āruhya garuḍaṃ viprā vinatākulanandanam //
meaning:
मेघगम्भीरया वाचा दिशः संनादयन्न् इव
आरुह्य गरुडं विप्रा विनताकुलनन्दनम् //
text_mt: making the quarters resound, as it were, with a voice deep as thunder, / having mounted Garuḍa, O brāhmaṇas, the delighter of Vinatā's family.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavān uvāca
mune brūhi paraṃ kāryaṃ yat te manasi vartate
varado 'ham anuprāpto varaṃ varaya suvrata //
meaning:
श्रीभगवान् उवाच
मुने ब्रूहि परं कार्यं यत् ते मनसि वर्तते
वरदो ऽहम् अनुप्राप्तो वरं वरय सुव्रत //
text_mt: The Holy One said: / O sage, speak the ultimate desire that is in your heart; / I have arrived as the giver of boons; choose a boon, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
cakṣur unmīlya sahasā dadarśa purato harim //
meaning:
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्य देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः
चक्षुर् उन्मील्य सहसा ददर्श पुरतो हरिम् //
text_mt: Hearing these words of the god of gods who wields the discus, / he opened his eyes and suddenly saw Hari before him:

sanskrit_iast:
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam //
meaning:
अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम्
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं मुकुटाङ्गदधारिणम् //
text_mt: resembling an atasī flower, with long eyes like lotus petals, / holding the conch, discus, and mace in his hands, wearing a crown and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbāhum udārāṅgaṃ pītavastradharaṃ śubham
śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam //
meaning:
चतुर्बाहुम् उदाराङ्गं पीतवस्त्रधरं शुभम्
श्रीवत्सलक्ष्मसंयुक्तं वनमालाविभूषितम् //
text_mt: four-armed, noble-limbed, wearing auspicious yellow garments, / marked with the Śrīvatsa, adorned with a garland of forest flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
divyacandanaliptāṅgaṃ divyamālyavibhūṣitam //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्
दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गं दिव्यमाल्यविभूषितम् //
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all jewels, / his limbs smeared with divine sandalwood paste, adorned with divine garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo romāñcitatanūruhaḥ
daṇḍavat praṇipatyorvyāṃ praṇāmam akarot tadā //
meaning:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो रोमाञ्चिततनूरुहः
दण्डवत् प्रणिपत्योर्व्यां प्रणामम् अकरोत् तदा //
text_mt: Then, overcome with wonder, the hair on his body bristling with joy, / he prostrated like a staff on the earth and made obeisance.

sanskrit_iast:
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ
ity uktvā muniśārdūlās taṃ stotum upacakrame //
meaning:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः
इत्य् उक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलास् तं स्तोतुम् उपचक्रमे //
text_mt: “Today my birth has borne fruit; today my asceticism has borne fruit!” / Having said this, O tigers among sages, he began to praise him:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇḍur uvāca
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīvatsāṅka jagatpate
jagadbīja jagaddhāma jagatsākṣin namo 'stu te //
meaning:
कण्डुर् उवाच
नारायण हरे कृष्ण श्रीवत्साङ्क जगत्पते
जगद्बीज जगद्धाम जगत्साक्षिन् नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: Kaṇḍu said: / O Nārāyaṇa, O Hari, O Kṛṣṇa, O one marked by the Śrīvatsa, O lord of the universe! / O seed of the universe, O abode of the universe, O witness of the universe, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
avyakta jiṣṇo prabhava pradhānapuruṣottama
puṇḍarīkākṣa govinda lokanātha namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अव्यक्त जिष्णो प्रभव प्रधानपुरुषोत्तम
पुण्डरीकाक्ष गोविन्द लोकनाथ नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O unmanifest one, O victorious one, O origin, O Puruṣottama of the pradhāna! / O lotus-eyed one, O Govinda, O protector of the world, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbha śrīnātha padmanātha sanātana
bhūgarbha dhruva īśāna hṛṣīkeśa namo 'stu te //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भ श्रीनाथ पद्मनाथ सनातन
भूगर्भ ध्रुव ईशान हृषीकेश नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O Hiraṇyagarbha, O lord of Śrī, O lord of the lotus, O eternal one! / O womb of the earth, O immovable one, O ruler, O Hṛṣīkeśa, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
anādyantāmṛtājeya jaya tvaṃ jayatāṃ vara
ajitākhaṇḍa śrīkṛṣṇa śrīnivāsa namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अनाद्यन्तामृताजेय जय त्वं जयतां वर
अजिताखण्ड श्रीकृष्ण श्रीनिवास नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O one without beginning or end, O immortal one, O unconquerable one, be victorious, O best among the victorious! / O unconquered one, O undivided one, O Śrīkṛṣṇa, O abode of Śrī, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
parjanyadharmakartā ca duṣpāra duradhiṣṭhita
duḥkhārtināśana hare jalaśāyin namo 'stu te //
meaning:
पर्जन्यधर्मकर्ता च दुष्पार दुरधिष्ठित
दुःखार्तिनाशन हरे जलशायिन् नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O rain cloud, O maker of dharma, O hard to cross, O difficult to attain, / O destroyer of grief and pain, O Hari, O one reclining on the waters, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapāvyakta bhūteśa bhūtatattvair anākula
bhūtādhivāsa bhūtātman bhūtagarbha namo 'stu te //
meaning:
भूतपाव्यक्त भूतेश भूततत्त्वैर् अनाकुल
भूताधिवास भूतात्मन् भूतगर्भ नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O protector of beings, O unmanifest one, O lord of beings, unperturbed by the principles of beings, / O dwelling of beings, O self of beings, O womb of beings, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñayajvan yajñadhara yajñadhātābhayaprada
yajñagarbha hiraṇyāṅga pṛśnigarbha namo 'stu te //
meaning:
यज्ञयज्वन् यज्ञधर यज्ञधाताभयप्रद
यज्ञगर्भ हिरण्याङ्ग पृश्निगर्भ नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O sacrifice, O sacrificer, O upholder of the sacrifice, O dispenser of the sacrifice, O granter of fearlessness, / O womb of the sacrifice, O golden-limbed one, O Pṛśnigarbha, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrabhṛt kṣetrī kṣetrahā kṣetrakṛd vaśī
kṣetrātman kṣetrarahita kṣetrasraṣṭre namo 'stu te //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रभृत् क्षेत्री क्षेत्रहा क्षेत्रकृद् वशी
क्षेत्रात्मन् क्षेत्ररहित क्षेत्रस्रष्ट्रे नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: You are the knower of the field, the supporter of the field, the possessor of the field, the destroyer of the field, the maker of the field, the controller; / O self of the field, O one free from the field, homage to the creator of the field!

sanskrit_iast:
guṇālaya guṇāvāsa guṇāśraya guṇāvaha
guṇabhoktṛ guṇārāma guṇatyāgin namo 'stu te //
meaning:
गुणालय गुणावास गुणाश्रय गुणावह
गुणभोक्तृ गुणाराम गुणत्यागिन् नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O abode of qualities, O dwelling of qualities, O refuge of qualities, O bringer of qualities, / O experiencer of qualities, O one delighting in qualities, O renouncer of qualities, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ viṣṇus tvaṃ hariś cakrī tvaṃ jiṣṇus tvaṃ janārdanaḥ
tvaṃ bhūtas tvaṃ vaṣaṭkāras tvaṃ bhavyas tvaṃ bhavatprabhuḥ //
meaning:
त्वं विष्णुस् त्वं हरिश् चक्री त्वं जिष्णुस् त्वं जनार्दनः
त्वं भूतस् त्वं वषट्कारस् त्वं भव्यस् त्वं भवत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: You are Viṣṇu, you are Hari, the discus-wielder; you are victorious, you are Janārdana; / you are the past, you are the vaṣaṭ-call, you are the future, you are the Lord of what is becoming;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ bhūtakṛt tvam avyaktas tvaṃ bhavo bhūtabhṛd bhavān
tvaṃ bhūtabhāvano devas tvām āhur ajam īśvaram //
meaning:
त्वं भूतकृत् त्वम् अव्यक्तस् त्वं भवो भूतभृद् भवान्
त्वं भूतभावनो देवस् त्वाम् आहुर् अजम् ईश्वरम् //
text_mt: You are the creator of beings, you are the unmanifest, you are existence, you support beings; / you are the originator of beings, the god; they call you the unborn Sovereign;

sanskrit_iast:
tvam anantaḥ kṛtajñas tvaṃ prakṛtis tvaṃ vṛṣākapiḥ
tvaṃ rudras tvaṃ durādharṣas tvam amoghas tvam īśvaraḥ //
meaning:
त्वम् अनन्तः कृतज्ञस् त्वं प्रकृतिस् त्वं वृषाकपिः
त्वं रुद्रस् त्वं दुराधर्षस् त्वम् अमोघस् त्वम् ईश्वरः //
text_mt: You are Ananta, you are grateful, you are nature, you are Vṛṣākapi; / you are Rudra, you are invincible, you are unfailing, you are the Sovereign;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ viśvakarmā jiṣṇus tvaṃ tvaṃ śaṃbhus tvaṃ vṛṣākṛtiḥ
tvaṃ śaṃkaras tvam uśanā tvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ tapo janaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं विश्वकर्मा जिष्णुस् त्वं त्वं शंभुस् त्वं वृषाकृतिः
त्वं शंकरस् त्वम् उशना त्वं सत्यं त्वं तपो जनः //
text_mt: You are Viśvakarman, you are victorious, you are Śambhu, you have the form of a bull; / you are Śaṅkara, you are Uśanas, you are truth, you are asceticism, you are Janaloka;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ viśvajetā tvaṃ śarma tvaṃ śaraṇyas tvam akṣaram
tvaṃ śaṃbhus tvaṃ svayaṃbhūś ca tvaṃ jyeṣṭhas tvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं विश्वजेता त्वं शर्म त्वं शरण्यस् त्वम् अक्षरम्
त्वं शंभुस् त्वं स्वयंभूश् च त्वं ज्येष्ठस् त्वं परायणः //
text_mt: You are the conqueror of all, you are shelter, you are refuge, you are the imperishable; / you are Śambhu, and you are Svayambhū; you are the eldest, you are the supreme resort;

sanskrit_iast:
tvam ādityas tvam oṃkāras tvaṃ prāṇas tvaṃ tamisrahā
tvaṃ parjanyas tvaṃ prathitas tvaṃ vedhās tvaṃ sureśvaraḥ //
meaning:
त्वम् आदित्यस् त्वम् ओंकारस् त्वं प्राणस् त्वं तमिस्रहा
त्वं पर्जन्यस् त्वं प्रथितस् त्वं वेधास् त्वं सुरेश्वरः //
text_mt: You are the sun, you are the syllable Oṃ, you are breath, you are the dispeller of darkness; / you are the rain cloud, you are renowned, you are the creator, you are the lord of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
tvam ṛg yajuḥ sāma caiva tvam ātmā saṃmato bhavān
tvam agnis tvaṃ ca pavanas tvam āpo vasudhā bhavān //
meaning:
त्वम् ऋग् यजुः साम चैव त्वम् आत्मा संमतो भवान्
त्वम् अग्निस् त्वं च पवनस् त्वम् आपो वसुधा भवान् //
text_mt: You are the Ṛg, the Yajur, and the Sāma; you are acknowledged as the Self; / you are Agni, and you are the wind; you are the waters; you are the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sraṣṭā tvaṃ tathā bhoktā hotā tvaṃ ca haviḥ kratuḥ
tvaṃ prabhus tvaṃ vibhuḥ śreṣṭhas tvaṃ lokapatir acyutaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं स्रष्टा त्वं तथा भोक्ता होता त्वं च हविः क्रतुः
त्वं प्रभुस् त्वं विभुः श्रेष्ठस् त्वं लोकपतिर् अच्युतः //
text_mt: You are the creator, and likewise the enjoyer; you are the hotṛ-priest, the oblation, and the sacrificial rite; / you are the lord, you are all-pervading, the highest, you are the lord of the worlds, Acyuta;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sarvadarśanaḥ śrīmāṃs tvaṃ sarvadamano 'rihā
tvam ahas tvaṃ tathā rātris tvām āhur vatsaraṃ budhāḥ //
meaning:
त्वं सर्वदर्शनः श्रीमांस् त्वं सर्वदमनो ऽरिहा
त्वम् अहस् त्वं तथा रात्रिस् त्वाम् आहुर् वत्सरं बुधाः //
text_mt: You are all-seeing, glorious; you are the tamer of all, the slayer of foes; / you are day, and likewise night; the wise call you the year;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kālas tvaṃ kalā kāṣṭhā tvaṃ muhūrtaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ
tvaṃ bālas tvaṃ tathā vṛddhas tvaṃ pumān strī napuṃsakaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं कालस् त्वं कला काष्ठा त्वं मुहूर्तः क्षणा लवाः
त्वं बालस् त्वं तथा वृद्धस् त्वं पुमान् स्त्री नपुंसकः //
text_mt: You are time, you are the kalā, the kāṣṭhā, you are the muhūrta, the moments, and the seconds; / you are the youth, and likewise the elder; you are male, female, and neuter;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ viśvayonis tvaṃ cakṣus tvaṃ sthāṇus tvaṃ śuciśravāḥ
tvaṃ śāśvatas tvam ajitas tvam upendras tvam uttamaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं विश्वयोनिस् त्वं चक्षुस् त्वं स्थाणुस् त्वं शुचिश्रवाः
त्वं शाश्वतस् त्वम् अजितस् त्वम् उपेन्द्रस् त्वम् उत्तमः //
text_mt: You are the source of all, you are the eye, you are immovable, you are Śuciśravas; / you are eternal, you are unconquered, you are Upendra, you are the highest;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ sarvaviśvasukhadas tvaṃ vedāṅgaṃ tvam avyayaḥ
tvaṃ vedavedas tvaṃ dhātā vidhātā tvaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं सर्वविश्वसुखदस् त्वं वेदाङ्गं त्वम् अव्ययः
त्वं वेदवेदस् त्वं धाता विधाता त्वं समाहितः //
text_mt: You grant happiness to the entire universe, you are the Vedāṅgas, you are imperishable; / you are what is known through the Vedas, you are the creator, the ordainer, you are concentrated;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ jalanidhir āmūlaṃ tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ punar vasuḥ
tvaṃ vaidyas tvaṃ dhṛtātmā ca tvam atīndriyagocaraḥ //
meaning:
त्वं जलनिधिर् आमूलं त्वं धाता त्वं पुनर् वसुः
त्वं वैद्यस् त्वं धृतात्मा च त्वम् अतीन्द्रियगोचरः //
text_mt: You are the ocean to its depths, you are the sustainer, you are the Vasu; / you are the physician, and the steadfast self; you are beyond the reach of the senses;

sanskrit_iast:
tvam agraṇīr grāmaṇīs tvaṃ tvaṃ suparṇas tvam ādimān
tvaṃ saṃgrahas tvaṃ sumahat tvaṃ dhṛtātmā tvam acyutaḥ //
meaning:
त्वम् अग्रणीर् ग्रामणीस् त्वं त्वं सुपर्णस् त्वम् आदिमान्
त्वं संग्रहस् त्वं सुमहत् त्वं धृतात्मा त्वम् अच्युतः //
text_mt: You are the leader, you are the village chief, you are Garuḍa, you are the primal one; / you are the collection, you are the great intellect-principle, you are the steadfast self, you are Acyuta;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ yamas tvaṃ ca niyamas tvaṃ prāṃśus tvaṃ caturbhujaḥ
tvam evānnāntarātmā tvaṃ paramātmā tvam ucyate //
meaning:
त्वं यमस् त्वं च नियमस् त्वं प्रांशुस् त्वं चतुर्भुजः
त्वम् एवान्नान्तरात्मा त्वं परमात्मा त्वम् उच्यते //
text_mt: You are the restrainer, and you are the rule; you are tall, you are four-armed; / you alone are the inner self of food; you are called the supreme self;

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ gurus tvaṃ gurutamas tvaṃ vāmas tvaṃ pradakṣiṇaḥ
tvaṃ pippalas tvam agamas tvaṃ vyaktas tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
त्वं गुरुस् त्वं गुरुतमस् त्वं वामस् त्वं प्रदक्षिणः
त्वं पिप्पलस् त्वम् अगमस् त्वं व्यक्तस् त्वं प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: You are the elder, you are the highest teacher; you are left, you are right; / you are the holy fig tree, you are immovable; you are manifest, you are the lord of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyanābhas tvaṃ devas tvaṃ śaśī tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ
anirdeśyavapus tvaṃ vai tvaṃ yamas tvaṃ surārihā //
meaning:
हिरण्यनाभस् त्वं देवस् त्वं शशी त्वं प्रजापतिः
अनिर्देश्यवपुस् त्वं वै त्वं यमस् त्वं सुरारिहा //
text_mt: You are the golden-naveled god; you are the moon; you are the lord of creatures; / you whose form is beyond definition; indeed, you are Yama; you are the slayer of the gods' enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇo devas tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ sanātanaḥ
tvaṃ vāsudevo 'meyātmā tvam eva guṇavarjitaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं च संकर्षणो देवस् त्वं कर्ता त्वं सनातनः
त्वं वासुदेवो ऽमेयात्मा त्वम् एव गुणवर्जितः //
text_mt: And you are the god Saṃkarṣaṇa; you are the creator; you are eternal; / you are Vāsudeva of immeasurable self; you alone are free of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ jyeṣṭhas tvaṃ variṣṭhas tvaṃ tvaṃ sahiṣṇuś ca mādhavaḥ
sahasraśīrṣā tvaṃ devas tvam avyaktaḥ sahasradṛk //
meaning:
त्वं ज्येष्ठस् त्वं वरिष्ठस् त्वं त्वं सहिष्णुश् च माधवः
सहस्रशीर्षा त्वं देवस् त्वम् अव्यक्तः सहस्रदृक् //
text_mt: You are the eldest; you are the foremost; you are patient, and [you are] Mādhava; / thousand-headed are you, O god; you are the unmanifest, thousand-eyed;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrapādas tvaṃ devas tvaṃ virāṭ tvaṃ suraprabhuḥ
tvam eva tiṣṭhase bhūyo devadeva daśāṅgulaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रपादस् त्वं देवस् त्वं विराट् त्वं सुरप्रभुः
त्वम् एव तिष्ठसे भूयो देवदेव दशाङ्गुलः //
text_mt: thousand-footed are you, O god; you are the cosmic person; you are the lord of the gods; / you alone stand further, O god of gods, by ten fingers' width.

sanskrit_iast:
yad bhūtaṃ tat tvam evoktaḥ puruṣaḥ śakra uttamaḥ
yad bhāvyaṃ tat tvam īśānas tvam ṛtas tvaṃ tathāmṛtaḥ //
meaning:
यद् भूतं तत् त्वम् एवोक्तः पुरुषः शक्र उत्तमः
यद् भाव्यं तत् त्वम् ईशानस् त्वम् ऋतस् त्वं तथामृतः //
text_mt: Whatever has been, that indeed are you called—the supreme puruṣa, Śakra; / whatever is to be, that [too] are you, the ruler; you are truth, and likewise the immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatto rohaty ayaṃ loko mahīyāṃs tvam anuttamaḥ
tvaṃ jyāyān puruṣas tvaṃ ca tvaṃ deva daśadhā sthitaḥ //
meaning:
त्वत्तो रोहत्य् अयं लोको महीयांस् त्वम् अनुत्तमः
त्वं ज्यायान् पुरुषस् त्वं च त्वं देव दशधा स्थितः //
text_mt: From you grows this world; you are the greater one, unexcelled; / you are the senior puruṣa, and you, O god, stand in tenfold form.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvabhūtaś caturbhāgo navabhāgo 'mṛto divi
navabhāgo 'ntarikṣasthaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
विश्वभूतश् चतुर्भागो नवभागो ऽमृतो दिवि
नवभागो ऽन्तरिक्षस्थः पौरुषेयः सनातनः //
text_mt: Having become all beings, one quarter [lies here]; nine parts are immortal in heaven; / nine parts dwell in the intermediate space, belonging to the puruṣa, eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgadvayaṃ ca bhūsaṃsthaṃ caturbhāgo 'py abhūd iha
tvatto yajñāḥ saṃbhavanti jagato vṛṣṭikāraṇam //
meaning:
भागद्वयं च भूसंस्थं चतुर्भागो ऽप्य् अभूद् इह
त्वत्तो यज्ञाः संभवन्ति जगतो वृष्टिकारणम् //
text_mt: And two parts dwell on earth; a fourth part also existed here. / From you arise the sacrifices, the cause of rain for the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatto virāṭ samutpanno jagato hṛdi yaḥ pumān
so 'tiricyata bhūtebhyas tejasā yaśasā śriyā //
meaning:
त्वत्तो विराट् समुत्पन्नो जगतो हृदि यः पुमान्
सो ऽतिरिच्यत भूतेभ्यस् तेजसा यशसा श्रिया //
text_mt: From you the cosmic person was born, the puruṣa who is in the heart of the world; / he surpassed all beings in splendor, fame, and majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ surāṇām āhāraḥ pṛṣadājyam ajāyata
grāmyāraṇyāś cauṣadhayas tvattaḥ paśumṛgādayaḥ //
meaning:
त्वत्तः सुराणाम् आहारः पृषदाज्यम् अजायत
ग्राम्यारण्याश् चौषधयस् त्वत्तः पशुमृगादयः //
text_mt: From you the food of the gods, the speckled clarified butter, was produced; / [and from you arose] domestic and wild medicinal plants, domestic beasts, wild animals, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyeyadhyānaparas tvaṃ ca kṛtavān asi cauṣadhīḥ
tvaṃ devadeva saptāsya kālākhyo dīptavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
ध्येयध्यानपरस् त्वं च कृतवान् असि चौषधीः
त्वं देवदेव सप्तास्य कालाख्यो दीप्तविग्रहः //
text_mt: Intent on meditation upon the object of meditation, you also created the plants. / You, O god of gods, are seven-faced, named Time, of blazing bodily form.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ sarvaṃ jagad etac carācaram
tvattaḥ sarvam idaṃ jātaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
जङ्गमाजङ्गमं सर्वं जगद् एतच् चराचरम्
त्वत्तः सर्वम् इदं जातं त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Everything moving and unmoving, this entire world animate and inanimate— / from you all this was born, and in you all is established.

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddhas tvaṃ mādhavas tvaṃ pradyumnaḥ surārihā
deva sarvasuraśreṣṭha sarvalokaparāyaṇa //
meaning:
अनिरुद्धस् त्वं माधवस् त्वं प्रद्युम्नः सुरारिहा
देव सर्वसुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकपरायण //
text_mt: You are Aniruddha; you are Mādhava; you are Pradyumna, slayer of the gods' enemies, / O god, supreme among all the gods, final refuge of all the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
trāhi mām aravindākṣa nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te
namas te bhagavan viṣṇo namas te puruṣottama //
meaning:
त्राहि माम् अरविन्दाक्ष नारायण नमो ऽस्तु ते
नमस् ते भगवन् विष्णो नमस् ते पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: Protect me, O lotus-eyed one! O Nārāyaṇa, reverence to you! / Reverence to you, O Lord Viṣṇu! Reverence to you, O Puruṣottama!

sanskrit_iast:
namas te sarvalokeśa namas te kamalālaya
guṇālaya namas te 'stu namas te 'stu guṇākara //
meaning:
नमस् ते सर्वलोकेश नमस् ते कमलालय
गुणालय नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते ऽस्तु गुणाकर //
text_mt: Reverence to you, O ruler of all worlds! Reverence to you, abode of the lotus goddess! / Abode of virtues, reverence to you! Reverence to you, mine of virtues!

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeva namas te 'stu namas te 'stu surottama
janārdana namas te 'stu namas te 'stu sanātana //
meaning:
वासुदेव नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते ऽस्तु सुरोत्तम
जनार्दन नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते ऽस्तु सनातन //
text_mt: O Vāsudeva, reverence to you! Reverence to you, best of the gods! / O Janārdana, reverence to you! Reverence to you, eternal one!

sanskrit_iast:
namas te yogināṃ gamya yogāvāsa namo 'stu te
gopate śrīpate viṣṇo namas te 'stu marutpate //
meaning:
नमस् ते योगिनां गम्य योगावास नमो ऽस्तु ते
गोपते श्रीपते विष्णो नमस् ते ऽस्तु मरुत्पते //
text_mt: Reverence to you, accessible to yogins! Dwelling place of yoga, reverence to you! / Lord of cattle, lord of Śrī, O Viṣṇu, reverence to you, lord of the Maruts!

sanskrit_iast:
jagatpate jagatsūte namas te jñānināṃ pate
divaspate namas te 'stu namas te 'stu mahīpate //
meaning:
जगत्पते जगत्सूते नमस् ते ज्ञानिनां पते
दिवस्पते नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते ऽस्तु महीपते //
text_mt: Lord of the universe, source of the universe, reverence to you, lord of the wise! / Reverence to you, lord of heaven! Reverence to you, lord of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
namas te madhuhantre ca namas te puṣkarekṣaṇa
kaiṭabhaghna namas te 'stu subrahmaṇya namo 'stu te //
meaning:
नमस् ते मधुहन्त्रे च नमस् ते पुष्करेक्षण
कैटभघ्न नमस् ते ऽस्तु सुब्रह्मण्य नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: Reverence to you, slayer of Madhu! And reverence to you, lotus-eyed one! / O slayer of Kaiṭabha, reverence to you! Very dear to the brahmins, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te mahāmīna śrutipṛṣṭhadharācyuta
samudrasalilakṣobha padmajāhlādakāriṇe //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते महामीन श्रुतिपृष्ठधराच्युत
समुद्रसलिलक्षोभ पद्मजाह्लादकारिणे //
text_mt: Reverence to you, great Fish, O Achyuta who bore the Vedas on your back, / who churned the ocean waters, who brought delight to the lotus-born [Brahmā]!

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaśīrṣa mahāghoṇa mahāpuruṣavigraha
madhukaiṭabhahantre ca namas te turagānana //
meaning:
अश्वशीर्ष महाघोण महापुरुषविग्रह
मधुकैटभहन्त्रे च नमस् ते तुरगानन //
text_mt: O horse-headed one, great-snouted, having the bodily form of the Great Person, / slayer of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, reverence to you, horse-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
mahākamaṭhabhogāya pṛthivyuddharaṇāya ca
vidhṛtādrisvarūpāya mahākūrmāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
महाकमठभोगाय पृथिव्युद्धरणाय च
विधृताद्रिस्वरूपाय महाकूर्माय ते नमः //
text_mt: To you whose form is the great tortoise, who uplifted the earth, / whose essential nature bore the mountain—reverence to you, the Great Tortoise!

sanskrit_iast:
namo mahāvarāhāya pṛthivyuddhārakāriṇe
namaś cādivarāhāya viśvarūpāya vedhase //
meaning:
नमो महावराहाय पृथिव्युद्धारकारिणे
नमश् चादिवराहाय विश्वरूपाय वेधसे //
text_mt: Reverence to the Great Boar, who achieved the uplift of the earth; / and reverence to the Primordial Boar of universal form, the creator!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'nantāya sūkṣmāya mukhyāya ca varāya ca
paramāṇusvarūpāya yogigamyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽनन्ताय सूक्ष्माय मुख्याय च वराय च
परमाणुस्वरूपाय योगिगम्याय ते नमः //
text_mt: Reverence to the infinite, the subtle, the foremost, and the best; / to you whose nature is the atomic particle, accessible to yogins, reverence!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai namaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya
yogīndravṛttanilayāya sudurvidāya
kṣīrārṇavāśritamahāhisutalpagāya
tubhyaṃ namaḥ kanakaratnasukuṇḍalāya
meaning:
तस्मै नमः कारणकारणाय
योगीन्द्रवृत्तनिलयाय सुदुर्विदाय
क्षीरार्णवाश्रितमहाहिसुतल्पगाय
तुभ्यं नमः कनकरत्नसुकुण्डलाय
text_mt: Reverence to him, the cause of causes, / who abides in the state of the lords of yoga, very difficult to know, / who rests on the great serpent-son bed in the Ocean of Milk; / to you, who wear beautiful earrings of gold and jewels, reverence!

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
itthaṃ stutas tadā tena prītaḥ provāca mādhavaḥ
kṣipraṃ brūhi muniśreṣṭha matto yad abhivāñchasi //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्थं स्तुतस् तदा तेन प्रीतः प्रोवाच माधवः
क्षिप्रं ब्रूहि मुनिश्रेष्ठ मत्तो यद् अभिवाञ्छसि //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Praised in this manner by him then, Mādhava, pleased, said: / “Speak quickly, best of sages, what you desire from me.”

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇḍur uvāca
saṃsāre 'smiñ jagannātha dustare lomaharṣaṇe
anitye duḥkhabahule kadalīdalasaṃnibhe //
meaning:
कण्डुर् उवाच
संसारे ऽस्मिञ् जगन्नाथ दुस्तरे लोमहर्षणे
अनित्ये दुःखबहुले कदलीदलसंनिभे //
text_mt: Kaṇḍu said: / “In this saṃsāra, O Lord of the Universe, difficult to cross, hair-raising, / impermanent, full of suffering, resembling the leaf of a plantain tree,

sanskrit_iast:
nirāśraye nirālambe jalabudbudacañcale
sarvopadravasaṃyukte dustare cātibhairave //
meaning:
निराश्रये निरालम्बे जलबुद्बुदचञ्चले
सर्वोपद्रवसंयुक्ते दुस्तरे चातिभैरवे //
text_mt: shelterless, supportless, unsteady as a water bubble, / full of all kinds of distress, impassable and exceedingly terrifying,

sanskrit_iast:
bhramāmi suciraṃ kālaṃ māyayā mohitas tava
na cāntam abhigacchāmi viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ //
meaning:
भ्रमामि सुचिरं कालं मायया मोहितस् तव
न चान्तम् अभिगच्छामि विषयासक्तमानसः //
text_mt: I wander for a very long time, deluded by your illusory power, / and find no end, my mind attached to sense objects.

sanskrit_iast:
tvām ahaṃ cādya deveśa saṃsārabhayapīḍitaḥ
gato 'smi śaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa mām uddhara bhavārṇavāt //
meaning:
त्वाम् अहं चाद्य देवेश संसारभयपीडितः
गतो ऽस्मि शरणं कृष्ण माम् उद्धर भवार्णवात् //
text_mt: And today, afflicted by the fear of saṃsāra, O lord of gods, / I have gone to you for refuge, O Kṛṣṇa; rescue me from the ocean of worldly existence!

sanskrit_iast:
gantum icchāmi paramaṃ padaṃ yat te sanātanam
prasādāt tava deveśa punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
गन्तुम् इच्छामि परमं पदं यत् ते सनातनम्
प्रसादात् तव देवेश पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: I wish to go to that supreme, eternal abode of yours, / from which return is hard to occur, by your grace, O lord of gods!”

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavān uvāca
bhakto 'si me muniśreṣṭha mām ārādhaya nityaśaḥ
matprasādād dhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpyasi tvaṃ samīhitam //
meaning:
श्रीभगवान् उवाच
भक्तो ऽसि मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ माम् आराधय नित्यशः
मत्प्रसादाद् ध्रुवं मोक्षं प्राप्यसि त्वं समीहितम् //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / “You are my devotee, best of sages; worship me constantly. / By my grace you will surely attain the desired liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
madbhaktāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātijāḥ
prāpnuvanti parāṃ siddhiṃ kiṃ punas tvaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
मद्भक्ताः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्रान्त्यजातिजाः
प्राप्नुवन्ति परां सिद्धिं किं पुनस् त्वं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: Devoted to me, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, śūdras, and those born of the lowest castes / attain supreme perfection—how much more so you, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
śvapāko 'pi ca madbhaktaḥ samyak śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
prāpnoty abhimatāṃ siddhim anyeṣāṃ tatra kā kathā //
meaning:
श्वपाको ऽपि च मद्भक्तः सम्यक् श्रद्धासमन्वितः
प्राप्नोत्य् अभिमतां सिद्धिम् अन्येषां तत्र का कथा //
text_mt: Even a dog-cooker who is devoted to me and endowed with complete faith / attains the desired perfection; what need be said of others in this regard?”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evam uktvā tu taṃ viprāḥ sa devo bhaktavatsalaḥ
durvijñeyagatir viṣṇus tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा तु तं विप्राः स देवो भक्तवत्सलः
दुर्विज्ञेयगतिर् विष्णुस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having spoken thus to him, O brahmins, that god who is affectionate to his devotees, / Viṣṇu, whose path is hard to comprehend, disappeared right there.

sanskrit_iast:
gate tasmin muniśreṣṭhāḥ kaṇḍuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ
sarvān kāmān parityajya svasthacitto bhavat punaḥ //
meaning:
गते तस्मिन् मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कण्डुः संहृष्टमानसः
सर्वान् कामान् परित्यज्य स्वस्थचित्तो भवत् पुनः //
text_mt: When he had departed, O best of sages, Kaṇḍu, with an overjoyed mind, / cast aside all desires and became tranquil in mind once more.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvendriyāṇi saṃyamya nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtiḥ
ekāgramānasaḥ samyag dhyātvā taṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
सर्वेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य निर्ममो निरहंकृतिः
एकाग्रमानसः सम्यग् ध्यात्वा तं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Restraining all his sense organs, free from possessiveness, devoid of egotism, / with single-pointed mind, meditating properly upon that Puruṣottama

sanskrit_iast:
nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ sattāmātravyavasthitam
avāpa paramaṃ mokṣaṃ surāṇām api durlabham //
meaning:
निर्लेपं निर्गुणं शान्तं सत्तामात्रव्यवस्थितम्
अवाप परमं मोक्षं सुराणाम् अपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: who is taintless, devoid of guṇas, tranquil, abiding purely in pure existence, / he attained supreme liberation, difficult even for the gods to achieve.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi kathāṃ kaṇḍor mahātmanaḥ
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
यः पठेच् छृणुयाद् वापि कथां कण्डोर् महात्मनः
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever reads or hears the story of the great-souled Kaṇḍu, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ karmabhūmir udāhṛtā
mokṣakṣetraṃ ca paramaṃ devaṃ ca puruṣottamam //
meaning:
एवं मया मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कर्मभूमिर् उदाहृता
मोक्षक्षेत्रं च परमं देवं च पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Thus, O best of sages, has been described by me the land of ritual action, / the supreme field of liberation, and the god Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
ye paśyanti vibhuṃ stuvanti varadaṃ dhyāyanti muktipradaṃ
bhaktyā śrīpuruṣottamākhyam ajaraṃ saṃsāraduḥkhāpaham //
meaning:
ये पश्यन्ति विभुं स्तुवन्ति वरदं ध्यायन्ति मुक्तिप्रदं
भक्त्या श्रीपुरुषोत्तमाख्यम् अजरं संसारदुःखापहम् //
text_mt: Those who behold, praise, and meditate with devotion upon the all-pervading, boon-granting, / liberation-giving one named glorious Puruṣottama, ageless, who removes the suffering of saṃsāra:

sanskrit_iast:
te bhuktvā manujendrabhogam amalāḥ svarge ca divyaṃ sukhaṃ
paścād yānti samastadoṣarahitāḥ sthānaṃ harer avyayam //
meaning:
ते भुक्त्वा मनुजेन्द्रभोगम् अमलाः स्वर्गे च दिव्यं सुखं
पश्चाद् यान्ति समस्तदोषरहिताः स्थानं हरेर् अव्ययम् //
text_mt: Having enjoyed the pleasures of monarchs and spotless divine bliss in heaven, / they, freed from all faults, afterwards go to the imperishable abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
lomaharṣaṇa uvāca
vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā munayaḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ
prītā babhūvuḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vismitāś ca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
लोमहर्षण उवाच
व्यासस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनयः संयतेन्द्रियाः
प्रीता बभूवुः संहृष्टा विस्मिताश् च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Lomaharṣaṇa said: / Having heard the word of Vyāsa, the sages of restrained senses / were pleased, delighted, and repeatedly filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
aho bhāratavarṣasya tvayā saṃkīrtitā guṇāḥ
tadvac chrīpuruṣākhyasya kṣetrasya puruṣottama //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
अहो भारतवर्षस्य त्वया संकीर्तिता गुणाः
तद्वच् छ्रीपुरुषाख्यस्य क्षेत्रस्य पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: The sages said: / Ah, you have proclaimed the virtues of Bhāratavarṣa, / and likewise, O Puruṣottama, of the sacred site named Śrīpuruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vismayo hi na caikasya śrutvā māhātmyam uttamam
puruṣākhyasya kṣetrasya prītiś ca vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
विस्मयो हि न चैकस्य श्रुत्वा माहात्म्यम् उत्तमम्
पुरुषाख्यस्य क्षेत्रस्य प्रीतिश् च वदतां वर //
text_mt: For not merely of one was the wonder upon hearing the supreme majesty / of the sacred site named Puruṣa, and the delight, O best of speakers!

sanskrit_iast:
cirāt prabhṛti cāsmākaṃ saṃśayo hṛdi vartate
tvadṛte saṃśayasyāsya cchettā nānyo 'sti bhūtale //
meaning:
चिरात् प्रभृति चास्माकं संशयो हृदि वर्तते
त्वदृते संशयस्यास्य च्छेत्ता नान्यो ऽस्ति भूतले //
text_mt: And for a long time a doubt has dwelt in our hearts; / on earth there is no other dispeller of this doubt except you.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattiṃ baladevasya kṛṣṇasya ca mahītale
bhadrāyāś caiva kārtsnyena pṛcchāmas tvāṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
उत्पत्तिं बलदेवस्य कृष्णस्य च महीतले
भद्रायाश् चैव कार्त्स्न्येन पृच्छामस् त्वां महामुने //
text_mt: We ask you in full, O great sage, / about the birth of Baladeva and Kṛṣṇa, and of Bhadrā, upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ tau samutpannau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāv ubhau
vasudevasutau vīrau sthitau nandagṛhe mune //
meaning:
किमर्थं तौ समुत्पन्नौ कृष्णसंकर्षणाव् उभौ
वसुदेवसुतौ वीरौ स्थितौ नन्दगृहे मुने //
text_mt: For what purpose were both Kṛṣṇa and Saṃkarṣaṇa born, / the two heroic sons of Vasudeva, and dwelt in Nanda's house, O sage?

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsāre mṛtyuloke 'smin duḥkhaprāye 'ticañcale
jalabudbudasaṃkāśe bhairave lomaharṣaṇe //
meaning:
निःसारे मृत्युलोके ऽस्मिन् दुःखप्राये ऽतिचञ्चले
जलबुद्बुदसंकाशे भैरवे लोमहर्षणे //
text_mt: In this mortal world, devoid of essence, full of suffering, extremely fickle, / resembling a water bubble, terrible, hair-raising—

sanskrit_iast:
viṇmūtrapicchalaṃ kaṣṭaṃ saṃkaṭaṃ duḥkhadāyakam
kathaṃ ghorataraṃ teṣāṃ garbhavāsam arocata //
meaning:
विण्मूत्रपिच्छलं कष्टं संकटं दुःखदायकम्
कथं घोरतरं तेषां गर्भवासम् अरोचत //
text_mt: slippery with feces and urine, painful, cramped, causing suffering— / how did that most dreadful dwelling in the womb please them?

sanskrit_iast:
yāni karmāṇi cakrus te samutpannā mahītale
vistareṇa mune tāni brūhi no vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
