text_mt: Kāliya was subdued in the water, Pralamba was struck down, / and this Govardhana was held aloft; our minds are filled with doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ hareḥ pādau śrayāmo 'mitavikrama
yathā tvadvīryam ālokya na tvāṃ manyāmahe naram //
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं हरेः पादौ श्रयामो ऽमितविक्रम
यथा त्वद्वीर्यम् आलोक्य न त्वां मन्यामहे नरम् //
text_mt: In truth, in truth, we take refuge at Hari's feet, O you of boundless prowess: / observing your might, we do not consider you a human being.

sanskrit_iast:
devo vā dānavo vā tvaṃ yakṣo gandharva eva vā
kiṃ cāsmākaṃ vicāreṇa bāndhavo 'sti namo 'stu te //
meaning:
देवो वा दानवो वा त्वं यक्षो गन्धर्व एव वा
किं चास्माकं विचारेण बान्धवो ऽस्ति नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: Whether you are a god, a Dānava, a Yakṣa, or indeed a Gandharva, / what need have we for deliberation? You are our kinsman; homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
prītiḥ sastrīkumārasya vrajasya tava keśava
karma cedam aśakyaṃ yat samastais tridaśair api //
meaning:
प्रीतिः सस्त्रीकुमारस्य व्रजस्य तव केशव
कर्म चेदम् अशक्यं यत् समस्तैस् त्रिदशैर् अपि //
text_mt: The love of Vraja, together with its women and children, is yours, O Keśava; / and yet this deed of yours is impossible even for all the thirty [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
bālatvaṃ cātivīryaṃ ca janma cāsmāsv aśobhanam
cintyamānam ameyātmañ śaṅkāṃ kṛṣṇa prayacchati //
meaning:
बालत्वं चातिवीर्यं च जन्म चास्मास्व् अशोभनम्
चिन्त्यमानम् अमेयात्मञ् शङ्कां कृष्ण प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Your childhood, your extraordinary prowess, and your humble birth among us, / when pondered, O unmeasurable self, give rise to doubt, O Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā tv asau tūṣṇīṃ kiṃcit praṇayakopavān
ity evam uktas tair gopair āha kṛṣṇo dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
क्षणं भूत्वा त्व् असौ तूष्णीं किंचित् प्रणयकोपवान्
इत्य् एवम् उक्तस् तैर् गोपैर् आह कृष्णो द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Remaining silent for a moment, slightly provoked by an affectionate anger, / Kṛṣṇa, having been spoken to in this manner by those cowherds, said, O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
matsaṃbandhena vo gopā yadi lajjā na jāyate
ślāghyo vāhaṃ tataḥ kiṃ vo vicāreṇa prayojanam //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
मत्संबन्धेन वो गोपा यदि लज्जा न जायते
श्लाघ्यो वाहं ततः किं वो विचारेण प्रयोजनम् //
text_mt: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O cowherds, if no shame arises for you from your relationship with me, / or if I am praiseworthy, then what purpose do you have with such deliberation?

sanskrit_iast:
yadi vo 'sti mayi prītiḥ ślāghyo 'haṃ bhavatāṃ yadi
tad arghā bandhusadṛśī bāndhavāḥ kriyatāṃ mayi //
meaning:
यदि वो ऽस्ति मयि प्रीतिः श्लाघ्यो ऽहं भवतां यदि
तद् अर्घा बन्धुसदृशी बान्धवाः क्रियतां मयि //
text_mt: If you have affection for me, if I am praiseworthy in your eyes, / then let respect suitable for a kinsman be shown toward me, O kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ devo na gandharvo na yakṣo na ca dānavaḥ
ahaṃ vo bāndhavo jāto nātaś cintyam ato 'nyathā //
meaning:
नाहं देवो न गन्धर्वो न यक्षो न च दानवः
अहं वो बान्धवो जातो नातश् चिन्त्यम् अतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: I am not a god, nor a Gandharva, nor a Yakṣa, nor a Dānava; / I was born as your kinsman, and nothing other than this should be thought.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
iti śrutvā harer vākyaṃ baddhamaunās tato balam
yayur gopā mahābhāgās tasmin praṇayakopini //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा हरेर् वाक्यं बद्धमौनास् ततो बलम्
ययुर् गोपा महाभागास् तस्मिन् प्रणयकोपिनि //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Hearing Hari's words, keeping silence, the fortunate cowherds / then departed with their host, since he was provoked with affectionate anger.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇas tu vimalaṃ vyoma śaraccandrasya candrikām
tathā kumudinīṃ phullām āmoditadigantarām //
meaning:
कृष्णस् तु विमलं व्योम शरच्चन्द्रस्य चन्द्रिकाम्
तथा कुमुदिनीं फुल्लाम् आमोदितदिगन्तराम् //
text_mt: And Kṛṣṇa, observing the clear sky, the moonlight of the autumn moon, / and the blossoming night-lotuses that perfumed the horizons,

sanskrit_iast:
vanarājīṃ tathā kūjadbhṛṅgamālāmanoramām
vilokya saha gopībhir manaś cakre ratiṃ prati //
meaning:
वनराजीं तथा कूजद्भृङ्गमालामनोरमाम्
विलोक्य सह गोपीभिर् मनश् चक्रे रतिं प्रति //
text_mt: as well as the row of trees delightful with swarms of humming bees, / directed his mind toward love in the company of the cowherd women.

sanskrit_iast:
saha rāmeṇa madhuram atīva vanitāpriyam
jagau kamalapādo 'sau nāma tatra kṛtavrataḥ //
meaning:
सह रामेण मधुरम् अतीव वनिताप्रियम्
जगौ कमलपादो ऽसौ नाम तत्र कृतव्रतः //
text_mt: Together with Rāma, that lotus-footed one, observing his vow, / sang sweetly there a song exceedingly pleasing to women.

sanskrit_iast:
ramyaṃ gītadhvaniṃ śrutvā saṃtyajyāvasathāṃs tadā
ājagmus tvaritā gopyo yatrāste madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
रम्यं गीतध्वनिं श्रुत्वा संत्यज्यावसथांस् तदा
आजग्मुस् त्वरिता गोप्यो यत्रास्ते मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Hearing the delightful sound of the singing, the cowherd women / then left their homes and came in haste to where Madhusūdana was.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiḥ śanair jagau gopī kācit tasya padānugā
dattāvadhānā kācic ca tam eva manasāsmarat //
meaning:
शनैः शनैर् जगौ गोपी काचित् तस्य पदानुगा
दत्तावधाना काचिच् च तम् एव मनसास्मरत् //
text_mt: One cowherd woman sang very softly, following his steps; / another, having given her full attention, remembered him alone in her mind.

sanskrit_iast:
kācit kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti coktvā lajjām upāyayau
yayau ca kācit premāndhā tatpārśvam avilajjitā //
meaning:
काचित् कृष्णेति कृष्णेति चोक्त्वा लज्जाम् उपाययौ
ययौ च काचित् प्रेमान्धा तत्पार्श्वम् अविलज्जिता //
text_mt: One called out, 'Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!' and was overcome with bashfulness; / and another, blinded by love, approached his side unashamed.

sanskrit_iast:
kācid āvasathasyāntaḥ sthitvā dṛṣṭvā bahir gurum
tanmayatvena govindaṃ dadhyau mīlitalocanā //
meaning:
काचिद् आवसथस्यान्तः स्थित्वा दृष्ट्वा बहिर् गुरुम्
तन्मयत्वेन गोविन्दं दध्यौ मीलितलोचना //
text_mt: One, staying inside her dwelling, having seen her elder outside, / absorbed in him, meditated on Govinda with closed eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
gopīparivṛto rātriṃ śaraccandramanoramām
mānayām āsa govindo rāsārambharasotsukaḥ //
meaning:
गोपीपरिवृतो रात्रिं शरच्चन्द्रमनोरमाम्
मानयाम् आस गोविन्दो रासारम्भरसोत्सुकः //
text_mt: Surrounded by the cowherd women, Govinda, eager for the delight of beginning the rāsa dance, / passed the night, which was enchanting with the autumn moon.

sanskrit_iast:
gopyaś ca vṛndaśaḥ kṛṣṇaceṣṭābhyāyattamūrtayaḥ
anyadeśagate kṛṣṇe cerur vṛndāvanāntaram //
meaning:
गोप्यश् च वृन्दशः कृष्णचेष्टाभ्यायत्तमूर्तयः
अन्यदेशगते कृष्णे चेरुर् वृन्दावनान्तरम् //
text_mt: And the cowherd women, in groups, their bodies absorbed in imitating Kṛṣṇa's actions, / when Kṛṣṇa had gone to another place, wandered within Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
babhramus tās tato gopyaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ
kṛṣṇasya caraṇaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvane dvijāḥ //
meaning:
बभ्रमुस् तास् ततो गोप्यः कृष्णदर्शनलालसाः
कृष्णस्य चरणं रात्रौ दृष्ट्वा वृन्दावने द्विजाः //
text_mt: Then those cowherd women wandered about, longing for the sight of Kṛṣṇa, / having seen Kṛṣṇa’s footprint at night in Vṛndāvana, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nānāprakārāsu kṛṣṇaceṣṭāsu tāsu ca
gopyo vyagrāḥ samaṃ cerū ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam //
meaning:
एवं नानाप्रकारासु कृष्णचेष्टासु तासु च
गोप्यो व्यग्राः समं चेरू रम्यं वृन्दावनं वनम् //
text_mt: Thus, absorbed in those various actions of Kṛṣṇa, / the cowherd women roamed together through the charming forest of Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttās tās tato gopyo nirāśāḥ kṛṣṇadarśane
yamunātīram āgamya jagus taccaritaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
निवृत्तास् तास् ततो गोप्यो निराशाः कृष्णदर्शने
यमुनातीरम् आगम्य जगुस् तच्चरितं द्विजाः //
text_mt: Then those cowherd women turned back, hopeless of seeing Kṛṣṇa; / having reached the bank of the Yamunā, O twice-born ones, they sang of his deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dadṛśur āyāntaṃ vikāśimukhapaṅkajam
gopyas trailokyagoptāraṃ kṛṣṇam akliṣṭakāriṇam //
meaning:
ततो ददृशुर् आयान्तं विकाशिमुखपङ्कजम्
गोप्यस् त्रैलोक्यगोप्तारं कृष्णम् अक्लिष्टकारिणम् //
text_mt: Then the cowherd women saw Kṛṣṇa coming, his lotus face blossoming, / the protector of the three worlds, who acts without effort.

sanskrit_iast:
kācid ālokya govindam āyāntam atiharṣitā
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti prāhotphullavilocanā //
meaning:
काचिद् आलोक्य गोविन्दम् आयान्तम् अतिहर्षिता
कृष्ण कृष्णेति कृष्णेति प्राहोत्फुल्लविलोचना //
text_mt: One woman, seeing Govinda approach, filled with immense joy, / with wide-open eyes, cried out, “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!”

sanskrit_iast:
kācid bhrūbhaṅguraṃ kṛtvā lalāṭaphalakaṃ harim
vilokya netrabhṛṅgābhyāṃ papau tanmukhapaṅkajam //
meaning:
काचिद् भ्रूभङ्गुरं कृत्वा ललाटफलकं हरिम्
विलोक्य नेत्रभृङ्गाभ्यां पपौ तन्मुखपङ्कजम् //
text_mt: Another, knitting her brow on the surface of her forehead, gazed upon Hari / and drank in his lotus face with the bees of her eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
kācid ālokya govindaṃ nimīlitavilocanā
tasyaiva rūpaṃ dhyāyantī yogārūḍheva sā babhau //
meaning:
काचिद् आलोक्य गोविन्दं निमीलितविलोचना
तस्यैव रूपं ध्यायन्ती योगारूढेव सा बभौ //
text_mt: Another woman, upon seeing Govinda, closed her eyes / and, meditating upon his form alone, appeared as if she had attained yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāṃcit priyālāpaiḥ kāṃcid bhrūbhaṅgavīkṣitaiḥ
ninye 'nunayam anyāś ca karasparśena mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
ततः कांचित् प्रियालापैः कांचिद् भ्रूभङ्गवीक्षितैः
निन्ये ऽनुनयम् अन्याश् च करस्पर्शेन माधवः //
text_mt: Then Mādhava conciliated one woman with loving words, another with glances from knitted brows, / and others with the touch of his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiḥ prasannacittābhir gopībhiḥ saha sādaram
rarāma rāsagoṣṭhībhir udāracarito hariḥ //
meaning:
ताभिः प्रसन्नचित्ताभिर् गोपीभिः सह सादरम्
रराम रासगोष्ठीभिर् उदारचरितो हरिः //
text_mt: Together with those pleased cowherd women, Hari of noble deeds / sportively engaged respectfully in the circle of the rāsa dance.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsamaṇḍalabaddho 'pi kṛṣṇapārśvam anūdgatā
gopījano na caivābhūd ekasthānasthirātmanā //
meaning:
रासमण्डलबद्धो ऽपि कृष्णपार्श्वम् अनूद्गता
गोपीजनो न चैवाभूद् एकस्थानस्थिरात्मना //
text_mt: Though formed into the circle of the rāsa dance, each cowherd woman followed closely by Kṛṣṇa’s side; / not one remained stationary in a single place.

sanskrit_iast:
haste pragṛhya caikaikāṃ gopikāṃ rāsamaṇḍalam
cakāra ca karasparśanimīlitadṛśaṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
हस्ते प्रगृह्य चैकैकां गोपिकां रासमण्डलम्
चकार च करस्पर्शनिमीलितदृशं हरिः //
text_mt: And taking each cowherd woman by the hand, Hari formed the rāsa circle, / while their eyes closed at the touch of his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravavṛte ramyā caladvalayanisvanaiḥ
anuyātaśaratkāvyageyagītir anukramām //
meaning:
ततः प्रववृते रम्या चलद्वलयनिस्वनैः
अनुयातशरत्काव्यगेयगीतिर् अनुक्रमाम् //
text_mt: Then commenced a delightful, orderly singing accompanied by autumn poems, / resounded by the jingling of moving bracelets.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaḥ śaraccandramasaṃ kaumudīkumudākaram
jagau gopījanas tv ekaṃ kṛṣṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णः शरच्चन्द्रमसं कौमुदीकुमुदाकरम्
जगौ गोपीजनस् त्व् एकं कृष्णनाम पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa sang of the autumn moon and its mass of lotus-blooming light; / but the cowherd women sang repeatedly only the name of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
parivṛttā śrameṇaikā caladvalayatāpinī
dadau bāhulatāṃ skandhe gopī madhuvighātinaḥ //
meaning:
परिवृत्ता श्रमेणैका चलद्वलयतापिनी
ददौ बाहुलतां स्कन्धे गोपी मधुविघातिनः //
text_mt: One cowherd woman, turning round in weariness, distressed by her jingling bracelets, / placed her creeper-like arm upon the shoulder of the slayer of Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
kācit pravilasadbāhuḥ parirabhya cucumba tam
gopī gītastutivyājanipuṇā madhusūdanam //
meaning:
काचित् प्रविलसद्बाहुः परिरभ्य चुचुम्ब तम्
गोपी गीतस्तुतिव्याजनिपुणा मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: Another cowherd woman, her arms gracefully shining, skilled in the art of song and praise, / embraced and kissed the slayer of Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
gopīkapolasaṃśleṣam abhipadya harer bhujau
pulakodgamaśasyāya svedāmbughanatāṃ gatau //
meaning:
गोपीकपोलसंश्लेषम् अभिपद्य हरेर् भुजौ
पुलकोद्गमशस्याय स्वेदाम्बुघनतां गतौ //
text_mt: Coming into close embrace with the cowherd women's cheeks, Hari’s arms / became dense with drops of sweat that watered the harvest of bristling hairs.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsageyaṃ jagau kṛṣṇo yāvat tārataradhvaniḥ
sādhu kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti tāvat tā dviguṇaṃ jaguḥ //
meaning:
रासगेयं जगौ कृष्णो यावत् तारतरध्वनिः
साधु कृष्णेति कृष्णेति तावत् ता द्विगुणं जगुः //
text_mt: As loudly and clearly as Kṛṣṇa sang the rāsa song, / so with double the intensity they sang: “Well done, Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!”

sanskrit_iast:
gate 'nugamanaṃ cakrur valane saṃmukhaṃ yayuḥ
pratilomānulomena bhejur gopāṅganā harim //
meaning:
गते ऽनुगमनं चक्रुर् वलने संमुखं ययुः
प्रतिलोमानुलोमेन भेजुर् गोपाङ्गना हरिम् //
text_mt: When he moved away, they followed; when he turned back, they came face to face; / the cowherd women attended upon Hari in backward and forward movements.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadā saha gopībhī rarāma madhusūdanaḥ
sa varṣakoṭipratimaḥ kṣaṇas tena vinābhavat //
meaning:
स तदा सह गोपीभी रराम मधुसूदनः
स वर्षकोटिप्रतिमः क्षणस् तेन विनाभवत् //
text_mt: Then the slayer of Madhu sported with the cowherd women; / without him, a single moment seemed like a myriad of years.

sanskrit_iast:
tā vāryamāṇāḥ pitṛbhiḥ patibhir bhrātṛbhis tathā
kṛṣṇaṃ gopāṅganā rātrau ramayanti ratipriyāḥ //
meaning:
ता वार्यमाणाः पितृभिः पतिभिर् भ्रातृभिस् तथा
कृष्णं गोपाङ्गना रात्रौ रमयन्ति रतिप्रियाः //
text_mt: Though restrained by their fathers, husbands, and brothers, / the cowherd women, who loved delight, found their joy with Kṛṣṇa at night.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi kaiśorakavayā mānayan madhusūdanaḥ
reme tābhir ameyātmā kṣapāsu kṣapitāhitaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि कैशोरकवया मानयन् मधुसूदनः
रेमे ताभिर् अमेयात्मा क्षपासु क्षपिताहितः //
text_mt: He too, of adolescent age, honoring them, the slayer of Madhu, / of immeasurable self, who destroys his enemies, sported with them through the nights.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhartṛṣu tathā tāsu sarvabhūteṣu ceśvaraḥ
ātmasvarūparūpo 'sau vyāpya sarvam avasthitaḥ //
meaning:
तद्भर्तृषु तथा तासु सर्वभूतेषु चेश्वरः
आत्मस्वरूपरूपो ऽसौ व्याप्य सर्वम् अवस्थितः //
text_mt: In their husbands, in them, and in all living beings, the Lord, / having the form of his own essential nature, dwells pervading all.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā samastabhūteṣu nabho 'gniḥ pṛthivī jalam
vāyuś cātmā tathaivāsau vyāpya sarvam avasthitaḥ //
meaning:
यथा समस्तभूतेषु नभो ऽग्निः पृथिवी जलम्
वायुश् चात्मा तथैवासौ व्याप्य सर्वम् अवस्थितः //
text_mt: Just as space, fire, earth, water, and air / dwell pervading all beings, so too does he abide as the Self, pervading all.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
pradoṣārdhe kadācit tu rāsāsakte janārdane
trāsayan samado goṣṭhān ariṣṭaḥ samupāgataḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
प्रदोषार्धे कदाचित् तु रासासक्ते जनार्दने
त्रासयन् समदो गोष्ठान् अरिष्टः समुपागतः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Once, in the middle of the evening, while Janārdana was engaged in the rāsa, / Ariṣṭa arrived, frantic with rut, terrifying the cowpens.

sanskrit_iast:
satoyatoyadākāras tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo 'rkalocanaḥ
khurāgrapātair atyarthaṃ dārayan dharaṇītalam //
meaning:
सतोयतोयदाकारस् तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो ऽर्कलोचनः
खुराग्रपातैर् अत्यर्थं दारयन् धरणीतलम् //
text_mt: Resembling a water-laden raincloud, sharp-horned, with eyes like the sun, / deeply tearing up the surface of the earth with the strikes of his hoof-tips,

sanskrit_iast:
lelihānaḥ saniṣpeṣaṃ jihvayauṣṭhau punaḥ punaḥ
saṃrambhākṣiptalāṅgūlaḥ kaṭhinaskandhabandhanaḥ //
meaning:
लेलिहानः सनिष्पेषं जिह्वयौष्ठौ पुनः पुनः
संरम्भाक्षिप्तलाङ्गूलः कठिनस्कन्धबन्धनः //
text_mt: repeatedly licking both lips with his tongue with a grinding sound, / his tail tossed about in fury, his neck firm and stout,

sanskrit_iast:
udagrakakudābhogaḥ pramāṇād duratikramaḥ
viṇmūtrāliptapṛṣṭhāṅgo gavām udvegakārakaḥ //
meaning:
उदग्रककुदाभोगः प्रमाणाद् दुरतिक्रमः
विण्मूत्रालिप्तपृष्ठाङ्गो गवाम् उद्वेगकारकः //
text_mt: with a lofty, expansive hump, insurmountable in size, / his flanks and back smeared with dung and urine, causing terror to the cattle,

sanskrit_iast:
pralambakaṇṭho 'bhimukhas tarughātāṅkitānanaḥ
pātayan sa gavāṃ garbhān daityo vṛṣabharūpadhṛk //
meaning:
प्रलम्बकण्ठो ऽभिमुखस् तरुघाताङ्किताननः
पातयन् स गवां गर्भान् दैत्यो वृषभरूपधृक् //
text_mt: with a dangling dewlap, facing forward, his face marked by collisions with trees, / causing the cattle to miscarry their calves—that daitya assumed the form of a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
sūdayaṃs tarasā sarvān vanāny aṭati yaḥ sadā
tatas tam atighorākṣam avekṣyātibhayāturāḥ //
meaning:
सूदयंस् तरसा सर्वान् वनान्य् अटति यः सदा
ततस् तम् अतिघोराक्षम् अवेक्ष्यातिभयातुराः //
text_mt: Quickly destroying everything, he always roamed the forests. / Then, seeing him with his exceedingly terrible eyes, being overcome with great fear,

sanskrit_iast:
gopā gopastriyaś caiva kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cukruśuḥ
siṃhanādaṃ tataś cakre talaśabdaṃ ca keśavaḥ //
meaning:
गोपा गोपस्त्रियश् चैव कृष्ण कृष्णेति चुक्रुशुः
सिंहनादं ततश् चक्रे तलशब्दं च केशवः //
text_mt: the cowherds and the cowherd women cried out: “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!” / Thereupon Keśava let out a lion-like roar and slapped his palms together.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchabdaśravaṇāc cāsau dāmodaramukhaṃ yayau
agranyastaviṣāṇāgraḥ kṛṣṇakukṣikṛtekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छब्दश्रवणाच् चासौ दामोदरमुखं ययौ
अग्रन्यस्तविषाणाग्रः कृष्णकुक्षिकृतेक्षणः //
text_mt: And hearing that sound, he charged straight at Dāmodara, / pointing the tips of his horns forward, fixing his gaze on Kṛṣṇa’s belly.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyadhāvata duṣṭātmā daityo vṛṣabharūpadhṛk
āyāntaṃ daityavṛṣabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo mahābalam //
meaning:
अभ्यधावत दुष्टात्मा दैत्यो वृषभरूपधृक्
आयान्तं दैत्यवृषभं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णो महाबलम् //
text_mt: The evil-minded daitya, bearing the form of a bull, rushed forward. / Seeing the bull-daitya of immense strength approaching,

sanskrit_iast:
na cacāla tataḥ sthānād avajñāsmitalīlayā
āsannaṃ caiva jagrāha grāhavan madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
न चचाल ततः स्थानाद् अवज्ञास्मितलीलया
आसन्नं चैव जग्राह ग्राहवन् मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa did not stir from his place, displaying a scornful smile; / and as he drew near, the slayer of Madhu seized him like an alligator.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna jānunā kukṣau viṣāṇagrahaṇācalam
tasya darpabalaṃ hatvā gṛhītasya viṣāṇayoḥ //
meaning:
जघान जानुना कुक्षौ विषाणग्रहणाचलम्
तस्य दर्पबलं हत्वा गृहीतस्य विषाणयोः //
text_mt: He struck him in the flank with his knee, holding him immobile by grabbing his horns; / having broken the strength of his pride as he held him by the horns,

sanskrit_iast:
āpīḍayad ariṣṭasya kaṇṭhaṃ klinnam ivāmbaram
utpāṭya śṛṅgam ekaṃ ca tenaivātāḍayat tataḥ //
meaning:
आपीडयद् अरिष्टस्य कण्ठं क्लिन्नम् इवाम्बरम्
उत्पाट्य शृङ्गम् एकं च तेनैवाताडयत् ततः //
text_mt: he wrung Ariṣṭa’s throat like a wet cloth; / and tearing out one of his horns, he beat him with it.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāra sa mahādaityo mukhāc choṇitam udvaman
tuṣṭuvur nihate tasmin gopā daitye janārdanam
jambhe hate sahasrākṣaṃ purā devagaṇā yathā //
meaning:
ममार स महादैत्यो मुखाच् छोणितम् उद्वमन्
तुष्टुवुर् निहते तस्मिन् गोपा दैत्ये जनार्दनम्
जम्भे हते सहस्राक्षं पुरा देवगणा यथा //
text_mt: Vomiting blood from his mouth, that great daitya died. / When that daitya was killed, the cowherds praised Janārdana, / just as the hosts of gods had once praised the thousand-eyed Indra when Jambha was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
kakudmini hate 'riṣṭe dhenuke ca nipātite
pralambe nidhanaṃ nīte dhṛte govardhanācale //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ककुद्मिनि हते ऽरिष्टे धेनुके च निपातिते
प्रलम्बे निधनं नीते धृते गोवर्धनाचले //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / When the humped bull Ariṣṭa was killed, and Dhenuka was struck down, / when Pralamba was brought to death, and Mount Govardhana was held up,

sanskrit_iast:
damite kāliye nāge bhagne tuṅgadrumadvaye
hatāyāṃ pūtanāyāṃ ca śakaṭe parivartite //
meaning:
दमिते कालिये नागे भग्ने तुङ्गद्रुमद्वये
हतायां पूतनायां च शकटे परिवर्तिते //
text_mt: when the serpent Kāliya was subdued, and the two tall trees were broken, / when Pūtanā was slain, and the cart was overturned,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsāya nāradaḥ prāha yathāvṛttam anukramāt
yaśodādevakīgarbhaparivartādy aśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
कंसाय नारदः प्राह यथावृत्तम् अनुक्रमात्
यशोदादेवकीगर्भपरिवर्ताद्य् अशेषतः //
text_mt: Nārada recounted to Kaṃsa everything that had happened, in order, / completely, beginning with the exchange of Yaśodā’s and Devakī’s embryos.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tat sakalaṃ kaṃso nāradād devadarśanāt
vasudevaṃ prati tadā kopaṃ cakre sa durmatiḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तत् सकलं कंसो नारदाद् देवदर्शनात्
वसुदेवं प्रति तदा कोपं चक्रे स दुर्मतिः //
text_mt: Hearing all that from Nārada, who had a divine vision, / the evil-minded Kaṃsa was then enraged against Vasudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'tikopād upālabhya sarvayādavasaṃsadi
jagarhe yādavāṃś cāpi kāryaṃ caitad acintayat //
meaning:
सो ऽतिकोपाद् उपालभ्य सर्वयादवसंसदि
जगर्हे यादवांश् चापि कार्यं चैतद् अचिन्तयत् //
text_mt: In extreme anger, he censured him in the assembly of all the Yādavas / and also reproached the Yādavas; and he reflected on this course of action:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvan na balam ārūḍhau balakṛṣṇau subālakau
tāvad eva mayā vadhyāv asādhyau rūḍhayauvanau //
meaning:
यावन् न बलम् आरूढौ बलकृष्णौ सुबालकौ
तावद् एव मया वध्याव् असाध्यौ रूढयौवनौ //
text_mt: “Before Bala and Kṛṣṇa, who are merely young boys, attain their full strength, / they must be killed by me; when their youth is fully developed, they will be unconquerable.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇūro 'tra mahāvīryo muṣṭikaś ca mahābalaḥ
etābhyāṃ mallayuddhe tau ghātayiṣyāmi durmadau //
meaning:
चाणूरो ऽत्र महावीर्यो मुष्टिकश् च महाबलः
एताभ्यां मल्लयुद्धे तौ घातयिष्यामि दुर्मदौ //
text_mt: Here Cāṇūra is of great prowess, and Muṣṭika is of great strength; / through these two I shall have those two arrogant ones killed in a wrestling match.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurmahamahāyāgavyājenānīya tau vrajāt
tathā tathā kariṣyāmi yāsyataḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yathā //
meaning:
धनुर्महमहायागव्याजेनानीय तौ व्रजात्
तथा तथा करिष्यामि यास्यतः संक्षयं यथा //
text_mt: Bringing them from Vraja under the pretext of the great bow-sacrifice, / I shall act in such a way that both of them will perish.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity ālocya sa duṣṭātmā kaṃso rāmajanārdanau
hantuṃ kṛtamatir vīram akrūraṃ vākyam abravīt //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् आलोच्य स दुष्टात्मा कंसो रामजनार्दनौ
हन्तुं कृतमतिर् वीरम् अक्रूरं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having thus resolved, the evil-minded Kaṃsa, determined to kill / Rāma and Janārdana, addressed words to the heroic Akrūra:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsa uvāca
bho bho dānapate vākyaṃ kriyatāṃ prītaye mama
itaḥ syandanam āruhya gamyatāṃ nandagokulam //
meaning:
कंस उवाच
भो भो दानपते वाक्यं क्रियतां प्रीतये मम
इतः स्यन्दनम् आरुह्य गम्यतां नन्दगोकुलम् //
text_mt: Kaṃsa said: / “O lord of charity, carry out my words for my satisfaction: / mounting a chariot from here, go to Nanda’s Gokula.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevasutau tatra viṣṇor aṃśasamudbhavau
nāśāya kila saṃbhūtau mama duṣṭau pravardhataḥ //
meaning:
वसुदेवसुतौ तत्र विष्णोर् अंशसमुद्भवौ
नाशाय किल संभूतौ मम दुष्टौ प्रवर्धतः //
text_mt: The two sons of Vasudeva, sprung from portions of Viṣṇu, / who were born indeed for my destruction, are growing up there, wicked as they are.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurmahamahāyāgaś caturdaśyāṃ bhaviṣyati
āneyau bhavatā tau tu mallayuddhāya tatra vai //
meaning:
धनुर्महमहायागश् चतुर्दश्यां भविष्यति
आनेयौ भवता तौ तु मल्लयुद्धाय तत्र वै //
text_mt: The great sacrifice of the bow festival will take place on the fourteenth day; / the two must indeed be brought there by you for a wrestling match.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇūramuṣṭikau mallau niyuddhakuśalau mama
tābhyāṃ sahānayor yuddhaṃ sarvaloko 'tra paśyatu //
meaning:
चाणूरमुष्टिकौ मल्लौ नियुद्धकुशलौ मम
ताभ्यां सहानयोर् युद्धं सर्वलोको ऽत्र पश्यतु //
text_mt: My two wrestlers, Cāṇūra and Muṣṭika, are skilled in close combat; / let everyone here watch the fight between those two and them.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgaḥ kuvalayāpīḍo mahāmātrapracoditaḥ
sa tau nihaṃsyate pāpau vasudevātmajau śiśū //
meaning:
नागः कुवलयापीडो महामात्रप्रचोदितः
स तौ निहंस्यते पापौ वसुदेवात्मजौ शिशू //
text_mt: The elephant Kuvalayāpīḍa, urged on by his mahout, / will kill those two wicked boys, the sons of Vasudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tau hatvā vasudevaṃ ca nandagopaṃ ca durmatim
haniṣye pitaraṃ caiva ugrasenaṃ ca durmatim //
meaning:
तौ हत्वा वसुदेवं च नन्दगोपं च दुर्मतिम्
हनिष्ये पितरं चैव उग्रसेनं च दुर्मतिम् //
text_mt: Having slain them, and Vasudeva, and evil-minded Nandagopa, / I will also slay my father, the evil-minded Ugrasena.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samastagopānāṃ godhanāny akhilāny aham
vittaṃ cāpahariṣyāmi duṣṭānāṃ madvadhaiṣiṇām //
meaning:
ततः समस्तगोपानां गोधनान्य् अखिलान्य् अहम्
वित्तं चापहरिष्यामि दुष्टानां मद्वधैषिणाम् //
text_mt: Then I will seize all the cattle-wealth / and the riches of all the wicked cowherds who desire my death.

sanskrit_iast:
tvām ṛte yādavāś ceme duṣṭā dānapate mama
eteṣāṃ ca vadhāyāhaṃ prayatiṣyāmy anukramāt //
meaning:
त्वाम् ऋते यादवाश् चेमे दुष्टा दानपते मम
एतेषां च वधायाहं प्रयतिष्याम्य् अनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: Except for you, O lord of gifts, these Yādavas are wicked towards me; / and I will strive to kill them in due succession.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niṣkaṇṭakaṃ sarvaṃ rājyam etad ayādavam
prasādhiṣye tvayā tasmān matprītyā vīra gamyatām //
meaning:
ततो निष्कण्टकं सर्वं राज्यम् एतद् अयादवम्
प्रसाधिष्ये त्वया तस्मान् मत्प्रीत्या वीर गम्यताम् //
text_mt: Then, free of obstacles, I will rule over this whole kingdom / cleared of Yādavas together with you; therefore, O hero, go for my pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ca māhiṣaṃ sarpir dadhi cāpy upahārya vai
gopāḥ samānayanty āśu tvayā vācyās tathā tathā //
meaning:
यथा च माहिषं सर्पिर् दधि चाप्य् उपहार्य वै
गोपाः समानयन्त्य् आशु त्वया वाच्यास् तथा तथा //
text_mt: And you must speak to the cowherds in such a way / that they quickly bring buffalo-butter and curds as an offering.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity ājñaptas tadākrūro mahābhāgavato dvijāḥ
prītimān abhavat kṛṣṇaṃ śvo drakṣyāmīti satvaraḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् आज्ञप्तस् तदाक्रूरो महाभागवतो द्विजाः
प्रीतिमान् अभवत् कृष्णं श्वो द्रक्ष्यामीति सत्वरः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Commanded thus, Akrūra, a great devotee of the Lord, O twice-born ones, / became joyful, [thinking,] 'I will see Kṛṣṇa tomorrow,' and acted with haste.

sanskrit_iast:
tathety uktvā tu rājānaṃ ratham āruhya satvaraḥ
niścakrāma tadā puryā mathurāyā madhupriyaḥ //
meaning:
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा तु राजानं रथम् आरुह्य सत्वरः
निश्चक्राम तदा पुर्या मथुराया मधुप्रियः //
text_mt: Having said 'So be it' to the king, he mounted his chariot in haste, / and then the friend of Madhu set forth from the city of Mathurā.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
keśī cāpi balodagraḥ kaṃsadūtaḥ pracoditaḥ
kṛṣṇasya nidhanākāṅkṣī vṛndāvanam upāgamat //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
केशी चापि बलोदग्रः कंसदूतः प्रचोदितः
कृष्णस्य निधनाकाङ्क्षी वृन्दावनम् उपागमत् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / And Keśin too, formidable in strength, urged on as Kaṃsa’s messenger / and desiring Kṛṣṇa’s destruction, came to Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
sa khurakṣatabhūpṛṣṭhaḥ saṭākṣepadhutāmbudaḥ
punar vikrāntacandrārkamārgo gopāntam āgamat //
meaning:
स खुरक्षतभूपृष्ठः सटाक्षेपधुताम्बुदः
पुनर् विक्रान्तचन्द्रार्कमार्गो गोपान्तम् आगमत् //
text_mt: He, tearing up the surface of the earth with his hooves, scattering the clouds with the shaking of his mane, / and traversing again the path of the moon and the sun, came among the cowherds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya hreṣitaśabdena gopālā daityavājinaḥ
gopyaś ca bhayasaṃvignā govindaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
तस्य ह्रेषितशब्देन गोपाला दैत्यवाजिनः
गोप्यश् च भयसंविग्ना गोविन्दं शरणं ययुः //
text_mt: At the sound of the neighing of that demon horse, the cowherds / and cowherdesses, agitated by fear, went to Govinda for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
trāhi trāhīti govindas teṣāṃ śrutvā tu tadvacaḥ
satoyajaladadhvānagambhīram idam uktavān //
meaning:
त्राहि त्राहीति गोविन्दस् तेषां श्रुत्वा तु तद्वचः
सतोयजलदध्वानगम्भीरम् इदम् उक्तवान् //
text_mt: Hearing their cry of 'Save us! Save us!', Govinda / spoke these words, deep as the rumbling of a raincloud:

sanskrit_iast:
govinda uvāca
alaṃ trāsena gopālāḥ keśinaḥ kiṃ bhayāturaiḥ
bhavadbhir gopajātīyair vīravīryaṃ vilopyate //
meaning:
गोविन्द उवाच
अलं त्रासेन गोपालाः केशिनः किं भयातुरैः
भवद्भिर् गोपजातीयैर् वीरवीर्यं विलोप्यते //
text_mt: Govinda said: / 'Enough with fear, O cowherds! Why is heroic valour obliterated / by you cowherds, afflicted with terror of Keśin?

sanskrit_iast:
kim anenālpasāreṇa hreṣitāropakāriṇā
daiteyabalavāhyena valgatā duṣṭavājinā //
meaning:
किम् अनेनाल्पसारेण ह्रेषितारोपकारिणा
दैतेयबलवाह्येन वल्गता दुष्टवाजिना //
text_mt: What is the use of this vile horse of little strength, / doing no service beyond neighing, galloping and carrying the force of the Daityas?

sanskrit_iast:
ehy ehi duṣṭa kṛṣṇo 'haṃ pūṣṇas tv iva pinākadhṛk
pātayiṣyāmi daśanān vadanād akhilāṃs tava //
meaning:
एह्य् एहि दुष्ट कृष्णो ऽहं पूष्णस् त्व् इव पिनाकधृक्
पातयिष्यामि दशनान् वदनाद् अखिलांस् तव //
text_mt: Come, come, wicked one! I am Kṛṣṇa; like the bow-bearing Śiva to Pūṣan, / I will knock out all the teeth from your mouth!'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktvā sa tu govindaḥ keśinaḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau
vivṛtāsyaś ca so 'py enaṃ daiteyaś ca upādravat //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा स तु गोविन्दः केशिनः संमुखं ययौ
विवृतास्यश् च सो ऽप्य् एनं दैतेयश् च उपाद्रवत् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having spoken thus, Govinda went towards Keśin, / and the Daitya, with his mouth wide open, rushed at him.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhum ābhoginaṃ kṛtvā mukhe tasya janārdanaḥ
praveśayām āsa tadā keśino duṣṭavājinaḥ //
meaning:
बाहुम् आभोगिनं कृत्वा मुखे तस्य जनार्दनः
प्रवेशयाम् आस तदा केशिनो दुष्टवाजिनः //
text_mt: Curving his arm, Janārdana / then thrust it into the mouth of that wicked horse Keśin.

sanskrit_iast:
keśino vadanaṃ tena viśatā kṛṣṇabāhunā
śātitā daśanās tasya sitābhrāvayavā iva //
meaning:
केशिनो वदनं तेन विशता कृष्णबाहुना
शातिता दशनास् तस्य सिताभ्रावयवा इव //
text_mt: As Kṛṣṇa’s arm entered the mouth of Keśin, / his teeth were knocked out by it, resembling pieces of a white cloud.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya vavṛdhe bāhuḥ keśidehagato dvijāḥ
vināśāya yathā vyādhir āptabhūtair upekṣitaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णस्य ववृधे बाहुः केशिदेहगतो द्विजाः
विनाशाय यथा व्याधिर् आप्तभूतैर् उपेक्षितः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa’s arm expanded inside Keśin’s body, O twice-born ones, / just as a disease neglected by trusted kin grows to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
vipāṭitauṣṭho bahulaṃ saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ vaman
sṛkkaṇī vivṛte cakre viśliṣṭe muktabandhane //
meaning:
विपाटितौष्ठो बहुलं सफेनं रुधिरं वमन्
सृक्कणी विवृते चक्रे विश्लिष्टे मुक्तबन्धने //
text_mt: With his lips torn apart, vomiting abundant frothy blood, / the horse opened his mouth wide as the corners tore away and the joints severed.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma dharaṇīṃ pādaiḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ samutsṛjan
svedārdragātraḥ śrāntaś ca niryatnaḥ so 'bhavat tataḥ //
meaning:
जगाम धरणीं पादैः शकृन्मूत्रं समुत्सृजन्
स्वेदार्द्रगात्रः श्रान्तश् च निर्यत्नः सो ऽभवत् ततः //
text_mt: He fell to the ground with his legs, discharging dung and urine; / with his limbs wet with sweat and exhausted, he then became lifeless.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāditāsyo mahāraudraḥ so 'suraḥ kṛṣṇabāhunā
nipapāta dvidhābhūto vaidyutena yathā drumaḥ //
meaning:
व्यादितास्यो महारौद्रः सो ऽसुरः कृष्णबाहुना
निपपात द्विधाभूतो वैद्युतेन यथा द्रुमः //
text_mt: With his mouth gaping wide, that terrible Asura, struck by Kṛṣṇa’s arm, / fell split into two, like a tree struck by lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipādapṛṣṭhapucchārdhaśravaṇaikākṣanāsike
keśinas te dvidhā bhūte śakale ca virejatuḥ //
meaning:
द्विपादपृष्ठपुच्छार्धश्रवणैकाक्षनासिके
केशिनस् ते द्विधा भूते शकले च विरेजतुः //
text_mt: Those two halves of Keśin shone, / each possessing two legs, half a back, half a tail, one ear, one eye, and one nostril.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tu keśinaṃ kṛṣṇo muditair gopakair vṛtaḥ
anāyastatanuḥ svastho hasaṃs tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
हत्वा तु केशिनं कृष्णो मुदितैर् गोपकैर् वृतः
अनायस्ततनुः स्वस्थो हसंस् तत्रैव संस्थितः //
text_mt: Having slain Keśin, Kṛṣṇa, surrounded by rejoicing cowherd boys, / stood right there, his body unwearied, at ease and smiling.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gopāś ca gopyaś ca hate keśini vismitāḥ
tuṣṭuvuḥ puṇḍarīkākṣam anurāgamanoramam //
meaning:
ततो गोपाश् च गोप्यश् च हते केशिनि विस्मिताः
तुष्टुवुः पुण्डरीकाक्षम् अनुरागमनोरमम् //
text_mt: Then, Keśin having been slain, the amazed cowherds and cowherdesses / praised the lotus-eyed one, captivating with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
āyayau tvarito vipro nārado jaladasthitaḥ
keśinaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣanirbharamānasaḥ //
meaning:
आययौ त्वरितो विप्रो नारदो जलदस्थितः
केशिनं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हर्षनिर्भरमानसः //
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa Nārada, standing in a cloud, quickly arrived; / seeing Keśin slain, his mind was filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sādhu sādhu jagannātha līlayaiva yad acyuta
nihato 'yaṃ tvayā keśī kleśadas tridivaukasām //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
साधु साधु जगन्नाथ लीलयैव यद् अच्युत
निहतो ऽयं त्वया केशी क्लेशदस् त्रिदिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'Well done, well done, O Lord of the world, that in mere sport, O Acyuta, / this Keśin, who caused distress to the dwellers of heaven, has been slain by you!

sanskrit_iast:
sukarmāṇy avatāre tu kṛtāni madhusūdana
yāni vai vismitaṃ cetas toṣam etena me gatam //
meaning:
सुकर्माण्य् अवतारे तु कृतानि मधुसूदन
यानि वै विस्मितं चेतस् तोषम् एतेन मे गतम् //
text_mt: The good deeds done in this incarnation, O slayer of Madhu, / have astonished my mind and brought satisfaction to it.

sanskrit_iast:
turagasyāsya śakro 'pi kṛṣṇa devāś ca bibhyati
dhutakesarajālasya hreṣato 'bhrāvalokinaḥ //
meaning:
तुरगस्यास्य शक्रो ऽपि कृष्ण देवाश् च बिभ्यति
धुतकेसरजालस्य ह्रेषतो ऽभ्रावलोकिनः //
text_mt: Even Śakra and the gods, O Kṛṣṇa, were afraid of this horse / who shook his mane, neighed, and looked up into the clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt tvayaiṣa duṣṭātmā hataḥ keśī janārdana
tasmāt keśavanāmnā tvaṃ loke geyo bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
यस्मात् त्वयैष दुष्टात्मा हतः केशी जनार्दन
तस्मात् केशवनाम्ना त्वं लोके गेयो भविष्यसि //
text_mt: Because this wicked Keśin has been slain by you, O Janārdana, / therefore you will be celebrated in the world by the name Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
svasty astu te gamiṣyāmi kaṃsayuddhe 'dhunā punaḥ
paraśvo 'haṃ sameṣyāmi tvayā keśiniṣūdana //
meaning:
स्वस्त्य् अस्तु ते गमिष्यामि कंसयुद्धे ऽधुना पुनः
परश्वो ऽहं समेष्यामि त्वया केशिनिषूदन //
text_mt: May it be well with you; I will go now, and in the fight with Kaṃsa, / the day after tomorrow, I will meet you again, O slayer of Keśin.

sanskrit_iast:
ugrasenasute kaṃse sānuge vinipātite
bhārāvatārakartā tvaṃ pṛthivyā dharaṇīdhara //
meaning:
उग्रसेनसुते कंसे सानुगे विनिपातिते
भारावतारकर्ता त्वं पृथिव्या धरणीधर //
text_mt: When Kaṃsa, the son of Ugrasena, has been struck down along with his followers, / you, O upholder of the earth, will remove the burden of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrānekaprakāreṇa yuddhāni pṛthivīkṣitām
draṣṭavyāni mayā yuṣmatpraṇītāni janārdana //
meaning:
तत्रानेकप्रकारेण युद्धानि पृथिवीक्षिताम्
द्रष्टव्यानि मया युष्मत्प्रणीतानि जनार्दन //
text_mt: There I must witness the battles of the earthly rulers in various ways, / brought about by you, O Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ yāsyāmi govinda devakāryaṃ mahat kṛtam
tvayā sabhājitaś cāhaṃ svasti te 'stu vrajāmy aham //
meaning:
सो ऽहं यास्यामि गोविन्द देवकार्यं महत् कृतम्
त्वया सभाजितश् चाहं स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु व्रजाम्य् अहम् //
text_mt: So I will go, O Govinda; a great work for the gods has been accomplished, / and I have been honoured by you; may it be well with you, I depart.'

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
nārade tu gate kṛṣṇaḥ saha gopair avismitaḥ
viveśa gokulaṃ gopīnetrapānaikabhājanam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
नारदे तु गते कृष्णः सह गोपैर् अविस्मितः
विवेश गोकुलं गोपीनेत्रपानैकभाजनम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / When Nārada had departed, Kṛṣṇa, unastonished, together with the cowherds, / entered the cow-settlement, the sole vessel for drinking in by the eyes of the cowherdesses.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
akrūro 'pi viniṣkramya syandanenāśugāminā
kṛṣṇasaṃdarśanāsaktaḥ prayayau nandagokule //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अक्रूरो ऽपि विनिष्क्रम्य स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना
कृष्णसंदर्शनासक्तः प्रययौ नन्दगोकुले //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Akrūra too, having set out on a swift chariot / and intent on seeing Kṛṣṇa, arrived at Nanda’s cow-settlement.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayām āsa cākrūro nāsti dhanyataro mayā
yo 'ham aṃśāvatīrṇasya mukhaṃ drakṣyāmi cakriṇaḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तयाम् आस चाक्रूरो नास्ति धन्यतरो मया
यो ऽहम् अंशावतीर्णस्य मुखं द्रक्ष्यामि चक्रिणः //
text_mt: And Akrūra reflected: 'There is none more fortunate than I, / since I will behold the face of the discus-bearer descended as a partial incarnation.

sanskrit_iast:
adya me saphalaṃ janma suprabhātā ca me niśā
yad unnidrābjapattrākṣaṃ viṣṇor drakṣyāmy aham mukham //
meaning:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सुप्रभाता च मे निशा
यद् उन्निद्राब्जपत्त्राक्षं विष्णोर् द्रक्ष्याम्य् अहम् मुखम् //
text_mt: Today my birth is fruitful, and beautiful is the dawning of my night, / since I will behold the face of Viṣṇu, whose eyes are like fully opened lotus petals.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ harati yat puṃsāṃ smṛtaṃ saṃkalpanāmayam
tat puṇḍarīkanayanaṃ viṣṇor drakṣyāmy ahaṃ mukham //
meaning:
पापं हरति यत् पुंसां स्मृतं संकल्पनामयम्
तत् पुण्डरीकनयनं विष्णोर् द्रक्ष्याम्य् अहं मुखम् //
text_mt: I will behold the lotus-eyed face of Viṣṇu, / which, when remembered, removes the sin born of wrongful thoughts in men.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjagmuś ca yato vedā vedāṅgāny akhilāni ca
drakṣyāmi yat paraṃ dhāma devānāṃ bhagavanmukham //
meaning:
निर्जग्मुश् च यतो वेदा वेदाङ्गान्य् अखिलानि च
द्रक्ष्यामि यत् परं धाम देवानां भगवन्मुखम् //
text_mt: I will behold that supreme abode of the gods, the face of the Lord, / from which the Vedas and all the auxiliary limbs of the Veda went forth.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeṣu yajñapuruṣaḥ puruṣaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ijyate yo 'khilādhāras taṃ drakṣyāmi jagatpatim //
meaning:
यज्ञेषु यज्ञपुरुषः पुरुषैः पुरुषोत्तमः
इज्यते यो ऽखिलाधारस् तं द्रक्ष्यामि जगत्पतिम् //
text_mt: I will behold that Lord of the world, the support of all, / who is worshipped in sacrifices by men as the sacrifice-person, as Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā yam indro yajñānāṃ śatenāmararājatām
avāpa tam anantādim ahaṃ drakṣyāmi keśavam //
meaning:
इष्ट्वा यम् इन्द्रो यज्ञानां शतेनामरराजताम्
अवाप तम् अनन्तादिम् अहं द्रक्ष्यामि केशवम् //
text_mt: I will behold Keśava, the beginning of the infinite, worshipping whom / Indra obtained sovereignty over the immortals by a hundred sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
na brahmā nendrarudrāśvivasvādityamarudgaṇāḥ
yasya svarūpaṃ jānanti spṛśaty adya sa me hariḥ //
meaning:
न ब्रह्मा नेन्द्ररुद्राश्विवस्वादित्यमरुद्गणाः
यस्य स्वरूपं जानन्ति स्पृशत्य् अद्य स मे हरिः //
text_mt: Hari, whose essential nature neither Brahmā, nor Indra, Rudra, the Aśvins, the Vasus, Ādityas, or hosts of Maruts / know, will touch me today.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmā sarvagaḥ sarvaḥ sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitaḥ
yo bhavaty avyayo vyāpī sa vīkṣyate mayādya ha //
meaning:
सर्वात्मा सर्वगः सर्वः सर्वभूतेषु संस्थितः
यो भवत्य् अव्ययो व्यापी स वीक्ष्यते मयाद्य ह //
text_mt: He who is the self of all, omnipresent, all-things, residing in all beings, / who is imperishable and all-pervading, will indeed be seen by me today.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyakūrmavarāhādyaiḥ siṃharūpādibhiḥ sthitam
cakāra yogato yogaṃ sa mām ālāpayiṣyati //
meaning:
मत्स्यकूर्मवराहाद्यैः सिंहरूपादिभिः स्थितम्
चकार योगतो योगं स माम् आलापयिष्यति //
text_mt: He who, assuming forms such as the fish, tortoise, boar, and lion, / established order through his yoga, will converse with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃprataṃ ca jagatsvāmī kāryajāte vraje sthitim
kartuṃ manuṣyatāṃ prāptaḥ svecchādehadhṛg avyayaḥ //
meaning:
सांप्रतं च जगत्स्वामी कार्यजाते व्रजे स्थितिम्
कर्तुं मनुष्यतां प्राप्तः स्वेच्छादेहधृग् अव्ययः //
text_mt:
And now the Lord of the world, to fulfill his purpose, has attained human form
to dwell in Vraja, assuming a body by his own will, imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nantaḥ pṛthivīṃ dhatte śikharasthitisaṃsthitām
so 'vatīrṇo jagatyarthe mām akrūreti vakṣyati //
meaning:
यो ऽनन्तः पृथिवीं धत्ते शिखरस्थितिसंस्थिताम्
सो ऽवतीर्णो जगत्यर्थे माम् अक्रूरेति वक्ष्यति //
text_mt:
He who, as Ananta, bears the earth resting on his hoods,
he has descended for the sake of the world, and will say to me, “Akrūra!”

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbandhusuhṛdbhrātṛmātṛbandhumayīm imām
yanmāyāṃ nālam uddhartuṃ jagat tasmai namo namaḥ //
meaning:
पितृबन्धुसुहृद्भ्रातृमातृबन्धुमयीम् इमाम्
यन्मायां नालम् उद्धर्तुं जगत् तस्मै नमो नमः //
text_mt:
Salutations, salutations to him whose illusory power,
consisting of fathers, kinsmen, friends, brothers, and mothers, the world cannot overcome!

sanskrit_iast:
taranty avidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṛdi yasmin niveśite
yogamāyām imāṃ martyās tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
तरन्त्य् अविद्यां विततां हृदि यस्मिन् निवेशिते
योगमायाम् इमां मर्त्यास् तस्मै विद्यात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
Salutations to him whose self is knowledge, placed in whose heart
mortals cross over this widespread ignorance, this yogamāyā!

sanskrit_iast:
yajvabhir yajñapuruṣo vāsudevaś ca śāśvataiḥ
vedāntavedibhir viṣṇuḥ procyate yo nato 'smi tam //
meaning:
यज्वभिर् यज्ञपुरुषो वासुदेवश् च शाश्वतैः
वेदान्तवेदिभिर् विष्णुः प्रोच्यते यो नतो ऽस्मि तम् //
text_mt:
I bow down to him who is proclaimed as the Sacrifice-Puruṣa by sacrificers,
as eternal Vāsudeva, and as Viṣṇu by knowers of the Vedānta.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yatra jagad dhāmni dhāryate ca pratiṣṭhitam
sadasattvaṃ sa sattvena mayy asau yātu saumyatām //
meaning:
तथा यत्र जगद् धाम्नि धार्यते च प्रतिष्ठितम्
सदसत्त्वं स सत्त्वेन मय्य् असौ यातु सौम्यताम् //
text_mt:
Likewise, in which abode the world is held and established,
he who is being and non-being, may he, through his sattva, show benevolence toward me.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛte sakalakalyāṇabhājanaṃ yatra jāyate
puruṣapravaraṃ nityaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ harim //
meaning:
स्मृते सकलकल्याणभाजनं यत्र जायते
पुरुषप्रवरं नित्यं व्रजामि शरणं हरिम् //
text_mt:
When he is remembered, one becomes a vessel of all auspiciousness;
I perpetually take refuge in Hari, the foremost puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
itthaṃ sa cintayan viṣṇuṃ bhaktinamrātmamānasaḥ
akrūro gokulaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃcit sūrye virājati //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्थं स चिन्तयन् विष्णुं भक्तिनम्रात्ममानसः
अक्रूरो गोकुलं प्राप्तः किंचित् सूर्ये विराजति //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Thus meditating upon Viṣṇu, his mind humbled in devotion,
Akrūra reached Gokula as the sun was still shining a little.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dadarśa tadā tatra kṛṣṇam ādohane gavām
vatsamadhyagataṃ phullanīlotpaladalacchavim //
meaning:
स ददर्श तदा तत्र कृष्णम् आदोहने गवाम्
वत्समध्यगतं फुल्लनीलोत्पलदलच्छविम् //
text_mt:
He then saw Kṛṣṇa there at the milking-place of the cows,
standing among the calves, having the luster of a blooming blue lotus petal,

sanskrit_iast:
praphullapadmapattrākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam
pralambabāhum āyāmatuṅgorasthalam unnasam //
meaning:
प्रफुल्लपद्मपत्त्राक्षं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम्
प्रलम्बबाहुम् आयामतुङ्गोरस्थलम् उन्नसम् //
text_mt:
with eyes like fully blossomed lotus petals, a chest marked with the Śrīvatsa,
long arms, an expansive and prominent chest, and a raised nose,

sanskrit_iast:
savilāsasmitādhāraṃ bibhrāṇaṃ mukhapaṅkajam
tuṅgaraktanakhaṃ padbhyāṃ dharaṇyāṃ supratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
सविलासस्मिताधारं बिभ्राणं मुखपङ्कजम्
तुङ्गरक्तनखं पद्भ्यां धरण्यां सुप्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt:
bearing a lotus-face that was the receptacle of playful smiles,
with elevated red nails, firmly planted on the earth with both feet,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhrāṇaṃ vāsasī pīte vanyapuṣpavibhūṣitam
sāndranīlalatāhastaṃ sitāmbhojāvataṃsakam //
meaning:
बिभ्राणं वाससी पीते वन्यपुष्पविभूषितम्
सान्द्रनीललताहस्तं सिताम्भोजावतंसकम् //
text_mt:
wearing two yellow garments, adorned with wild flowers,
holding a dense blue vine in his hand, and wearing a white lotus as an ear-ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsendukundadhavalaṃ nīlāmbaradharaṃ dvijāḥ
tasyānu balabhadraṃ ca dadarśa yadunandanam //
meaning:
हंसेन्दुकुन्दधवलं नीलाम्बरधरं द्विजाः
तस्यानु बलभद्रं च ददर्श यदुनन्दनम् //
text_mt:
And behind him, O twice-born, he saw Balabhadra, the delight of the Yadus,
white as a swan, the moon, and jasmine, and wearing a blue garment,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṃśum uttuṅgabāhuṃ ca vikāśimukhapaṅkajam
meghamālāparivṛtaṃ kailāsādrim ivāparam //
meaning:
प्रांशुम् उत्तुङ्गबाहुं च विकाशिमुखपङ्कजम्
मेघमालापरिवृतं कैलासाद्रिम् इवापरम् //
text_mt:
tall, with long arms, an open lotus-face,
resembling another Mount Kailāsa enveloped by a garland of clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
tau dṛṣṭvā vikasadvaktrasarojaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgas tadākrūro 'bhavad dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तौ दृष्ट्वा विकसद्वक्त्रसरोजः स महामतिः
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गस् तदाक्रूरो ऽभवद् द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Seeing the two of them, O twice-born, the high-minded Akrūra’s lotus-face bloomed,
and all his limbs bristled with thrills.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etat paramaṃ dhāma etat tat paramaṃ padam
abhavad vāsudevo 'sau dvidhā yo 'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
य एतत् परमं धाम एतत् तत् परमं पदम्
अभवद् वासुदेवो ऽसौ द्विधा यो ऽयं व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt:
[He thought:] “He who is this supreme abode, this supreme state,
this Vāsudeva, is present here divided into two forms.

sanskrit_iast:
sāphalyam akṣṇor yugapan mamāstu
dṛṣṭe jagaddhātari hāsam uccaiḥ
apy aṅgam etad bhagavatprasādād
dattāṅgasaṅge phalavartma tat syāt
meaning:
साफल्यम् अक्ष्णोर् युगपन् ममास्तु
दृष्टे जगद्धातरि हासम् उच्चैः
अप्य् अङ्गम् एतद् भगवत्प्रसादाद्
दत्ताङ्गसङ्गे फलवर्त्म तत् स्यात्
text_mt:
May both my eyes attain fulfillment at once
upon seeing the Creator of the world, whose smile is radiant!
And may this body of mine, through the grace of the Blessed One,
find the path of fulfillment when granted contact with his limbs!

sanskrit_iast:
adyaiva spṛṣṭvā mama hastapadmaṃ
kariṣyati śrīmadanantamūrtiḥ
yasyāṅgulisparśahatākhilāghair
avāpyate siddhir anuttamā naraiḥ
meaning:
अद्यैव स्पृष्ट्वा मम हस्तपद्मं
करिष्यति श्रीमदनन्तमूर्तिः
यस्याङ्गुलिस्पर्शहताखिलाघैर्
अवाप्यते सिद्धिर् अनुत्तमा नरैः
text_mt:
This very day the glorious one of infinite forms
will touch my lotus-hand,
by the touch of whose fingers men, having all sins destroyed,
attain unexcelled perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāśvirudrendravasupraṇītā
devāḥ prayacchanti varaṃ prahṛṣṭāḥ
cakraṃ ghnatā daityapater hṛtāni
daityāṅganānāṃ nayanāntarāṇi
meaning:
तथाश्विरुद्रेन्द्रवसुप्रणीता
देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति वरं प्रहृष्टाः
चक्रं घ्नता दैत्यपतेर् हृतानि
दैत्याङ्गनानां नयनान्तराणि
text_mt:
Likewise, the gods led by the Aśvins, Rudras, Indras, and Vasus
rejoicingly grant boons [to him],
whose disc, slaying the lord of the Daityas,
snatched away the pupils from the eyes of Daitya women.

sanskrit_iast:
yatrāmbu vinyasya balir manobhyām
avāpa bhogān vasudhātalasthaḥ
tathāmareśas tridaśādhipatyaṃ
manvantaraṃ pūrṇam avāpa śakraḥ
meaning:
यत्राम्बु विन्यस्य बलिर् मनोभ्याम्
अवाप भोगान् वसुधातलस्थः
तथामरेशस् त्रिदशाधिपत्यं
मन्वन्तरं पूर्णम् अवाप शक्रः
text_mt:
Placing water upon [whose feet] with his mind, Bali,
though dwelling on the earthly realm, obtained pleasures;
and Śakra, the lord of the immortals, obtained sovereign rule over the thirty [gods]
for a complete manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
atheśa māṃ kaṃsaparigraheṇa
doṣāspadībhūtam adoṣayuktam
kartā na mānopahitaṃ dhig astu
yasmān manaḥ sādhubahiṣkṛto yaḥ
meaning:
अथेश मां कंसपरिग्रहेण
दोषास्पदीभूतम् अदोषयुक्तम्
कर्ता न मानोपहितं धिग् अस्तु
यस्मान् मनः साधुबहिष्कृतो यः
text_mt:
Now, O Lord, although I am guiltless, because of my acceptance by Kaṃsa
I have become an object of blame; will he not make me honored?
Fie [on me], whose mind is cast out by the virtuous!

sanskrit_iast:
jñānātmakasyākhilasattvarāśer
vyāvṛttadoṣasya sadāsphuṭasya
kiṃ vā jagaty atra samastapuṃsām
ajñātam asyāsti hṛdi sthitasya
meaning:
ज्ञानात्मकस्याखिलसत्त्वराशेर्
व्यावृत्तदोषस्य सदास्फुटस्य
किं वा जगत्य् अत्र समस्तपुंसाम्
अज्ञातम् अस्यास्ति हृदि स्थितस्य
text_mt:
For him who consists of knowledge, who is the aggregate of all beings,
free from fault, ever manifest,
who dwells in the hearts of all men,
what indeed is unknown in this world?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād ahaṃ bhaktivinamragātro
vrajāmi viśveśvaram īśvarāṇām
aṃśāvatāraṃ puruṣottamasya
anādimadhyāntam ajasya viṣṇoḥ
meaning:
तस्माद् अहं भक्तिविनम्रगात्रो
व्रजामि विश्वेश्वरम् ईश्वराणाम्
अंशावतारं पुरुषोत्तमस्य
अनादिमध्यान्तम् अजस्य विष्णोः
text_mt:
Therefore, with my limbs bent in devotion,
I go to the Lord of the universe, the Ruler of rulers,
the partial incarnation of Puruṣottama,
the unborn Viṣṇu, who has no beginning, middle, or end.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
cintayann iti govindam upagamya sa yādavaḥ
akrūro 'smīti caraṇau nanāma śirasā hareḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
चिन्तयन्न् इति गोविन्दम् उपगम्य स यादवः
अक्रूरो ऽस्मीति चरणौ ननाम शिरसा हरेः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Meditating thus upon Govinda, the Yādava approached,
and saying, “I am Akrūra,” he bowed down with his head to Hari’s feet.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'py enaṃ dhvajavajrābjakṛtacihnena pāṇinā
saṃspṛśyākṛṣya ca prītyā sugāḍhaṃ pariṣasvaje //
meaning:
सो ऽप्य् एनं ध्वजवज्राब्जकृतचिह्नेन पाणिना
संस्पृश्याकृष्य च प्रीत्या सुगाढं परिषस्वजे //
text_mt:
And he too, touching him with his hand marked with the banner, thunderbolt, and lotus,
drew him close, and embraced him tightly with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasaṃvadanau tena yathāvad balakeśavau
tataḥ praviṣṭau sahasā tam ādāyātmamandiram //
meaning:
कृतसंवदनौ तेन यथावद् बलकेशवौ
ततः प्रविष्टौ सहसा तम् आदायात्ममन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
Having duly exchanged greetings with him,
Bala and Keśava then swiftly took him into their home.

sanskrit_iast:
saha tābhyāṃ tadākrūraḥ kṛtasaṃvandanādikaḥ
bhuktabhojyo yathānyāyam ācacakṣe tatas tayoḥ //
meaning:
सह ताभ्यां तदाक्रूरः कृतसंवन्दनादिकः
भुक्तभोज्यो यथान्यायम् आचचक्षे ततस् तयोः //
text_mt:
Together with the two of them, having performed salutations and other rites,
Akrūra, having eaten food as was proper, then told both of them

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nirbhartsitas tena kaṃsenānakadundubhiḥ
yathā ca devakī devī dānavena durātmanā //
meaning:
यथा निर्भर्त्सितस् तेन कंसेनानकदुन्दुभिः
यथा च देवकी देवी दानवेन दुरात्मना //
text_mt:
how Ānakadundubhi had been reviled by Kaṃsa,
and how Devakī had been abused by that evil-minded Dānava,

sanskrit_iast:
ugrasene yathā kaṃsaḥ sa durātmā ca vartate
yaṃ caivārthaṃ samuddiśya kaṃsena sa visarjitaḥ //
meaning:
उग्रसेने यथा कंसः स दुरात्मा च वर्तते
यं चैवार्थं समुद्दिश्य कंसेन स विसर्जितः //
text_mt:
how that evil-souled Kaṃsa treated Ugrasena,
and for what purpose he himself had been dispatched by Kaṃsa.

sanskrit_iast:
tat sarvaṃ vistarāc chrutvā bhagavān keśisūdanaḥ
uvācākhilam etat tu jñātaṃ dānapate mayā //
meaning:
तत् सर्वं विस्तराच् छ्रुत्वा भगवान् केशिसूदनः
उवाचाखिलम् एतत् तु ज्ञातं दानपते मया //
text_mt:
Having heard all that in detail, the Blessed One, the slayer of Keśin,
said: “All this is indeed known to me, O lord of gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣye ca mahābhāga yad atraupāyikaṃ matam
vicintyaṃ nānyathaitat te viddhi kaṃsaṃ hataṃ mayā //
meaning:
करिष्ये च महाभाग यद् अत्रौपायिकं मतम्
विचिन्त्यं नान्यथैतत् ते विद्धि कंसं हतं मया //
text_mt:
And, O fortunate one, I will do what is deemed expedient in this matter.
You need not think otherwise about this; know Kaṃsa to be already slain by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ rāmaś ca mathurāṃ śvo yāsyāvaḥ samaṃ tvayā
gopavṛddhāś ca yāsyanti ādāyopāyanaṃ bahu //
meaning:
अहं रामश् च मथुरां श्वो यास्यावः समं त्वया
गोपवृद्धाश् च यास्यन्ति आदायोपायनं बहु //
text_mt:
Rāma and I shall go to Mathurā tomorrow along with you;
and the elders among the cowherds will go, taking many offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
niśeyaṃ nīyatāṃ vīra na cintāṃ kartum arhasi
trirātrābhyantare kaṃsaṃ haniṣyāmi sahānugam //
meaning:
निशेयं नीयतां वीर न चिन्तां कर्तुम् अर्हसि
त्रिरात्राभ्यन्तरे कंसं हनिष्यामि सहानुगम् //
text_mt:
Spend this night [here], O hero; you ought not to worry.
Within three nights I will kill Kaṃsa along with his followers.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
samādiśya tato gopān akrūro 'pi sakeśavaḥ
suṣvāpa balabhadraś ca nandagopagṛhe gataḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
समादिश्य ततो गोपान् अक्रूरो ऽपि सकेशवः
सुष्वाप बलभद्रश् च नन्दगोपगृहे गतः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having then instructed the cowherds, Akrūra, accompanied by Keśava
and Balabhadra, went to Nandagopa’s house and slept.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale rāmakṛṣṇau mahābalau
akrūreṇa samaṃ gantum udyatau mathurāṃ purīm //
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते विमले रामकृष्णौ महाबलौ
अक्रूरेण समं गन्तुम् उद्यतौ मथुरां पुरीम् //
text_mt:
Then, at clear dawn, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, of mighty strength,
prepared to depart with Akrūra for the city of Mathurā.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā gopījanaḥ sāsraḥ ślathadvalayabāhukaḥ
niśvasaṃś cātiduḥkhārtaḥ prāha cedaṃ parasparam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा गोपीजनः सास्रः श्लथद्वलयबाहुकः
निश्वसंश् चातिदुःखार्तः प्राह चेदं परस्परम् //
text_mt:
Seeing them, the gopīs, weeping, with bangles slipping from their arms,
sighing and exceedingly stricken with grief, said this to one another:

sanskrit_iast:
mathurāṃ prāpya govindaḥ kathaṃ gokulam eṣyati
nāgarastrīkalālāpamadhu śrotreṇa pāsyati //
meaning:
मथुरां प्राप्य गोविन्दः कथं गोकुलम् एष्यति
नागरस्त्रीकलालापमधु श्रोत्रेण पास्यति //
text_mt:
“Having reached Mathurā, how will Govinda ever return to Gokula?
He will drink with his ear the honey of the sweet speech of city women.

sanskrit_iast:
vilāsivākyajāteṣu nāgarīṇāṃ kṛtāspadam
cittam asya kathaṃ grāmyagopagopīṣu yāsyati //
meaning:
विलासिवाक्यजातेषु नागरीणां कृतास्पदम्
चित्तम् अस्य कथं ग्राम्यगोपगोपीषु यास्यति //
text_mt:
His mind, having found a place among the playful words of the city women,
how will it ever turn to rustic cowherd boys and gopīs?

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṃ samastagoṣṭhasya vidhinā haratā harim
prahṛtaṃ gopayoṣitsu nighṛṇena durātmanā //
meaning:
सारं समस्तगोष्ठस्य विधिना हरता हरिम्
प्रहृतं गोपयोषित्सु निघृणेन दुरात्मना //
text_mt:
By taking Hari away, the essence of the entire cowherd settlement,
a blow has been struck at the cowherd women by merciless, wicked Fate!

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvagarbhasmitaṃ vākyaṃ vilāsalalitā gatiḥ
nāgarīṇām atīvaitat kaṭākṣekṣitam eva tu //
meaning:
भावगर्भस्मितं वाक्यं विलासललिता गतिः
नागरीणाम् अतीवैतत् कटाक्षेक्षितम् एव तु //
text_mt:
The speech laden with romantic sentiment and smiles, the graceful, playful gait
of the city women, and especially their sidelong glances—

sanskrit_iast:
grāmyo harir ayaṃ tāsāṃ vilāsanigaḍair yataḥ
bhavatīnāṃ punaḥ pārśvaṃ kayā yuktyā sameṣyati //
meaning:
ग्राम्यो हरिर् अयं तासां विलासनिगडैर् यतः
भवतीनां पुनः पार्श्वं कया युक्त्या समेष्यति //
text_mt:
since this rustic Hari is bound by their playful fetters,
by what means will he ever return to you again?

sanskrit_iast:
eṣo hi ratham āruhya mathurāṃ yāti keśavaḥ
akrūrakrūrakeṇāpi hatāśena pratāritaḥ //
meaning:
एषो हि रथम् आरुह्य मथुरां याति केशवः
अक्रूरक्रूरकेणापि हताशेन प्रतारितः //
text_mt:
For Keśava is mounting the chariot and going to Mathurā,
lured away even by that wretched, cruel Akrūra!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na vetti nṛśaṃso 'yam anurāgaparaṃ janam
yenemam akṣarāhlādaṃ nayaty anyatra no harim //
meaning:
किं न वेत्ति नृशंसो ऽयम् अनुरागपरं जनम्
येनेमम् अक्षराह्लादं नयत्य् अन्यत्र नो हरिम् //
text_mt:
Does this cruel man not know people who are devoted with passionate love,
since he is carrying our Hari, this imperishable delight, somewhere else?

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa rāmeṇa sahitaḥ prayāty atyantanirghṛṇaḥ
ratham āruhya govindas tvaryatām asya vāraṇe //
meaning:
एष रामेण सहितः प्रयात्य् अत्यन्तनिर्घृणः
रथम् आरुह्य गोविन्दस् त्वर्यताम् अस्य वारणे //
text_mt:
Extremely heartless, he is departing along with Rāma,
having mounted the chariot; Govinda must be stopped at once!

sanskrit_iast:
gurūṇām agrato vaktuṃ kiṃ bravīṣi na naḥ kṣamam
guravaḥ kiṃ kariṣyanti dagdhānāṃ virahāgninā //
meaning:
गुरूणाम् अग्रतो वक्तुं किं ब्रवीषि न नः क्षमम्
गुरवः किं करिष्यन्ति दग्धानां विरहाग्निना //
text_mt:
Why do you say, ‘It is not proper for us to speak before our elders’?
What will elders do to those who are already burned by the fire of separation?

sanskrit_iast:
nandagopamukhā gopā gantum ete samudyatāḥ
nodyamaṃ kurute kaścid govindavinivartane //
meaning:
नन्दगोपमुखा गोपा गन्तुम् एते समुद्यताः
नोद्यमं कुरुते कश्चिद् गोविन्दविनिवर्तने //
text_mt:
These cowherds headed by Nandagopa are prepared to go;
not one of them makes an effort to turn Govinda back!”

sanskrit_iast:
suprabhātādya rajanī mathurāvāsiyoṣitām
yāsām acyutavaktrābje yāti netrālibhogyatām //
meaning:
सुप्रभाताद्य रजनी मथुरावासियोषिताम्
यासाम् अच्युतवक्त्राब्जे याति नेत्रालिभोग्यताम् //
text_mt: “Today a fair dawn has broken over the night of the women residing in Mathurā, / whose bee-like eyes come to feast upon the lotus-face of Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyās te pathi ye kṛṣṇam ito yāntam avāritāḥ
udvahiṣyanti paśyantaḥ svadehaṃ pulakāñcitam //
meaning:
धन्यास् ते पथि ये कृष्णम् इतो यान्तम् अवारिताः
उद्वहिष्यन्ति पश्यन्तः स्वदेहं पुलकाञ्चितम् //
text_mt: Blessed are those along the road who, unobstructed, as they behold Kṛṣṇa going hence, / will bear their bodies bristling with horripilation!

sanskrit_iast:
mathurānagarīpauranayanānāṃ mahotsavaḥ
govindavadanālokād atīvādya bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
मथुरानगरीपौरनयनानां महोत्सवः
गोविन्दवदनालोकाद् अतीवाद्य भविष्यति //
text_mt: A great festival for the eyes of the citizens of Mathurā city / will take place today from the sight of Govinda's face!

sanskrit_iast:
ko nu svapnaḥ sabhāgyābhir dṛṣṭas tābhir adhokṣajam
vistārikāntanayanā yā drakṣyanty anivāritam //
meaning:
को नु स्वप्नः सभाग्याभिर् दृष्टस् ताभिर् अधोक्षजम्
विस्तारिकान्तनयना या द्रक्ष्यन्त्य् अनिवारितम् //
text_mt: What fortunate dream was seen by those women who, / with wide, beautiful eyes, will behold Adhokṣaja unhindered?

sanskrit_iast:
aho gopījanasyāsya darśayitvā mahānidhim
uddhṛtāny adya netrāṇi vidhātrākaruṇātmanā //
meaning:
अहो गोपीजनस्यास्य दर्शयित्वा महानिधिम्
उद्धृतान्य् अद्य नेत्राणि विधात्राकरुणात्मना //
text_mt: Alas! Having shown a great treasure to these gopīs, / the eyes of today have been plucked out by the pitiless Creator!

sanskrit_iast:
anurāgeṇa śaithilyam asmāsu vrajato hareḥ
śaithilyam upayānty āśu kareṣu valayāny api //
meaning:
अनुरागेण शैथिल्यम् अस्मासु व्रजतो हरेः
शैथिल्यम् उपयान्त्य् आशु करेषु वलयान्य् अपि //
text_mt: As Hari departs, our affection undergoes slackening; / even the bracelets upon our wrists swiftly slip and grow loose!”

sanskrit_iast:
akrūraḥ krūrahṛdayaḥ śīghraṃ prerayate hayān
evam ārtāsu yoṣitsu ghṛṇā kasya na jāyate //
meaning:
अक्रूरः क्रूरहृदयः शीघ्रं प्रेरयते हयान्
एवम् आर्तासु योषित्सु घृणा कस्य न जायते //
text_mt: Akrūra, cruel-hearted, swiftly urges on the horses. / When women are thus distressed, in whom does pity not arise?

sanskrit_iast:
he he kṛṣṇa rathasyoccaiś cakrareṇur nirīkṣyatām
dūrīkṛto harir yena so 'pi reṇur na lakṣyate //
meaning:
हे हे कृष्ण रथस्योच्चैश् चक्ररेणुर् निरीक्ष्यताम्
दूरीकृतो हरिर् येन सो ऽपि रेणुर् न लक्ष्यते //
text_mt: “O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa! Look at the chariot's wheel-dust rising high! / Even that dust by which Hari is hidden from view can no longer be seen!”

sanskrit_iast:
ity evam atihārdena gopījananirīkṣitaḥ
tatyāja vrajabhūbhāgaṃ saha rāmeṇa keśavaḥ //
meaning:
इत्य् एवम् अतिहार्देन गोपीजननिरीक्षितः
तत्याज व्रजभूभागं सह रामेण केशवः //
text_mt: Thus gazed upon with intense affection by the gopīs, / Keśava, together with Rāma, departed from the region of Vraja.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchanto javanāśvena rathena yamunātaṭam
prāptā madhyāhnasamaye rāmākrūrajanārdanāḥ //
meaning:
गच्छन्तो जवनाश्वेन रथेन यमुनातटम्
प्राप्ता मध्याह्नसमये रामाक्रूरजनार्दनाः //
text_mt: Proceeding in the chariot drawn by swift horses to the bank of the Yamunā, / Rāma, Akrūra, and Janārdana arrived at midday.

sanskrit_iast:
athāha kṛṣṇam akrūro bhavadbhyāṃ tāvad āsyatām
yāvat karomi kālindyām āhnikārhaṇam ambhasi //
meaning:
अथाह कृष्णम् अक्रूरो भवद्भ्यां तावद् आस्यताम्
यावत् करोमि कालिन्द्याम् आह्निकार्हणम् अम्भसि //
text_mt: Then Akrūra said to Kṛṣṇa: “May you both remain here / while I perform my daily worship in the waters of the Kālindī.”

sanskrit_iast:
tathety ukte tataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ
dadhyau brahma paraṃ viprāḥ praviśya yamunājale //
meaning:
तथेत्य् उक्ते ततः स्नातः स्वाचान्तः स महामतिः
दध्यौ ब्रह्म परं विप्राः प्रविश्य यमुनाजले //
text_mt: When [Kṛṣṇa] said, “So be it,” that wise man bathed, rinsed his mouth, / entered the waters of the Yamunā, O twice-born ones, and meditated on the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
phaṇāsahasramālāḍhyaṃ balabhadraṃ dadarśa saḥ
kundāmalāṅgam unnidrapadmapattrāyatekṣaṇam //
meaning:
फणासहस्रमालाढ्यं बलभद्रं ददर्श सः
कुन्दामलाङ्गम् उन्निद्रपद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम् //
text_mt: He beheld Balabhadra endowed with a garland of a thousand hoods, / his limbs pure white like the kunda flower, his long eyes like the petals of a blooming lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtaṃ vāsukiḍimbhaughair mahadbhiḥ pavanāśibhiḥ
saṃstūyamānam udgandhivanamālāvibhūṣitam //
meaning:
वृतं वासुकिडिम्भौघैर् महद्भिः पवनाशिभिः
संस्तूयमानम् उद्गन्धिवनमालाविभूषितम् //
text_mt: surrounded by the great offspring of Vāsuki that feed on wind, / being praised with hymns, adorned with a fragrant garland of wild flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānam asite vastre cārurūpāvataṃsakam
cārukuṇḍalinaṃ mattam antarjalatale sthitam //
meaning:
दधानम् असिते वस्त्रे चारुरूपावतंसकम्
चारुकुण्डलिनं मत्तम् अन्तर्जलतले स्थितम् //
text_mt: wearing dark garments, with a graceful crest-ornament, / possessing lovely earrings, intoxicated, situated beneath the surface of the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyotsaṅge ghanaśyāmam ātāmrāyatalocanam
caturbāhum udārāṅgaṃ cakrādyāyudhabhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
तस्योत्सङ्गे घनश्यामम् आताम्रायतलोचनम्
चतुर्बाहुम् उदाराङ्गं चक्राद्यायुधभूषणम् //
text_mt: On his lap [he beheld Hari], dark as a raincloud, with long, reddish eyes, / four-armed, noble of limb, adorned with weapons such as the discus,

sanskrit_iast:
pīte vasānaṃ vasane citramālyavibhūṣitam
śakracāpataḍinmālāvicitram iva toyadam //
meaning:
पीते वसानं वसने चित्रमाल्यविभूषितम्
शक्रचापतडिन्मालाविचित्रम् इव तोयदम् //
text_mt: clothed in yellow garments, adorned with diverse garlands, / like a cloud variegated by a rainbow and flashes of lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ cārukeyūramukuṭojjvalam
dadarśa kṛṣṇam akliṣṭaṃ puṇḍarīkāvataṃsakam //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं चारुकेयूरमुकुटोज्ज्वलम्
ददर्श कृष्णम् अक्लिष्टं पुण्डरीकावतंसकम् //
text_mt: his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa, radiant with beautiful armlets and a diadem; / he saw Kṛṣṇa, untiring in action, wearing a lotus as an ear-ornament,

sanskrit_iast:
sanandanādyair munibhiḥ siddhayogair akalmaṣaiḥ
saṃcintyamānaṃ manasā nāsāgranyastalocanaiḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दनाद्यैर् मुनिभिः सिद्धयोगैर् अकल्मषैः
संचिन्त्यमानं मनसा नासाग्रन्यस्तलोचनैः //
text_mt: being contemplated in mind by sages such as Sanandana, / who were accomplished in yoga and free from taint, their eyes fixed on the tips of their noses.

sanskrit_iast:
balakṛṣṇau tadākrūraḥ pratyabhijñāya vismitaḥ
acintayad atho śīghraṃ katham atrāgatāv iti //
meaning:
बलकृष्णौ तदाक्रूरः प्रत्यभिज्ञाय विस्मितः
अचिन्तयद् अथो शीघ्रं कथम् अत्रागताव् इति //
text_mt: Recognizing Bala and Kṛṣṇa, Akrūra was astonished / and then swiftly thought: “How have they come here?”

sanskrit_iast:
vivakṣoḥ stambhayām āsa vācaṃ tasya janārdanaḥ
tato niṣkramya salilād ratham abhyāgataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
विवक्षोः स्तम्भयाम् आस वाचं तस्य जनार्दनः
ततो निष्क्रम्य सलिलाद् रथम् अभ्यागतः पुनः //
text_mt: As he wished to speak, Janārdana paralyzed his voice; / then, emerging from the water, he approached the chariot once more.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa tatra caivobhau rathasyopari saṃsthitau
rāmakṛṣṇau yathā pūrvaṃ manuṣyavapuṣānvitau //
meaning:
ददर्श तत्र चैवोभौ रथस्योपरि संस्थितौ
रामकृष्णौ यथा पूर्वं मनुष्यवपुषान्वितौ //
text_mt: And there he beheld them both sitting upon the chariot, / Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, endowed with human forms just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
nimagnaś ca punas toye dadṛśe sa tathaiva tau
saṃstūyamānau gandharvair munisiddhamahoragaiḥ //
meaning:
निमग्नश् च पुनस् तोये ददृशे स तथैव तौ
संस्तूयमानौ गन्धर्वैर् मुनिसिद्धमहोरगैः //
text_mt: Plunging once more into the water, he saw the two just as before, / being praised with hymns by gandharvas, sages, siddhas, and great serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vijñātasadbhāvaḥ sa tu dānapatis tadā
tuṣṭāva sarvavijñānamayam acyutam īśvaram //
meaning:
ततो विज्ञातसद्भावः स तु दानपतिस् तदा
तुष्टाव सर्वविज्ञानमयम् अच्युतम् ईश्वरम् //
text_mt: Then, having realized the true reality, that lord of charity / praised Acyuta, the Lord who consists of all wisdom:

sanskrit_iast:
akrūra uvāca
tanmātrarūpiṇe 'cintyamahimne paramātmane
vyāpine naikarūpaikasvarūpāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
अक्रूर उवाच
तन्मात्ररूपिणे ऽचिन्त्यमहिम्ने परमात्मने
व्यापिने नैकरूपैकस्वरूपाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Akrūra said: / “Salutations, salutations to you whose form is the subtle elements, of inconceivable majesty, the supreme self, / all-pervading, whose single essential nature possesses manifold forms!

sanskrit_iast:
śabdarūpāya te 'cintyahavirbhūtāya te namaḥ
namo vijñānarūpāya parāya prakṛteḥ prabho //
meaning:
शब्दरूपाय ते ऽचिन्त्यहविर्भूताय ते नमः
नमो विज्ञानरूपाय पराय प्रकृतेः प्रभो //
text_mt: Salutations to you whose form is sound, to you who have become the inconceivable oblation; / salutations to you whose form is wisdom, who are beyond prakṛti, O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtātmā cendriyātmā ca pradhānātmā tathā bhavān
ātmā ca paramātmā ca tvam ekaḥ pañcadhā sthitaḥ //
meaning:
भूतात्मा चेन्द्रियात्मा च प्रधानात्मा तथा भवान्
आत्मा च परमात्मा च त्वम् एकः पञ्चधा स्थितः //
text_mt: You are the self of the elements, the self of the senses, and likewise the self of pradhāna; / you are the self and the supreme self: you, the one, abide in fivefold division.

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda sarvadharmātman kṣarākṣara maheśvara
brahmaviṣṇuśivādyābhiḥ kalpanābhir udīritaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसीद सर्वधर्मात्मन् क्षराक्षर महेश्वर
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाद्याभिः कल्पनाभिर् उदीरितः //
text_mt: Be gracious, O self of all dharma, the perishable and the imperishable, O great lord, / designated by the conceptions of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the rest!

sanskrit_iast:
anākhyeyasvarūpātmann anākhyeyaprayojana
anākhyeyābhidhāna tvāṃ nato 'smi parameśvaram //
meaning:
अनाख्येयस्वरूपात्मन्न् अनाख्येयप्रयोजन
अनाख्येयाभिधान त्वां नतो ऽस्मि परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: O you whose essential nature is ineffable, whose purpose is ineffable, / whose name is ineffable, I bow to you, the supreme lord!

sanskrit_iast:
na yatra nātha vidyante nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ
tad brahma paramaṃ nityam avikāri bhavān ajaḥ //
meaning:
न यत्र नाथ विद्यन्ते नामजात्यादिकल्पनाः
तद् ब्रह्म परमं नित्यम् अविकारि भवान् अजः //
text_mt: Where no conceptual constructions of name, genus, and so forth exist, O Lord, / that is the supreme, eternal, immutable Brahman; you are the unborn one.

sanskrit_iast:
na kalpanām ṛte 'rthasya sarvasyādhigamo yataḥ
tataḥ kṛṣṇācyutānanta viṣṇusaṃjñābhir īḍyase //
meaning:
न कल्पनाम् ऋते ऽर्थस्य सर्वस्याधिगमो यतः
ततः कृष्णाच्युतानन्त विष्णुसंज्ञाभिर् ईड्यसे //
text_mt: Because without conceptual construction no meaning whatsoever can be apprehended, / therefore you are praised under the appellations of Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmaṃs tvam aja vikalpanābhir etair
devās tvaṃ jagad akhilaṃ tvam eva viśvam
viśvātmaṃs tvam ativikārabhedahīnaḥ
sarvasmin nahi bhavato 'sti kiṃcid anyat
meaning:
सर्वात्मंस् त्वम् अज विकल्पनाभिर् एतैर्
देवास् त्वं जगद् अखिलं त्वम् एव विश्वम्
विश्वात्मंस् त्वम् अतिविकारभेदहीनः
सर्वस्मिन् नहि भवतो ऽस्ति किंचिद् अन्यत्
text_mt: O self of all, unborn, through these conceptual constructions / you are the gods, you are the entire world, you alone are the universe; / O self of the universe, free from all modifications and distinctions, / in all this there is nothing whatsoever other than you!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmā paśupatir aryamā vidhātā
tvaṃ dhātā tridaśapatiḥ samīraṇo 'gniḥ
toyeśo dhanapatir antakas tvam eko
bhinnātmā jagad api pāsi śaktibhedaiḥ
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्मा पशुपतिर् अर्यमा विधाता
त्वं धाता त्रिदशपतिः समीरणो ऽग्निः
तोयेशो धनपतिर् अन्तकस् त्वम् एको
भिन्नात्मा जगद् अपि पासि शक्तिभेदैः
text_mt: You are Brahmā, Paśupati, Aryaman, the ordainer; / you are Dhātṛ, the lord of the gods, the wind, fire, / the lord of waters, the lord of wealth, the ender; being one, / differentiated in self, you protect the world through your various powers.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ bhavān sṛjati hanti gabhastirūpo
viśvaṃ ca te guṇamayo 'yam aja prapañcaḥ
rūpaṃ paraṃ saditivācakam akṣaraṃ yaj
jñānātmane sadasate praṇato 'smi tasmai
meaning:
विश्वं भवान् सृजति हन्ति गभस्तिरूपो
विश्वं च ते गुणमयो ऽयम् अज प्रपञ्चः
रूपं परं सदितिवाचकम् अक्षरं यज्
ज्ञानात्मने सदसते प्रणतो ऽस्मि तस्मै
text_mt: You create the universe, and in the form of rays of light you destroy it; / this phenomenal expanse composed of the guṇas is your universe, O unborn one; / to that supreme, imperishable form expressed by the word 'being', / consisting of knowledge, both being and non-being, I bow!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca
pradyumnāya namas tubhyam aniruddhāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय नमः संकर्षणाय च
प्रद्युम्नाय नमस् तुभ्यम् अनिरुद्धाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Oṃ, salutations to Vāsudeva, and salutations to Saṃkarṣaṇa; / salutations to Pradyumna; salutations to you, Aniruddha!”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evam antar jale kṛṣṇam abhiṣṭūya sa yādavaḥ
arghayām āsa sarveśaṃ dhūpapuṣpair manomayaiḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एवम् अन्तर् जले कृष्णम् अभिष्टूय स यादवः
अर्घयाम् आस सर्वेशं धूपपुष्पैर् मनोमयैः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having thus praised Kṛṣṇa within the water, that Yādava / offered worship to the Lord of all with mental incense and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
parityajyānyaviṣayaṃ manas tatra niveśya saḥ
brahmabhūte ciraṃ sthitvā virarāma samādhitaḥ //
meaning:
परित्यज्यान्यविषयं मनस् तत्र निवेश्य सः
ब्रह्मभूते चिरं स्थित्वा विरराम समाधितः //
text_mt: Forsaking any other object, fixing his mind upon him, / having remained for a long time as one who has become Brahman, he withdrew from samādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyam ivātmānaṃ manyamāno dvijottamāḥ
ājagāma rathaṃ bhūyo nirgamya yamunāmbhasaḥ //
meaning:
कृतकृत्यम् इवात्मानं मन्यमानो द्विजोत्तमाः
आजगाम रथं भूयो निर्गम्य यमुनाम्भसः //
text_mt: Deeming himself to have accomplished his purpose, O best of the twice-born, / he came out of the waters of the Yamunā and went back to the chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmakṛṣṇau dadarśātha yathāpūrvam avasthitau
vismitākṣaṃ tadākrūraṃ taṃ ca kṛṣṇo 'bhyabhāṣata //
meaning:
रामकृष्णौ ददर्शाथ यथापूर्वम् अवस्थितौ
विस्मिताक्षं तदाक्रूरं तं च कृष्णो ऽभ्यभाषत //
text_mt: Then he beheld Rāma and Kṛṣṇa remaining just as before; / and Kṛṣṇa addressed that Akrūra whose eyes were filled with wonder:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
kiṃ tvayā dṛṣṭam āścaryam akrūra yamunājale
vismayotphullanayano bhavān saṃlakṣyate yataḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
किं त्वया दृष्टम् आश्चर्यम् अक्रूर यमुनाजले
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनो भवान् संलक्ष्यते यतः //
text_mt: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / “What wondrous thing did you see in the waters of the Yamunā, Akrūra, / since your eyes appear wide open with astonishment?”

sanskrit_iast:
akrūra uvāca
antar jale yad āścaryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tatra mayācyuta
tad atraiva hi paśyāmi mūrtimat purataḥ sthitam //
meaning:
अक्रूर उवाच
अन्तर् जले यद् आश्चर्यं दृष्टं तत्र मयाच्युत
तद् अत्रैव हि पश्यामि मूर्तिमत् पुरतः स्थितम् //
text_mt: Akrūra said: / “The wonder that I saw within the water there, O Acyuta, / that very same wonder I see right here, standing embodied before me!”

sanskrit_iast:
jagad etan mahāścaryarūpaṃ yasya mahātmanaḥ
tenāścaryapareṇāhaṃ bhavatā kṛṣṇa saṃgataḥ //
meaning:
जगद् एतन् महाश्चर्यरूपं यस्य महात्मनः
तेनाश्चर्यपरेणाहं भवता कृष्ण संगतः //
text_mt:
To that great soul whose form is this entire great wondrous world,
to you, Kṛṣṇa, who surpass all wonders, I have come.

sanskrit_iast:
tat kim etena mathurāṃ prayāmo madhusūdana
bibhemi kaṃsād dhig janma parapiṇḍopajīvinaḥ //
meaning:
तत् किम् एतेन मथुरां प्रयामो मधुसूदन
बिभेमि कंसाद् धिग् जन्म परपिण्डोपजीविनः //
text_mt:
So why speak of this? Let us proceed to Mathurā, O Madhusūdana!
I fear Kaṃsa. Fie on a life lived depending on another’s bread!

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktvā codayām āsa tān hayān vātaraṃhasaḥ
saṃprāptaś cāpi sāyāhne so 'krūro mathurāṃ purīm
vilokya mathurāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ cāha sa yādavaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा चोदयाम् आस तान् हयान् वातरंहसः
संप्राप्तश् चापि सायाह्ने सो ऽक्रूरो मथुरां पुरीम्
विलोक्य मथुरां कृष्णं रामं चाह स यादवः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having spoken thus, he urged on those horses swift as the wind,
and Akrūra reached the city of Mathurā in the evening.
Seeing Mathurā, that Yādava said to Kṛṣṇa and Rāma:

sanskrit_iast:
akrūra uvāca
padbhyāṃ yātaṃ mahāvīryau rathenaiko viśāmy aham
gantavyaṃ vasudevasya no bhavadbhyāṃ tathā gṛhe
yuvayor hi kṛte vṛddhaḥ kaṃsena sa nirasyate //
meaning:
अक्रूर उवाच
पद्भ्यां यातं महावीर्यौ रथेनैको विशाम्य् अहम्
गन्तव्यं वसुदेवस्य नो भवद्भ्यां तथा गृहे
युवयोर् हि कृते वृद्धः कंसेन स निरस्यते //
text_mt:
Akrūra said:
Go on foot, O two of great valor! I will enter alone in the chariot.
You must not go likewise to Vasudeva’s house,
for on your account that old man is harassed by Kaṃsa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktvā praviveśāsāv akrūro mathurāṃ purīm
praviṣṭau rāmakṛṣṇau ca rājamārgam upāgatau //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रविवेशासाव् अक्रूरो मथुरां पुरीम्
प्रविष्टौ रामकृष्णौ च राजमार्गम् उपागतौ //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having spoken thus, Akrūra entered the city of Mathurā,
and Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, having entered, arrived on the royal highway.

sanskrit_iast:
strībhir naraiś ca sānandalocanair abhivikṣitau
jagmatur līlayā vīrau prāptau bālagajāv iva //
meaning:
स्त्रीभिर् नरैश् च सानन्दलोचनैर् अभिविक्षितौ
जग्मतुर् लीलया वीरौ प्राप्तौ बालगजाव् इव //
text_mt:
Gazed upon by women and men with delighted eyes,
the two heroes proceeded playfully, like two arrived young elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramamāṇau tu tau dṛṣṭvā rajakaṃ raṅgakārakam
ayācetāṃ svarūpāṇi vāsāṃsi rucirāṇi tau //
meaning:
भ्रममाणौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा रजकं रङ्गकारकम्
अयाचेतां स्वरूपाणि वासांसि रुचिराणि तौ //
text_mt:
As they wandered, seeing a washerman who was a dyer,
they asked him for beautiful garments of suitable form.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsasya rajakaḥ so 'tha prasādārūḍhavismayaḥ
bahūny ākṣepavākyāni prāhoccai rāmakeśavau //
meaning:
कंसस्य रजकः सो ऽथ प्रसादारूढविस्मयः
बहून्य् आक्षेपवाक्यानि प्राहोच्चै रामकेशवौ //
text_mt:
Then that washerman of Kaṃsa, filled with haughty insolence born of royal favor,
spoke many harsh insults loudly to Rāma and Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
tatas talaprahāreṇa kṛṣṇas tasya durātmanaḥ
pātayām āsa kopena rajakasya śiro bhuvi //
meaning:
ततस् तलप्रहारेण कृष्णस् तस्य दुरात्मनः
पातयाम् आस कोपेन रजकस्य शिरो भुवि //
text_mt:
Then, with a blow of his palm, Kṛṣṇa in anger struck off
that evil-minded washerman’s head to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvādāya ca vastrāṇi pītanīlāmbarau tataḥ
kṛṣṇarāmau mudāyuktau mālākāragṛhaṃ gatau //
meaning:
हत्वादाय च वस्त्राणि पीतनीलाम्बरौ ततः
कृष्णरामौ मुदायुक्तौ मालाकारगृहं गतौ //
text_mt:
Having killed him and taken the clothes, the two, dressed in yellow and dark blue garments,
Kṛṣṇa and Rāma, filled with joy, went to the house of a garland-maker.

sanskrit_iast:
vikāsinetrayugalo mālākāro 'tivismitaḥ
etau kasya kuto yātau manasācintayat tataḥ //
meaning:
विकासिनेत्रयुगलो मालाकारो ऽतिविस्मितः
एतौ कस्य कुतो यातौ मनसाचिन्तयत् ततः //
text_mt:
With a pair of wide-open eyes, the garland-maker, greatly amazed,
then thought in his mind: “Whose sons are these two, and whence have they come?”

sanskrit_iast:
pītanīlāmbaradharau dṛṣṭvātisumanoharau
sa tarkayām āsa tadā bhuvaṃ devāv upāgatau //
meaning:
पीतनीलाम्बरधरौ दृष्ट्वातिसुमनोहरौ
स तर्कयाम् आस तदा भुवं देवाव् उपागतौ //
text_mt:
Seeing them wearing yellow and dark blue garments, exceedingly charming,
he then surmised: “Two gods have arrived on earth.”

sanskrit_iast:
vikāśimukhapadmābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ puṣpāṇi yācitaḥ
bhuvaṃ viṣṭabhya hastābhyāṃ pasparśa śirasā mahīm //
meaning:
विकाशिमुखपद्माभ्यां ताभ्यां पुष्पाणि याचितः
भुवं विष्टभ्य हस्ताभ्यां पस्पर्श शिरसा महीम् //
text_mt:
Asked for flowers by the two with blossoming lotus-like faces,
he planted his hands on the ground and touched the earth with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
prasādasumukhau nāthau mama geham upāgatau
dhanyo 'ham arcayiṣyāmīty āha tau mālyajīvikaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसादसुमुखौ नाथौ मम गेहम् उपागतौ
धन्यो ऽहम् अर्चयिष्यामीत्य् आह तौ माल्यजीविकः //
text_mt:
“My two lords, gracious and sweet-faced, have arrived at my home!
Blessed am I; I shall worship you,” said that seller of garlands to them.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭavadanas tayoḥ puṣpāṇi kāmataḥ
cārūṇy etāni caitāni pradadau sa vilobhayan //
meaning:
ततः प्रहृष्टवदनस् तयोः पुष्पाणि कामतः
चारूण्य् एतानि चैतानि प्रददौ स विलोभयन् //
text_mt:
Then, with a joyful face, he gave them flowers as they desired,
alluring them: “These are beautiful, and these [too].”

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāsau mālākārottamo dadau
puṣpāṇi tābhyāṃ cārūṇi gandhavanty amalāni ca //
meaning:
पुनः पुनः प्रणम्यासौ मालाकारोत्तमो ददौ
पुष्पाणि ताभ्यां चारूणि गन्धवन्त्य् अमलानि च //
text_mt:
Bowing again and again, that best of garland-makers gave
flowers to both of them, lovely, fragrant, and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
mālākārāya kṛṣṇo 'pi prasannaḥ pradadau varam
śrīs tvāṃ matsaṃśrayā bhadra na kadācit tyajiṣyati //
meaning:
मालाकाराय कृष्णो ऽपि प्रसन्नः प्रददौ वरम्
श्रीस् त्वां मत्संश्रया भद्र न कदाचित् त्यजिष्यति //
text_mt:
Pleased, Kṛṣṇa too granted a boon to the garland-maker:
“Prosperity, relying on me, dear man, shall never leave you.

sanskrit_iast:
balahānir na te saumya dhanahānir athāpi vā
yāvad dharaṇisūryau ca saṃtatiḥ putrapautrikī //
meaning:
बलहानिर् न ते सौम्य धनहानिर् अथापि वा
यावद् धरणिसूर्यौ च संततिः पुत्रपौत्रिकी //
text_mt:
There will be no loss of strength for you, gentle one, nor any loss of wealth,
and your lineage of sons and grandsons will endure as long as the earth and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā ca vipulān bhogāṃs tvam ante matprasādataḥ
mamānusmaraṇaṃ prāpya divyalokam avāpsyasi //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा च विपुलान् भोगांस् त्वम् अन्ते मत्प्रसादतः
ममानुस्मरणं प्राप्य दिव्यलोकम् अवाप्स्यसि //
text_mt:
And having enjoyed vast pleasures, in the end, by my grace,
attaining remembrance of me, you will reach the celestial world.

sanskrit_iast:
dharme manaś ca te bhadra sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati
yuṣmatsaṃtatijātānāṃ dīrgham āyur bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
धर्मे मनश् च ते भद्र सर्वकालं भविष्यति
युष्मत्संततिजातानां दीर्घम् आयुर् भविष्यति //
text_mt:
Your mind will always be devoted to dharma, dear man;
those born in your lineage will have long life.

sanskrit_iast:
nopasargādikaṃ doṣaṃ yuṣmatsaṃtatisaṃbhavaḥ
avāpsyati mahābhāga yāvat sūryo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
नोपसर्गादिकं दोषं युष्मत्संततिसंभवः
अवाप्स्यति महाभाग यावत् सूर्यो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
No calamity or misfortune will fall upon one born of your lineage,
O highly fortunate one, as long as the sun shall endure.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktvā tadgṛhāt kṛṣṇo baladevasahāyavān
nirjagāma muniśreṣṭhā mālākāreṇa pūjitaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा तद्गृहात् कृष्णो बलदेवसहायवान्
निर्जगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठा मालाकारेण पूजितः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by Baladeva,
departed from his house, O best of sages, after being honored by the garland-maker.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
rājamārge tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sānulepanabhājanām
dadarśa kubjām āyāntīṃ navayauvanagocarām //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
राजमार्गे ततः कृष्णः सानुलेपनभाजनाम्
ददर्श कुब्जाम् आयान्तीं नवयौवनगोचराम् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Then on the royal highway, Kṛṣṇa saw a hunchbacked woman
approaching with a vessel of ointments, within the realm of fresh youth.

sanskrit_iast:
tām āha lalitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kasyedam anulepanam
bhavatyā nīyate satyaṃ vadendīvaralocane //
meaning:
ताम् आह ललितं कृष्णः कस्येदम् अनुलेपनम्
भवत्या नीयते सत्यं वदेन्दीवरलोचने //
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa playfully said to her: “For whom is this ointment
