meaning:
कृष्णो ऽपि बलभद्राद्यैर् यदुभिः परिवारितः
प्रययौ कुण्डिनं द्रष्टुं विवाहं चैद्यभूपतेः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa too, surrounded by Balabhadra and the other Yadus, / set out for Kuṇḍina to see the marriage of the king of the Cedis.

sanskrit_iast:
śvobhāvini vivāhe tu tāṃ kanyāṃ hṛtavān hariḥ
vipakṣabhāvam āsādya rāmādyeṣv eva bandhuṣu //
meaning:
श्वोभाविनि विवाहे तु तां कन्यां हृतवान् हरिः
विपक्षभावम् आसाद्य रामाद्येष्व् एव बन्धुषु //
text_mt: When the wedding was to take place on the next day, Hari carried off that maiden, / while relatives like Rāma and others assumed the role of an opposing force.

sanskrit_iast:
tataś ca pauṇḍrakaḥ śrīmān dantavaktro vidūrathaḥ
śiśupālo jarāsaṃdhaḥ śālvādyāś ca mahībhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ततश् च पौण्ड्रकः श्रीमान् दन्तवक्त्रो विदूरथः
शिशुपालो जरासंधः शाल्वाद्याश् च महीभृतः //
text_mt: And then the glorious Pauṇḍraka, Dantavaktra, Vidūratha, / Śiśupāla, Jarāsaṃdha, and kings such as Śālva,

sanskrit_iast:
kupitās te hariṃ hantuṃ cakrur udyogam uttamam
nirjitāś ca samāgamya rāmādyair yadupuṃgavaiḥ //
meaning:
कुपितास् ते हरिं हन्तुं चक्रुर् उद्योगम् उत्तमम्
निर्जिताश् च समागम्य रामाद्यैर् यदुपुंगवैः //
text_mt: enraged, made a supreme effort to kill Hari; / and coming together, they were completely defeated by the preeminent Yadus headed by Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi ahatvā yudhi keśavam
kṛtvā pratijñāṃ rukmī ca hantuṃ kṛṣṇam abhidrutaḥ //
meaning:
कुण्डिनं न प्रवेक्ष्यामि अहत्वा युधि केशवम्
कृत्वा प्रतिज्ञां रुक्मी च हन्तुं कृष्णम् अभिद्रुतः //
text_mt: "I will not enter Kuṇḍina without slaying Keśava in battle"— / having made this vow, Rukmin rushed forward to kill Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā balaṃ sa nāgāśvapattisyandanasaṃkulam
nirjitaḥ pātitaś corvyāṃ līlayaiva sa cakriṇā //
meaning:
हत्वा बलं स नागाश्वपत्तिस्यन्दनसंकुलम्
निर्जितः पातितश् चोर्व्यां लीलयैव स चक्रिणा //
text_mt: After destroying his army crowded with elephants, horses, foot-soldiers, and chariots, / he was effortlessly vanquished and thrown down to the earth by the wielder of the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjitya rukmiṇaṃ samyag upayeme sa rukmiṇīm
rākṣasena vidhānena saṃprāpto madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
निर्जित्य रुक्मिणं सम्यग् उपयेमे स रुक्मिणीम्
राक्षसेन विधानेन संप्राप्तो मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Having utterly defeated Rukmin, Madhusūdana, who had arrived, / married Rukmiṇī according to the rākṣasa rite.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jajñe ca pradyumno madanāṃśaḥ sa vīryavān
jahāra śambaro yaṃ vai yo jaghāna ca śambaram //
meaning:
तस्यां जज्ञे च प्रद्युम्नो मदनांशः स वीर्यवान्
जहार शम्बरो यं वै यो जघान च शम्बरम् //
text_mt: And upon her was born Pradyumna of great valor, a portion of Madana, / whom Śambara indeed abducted and who slew Śambara.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
śambareṇa hṛto vīraḥ pradyumnaḥ sa kathaṃ punaḥ
śambaraś ca mahāvīryaḥ pradyumnena kathaṃ hataḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
शम्बरेण हृतो वीरः प्रद्युम्नः स कथं पुनः
शम्बरश् च महावीर्यः प्रद्युम्नेन कथं हतः //
text_mt: The sages said: / How was that hero Pradyumna abducted by Śambara, / and how was Śambara of great valor slain by Pradyumna?

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ṣaṣṭhe 'hni jātamātre tu pradyumnaṃ sūtikāgṛhāt
mamaiṣa hanteti dvijā hṛtavān kālaśambaraḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
षष्ठे ऽह्नि जातमात्रे तु प्रद्युम्नं सूतिकागृहात्
ममैष हन्तेति द्विजा हृतवान् कालशम्बरः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / On the sixth day, just after he was born, Kālaśambara abducted Pradyumna / from the lying-in chamber, O twice-born ones, thinking, "This is my slayer!"

sanskrit_iast:
nītvā cikṣepa caivainaṃ grāho 'gre lavaṇārṇave
kallolajanitāvarte sughore makarālaye //
meaning:
नीत्वा चिक्षेप चैवैनं ग्राहो ऽग्रे लवणार्णवे
कल्लोलजनितावर्ते सुघोरे मकरालये //
text_mt: And carrying him off, the monster cast him forward into the salt ocean, / into that terrible abode of sea-monsters with whirlpools produced by billowing waves.

sanskrit_iast:
patitaṃ caiva tatraiko matsyo jagrāha bālakam
na mamāra ca tasyāpi jaṭharānaladīpitaḥ //
meaning:
पतितं चैव तत्रैको मत्स्यो जग्राह बालकम्
न ममार च तस्यापि जठरानलदीपितः //
text_mt: And a fish seized the boy who had fallen there; / yet, blazing with the fire of the boy's belly, it did not die.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyabandhaiś ca matsyo 'sau matsyair anyaiḥ saha dvijāḥ
ghātito 'suravaryāya śambarāya niveditaḥ //
meaning:
मत्स्यबन्धैश् च मत्स्यो ऽसौ मत्स्यैर् अन्यैः सह द्विजाः
घातितो ऽसुरवर्याय शम्बराय निवेदितः //
text_mt: And that fish, along with other fish, O twice-born ones, / was killed by fishermen and presented to the foremost Asura, Śambara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya māyāvatī nāma patnī sarvagṛheśvarī
kārayām āsa sūdānām ādhipatyam aninditā //
meaning:
तस्य मायावती नाम पत्नी सर्वगृहेश्वरी
कारयाम् आस सूदानाम् आधिपत्यम् अनिन्दिता //
text_mt: His wife named Māyāvatī, the mistress of the entire household, / blameless, exercised sovereignty over the cooks.

sanskrit_iast:
dārite matsyajaṭhare dadṛśe sātiśobhanam
kumāraṃ manmathataror dagdhasya prathamāṅkuram //
meaning:
दारिते मत्स्यजठरे ददृशे सातिशोभनम्
कुमारं मन्मथतरोर् दग्धस्य प्रथमाङ्कुरम् //
text_mt: When the belly of the fish was torn open, she saw an exceedingly handsome / boy, the first sprout of the burned tree of Manmatha.

sanskrit_iast:
ko 'yaṃ katham ayaṃ matsyajaṭhare samupāgataḥ
ity evaṃ kautukāviṣṭāṃ tāṃ tanvīṃ prāha nāradaḥ //
meaning:
को ऽयं कथम् अयं मत्स्यजठरे समुपागतः
इत्य् एवं कौतुकाविष्टां तां तन्वीं प्राह नारदः //
text_mt: "Who is this? How has he come into the belly of a fish?" / To that slender lady who was thus filled with wonder, Nārada spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
ayaṃ samastajagatāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇā
śambareṇa hṛtaḥ kṛṣṇatanayaḥ sūtikāgṛhāt //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अयं समस्तजगतां सृष्टिसंहारकारिणा
शम्बरेण हृतः कृष्णतनयः सूतिकागृहात् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / "This son of Kṛṣṇa has been abducted from the lying-in chamber / by Śambara, who brings about the creation and destruction of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣiptaḥ samudre matsyena nigīrṇas te vaśaṃ gataḥ
nararatnam idaṃ subhru viśrabdhā paripālaya //
meaning:
क्षिप्तः समुद्रे मत्स्येन निगीर्णस् ते वशं गतः
नररत्नम् इदं सुभ्रु विश्रब्धा परिपालय //
text_mt: Cast into the sea and swallowed by a fish, he has come under your power. / Protect this jewel among men with confidence, O fair-browed lady!"

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
nāradenaivam uktā sā pālayām āsa taṃ śiśum
bālyād evātirāgeṇa rūpātiśayamohitā //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
नारदेनैवम् उक्ता सा पालयाम् आस तं शिशुम्
बाल्याद् एवातिरागेण रूपातिशयमोहिता //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Thus addressed by Nārada, she reared that child / from his childhood with intense affection, infatuated by the perfection of his beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yadā yauvanābhogabhūṣito 'bhūd dvijottamāḥ
sābhilāṣā tadā sā tu babhūva gajagāminī //
meaning:
स यदा यौवनाभोगभूषितो ऽभूद् द्विजोत्तमाः
साभिलाषा तदा सा तु बभूव गजगामिनी //
text_mt: When he was adorned with the fullness of youth, O best of the twice-born, / then she, who walked like an elephant, was filled with desire.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāvatī dadau cāsmai māyā sarvā mahātmane
pradyumnāyātmabhūtāya tannyastahṛdayekṣaṇā
prasajjantīṃ tu tām āha sa kārṣṇiḥ kamalalocanaḥ //
meaning:
मायावती ददौ चास्मै माया सर्वा महात्मने
प्रद्युम्नायात्मभूताय तन्न्यस्तहृदयेक्षणा
प्रसज्जन्तीं तु ताम् आह स कार्ष्णिः कमललोचनः //
text_mt: And Māyāvatī imparted all illusory powers to the high-souled / Pradyumna, who had become her very self, her heart and eyes fixed upon him; / but to her who was clinging to him, the son of Kṛṣṇa, lotus-eyed, said:

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumna uvāca
mātṛbhāvaṃ vihāyaiva kimarthaṃ vartase 'nyathā //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्न उवाच
मातृभावं विहायैव किमर्थं वर्तसे ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: Pradyumna said: / "Why do you abandon maternal feelings and behave otherwise?"

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
sā cāsmai kathayām āsa na putras tvaṃ mameti vai
tanayaṃ tvām ayaṃ viṣṇor hṛtavān kālaśambaraḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
सा चास्मै कथयाम् आस न पुत्रस् त्वं ममेति वै
तनयं त्वाम् अयं विष्णोर् हृतवान् कालशम्बरः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / And she told him: "You are indeed not my son; / Kālaśambara carried you off, the son of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣiptaḥ samudre matsyasya saṃprāpto jaṭharān mayā
sā tu roditi te mātā kāntādyāpy ativatsalā //
meaning:
क्षिप्तः समुद्रे मत्स्यस्य संप्राप्तो जठरान् मया
सा तु रोदिति ते माता कान्ताद्याप्य् अतिवत्सला //
text_mt: You were thrown into the ocean and obtained by me from the belly of a fish; / but that mother of yours, deeply affectionate, still weeps for her beloved."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktaḥ śambaraṃ yuddhe pradyumnaḥ sa samāhvayat
krodhākulīkṛtamanā yuyudhe ca mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्तः शम्बरं युद्धे प्रद्युम्नः स समाह्वयत्
क्रोधाकुलीकृतमना युयुधे च महाबलः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Thus spoken to, Pradyumna challenged Śambara in battle; / with his mind agitated by anger, that one of great strength fought.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā sainyam aśeṣaṃ tu tasya daityasya mādhaviḥ
sapta māyā vyatikramya māyāṃ saṃyuyuje 'ṣṭamīm //
meaning:
हत्वा सैन्यम् अशेषं तु तस्य दैत्यस्य माधविः
सप्त माया व्यतिक्रम्य मायां संयुयुजे ऽष्टमीम् //
text_mt: Having slain the entire army of that Daitya, the descendant of Madhu, / having overcome seven illusory arts, employed the eighth illusory art.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā jaghāna taṃ daityaṃ māyayā kālaśambaram
utpatya ca tayā sārdham ājagāma pituḥ puram //
meaning:
तया जघान तं दैत्यं मायया कालशम्बरम्
उत्पत्य च तया सार्धम् आजगाम पितुः पुरम् //
text_mt: With that illusory power he slew that Daitya Kālaśambara; / and flying up with her, he went to his father's city.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥpure ca patitaṃ māyāvatyā samanvitam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭasaṃkalpā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ
rukmiṇī cābravīt premṇā āsaktadṛṣṭir aninditā //
meaning:
अन्तःपुरे च पतितं मायावत्या समन्वितम्
तं दृष्ट्वा हृष्टसंकल्पा बभूवुः कृष्णयोषितः
रुक्मिणी चाब्रवीत् प्रेम्णा आसक्तदृष्टिर् अनिन्दिता //
text_mt: Seeing him who had descended into the inner chambers together with Māyāvatī, / the wives of Kṛṣṇa became joyful in mind; / and Rukmiṇī, blameless, said with love, her gaze fixed upon him:

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇy uvāca
dhanyāyāḥ khalv ayaṃ putro vartate navayauvane
asmin vayasi putro me pradyumno yadi jīvati //
meaning:
रुक्मिण्य् उवाच
धन्यायाः खल्व् अयं पुत्रो वर्तते नवयौवने
अस्मिन् वयसि पुत्रो मे प्रद्युम्नो यदि जीवति //
text_mt: Rukmiṇī said: / "Fortunate indeed is the woman whose son this is, now in the prime of fresh youth; / my son Pradyumna would be at this age, if he is alive.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāgyā jananī vatsa tvayā kāpi vibhūṣitā
athavā yādṛśaḥ sneho mama yādṛg vapuś ca te
harer apatyaṃ suvyaktaṃ bhavān vatsa bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
सभाग्या जननी वत्स त्वया कापि विभूषिता
अथवा यादृशः स्नेहो मम यादृग् वपुश् च ते
हरेर् अपत्यं सुव्यक्तं भवान् वत्स भविष्यति //
text_mt: Some mother, O dear child, has been made fortunate, adorned by you! / Or, judging by the love that is mine and by your form, / you are very clearly Hari's offspring, my dear child!"

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
etasminn antare prāptaḥ saha kṛṣṇena nāradaḥ
antaḥpuravarāṃ devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ prāha harṣitaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे प्राप्तः सह कृष्णेन नारदः
अन्तःपुरवरां देवीं रुक्मिणीं प्राह हर्षितः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / In the meantime Nārada arrived together with Kṛṣṇa; / delighted, he spoke to Queen Rukmiṇī, the best of the inner chamber:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
eṣa te tanayaḥ subhru hatvā śambaram āgataḥ
hṛto yenābhavat pūrvaṃ putras te sūtikāgṛhāt //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
एष ते तनयः सुभ्रु हत्वा शम्बरम् आगतः
हृतो येनाभवत् पूर्वं पुत्रस् ते सूतिकागृहात् //
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "O fair-browed lady, this is your son who has returned after slaying Śambara, / by whom your son was previously abducted from the lying-in chamber.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ māyāvatī bhāryā tanayasyāsya te satī
śambarasya na bhāryeyaṃ śrūyatām atra kāraṇam //
meaning:
इयं मायावती भार्या तनयस्यास्य ते सती
शम्बरस्य न भार्येयं श्रूयताम् अत्र कारणम् //
text_mt: This virtuous Māyāvatī is the wife of this son of yours; / she is not Śambara's wife. Hear the reason for this:

sanskrit_iast:
manmathe tu gate nāśaṃ tadudbhavaparāyaṇā
śambaraṃ mohayām āsa māyārūpeṇa rukmiṇi //
meaning:
मन्मथे तु गते नाशं तदुद्भवपरायणा
शम्बरं मोहयाम् आस मायारूपेण रुक्मिणि //
text_mt: When Manmatha met his destruction, she, intent on his rebirth, / deluded Śambara with an illusory form, O Rukmiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhādyupabhogeṣu rūpaṃ māyāmayaṃ śubham
darśayām āsa daityasya tasyeyaṃ madirekṣaṇā //
meaning:
विवाहाद्युपभोगेषु रूपं मायामयं शुभम्
दर्शयाम् आस दैत्यस्य तस्येयं मदिरेक्षणा //
text_mt: In marriage and other pleasures, she of intoxicating eyes / displayed to that Daitya an illusory, auspicious form.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmo 'vatīrṇaḥ putras te tasyeyaṃ dayitā ratiḥ
viśaṅkā nātra kartavyā snuṣeyaṃ tava śobhanā //
meaning:
कामो ऽवतीर्णः पुत्रस् ते तस्येयं दयिता रतिः
विशङ्का नात्र कर्तव्या स्नुषेयं तव शोभना //
text_mt: Your son is Kāma descended, and this is his beloved Rati; / no doubt should be entertained here. She is your fair daughter-in-law."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tato harṣasamāviṣṭau rukmiṇīkeśavau tadā
nagarī ca samastā sā sādhu sādhv ity abhāṣata //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततो हर्षसमाविष्टौ रुक्मिणीकेशवौ तदा
नगरी च समस्ता सा साधु साध्व् इत्य् अभाषत //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Then Rukmiṇī and Keśava were filled with joy, / and the whole city cried out, “Well done! Well done!”

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ naṣṭena putreṇa saṃgatāṃ prekṣya rukmiṇīm
avāpa vismayaṃ sarvo dvāravatyāṃ janas tadā //
meaning:
चिरं नष्टेन पुत्रेण संगतां प्रेक्ष्य रुक्मिणीम्
अवाप विस्मयं सर्वो द्वारवत्यां जनस् तदा //
text_mt: Seeing Rukmiṇī reunited with her long-lost son, / all the people in Dvāravatī were filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
cārudeṣṇaṃ sudeṣṇaṃ ca cārudehaṃ ca śobhanam
suṣeṇaṃ cāruguptaṃ ca bhadracāruṃ tathāparam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
चारुदेष्णं सुदेष्णं च चारुदेहं च शोभनम्
सुषेणं चारुगुप्तं च भद्रचारुं तथापरम् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Cārudeṣṇa, Sudeṣṇa, the handsome Cārudeha, / Suṣeṇa, Cārugupta, and another, Bhadracāru,

sanskrit_iast:
cāruvindaṃ sucāruṃ ca cāruṃ ca balināṃ varam
rukmiṇy ajanayat putrān kanyāṃ cārumatīṃ tathā //
meaning:
चारुविन्दं सुचारुं च चारुं च बलिनां वरम्
रुक्मिण्य् अजनयत् पुत्रान् कन्यां चारुमतीं तथा //
text_mt: Cāruvinda, Sucāru, and Cāru, best of the strong— / Rukmiṇī bore these sons, and also a daughter, Cārumatī.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāś ca bhāryāḥ kṛṣṇasya babhūvuḥ sapta śobhanāḥ
kālindī mitravindā ca satyā nāgnajitī tathā //
meaning:
अन्याश् च भार्याः कृष्णस्य बभूवुः सप्त शोभनाः
कालिन्दी मित्रविन्दा च सत्या नाग्नजिती तथा //
text_mt: And Kṛṣṇa had seven other beautiful wives: / Kālindī, Mitravindā, and Satyā, the daughter of Nagnajit,

sanskrit_iast:
devī jāmbavatī cāpi sadā tuṣṭā tu rohiṇī
madrarājasutā cānyā suśīlā śīlamaṇḍalā //
meaning:
देवी जाम्बवती चापि सदा तुष्टा तु रोहिणी
मद्रराजसुता चान्या सुशीला शीलमण्डला //
text_mt: and the divine Jāmbavatī, and Rohiṇī, who was ever cheerful, / and another, the princess of Madra, virtuous and endowed with all good conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
sātrājitī satyabhāmā lakṣmaṇā cāruhāsinī
ṣoḍaśātra sahasrāṇi strīṇām anyāni cakriṇaḥ //
meaning:
सात्राजिती सत्यभामा लक्ष्मणा चारुहासिनी
षोडशात्र सहस्राणि स्त्रीणाम् अन्यानि चक्रिणः //
text_mt: Satyabhāmā, the daughter of Satrājit, and the sweet-smiling Lakṣmaṇā. / In addition to these, the wielder of the discus had sixteen thousand women.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumno 'pi mahāvīryo rukmiṇas tanayāṃ śubhām
svayaṃvarasthāṃ jagrāha sāpi taṃ tanayaṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नो ऽपि महावीर्यो रुक्मिणस् तनयां शुभाम्
स्वयंवरस्थां जग्राह सापि तं तनयं हरेः //
text_mt: The mighty Pradyumna too took the fair daughter of Rukmin / at her svayaṃvara, and she chose that son of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyām asyābhavat putro mahābalaparākramaḥ
aniruddho raṇe ruddho vīryodadhir ariṃdamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याम् अस्याभवत् पुत्रो महाबलपराक्रमः
अनिरुद्धो रणे रुद्धो वीर्योदधिर् अरिंदमः //
text_mt: Upon her he fathered a son of great strength and valor, / Aniruddha, unobstructed in battle, an ocean of prowess, a tamer of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi rukmiṇaḥ pautrīṃ varayām āsa keśavaḥ
dauhitrāya dadau rukmī spardhayann api śauriṇā //
meaning:
तस्यापि रुक्मिणः पौत्रीं वरयाम् आस केशवः
दौहित्राय ददौ रुक्मी स्पर्धयन्न् अपि शौरिणा //
text_mt: For him Keśava chose the granddaughter of Rukmin; / Rukmin gave her to his daughter’s son, even while rivaling Śauri.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā vivāhe rāmādyā yādavā hariṇā saha
rukmiṇo nagaraṃ jagmur nāmnā bhojakaṭaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तस्या विवाहे रामाद्या यादवा हरिणा सह
रुक्मिणो नगरं जग्मुर् नाम्ना भोजकटं द्विजाः //
text_mt: For his wedding, O twice-born ones, the Yādavas headed by Rāma, together with Hari, / went to Rukmin’s city, named Bhojakaṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhe tatra nirvṛtte prādyumneḥ sumahātmanaḥ
kaliṅgarājapramukhā rukmiṇaṃ vākyam abruvan //
meaning:
विवाहे तत्र निर्वृत्ते प्राद्युम्नेः सुमहात्मनः
कलिङ्गराजप्रमुखा रुक्मिणं वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् //
text_mt: When the marriage of Pradyumna’s high-souled son was concluded there, / [the kings] headed by the king of Kaliṅga addressed words to Rukmin:

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṅgādaya ūcuḥ
anakṣajño halī dyūte tathāsya vyasanaṃ mahat
tan nayāmo balaṃ tasmād dyūtenaiva mahādyute //
meaning:
कलिङ्गादय ऊचुः
अनक्षज्ञो हली द्यूते तथास्य व्यसनं महत्
तन् नयामो बलं तस्माद् द्यूतेनैव महाद्युते //
text_mt:
The Kaliṅga king and others said:
“The plow-wielder does not know dice, yet he has a great passion for gambling; / therefore, O greatly radiant one, let us defeat Bala by dice alone!”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tatheti tān āha nṛpān rukmī balasamanvitaḥ
sabhāyāṃ saha rāmeṇa cakre dyūtaṃ ca vai tadā //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तथेति तान् आह नृपान् रुक्मी बलसमन्वितः
सभायां सह रामेण चक्रे द्यूतं च वै तदा //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
“So be it,” Rukmin, endowed with might, said to those kings, / and then engaged in a game of dice with Rāma in the assembly hall.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasram ekaṃ niṣkāṇāṃ rukmiṇā vijito balaḥ
dvitīye divase cānyat sahasraṃ rukmiṇā jitaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रम् एकं निष्काणां रुक्मिणा विजितो बलः
द्वितीये दिवसे चान्यत् सहस्रं रुक्मिणा जितः //
text_mt: A thousand niṣkas were won from Bala by Rukmin; / on the second day, another thousand was won by Rukmin.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daśa sahasrāṇi niṣkāṇāṃ paṇam ādade
balabhadraprapannāni rukmī dyūtavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दश सहस्राणि निष्काणां पणम् आददे
बलभद्रप्रपन्नानि रुक्मी द्यूतविदां वरः //
text_mt: Then Rukmin, best among those skilled in dice, / accepted a wager of ten thousand niṣkas offered by Balabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jahāsātha balaṃ kaliṅgādhipatir dvijāḥ
dantān vidarśayan mūḍho rukmī cāha madoddhataḥ //
meaning:
ततो जहासाथ बलं कलिङ्गाधिपतिर् द्विजाः
दन्तान् विदर्शयन् मूढो रुक्मी चाह मदोद्धतः //
text_mt: Then, O twice-born ones, the foolish king of Kaliṅga laughed at Bala, / showing his teeth, and Rukmin, haughty with pride, said:

sanskrit_iast:
rukmy uvāca
avidyo 'yaṃ mahādyūte balabhadraḥ parājitaḥ
mṛṣaivākṣāvalepatvād yo 'yaṃ mene 'kṣakovidam //
meaning:
रुक्म्य् उवाच
अविद्यो ऽयं महाद्यूते बलभद्रः पराजितः
मृषैवाक्षावलेपत्वाद् यो ऽयं मेने ऽक्षकोविदम् //
text_mt:
Rukmin said:
“This Balabhadra, who is unskilled in the great game of dice, has been defeated! / In vain, out of vanity regarding the dice, did he deem himself skilled in dice!”

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kaliṅgarājaṃ tu prakāśadaśanānanam
rukmiṇaṃ cāpi durvākyaṃ kopaṃ cakre halāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कलिङ्गराजं तु प्रकाशदशनाननम्
रुक्मिणं चापि दुर्वाक्यं कोपं चक्रे हलायुधः //
text_mt: Seeing the king of Kaliṅga with his teeth bared in a grin, / and hearing Rukmin’s abusive words, the plow-armed one grew enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tataḥ kopaparītātmā niṣkakoṭiṃ halāyudhaḥ
glahaṃ jagrāha rukmī ca tatas tv akṣān apātayat //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा निष्ककोटिं हलायुधः
ग्लहं जग्राह रुक्मी च ततस् त्व् अक्षान् अपातयत् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Then, his mind seized by rage, the plow-armed one staked / a crore of niṣkas, and Rukmin cast the dice.

sanskrit_iast:
ajayad baladevo 'tha prāhoccais taṃ jitaṃ mayā
mameti rukmī prāhoccair alīkoktair alaṃ balam //
meaning:
अजयद् बलदेवो ऽथ प्राहोच्चैस् तं जितं मया
ममेति रुक्मी प्राहोच्चैर् अलीकोक्तैर् अलं बलम् //
text_mt: Baladeva won, and said aloud: “I have won!” / “It is mine!” Rukmin said loudly, “enough of your false claims, Bala!”

sanskrit_iast:
tvayokto 'yaṃ glahaḥ satyaṃ na mamaiṣo 'numoditaḥ
evaṃ tvayā ced vijitaṃ na mayā vijitaṃ katham //
meaning:
त्वयोक्तो ऽयं ग्लहः सत्यं न ममैषो ऽनुमोदितः
एवं त्वया चेद् विजितं न मया विजितं कथम् //
text_mt: “This wager was declared by you, true, but it was not agreed to by me. / If you have won in this manner, why have I not won?”

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ntarikṣe vāg uccaiḥ prāha gambhīranādinī
baladevasya taṃ kopaṃ vardhayantī mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽन्तरिक्षे वाग् उच्चैः प्राह गम्भीरनादिनी
बलदेवस्य तं कोपं वर्धयन्ती महात्मनः //
text_mt: Then a voice in the sky spoke aloud in a deep roar, / increasing the wrath of the high-souled Baladeva:

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśavāg uvāca
jitaṃ tu baladevena rukmiṇā bhāṣitaṃ mṛṣā
anuktvā vacanaṃ kiṃcit kṛtaṃ bhavati karmaṇā //
meaning:
आकाशवाग् उवाच
जितं तु बलदेवेन रुक्मिणा भाषितं मृषा
अनुक्त्वा वचनं किंचित् कृतं भवति कर्मणा //
text_mt:
The voice in the sky said:
“It was indeed won by Baladeva; Rukmin has spoken falsely. / Even without uttering a word, [consent] is established by action.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tato balaḥ samutthāya krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
jaghānāṣṭāpadenaiva rukmiṇaṃ sa mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततो बलः समुत्थाय क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
जघानाष्टापदेनैव रुक्मिणं स महाबलः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Then Bala arose, his eyes bloodshot with rage, / and that mighty one struck Rukmin dead with the gaming board itself.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṅgarājaṃ cādāya visphurantaṃ balād balaḥ
babhañja dantān kupito yaiḥ prakāśaṃ jahāsa saḥ //
meaning:
कलिङ्गराजं चादाय विस्फुरन्तं बलाद् बलः
बभञ्ज दन्तान् कुपितो यैः प्रकाशं जहास सः //
text_mt: And violently seizing the trembling king of Kaliṅga, / Bala, in his fury, smashed the teeth with which he had openly laughed.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣya ca mahāstambhaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ balaḥ
jaghāna ye tatpakṣās tān bhūbhṛtaḥ kupito balaḥ //
meaning:
आकृष्य च महास्तम्भं जातरूपमयं बलः
जघान ये तत्पक्षास् तान् भूभृतः कुपितो बलः //
text_mt: Uprooting a massive pillar made of gold, / the enraged Bala struck down the kings who were on his side.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ palāyanaparaṃ dvijāḥ
tad rājamaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva kupite bale //
meaning:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं पलायनपरं द्विजाः
तद् राजमण्डलं सर्वं बभूव कुपिते बले //
text_mt: Then a cry of woe arose, and all of them took to flight, O twice-born ones; / that entire circle of kings fled when Bala was enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
balena nihataṃ śrutvā rukmiṇaṃ madhusūdanaḥ
novāca vacanaṃ kiṃcid rukmiṇībalayor bhayāt //
meaning:
बलेन निहतं श्रुत्वा रुक्मिणं मधुसूदनः
नोवाच वचनं किंचिद् रुक्मिणीबलयोर् भयात् //
text_mt: Hearing that Rukmin had been slain by Bala, Madhusūdana / said not a word, out of fear for both Rukmiṇī and Bala.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'niruddham ādāya kṛtodvāhaṃ dvijottamāḥ
dvārakām ājagāmātha yaducakraṃ sakeśavam //
meaning:
ततो ऽनिरुद्धम् आदाय कृतोद्वाहं द्विजोत्तमाः
द्वारकाम् आजगामाथ यदुचक्रं सकेशवम् //
text_mt: Then, taking Aniruddha, who had concluded his marriage, O best of the twice-born, / the host of the Yadus returned to Dvārakā along with Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
dvāravatyāṃ tataḥ śauriṃ śakras tribhuvaneśvaraḥ
ājagāmātha munayo mattairāvatapṛṣṭhagaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
द्वारवत्यां ततः शौरिं शक्रस् त्रिभुवनेश्वरः
आजगामाथ मुनयो मत्तैरावतपृष्ठगः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Then Śakra, the lord of the three worlds, mounted on the rutting Airāvata, / came to Śauri in Dvāravatī, O sages.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya dvārakāṃ so 'tha samīpe ca hares tadā
kathayām āsa daityasya narakasya viceṣṭitam //
meaning:
प्रविश्य द्वारकां सो ऽथ समीपे च हरेस् तदा
कथयाम् आस दैत्यस्य नरकस्य विचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Entering Dvārakā, he then approached Hari / and recounted the deeds of the Daitya Naraka:

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
tvayā nāthena devānāṃ manuṣyatve 'pi tiṣṭhatā
praśamaṃ sarvaduḥkhāni nītāni madhusūdana //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
त्वया नाथेन देवानां मनुष्यत्वे ऽपि तिष्ठता
प्रशमं सर्वदुःखानि नीतानि मधुसूदन //
text_mt:
Indra said:
“With you as protector of the gods, even while dwelling in human form, / all afflictions have been brought to an end, O Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvijanarakṣāyai so 'riṣṭo dhenukas tathā
pralambādyās tathā keśī te sarve nihatās tvayā //
meaning:
तपस्विजनरक्षायै सो ऽरिष्टो धेनुकस् तथा
प्रलम्बाद्यास् तथा केशी ते सर्वे निहतास् त्वया //
text_mt: For the protection of ascetics, Ariṣṭa, Dhenuka, / Pralamba and the rest, and Keśin—all of them have been slain by you.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsaḥ kuvalayāpīḍaḥ pūtanā bālaghātinī
nāśaṃ nītās tvayā sarve ye 'nye jagadupadravāḥ //
meaning:
कंसः कुवलयापीडः पूतना बालघातिनी
नाशं नीतास् त्वया सर्वे ये ऽन्ये जगदुपद्रवाः //
text_mt: Kaṃsa, Kuvalayāpīḍa, and Pūtanā the slayer of children, / and all other afflictions of the world have been brought to destruction by you.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmaddordaṇḍasaṃbuddhiparitrāte jagattraye
yajñe yajñahaviḥ prāśya tṛptiṃ yānti divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
युष्मद्दोर्दण्डसंबुद्धिपरित्राते जगत्त्रये
यज्ञे यज्ञहविः प्राश्य तृप्तिं यान्ति दिवौकसः //
text_mt: When the three worlds are guarded by your formidable arms, / the dwellers of heaven attain satisfaction by consuming the sacrificial oblation at sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ sāṃpratam āyāto yannimittaṃ janārdana
tac chrutvā tatpratīkāraprayatnaṃ kartum arhasi //
meaning:
सो ऽहं सांप्रतम् आयातो यन्निमित्तं जनार्दन
तच् छ्रुत्वा तत्प्रतीकारप्रयत्नं कर्तुम् अर्हसि //
text_mt: The cause for which I have now come, O Janārdana— / hear it, and deign to make an effort to remedy it.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumo 'yaṃ narako nāma prāgjyotiṣapureśvaraḥ
karoti sarvabhūtānām apaghātam ariṃdama //
meaning:
भौमो ऽयं नरको नाम प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरेश्वरः
करोति सर्वभूतानाम् अपघातम् अरिंदम //
text_mt: This son of the Earth, named Naraka, ruler of the city of Prāgjyotiṣa, / brings destruction to all living beings, O tamer of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
devasiddhasurādīnāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca janārdana
hatvā tu so 'suraḥ kanyā rurodha nijamandire //
meaning:
देवसिद्धसुरादीनां नृपाणां च जनार्दन
हत्वा तु सो ऽसुरः कन्या रुरोध निजमन्दिरे //
text_mt: Having slain gods, siddhas, asuras, and kings, O Janārdana, / that asura has confined their maidens in his own palace.

sanskrit_iast:
chattraṃ yat salilasrāvi taj jahāra pracetasaḥ
mandarasya tathā śṛṅgaṃ hṛtavān maṇiparvatam //
meaning:
छत्त्रं यत् सलिलस्रावि तज् जहार प्रचेतसः
मन्दरस्य तथा शृङ्गं हृतवान् मणिपर्वतम् //
text_mt: He stole the umbrella of Pracetas which sheds water, / and he took the peak of Mandara, the jeweled mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtasrāviṇī divye mātur me 'mṛtakuṇḍale
jahāra so 'suro 'dityā vāñchaty airāvataṃ dvipam //
meaning:
अमृतस्राविणी दिव्ये मातुर् मे ऽमृतकुण्डले
जहार सो ऽसुरो ऽदित्या वाञ्छत्य् ऐरावतं द्विपम् //
text_mt: That asura stole the two divine earrings of my mother Aditi, dripping with nectar, / and he covets the elephant Airāvata.

sanskrit_iast:
durnītam etad govinda mayā tasya tavoditam
yad atra pratikartavyaṃ tat svayaṃ parimṛśyatām //
meaning:
दुर्नीतम् एतद् गोविन्द मया तस्य तवोदितम्
यद् अत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत् स्वयं परिमृश्यताम् //
text_mt: This misconduct of his has been related to you by me, O Govinda; / consider yourself what should be done as a remedy in this matter.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
iti śrutvā smitaṃ kṛtvā bhagavān devakīsutaḥ
gṛhītvā vāsavaṃ haste samuttasthau varāsanāt //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा स्मितं कृत्वा भगवान् देवकीसुतः
गृहीत्वा वासवं हस्ते समुत्तस्थौ वरासनात् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having heard this and smiled, the blessed son of Devakī / took Vāsava by the hand and rose from his splendid seat.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcintitam upāruhya garuḍaṃ gaganecaram
satyabhāmāṃ samāropya yayau prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram //
meaning:
संचिन्तितम् उपारुह्य गरुडं गगनेचरम्
सत्यभामां समारोप्य ययौ प्राग्ज्योतिषं पुरम् //
text_mt: Mounting the sky-wandering Garuḍa, summoned by thought, / and taking Satyabhāmā with him, he set out for the city of Prāgjyotiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgaṃ śakro 'pi tridaśālayam
tato jagāma sumanāḥ paśyatāṃ dvārakaukasām //
meaning:
आरुह्यैरावतं नागं शक्रो ऽपि त्रिदशालयम्
ततो जगाम सुमनाः पश्यतां द्वारकौकसाम् //
text_mt: Śakra too, mounting the elephant Airāvata, / then went to the abode of the thirty gods with a joyful mind, as the residents of Dvārakā looked on.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgjyotiṣapurasyāsya samantāc chatayojanam
ācitaṃ bhairavaiḥ pāśaiḥ parasainyanivāraṇe //
meaning:
प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरस्यास्य समन्ताच् छतयोजनम्
आचितं भैरवैः पाशैः परसैन्यनिवारणे //
text_mt: For a hundred yojanas all around this city of Prāgjyotiṣa, / it was covered with terrible snares to ward off enemy armies.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃś ciccheda hariḥ pāśān kṣiptvā cakraṃ sudarśanam
tato muraḥ samuttasthau taṃ jaghāna ca keśavaḥ //
meaning:
तांश् चिच्छेद हरिः पाशान् क्षिप्त्वा चक्रं सुदर्शनम्
ततो मुरः समुत्तस्थौ तं जघान च केशवः //
text_mt: Hari cut those snares, hurling the Sudarśana discus; / then Mura arose, and Keśava slew him.

sanskrit_iast:
muros tu tanayān sapta sahasrās tāṃs tato hariḥ
cakradhārāgninirdagdhāṃś cakāra śalabhān iva //
meaning:
मुरोस् तु तनयान् सप्त सहस्रास् तांस् ततो हरिः
चक्रधाराग्निनिर्दग्धांश् चकार शलभान् इव //
text_mt:
Then Hari burned Mura's seven thousand sons
with the fire of his discus's edge, like moths.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā muraṃ hayagrīvaṃ tathā pañcajanaṃ dvijāḥ
prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ dhīmāṃs tvarāvān samupādravat //
meaning:
हत्वा मुरं हयग्रीवं तथा पञ्चजनं द्विजाः
प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं धीमांस् त्वरावान् समुपाद्रवत् //
text_mt:
Having slain Mura, Hayagrīva, and likewise Pañcajana, O twice-born ones,
the wise and swift one rushed toward the city of Prāgjyotiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
narakenāsya tatrābhūn mahāsainyena saṃyugaḥ
kṛṣṇasya yatra govindo jaghne daityān sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
नरकेनास्य तत्राभून् महासैन्येन संयुगः
कृष्णस्य यत्र गोविन्दो जघ्ने दैत्यान् सहस्रशः //
text_mt:
There took place a battle with Naraka and his vast army,
in which Govinda, Kṛṣṇa, slew Daityas by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāstravarṣaṃ muñcantaṃ sa bhaumaṃ narakaṃ balī
kṣiptvā cakraṃ dvidhā cakre cakrī daiteyacakrahā //
meaning:
शस्त्रास्त्रवर्षं मुञ्चन्तं स भौमं नरकं बली
क्षिप्त्वा चक्रं द्विधा चक्रे चक्री दैतेयचक्रहा //
text_mt:
Hurling his discus at Naraka, son of the Earth, who was discharging a rain of weapons and missiles,
the mighty wielder of the discus, slayer of the host of Daityas, cleaved him in two.

sanskrit_iast:
hate tu narake bhūmir gṛhītvāditikuṇḍale
upatasthe jagannāthaṃ vākyaṃ cedam athābravīt //
meaning:
हते तु नरके भूमिर् गृहीत्वादितिकुण्डले
उपतस्थे जगन्नाथं वाक्यं चेदम् अथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
When Naraka was slain, the Earth took Aditi's two earrings,
approached the Lord of the World, and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇy uvāca
yadāham uddhṛtā nātha tvayā śūkaramūrtinā
tvatsaṃsparśabhavaḥ putras tadāyaṃ mayy ajāyata //
meaning:
धरण्य् उवाच
यदाहम् उद्धृता नाथ त्वया शूकरमूर्तिना
त्वत्संस्पर्शभवः पुत्रस् तदायं मय्य् अजायत //
text_mt:
Dharaṇī said:
When I was lifted up by you in the form of a boar, O Lord,
then this son was born in me from contact with you.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'yaṃ tvayaiva datto me tvayaiva vinipātitaḥ
gṛhāṇa kuṇḍale ceme pālayāsya ca saṃtatim //
meaning:
सो ऽयं त्वयैव दत्तो मे त्वयैव विनिपातितः
गृहाण कुण्डले चेमे पालयास्य च संततिम् //
text_mt:
He was given to me by you alone, and by you alone he has been struck down.
Take these two earrings, and protect his progeny.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārāvataraṇārthāya mamaiva bhagavān imam
aṃśena lokam āyātaḥ prasādasumukha prabho //
meaning:
भारावतरणार्थाय ममैव भगवान् इमम्
अंशेन लोकम् आयातः प्रसादसुमुख प्रभो //
text_mt:
For the purpose of removing my burden, the Blessed One has come to this world
with a portion [of himself], O Lord gracious of countenance!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kartā ca vikartā ca saṃhartā prabhavo 'vyayaḥ
jagatsvarūpo yaś ca tvaṃ stūyase 'cyuta kiṃ mayā //
meaning:
त्वं कर्ता च विकर्ता च संहर्ता प्रभवो ऽव्ययः
जगत्स्वरूपो यश् च त्वं स्तूयसे ऽच्युत किं मया //
text_mt:
You are the creator, the transformer, the destroyer, the origin, imperishable;
you whose form is the world, how can you be praised by me, O Acyuta?

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpī vyāpyaḥ kriyā kartā kāryaṃ ca bhagavān sadā
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā stūyase 'cyuta kiṃ mayā //
meaning:
व्यापी व्याप्यः क्रिया कर्ता कार्यं च भगवान् सदा
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा स्तूयसे ऽच्युत किं मया //
text_mt:
Always the pervader, the pervaded, the action, the agent, and the effect, O Blessed One,
the self of the self of all beings—how can you be praised by me, O Acyuta?

sanskrit_iast:
paramātmā tvam ātmā ca bhūtātmā cāvyayo bhavān
yadā tadā stutir nāsti kimarthaṃ te pravartatām //
meaning:
परमात्मा त्वम् आत्मा च भूतात्मा चाव्ययो भवान्
यदा तदा स्तुतिर् नास्ति किमर्थं ते प्रवर्तताम् //
text_mt:
When you are the supreme self, the self, the self of beings, and the imperishable one,
then praise does not exist; to what end should it proceed for you?

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda sarvabhūtātman narakena kṛtaṃ ca yat
tat kṣamyatām adoṣāya matsutaḥ sa nipātitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसीद सर्वभूतात्मन् नरकेन कृतं च यत्
तत् क्षम्यताम् अदोषाय मत्सुतः स निपातितः //
text_mt:
Be gracious, O Self of all beings! And whatever was done by Naraka,
let that be forgiven; so that he would be guiltless, my son was struck down.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tatheti coktvā dharaṇīṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ
ratnāni narakāvāsāj jagrāha munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तथेति चोक्त्वा धरणीं भगवान् भूतभावनः
रत्नानि नरकावासाज् जग्राह मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Saying "So be it" to the Earth, the Blessed One, creator of beings,
took the jewels from Naraka's dwelling, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāpure sa kanyānāṃ ṣoḍaśātulavikramaḥ
śatādhikāni dadṛśe sahasrāṇi dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
कन्यापुरे स कन्यानां षोडशातुलविक्रमः
शताधिकानि ददृशे सहस्राणि द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
In the women's quarters he of peerless valor saw sixteen thousand
and one hundred maidens, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaṃṣṭrān gajāṃś cogrān ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi dṛṣṭavān
kāmbojānāṃ tathāśvānāṃ niyutāny ekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
चतुर्दंष्ट्रान् गजांश् चोग्रान् षट् सहस्राणि दृष्टवान्
काम्बोजानां तथाश्वानां नियुतान्य् एकविंशतिम् //
text_mt:
He also saw six thousand fierce elephants with four tusks,
and two million one hundred thousand Kāmboja horses.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyās tāś ca tathā nāgāṃs tān aśvān dvārakāṃ purīm
prāpayām āsa govindaḥ sadyo narakakiṃkaraiḥ //
meaning:
कन्यास् ताश् च तथा नागांस् तान् अश्वान् द्वारकां पुरीम्
प्रापयाम् आस गोविन्दः सद्यो नरककिंकरैः //
text_mt:
Those maidens, and likewise those elephants and horses,
Govinda dispatched immediately to the city of Dvārakā by Naraka's servants.

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśe vāruṇaṃ chattraṃ tathaiva maṇiparvatam
āropayām āsa harir garuḍe patageśvare //
meaning:
ददृशे वारुणं छत्त्रं तथैव मणिपर्वतम्
आरोपयाम् आस हरिर् गरुडे पतगेश्वरे //
text_mt:
He saw the umbrella of Varuṇa and likewise the Jewel Mountain;
Hari loaded them onto Garuḍa, the lord of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya ca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ satyabhāmāsahāyavān
adityāḥ kuṇḍale dātuṃ jagāma tridaśālayam //
meaning:
आरुह्य च स्वयं कृष्णः सत्यभामासहायवान्
अदित्याः कुण्डले दातुं जगाम त्रिदशालयम् //
text_mt:
Mounting [him] himself along with his companion Satyabhāmā,
Kṛṣṇa went to the abode of the gods to give the earrings to Aditi.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
garuḍo vāruṇaṃ chattraṃ tathaiva maṇiparvatam
sabhāryaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ līlayaiva vahan yayau //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
गरुडो वारुणं छत्त्रं तथैव मणिपर्वतम्
सभार्यं च हृषीकेशं लीलयैव वहन् ययौ //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Effortlessly carrying the umbrella of Varuṇa, the Jewel Mountain,
and Hṛṣīkeśa accompanied by his wife, Garuḍa went forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śaṅkham upādhmāya svargadvāraṃ gato hariḥ
upatasthus tato devāḥ sārghapātrā janārdanam //
meaning:
ततः शङ्खम् उपाध्माय स्वर्गद्वारं गतो हरिः
उपतस्थुस् ततो देवाः सार्घपात्रा जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
Then Hari, having blown his conch, reached the gate of heaven;
there the gods, holding vessels of argha offerings, approached Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
sa devair arcitaḥ kṛṣṇo devamātur niveśanam
sitābhraśikharākāraṃ praviśya dadṛśe 'ditim //
meaning:
स देवैर् अर्चितः कृष्णो देवमातुर् निवेशनम्
सिताभ्रशिखराकारं प्रविश्य ददृशे ऽदितिम् //
text_mt:
Worshiped by the gods, Kṛṣṇa entered the dwelling of the mother of the gods,
which resembled the peak of a white cloud, and saw Aditi.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāṃ praṇamya śakreṇa sahitaḥ kuṇḍalottame
dadau narakanāśaṃ ca śaśaṃsāsyai janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
स तां प्रणम्य शक्रेण सहितः कुण्डलोत्तमे
ददौ नरकनाशं च शशंसास्यै जनार्दनः //
text_mt:
Bowing to her together with Śakra, Janārdana gave her
the two excellent earrings and told her of the destruction of Naraka.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prītā jaganmātā dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ harim
tuṣṭāvāditir avyagraṃ kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रीता जगन्माता धातारं जगतां हरिम्
तुष्टावादितिर् अव्यग्रं कृत्वा तत्प्रवणं मनः //
text_mt:
Then, delighted, Aditi, mother of the worlds, praised Hari,
the creator of the worlds, making her focused mind intent on him.

sanskrit_iast:
aditir uvāca
namas te puṇḍarīkākṣa bhaktānām abhayaṃkara
sanātanātman bhūtātman sarvātman bhūtabhāvana //
meaning:
अदितिर् उवाच
नमस् ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष भक्तानाम् अभयंकर
सनातनात्मन् भूतात्मन् सर्वात्मन् भूतभावन //
text_mt:
Aditi said:
Homage to you, lotus-eyed one, granter of fearlessness to devotees,
eternal self, self of beings, self of all, creator of beings!

sanskrit_iast:
praṇetar manaso buddher indriyāṇāṃ guṇātmaka
sitadīrghādiniḥśeṣakalpanāparivarjita //
meaning:
प्रणेतर् मनसो बुद्धेर् इन्द्रियाणां गुणात्मक
सितदीर्घादिनिःशेषकल्पनापरिवर्जित //
text_mt:
Guide of the mind, the intellect, and the senses, composed of the guṇas,
devoid of all conceptual constructs such as white or long!

sanskrit_iast:
janmādibhir asaṃspṛṣṭasvapnādivārivarjitaḥ
saṃdhyā rātrir ahar bhūmir gaganaṃ vāyur ambu ca //
meaning:
जन्मादिभिर् असंस्पृष्टस्वप्नादिवारिवर्जितः
संध्या रात्रिर् अहर् भूमिर् गगनं वायुर् अम्बु च //
text_mt:
Untouched by birth and the like, devoid of sleep and the like;
you are twilight, night, day, earth, sky, wind, and water,

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśano mano buddhir bhūtādis tvaṃ tathācyuta
sṛṣṭisthitivināśānāṃ kartā kartṛpatir bhavān //
meaning:
हुताशनो मनो बुद्धिर् भूतादिस् त्वं तथाच्युत
सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशानां कर्ता कर्तृपतिर् भवान् //
text_mt:
fire, mind, intellect, and the ego-principle, O Acyuta!
You are the agent of creation, preservation, and destruction, the lord of agents.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivākhyābhir ātmamūrtibhir īśvaraḥ
māyābhir etad vyāptaṃ te jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाख्याभिर् आत्ममूर्तिभिर् ईश्वरः
मायाभिर् एतद् व्याप्तं ते जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt:
Through your forms known as Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, you are the Lord;
by your illusory powers this world, moving and unmoving, is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
anātmany ātmavijñānaṃ sā te māyā janārdana
ahaṃ mameti bhāvo 'tra yayā samupajāyate //
meaning:
अनात्मन्य् आत्मविज्ञानं सा ते माया जनार्दन
अहं ममेति भावो ऽत्र यया समुपजायते //
text_mt:
The notion of self in what is not-self is that illusory power of yours, O Janārdana,
by which the feeling of "I" and "mine" arises here.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāramadhye māyāyās tavaitan nātha ceṣṭitam
yaiḥ svadharmaparair nātha narair ārādhito bhavān //
meaning:
संसारमध्ये मायायास् तवैतन् नाथ चेष्टितम्
यैः स्वधर्मपरैर् नाथ नरैर् आराधितो भवान् //
text_mt:
In the midst of saṃsāra, O Lord, this is the working of your illusory power;
by those men devoted to their own dharma by whom you, O Lord, are worshiped,

sanskrit_iast:
te taranty akhilām etāṃ māyām ātmavimuktaye
brahmādyāḥ sakalā devā manuṣyāḥ paśavas tathā //
meaning:
ते तरन्त्य् अखिलाम् एतां मायाम् आत्मविमुक्तये
ब्रह्माद्याः सकला देवा मनुष्याः पशवस् तथा //
text_mt:
they cross over this entire illusory power for the sake of self-liberation.
All gods beginning with Brahmā, humans, and likewise beasts,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāyāmahāvarte mohāndhatamasāvṛtāḥ
ārādhya tvām abhīpsante kāmān ātmabhavakṣaye //
meaning:
विष्णुमायामहावर्ते मोहान्धतमसावृताः
आराध्य त्वाम् अभीप्सन्ते कामान् आत्मभवक्षये //
text_mt:
covered in blinding darkness of delusion within the great whirlpool of Viṣṇu's illusory power,
having worshiped you, desire sense-pleasures at the dissolution of their own existence.

sanskrit_iast:
pade te puruṣā baddhā māyayā bhagavaṃs tava
mayā tvaṃ putrakāminyā vairipakṣakṣayāya ca //
meaning:
पदे ते पुरुषा बद्धा मायया भगवंस् तव
मया त्वं पुत्रकामिन्या वैरिपक्षक्षयाय च //
text_mt:
Bound at your feet by illusory power, O Blessed One, are all men;
by me, desiring sons and the destruction of the enemy faction,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhito na mokṣāya māyāvilasitaṃ hi tat
kaupīnācchādanaprāyā vāñchā kalpadrumād api //
meaning:
आराधितो न मोक्षाय मायाविलसितं हि तत्
कौपीनाच्छादनप्राया वाञ्छा कल्पद्रुमाद् अपि //
text_mt:
you were worshiped, but not for liberation; for that is the play of illusory power.
When even from the wish-fulfilling tree a desire arises

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate yad apuṇyānāṃ so 'parādhaḥ svadoṣajaḥ
tat prasīdākhilajaganmāyāmohakarāvyaya //
meaning:
जायते यद् अपुण्यानां सो ऽपराधः स्वदोषजः
तत् प्रसीदाखिलजगन्मायामोहकराव्यय //
text_mt:
merely for a loincloth on the part of the meritless, that offense is born of one's own fault.
Therefore be gracious, O imperishable creator of delusion through the illusory power of the entire world!

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānaṃ jñānasadbhāva bhūtabhūteśa nāśaya
namas te cakrahastāya śārṅgahastāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञानं ज्ञानसद्भाव भूतभूतेश नाशय
नमस् ते चक्रहस्ताय शार्ङ्गहस्ताय ते नमः //
text_mt:
Destroy ignorance, O true essence of knowledge, lord of beings and elements!
Homage to you who hold the discus in hand; homage to you who hold the Śārṅga bow in hand!

sanskrit_iast:
gadāhastāya te viṣṇo śaṅkhahastāya te namaḥ
etat paśyāmi te rūpaṃ sthūlacihnopaśobhitam
na jānāmi paraṃ yat te prasīda parameśvara //
meaning:
गदाहस्ताय ते विष्णो शङ्खहस्ताय ते नमः
एतत् पश्यामि ते रूपं स्थूलचिह्नोपशोभितम्
न जानामि परं यत् ते प्रसीद परमेश्वर //

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
adityaivaṃ stuto viṣṇuḥ prahasyāha surāraṇim //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अदित्यैवं स्तुतो विष्णुः प्रहस्याह सुरारणिम् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Thus praised by Aditi, Viṣṇu smiled and said to the mother of the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
mātā devi tvam asmākaṃ prasīda varadā bhava //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
माता देवि त्वम् अस्माकं प्रसीद वरदा भव //
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
O goddess, you are our mother; be gracious, be the granter of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
aditir uvāca
evam astu yathecchā te tvam aśeṣasurāsuraiḥ
ajeyaḥ puruṣavyāghra martyaloke bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
अदितिर् उवाच
एवम् अस्तु यथेच्छा ते त्वम् अशेषसुरासुरैः
अजेयः पुरुषव्याघ्र मर्त्यलोके भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
Aditi said:
So be it, according to your wish! By all the gods and Asuras
you shall be unconquerable in the world of mortals, O tiger among men!

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tato 'nantaram evāsya śakrāṇīsahitāṃ ditim
satyabhāmā praṇamyāha prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततो ऽनन्तरम् एवास्य शक्राणीसहितां दितिम्
सत्यभामा प्रणम्याह प्रसीदेति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Immediately after this, Satyabhāmā bowed to Diti accompanied by Śakra's wife
and said repeatedly, "Be gracious!"

sanskrit_iast:
aditir uvāca
matprasādān na te subhru jarā vairūpyam eva ca
bhaviṣyaty anavadyāṅgi sarvakāmā bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
अदितिर् उवाच
मत्प्रसादान् न ते सुभ्रु जरा वैरूप्यम् एव च
भविष्यत्य् अनवद्याङ्गि सर्वकामा भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
Aditi said:
By my grace, O fair-browed one, neither old age nor disfigurement
shall happen to you, O flawless-limbed one; you shall have all your desires fulfilled!

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
adityā tu kṛtānujño devarājo janārdanam
yathāvat pūjayām āsa bahumānapuraḥsaram //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अदित्या तु कृतानुज्ञो देवराजो जनार्दनम्
यथावत् पूजयाम् आस बहुमानपुरःसरम् //
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Permitted by Aditi, the king of the gods properly worshiped
Janārdana with great respect.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dadarśa kṛṣṇo 'pi satyabhāmāsahāyavān
devodyānāni sarvāṇi nandanādīni sattamāḥ //
meaning:
ततो ददर्श कृष्णो ऽपि सत्यभामासहायवान्
देवोद्यानानि सर्वाणि नन्दनादीनि सत्तमाः //
text_mt:
Then Kṛṣṇa too, accompanied by Satyabhāmā, saw
all the divine gardens, Nandana and the others, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa ca sugandhāḍhyaṃ mañjarīpuñjadhāriṇam
śaityāhlādakaraṃ divyaṃ tāmrapallavaśobhitam //
meaning:
ददर्श च सुगन्धाढ्यं मञ्जरीपुञ्जधारिणम्
शैत्याह्लादकरं दिव्यं ताम्रपल्लवशोभितम् //
text_mt:
He also saw [the tree] rich in fragrance, bearing clusters of blossoms,
producing coolness and joy, divine, adorned with copper-colored sprouts,

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamāne 'mṛte jātaṃ jātarūpasamaprabham
pārijātaṃ jagannāthaḥ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha govindaṃ satyabhāmā dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
मथ्यमाने ऽमृते जातं जातरूपसमप्रभम्
पारिजातं जगन्नाथः केशवः केशिसूदनः
तं दृष्ट्वा प्राह गोविन्दं सत्यभामा द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
the Pārijāta, born when the nectar was churned, resembling gold in splendor.
Seeing it, Keśava, slayer of Keśin, Lord of the World—
seeing it, Satyabhāmā spoke to Govinda, O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
satyabhāmovāca
kasmān na dvārakām eṣa nīyate kṛṣṇa pādapaḥ
yadi te tad vacaḥ satyaṃ satyātyarthaṃ priyeti me //
meaning:
सत्यभामोवाच
कस्मान् न द्वारकाम् एष नीयते कृष्ण पादपः
यदि ते तद् वचः सत्यं सत्यात्यर्थं प्रियेति मे //
text_mt:
Satyabhāmā said:
Why is this tree not taken to Dvārakā, O Kṛṣṇa,
if that word of yours is true, that "Satyā is exceedingly dear to me"?

sanskrit_iast:
madgṛhe niṣkuṭārthāya tad ayaṃ nīyatāṃ taruḥ
na me jāmbavatī tādṛg abhīṣṭā na ca rukmiṇī //
meaning:
मद्गृहे निष्कुटार्थाय तद् अयं नीयतां तरुः
न मे जाम्बवती तादृग् अभीष्टा न च रुक्मिणी //
text_mt: Therefore let this tree be taken to my house to serve as a garden tree. / Neither Jāmbavatī nor Rukmiṇī is as dear to me [as you have said].

sanskrit_iast:
satye yathā tvam ity uktaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇāsakṛt priyam
satyaṃ tad yadi govinda nopacārakṛtaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
सत्ये यथा त्वम् इत्य् उक्तं त्वया कृष्णासकृत् प्रियम्
सत्यं तद् यदि गोविन्द नोपचारकृतं वचः //
text_mt: ‘O Satyā, you are dear to me as no other’—as was spoken repeatedly by you, O Kṛṣṇa, / if that was true, O Govinda, and not a statement made out of mere courtesy,

sanskrit_iast:
tad astu pārijāto 'yaṃ mama gehavibhūṣaṇam
bibhratī pārijātasya keśapāśena mañjarīm
sapatnīnām ahaṃ madhye śobheyam iti kāmaye //
meaning:
तद् अस्तु पारिजातो ऽयं मम गेहविभूषणम्
बिभ्रती पारिजातस्य केशपाशेन मञ्जरीम्
सपत्नीनाम् अहं मध्ये शोभेयम् इति कामये //
text_mt: then let this pārijāta tree be the ornament of my house. / Wearing a blossom-cluster of the pārijāta in my braid of hair, / I desire to shine in the midst of my co-wives.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktaḥ sa prahasyainaṃ pārijātaṃ garutmati
āropayām āsa haris tam ūcur vanarakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्तः स प्रहस्यैनं पारिजातं गरुत्मति
आरोपयाम् आस हरिस् तम् ऊचुर् वनरक्षिणः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having been addressed thus, Hari laughed and placed this pārijāta tree upon Garuḍa. / The guardians of the garden said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
vanapālā ūcuḥ
bhoḥ śacī devarājasya mahiṣī tatparigraham
pārijātaṃ na govinda hartum arhasi pādapam //
meaning:
वनपाला ऊचुः
भोः शची देवराजस्य महिषी तत्परिग्रहम्
पारिजातं न गोविन्द हर्तुम् अर्हसि पादपम् //
text_mt: The garden-keepers said: / “Sir, this is the property of Śacī, the queen of the king of gods. / You ought not, O Govinda, to take away this pārijāta tree.

sanskrit_iast:
śacīvibhūṣaṇārthāya devair amṛtamanthane
utpādito 'yaṃ na kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
शचीविभूषणार्थाय देवैर् अमृतमन्थने
उत्पादितो ऽयं न क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: This was produced by the gods at the churning of the nectar for the sake of adorning Śacī; / having taken it, you will not depart safely.

sanskrit_iast:
mauḍhyāt prārthayase kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ ca ko vrajet
avaśyam asya devendro vikṛtiṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyati //
meaning:
मौढ्यात् प्रार्थयसे क्षेमी गृहीत्वैनं च को व्रजेत्
अवश्यम् अस्य देवेन्द्रो विकृतिं कृष्ण यास्यति //
text_mt: Out of foolishness you covet it; who could depart safely having taken it? / Inevitably, O Kṛṣṇa, the lord of gods will become enraged at this.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrodyatakaraṃ śakram anuyāsyanti cāmarāḥ
tad alaṃ sakalair devair vigraheṇa tavācyuta
vipākakaṭu yat karma na tac chaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ //
meaning:
वज्रोद्यतकरं शक्रम् अनुयास्यन्ति चामराः
तद् अलं सकलैर् देवैर् विग्रहेण तवाच्युत
विपाककटु यत् कर्म न तच् छंसन्ति पण्डिताः //
text_mt: And the immortals will follow Śakra whose hand is raised with the vajra. / Therefore, enough of your conflict with all the gods, O Acyuta; / the wise do not praise an action whose consequence is bitter.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity ukte tair uvācaitān satyabhāmātikopinī //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्ते तैर् उवाचैतान् सत्यभामातिकोपिनी //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / When this was spoken by them, Satyabhāmā, extremely angry, said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
satyabhāmovāca
kā śacī pārijātasya ko vā śakraḥ surādhipaḥ
sāmānyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yady eṣo 'mṛtamanthane //
meaning:
सत्यभामोवाच
का शची पारिजातस्य को वा शक्रः सुराधिपः
सामान्यः सर्वलोकानां यद्य् एषो ऽमृतमन्थने //
text_mt: Satyabhāmā said: / “What is Śacī to the pārijāta, or who is Śakra, the ruler of the gods? / If it was produced in the churning of the nectar as the common property of all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
samutpannaḥ purā kasmād eko gṛhṇāti vāsavaḥ
yathā surā yathā cendur yathā śrīr vanarakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
समुत्पन्नः पुरा कस्माद् एको गृह्णाति वासवः
यथा सुरा यथा चेन्दुर् यथा श्रीर् वनरक्षिणः //
text_mt: why in ancient times did Vāsava alone take it? / Just as wine, and just as the moon, and just as Śrī, O guardians of the garden,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaḥ sarvalokasya pārijātas tathā drumaḥ
bhartṛbāhumahāgarvād ruṇaddhy enam atho śacī //
meaning:
सामान्यः सर्वलोकस्य पारिजातस् तथा द्रुमः
भर्तृबाहुमहागर्वाद् रुणद्ध्य् एनम् अथो शची //
text_mt: the pārijāta tree is likewise the common property of the whole world. / Does Śacī now hold it back out of great pride in her husband’s arm?

sanskrit_iast:
tat kathyatāṃ drutaṃ gatvā paulomyā vacanaṃ mama
satyabhāmā vadaty evaṃ bhartṛgarvoddhatākṣaram //
meaning:
तत् कथ्यतां द्रुतं गत्वा पौलोम्या वचनं मम
सत्यभामा वदत्य् एवं भर्तृगर्वोद्धताक्षरम् //
text_mt: Therefore, having gone swiftly, let my words be spoken to Paulomī. / Satyabhāmā speaks thus with words haughty with pride in her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvaṃ dayitā bhartur yadi tasya priyā hy asi
madbhartur harato vṛkṣaṃ tat kāraya nivāraṇam //
meaning:
यदि त्वं दयिता भर्तुर् यदि तस्य प्रिया ह्य् असि
मद्भर्तुर् हरतो वृक्षं तत् कारय निवारणम् //
text_mt: ‘If you are beloved of your husband, if indeed you are dear to him, / then bring about the restraint of my husband as he takes away the tree.

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmi te patiṃ śakraṃ jānāmi tridaśeśvaram
pārijātaṃ tathāpy enaṃ mānuṣī hārayāmi te //
meaning:
जानामि ते पतिं शक्रं जानामि त्रिदशेश्वरम्
पारिजातं तथाप्य् एनं मानुषी हारयामि ते //
text_mt: I know your husband is Śakra; I know he is the lord of the thirty [gods]; / nevertheless, I, a mortal woman, am causing your pārijāta to be taken away!’”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktā rakṣiṇo gatvā proccaiḥ procur yathoditam
śacī cotsāhayām āsa tridaśādhipatiṃ patim //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्ता रक्षिणो गत्वा प्रोच्चैः प्रोचुर् यथोदितम्
शची चोत्साहयाम् आस त्रिदशाधिपतिं पतिम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having been spoken to thus, the guardians went and reported loudly exactly as was said. / And Śacī incited her husband, the ruler of the thirty [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samastadevānāṃ sainyaiḥ parivṛto harim
pravṛktaḥ pārijātārtham indro yodhayituṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
ततः समस्तदेवानां सैन्यैः परिवृतो हरिम्
प्रवृक्तः पारिजातार्थम् इन्द्रो योधयितुं द्विजाः //
text_mt: Then, surrounded by the armies of all the gods, Indra set out / to fight Hari for the sake of the pārijāta, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ parighanistriṃśagadāśūladharāyudhāḥ
babhūvus tridaśāḥ sajjāḥ śakre vajrakare sthite //
meaning:
ततः परिघनिस्त्रिंशगदाशूलधरायुधाः
बभूवुस् त्रिदशाः सज्जाः शक्रे वज्रकरे स्थिते //
text_mt: Then, bearing weapons—iron clubs, swords, maces, and tridents— / the thirty [gods] were ready, with Śakra standing with the vajra in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nirīkṣya govindo nāgarājopari sthitam
śakraṃ devaparīvāraṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam //
meaning:
ततो निरीक्ष्य गोविन्दो नागराजोपरि स्थितम्
शक्रं देवपरीवारं युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् //
text_mt: Then Govinda, seeing Śakra mounted upon the king of elephants, / accompanied by the host of gods and arrived for battle,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra śaṅkhanirghoṣaṃ diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan
mumoca ca śaravrātaṃ sahasrāyutasaṃmitam //
meaning:
चकार शङ्खनिर्घोषं दिशः शब्देन पूरयन्
मुमोच च शरव्रातं सहस्रायुतसंमितम् //
text_mt: made the sound of his conch, filling the directions with the roar, / and loosed a swarm of arrows numbered in thousands and tens of thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
tato diśo nabhaś caiva dṛṣṭvā śaraśatācitam
mumucus tridaśāḥ sarve śastrāṇy astrāṇy anekaśaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दिशो नभश् चैव दृष्ट्वा शरशताचितम्
मुमुचुस् त्रिदशाः सर्वे शस्त्राण्य् अस्त्राण्य् अनेकशः //
text_mt: Then, seeing the directions and the sky covered with hundreds of arrows, / all the thirty [gods] loosed numerous close-combat and missile weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikam astraṃ śastraṃ ca devair muktaṃ sahasradhā
ciccheda līlayaiveśo jagatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
एकैकम् अस्त्रं शस्त्रं च देवैर् मुक्तं सहस्रधा
चिच्छेद लीलयैवेशो जगतां मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Each single missile and hand-held weapon released by the gods / the lord of the worlds, Madhusūdana, effortlessly cut into a thousand pieces.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśaṃ salilarājasya samākṛṣyoragāśanaḥ
cacāla khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛttvā bālapannagadehavat //
meaning:
पाशं सलिलराजस्य समाकृष्योरगाशनः
चचाल खण्डशः कृत्त्वा बालपन्नगदेहवत् //
text_mt: Having pulled away the noose of the king of waters, [Garuḍa] the devourer of snakes / marched forth having cut it into pieces like the body of a young serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
yamena prahitaṃ daṇḍaṃ gadāprakṣepakhaṇḍitam
pṛthivyāṃ pātayām āsa bhagavān devakīsutaḥ //
meaning:
यमेन प्रहितं दण्डं गदाप्रक्षेपखण्डितम्
पृथिव्यां पातयाम् आस भगवान् देवकीसुतः //
text_mt: The blessed son of Devakī caused the staff hurled by Yama, / broken by a throw of his mace, to fall to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śibikāṃ ca dhaneśasya cakreṇa tilaśo vibhuḥ
cakāra śaurir arkendū dṛṣṭipātahataujasau //
meaning:
शिबिकां च धनेशस्य चक्रेण तिलशो विभुः
चकार शौरिर् अर्केन्दू दृष्टिपातहतौजसौ //
text_mt: And with his discus the all-pervading lord [cut] the palanquin of the lord of wealth into sesame-sized pieces; / Śauri stripped the sun and the moon of their splendor with a mere glance.

sanskrit_iast:
nīto 'gniḥ śataśo bāṇair drāvitā vasavo diśaḥ
cakravicchinnaśūlāgrā rudrā bhuvi nipātitāḥ //
meaning:
नीतो ऽग्निः शतशो बाणैर् द्राविता वसवो दिशः
चक्रविच्छिन्नशूलाग्रा रुद्रा भुवि निपातिताः //
text_mt: Agni was driven off by hundreds of arrows; the Vasus were scattered in all directions; / the Rudras, the tips of their tridents severed by the discus, were thrown down to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyā viśve ca maruto gandharvāś caiva sāyakaiḥ
śārṅgiṇā preritāḥ sarve vyomni śālmalitūlavat //
meaning:
साध्या विश्वे च मरुतो गन्धर्वाश् चैव सायकैः
शार्ङ्गिणा प्रेरिताः सर्वे व्योम्नि शाल्मलितूलवत् //
text_mt: The Sādhyas, the Viśvedevas, the Maruts, and the Gandharvas / were all driven into the sky by the arrows of the bowman like cotton from a silk-cotton tree.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍaś cāpi vaktreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ ca nakhāṅkuraiḥ
bhakṣayann ahanad devān dānavāṃś ca sadā khagaḥ //
meaning:
गरुडश् चापि वक्त्रेण पक्षाभ्यां च नखाङ्कुरैः
भक्षयन्न् अहनद् देवान् दानवांश् च सदा खगः //
text_mt: And Garuḍa the bird, with his beak, with his two wings, and with his sharp talons, / smote the gods and devoured the Dānavas as always.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa devendramadhusūdanau
parasparaṃ vavarṣāte dhārābhir iva toyadau //
meaning:
ततः शरसहस्रेण देवेन्द्रमधुसूदनौ
परस्परं ववर्षाते धाराभिर् इव तोयदौ //
text_mt: Then the ruler of the gods and Madhusūdana rained upon each other / with thousands of arrows, like two clouds with torrents [of rain].

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatena garuḍo yuyudhe tatra saṃkule
devaiḥ sametair yuyudhe śakreṇa ca janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतेन गरुडो युयुधे तत्र संकुले
देवैः समेतैर् युयुधे शक्रेण च जनार्दनः //
text_mt: There in that melee Garuḍa fought with Airāvata; / Janārdana fought with Śakra and the assembled gods.

sanskrit_iast:
chinneṣu śīryamāṇeṣu śastreṣv astreṣu satvaram
jagrāha vāsavo vajraṃ kṛṣṇaś cakraṃ sudarśanam //
meaning:
छिन्नेषु शीर्यमाणेषु शस्त्रेष्व् अस्त्रेषु सत्वरम्
जग्राह वासवो वज्रं कृष्णश् चक्रं सुदर्शनम् //
text_mt: When their weapons and missiles were cut and shattered, swiftly / Vāsava seized his vajra and Kṛṣṇa the discus Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
vajracakradharau dṛṣṭvā devarājajanārdanau //
meaning:
ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
वज्रचक्रधरौ दृष्ट्वा देवराजजनार्दनौ //
text_mt: Then a cry of woe arose from the entire three worlds with all that moves and is still, / seeing the king of gods and Janārdana bearing the vajra and the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣiptaṃ vajram athendreṇa jagrāha bhagavān hariḥ
na mumoca tadā cakraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt //
meaning:
क्षिप्तं वज्रम् अथेन्द्रेण जग्राह भगवान् हरिः
न मुमोच तदा चक्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then the blessed lord Hari caught the vajra hurled by Indra; / he did not release his discus then, but said, “Halt! Halt!”

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭavajraṃ devendraṃ garuḍakṣatavāhanam
satyabhāmābravīd vākyaṃ palāyanaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
प्रनष्टवज्रं देवेन्द्रं गरुडक्षतवाहनम्
सत्यभामाब्रवीद् वाक्यं पलायनपरायणम् //
text_mt: To the king of gods, whose vajra was lost, whose mount was wounded by Garuḍa, / and who was bent on flight, Satyabhāmā spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
satyabhāmovāca
trailokyeśvara no yuktaṃ śacībhartuḥ palāyanam
pārijātasragābhogāt tvām upasthāsyate śacī //
meaning:
सत्यभामोवाच
त्रैलोक्येश्वर नो युक्तं शचीभर्तुः पलायनम्
पारिजातस्रगाभोगात् त्वाम् उपस्थास्यते शची //
text_mt: Satyabhāmā said: / “O lord of the three worlds, flight is not proper for the husband of Śacī! / Śacī will attend upon you on account of the expanse of the pārijāta garland.

sanskrit_iast:
kīdṛśaṃ deva rājyaṃ te pārijātasragujjvalām
apaśyato yathāpūrvaṃ praṇayābhyāgatāṃ śacīm //
meaning:
कीदृशं देव राज्यं ते पारिजातस्रगुज्ज्वलाम्
अपश्यतो यथापूर्वं प्रणयाभ्यागतां शचीम् //
text_mt: What kind of sovereignty is yours, O god, if you do not see Śacī, / radiant with a garland of pārijāta, approach in love as before?

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ śakra prayāsena na vrīḍāṃ yātum arhasi
nīyatāṃ pārijāto 'yaṃ devāḥ santu gatavyathāḥ //
meaning:
अलं शक्र प्रयासेन न व्रीडां यातुम् अर्हसि
नीयतां पारिजातो ऽयं देवाः सन्तु गतव्यथाः //
text_mt: Enough of your effort, O Śakra; you ought not to feel shame. / Let this pārijāta be taken; let the gods be freed from grief.

sanskrit_iast:
patigarvāvalepena bahumānapuraḥsaram
na dadarśa gṛhāyātām upacāreṇa māṃ śacī //
meaning:
पतिगर्वावलेपेन बहुमानपुरःसरम्
न ददर्श गृहायाताम् उपचारेण मां शची //
text_mt: Out of pride in her husband, Śacī did not receive me with courtesy / accompanied by great honor when I came to her house.

sanskrit_iast:
strītvād agurucittāhaṃ svabhartuḥ ślāghanāparā
tataḥ kṛtavatī śakra bhavatā saha vigraham //
meaning:
स्त्रीत्वाद् अगुरुचित्ताहं स्वभर्तुः श्लाघनापरा
ततः कृतवती शक्र भवता सह विग्रहम् //
text_mt: Because of my womanhood, being light-minded, and devoted to praising my own husband, / I therefore entered into a dispute with you, O Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tad alaṃ pārijātena parasvena hṛtena vā
rūpeṇa yaśasā caiva bhavet strī kā na garvitā //
meaning:
तद् अलं पारिजातेन परस्वेन हृतेन वा
रूपेण यशसा चैव भवेत् स्त्री का न गर्विता //
text_mt: Therefore, enough of the pārijāta or of taking the property of another! / What woman would not be proud of beauty and renown?”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity ukte vai nivavṛte devarājas tayā dvijāḥ
prāha cainām alaṃ caṇḍi sakhi khedātivistaraiḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्ते वै निववृते देवराजस् तया द्विजाः
प्राह चैनाम् अलं चण्डि सखि खेदातिविस्तरैः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / When this was spoken by her, the king of gods turned back, O twice-born, / and said to her: “Enough, O passionate one, my friend, of excessive outpourings of grief!

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi sargasaṃhārasthitikartākhilasya yaḥ
jitasya tena me vrīḍā jāyate viśvarūpiṇā //
meaning:
न चापि सर्गसंहारस्थितिकर्ताखिलस्य यः
जितस्य तेन मे व्रीडा जायते विश्वरूपिणा //
text_mt: Nor does shame arise in me at being conquered by him / who is the creator of the primary creation, destruction, and preservation of all, whose form is the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiñ jagat sakalam etad anādimadhye
yasmād yataś ca na bhaviṣyati sarvabhūtāt
tenodbhavapralayapālanakāraṇena
vrīḍā kathaṃ bhavati devi nirākṛtasya
meaning:
यस्मिञ् जगत् सकलम् एतद् अनादिमध्ये
यस्माद् यतश् च न भविष्यति सर्वभूतात्
तेनोद्भवप्रलयपालनकारणेन
व्रीडा कथं भवति देवि निराकृतस्य
text_mt: In whom is this entire world, who has neither beginning nor middle, / from whom and because of whom it exists, the source of all beings— / how can shame arise for one repulsed by him, / the cause of origination, dissolution, and preservation, O goddess?

sanskrit_iast:
sakalabhuvanamūrtir alpā susūkṣmā
viditasakalavedair jñāyate yasya nānyaiḥ
tam ajam akṛtam īśaṃ śāśvataṃ svecchayainaṃ
jagadupakṛtim ādyaṃ ko vijetuṃ samarthaḥ
meaning:
सकलभुवनमूर्तिर् अल्पा सुसूक्ष्मा
विदितसकलवेदैर् ज्ञायते यस्य नान्यैः
तम् अजम् अकृतम् ईशं शाश्वतं स्वेच्छयैनं
जगदुपकृतिम् आद्यं को विजेतुं समर्थः
text_mt: Whose form is the entire world, and who is small and exceedingly subtle, / known by those who know all the Vedas and not by others— / who is capable of conquering that unborn, uncreated, eternal Lord, / who out of his own will brings about the welfare of the world, the primeval one?”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
saṃstuto bhagavān itthaṃ devarājena keśavaḥ
prahasya bhāvagambhīram uvācedaṃ dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
संस्तुतो भगवान् इत्थं देवराजेन केशवः
प्रहस्य भावगम्भीरम् उवाचेदं द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having been praised thus by the king of gods, the blessed Keśava, / laughing, spoke these words profound with meaning, O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavān uvāca
devarājo bhavān indro vayaṃ martyā jagatpate
kṣantavyaṃ bhavataivaitad aparādhakṛtaṃ mama //
meaning:
श्रीभगवान् उवाच
देवराजो भवान् इन्द्रो वयं मर्त्या जगत्पते
क्षन्तव्यं भवतैवैतद् अपराधकृतं मम //
text_mt: The blessed lord said: / “You are Indra, the king of the gods; we are mortals, O lord of the world. / This transgression committed by me must surely be forgiven by you.”

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātataruś cāyaṃ nīyatām ucitāspadam
gṛhīto 'yaṃ mayā śakra satyāvacanakāraṇāt //
meaning:
पारिजाततरुश् चायं नीयताम् उचितास्पदम्
गृहीतो ऽयं मया शक्र सत्यावचनकारणात् //
text_mt: "And let this pārijāta tree be taken to its proper abode; / it was taken by me, O Śakra, on account of Satyā's word.

sanskrit_iast:
vajraṃ cedaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ prahitaṃ tvayā
tavaivaitat praharaṇaṃ śakra vairividāraṇam //
meaning:
वज्रं चेदं गृहाण त्वं यष्टव्यं प्रहितं त्वया
तवैवैतत् प्रहरणं शक्र वैरिविदारणम् //
text_mt: And take this thunderbolt, which was hurled by you; / this weapon that splits enemies belongs to you alone, O Śakra."

sanskrit_iast:
śakra uvāca
vimohayasi mām īśa martyo 'ham iti kiṃ vadan
jānīmas tvāṃ bhagavato 'nantasaukhyavido vayam //
meaning:
शक्र उवाच
विमोहयसि माम् ईश मर्त्यो ऽहम् इति किं वदन्
जानीमस् त्वां भगवतो ऽनन्तसौख्यविदो वयम् //
text_mt: Śakra said: / "Why do you bewilder me, O Lord, saying 'I am a mortal'? / We know you to be the Lord who knows infinite bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'si so 'si jagannātha pravṛttau nātha saṃsthitaḥ
jagataḥ śalyaniṣkarṣaṃ karoṣy asurasūdana //
meaning:
यो ऽसि सो ऽसि जगन्नाथ प्रवृत्तौ नाथ संस्थितः
जगतः शल्यनिष्कर्षं करोष्य् असुरसूदन //
text_mt: Whoever you are, you are that, O Lord of the world, established in active life, O Master! / You remove the thorn of the world, O slayer of asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
nīyatāṃ pārijāto 'yaṃ kṛṣṇa dvāravatīṃ purīm
martyaloke tvayā mukte nāyaṃ saṃsthāsyate bhuvi //
meaning:
नीयतां पारिजातो ऽयं कृष्ण द्वारवतीं पुरीम्
मर्त्यलोके त्वया मुक्ते नायं संस्थास्यते भुवि //
text_mt: Let this pārijāta be taken to the city of Dvāravatī, O Kṛṣṇa; / when the mortal world has been abandoned by you, it will not remain on earth."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tathety uktvā tu devendram ājagāma bhuvaṃ hariḥ
prayuktaiḥ siddhagandharvaiḥ stūyamānas tv atharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तथेत्य् उक्त्वा तु देवेन्द्रम् आजगाम भुवं हरिः
प्रयुक्तैः सिद्धगन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानस् त्व् अथर्षिभिः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having said 'So be it' to the king of the gods, Hari came to the earth, / being praised by assembled siddhas and gandharvas, and by the ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma kṛṣṇaḥ sahasā gṛhītvā pādapottamam
tataḥ śaṅkham upādhmāya dvārakopari saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
जगाम कृष्णः सहसा गृहीत्वा पादपोत्तमम्
ततः शङ्खम् उपाध्माय द्वारकोपरि संस्थितः //
text_mt: Taking the best of trees, Kṛṣṇa went swiftly; / then, having blown his conch, standing above Dvārakā,

sanskrit_iast:
harṣam utpādayām āsa dvārakāvāsināṃ dvijāḥ
avatīryātha garuḍāt satyabhāmāsahāyavān //
meaning:
हर्षम् उत्पादयाम् आस द्वारकावासिनां द्विजाः
अवतीर्याथ गरुडात् सत्यभामासहायवान् //
text_mt: he caused joy to the inhabitants of Dvārakā, O twice-born ones; / and having descended from Garuḍa, accompanied by Satyabhāmā,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkuṭe sthāpayām āsa pārijātaṃ mahātarum
yam abhyetya janaḥ sarvo jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm //
meaning:
निष्कुटे स्थापयाम् आस पारिजातं महातरुम्
यम् अभ्येत्य जनः सर्वो जातिं स्मरति पौर्विकीम् //
text_mt: he planted the great pārijāta tree in the pleasure garden; / approaching which, every person remembers their previous birth,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsyate yasya puṣpāṇāṃ gandhenorvī triyojanam
tatas te yādavāḥ sarve devagandhān amānuṣān //
meaning:
वास्यते यस्य पुष्पाणां गन्धेनोर्वी त्रियोजनम्
ततस् ते यादवाः सर्वे देवगन्धान् अमानुषान् //
text_mt: and by the fragrance of whose flowers the earth is perfumed for three yojanas. / Then all those Yādavas beheld divine, superhuman fragrances

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśuḥ pādape tasmin kurvato mukhadarśanam
kiṃkaraiḥ samupānītaṃ hastyaśvādi tato dhanam //
meaning:
ददृशुः पादपे तस्मिन् कुर्वतो मुखदर्शनम्
किंकरैः समुपानीतं हस्त्यश्वादि ततो धनम् //
text_mt: showing their appearance upon that tree. / Then, from the possessions of Naraka, the wealth such as elephants, horses, and the like, brought by servants,

sanskrit_iast:
striyaś ca kṛṣṇo jagrāha narakasya parigrahāt
tataḥ kāle śubhe prāpta upayeme janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रियश् च कृष्णो जग्राह नरकस्य परिग्रहात्
ततः काले शुभे प्राप्त उपयेमे जनार्दनः //
text_mt: and the women, Kṛṣṇa took; / then, when an auspicious time arrived, Janārdana married

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ kanyā narakāvāsāt sarvato yāḥ samāhṛtāḥ
ekasminn eva govindaḥ kālenāsāṃ dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
ताः कन्या नरकावासात् सर्वतो याः समाहृताः
एकस्मिन्न् एव गोविन्दः कालेनासां द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: those maidens who had been carried off from everywhere to Naraka's dwelling; / at a single time, Govinda, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha vidhivat pāṇīn pṛthagdehe svadharmataḥ
ṣoḍaśa strīsahasrāṇi śatam ekaṃ tathādhikam //
meaning:
जग्राह विधिवत् पाणीन् पृथग्देहे स्वधर्मतः
षोडश स्त्रीसहस्राणि शतम् एकं तथाधिकम् //
text_mt: took their hands according to the ritual rule, in separate bodies, according to his own dharma; / sixteen thousand women, and one hundred more besides:

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanti cakre rūpāṇi bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ
ekaikaśaś ca tāḥ kanyā menire madhusūdanam //
meaning:
तावन्ति चक्रे रूपाणि भगवान् मधुसूदनः
एकैकशश् च ताः कन्या मेनिरे मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: the blessed Lord, the slayer of Madhu, assumed so many forms; / and one by one those maidens thought of the slayer of Madhu:

sanskrit_iast:
mamaiva pāṇigrahaṇaṃ govindaḥ kṛtavān iti
niśāsu jagataḥ sraṣṭā tāsāṃ geheṣu keśavaḥ
uvāsa viprāḥ sarvāsāṃ viśvarūpadharo hariḥ //
meaning:
ममैव पाणिग्रहणं गोविन्दः कृतवान् इति
निशासु जगतः स्रष्टा तासां गेहेषु केशवः
उवास विप्राः सर्वासां विश्वरूपधरो हरिः //
text_mt: "Govinda took my hand alone." / In the nights, the creator of the world, Keśava, / dwelt in the houses of all of them, O brāhmaṇas, Hari bearing universal forms.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
pradyumnādyā hareḥ putrā rukmiṇyāṃ kathitā dvijāḥ
bhānvādikāṃś ca vai putrān satyabhāmā vyajāyata //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
प्रद्युम्नाद्या हरेः पुत्रा रुक्मिण्यां कथिता द्विजाः
भान्वादिकांश् च वै पुत्रान् सत्यभामा व्यजायत //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Pradyumna and the other sons of Hari born of Rukmiṇī have been told, O twice-born ones; / and Satyabhāmā gave birth to Bhānu and other sons.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptimantaḥ prapakṣādyā rohiṇyās tanayā hareḥ
babhūvur jāmbavatyāś ca sāmbādyā bāhuśālinaḥ //
meaning:
दीप्तिमन्तः प्रपक्षाद्या रोहिण्यास् तनया हरेः
बभूवुर् जाम्बवत्याश् च साम्बाद्या बाहुशालिनः //
text_mt: Dīptimat, Prapakṣa, and others were the splendid sons of Rohiṇī by Hari; / and born of Jāmbavatī were Sāmba and others, possessed of strong arms.

sanskrit_iast:
tanayā bhadravindādyā nāgnajityāṃ mahābalāḥ
saṃgrāmajitpradhānās tu śaibyāyāṃ cābhavan sutāḥ //
meaning:
तनया भद्रविन्दाद्या नाग्नजित्यां महाबलाः
संग्रामजित्प्रधानास् तु शैब्यायां चाभवन् सुताः //
text_mt: Bhadravinda and other sons born of Nāgnajitī were mighty; / and those born of Śaibyā had Saṃgrāmajit as the chief.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkādyās tu sutā mādrī gātravatpramukhān sutān
avāpa lakṣmaṇā putrān kālindyāś ca śrutādayaḥ //
meaning:
वृकाद्यास् तु सुता माद्री गात्रवत्प्रमुखान् सुतान्
अवाप लक्ष्मणा पुत्रान् कालिन्द्याश् च श्रुतादयः //
text_mt: Mādrī obtained sons such as Vṛka, Lakṣmaṇā bore sons headed by Gātravat, / and from Kālindī came Śruta and others.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāsāṃ caiva bhāryāṇāṃ samutpannāni cakriṇaḥ
aṣṭāyutāni putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi śataṃ tathā //
meaning:
अन्यासां चैव भार्याणां समुत्पन्नानि चक्रिणः
अष्टायुतानि पुत्राणां सहस्राणि शतं तथा //
text_mt: And to the wielder of the discus from his other wives were born / eighty thousand sons, and a thousand, and a hundred.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnaḥ pramukhas teṣāṃ rukmiṇyās tu sutas tataḥ
pradyumnād aniruddho 'bhūd vajras tasmād ajāyata //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नः प्रमुखस् तेषां रुक्मिण्यास् तु सुतस् ततः
प्रद्युम्नाद् अनिरुद्धो ऽभूद् वज्रस् तस्माद् अजायत //
text_mt: Pradyumna was chief among them, the son born of Rukmiṇī; / from Pradyumna came Aniruddha, and from him Vajra was born.

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddho raṇe ruddho baleḥ pautrīṃ mahābalaḥ
bāṇasya tanayām ūṣām upayeme dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
अनिरुद्धो रणे रुद्धो बलेः पौत्रीं महाबलः
बाणस्य तनयाम् ऊषाम् उपयेमे द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The mighty Aniruddha, besieged in battle, married the granddaughter of Bali, / the daughter of Bāṇa, named Uṣā, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yuddham abhūd ghoraṃ hariśaṃkarayor mahat
chinnaṃ sahasraṃ bāhūnāṃ yatra bāṇasya cakriṇā //
meaning:
यत्र युद्धम् अभूद् घोरं हरिशंकरयोर् महत्
छिन्नं सहस्रं बाहूनां यत्र बाणस्य चक्रिणा //
text_mt: where a dreadful, great battle took place between Hari and Śaṅkara, / where a thousand arms of Bāṇa were cut off by the wielder of the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ yuddham abhūd brahmann uṣārthe harakṛṣṇayoḥ
kathaṃ kṣayaṃ ca bāṇasya bāhūnāṃ kṛtavān hariḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
कथं युद्धम् अभूद् ब्रह्मन्न् उषार्थे हरकृष्णयोः
कथं क्षयं च बाणस्य बाहूनां कृतवान् हरिः //
text_mt: The sages said: / How did the battle take place, O holy one, for the sake of Uṣā between Hara and Kṛṣṇa? / And how did Hari bring about the destruction of Bāṇa's arms?

sanskrit_iast:
etat sarvaṃ mahābhāga vaktum arhasi no 'khilam
mahat kautūhalaṃ jātaṃ śrotum etāṃ kathāṃ śubhām //
meaning:
एतत् सर्वं महाभाग वक्तुम् अर्हसि नो ऽखिलम्
महत् कौतूहलं जातं श्रोतुम् एतां कथां शुभाम् //
text_mt: You ought to tell all this completely to us, O fortunate one; / a great curiosity has arisen to hear this auspicious tale.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
uṣā bāṇasutā viprāḥ pārvatīṃ śaṃbhunā saha
krīḍantīm upalakṣyoccaiḥ spṛhāṃ cakre tadā svayam
tataḥ sakalacittajñā gaurī tām āha bhāminīm //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
उषा बाणसुता विप्राः पार्वतीं शंभुना सह
क्रीडन्तीम् उपलक्ष्योच्चैः स्पृहां चक्रे तदा स्वयम्
ततः सकलचित्तज्ञा गौरी ताम् आह भामिनीम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / O brāhmaṇas, Uṣā, the daughter of Bāṇa, seeing Pārvatī / sporting with Śambhu, herself felt a strong longing; / then Gaurī, who knows the minds of all, said to that lovely woman:

sanskrit_iast:
gaury uvāca
alam ity anutāpena bhartrā tvam api raṃsyase //
meaning:
गौर्य् उवाच
अलम् इत्य् अनुतापेन भर्त्रा त्वम् अपि रंस्यसे //
text_mt: Gaurī said: / "Enough with grief! You too will take pleasure with a husband."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ity uktā sā tadā cakre kadeti matim ātmanaḥ
ko vā bhartā mamety enāṃ punar apy āha pārvatī //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्य् उक्ता सा तदा चक्रे कदेति मतिम् आत्मनः
को वा भर्ता ममेत्य् एनां पुनर् अप्य् आह पार्वती //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having been addressed thus, she then wondered to herself, 'When? / Or who will my husband be?' To her, Pārvatī spoke again:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvaty uvāca
vaiśākhe śukladvādaśyāṃ svapne yo 'bhibhavaṃ tava
kariṣyati sa te bhartā rājaputri bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
पार्वत्य् उवाच
वैशाखे शुक्लद्वादश्यां स्वप्ने यो ऽभिभवं तव
करिष्यति स ते भर्ता राजपुत्रि भविष्यति //
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / "He who will overpower you in a dream on the twelfth day of the bright half of Vaiśākha, / he shall be your husband, O princess."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tasyāṃ tithau pumān svapne yathā devyā udīritaḥ
tathaivābhibhavaṃ cakre rāgaṃ cakre ca tatra sā
tataḥ prabuddhā puruṣam apaśyantī tam utsukā //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तस्यां तिथौ पुमान् स्वप्ने यथा देव्या उदीरितः
तथैवाभिभवं चक्रे रागं चक्रे च तत्र सा
ततः प्रबुद्धा पुरुषम् अपश्यन्ती तम् उत्सुका //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / On that lunar day, a man in a dream, just as described by the goddess, / overpowered her in that very manner, and she fell in love with him; / then, having awakened, not seeing that man, longing,

sanskrit_iast:
uṣovāca
kva gato 'sīti nirlajjā dvijāś coktavatī sakhīm
bāṇasya mantrī kumbhāṇḍaś citralekhā tu tatsutā //
meaning:
उषोवाच
क्व गतो ऽसीति निर्लज्जा द्विजाश् चोक्तवती सखीम्
बाणस्य मन्त्री कुम्भाण्डश् चित्रलेखा तु तत्सुता //
text_mt: Uṣā said: / "Where have you gone?" Thus, shameless, she spoke to her female companion, O twice-born ones. / Bāṇa's minister was Kumbhāṇḍa, and Citralekhā was his daughter;

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ sakhy abhavat sā ca prāha ko 'yaṃ tvayocyate
yadā lajjākulā nāsya kathayām āsa sā sakhī //
meaning:
तस्याः सख्य् अभवत् सा च प्राह को ऽयं त्वयोच्यते
यदा लज्जाकुला नास्य कथयाम् आस सा सखी //
text_mt: she was her companion, and she said: "Who is this spoken of by you?" / When that friend, overcome with modesty, did not tell,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā viśvāsam ānīya sarvam evānvavedayat
viditāyāṃ tu tām āha punar ūṣā yathoditam
devyā tathaiva tatprāptau yo 'bhyupāyaḥ kuruṣva tam //
meaning:
तदा विश्वासम् आनीय सर्वम् एवान्ववेदयत्
विदितायां तु ताम् आह पुनर् ऊषा यथोदितम्
देव्या तथैव तत्प्राप्तौ यो ऽभ्युपायः कुरुष्व तम् //
text_mt: then, having gained her trust, she revealed everything. / When it was known, Uṣā spoke to her again: "Just as it was stated / by the goddess, so whatever means there is to attain him, employ that."

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tataḥ paṭe surān daityān gandharvāṃś ca pradhānataḥ
manuṣyāṃś cābhilikhyāsau citralekhāpy adarśayat //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततः पटे सुरान् दैत्यान् गन्धर्वांश् च प्रधानतः
मनुष्यांश् चाभिलिख्यासौ चित्रलेखाप्य् अदर्शयत् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Then, having painted the gods, the daityas, and the gandharvas foremost, / and the mortals on a canvas, Citralekhā showed them.

sanskrit_iast:
apāsya sā tu gandharvāṃs tathoragasurāsurān
manuṣyeṣu dadau dṛṣṭiṃ teṣv apy andhakavṛṣṇiṣu //
meaning:
अपास्य सा तु गन्धर्वांस् तथोरगसुरासुरान्
मनुष्येषु ददौ दृष्टिं तेष्व् अप्य् अन्धकवृष्णिषु //
text_mt: Setting aside the gandharvas, the uragas, the suras, and the asuras, / she fixed her gaze upon the mortals, and among them too, upon the Andhakas and Vṛṣṇis.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇarāmau vilokyāsīt subhrūr lajjāyatekṣaṇā
pradyumnadarśane vrīḍādṛṣṭiṃ ninye tato dvijāḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णरामौ विलोक्यासीत् सुभ्रूर् लज्जायतेक्षणा
प्रद्युम्नदर्शने व्रीडादृष्टिं निन्ये ततो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Beholding Kṛṣṇa and Rāma, the fair-browed girl became shy-eyed; / at the sight of Pradyumna, she turned her eyes away with embarrassment, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ ca tato lajjā kvāpi nirākṛtā
so 'yaṃ so 'yaṃ mamety ukte tayā sā yogagāminī
yayau dvāravatīm ūṣāṃ samāśvāsya tataḥ sakhī //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वानिरुद्धं च ततो लज्जा क्वापि निराकृता
सो ऽयं सो ऽयं ममेत्य् उक्ते तया सा योगगामिनी
ययौ द्वारवतीम् ऊषां समाश्वास्य ततः सखी //
text_mt: And then, having seen Aniruddha, all shame was cast aside; / when she said, "It is he! It is he! He is mine!", that female companion who traveled by yoga, / having comforted Uṣā, then went to Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
bāṇo 'pi praṇipatyāgre tataś cāha trilocanam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
बाणो ऽपि प्रणिपत्याग्रे ततश् चाह त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Bāṇa too, having bowed down before the three-eyed Lord, said:

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇa uvāca
deva bāhusahasreṇa nirviṇṇo 'haṃ vināhavam
kaccin mamaiṣāṃ bāhūnāṃ sāphalyakaraṇo raṇaḥ
bhaviṣyati vinā yuddhaṃ bhārāya mama kiṃ bhujaiḥ //
meaning:
बाण उवाच
देव बाहुसहस्रेण निर्विण्णो ऽहं विनाहवम्
कच्चिन् ममैषां बाहूनां साफल्यकरणो रणः
भविष्यति विना युद्धं भाराय मम किं भुजैः //
text_mt:
Bāṇa said:
O god, I am weary of these thousand arms without a combat.
Will there ever be a battle for me that makes these arms fruitful?
Without war, why are my arms a burden to me?

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca
mayūradhvajabhaṅgas te yadā bāṇa bhaviṣyati
piśitāśijanānandaṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ tadā raṇam //
meaning:
शंकर उवाच
मयूरध्वजभङ्गस् ते यदा बाण भविष्यति
पिशिताशिजनानन्दं प्राप्स्यसि त्वं तदा रणम् //
text_mt:
Śaṅkara said:
When the destruction of your peacock-banner occurs, O Bāṇa,
then you shall obtain a battle that brings delight to flesh-eaters.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tataḥ praṇamya muditaḥ śaṃbhum abhyāgato gṛhāt
bhagnaṃ dhvajam athālokya hṛṣṭo harṣaṃ paraṃ yayau //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
ततः प्रणम्य मुदितः शंभुम् अभ्यागतो गृहात्
भग्नं ध्वजम् अथालोक्य हृष्टो हर्षं परं ययौ //

sanskrit_iast:
etasminn eva kāle tu yogavidyābalena tam
aniruddham athāninye citralekhā varā sakhī //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्न् एव काले तु योगविद्याबलेन तम्
अनिरुद्धम् अथानिन्ये चित्रलेखा वरा सखी //
text_mt:
At that very time, by the power of the science of yoga,
Citralekhā, the excellent friend, brought that Aniruddha.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāntaḥpuramadhye taṃ ramamāṇaṃ sahoṣayā
vijñāya rakṣiṇo gatvā śaśaṃsur daityabhūpateḥ //
meaning:
कन्यान्तःपुरमध्ये तं रममाणं सहोषया
विज्ञाय रक्षिणो गत्वा शशंसुर् दैत्यभूपतेः //
text_mt:
Perceiving him sporting with Uṣā in the inner apartments of the maidens,
the guards went and reported it to the Daitya king.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādiṣṭaṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ tu sainyaṃ tena mahātmanā
jaghāna parighaṃ lauham ādāya paravīrahā //
meaning:
व्यादिष्टं किंकराणां तु सैन्यं तेन महात्मना
जघान परिघं लौहम् आदाय परवीरहा //
text_mt:
The army of servants dispatched by that high-souled one
the slayer of enemy heroes struck down, taking up an iron club.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣu teṣu bāṇo 'pi rathasthas tadvadhodyataḥ
yudhyamāno yathāśakti yadā vīreṇa nirjitaḥ //
meaning:
हतेषु तेषु बाणो ऽपि रथस्थस् तद्वधोद्यतः
युध्यमानो यथाशक्ति यदा वीरेण निर्जितः //
text_mt:
When they were slain, Bāṇa too, stationed on his chariot, set upon killing him;
while fighting according to his ability, when he was vanquished by the hero,

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā yuyudhe tena sa tadā mantracoditaḥ
tataś ca pannagāstreṇa babandha yadunandanam //
meaning:
मायया युयुधे तेन स तदा मन्त्रचोदितः
ततश् च पन्नगास्त्रेण बबन्ध यदुनन्दनम् //
text_mt:
he then fought with illusory power, impelled by incantations,
and then bound the delight of the Yadus with the serpent-missile.

sanskrit_iast:
